The government answered that the RIVM and a signalling consultation monitor zoonotic risks, that biosecurity and culling measures apply, and that VWS and LNV share responsibilities under separate legal frameworks.
As indicated in my answer to question 5, we monitor the zoonotic risk closely.
Zoals aangegeven in mijn antwoord op vraag 5, volgen we het zoönotische risico intensief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de razendsnelle verspreiding van het vogelgriepvirus over Nederland

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the rapid spread of highly pathogenic avian influenza, the origin of such viruses in poultry farming, the culling of poultry by gassing, the lack of a nationwide hunting ban, and whether the government will reduce livestock numbers to limit zoonotic risk. The Minister answers most questions factually, defends the terminology and biosecurity measures, rejects a nationwide hunting ban as having limited effect, and says a broader expert group will examine zoonosis prevention.

The cabinet will, together with an expert group to be established, map out what is needed across public health, animal health and the environment to reduce as far as possible the risk of zoonoses arising.

Het kabinet zal daartoe samen met een expertgroep die ingesteld zal worden in beeld brengen wat nodig is in de breedte van volksgezondheid, diergezondheid en milieu om het risico op het ontstaan van zoönosen zoveel mogelijk te verkleinen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de nog altijd voortdurende dreiging van het coronavirus in de vleesindustrie

MP Ouwehand asked the ministers whether they would prevent meat processor Vion from raising slaughter rates and why no intervention followed at Vion and Van Rooi Meat, and asked about coronavirus transmission via meat and the scope of slaughterhouse testing. The minister replied that slaughter hours were only temporarily reduced and are returning to normal, that the safety region judged the situations safe enough and acted case by case, and that testing is risk-based and scientific evidence shows food transmission is very unlikely.
It is up to the chair of the safety region, within infectious disease control, to take the most suitable control measures case by case.
Het is aan de voorzitter van de veiligheidsregio in het kader van infectieziektenbestrijding om per geval de meest geëigende (beheers)maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de waarschuwing dat de gemuteerde varianten van het coronavirus die rondgaan in de nertsenfokkerij, ongevoelig zijn voor de ontwikkelde vaccins

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether mink-derived SARS-CoV-2 variants found in Denmark could make COVID-19 vaccines ineffective and whether the Netherlands was aware of the risk. The minister answered that the risk was theoretical and unconfirmed, that Dutch mink farms are being culled as a precaution, and that the Netherlands has raised the issue at EU level.
The legislative process for the cessation scheme is proceeding as planned.
Het wetgevingstraject voor de stoppersregeling loopt als gepland.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over Canadese wetgeving die het openbaar maken van misstanden in de dierindustrie strafbaar stelt (Bill 156) en over de dood van de Canadese dierenrechtenactiviste Regan Russell

An MP asked the Dutch ministers about Ontario's Bill 156, which criminalises exposing animal abuse in farming, and about the death of activist Regan Russell, along with Canadian animal welfare commitments under CETA. The government says Bill 156 is not a response to the abuse cases, that protest rights are not affected, that the Russell death was investigated with a careless-driving charge, and that it will keep the Russell investigation under watch and raise animal welfare within CETA dialogue.
The cabinet cannot confirm that the Canadian province of Ontario adopted Bill 156 in response to the aforementioned cases.
Het kabinet kan niet bevestigen dat de Canadese Provincie Ontario Bill 156 heeft aangenomen in reactie op de eerder genoemde zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de nieuwe coronabesmettingen bij twee nertsenfokkerijen

MP Ouwehand asked the ministers why new COVID-19 infections appeared at mink farms, how inspection and culling were conducted, and whether the culling method breached EU animal-killing rules. Minister Schouten answered that human transmission is most likely, described tightened measures and NVWA inspections, and rejected claims of illegality while promising to share the ongoing tracing research and the culling reports.
Once a definitive research report has been drawn up, we will share the results with your House.
Zodra er een definitief onderzoeksverslag is opgesteld, zullen we de resultaten met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over nalatigheid bij de NVWA bij het ingrijpen in slachthuizen waar onvoldoende maatregelen werden genomen tegen de verspreiding van het coronavirus

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the ministers why the NVWA failed to act against inadequate COVID-19 measures in slaughterhouses, despite staff warnings, and whether the government misinformed parliament. The minister rejects charges of NVWA or ministerial failure, says the NVWA did act (including suspending work at four slaughterhouses), and promises ongoing coordination and a September letter on the line-speed motion.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het beschermen van dieren bij de verwachte hittegolven

Ouwehand (PvdD) asks why the government has not protected animals from heat stress and transport deaths in the expected heatwaves, and why promised evaluations, protocols, a transport ban bill and NVWA capacity have not been shown to Parliament. Minister Schouten answers that a 35-degree transport ban is set by policy rule effective 2 July, that sector protocols were updated, that NVWA capacity is limited and not fixed in advance, and that she cannot impose herd-size limits, and she sends a letter with details.
The ban is not established through a bill but through a policy rule.
Het verbod wordt niet via een wetsvoorstel vastgelegd maar door middel van een beleidsregel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de aanhoudende mensenrechtenschendingen en ontbossing in Brazilië

An MP asked the government about deforestation, rights violations and a Brazilian bill legalising land grabs, and whether the Netherlands would boycott Brazil or withdraw support for the EU-Mercosur deal. The minister confirmed the reported rise in deforestation (without independent verification), described the bill's history and criticism, and said the Netherlands keeps raising concerns through dialogue, while stating boycott decisions belong to companies and consumers and that no position on Mercosur has yet been taken.
The cabinet will not take a position until the necessary documents are available.
Het kabinet zal geen standpunt innemen voordat de daartoe benodigde stukken beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over extra voordelige Ster zendtijd voor brancheorganisaties en belangenverenigingen

An MP asked whether the farmers' action group FDF received discounted Ster advertising airtime, whether ads breaching the Advertising Code should be barred from preferential slots, and whether charities should receive equal shares of the discounted airtime. The minister answered that FDF bought airtime at regular rates, that Ster is bound by Advertising Code Commission rulings, and that airtime allocation is Ster's responsibility under the Media Act, so he cannot intervene.
Filling the Ster airtime is the responsibility of Ster.
Het invullen van de Ster-zendtijd is de verantwoordelijkheid van de Ster.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over gratis Ster zendtijd voor brancheorganisaties en belangenverenigingen

An MP asked the minister about free Ster airtime for trade and interest organisations during the coronavirus crisis, while charities were excluded, and about the content of some farmer-group ads. The minister answered that airtime allocation is Ster's responsibility, that the Commissariaat voor de Media oversees compliance, and that the broadcaster does not air ads violating the Reclame Code.
Filling the Ster airtime is the responsibility of Ster. I cannot intervene in the choices Ster makes regarding advertising airtime.
Het invullen van de Ster-zendtijd is de verantwoordelijkheid van de Ster. Ik kan niet treden in de keuzes die de Ster maakt ten aanzien van de reclamezendtijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, Bromet en Futselaar over de gevaren van de coronabesmettingen bij nertsenfokkerijen

Three MPs asked the ministers about COVID-19 infections at mink farms, including culling, protective equipment, enforcement of the reporting duty and inspections, and the future of mink farming. The ministers answered that infections were confirmed on nine locations at six farms, that culling was decided on 3 June with a possible voluntary exit scheme still under study, that the NVWA carried out no mink-farm inspections in 2020 so far, and that the questions were answered later than planned.
Not all animals are tested, so we cannot give the precise number of infected animals.
Niet alle dieren worden onderzocht en daarom kunnen wij het precieze aantal besmette dieren niet geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over coronabesmettingen bij medewerkers van slachthuizen en vleesverwerkingsbedrijven

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers about COVID-19 infections among slaughterhouse workers, whether the RIVM guidelines could be followed, enforcement by the NVWA and KDS, and the risk to food safety and animal welfare. Minister Schouten answered that slaughterhouses bear primary responsibility, that the NVWA can suspend work where guidelines cannot be followed and did so at four plants, and that some questions (sick-leave data, number of stoppages, stocks of meat) were not available or answered only partially.
Where the NVWA finds that the RIVM guidelines cannot adequately be followed, the NVWA employee can immediately suspend the service.
Daar waar de NVWA constateert dat de richtlijnen van het RIVM niet adequaat kunnen worden opgevolgd, kan de NVWA-medewerker de dienstverlening per direct opschorten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, Wassenberg en Van Esch over een alomvattend aanvalsplan om het risico op toekomstige overspringende zoönotische infectieziekten drastisch te verkleinen

MPs Ouwehand, Wassenberg and Van Esch asked about zoonotic disease risks, intensive livestock farming, wildlife trade, deforestation and a comprehensive action plan to reduce spillover risk. The ministers answered that risks are recognised and managed through the Dutch zoonosis structure, but declined to commit to new bans, a dedicated action plan or additional wildlife-trade enforcement, saying existing measures are sufficient.
The cabinet will continue to work to keep the risks as small as possible or make them smaller.
Het kabinet zal zich ervoor blijven inzetten dat de risico's zo klein mogelijk zijn of kleiner worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het uitsluiten van plantaardige zuivel van Europese landbouwsubsidies

An MP asks whether EU agricultural subsidies (CAP pillars 1 and 2) exclude plant-based dairy producers and whether this conflicts with government policy to shift toward a more plant-based society. The minister answers that the rules define dairy as animal-derived, that plant-based producers are not excluded from CAP support if they meet the scheme conditions, and that the government will promote plant-based alternatives in the new CAP and national strategic plan.
The starting point is that the supported actions contribute to achieving the stated objectives.
Het uitgangspunt is dat de ondersteunde acties bijdragen aan het behalen van de genoemde doelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de berichten dat de meeste bedrijven in de vleessector de RIVM-richtlijnen niet naleven

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about union reports that most meat-sector firms do not follow RIVM corona guidelines yet slaughtering continues, and whether the minister misled parliament about it. The minister replies that slaughterhouses are responsible for compliance, that the NVWA has suspended inspections at some plants, that a worker-hygiene study is underway, and denies misinforming parliament or withholding information.
I do not recognise the picture that measures are not being complied with across the board.
Ik herken mij niet in het beeld dat over de hele linie maatregelen niet worden nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het stilleggen van de eendenhouderij

MP Ouwehand (PvdD) asks the Minister of Agriculture about halting the duck farming sector during the coronavirus crisis, including animal welfare, bird flu risk, a missing nature permit for the only duck slaughterhouse, and compensation. The minister confirms the sector's temporary halt on new hatching and early slaughter, says a permit question falls to the province, acknowledges welfare concerns, and declines to make ending the sector a condition for aid.
The authority to assess whether this development requires a permit under the Nature Conservation Act lies with the province, in this case the province of Gelderland.
De bevoegdheid om te beoordelen of deze ontwikkeling vergunningplichtig is onder Wet natuurbescherming (Wnb) ligt bij de provincie, in dit geval provincie Gelderland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de situatie voor dieren in de veehouderij als gevolg van de coronacrisis

Party for the Animals MP Ouwehand asks the agriculture minister about animal welfare risks in livestock farming after COVID-19 cut demand from hospitality and export, causing overcrowded stalls, unsold meat and milk, and culling of day-old chicks. Minister Schouten replies that welfare remains monitored, that she lacks legal powers to impose mandatory production limits on a non-contagious-disease basis, and that sectors are pursuing voluntary measures.

In this situation I have no legal powers to impose mandatory production-limiting measures as a crisis measure under the Animal Health and Welfare Act and the Animals Act, because COVID-19 is not an infectious animal disease.

Ik heb echter in deze situatie geen wettelijke mogelijkheden om, als crisismaatregel, verplichte productiebeperkende maatregelen op te leggen op basis van de Gezondheids- en Welzijnswet voor dieren (GWWD) en de Wet dieren omdat COVID-19 geen besmettelijke dierziekte is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het lot van kalfjes uit de melkveehouderij als gevolg van de coronacrisis

The MP Ouwehand asks the Minister of Agriculture about the fate of dairy calves during the COVID-19 crisis, including the drop in veal demand, longer stays in stables, calf imports, transport welfare abuses seen in new footage, and farming restrictions. The Minister answers that sector-wide production limits cannot be imposed legally, that the NVWA has reduced inspections, and that research and talks with the sector are ongoing.
The NVWA does carry out inspections on reports that immediately require them, due to the seriousness of the violation and/or the possible consequences for animal welfare or animal health.
De NVWA voert wel inspecties uit bij meldingen die daar, vanwege de ernst van de overtreding en/of de mogelijke gevolgen voor het dierenwelzijn of diergezondheid, onmiddellijk om vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het delen van de aanpak van de stikstofcrisis met de Kamer

Ouwehand (PvdD) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether an agreement exists on the nitrogen crisis approach and whether she will send it to parliament. Minister Schouten replied that the cabinet decided that day on a structural approach, to be sent to parliament with the answers, and confirmed she will send it.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, Bromet, Moorlag en Futselaar over het uitgelekte plan voor de aanpak van de stikstofproblematiek

MPs Ouwehand, Bromet, Moorlag and Futselaar asked the minister how leaks about the nitrogen plan reached the media before parliament was informed, and when parliament would receive the plan. The minister regrets the media coverage, says parliament will be informed once cabinet decides, and states the cabinet has now concluded its decision and sent the structural approach letter to parliament.
I attach importance to informing your House once the discussions with the parties involved have taken place and cabinet decision-making is complete.
Ik hecht eraan uw Kamer te informeren zodra de besprekingen met betrokken partijen hebben plaatsgevonden en de besluitvorming in het kabinet is afgerond.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Wilders, Buitenweg, Futselaar, Kuiken, Van der Graaf, Ouwehand, Van Otterloo, Azarkan, Stoffer, Baudet, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Haga over de mogelijke inzet van apps in het ka

Thirteen MPs asked the ministers about the possible use of contact-tracing apps in the COVID-19 'test, trace and stay home' policy, covering their purpose, effectiveness, privacy, source code, cybersecurity and accessibility. The government answered by referring to its separate COVID-19 update letter (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249) rather than answering the questions directly.
The written questions ... have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken' (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249).
De schriftelijke vragen ... zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de gevolgen van de maatregelen tegen het coronavirus voor dieren in de veehouderij

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture about animal welfare risks in livestock during the coronavirus crisis, including transport delays, slaughterhouse staffing, NVWA and KDS inspector absences, and food safety. The Minister answers that welfare is weighed in crisis measures, EU transport rules still apply, she does not support a transport stop, NVWA has scaled back non-essential supervision while keeping slaughter inspections, and several answers are deferred to a later reply.
Where possible the questions have been answered. More time is needed for the questions not yet answered.
Daar waar mogelijk zijn de vragen beantwoord. Voor de niet-beantwoorde vragen is meer tijd nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de Nationale Week zonder Vlees

Ouwehand (PvdD) asked the Minister of Agriculture why the ministry dropped its 2019 promotion of the Week without Meat, whether it will promote reduced meat consumption as a nitrogen and climate measure, and what it is doing to shift to plant-based proteins. Minister Schouten answered that the Week is for the foundation to promote, that the government promotes a healthy and sustainable diet via the Schijf van Vijf, that the ministry's catering participates, and listed existing protein-transition research and programmes.
It is up to the Nationale Week zonder Vlees foundation to invite people to take part in the Nationale Week zonder Vlees.
Het is aan de stichting Nationale Week zonder Vlees om mensen uit te nodigen om mee te doen met de Nationale Week zonder Vlees.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de gevolgen van CETA voor onze rechtsstaat, onze soevereiniteit en de landbouw

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation about the consequences of CETA for the rule of law, sovereignty and Dutch arable farming, covering pesticide residue standards, investor protection, MFN clauses and Brexit. The minister answered that EU import standards apply to all products, that CETA's investment protections are comparable to Dutch law, and that the government sees no reason to reconsider its support.
Investment protection in CETA offers a similar level of protection to investors as Dutch law does.
Investeringsbescherming in CETA biedt een soortgelijk niveau van bescherming aan investeerders als het Nederlands recht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de lagere dierenwelzijnsstandaarden in Canada, naar aanleiding van het rondetafelgesprek over het EU-Canada-vrijhandelsverdrag CETA van 6 november 2019

An MP asked the trade and agriculture ministers whether lower animal welfare standards in Canada (transport durations, sow housing, cattle branding) undermine a level playing field under CETA, and whether EU import requirements can enforce equivalence. The government answered that EU import rules cover only plant/animal health, food safety and labelling, that animal welfare import conditions are limited under WTO rules, and that the CETA Regulatory Cooperation Forum is discussing long-distance animal transport.
Through CETA it is possible to keep talking with Canada about animal welfare requirements.
Via CETA is het mogelijk om in gesprek te blijven met Canada over dierenwelzijnseisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het Joint Management Committee on Sanitary and Phytosanitary Measures in het CETA-verdrag

An MP asked the ministers about the CETA Joint Management Committee on SPS measures, including whether it can amend CETA without parliamentary control and how the EU position is set. The minister answered that amendments to annexes and protocols follow a simplified procedure, that the Council sets the EU position and Parliament is informed, and that Parliament must approve treaty amendments under article 91 of the Constitution, but many questions were answered only by reference to earlier answers or to the European Commission website.

Deviating from that, article 5.14(2)(d) of CETA and article 30.2(2) determine that the Joint Management Committee on SPS measures and the CETA Joint Committee respectively may decide to amend the protocols and certain annexes to the agreement.

In afwijking daarvan bepalen artikel 5.14, lid 2, onder d, van CETA en artikel 30.2, lid 2, dat het Gemengd Comité van beheer voor sanitaire en fytosanitaire maatregelen respectievelijk het CETA Gemengd Comité kunnen besluiten om de protocollen en een aantal bijlagen bij het akkoord te wijzigen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de aanwezigheid van de minister bij de algemene ledenvergadering (ALV) van de organisatie van varkenshouders, waar hij blijkens het twitterverslag boeren heeft opgeroepen tot

MP Ouwehand asked Justice Minister Grapperhaus about his attendance at a pig farmers' general meeting, where he reportedly urged farmers to steal activists' cars, suggested using high-pressure hoses on activists, and made claims about activists' finances and the Boxtel occupation. The minister replied that he attended at the POV's invitation to discuss activism guidance, denied calling for theft or violence, said courts act justly, and acknowledged receiving a meat package but denied promoting the meat industry.
I have in no way called into question the functioning of judges.
Ik heb op geen enkele wijze het functioneren van rechters in twijfel getrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de mogelijke claim tegen de Nederlandse staat van Uniper en RWE, op basis van de ISDS-clausule in het Energie Charter Treaty

An MP asked the ministers about threatened ISDS claims by Uniper and RWE against the Dutch state under the Energy Charter Treaty after the coal ban, and about the treaty's future. The government answered that no formal claim exists yet, that intra-EU ISDS is not possible after Achmea, that a 10-year transition period compensates the plants, and that modernisation negotiations are underway rather than withdrawal.
On that basis the Netherlands is not considering withdrawing from the Energy Charter Treaty and is focusing in the coming period on modernising the treaty.
Nederland overweegt op grond daarvan niet om uit het Energiehandvestverdrag te stappen en zet de komende tijd in op de modernisering van dit verdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de kritiek van NGO’s op de concept-duurzaamheids-impactanalyse van het EU-Mercosur-verdrag en de status van het akkoord

An MP asked the government about NGO criticism of the draft sustainability impact assessment of the EU-Mercosur agreement, including its timing, data gaps on Brazilian deforestation and CO2, the mixed-competence status of the deal, and animal welfare conditions. The minister answered that the draft SIA is not final, the final version is expected mid-2020, a separate impact study on Dutch agriculture will be carried out, and the government will assess the deal before the Council decides.

The cabinet will, in accordance with the Voordewind et al. motion referring to the Koopmans/Snijder-Hazelhoff motion, commission a study into the impact of the EU-Mercosur Association Agreement on the Dutch economy, in particular Dutch agriculture and horticulture.

Het kabinet zal conform de motie Voordewind c.s. waarin verwezen wordt naar de motie Koopmans/Snijder-Hazelhoff een onderzoek laten uitvoeren naar de impact van het EU-Mercosur Associatieverdrag op de Nederlandse economie, in het bijzonder de Nederlandse land- en tuinbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het in gevaar brengen van de gezondheid van dier en mens voor een truc om stikstofruimte te verkrijgen

An MP asks the agriculture minister whether placing thousands of ducks in a vacant barn in an avian-influenza hotspot, to bank nitrogen room for a wind farm, endangers animal and human health and whether such schemes will be stopped. The minister says she knows the press reports, that the farmer used capacity within his permit, that the sector roadmap on avian influenza and possible location-based measures are underway, and refers to earlier answers on preventing such constructions.
In this case, the policy line was not deviated from.
In deze casus is niet afgeweken van deze beleidslijn.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de aanhoudende mensenrechtenschendingen in het Amazoneregenwoud, de plannen van president Bolsonaro van Brazilië om het Amazonewoud verder te vernietigen en de dubbele moraal

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about human rights violations and deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon under President Bolsonaro, the EU-Mercosur trade deal, and the perceived double standard of the EU. The Minister acknowledged the incidents and concerns, stated that the Netherlands and the EU keep raising human rights and forest protection with Brazil, and said the government will take a position on the trade deal once the Commission's sustainability impact assessment and the required documents are available.
The House will be informed in advance of the Cabinet's position.
De Kamer zal vooraf worden geïnformeerd over het standpunt van het Kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya , van den Hul, Ouwehand en Diks over de bosbranden in het Amazonewoud en het Mercosur-verdrag

MPs from SP, PvdA, PvdA-adjacent PvdD and GroenLinks asked whether the Netherlands would side with France and Ireland in opposing ratification of the EU-Mercosur agreement while Amazon fires continue, and whether it would support G7 aid for the Amazon. The minister replied that the government will take a position only once all texts and the Sustainability Impact Assessment are available, expected late 2019, with the Commission expecting a Council decision no earlier than November 2020, and that it will press Brazil bilaterally and within the EU on sustainable forest policy and will report separately on a possible Dutch contribution.
The cabinet will take a position once all necessary texts on the EU-Mercosur Association Agreement are available.
Kabinet zal een standpunt innemen als alle daarvoor noodzakelijke teksten over het EU-Mercosur-Associatieverdrag beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over de Amazonebranden en de westerse verantwoordelijkheid bij de branden

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked the government whether Amazon fires are human-caused, whether the EU-Mercosur trade deal incentivises deforestation, and whether Dutch firms and trade partners should face sanctions or procurement exclusion. The minister replied that the fires are likely set deliberately, pointed to Brazil's primary responsibility, promised diplomatic pressure within the EU-Mercosur process, and said the Dutch government does not support the soy corridor while the procurement exclusion of named firms is not legally straightforward, so it will only explore aligning procurement with OECD guidelines.
Excluding parties from public procurement is not straightforwardly legally possible.
Het uitsluiten van partijen van overheidsaanbestedingen is niet zonder meer juridisch mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het ontslag van de directeur van het Braziliaanse instituut dat versnelde ontbossing van Amazone aantoonde

An MP asked the minister whether Brazil's president had dismissed the director of INPE after it published accelerated Amazon deforestation figures, and how the Netherlands would respond. The minister said the dismissal would be worrying if motivated by the figures, that the Netherlands and EU consistently raise Amazon protection with Brazil, and declined to back the INPE workers' protest or urge the Commission to do so.
To the extent this dismissal would be related to the publication of the deforestation figures, this would be a worrying development
Voor zover dit ontslag verband zou houden met de publicatie van de ontbossingscijfers, zou dit een zorgwekkende ontwikkeling zijn
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over uitspraken van de Minister inzake het vrijhandelsverdrag met de Mercosur-landen

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether the EU-Mercosur trade agreement actually contains enforceable production, environmental and pesticide standards, and when the government would assess the agreement. The Minister answered that the agreement commits both sides to existing standards and dialogues, but that the EU cannot force Mercosur countries to adopt EU rules, and promised a government position only once all formal texts are available.
The House will be informed of the Cabinet's position before the Council decides on the agreement.
De Kamer zal over het standpunt van het Kabinet worden geïnformeerd voordat de Raad besluit over het akkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Ouwehand over het evenement 'Zwientie Tikken' waarbij varkens worden getreiterd ter vermaak van de mens

Two MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture whether the 'Zwientie Tikken' pig-chasing event at a Dutch festival was acceptable given animal welfare and disease rules, and what would be done. The minister said the organiser is responsible for compliance, the NVWA found three violations, two of which lead to written warnings and one to a report that may lead to a fine, and that pigs were sourced from a nearby farm with privacy reasons given for not disclosing details.
The NVWA found 3 violations here, two of which will be dealt with through a written warning.
De NVWA heeft hierbij 3 overtredingen vastgesteld, twee daarvan zullen met een schriftelijke waarschuwing afgedaan worden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over duizenden jonge varkens en kippen die in hun stal zijn gestorven door de hitte en de afhankelijkheid van de brandweer om oververhitting van stallen te voorkomen

Ouwehand (PvdD) asked the ministers about thousands of pigs and chickens dying from heat in closed stalls after ventilation failures, and about reliance on the fire brigade to cool stalls. Minister Schouten answered that the NVWA handled incidents, that the veterinarian is responsible for emergency and alarm systems, and that many questions could not be answered because the specific farms were not identified; she said the regional safety body decides on fire brigade cooling and that incident reporting will be made mandatory.
I will arrange for such incidents to always be reported to the NVWA.
Ik ga regelen dat dergelijke incidenten altijd gemeld moeten worden bij de NVWA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over stilleggen van diertransporten tijdens de hittegolf

MP Ouwehand asked why no transport stop for livestock was announced during the July 2019 heatwave, and whether the current plan allows animals to be transported below 35 degrees with risks. The minister replied that the 35-degree limit is a voluntary agreement that will be made legally binding, that NVWA inspections focus on animal welfare rather than temperature, and that inspection capacity was roughly doubled during hot days at the cost of other inspections.
Because in a number of cases the voluntary agreements unfortunately were not complied with, I will legally establish that transports at an outside temperature above 35 degrees are not permitted
Omdat in een aantal gevallen de vrijwillige afspraken helaas niet worden nageleefd, ga ik wettelijk vastleggen dat transporten bij een buitentemperatuur boven de 35 graden niet zijn toegestaan
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het niet naleven van het hitteprotocol voor dierentransporten door de veehouderij

An MP asked the Minister why pig and poultry farmers kept sending animals to slaughter above the 35°C limit in the heat protocol, and why the NVWA did not intervene at Vion Boxtel despite activist footage. The minister acknowledged the footage, said the NVWA found no violations on the morning in question, reported fines and sanctions issued in the July heat period, and announced the 35°C limit will be codified in law.
As you can read in my letter, I will now legally establish this 35-degree limit for transports taking place exclusively on Dutch territory.
Zoals u in mijn brief kunt lezen ga ik deze grens van 35 graden nu wettelijk vastleggen voor transporten die uitsluitend op Nederlands grondgebied plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Ouwehand, Voordewind en Bouali over het bericht ‘de zwarte kant van het voetbal’

Four MPs from SGP, PvdD, ChristenUnie and D66 asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and Development about reported deaths of migrant workers building World Cup facilities in Qatar and what the government is doing about labour abuse there. The ministers answered that every death is one too many, that Qatar has begun reforms with the ILO and that the Netherlands raises the issue bilaterally and multilaterally, while declining to boycott the tournament.
It does not fit Dutch policy to boycott sporting events because of political situations.
Het past niet in het Nederlandse beleid om sportevenementen te boycotten vanwege politieke situaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de halal slacht van eenden, duiven, konijnen en herten

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether the Vugts slaughterhouse in Steenbergen slaughters ducks, pigeons, rabbits and deer unstunned for halal, and why these species were not in the 2018 overview of unstunned slaughter. The minister answered that only sheep and lambs were slaughtered unstunned there, while all other animals were stunned first, so they were not listed.
From the data of the NVWA it appears that only sheep and lambs were slaughtered unstunned.
Uit de gegevens van de NVWA blijkt dat er uitsluitend schapen en lammeren onbedwelmd geslacht zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over intimidatie van toezichthouders door de vee- en vleessector

An MP asked the ministers about the assault on an NVWA veterinary inspector at an abattoir, the abattoir's prior violations, and the safety of inspectors working alone, including incident figures and transport and market controls. The minister condemned the violence, explained the suspension and its conditions (owner absent during inspections, two-person inspections at the company's cost), and answered many questions with incident data, while stating that many incident figures are not recorded.
Unfortunately, aggression and violence against NVWA inspectors do occur more often.
Het komt helaas vaker voor dat agressie en geweld tegen NVWA-inspecteurs wordt gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Van Raan over het openbreken van de associatieovereenkomst met Oekraïne en het vervolgens fors verhogen van de importquota voor Oekraïens kippenvlees

MPs Ouwehand and Van Raan asked whether the EU-Ukraine association agreement quota for Ukrainian chicken meat was tripled through a loophole, which Dutch and other EU processors may have facilitated, and whether the government would act to stop it. The minister confirmed the loophole and a proposed quota increase, said the government will decide its position after reviewing the Commission proposal, and gave limited answers on the named companies and the EBRD loan, pointing to other bodies.
The cabinet will study the European Commission's proposal after publication and on that basis take a definitive position.
Het kabinet zal het voorstel van de Europese Commissie, na publicatie, bestuderen en op basis hiervan een definitief standpunt innemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de hoge sterfte en mishandeling van kalfjes die geboren worden in de melkveehouderij

Ouwehand (PvdD) asked the Minister of Agriculture about high calf mortality and mistreatment in dairy farming, prompted by RTL reporting, including whether deaths are classified as stillbirths, whether calves are denied care for economic reasons, and what concrete targets exist. Minister Schouten acknowledges concern, explains monitoring and sector initiatives, disputes the 12.5% figure, and promises to set concrete targets with the sector this summer and report to parliament.
I want to give the sector room to continue the measures it has initiated.
Ik wil de sector de ruimte geven om de ingezette maatregelen verder door te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over een nieuw onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat het gebruik van landbouwgif kan leiden tot de ontwikkeling van ALS

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the government about a US study linking pesticide-related pollutants to faster ALS progression, and about the precautionary principle, the Gezondheidsraad advice, the RIVM exposure study and a promised meeting with a residents' group. The minister answers that the substances studied are EU-banned POPs, that the EU pesticide regulation allows intervention on new scientific insight, that monitoring found no exceeded limits, and that further research and meetings are planned.
Regulation (EC) 1107/2009 is based on the precautionary principle and provides the possibility to intervene where necessary on the basis of new scientific insights.
Verordening (EG) 1107/2009 gaat uit van het voorzorgsbeginsel en biedt de mogelijkheid om waar nodig in te grijpen op basis van nieuwe wetenschappelijke inzichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand het niet naleven van de wettelijke bepaling om de Wet dieren te evalueren

An MP asked why the Wet dieren evaluation required within five years of its 2013 entry into force had not yet been carried out and whether the minister had breached the law. The minister acknowledged the duty, attributed the timing to the phased entry into force, said the evaluation has started with a research bureau to report by year-end, and committed to informing parliament, while excluding enforcement capacity from the evaluation.
The research bureau will deliver the evaluation report by the end of the year at the latest, after which I will inform your House early next year.
Het onderzoeksbureau zal het evaluatierapport uiterlijk eind van het jaar opleveren, waarna ik uw Kamer begin volgend jaar zal informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over toezicht en handhaving binnen het domein dierenwelzijn van de NVWA

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality detailed questions about NVWA inspector numbers, veterinary training, inspection capacity and reporting of animal welfare violations, including whether inspection forms are filled in and whether budget cuts reduced inspection frequencies. The Minister answers that capacity is sufficient for the main risks, that some inspection frequencies were not in fact lowered, and provides inspection counts and figures on non-transportable animal arrivals at slaughterhouses.
However, I cannot rule out that the situation described in the question sometimes occurs in practice.
Ik kan echter niet uitsluiten dat de situatie die in de vraag geschetst wordt, zich soms in de praktijk voordoet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over uitbreiding van het externe onderzoek naar de gang van zaken rond de noordelijke slachthuizen en het optreden door de NVWA

MP Ouwehand asked the Minister of Agriculture why the external investigation into northern slaughterhouses and the NVWA's response is limited, whether it should cover farm supervision, the Animal Rights footage and a specific Limburg pig farm, and asked for the research questions and an answer before the AO. The Minister answered that the investigation (by 2Solve) is limited to the middle-sized cattle slaughterhouses in the north for now, that the NVWA cannot enforce on footage alone, that the Limburg farm passed re-inspections, and that results will be sent before summer; the research questions are attached.
Because of persistent signals about the northern slaughterhouses, I have decided to commission further external research into them.
Vanwege aanhoudende signalen rondom de noordelijke slachthuizen heb ik besloten hier nader extern onderzoek naar in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het nu alweer niet nakomen van de afspraken om de sterfte van bokjes in de melkgeitenhouderij terug te dringen

MP Ouwehand (PvdD) asks the Minister of Agriculture why the sector's plan to reduce kid mortality in dairy goat farming has not been reported to parliament, and why mortality figures for 2016-2017 are high and unclear. The Minister answers that the first reporting on the plan follows in spring 2019, that mortality is monitored via I&R registration and inspections, and that the sector is expected to reduce mortality without binding individual targets.
As I promised in the plenary debate on animals in livestock farming of 24 January, I will send Parliament a state-of-affairs letter on animal welfare in spring 2019.
Zoals ik in het plenair debat over dieren in de veehouderij van 24 januari jongstleden heb toegezegd, stuur ik uw Kamer in het voorjaar van 2019 een stand-van-zakenbrief dierenwelzijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het nu alweer niet nakomen van de afspraken om de sterfte van bokjes in de melkgeitenhouderij terug te dringen

An MP asked the minister why answers on kid goat mortality in dairy goat farming were delayed beyond three weeks, whether 2018 mortality figures exist, and whether farms reported quarterly data to the government. The minister said the delay was needed to coordinate with NVWA and RVO.nl, that quarterly mortality data goes to the private body Qlip rather than the government, and that 2018 figures were derived from the I&R registration system.
The action plan therefore does not oblige entrepreneurs to give the government quarterly insight into the mortality rate among lambs born on their farm.
Het plan van aanpak verplicht ondernemers dus niet om per kwartaal aan de overheid inzicht te geven over het uitvalspercentage onder lammeren die op hun bedrijf zijn geboren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de stalbrand in Biezenmortel waarbij zeker 2500 varkens zijn omgekomen en over het lot van de varkens die de brand in hun stal hebben overleefd

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the minister about a barn fire in Biezenmortel that killed around 2,500 pigs, the adequacy of fire-safety rules for enclosed pig barns, the removal of luchtwassers from the fire-risk discussion, and the fate of surviving pigs. The minister answers that housing systems meet legal requirements, that a fire-safety action plan is in place, that surviving pigs were sent to slaughter, and that the ban on air scrubbers was rejected because of environmental goals, though the fire-spread risk will be included in the action plan.
The progress report on the Brandveilige veestallen action plan, due before the summer recess, will report on the implementation and results of the periodic electrical inspections.

In de voortgangsrapportage over het actieplan Brandveilige veestallen, welke voor het zomerreces zal verschijnen, zal worden gerapporteerd over de uitvoering en de resultaten van de periodieke elektrakeuring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over ziekmakende giftige dampen in varkensstallen en het aanhoudende gedogen daarvan

MP Ouwehand asks the Minister of Agriculture about harmful ammonia levels in pig barns, whether the animal welfare rules have been enforced, and why no binding ceiling exists despite expert recommendations of 20 ppm. Minister Schouten replies that enforcement took place before 2018, that signal indicators were developed by WUR, that no statutory ceiling is set, and that an evaluation of the Animal Welfare Act will follow.
I have no reason to doubt the findings of the Climate Platform.
Ik heb geen reden om aan de uitkomsten van de bevindingen van het Klimaatplatform te twijfelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Ouwehand over de inmenging van Shell in inhoudelijke exposities van Rijksmuseum Boerhaave

MPs Van Raan and Ouwehand asked whether Shell's partnership with Rijksmuseum Boerhaave, including a Shell board member's role in an exhibition and Shell's links to the museum's supervisory board, compromises the museum's independence and whether the government will end it. The minister rejected the criticism, stating the partnership targets talent development, that the museum keeps editorial control under the Ethical Code, and that governance rules are followed; she refused to end the partnership.
Article 1.10 of that code requires museums, regardless of their source of income, to at all times retain control over the content and integrity of their programmes, exhibitions and activities.

Artikel 1.10. van die code schrijft voor dat musea, ongeacht de bron van inkomsten, te allen tijde controle houden over de inhoud en integriteit van hun programma's, tentoonstellingen en activiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de bekendheid van burgers met het dierenleed dat schuilgaat achter dons

MP Ouwehand (PvdD) asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality how consumers can know about animal suffering behind down after a Kassa broadcast showing live-plucking of ducks and misleading RDS labelling. Minister Schouten answers that she cannot confirm the origin of sold down, notes that retail and the industry bear responsibility through the textile convenant and that consumers can inform themselves, without committing to new action.
It is up to the retailers to instruct staff about the products they sell.
Het is aan de retail om medewerkers te instrueren over de producten die zij verkopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het proces rond de Bee Guidance

MP Ouwehand (PvdD) asked the Minister of Agriculture why her earlier written answers on the EU Bee guidance document process were thin, and asked about the process history, the Dutch position, leaked drafts and whether chronic toxicity testing would be relaxed. Minister Schouten answered that the Commission now proposes phased implementation with an EFSA mandate to revise contested parts within two years, that the Netherlands supports harmonised guidance and has no formal position yet, and that the drafts are working documents she will not send, while promising to inform parliament once a concrete proposal exists.
These are working documents circulated within a technical discussion. When the Commission presents a concrete proposal to the member states, I will inform your House of it.
Dit betreft werkdocumenten die binnen een technische discussie worden verspreid. Wanneer de EC een concreet voorstel aan de lidstaten voorlegt, zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de Week zonder vlees

MP Ouwehand asked the Justice Minister about the Week zonder vlees: whether the public would be urged to take part again, whether the Justice Ministry would serve meat-free canteen meals, the government's role in the campaign, and its response to external costs of meat production. The government answered via a joint reply stating the questions were answered in a separate Aanhangsel document, so no substantive answers were given here.
The written questions from MP Ouwehand (PvdD), question number 2019Z03360, on a week without meat, have been answered by means of Aanhangsel Handelingen, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1896.
Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD), vraagnummer 2019Z03360 , inzake een week zonder vlees, zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr.

An MP asked the government about the Week zonder vlees, the ministry's role in promoting it, meat externalities, and a Canadian dietary recommendation, and whether ministry diners could be made meat-free by default. The government answered jointly and the answers cited earlier written answers (Aanhangsel Handelingen 1896) rather than addressing the questions in substance.

The answer refers to the answers already published in Aanhangsel Handelingen 1896 and does not address the substance of the questions.

MP Ouwehand asked the government whether it would promote the Week without Meat among the public and its staff, whether its ministry was involved in the initiative, and how external costs of meat production should be reflected in prices. The government replied only by referring to earlier answers published in an appendix to the parliamentary proceedings, without addressing the substance of the questions.

MP Ouwehand asked the government about its role in the Week zonder vlees (meat-free week), including promotion via ministry Twitter, whether canteens and dinners should be made meat-free by default, the external costs of meat production, and Canadian dietary advice. The government answered by referring to the earlier written answers (Aanhangsel Handelingen 1896) rather than answering the questions directly.

An MP asked the government whether it would promote the Week without Meat, make ministry dinners meat-optional, state its role in the initiative, and act on external costs of meat consumption. The government answered via the Agriculture minister, referring to an earlier answer in the Handelingen appendix, so the substance of the response is not in this text.
have been answered by means of the Appendix to the Proceedings, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1896
zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr. 1896
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de week zonder vlees

An MP (Ouwehand, PvdD) asked the government about its role in the Week zonder Vlees campaign, meat-free catering at ministries, and reducing animal protein consumption in policy. The government answered that the campaign is a private initiative, that it promotes healthy and sustainable diets without ruling out meat, and that it considers mandatory meat-free catering too intrusive on personal choice.
It is primarily up to the Nationale Week Zonder Vlees foundation itself to draw the public's attention to the Week zonder Vlees.
Het is in de eerste plaats aan de stichting Nationale Week Zonder Vlees zelf om het publiek te wijzen op de Week zonder Vlees.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

An MP asks the Prime Minister and ministers how the government responds to Greta Thunberg's COP24 speech, including whether it rejects her claims about economic growth, climate inaction and the political system, and what it will do to meet the 1.5 degree target and reduce meat in its own canteens. The government answers collectively, as the answer text is only the header and cross-reference in the supplied excerpt, with no substantive responses visible.
The written questions from MP Ouwehand (PvdD), question number 2018Z24290, have been answered by way of Parliamentary Proceedings appendix, session 2018–2019, no. 1305.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) vraagnummer 2018Z24290 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr. 1305 .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

An MP asks the minister whether the government bears responsibility for climate policy and how it responds to Greta Thunberg's COP24 speech, including whether it will change its growth and trade stance and its own ministry's practices. The government answer, given jointly by several ministers, states the cabinet's climate commitments and says the questions were answered in an appendix to the parliamentary record.
The written questions from MP Ouwehand (PvdD), question number 2018Z24287, have been answered by means of Parliamentary Proceedings appendix 1305, session 2018–2019.
Nader antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) vraagnummer 2018Z24287 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Wassenberg over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

Two PvdD MPs asked 21 questions about Greta Thunberg's COP24 speech, including whether the government accepts shared responsibility for climate policy, whether it will tighten its own climate measures and move toward plant-based catering. The government answered on behalf of the full cabinet, but the answer text available here is only a reference to an Aanhangsel and gives no substantive response.
The written questions from MPs Ouwehand and Wassenberg (both PvdD), question number 2018Z24285, have been answered by means of Appendix to the Handelingen, session 2018–2019, no. 1305.
De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Wassenberg (beiden PvdD), vraagnummer 2018Z24285 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr. 1305 .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de mishandeling bij de slacht van verzwakte, afgedankte melkkoeien

An MP asked the minister about cruel treatment of cows at a German slaughterhouse near the Dutch border, whether Dutch cows were slaughtered there, dairy yield and vaccination practices, and NVWA oversight and enforcement at the Dutch slaughterhouse. The minister condemned the treatment shown, gave production figures, reported enforcement actions against transporters and farmers, and defended the NVWA's supervision and its approach to intimidation of inspectors.
If an NVWA inspector finds such conduct, they will take enforcement action.
Indien een toezichthouder van de NVWA dergelijk gedrag aantreft zal deze handhavend optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Diks, Van den Hul, Bouali, Ouwehand en Stoffer over hongerlonen en schendingen van arbeidsrechten in H&M’s productieketen

MPs asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a report on starvation wages and labour-rights violations in H&M's supply chain in Bulgaria, including whether H&M would be held to account, whether the textile covenant targets are slipping, whether the government will discuss freedom of association with covenant parties, and the state of a roadmap to extend covenants internationally. The minister said living wages are a human right, that H&M bears responsibility and should act and that she is willing to talk with H&M, pointed to covenant activities on living wages and union freedom and to ongoing EU-level IMVO coalition-building, but declined a separate meeting on union freedom.
I am willing to discuss this with H&M.
Ik ben bereid hierover in gesprek te gaan met H&M.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Ouwehand over de groeiplannen van Eindhoven Airport en de gevolgen voor de natuur

MPs Van Raan and Ouwehand asked whether Eindhoven Airport's growth scenarios would increase CO2, nitrogen and fine-particle emissions, conflict with Natura 2000 protection and the PAS, and whether a critical report was withheld. The government answered that the scenarios are analytical only, no decision has been taken, growth would be assessed as a priority project only later, and the report was not suppressed but published with a delay by the municipality.
The report concerned on nitrogen deposition was not withheld.
Het betreffende rapport over stikstofdepositie is niet achtergehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de verstikkingsdood van varkens nadat de ventilatie in hun stal uitviel

MP Ouwehand asked the Minister of Agriculture about the suffocation of about 1,200 pigs after ventilation failed in a fully automated barn, including reporting duties, the role of the NVWA and municipal and regional inspection, and oversight of automated systems. The minister answered that the NVWA's investigation found the barn had an alarm and emergency ventilation, that farmers bear primary responsibility, and that reporting obligations and inspections were in place, while declining to answer several questions about municipal inspections and past cases.

I do not have information on whether the keeper evaded a reporting obligation to the municipality of Haaren, nor on the findings and quality of the inspections by the Brabant-Noord environmental service.

Ik beschik niet over informatie of de houder zich onttrokken heeft aan een meldingsplicht aan de gemeente Haaren en over de bevindingen en de kwaliteit van de controles van de omgevingsdienst Brabant-Noord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de geplande herbouw en uitbreiding van mega varkensstal De Knorhof

Ouwehand (PvdD) asked the minister whether she would stop the rebuild and doubling of the De Knorhof mega pig farm after a fire, given the owner's animal welfare violations, prior bans and permit breaches, and asked about NVWA inspections, inspection reports and municipal litigation costs. The minister declined to judge or intervene, citing municipal and provincial competence, gave only partial inspection information (two welfare checks since July 2017), and refused to publish inspection reports or provide data on omgevingsdienst visits.

It is not for me to assess the plans, because for new construction, rebuilding and renovation of barns the applicable legal frameworks of spatial planning and environmental policy apply, for which the decentralised governments are the competent authority.

Het is niet aan mij om de plannen te beoordelen, want voor nieuwbouw, herbouw en renovatie van stallen zijn de vigerende wettelijke kaders van het ruimtelijk ordenings- en milieubeleid van toepassing, waarvoor de decentrale overheden het bevoegd gezag zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de grote vertraging bij de herbeoordeling van bestrijdingsmiddelen

An MP asked the ministers why pesticide active substances with possible harmful properties have had their EU approvals extended without full reassessment, and why Dutch authorisations remain in place. The minister replied that delays are due to procedural and capacity reasons, that extensions are temporary pending full review, that the Ctgb is the competent authority and acts when new scientific information warrants it, and that it is not for the minister to instruct the Ctgb.
The Ctgb is the competent authority in the Netherlands for decisions on whether to authorise plant protection products.
Het Ctgb is in Nederland de bevoegde autoriteit voor besluiten over het al dan niet toelaten van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Wassenberg en Ouwehand over de jaarlijkse milieuschade van ruim 37 miljard euro

MPs Van Raan, Wassenberg and Ouwehand asked the government about the roughly 37 billion euro annual environmental damage from Dutch firms and consumers, the CO2 minimum price, aviation emissions, livestock and imported environmental costs, and whether environmental costs are included in fiscal and policy calculations. The Minister mostly defended existing policy, said the PBL figures are uncertain and not fully comparable, pointed to planned True Pricing work and aviation measures, and declined to give some requested estimates.
The multi-year programme I have in mind should provide more insight into the cost-shifting mechanisms.
Het meerjarenprogramma dat mij voor ogen staat moet meer inzicht in de afwentelingsmechanismen opleveren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de aantallen dieren die onbedwelmd worden geslacht

An MP asked the minister for numbers and breakdowns on animals slaughtered without stunning in kosher and halal slaughter, including whether non-kosher meat is sold on as halal and whether the NVWA supervises these flows. The minister mostly declined detailed breakdowns (NVWA keeps no such records), said the NVWA only supervises the slaughter itself and not sales channels or labelling, and reported 80 violations in Q1 2018 with corrective measures and a noted improvement in Q2.
No, I cannot make this further breakdown. The NVWA does not keep records of this.
Nee, ik kan deze nadere uitsplitsing niet maken. De NVWA houdt hier geen registratie van bij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de bescherming van dieren tegen de hitte

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about protecting livestock from heat stress, including inspection powers, shelter in pastures, stable ventilation, and slaughter transport. The minister answered that holders must protect animals, that the NVWA has enforcement powers and has issued limited sanctions, and that existing sector protocols suffice without new restrictions.
No data are available on the number of inspections over the past 5 years under extreme warm weather conditions.
Er zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar over het aantal controles in de afgelopen 5 jaar bij extreme warme weersomstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Futselaar over de bijdrage van 8 miljoen euro aan de nertsenhouderij

MPs Ouwehand and Futselaar asked the minister about reallocating 8 million euro from pig-sector funds to fur farm transition measures, the maximum compensation per location, fraud risks, shortening the transition period, NVWA enforcement and animal testing for vaccines. The minister confirmed the 8 million reservation and the compensation caps, said the extra amount is still being explored under state aid rules, refused to shorten the transition period or introduce declining compensation, and described enforcement capacity and the animal testing permit with limited detail.
However, no intellectual property rights may be infringed nor confidential information disclosed.
Er mag echter geen intellectuele eigendomsrecht worden geschonden noch vertrouwelijke informatie worden prijsgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het afkeuren van gezonde groente en fruit door supermarkten

Party MP Ouwehand asks the minister whether supermarket cosmetic standards that led to 60,000 kilos of plums being rejected, and EU trade norms, should be relaxed so edible produce can be sold, and whether a non-enforcement policy should be adopted. The minister calls the waste regrettable, says she will talk with supermarket executives, but rejects a non-enforcement policy, saying the inspectorates only check EU norms and she will examine cosmetic requirements in EU norms.
Setting up a non-enforcement policy is therefore not necessary.
Het instellen van een gedoogbeleid is dan ook niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het bericht ‘Ernstig dierenleed vastgelegd bij nertsentransport vanuit Nederland’

An MP asked the minister about footage of severe animal suffering during mink transport from the Netherlands, including possible violations of EU transport rules, enforcement, controls, export ban and pre-departure checks. The minister said the NVWA is investigating via a complaint, enforcement lies with Polish authorities, mink transports were not controlled in five years for lack of risk indications, and declined to ban mink exports or require pre-departure checks, promising to raise the signal with the sector.
The NVWA contacted this competent authority to obtain more information about the situation found.
De NVWA heeft contact gezocht met deze bevoegde autoriteit om meer informatie te krijgen over de aangetroffen situatie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Ouwehand over het bericht dat het ABP 174 miljoen euro in de palmolie-industrie investeert

MPs Van Raan and Ouwehand asked whether the government finds the ABP's EUR 174 million investment in palm oil plantations in Papua, linked to rainforest clearance and human rights abuses, acceptable and whether it will press the fund to divest. The minister says the content is worrying, points to existing programmes on deforestation and land rights, and states that ABP decides its own investment policy while the government will pursue responsible-business covenants with the financial sector.
The pension fund ABP decides on its own investment policy and applies a specific responsible-investment policy.
Het pensioenfonds ABP gaat over het eigen beleggingsbeleid en hanteert specifiek beleid inzake verantwoord beleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het kantelen van een vrachtwagen met 300 jonge kalfjes aan boord

An MP asked the agriculture minister about a truck carrying about 300 young calves that overturned on the A16, the calves' ages, transport duration and rest stops, drinking systems, and monitoring of calf mortality and disease during transport. The minister answered most questions on substance, explained the rest-stop rules and NVWA checks, but declined to register transport deaths or illness, saying it is not a statutory task, and committed to no new action beyond referring the Irish stop violation to Irish authorities.
It is not a statutory task of the NVWA to register road accidents involving animals and report on them.
Het is geen wettelijke taak van de NVWA om wegongevallen met dieren te registreren en daarover te rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over fraude met kwarteleieren

An MP asked the minister of Agriculture about fraud with quail eggs sold as free-range, including whether quail farming for production is banned, which permits existed, and how inspections were carried out. The minister answered that no permits were ever granted, inspections found no quail, the NVWA and NCAE are investigating, and the minister will press for EU-level restrictions on quail egg laying cages.
I do not have information on this at my disposal.
Ik heb hierover geen informatie tot mijn beschikking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Arissen over de gevoeligheid van de eendenhouderij voor vogelpest

MPs Ouwehand and Arissen asked the government about the susceptibility of duck farming to avian influenza, outbreak frequency, hygiene, welfare links and whether duck farming should be closed. Minister Schouten answered that ducks are more easily infected, that housing and biosecurity measures reduce but cannot eliminate risk, and that she does not intend to ban duck farming, instead pursuing a future-vision trajectory with the sector and animal welfare groups.
I do not intend to ban duck farming in the Netherlands.
Ik ben niet van plan de eendenhouderij te verbieden in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het bericht dat er weer 30.000 kippen zijn gestorven bij een stalbrand op een bedrijf waar eerder al 80.000 kippen omkwamen door brand

MP Ouwehand asked the minister about a second barn fire at the same farm (30,000 chickens dead after 80,000 earlier), whether the stable met fire-safety rules, and whether existing stables should face stricter Building Code requirements. The minister confirmed the fire, said the stable was licensed in 2009 without a scrubber, admitted some data were unavailable, and said a review of Building Code rules for existing stables would report in the second half of 2018.
As indicated in the letter to parliament of 30 August 2017, I have started an exploration into adapting the Building Code for existing stables.
Ik heb, zoals aangegeven in de Kamerbrief van 30 augustus 2017, een verkenning gestart naar de aanpassing van het Bouwbesluit voor bestaande stallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het voortzetten van het succesvolle teeltproject zonder mest Planty Organic

MP Ouwehand asked the minister whether the Planty Organic mineral-self-sufficiency farming project, which received funding from 2013 to 2015 and now lacks money, should be continued and funded. The minister said project funding is always time-limited and renewal is not automatic, noted the project's promising results, and pointed the researchers to the Topsector Agro & Food call for new proposals rather than committing new funding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over dieren die verdrinken in hun eigen mest

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about 22 pigs that fell through slatted floors into a slurry pit in Wilp and drowned, and about how inspections of barn floors, animal numbers and welfare rules are enforced. The minister confirms the incident and the cruelty, refuses to disclose the farm's animal numbers citing privacy, explains NVWA's limited inspection role and that no prosecution will follow, and says the matter will be raised with the sector without committing to a specific new measure.
In the context of privacy, I do not consider it appropriate and correct to make the company data public in this individual case.
In het kader van privacy acht ik het niet gepast en correct om de bedrijfsgegevens in dit individuele geval openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het onderzoek van de commissie-Sorgdrager naar het fipronilschandaal

An MP asked whether the Sorgdrager commission's investigation into the fipronil egg scandal covers all actors in the egg chain, why private-sector representatives sit on its advisory group, and whether civil society groups such as foodwatch are heard. The ministers answer that the commission is independent and broad in scope, that no representatives of investigated organisations sit on the advisory group, and that the government will not steer the commission's findings.
No representatives of organisations that are the subject of the investigation take part in the expert advisory group.
In de klankbordgroep van deskundigen nemen geen vertegenwoordigers deel van organisaties die onderwerp van onderzoek zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Ouwehand over het transport –met dodelijke afloop- van 20.800 kalkoenkuikentjes per vliegtuig van Canada naar Nederland

An MP asked the ministers whether the transport by air from Canada to the Netherlands of 20,800 turkey chicks, about 90% of which died, was justified given animal welfare and climate impacts, and asked about inspection, enforcement and sanctions. The minister answered that air transport is allowed under IATA rules if followed, that the cause of death appears to be hypothermia, that the NVWA opened a criminal investigation and drew up a report, and that the case is ongoing so no further statements can be made.
In this specific case the matter is still ongoing and no further statements can be made.
In dit specifieke geval loopt de zaak nog en kunnen geen verdere uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de hoge aantallen dode, gewonde en kreupele kippen in eierboerderijen, ook die met een Beter Leven-keurmerk

An MP asks the minister about high mortality and injury among laying hens in all housing systems, including Beter Leven-certified farms, and about the animal welfare duty, the snavelkap ban, stocking density and subsidies for the egg sector. The minister acknowledges the footage is concerning and that mortality is around 8%, says no stricter stocking rules will be imposed beyond EU law, and says the beak-trimming evaluation will be discussed with the steering group before informing parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het daadwerkelijke aantal dieren dat is omgekomen bij stalbranden

MP Ouwehand asked the government why reported death tolls from the Agelo pig barn fire varied widely, whether fire services rely only on owners' figures, and whether stable fire prevention and animal welfare measures are adequate. Minister Kamp answered that fire services do not establish animal numbers themselves and rely on owners, that the fire response does not depend on exact numbers, and referred to the Actieplan Stalbranden evaluation for policy.
The number of animals involved in a fire is not established by the fire service.
Het aantal betrokken dieren bij een brand wordt niet vastgesteld door de brandweer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over Hepatitis E in varkensvleesproducten

An MP asks the Health Minister whether Hepatitis E found in Dutch pork products endangers consumers, whether labelling, recall, notification duties and export warnings are needed, and whether blood and organ donations are at risk. The minister replies that HEV RNA does not prove infectious virus, the risk is limited to defined risk groups who receive dietary advice, and a notification duty is not needed for now, while the EFSA opinion and RIVM study are awaited.
Given the international dimension of the problem, a coordinating role for the European Commission is desirable and necessary for such additional measures.
Gezien de internationale dimensie van het probleem is bij dergelijke aanvullende maatregelen een coördinerende rol van de Europese Commissie gewenst en noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het bericht dat Frankrijk de import van palmolie en onduurzame soja gaat verbieden

An MP asked whether the government will follow France in banning imports of unsustainable palm oil and soy to protect forests, and about Dutch responsibility for deforestation and the reliance on voluntary certification schemes. The minister answered that the government opposes import bans in principle, prefers sustainability in producing countries and voluntary standards (RSPO, RTRS), and rejects any contradiction in its climate and forest policy.

The cabinet is in principle not in favour of import bans, and instead works on making production in the countries themselves more sustainable and on increasing demand for sustainable palm oil and soy.

Het kabinet is in beginsel geen voorstander van importverboden, en werkt in plaats daarvan aan de verduurzaming van de productie in de landen zelf en aan het vergroten van de vraag naar duurzame palmolie en soja.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over honderdduizenden kippen die dreigen te worden gedood na ongefundeerde uitspraken van de NVWA in de fipronil-affaire

An MP asks whether the NVWA was right to tell poultry farmers they may decide themselves to kill fipronil-contaminated hens, and whether killing them is lawful under the Wet dieren, plus questions on hen-disease rules, treatment obligations, and NVWA oversight. The ministers answer that farmers may decide to have hens killed, that killing is not prohibited for hens under the cited provisions, that the NVWA gave no advice on the hens' fate, and that about 1.5 million hens had been killed at 47 locations by 15 August.
The NVWA indeed indicated that a poultry farmer can independently decide to have his hens killed early, without the government being obliged to do so.
De NVWA heeft inderdaad laten weten dat een pluimveehouder zelfstandig kan beslissen zijn kippen voortijdig te laten doden, zonder dat de overheid daartoe verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Hijink, Ouwehand en Van Raan over het steunen van de fossiele sector dmv exportkredietverzekeringen

MPs from the SP and PvdD asked whether Dutch export credit insurance (ekv) substantially supports the fossil fuel sector, including the reported €7.3 billion Atradius DSB exposure, and whether it should be tightened to align with Paris goals. The State Secretary answered that the ekv is generic and demand-driven with no fossil-specific policy, that it is cost-covering, that about 39% of the portfolio (€6.4 billion) is fossil-related, that oil and gas transactions undergo environmental and social due diligence, and that he will not explicitly phase out support for non-Paris-aligned projects while promoting renewable and climate-related export cover.
There is no policy to support the fossil fuel sector in particular.
Er is geen beleid om de fossiele sector in het bijzonder te ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de verstoring van jacht in broedtijd

MP Ouwehand asks whether hunters who shot geese during the breeding season in a Staatsbosbeheer nature area acted lawfully, whether charges were filed, and whether a general hunting ban in breeding, moulting and nursing periods should be introduced. The State Secretary replies that the shooting took place on adjacent land under a provincial exemption, no report was drawn up, a general ban is unnecessary, stricter penalties are not planned, and that provinces can attach conditions to exemptions.
No official report was drawn up, because there was no shooting in the Arkemheen polder nature area.
Er geen proces-verbaal opgemaakt, omdat er geen sprake was van afschot in het natuurgebied polder Arkemheen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Dik-Faber, Remco Dijkstra, Ouwehand, Cegerek, Van Veldhoven, Van Tongeren en Geurts over het bericht dat chemiebedrijven de veiligheidsregels schenden

MPs asked the state secretary how to respond to reports that more than half of Dutch major-risk chemical firms repeatedly violated safety rules, including risks to workers and residents in Zaltbommel and how inspections and enforcement work. The state secretary replied that violations fell from 850 to 615 in 2015, that most are light offences, that inspectors act immediately on serious ones, that Zaltbommel is being handled through a planning and permit process, and that repeat offenders face escalated sanctions.
As previously promised, I will send the State of Safety of Major Risk Companies report for 2016 to your House before the summer, including an analysis of regional differences in compliance rates.
Zoals eerder toegezegd, zal ik de Staat van de Veiligheid Majeure Risicobedrijven over 2016 voor de zomer naar uw Kamer sturen inclusief een analyse van regionale verschillen in naleefpercentages.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Ouwehand over het overzicht methaanemissies door olie- en gasindustrie

MPs Van Tongeren and Ouwehand asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about methane emission estimates and measurement methods in the oil and gas industry, including reporting gaps, the 1990s basis of the calculation method, and verification by SodM. The minister answered that emissions are calculated from measured flow rates and standard factors, that SodM supervises company reporting with four experts, and that NOGEPA is reviewing methods, while declining to fully answer the questions on Groningen gas production data that were covered by a separate Wob request.
For answering questions 28 to 31 I refer to my response to these questions, which I sent to your House on 9 February.
