Voor de beantwoording van vragen 28 t/m 31 verwijs ik naar mijn reactie op deze vragen, die ik uw Kamer op 9 februari jl. heb toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de besteding van belastinggeld aan foute soja

MP Ouwehand asks the minister about public funding for the Round Table on Responsible Soy and the Soy Fast Track Fund, including total spending, reporting on results, and whether funding should end after ten years of limited progress. The minister defends the RTRS standards and the fund, reports Dutch payments of about 6 million euro for phases I and II plus 3 million for phase III, and says the ministry will keep investing in sustainable soy.
This results reporting provides adequate insight into the use of the funds, including in the case of the Soy Fast Track Fund.
Deze resultaatsverantwoording geeft adequaat inzicht in de besteding van de middelen, ook in het geval van het Soy Fast Track Fund.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het levend strippen en half slachten van vissen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that live fish are gutted and partly slaughtered before being sold in a Nijmegen shop, and whether this conflicts with animal welfare law. The State Secretary confirmed awareness of the case, said the police and NVWA are investigating, and described ongoing research into stunning methods for fish on vessels, but gave no numbers on fish killed per method.
The NVWA therefore intervenes when irregularities are found.
De NVWA treedt dan ook op als onregelmatigheden worden geconstateerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over Nederlandse banken die investeren in de aanleg van de omstreden North Dakota oliepijpleiding

An MP asks the government about Dutch banks financing the contested Dakota Access pipeline and whether they should halt the project, respect Sioux rights, stop protest repression, and end fossil fuel lending. The minister answers by citing the OECD guidelines and UN principles, saying banks must use their influence and that the decision on permits and bank relationships is up to the US and the banks themselves, while the government will not take a position against the pipeline.

I expect Dutch banks to use their influence, in line with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights, to prevent and address potential violations.

Ik verwacht van Nederlandse banken dat zij conform de OESO Richtlijnen voor Multinationale Ondernemingen en de UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights (UNGP's) hun invloed gebruiken om (potentiële) schendingen te voorkomen en aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Dik-Faber, Ouwehand, Smaling en Jan Vos over het WOB-verzoek van Milieudefensie over gaswinningsbesluit 2016

Five MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the NAM's influence on the 2016 Groningen gas extraction decision, including a pre-sent expectations letter, consultations with NAM and Shell, and the withholding of an SodM advice from parliament. The minister answered that a draft expectations letter was shared with NAM only to test interpretation and feasibility, that the SodM advice was not actively sent but was later provided and published, and that the extraction ceiling was set on safety grounds at 24 billion m3 per year.
Since the SodM advice only confirmed that the process communicated to your House could proceed, I did not find it necessary to actively inform your House about it.
Aangezien het advies van SodM slechts bevestigde dat het met uw Kamer gecommuniceerde proces doorgang kon vinden, heb ik het niet nodig gevonden uw Kamer hier actief over te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het gevaarlijke landbouwgif buprofezin

An MP asks the state secretaries whether the EU will ban pesticide buprofezin for food crops after it can form the carcinogen aniline, why the Dutch Ctgb authorised it recently, and whether authorisation should be suspended while doubts exist. The government replies that the EC has not yet decided, that the Ctgb is an independent body applying EU assessment methods, and that authorisations will be adjusted if the EC changes approval.

The Ctgb, the Dutch authorisation authority, is an independent administrative body that assesses applications using European harmonised assessment methods and takes decisions based on the regulations in force at the time.

Het Ctgb – de Nederlandse toelatingsautoriteit – is een zelfstandig bestuursorgaan dat aanvragen toetst volgens Europees geharmoniseerde beoordelingsmethodieken en besluiten neemt op basis van de op dat moment vigerende regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de vergroeningseis van het Gemeenschappelijk Landbouwbeleid om permanent grasland te behouden

An MP asked the state secretary whether the CAP greening requirement to maintain permanent grassland is being met, including Dutch Natura 2000 protections, national monitoring, and a seemingly inconsistent earlier debate statement about ploughing grassland. The state secretary answered that the area of permanent grassland has not declined beyond the threshold, so no farm-level measures are needed, and that the earlier statement was consistent with the Commission's interpretation.
The result of this calculation was that there has been no decrease in the area of permanent grassland.
Het resultaat van deze berekening was dat er geen afname van het areaal blijvend grasland heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de gevaren van de aanwezigheid van landbouwgif in ons voedsel

MP Ouwehand asked about a French study finding pesticide residues in non-organic muesli, including levels she said exceeded drinking-water limits, possible hormone disruptors, and availability in Dutch supermarkets. The minister answered that residues are below EU maximum limits, the RIVM finds no consumer risk, no consequences or new testing are planned, and the government aims to speed the transition to sustainable crop protection.
I therefore attach no consequences to the results of this French study.
Ik verbind daarom geen consequenties aan de resultaten van deze Franse studie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de gevaren van anti vlooien- en tekenmiddel Bravecto

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports of illness and deaths in dogs linked to the flea and tick medicine Bravecto, and whether it should be withdrawn. The State Secretary confirmed the reports, said the EMA is reviewing a periodic safety report with priority, and said he would await that assessment before taking further action, while noting he could ban prescribing and application if needed.
I will therefore await the periodic safety report and the EMA's judgement.
Ik wacht het periodieke veiligheidsrapport en het oordeel van de EMA dan ook af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over impulsaankopen en het welzijn van paarden en pony's

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether it is acceptable that intoxicated buyers can impulsively purchase a 3.5-month-old foal at a horse market, whether that age is suitable for weaning, and whether the voluntary Sectorraad Paarden has protected horse welfare. The State Secretary answered that such sales should be careful and considered, that 3.5 months is too young under the Besluit houders van dieren, that the responsibility for welfare lies with the owner, and that a timely answer before the committee meeting was not possible.
Do you think 3.5 months is a suitable age for a foal to be separated from its mother and handed over to the trade? Answer 3: No.
Vindt u 3,5 maand een geschikte leeftijd voor een veulen om reeds van zijn moeder gescheiden te zijn en te worden overgeleverd aan de handel? Antwoord 3 Nee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de uitspraak dat Circus Renz International toch olifanten mag vervoeren ondanks verbod

An MP asked the state secretary about a court ruling allowing Circus Renz International to transport elephants despite the ban on wild animals in circuses. The secretary respects the interim ruling, will grant temporary exemptions for transport until the end of current tours for circuses in a similar position, and says performance with animals remains prohibited and will be enforced.
I respect this ruling. That means I will grant a temporary exemption for transporting animals until the end of their tour to circuses in a comparable situation.

Ik respecteer deze uitspraak. Dat betekent dat ik aan circussen die zich in een vergelijkbare situatie bevinden een tijdelijke ontheffing zal verlenen voor het vervoer van de dieren tot het einde van hun tournee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over rekening houden met fauna bij renovatie van woningen

MP Ouwehand asked whether alternative roosts for protected species were actually realised under the Stroomversnelling renovation exemption, and whether energy renovation of 111,000 homes should be redesigned to disturb fauna less. The Secretary of State said temporary alternatives are provided, overcompensation is expected, consultation with species organisations is ongoing, and that ensuring alternative roosts is the exemption holder's responsibility.
The initiator has not offered permanent alternative roosts in the area because, after an environmental check, it was found that sufficient alternatives exist nearby.

Door de initiatiefnemer zijn geen blijvende alternatieve verblijfplaatsen in de omgeving aangeboden omdat, na uitvoering van een omgevingscheck, is geconstateerd dat er in de omgeving voldoende alternatieven zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de consequenties van een mogelijke fusie van Monsanto en Syngenta voor de voedselzekerheid

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the food-security consequences of a possible Monsanto takeover of Syngenta, including whether BASF might also acquire parts of Syngenta and whether the takeover could be blocked by competition authorities. The government expressed concern about concentration of the global food supply at a few multinationals, and explained that Dutch and EU merger control apply under defined turnover thresholds, with the ACM and the European Commission assessing significant impediments to competition.
I find it worrying if the global food supply threatens to be concentrated among a few multinationals
Ik vind het zorgelijk als de wereldvoedselvoorziening dreigt te worden geconcentreerd bij enkele multinationals
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het bestrijdingsmiddel azadirachtin dat hommels bedreigt

An MP asked the State Secretary about a 2015 study linking the pesticide azadirachtin to reduced bumblebee survival and reproduction, why its approval did not consider bumblebees, how much is used, and whether a moratorium will be imposed. The Secretary said the study will be considered in the Ctgb's re-assessment, that the EU bee guidance now includes bumblebees, that sales data are confidential, and that no moratorium is planned pending that assessment.
The Ctgb has indicated that the cited publication will be taken into account in the re-assessment of the said product.
Het Ctgb heeft aangegeven dat de aangehaalde publicatie zal worden meegenomen binnen de herbeoordeling van het genoemde middel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over de illegale handel in puppy’s

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked the State Secretary and Justice Minister about illegal cross-border puppy trade, document fraud, online sales, veterinary complicity, police and NVWA enforcement, and a lifetime animal-keeping ban. The government answered that it has taken measures, pointed to separate letters, said veterinarians cannot be prosecuted without proven intent, rejected mandatory parent-dog presence, and promised an evaluation of the keeping ban before the summer recess.
At the request of the House, the Minister of Justice will also examine in the evaluation the possibilities of imposing the keeping ban as a standalone measure or penalty.
Op verzoek van uw Kamer laat de Minister van V&J in de evaluatie ook kijken naar de mogelijkheden het houdverbod als zelfstandige maatregel of straf op te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over het veilen en opvangen van dieren na een inbeslagname

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked why a severely neglected pony was auctioned after a bankruptcy and whether curators may auction animals and pressure debtors with seizure threats. The government answered that auctions are permitted under the Bankruptcy Act, that criminal complaints were filed, that curators must follow the Animal Welfare Act and may be complained about to the rechter-commissaris, and that no additional national policy is considered necessary.
This of course does not prevent those involved from complaining about the curator's conduct to the rechter-commissaris, who supervises the proper handling of the bankruptcy.
Dit laat uiteraard onverlet dat betrokkenen zich over het gedrag van de curator kunnen beklagen bij de rechter-commissaris, die toeziet op de correcte afwikkeling van het faillissement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Van Veldhoven over de Rijksverkoop van natuur in Nationaal Park

MPs Ouwehand and Van Veldhoven asked whether the sale by the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf of the Vafamil nature site in Bloemendaal, which lies within the EHS, Zuid-Kennemerland National Park and Natura 2000, should be stopped or transferred to a nature manager. Minister Blok answered that the site remains protected by zoning and Natura 2000 obligations regardless of buyer, that sales follow state-aid rules, and that zoning changes are a municipal responsibility.
For this reason, in principle it does not matter to whom the site is sold: a large nature manager or another private legal entity.
Om deze reden maakt het dan in beginsel niet uit aan wie het terrein wordt verkocht; een grote natuurbeheerder of een andere particuliere rechtspersoon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de dolfijnenslachtingen door Japan en de Faeröer en het plan van Japan om de walvisjacht weer te hervatten

An MP asked the government about dolphin hunts in Japan and the Faroe Islands, Danish police role, whether Japan would resume Antarctic whaling despite the ICJ ruling, and the EU-Japan trade and framework agreements. The ministers said Denmark would be pressed on dolphin killings, the ICJ ruling strengthens opposition to whaling, and whaling and dolphin killing would be raised in the EU-Japan framework negotiations, though no EU consensus exists on linking trade to whaling.
The cabinet will again address Denmark and indicate that killing dolphins, as happens in the Faroe Islands, is not acceptable.
Het kabinet zal Denemarken opnieuw aanspreken en aangeven dat het doden van dolfijnen, zoals dit gebeurt op de Faeröer eilanden, niet acceptabel is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de grote brand op het industrieterrein in Maastricht

The MP asked whether toxic substances and asbestos were released in a large fire at a Maastricht industrial estate, why residents did not receive a NL-Alert, and about permits, inspections and fire safety. The Minister answered that no harmful concentrations were found, the NL-Alert was mistakenly replaced by Burgernet, inspections found the companies in order, and the distances to housing were adequate.
It is not known at which company the fire started.
Niet bekend is bij welk bedrijf de brand is ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de effecten van het gebruik van landbouwgif op Natura 2000-gebieden

Ouwehand (PvdD) asked whether the Alterra report on bulb cultivation near Natura 2000 areas, showing high pesticide use may harm protected wetlands, justifies a ban and mandatory appropriate assessments. The state secretary replied that the Ctgb already accounts for non-target risks, that bulb growing is treated as existing use not requiring a permit, that provinces are competent authorities, and that no ban or retroactive assessments are planned, while noting knowledge gaps are being studied.
Are you willing to introduce a ban on growing bulbs and other pesticide-intensive crops in and around Natura 2000 areas?
Bent u bereid om een verbod in te stellen op het in telen van bollen en andere gif-intensieve teelten in en rond Natura 2000-gebieden?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het rapport ‘Ecologische gevolgen van bollenteelt op de Veluwe’ van Alterra

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the minister whether the Alterra report on high pesticide use in Veluwe bulb cultivation, which found larger potential effects than arable crops, should lead to consequences for bulb growing near drinking water catchments and for Water Framework Directive goals. The state secretary replied that the Ctgb assesses risks of individual pesticides including to protected areas and drinking water catchments, that the report did not establish the actual risk, and that no consequences follow, and declined to answer before the scheduled water committee meeting in time.

Because the Alterra study does not indicate how large the risk of bulb cultivation on the Veluwe actually is, and because risks to drinking water catchments are assessed when pesticides are authorised, the conclusions of the Alterra report have no consequences for bulb cultivation in and around drinking water catchments.

Omdat de studie van Alterra niet aangeeft hoe groot het risico van de bollenteelt op de Veluwe daadwerkelijk is en omdat bij de toelatingen van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen de risico's voor drinkwaterwingebieden worden beoordeeld, hebben de conclusies uit het Alterrarapport geen gevolgen voor de bollenteelt in en rond drinkwaterwingebieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over Europese subsidies voor promotie van bloemen

MP Ouwehand asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether EU co-financing for the 'Lievelingsbloem' flower promotion campaign should be opposed, questioned pesticide use and social costs in flower cultivation, and asked for stricter conditions. The State Secretary confirmed roughly EUR 4.04 million in EU co-financing over three years, said promotion should be left to the sector but that the Council accepted all farm products, and stated that pesticide use is regulated and enforced by the NVWA without quantifying social costs.
From the standpoint of a level playing field, as long as Dutch entrepreneurs comply with the Community rules, I will not deny them the possibility of using this scheme.
Vanuit het oogpunt van gelijk speelveld ga ik Nederlandse ondernemers, zolang zij zich aan de communautaire regels houden, niet de mogelijkheid ontzeggen om van deze regeling gebruik te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Smaling en Ouwehand over het bericht dat de EU ervan afziet om teerzandolie te labelen

MPs Jasper van Dijk, Smaling and Ouwehand asked whether the EU's dropping of a separate label for tar sands oil, its impact on climate ambitions, CETA and TTIP, and possible import bans or labelling are acceptable. The State Secretary answered that tar sands oil is still legally importable, that no import ban or consumer labelling is feasible given traceability limits, and that EU climate targets are not weakened.
I have no plans to exclude tar sands oil from the Netherlands.
Ik heb geen plannen om teerzandolie te weren uit Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het maatschappelijk verzet tegen dierproeven op labradors

An MP asked the state secretary about public opposition to planned dog experiments on 39 labradors at Maastricht University, the 323 dogs used 2004–2012, rising dog-experiment numbers, and ethical review and transparency. The answers say the experiments were paused, an external commission will review them, and a new central licensing body (CCD) with published summaries will increase transparency and ethical scrutiny.
The Government Information (Public Access) Act ensures that every citizen can gain insight into government actions.
De Wet openbaarheid van bestuur zorgt ervoor dat iedere burger inzage kan krijgen in het overheidshandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het bericht dat er nog steeds wrede dierproeven voor Botox worden gedaan

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether animal toxicity tests (LD50/LC50) for Botox products continue in the EU and the Netherlands despite bans on cosmetic animal testing and on LD50 tests, and why an animal-free alternative was not used. The State Secretary answers that no botulinum toxin LD50 tests are done in the Netherlands, that no EU ban applies to these medicinal products, that exemptions remain possible when no alternative exists, that an alternative exists only for one producer's product, and that a review of LD50/LC50 testing will be sent to parliament.
I have no information available on the increase in the use of botulinum toxin nor on the (increase in the) number of animal tests for botulinum toxin products.
Ik heb geen informatie beschikbaar over de toename van het gebruik van botulinetoxine noch over (de toename van) het aantal dierproeven voor botulinetoxine-producten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over export van levende wolhandkrabben naar voedselautomaten in China

Ouwehand (PvdD) asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about export of live Chinese mitten crabs to Chinese vending machines, including their packaging, welfare, dioxin contamination and whether export should be halted. The government answered that export to Hong Kong is the only destination recorded, that no welfare rules specific to invertebrates exist, that it sees no reason to stop exports because EU free movement of goods forbids a ban, and that it will talk with the sector about careful transport.
I see no reason to stop the export.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de export te stoppen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Van Veldhoven, Dik-Faber en Ouwehand over schaliegasboringen Argentinië

MPs from GroenLinks, D66, ChristenUnie and PvdD asked the government about Shell's shale gas test drilling in Argentina, including proximity to a protected area, environmental information access, consultation and compensation for local farmers, and OECD guideline compliance. The minister answered that the drilling lies outside the current protected area, that Shell claims legal compliance and denies harm to livestock, that the embassy's 2013 site visit was routine economic diplomacy, and that OECD guideline questions fall to the National Contact Point.
Whether and to what extent the Environment and Information Disclosure chapters apply to Shell's activities in Vaca Muerta, I cannot assess.
Of en in hoeverre de hoofdstukken Milieu en Informatieverstrekking van toepassing zijn op de activiteiten van Shell in Vaca Muerta, kan ik niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het monitoren en beïnvloeden van internetdiscussies over het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice and the Prime Minister whether ministry staff monitor and try to influence online discussions about the ministry's policy, and whether this is acceptable given citizens' freedom of expression. The minister replied that no staff are recruited to influence opinion, that monitoring media is a way to pick up signals from society, that staff must identify themselves as civil servants online, and that influencing discussions is outside the communication guidelines.
Ministers do not recruit staff to monitor and influence citizens' opinions about their policy and functioning.
Bewindslieden werven geen medewerkers om de meningsvorming van burgers over hun beleid en functioneren te volgen en te beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het voorstel dat een nationaal teeltverbod op gengewassen mogelijk zou moeten maken

Deputy MP Ouwehand asked the state secretaries whether the proposal giving member states a national power to ban GM crop cultivation had changed, which countries block it, whether the Netherlands can support a proposal that does not meet the Ouwehand motion, and whether a political debate should precede any decision. The government answered only by referring the Chamber to a recent letter on the proposal and the expected Environment Council discussion.
For the answers to your questions I refer you to the recent letter sent to your Chamber on the proposal for national cultivation competence
Voor de beantwoording van uw vragen verwijs ik u naar de recent aan uw Kamer gestuurde brief over het voorstel voor nationale teeltbevoegdheid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over het gebruik van levende dieren bij militaire oefeningen

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked whether the Ministry of Defence should stop using live animals in military medical training, given available simulators and EU rules, and why it allegedly told PETA US otherwise. The minister acknowledged live-animal training remains mandatory for trauma surgeons and anaesthetists (DSTC/DATC courses) with no alternative, denied a breach of Dutch law, and admitted the 2011 statement to PETA was inaccurate.
This information is not known to me. There are no international agreements or obligations regarding such reporting, and in practice this information is also not exchanged.
Deze informatie is mij niet bekend. Er zijn geen internationale afspraken of verplichtingen inzake dergelijke rapportages en ook in de praktijk wordt deze informatie niet uitgewisseld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het lot van uitgezette otters in Nederland

An MP asks the State Secretary about otters killed in muskrat traps, PCB contamination, road deaths and the legitimacy of the otter reintroduction programme, and whether permits should be revoked. The State Secretary answers that bycatch is minimised but cannot be fully prevented, that the PCB link is unproven, that reintroduction met IUCN guidelines, and that one permit remains valid with no new applications known.
I have asked Alterra to prepare a report on the traffic hotspots where otters are often victims of road traffic.
Ik heb aan Alterra gevraagd om een rapport op te stellen over de verkeersknelpunten waar otters vaak slachtoffer van het verkeer zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het gebruik van baden met garra-rufavissen

An MP asked the government about health risks, animal welfare and a Belgian advisory opinion concerning fish spa baths with garra rufa fish. The minister said RIVM considers the risks acceptable with user restrictions and hygiene rules, rejected a ban, and pointed to existing animal welfare rules.
I intend to provide, in the amendment of the Bhvbz, that the operator must ensure the fish spa is not used by them.
Daarom ben ik voornemens om bij de wijziging van het Bhvbz te regelen dat de exploitant ervoor zorg moet dragen dat de fish spa niet door hen gebruikt wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het verkrijgen van een Europees patent op soja door Monsanto

An MP asked whether the European Patent Office granted Monsanto a patent on soybean traits giving exclusive rights over more than 250 varieties, and whether this conflicts with the Biotechnology Directive and calls for no patents on conventional breeding. The State Secretary answered that the patent covers only a marker-based screening method, not plants or varieties, that it was granted under the EPC, that no objection will be lodged, and that the government is pursuing a broad breeders' exemption.
I see no reason to object to the patent in question.
Ik zie geen reden om bezwaar te maken tegen het onderhavige octrooi.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de aanpak van broodfok en malafide hondenhandel

The MP asks the State Secretary and Minister how the government will tackle puppy-farming and dishonest dog trade, including inspection numbers, prosecution, licensing of vets, and identification and registration of dogs. The government answers with inspection and recheck figures, enforcement capacity, prosecution limits, a rejection of a standalone kennel ban and of an extra identification requirement, and a commitment to a review in about eighteen months.
This information cannot be generated from the systems of the Public Prosecution Service (OM).
Deze informatie kan niet uit de systemen van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) worden gegenereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Tongeren, Paulus Jansen, Agnes Mulder en Ouwehand over het verstrekken van jodiumpillen in verband met het beperken van effecten van een nucleaire ramp

MPs from GroenLinks, SP, CDA and PvdD asked the Minister of Health whether Dutch households should receive iodine tablets in advance of a nuclear accident, given the Tsjernobyl and Fukushima experience with central storage. The minister said she is considering door-to-door distribution for some zones, will consult regional partners and the ministries involved, and admitted she does not know how long distribution takes or how many people could be reached.

In the coming months I want to work out, in consultation with the Ministers of Economic Affairs and of Security and Justice and the relevant regional partners, a proposal for effective and efficient distribution of iodine tablets.

De komende maanden wil ik in overleg met de Ministers van Economische Zaken en Veiligheid en Justitie en de betrokken regionale partners een voorstel uitwerken voor een effectieve en efficiënte distributie van jodiumtabletten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over het gebruik van levende dieren bij militaire oefeningen

Two MPs asked the government whether it condones live-animal military training such as shooting pigs and goat trauma drills, and whether Dutch soldiers take part in such training. The minister answered that the armed forces limit animal use as far as possible, that survival and trauma-surgery training uses pigs and rabbits or chickens under supervision, and that she cannot commit to ending such training for Dutch soldiers.
No, this information is not available.
Nee, deze informatie is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwenhand over het fokken en doden van gezonde dieren in dierentuinen

An MP asks the State Secretary whether zoos may cull healthy animals to prevent inbreeding, how many animals Dutch zoos breed and cull, and whether the EAZA rules should be tightened. The State Secretary answers that euthanasia is a last resort, that Dutch zoos report births and deaths to RVO.nl with no excesses found, and that no tightening of breeding programmes is planned.
These overviews are assessed for excesses and risks.
Deze overzichten worden beoordeeld op excessen en risico's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over aanvallen van Japanse walvisvaarders op Nederlandse schepen van Sea Shepherd

The MP asks the government whether it knows of Japanese whaling vessels attacking a Sea Shepherd ship, whether this endangers maritime safety, what it has done to respond, and whether it will prosecute or raise the issue at the IWC. The minister answers that the ILT has examined the February 2 incidents, found intimidating manoeuvres that may have been deliberate, referred the report to the Public Prosecution Service, raised concerns with the Japanese ambassador, and will voice concerns at the IWC.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to assess whether further action will follow.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te beoordelen of terzake nadere actie zal volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over ongunstige milieucondities in natuurgebieden

An MP asked the state secretary about a Wageningen study finding nitrogen from livestock farming and drying-out of nature as main threats to Dutch nature, and whether sustainable farming and policy changes would follow. The state secretary agreed the study points to these problems, supports further sustainable farming within existing plans, and said the study offers no new insights beyond what led to the nitrogen programme.
I am in favour of further sustainability in agriculture; this contributes to improving nature quality.
Ik ben een voorstander van een verdere verduurzaming van de landbouw, dit draagt bij aan het verbeteren van de natuurkwaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over dolfijnenslachtingen in Taiji en handel in dolfijnen voor entertainment

An MP asked the foreign and economic affairs ministers about the dolphin slaughter in Taiji, the sale of dolphins for entertainment, and follow-up on earlier motions and IWC efforts. The government answered that the ambassador voiced disapproval, that Dutch efforts continue via the IWC and EU trade talks, and that it will inform parliament of outcomes.
On the Dutch position at the upcoming IWC annual meeting in September 2014, your House will be informed in good time.
Over de inzet van Nederland tijdens de komende jaarvergadering van de IWC in september 2014 zal uw Kamer tijdig worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het lot van de paarden die na het faillissement van een zorgboerderij worden geveild

MP Ouwehand asked why the 28 horses of a bankrupt care farm were being auctioned, whether the auction should be stopped in favour of rehoming, and whether the food safety authority NVWA had checked animal welfare or was involved in the auction decision. The state secretary answered that bankruptcy handling follows the rules regardless of cause, that high bids made impulse purchases or slaughter sales unlikely so stopping the auction is not needed, and that the NVWA had received no welfare complaints and was not involved in the auction decision.
The NVWA is not involved in the decision to auction the horses or in its further course.
De NVWA is niet betrokken bij het besluit tot veiling van de paarden of het verdere verloop daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, Jacobi, Van Gerven, Graus, Schouw, Klaver en Klein over de gevolgen van het bestrijdingsmiddel metram-natrium op de volksgezondheid, het milieu en de natuur

MPs from several parties asked the state secretary about the EU ban on metam-natrium, its health and environmental risks, and why the Netherlands keeps granting exemptions, including a 120-day article 38 exemption that the Ctgb advised against. The state secretary answered that the EU exemption is for essential use, that the article 38 exemption covers a very small area against a quarantine nematode, and promised talks with the sector and a letter to parliament on limiting exposure of residents.
I will shortly consult with LTO and the relevant party in the crop protection industry on the possibilities for further regulating residents' exposure to metam-natrium.

Ik zal op korte termijn over de mogelijkheden van het verder reguleren van de blootstelling van metam-natrium aan omwonenden in overleg treden met LTO en de relevante partij in de gewasbeschermingsmiddelenindustrie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de toelating van gentechgewassen in de Europese Unie

The MP Ouwehand asked why the government voted for EU import approval of genetically modified maize MON 87460 without first informing parliament, and whether it considers GMO safety proven given scientists' concerns. The government replied that its vote followed EFSA, COGEM and RIKILT advice, that it trusts the EFSA risk assessment, and that it will place a parliamentary reservation and inform parliament on its approach to GMO approvals, including maize 1507, before that vote.
Until I have discussed this cabinet approach with you, I will enter a parliamentary reservation on votes concerning this crop.
Totdat ik deze kabinetsaanpak met u besproken heb, zal ik een parlementair voorbehoud aantekenen bij stemmingen over dit gewas.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over “De bedreigde status van vissen door de jacht op nepkaviaar"

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs whether the lumpfish is threatened by hunting for its roe used in fake caviar, and whether Dutch fishing should be banned. The State Secretary answered that the species is poorly studied and not assessed as threatened, that Dutch catches are incidental (about 500 kg since 2002), and that a Dutch ban is not appropriate, though she will raise the issue in the Fisheries Council.
However, I will raise attention for the issue in the Fisheries Council, since other member states such as Denmark and Sweden land larger quantities.
Wel zal ik in de Visserijraad aandacht vragen voor de problematiek, aangezien andere lidstaten zoals Denemarken en Zweden grotere hoeveelheden aanlanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het verlenen van een vergunning aan Cuadrilla

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether Cuadrilla's financial position and corporate responsibility, given the SOMO quick scan, justified granting it an exploration licence, and why no financial guarantee under article 46 of the Mining Act was required. The minister replied that the financial capacity and corporate responsibility assessments gave no grounds to refuse or revoke the licence, that business-confidential financial data will not be published, and that the guarantee could not be required at the exploration stage.
Business-confidential financial data about Cuadrilla I cannot and will not make public.
Bedrijfsvertrouwelijke, financiële gegevens over Cuadrilla kan en wil ik niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de goudvisindustrie

Ouwehand (PvdD) asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about welfare conditions for ornamental goldfish in breeding, air transport, sedation, retail housing and sales volumes, following a Keuringsdienst van Waarde broadcast. The State Secretary answered that transport is governed by IATA rules and NVWA enforcement, that volumes and origins are not registered, and that new pet-trade rules and buyer information will improve welfare.
The origin and the species are not registered.
De herkomst en de soorten worden niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de Natuurbeschermingswetvergunningverlening in Drenthe

MP Ouwehand asks the State Secretary about Drenthe granting 214 Nature Conservation Act permits in 2013 under the Groenmanifest, possibly exhausting nitrogen headroom before the PAS is in force, and whether the province is too lax. The State Secretary answers that none were tested by the Council of State, the province has suspended the Groenmanifest until 1 February 2014, and the PAS, like the Groenmanifest, uses a 'hand on the tap' principle, with detailed figures to follow in the draft PAS programme.
Given the large number of permit applications, the province of Drenthe decided to pause and suspend the Groenmanifest until 1 February 2014.
Naar aanleiding van het grote aantal vergunningaanvragen heeft provincie Drenthe besloten een pas op de plaats te maken en het Groenmanifest tot 1 februari 2014 op te schorten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Van Dekken over aanhoudende overtredingen van het verbod op het verloten van dieren

MPs Ouwehand and Van Dekken asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why animals such as horses, ponies, calves and pigeons are still being raffled despite the legal ban, whether enforcement and penalties will be tightened, and how the ban is enforced. The State Secretary acknowledged the violations, said existing tools (compliance orders with penalty payments and criminal action) are sufficient, confirmed repeated administrative action against the Assendelft riding-school owner, and reported five compliance orders and one warning since 2011 but no permanent monitoring of all sites.
I have sufficient possibilities to act against the raffling of animals.
Ik heb voldoende mogelijkheden om tegen het verloten van dieren op te treden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het plan om de leefbaarheid van het dorp Moerdijk op te offeren voor economische ontwikkeling

MP Ouwehand asked ministers whether the advisory commission's view that port and industrial growth at Moerdijk should take priority over village liveability, and the resulting environmental, health and traffic impacts, were acceptable. The government answered that the trade-off is a matter for the regional authorities in the consultation on the port vision, that environmental norms still apply, and that it sees no role for the national government at this stage.
Given this consultation process, I currently see no role for the national government.
Gelet op dit consultatieproces zie ik thans geen rol voor de rijksoverheid weggelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman, Schouw, Gesthuizen, Ouwehand en Voordewind over de voorgenomen ontruiming van de vluchtflat

MPs asked the state secretary what happens to residents of the Amsterdam 'vluchtflat' without residence prospects after its planned eviction, whether immigration detention is appropriate for them, who bears responsibility for their welfare and medical care, and whether alternative shelter will be provided before eviction. The state secretary replied that residents may choose to work on return and then get shelter in a freedom-restricting location with DT&V facilitation, that detention is a last resort applied case by case, that residents remain responsible for their own choices while retaining right to necessary medical care, and that he shares the ambition to prevent residents ending up on the street.
Since the residents of the Vluchtflat show no willingness to return and hardly want to talk to the DT&V, I do not rule out that in individual cases immigration detention may be the last resort.

Nu de bewoners van de Vluchtflat niet getuigen van terugkeerbereidheid en nauwelijks willen praten met de DT&V, sluit ik niet uit dat in individuele gevallen vreemdelingenbewaring het uiterste middel kan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het plankgasplannetje op de A2

MP Ouwehand (PvdD) asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs why the minister of Infrastructure and Environment's claims about raising the A2 speed limit to 130 km/h were not coordinated with her, whether the nitrogen reduction under the PAS can deliver what was promised, and when nature will have recovered enough for the speed increase. The state secretary replied that the earlier answers were given on behalf of the cabinet, that preliminary AERIUS calculations suggest little impact on nitrogen, that the PAS will be substantiated when the draft programme is published, and that nature recovery timing is covered by the PAS.
The draft PAS programme will be made available for public inspection.
Het conceptprogramma PAS zal ter inzage worden gelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het houden van haaien in een discotheek

MP Ouwehand asked whether sharks kept in a discotheque aquarium in Arnhem comply with animal welfare law, whether the NVWA inspected before opening, and whether the state will act. The state secretary confirmed the aquarium, reported a September inspection finding no animal suffering or violation and no legal basis for seizure, and referred to earlier answers for the remaining questions.
The NVWA was unable to establish animal suffering, and therefore also no violation.
De NVWA heeft geen dierenkwelling kunnen vaststellen, en daarmee ook geen overtreding.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de schimmelinfectie die de vuursalamander bedreigt

MP Ouwehand asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs about a chytrid fungus threatening the fire salamander, including its spread, possible spillover to other amphibians, and funding for multi-year research and protection. The state secretary agreed the findings are important and said she is taking stock of research priorities with researchers and managers and is willing to contribute financially, without committing to a specific multi-year study or timetable.
I am taking stock, with the researchers and managers involved, of the priorities for further research and remedial measures.
Ik inventariseer met betrokken onderzoekers en beheerders de prioriteiten voor verder onderzoek en remediërende maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over stopzetten diervriendelijke aanpak zwerfkattenprobleem terwijl jacht op katten blijft toegestaan

An MP asks why the state secretary froze new exemptions for the Trap-Neuter-Return method for stray cats while provinces still authorise shooting cats, and questions the rejection of an identification and registration duty for cats. The secretary answers that exemptions are under review for effectiveness, no new ones are issued pending results, and that culling permission and cat-policy choices lie with provinces.
Granting permission to shoot stray cats is a responsibility of the provinces.
Het verlenen van toestemming voor afschieten van zwerfkatten is een verantwoordelijkheid van de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het dumpen van hondjes

An MP asks the State Secretary whether dumping puppies in water (Voorburg, with a witness seeing the man walk away, and a nursing dog left at a supermarket) should lead to a ban on keeping animals, and what will be done to prevent such cases. The government declines to comment on the individual cases pending prosecution, but says dumping animals will be explicitly classed as animal cruelty in the draft Besluit houders van dieren, allowing a keeping ban of up to 10 years as a condition of a suspended sentence.
In general, abandoning an animal (dumping) will be explicitly classified as animal cruelty in the draft Besluit houders van dieren.
Ten algemene, wordt het zich ontdoen van een dier (dumpen) in het concept-Besluit houders van dieren expliciet aangemerkt als dierenmishandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het misbruiken van Braziliaanse «Moeders voor Moeders» door MSD voor vruchtbaarheidsversnellers voor de bioindustrie

MP Ouwehand asked whether MSD's use of Brazilian women's urine and pregnant mares' blood to produce the fertility drug PG600 for pig farming was misleading, and whether these animal tests should be stopped. The state secretary answered that the women were not properly informed and that the programme has been stopped, that PG600 is a licensed veterinary drug, and that she is investigating whether the horse-blood animal test licence still fits the Animal Testing Act framework.
Exact data on the number of farms using this product and the number of pigs involved are not known.
Exacte gegevens over het aantal bedrijven die dit middel gebruiken en bij hoeveel varkens zijn niet bekend.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken over resistente schimmel bij patiënten en in huizen als gevolg van landbouwgif (ingezo

An MP asks the health minister and state secretary whether an azole-resistant Aspergillus fungus spreading in homes and patients is linked to agricultural fungicides, and what is being done. The minister answers that a causal link is not proven but not excluded, that a referral laboratory and a Royal HaskoningDHV study on biocides are under way, and that the Ctgb can withdraw approvals only on new scientific evidence.
It is still unclear where the cause of the resistance lies; it may be in agriculture, but also outside it.
Het is nog onduidelijk waar de oorzaak van de resistentie ligt, dat kan in de landbouw zijn, maar ook er buiten.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over bewegende lasers aan windmolenwieken in vogelgebied

An MP asked whether planned moving lasers on wind turbines at the Tweede Maasvlakte bird area had been studied for effects on migratory birds and protected colonies, and whether the state land owner would prevent nature disturbance. The state secretary answered that no such study exists yet, that the operator must show no significant harm to protected nature, and that any permit would be assessed later.
No, no research has been done on that.
Nee, daar is geen onderzoek naar gedaan.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over haaien als attractie in een club

An MP asked the state secretary whether a planned permanent shark aquarium in an Arnhem nightclub, which would hold small sharks and groupers, threatens animal welfare, and whether such animals should be banned as pets. The answer acknowledges the plan, says noise, vibration and light could stress the animals and that the NVWA has been asked to investigate, and points to a forthcoming positive list for pets.
I have asked the NVWA to conduct further investigation into this.
Ik heb de NVWA verzocht hiernaar nader onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de oproepen van de Dierenbescherming aan dierenwinkels in Amsterdam en Diemen te stoppen met de verkoop van konijnen

MP Ouwehand asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the Dierenbescherming's call on pet shops to stop selling rabbits, the overcrowding of rabbit shelters, and an industry trade magazine article advising how to persuade parents into impulse purchases, asking whether the government will resist self-regulation and address impulse buying in its animal welfare policy letter. The State Secretary agrees the initiative to rehome rabbits is good, notes that sellers must advise buyers under the Besluit Gezelschapsdieren, points to the Landelijk Informatiecentrum Gezelschapsdieren, says certification could complement rules, and promises an animal welfare policy letter before summer including impulse purchases.
As promised, I will send your House an animal welfare policy letter before the summer, of which impulse purchases will be part.
Zoals toegezegd stuur ik uw Kamer voor de zomer een beleidsbrief dierenwelzijn, waar impulsaankopen onderdeel van uit maakt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de fraudebestendigheid van het registratiesysteem voor honden

An MP asked the state secretary about fraud vulnerabilities in the dog registration system, including whether personal data could be deleted anonymously and why multiple databases exist. The state secretary said the system is sound, that only Dienst Regelingen can delete central records, and that no changes are planned until a three-year evaluation.
In three years the measures taken under the identification and registration of dogs will be evaluated.
Over 3 jaar worden de maatregelen genomen in het kader van identificatie en registratie van honden geëvalueerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de gevaren van mestvergisters voor de volksgezondheid

MP Ouwehand asked whether manure digesters pose public health risks, citing a 2012 biogas leak in Coevorden that forced evacuations, and whether local permitting and oversight are adequate and whether national rules or a construction stop are needed. The government answered that the RIVM risk assessment was sound, that the permit and enforcement questions are for the competent local authority and that it has no information on the Coevorden permit, and that it will evaluate co-digestion policy in two years but sees no need for a construction stop.
I have no insight into the permit for the digester in Coevorden and its enforcement by the competent authority.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de vergunning voor de vergister in Coevorden en de handhaving daarvan door het bevoegde gezag.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Bonis en Ten Broeke over de detentie van Abdulkareem Yousef al-Khoder in Saudi-Arabië

MPs from many parties asked the foreign minister whether the four-month detention of human rights activist Abdulkareem Yousef al-Khoder in Saudi Arabia was justified, whether the government agrees with Amnesty International that he is a prisoner of conscience, and whether it will urge Saudi Arabia to release him. The minister answered that the EU is investigating the background of the arrest with Saudi bodies, that EU action will depend on the outcome, and that the Netherlands generally raises human rights defender issues with Saudi authorities.
Depending on the outcome of the investigation, the EU will consider whether, and if so what, action is effective and desirable.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek zal in EU-verband worden bezien of, en zo ja welke, actie effectief en wenselijk is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over het gebruik van slangen in amusementsprogramma’s

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs about snakes used in the entertainment show Killer Karaoke, including whether the stress caused to the animals should be combated and whether oversight should be tightened. The state secretary replied that the NVWA has started a criminal investigation under the Animal Health and Welfare Act, declined to comment on the stress while it is ongoing, and saw no reason to tighten oversight.
Pending that investigation, I make no statements about the remarks of Dr. Freek Vonk and the stress the snakes may have undergone.
Hangende dat onderzoek doe ik geen mededelingen over de uitlatingen van Dr. Freek Vonk en de stress, die de slangen mogelijk ondergaan hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de gevaren van bestrijdingsmiddelen voor de volksgezondheid

Ouwehand (PvdD) asked whether an Australian study linking parental pesticide exposure in pregnancy to childhood brain tumours applies in the Netherlands, and whether imidacloprid and similar products should be withdrawn. Minister Schippers answered that RIVM and Ctgb see no evidence of tumour formation from authorised pesticides, that the study cannot establish causation or the substances involved, and that no fixed measures or deadlines can be set in advance for new scientific findings.
The Ctgb and RIVM concluded that for pesticides authorised in the Netherlands there are so far no indications that these agents lead to tumour formation in the brain.
Het Ctgb en het RIVM hebben geconcludeerd dat voor bestrijdingsmiddelen die in Nederland zijn toegelaten vooralsnog geen aanwijzingen zijn dat deze middelen leiden tot tumorvorming in de hersenen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het doden van een hond na een bijtincident

An MP asked the state secretary about the planned euthanasia of a dog after a bite incident, whether training could be an alternative, and whether tailored solutions and reliable behavioural testing would be pursued. The state secretary answered that municipalities are responsible, the mayor accepted a free training and assessment offer from a behavioural centre, and the state secretary has asked the Animal Affairs Council for an advisory opinion on preventing aggressive dog behaviour.
It is the responsibility of the municipality to decide how to handle bite incidents.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente te besluiten hoe om te gaan met bijtincidenten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over overtredingen bij het zaaien van met bestrijdingsmiddelen behandelde zaden en plotselinge vogelsterfte in Friesland

An MP asks the State Secretary of Economic Affairs whether neonicotinoid-treated sugar beet seed was left exposed during sowing in strong wind, whether the usage rules were breached, what enforcement occurred, and whether a link exists to bird deaths in Friesland. The government answers that no violation was established, no NVWA report was received, the bird deaths were attributed to roosting starlings and a broken branch, and it sees no grounds to tighten Ctgb approval criteria.
Based on the article you cite, it cannot be established whether there was a violation, because information about the conditions during sowing is missing.
Op grond van het door u geciteerde artikel kan niet worden vastgesteld of er sprake was van een overtreding, omdat informatie over de omstandigheden tijdens inzaai ontbreekt.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over de Tweede Nota Duurzame Gewasbescherming

An MP asked the state secretaries how the Second Pesticide Reduction Policy Note is progressing, the status of the Grashoff motion on glyphosate use and comparative studies of chemical versus non-chemical weed control, who is responsible for promoting non-chemical methods (Nefyto), and when the Note will be sent. The government answered that the Note will be finalised and sent in May, the two studies are nearly ready and will be forwarded with the Note, and responsibility for non-chemical methods lies with the ministers, not with industry.
I will finalise the Note and send it to you in May.
Ik zal de Nota afronden en u deze in mei toezenden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de handhaving van het coupeerverbod voor honden en paarden

An MP asked the state secretary how the ban on docking dogs' tails and horses' tails is enforced, given footage showing docked dogs at Dutch shows and an apparent trade in docked dogs. The state secretary replied that enforcement of the ban on the procedure abroad rests with Belgian authorities, that a ban on owning or exhibiting legally docked foreign dogs would conflict with EU free movement, and referred to a letter on horses.
Enforcement of that is for the Belgian enforcement authorities.
Handhaving daarvan is aan de Belgische handhavingsinstanties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het niet functioneren van tal van faunavoorzieningen die als compensatie moesten dienen voor het aantasten van de natuur

MP Ouwehand asked the state secretary whether many wildlife compensation structures (fish passages, animal tunnels, amphibian tunnels, ledges) are malfunctioning, how they are inspected, whether sanctions were imposed, and whether an investigation will be launched. The secretary says he has no data confirming or denying the claims, that enforcement covers only structures tied to the Flora- and faunawet, that 200 cases were resolved in three years without sanctions, and that he will approach managing bodies to check for deterioration.
As stated in my answer to question 3, my responsibility and authority are limited to facilities related to violations of the Flora- and faunawet
Zoals vermeld in mijn antwoord op vraag 3 beperkt mijn verantwoordelijkheid en bevoegdheid zich tot voorzieningen die zijn gerelateerd aan overtredingen van de Flora- en faunawet
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de aantasting van het leefgebied van de zeer zeldzame veldspitsmuis in Sibculo

An MP asks whether a monastery foundation in Sibculo violated Flora- and faunawet protections for the rare field shrew through past clearing and maintenance, and how supervision will ensure compliance and the planned compensation garden. The state secretary answers that a Zoogdiervereniging study found shrews present, a management plan was requested via Dienst Regelingen, NVWA checks on request, and further steps are left to Dienst Regelingen.
If there is cause, the NVWA checks at the request of Dienst Regelingen whether the foundation complies with the management plan drawn up by the Zoogdiervereniging.
Als daar aanleiding voor is, controleert de NVWA op verzoek van Dienst Regelingen of de stichting zich houdt aan het door de Zoogdiervereniging opgestelde beheerplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum, Schouw, Segers, Leijten, Klaver, Tony van Dijck, Dijkgraaf, Ouwehand en Klein over het bericht “VNG wil overleg kabinet over bezuinigingen”

MPs asked whether the government would commission research, with the VNG, into whether the decentralisations and cumulative efficiency cuts are feasible for municipalities, and how risks and cumulative effects on vulnerable groups are monitored. The minister declined a separate CPB study for now, pointed to monitoring commitments and a motion-based independent study to be scoped with the VNG, and said the minister of Social Affairs would map cumulative effects.
Your House has since, in a motion by MP Schouw, asked the government to have an independent party investigate the financial and implementation risks of the decentralisations.

Uw Kamer heeft inmiddels in een motie van het lid Schouw aan de regering verzocht door een onafhankelijke partij een onderzoek te laten doen naar de financiële risico's en uitvoeringsrisico's van de decentralisaties
Antwoord vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over Europese subsidies die het stierenvechten in stand houden

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked whether EU agricultural and cultural subsidies sustain bullfighting in Spain, including bull breeding, arena upkeep, and whether such subsidies should be withheld. The government answered that EU cultural funds do not finance arenas, bull breeding is not a separate EU subsidy category, and animal welfare and spending of national funds are member-state responsibilities, while promising only to support future welfare rules.
Fighting bulls do not form a separate category in relation to EU subsidies.
Vechtstieren vormen geen aparte categorie in relatie tot EU-subsidies.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over een sterke afname van de vlinderstand

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the sharp decline in butterfly populations, its causes in intensive agriculture, and whether the government will expand habitat, including flower-rich road verges. The State Secretary acknowledged the decline in about half of the 51 Dutch butterfly species, pointed to existing generic measures and provincial powers, and said talks with the provinces on nature policy would be reported to Parliament soon.
I am in discussion with the provinces about nature policy inside and outside the EHS, including agricultural nature management. I can inform your House about this soon.
Ik ben met de provincies in gesprek over het natuurbeleid binnen en buiten de EHS, waaronder het agrarisch natuurbeheer. Daarover kan ik uw Kamer binnenkort informeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over aanvaringen met illegale walvisvaarders

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he would ask the Japanese ambassador for clarification, and Australia for assistance, after whaling vessels rammed Sea Shepherd ships flying the Dutch flag, and what action should follow if vigilantism occurred. The minister answered that concerns were conveyed to Japan and Sea Shepherd, that talks were held with Australia, and that no assistance had yet been needed, without committing to further concrete steps.
In doing so, an appeal was made to both parties to prevent further escalation and to take steps that ensure safety at sea.
Daarbij is een oproep gedaan aan beide partijen om verdere escalatie te voorkomen en stappen te zetten die de veiligheid op zee waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de voorwaarden voor onderhandelingen over een vrijhandelsakkoord met Japan

MP Ouwehand asked whether reopening the Japanese market to Dutch veal, and respect for human rights and the whaling moratorium, were conditions for launching FTA talks with Japan, and whether the government would make these binding preconditions. The minister answered that veal access was a litmus test for Japan's non-tariff barriers, that human rights will feature in a framework agreement with a possible suspension clause (whaling excluded), and refused to make whaling a precondition while promising to raise it through IWC and bilateral channels.
No. The negotiations with Japan will be used to raise these themes further.
Nee. De onderhandelingen met Japan zullen worden aangegrepen om deze thema's verder aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over een onderzoek dat uitwijst dat een meerderheid van lokale bestuurders voorstander is van een vuurwerkverbod

An MP asked the government whether it would act on a DirectResearch survey showing that most local councillors and mayors favour a ban on consumer fireworks, and whether declining support for fireworks justifies a total ban. The minister answered that the survey sample (420 of 2000 respondents) may not be representative, that municipalities manage fireworks nuisance with existing tools and oppose shorter firing hours, and that most citizens still oppose a ban, so the government sees no reason to change course.
I do not know whether this outcome is representative of the total of around 10,000 councillors in the Netherlands.
Ik weet niet of deze uitkomst representatief is voor het totaal aantal van circa 10.000 raadsleden in Nederland.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over verlichting en energiebesparing

An MP asks whether the Netherlands should follow France in requiring offices and shops to switch off lighting at night to save energy, and how much energy this would save. The minister answers that switching off unnecessary lighting is sensible, estimates 2 PJ savings, but rejects a blanket obligation, pointing to existing building and activity-decree rules and promising a further energy-saving plan in spring 2013.
An obligation to switch off all lighting is not an obvious course in the Netherlands.
Een verplichting om alle verlichting uit te schakelen ligt in Nederland niet voor de hand.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het faillissement van de Stichting Nederlands Opvangcentrum Papegaaien (NOP)

An MP asked the state secretary about the bankruptcy of the parrot shelter N.O.P., the welfare of the roughly 1,800 animals left, who is responsible for them, and whether the NVWA still supervises them. The state secretary answered that the NVWA inspects weekly, the appointed curator is responsible for the animals and is seeking a new home for them, and there is no current reason to doubt their welfare.
I supervise compliance with the relevant legislation. It is now up to the curator to find a solution for the animals.
Ik zie toe op de naleving van de relevante wetgeving. Het is nu aan de curator om een oplossing te vinden voor de dieren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Pechtold, Van Bommel, Madlener, Van der Staaij, Ouwehand en Segers over het rapport “Seventeenth Bi-annual Report: Developments in European Union Procedures  en Practices Relevant

MPs asked the foreign minister about the COSAC report on parliamentary scrutiny of EU documents, including why the Dutch parliament lacks access to Council documents marked EU Restricted and Limité that Austrian MPs can see. The minister answered that both chambers will receive direct access to all Limité documents, that Limité is a distribution code rather than a classification, and that the Dutch parliament is already as well informed as the Austrian and European Parliaments.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over een vuurwerkverbod tijdens het broedseizoen

Member Ouwehand asked the state secretaries whether municipalities should be barred from permitting fireworks at events such as Queen's Day during the bird breeding season, citing a court ruling on Weesp. The state secretary replied that the court ruling concerned a handhavingsverzoek rejected by the Dienst Regelingen, not a municipal permit, and rejected a national fireworks ban, relying instead on the Flora- en faunawet's prohibition of intentional disturbance and organisers' duty to assess locations case by case.
I do not share your view.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over de belangenverstrengeling bij de toelating van bestrijdingsmiddelen en de negatieve gevolgen voor bijen en andere bestuivers

An MP asks the State Secretary about conflicts of interest and independence at the Ctgb, which assesses pesticides, including a former director's move to SETAC, SETAC funding by industry, and methodology used for imidacloprid water-quality standards. The government answers that the Ctgb is an independent body with a sound assessment framework and integrity code, sees no need for new rules on career moves, and will inform Parliament on improvement tracks and raise the transparency motion with the Ctgb.
The Ctgb is an independent administrative body that takes decisions on authorisation independently.
Het Ctgb is een zelfstandig bestuursorgaan dat in onafhankelijkheid besluiten neemt over de toelating.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over speelnatuur en groene schoolpleinen

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the health and education ministers about the benefits of green school playgrounds and whether the government supports their spread. The minister replied that municipalities and school boards are responsible, that the government welcomes such initiatives, and that VWS will stimulate healthy school playgrounds from 2013 using extra anti-obesity funds.
The national government has no direct responsibility for the design of school playgrounds and natural play areas.
De rijksoverheid heeft geen directe verantwoordelijkheid ten aanzien van de inrichting van schoolpleinen en speelnatuur.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het recht van ieder kind op natuur

An MP asked the state secretary whether a child's right to nature and a clean environment should be recognised and anchored in the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child, and what targets the government sets for the 70 percent of Dutch children who rarely visit nature. The state secretary agreed the concern is valid, said the existing children's rights in the UN Convention suffice, and pointed to stimulus measures carried out mainly by local authorities and nature organisations.

The children's rights to protection, life and development, health and recreation as set out in the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child provide sufficient guarantees for bringing children into contact with nature.

De rechten van kinderen op bescherming, op leven en ontwikkeling, op gezondheid en op recreatie zoals omschreven in het Internationaal Verdrag inzake de Rechten van het Kind (IVRK), bieden voldoende waarborgen voor het in contact brengen van kinderen met de natuur.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de explosieve toename en slacht van paarden in Nederland

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the state secretary about a sharp rise in horse slaughter, speculative breeding and impulse purchases, weak welfare policy, the rising number of neglect reports and labelling of horsemeat. The state secretary answers that the government lacks an overview of slaughter causes, relies on the Gids voor Goede Praktijken enforced by NVWA and the Inspectorate, promises to inform parliament about impulse purchases in mid-2013, and states that labelling already requires horsemeat to be identified.
For impulse purchases, it was promised during the committee debate on animal shelters of 20 November that you would be informed about impulse purchases of animals around mid-2013.
Voor wat betreft impulsaankopen is in het AO opvang van dieren van 20 november toegezegd om u medio 2013 te informeren over impulsaankopen van dieren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de mishandeling van katten voor de productie van een film

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether filming that mistreated cats in Antwerp's city hall, and possible criminal bans on making or showing such films, should be pursued in the Netherlands. The minister said the incident abroad falls outside Dutch jurisdiction, and declined a new ban, relying on existing animal welfare and criminal law and on broadcasters and internet providers to refuse such material.
Unlike with sex with animals, I do not intend to enforce the social norm through a ban.
Anders dan bij seks met dieren ben ik niet voornemens om de maatschappelijke norm door een verbod af te dwingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over apen die op wrede wijze worden afgemaakt in een proefdierfokkerij

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that surplus monkeys at a Mauritius primate breeder were killed cruelly, and about Dutch and EU links to that breeder, plus whether the EU Animal Testing Directive covers such practices. The minister replied that she was not familiar with the situation, that the company is based in Mauritius and not Dutch-owned, and that the directive sets rules on breeding, housing, origin and killing of animals but gave no substantive answers to the other questions.
Since I understand from the questions that this concerns a company based in Mauritius and not Dutch-owned, I find it logical that I have not been informed about this matter.
Aangezien het naar ik uit de vragen begrijp om een bedrijf gaat dat gevestigd is op Mauritius en niet in Nederlands eigendom is vind ik het logisch dat ik niet over deze zaak geïnformeerd te ben.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over aanhoudende problemen met de opslag en opvang van (in beslag genomen) dieren

An MP asks the state secretary of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation about the Dutch Papegaaienpark (NOP) bird shelter, which may be unable to feed about 2,100 seized birds, and why the ministry contracted it despite past misconduct and financial doubts. The state secretary answers that the ministry ended its contracts with NOP in summer 2012 over administrative and animal welfare shortcomings, that no federal funds are paid for animals not placed by the ministry, and that the ministry will act via administrative measures if welfare is harmed.
The Ministry of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation (EL&I) terminated all contracts with the NOP this summer.
Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie (EL&I) heeft deze zomer alle contracten met de NOP beëindigd.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over het polsen van Australië over het weren van een Nederlandse megatrawler uit hun wateren

MP Ouwehand asked the minister whether the Dutch government contacted Australia about the megatrawler Margiris, whether it misinformed parliament, and how it plans to address EU overcapacity. The minister replied that the government only asked Australia for information on new legislation affecting a Dutch investment, denied misinforming parliament, and rejected the claim that Dutch fleet overcapacity harms stocks.
For the cabinet there was no reason to intervene in early July.
Voor het kabinet was er geen reden om begin juli te interveniëren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over  een landelijke norm voor het aandeel groen in steden en dorpen

An MP asked the minister whether the UN green standard of 48 m2 per inhabitant is met in Dutch cities, and about the health, water and biodiversity benefits of urban green and whether a joint action plan with the VNG would follow. The minister said that about half of the 31 largest municipalities exceed the 75 m2 per dwelling benchmark, that no per-inhabitant figures exist, endorsed the benefits in general terms, and said green is a municipal responsibility, pointing to existing Rijk support programmes and a three-year intention declaration with the VNG.
No analyses are available of square metres of green per inhabitant in the Netherlands.
Er zijn geen analyses beschikbaar van vierkante meters groen per bewoner in Nederland.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over een klimaatambassadeur voor stadslandbouw

MP Ouwehand asks the state secretary what happened to her proposal for a climate ambassador for urban agriculture, whether it is a topic in Rijk-decentral consultations, and whether she is aware of municipal permit obstacles facing a Nijmegen urban farm. The state secretary replies that urban agriculture is adopted by the Rotterdam alderman under the Lokale Klimaatagenda, a learning group is being set up, a Green Deal exists, and the Nijmegen permit issue is a municipal competence to be raised in the learning group if it recurs.
Under the LKA a learning group on urban agriculture will be established focusing on knowledge exchange, bottlenecks and solutions.
Onder de LKA wordt een leergroep Stadslandbouw opgericht die zich zal richten op kennisuitwisseling, knelpunten en oplossingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over verwaarlozing van paarden in Weert

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary about neglected horses in Weert, including whether a horse was moved to an unknown location to evade inspection and whether that should be made a criminal offence. The State Secretary answered that inspections continued, the owner complied with orders and that moving animals is not in itself criminal, but that refusing cooperation with inspectors is punishable.
No, there are sufficient legal possibilities to obtain information or take action if cooperation is not provided.
Nee, er zijn voldoende wettelijke mogelijkheden om informatie te verkrijgen of op te treden als geen medewerking wordt verleend.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over het bericht “Dode apen op Schiphol”

An MP asked the State Secretary about 13 monkeys found dead at Schiphol, their cause of death, whether the transport was checked for animal welfare, and how many monkeys transit Schiphol yearly. The government said an NVWA investigation is ongoing, the surviving monkeys met health and CITES requirements for onward transport, and it will not speculate on further measures until the investigation concludes.
Once the investigation is concluded I will inform the House of the results.
Zodra het onderzoek is afgerond zal ik de kamer informeren over de resultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand heeft mij vragen gesteld over “de ehs die moet wijken voor kipgigant”.

MP Ouwehand asked whether the province of Flevoland may remove part of the Ecological Main Structure (EHS) to make way for a Kentucky Fried Chicken outlet, and whether the state secretary would urge the province to refuse. The state secretary acknowledged the press report but said the provinces are responsible for delineating the EHS and referred the MP to Flevoland.
The provinces are responsible for redrawing and recalibrating the Ecological Main Structure.
De provincies zijn verantwoordelijk voor het herbegrenzen en herijken van de Ecologische Hoofdstructuur.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de onhoudbare financiële problemen bij dierenasiel

An MP asked the state secretary about financial distress at animal shelters, the municipal duty to hold stray animals for two weeks, the use of dog tax revenue, and whether animal trade should fund shelters. The state secretary said he lacks insight into shelter finances, treats stray animal shelter as a local municipal responsibility, pointed to planned trade regulations, and offered to ask the VNG to raise the municipal holding duty.
I have no insight into the financial management of the shelters in the Netherlands.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de financiële huishouding van de opvangcentra in Nederland.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over een sloopwerf voor zeeschepen in Harlingen op 11 april 2012

An MP asked whether the Harlingen port's plan for a ship-breaking yard in the protected Wadden Sea would be assessed, its effects on the World Heritage and Natura 2000 area, dredging, pollution and transport of old ships. The state secretary answered that the plan is a local initiative still without detail, that the municipal council is first responsible, that existing rules will apply, and that the Rijk does not develop such sites itself.
It is primarily up to the Harlingen municipal council to assess the proposal and decide whether to support it.
Het is in eerste plaats aan de gemeenteraad van Harlingen om het voorstel te beoordelen en al dan niet te ondersteunen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over olieboringen in het Noordpoolgebied

MP Ouwehand asked the Dutch government whether it shares concerns about Shell's planned Arctic exploratory drilling, the risk of an unstoppable oil spill, and whether it will oppose or urge against the drilling.
