Minister Verhagen answered that the US authority is the competent regulator, that he sees no reason to doubt its decision, and that he will not call on other states or Shell to stop, while promising only to keep encouraging Shell toward responsible business.
It is not for me but for the permitting authority – in this case the US government – to weigh whether activities may be allowed.
Het is niet aan mij maar aan de vergunningverlener – in dit geval de Amerikaanse overheid – om de afweging te maken of activiteiten toegelaten kunnen worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over mogelijke uitlevering Paul Watson aan Costa Rica

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the German arrest of Paul Watson for possible extradition to Costa Rica, the absence of a Netherlands-Costa Rica extradition treaty, Costa Rica's human rights record, and whether the Netherlands would urge Germany not to extradite him. The minister answered that the decision lies solely with the German Justice Minister, that the Netherlands has no extradition treaty with Costa Rica, and that Costa Rica's legal system gives no cause for concern.
It is not for me to intervene in that decision, because responsibility lies exclusively with the German Minister.
Het is niet aan mij om in die beslissing te treden, omdat de verantwoordelijkheid hier uitsluitend ligt bij de Duitse Minister.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het houden van wallaby’s

An MP asks the state secretary about escaped wallabies, the lack of rules on keeping and selling exotic animals, the costs and ownership of recaptured animals, and trade data. The state secretary answers that the animal was recaptured and rehomed, that no sale conditions currently apply apart from a planned information duty, that a positive list for mammals is being prepared with WUR research, and that trade data for non-protected kangaroo species is not collected.
Currently no conditions are imposed on the sale of wallabies.
Momenteel worden geen voorwaarden gesteld aan de verkoop van wallaby's.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het toesturen van de lijst van diersoorten, waarin handel verboden is (sts ELI)

An MP asked the state secretary why the list of animal species banned from online trade, promised to journalists as ready by the end of the week, had not been sent to Marktplaats. The secretary confirmed the timing and stated that the list is now published on Marktplaats' information page.
The list is on the information page of the Marktplaats website.
De lijst staat op de informatiepagina van de website Marktplaats.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over haringpromotiecampagnes op basisscholen

MP Ouwehand asks the education and economic affairs ministers whether the commercial Dutch Fisheries Bureau's 'haringsmaaklessen' campaign in primary schools, which promotes herring to children, is acceptable given overfishing and marine harm, and whether the government subsidised it. The minister replies that schools are free to use such materials, that the campaign is not an official government product, that the Fisheries Bureau received two EU fisheries fund subsidies of 7 million each for sustainability promotion, and that herring stocks are within safe limits, while declining to commit to new measures.
Schools are completely free to use the 'haringsmaaklessen'.
Scholen zijn volledig vrij om gebruik te maken van de «haringsmaaklessen».
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de internethandel in (wilde) dieren (sts ELI)

An MP asks the state secretary about internet trade in wild animals on Marktplaats, the legality of keeping captive-bred wild animals, enforcement capacity, the role of the Tor network, and a positive list for animals. The state secretary answers that legal keeping requires proof of legal origin, that NVWA enforcement is limited to a few specialised investigators, and that a positive list for mammals will take effect on 1 January 2013, with other animal groups to be considered later.
I do not have recent figures on the volume of internet trade in (wild) animals on sales sites.
Ik beschik niet over recente cijfers over de omvang van de internethandel in (wilde) dieren op verkoopsites.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ferrier, Van der Staaij, El Fassed, De Lange, Ouwehand, Hachchi en Irrgang over het bericht dat ruim 18 miljoen mensen in de Sahel worden bedreigd door een humanitaire ramp

MPs asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about the Sahel food crisis affecting 18 million people, its urgency, past prevention efforts, Dutch funding levels, disaster risk reduction, and support for smallholders. The State Secretary answered that the situation is very serious, outlined past Dutch development projects, reported modest extra Dutch emergency contributions and planned bilateral and multilateral efforts, but gave no specific DRR funding breakdown and declined to pledge larger increases.
At present so-called aid tracking of DRR activities, labelling the DRR dimension of development cooperation activities, is not yet possible.
Op dit moment is het zogenoemde «aid tracking» van DRR activiteiten, het labellen van de DRR-dimensie van OS activiteiten, nog niet mogelijk.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over de kap van twee bomen in Schinnen

An MP asked the state secretary whether trees in Schinnen were felled without a permit and without public consultation to make way for beer tanks, and whether this was acceptable, given earlier NATO tree felling. The state secretary answered that the municipality's own tree policy applies, that the municipality said no environmental permit was needed, and that he does not judge the municipality's application of its autonomous policy.
I do not pass judgment on the application of the autonomous policy of the municipality of Schinnen.
Ik spreek geen oordeel uit over de toepassing van het autonome beleid van de gemeente Schinnen.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp en Ouwehand over het ontduiken van de m.e.r.-plicht voor vergunningverlening van intensieve veehouderij

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked whether municipalities are evading the EIA (MER) obligation for intensive livestock permits by approving stepwise expansions just below the threshold, and what consequences, oversight and enforcement follow. The minister answered that the matter rests with competent authorities (municipalities), that only incidental signals were received, that a mandatory EIA screening applies below the threshold, that inspection can act against structural negligence, and that supervision will shift to provinces under the pending Revitalisering Generiek Toezicht bill.
However, these are incidental reports, which gives me no reason to launch broader research into this.
Het gaat echter om incidentele berichten, hetgeen mij geen aanleiding geeft om hier een breder onderzoek naar in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Bommel, Çörüz, Van der Staaij en Ouwehand over vrouwenrechten in Marokko

Five MPs asked the foreign minister about Morocco's Article 475, which lets a rapist avoid prosecution by marrying the victim, following the suicide of Amina Filali, and whether the Netherlands would condemn it, press for repeal via the EU, and what Dutch Matra programme work addresses women's legal inequality. The minister confirmed the article conflicts with Morocco's international obligations, said the matter is for Morocco to reform through its own national debate, and noted the EU human rights dialogue and Dutch-funded women's rights projects in Rabat.
It is not known how often such cases occur.
Het is niet bekend hoe vaak dergelijke zaken voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het besluit van supermarktketen Plus om alleen nog biologische en vrije-uitloop eieren te verkopen

An MP from the PvdD asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation whether he welcomes supermarket chain Plus's decision to sell only organic and free-range eggs, and why the pluimveehouders' union and LTO criticised it. The state secretary answered that supermarkets decide their own product range, that the sector should manage the market transition itself, and that he sees no need for a letter of praise or reprimand.
It is primarily up to supermarkets and other parties to decide, within their market and consumer strategy, which products they offer to consumers.
Het is primair aan de supermarkten en andere partijen om binnen hun markt- en consumentenstrategie te besluiten welke producten zij aanbieden aan de consument.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over het laten inslapen van vier testapen door de Radboud Universiteit

MP Ouwehand asked the minister whether Radboud University euthanised four healthy rhesus monkeys that could have been rehomed, and how the animal ethics committee assessed the procedures. The minister answered that two were killed within the experiment on committee advice and two for veterinary reasons, that the university is responsible for decisions on animals after experiments, and that the NVWA found no violations of the Animal Experiments Act.
In response to your questions, I have asked the NVWA to assess the situation.
Ik heb de NVWA naar aanleiding van uw vragen verzocht de situatie te beoordelen.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over Aanvallen Japanse walvisvaarders op bemanning Sea Sheperd

An MP asked the foreign and economic affairs ministers about Japanese whalers' alleged violent attacks on Sea Shepherd crew near Antarctica, including water cannons, grappling hooks and bamboo poles, and asked why no prosecution had been launched. The minister said the Netherlands is in contact with both sides and will assess whether independent investigation is needed, but declined to judge the specific incidents, pointing to the absence of a judicial procedure and to the lack of complaints filed.
On the basis of the available information I am not in a position to make a substantive judgment on this specific situation.
Op basis van de beschikbare informatie ben ik niet in staat om een inhoudelijk oordeel te vellen over deze specifieke situatie.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over de nieuwe ophef die is ontstaan rond het Nederlands Opvangcentrum Papegaaien (N.O.P.)

An MP asked the state secretary about an alleged link between a bird shelter (N.O.P.) employee and illegal import of exotic birds, seizures during searches, whether the shelter's contract should be ended, and its fees and the reliability of shelters. The government answered that an investigation is ongoing, that the contract will be reviewed if the outcome warrants it, and that it cannot disclose contract fees as commercially sensitive.
When the outcome of the investigation is known, I will, if there is cause, review the agreements with the N.O.P. again.
Wanneer de uitkomsten van het onderzoek bekend zijn zal ik, wanneer hier aanleiding toe is, de overeenkomsten met de N.O.P. opnieuw bekijken.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over de uitbraak van het Rhinopneumonievirus onder paarden

Ouwehand asked the state secretary about the Rhinopneumonia outbreak among horses, including how owners are warned, whether a notification duty should exist, and how transport to markets and events should be judged. The state secretary said owners are informed through vets, the Sectorraad Paarden and a planned helpdesk, but saw no government role in a mandatory notification duty since the sector can manage the disease itself.
I see no role for the national government in this.
Hierbij zie ik geen rol voor de rijksoverheid weggelegd.

MPs from six parties asked the health minister about breast implants (PIP), the ASIA syndrome, the AZM autoimmune centre closure, registration, quality standards and liability. The minister said evidence linking implants to autoimmune disease is limited, referred to the pending NIV/NVPC study, and said clinics and insurers will cover aftercare while IGZ monitors, with other matters deferred to a separate letter.
Aftercare is the responsibility of the clinics and hospitals where these prostheses were implanted.
De nazorg is de verantwoordelijkheid van de klinieken en ziekenhuizen, waar deze protheses zijn ingebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de handelsmissie naar Japan en de mogelijkheid om daar de situatie van de in Japsn gevangengenomen Erwin Vermeulen te bespreken

An MP asks the Economics minister whether the trade mission to Japan would raise the detention of Dutch citizen Erwin Vermeulen, and about market access for agri-food exports, whaling, dolphin hunting and trade figures. The minister answers that the government will not interfere in Japan's legal process, that the case was resolved with his acquittal on 22 February, and that market access and non-tariff barriers were discussed along with trade and investment figures.
The Netherlands does not interfere in Japan's legal process.
Nederland mengt zich niet in de rechtsgang van Japan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de handelsmissie naar Japan

An MP asked the minister whether the Japan trade mission discussed the Dutch bill on the nationality of sea vessels in order to withdraw Sea Shepherd's Dutch registration, and why this was raised during a trade mission. The minister answered that the bill was briefly mentioned at Japan's request, that the Dutch position against whaling was stated, and that the court case of a Dutch citizen was left to the Japanese judiciary.
I emphasised that discussion of the legislation in the House of Representatives depends on the House agenda.
Ik heb benadrukt dat het bespreken van de wetgeving in de Tweede Kamer afhankelijk is van de kameragenda.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economie, Landbouw en Innovatie over de afname van vleermuizen onder invloed van wegen (ingezonden 7 november 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether new research showing roads significantly reduce bat numbers, activity and diversity is known, whether the Natura 2000 assessment of road effects was done, and whether monitoring and supplementary research on mitigation such as bat bridges will be undertaken. The secretary confirms awareness of the research, states most bat species are doing well thanks to mitigation, describes ongoing monitoring, and declines additional research on mitigation effectiveness, citing earlier studies.
No, research has already been carried out on that in the past.
Nee, in het verleden is daar al onderzoek naar gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de rechtszaak tegen Erwin Vermeulen in Japan

The MP asks whether the minister misled the press about family visit options for Erwin Vermeulen, detained in Japan, and about his treatment and detention conditions, and asks whether the government will raise the case with Japan. The minister answers that the family was correctly informed, that detention conditions met Japanese rules, that the government expressed concern and urged Japan to allow family contact, but that it refrained from judging the case while it was before the courts.
In my view correct information has been provided.
Er is naar mijn oordeel correcte informatie verstrekt.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over het naleven van de afspraken over het welzijn van de grote grazers in de Oostvaardersplassen

An MP asked the state secretary whether ICMO2 recommendations on shelter, opening the Hollandse Hout forest, early-reactive culling, staffing amid budget cuts and visitor safety were being implemented for the large herbivores in the Oostvaardersplassen. The secretary said shelter walls were built and forests opened, declined to open Hollandse Hout because Lelystad council refused, denied a 20 million euro cut to Staatsbosbeheer's budget for 2012 while citing ongoing provincial financing talks, and pointed to protocols for culling and safety.
On the state of affairs of the application of early-reactive management of the large herbivores in the Oostvaardersplassen you receive a separate letter.
Over de stand van zaken van de toepassing van het vroeg-reactief beheer van de grote grazers in de Oostvaardersplassen ontvangt u separaat een brief

Vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Thieme (beiden Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat orka Morgan gebruikt zal worden in een fokprogramma en in sh

MPs Ouwehand and Thieme asked the state secretary whether orca Morgan would be used in shows and a breeding programme at Loro Parque and how this squares with his earlier statements on education, research and orca welfare. The state secretary answered that the transfer was based on Spanish authority approval and the park's claimed educational and research purposes, that enforcement lies with Spanish authorities, and that Morgan's move was the better of two options for her welfare.
It is not for me but for the Spanish authorities to monitor compliance with CITES legislation and international treaties on marine mammals.
Het is niet aan mij maar aan de Spaanse autoriteiten om toe te zien op CITES wetgeving en internationale verdragen inzake zeezoogdieren.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand en Hazekamp over de Natuurbeschermingswet-vergunning voor de staand want visserij op het Markermeer

Two MPs asked the state secretary to respond to the province of Flevoland's permit allowing staand want fishing in the Markermeer, which kills large numbers of protected waterbirds, and whether this breaches nature protection law. The secretary answered that the province is the competent authority and judged that no significant negative effects were shown, that he sees no reason to issue a direction against the permit, and that objections can be lodged through the usual channels.
However, I see no reason to use my power to issue a direction regarding the permit granted by Flevoland.
Ik zie echter geen aanleiding gebruik te maken van mijn bevoegdheid een aanwijzing te geven ter zake van de door Flevoland verleende vergunning.

Vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand (beiden Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de 28 in beslag genomen pony’s in Elkenrade (ingezonden 9 december 2011).

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked the state secretary about 28 confiscated ponies in Elkenrade, the role of police and inspection bodies, action against the owner, shelter capacity, and whether the animals could be euthanised or sent to slaughter. The state secretary answered that the case is still under criminal investigation, the owner has not formally relinquished the animals, shelter places are sufficient, the animals are well cared for, and it cannot guarantee they will not end at a slaughterhouse.
Since the investigation is still ongoing, I cannot make further statements about it.
Aangezien het onderzoek nog loopt kan ik daar verder geen uitspraken over doen.

Vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand (beiden Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de 28 in beslag genomen pony’s in Elkenrade (ingezonden 22 december 2011).

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked the state secretary about 28 seized ponies in Elkenrade, including one pony found still dirty and infected after four weeks at a shelter and one that later died there, and whether shelter inspections should be tightened. The state secretary defended the shelter care as appropriate given the animals' condition, explained the death as heart failure, and rejected tightening inspections, pointing to annual NVWA inspections and Dienst Regelingen visits.

Do you share the view that inspections of (temporary) shelter addresses should be tightened, so that neglected animals after seizure do not end up in exactly the same situation they were removed from?

Deelt u de mening dat de controles op (tijdelijke) opvangadressen aangescherpt moeten worden, zodat verwaarloosde dieren na inbeslagname niet in exact dezelfde situatie terecht komen als waaruit ze zijn weggehaald?

Vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand (beiden Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bewapenen van schepen voor de ille

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked whether Japanese disaster-relief funds were used to arm whaling ships and whether the Netherlands would protest and act on a 2008 shooting incident. The minister replied that the Japanese government denied using relief funds for arming vessels, that the Netherlands opposes whaling, and that no protest was planned beyond calling on both sides to respect maritime rules.
The Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs has assured me that the Japanese whaling ships are not armed.
Het Japanse ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft mij verzekerd dat de Japanse walvisschepen niet bewapend zijn.

Vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Thieme (beiden Partij voor de Dieren) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretarissen van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Soc

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked ministers about illegal heavy fireworks smuggling, the costs of firework injuries, and whether a consumer firework ban was unavoidable. State secretary Atsma listed enforcement measures and cost estimates but declined for now to ban consumer fireworks, citing lack of public support and a planned update of a 2008 survey.
At this moment I therefore am not considering introducing a total ban on consumer fireworks.
Op dit moment overweeg ik daarom niet een totaal verbod op consumentenvuurwerk in te stellen.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de arrestatie van vrijwilligers van Sea Shepherd en over de bedreigingen die aan het adres van Sea Shepherd zijn gedaan (ing

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about the detention in Japan of Dutch Sea Shepherd volunteer Erwin Vermeulen, his treatment during interrogation, and threats against the organisation, and whether the government will act. The minister answers that Vermeulen receives consular assistance, that the Netherlands will not intervene in Japanese legal proceedings, and that it has raised concerns with Japan about threats while leaving prosecution decisions to Japanese authorities.
The Netherlands does not interfere in Japan's legal proceedings and does not comment on guilt or sentencing.
Nederland treedt niet in de rechtsgang van Japan en spreekt zich niet uit over de schuldvraag of strafmaat.

Vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretarissen van Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over nieuwe toelatingen van bestrijdingsmiddelen op b

MPs Ouwehand and Thieme asked why the Ctgb authorised new pesticides containing glyphosate (RoundUp Force, also for public green maintenance) and imidacloprid (Sombrero, for beet seed treatment) despite a motion against non-commercial glyphosate use and known imidacloprid water and bee risks, and asked for withdrawal. State Secretary Bleker answered that the authorisations meet EU criteria, that EU rules do not allow excluding non-commercial uses or withdrawing authorisations, and that the motion will be implemented in the national action plan.

No, if a plant protection product meets the set requirements, the European regulation does not provide the authority to exclude 'non-commercial applications' from the requested authorisation or to withdraw a granted authorisation.

Nee, indien een gewasbeschermingsmiddel voldoet aan de gestelde eisen, biedt de Europese verordening niet de bevoegdheid om «niet-commerciële toepassingen» uit te sluiten van de aangevraagde toelating of om een verleende toelating weer in te trekken.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind, Schouten (ChristenUnie), Ferrier (CDA), Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren), Van Tongeren (GroenLinks), Dijkhoff (VVD), Van der Staaij (SGP), Dikkers (PvdA), Gesthuizen (SP) en Hachchi (D66)

Ten MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Foreign Minister about child labour in Turkish hazelnut harvesting one year after it was first reported, including whether enforcement is adequate, whether companies are meeting their responsibilities, and the status of various studies and working groups. The government answered that the problem lies mainly with Turkey, that the embassy raised it with Turkish authorities and funds a study, that industry bodies have adopted guidelines and a Turkish action plan exists, but that it could not confirm concrete results of the Turkish working group and could not answer in time for the scheduled debate.
The cabinet will continue to raise this issue within the EU framework, including in the Council conclusions.
Het kabinet zal hier in EU-kader aandacht voor blijven vragen, ook in de Raadsconclusies.

Vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand ( beiden Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het mogelijk versoepelen van de regelingen om honden als trekdier in te kun

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked the state secretary whether a new protocol would ease exemptions allowing dogs to pull carts, and whether this conflicts with the animal welfare law and with mandatory X-ray screening. The secretary answered that exemptions exist for sled dog sport, that the procedure is being formalised for uniformity and transparency without a policy change, that a veterinary health statement is already required, and that no separate notification to parliament is planned.
Currently work is being done on formalising the procedure by which requests for exemption from the ban on traction are assessed.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan het formaliseren van de procedure waarmee de verzoeken tot ontheffing van het verbod op trekkracht beoordeeld worden.

Vragen van het lid Thieme en Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over ongelukken tijdens het vervoer van dieren (ingezonden 10 november 2011).

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked about an animal transport incident on the A4 in which a cow or ox got stuck in a trailer, whether police shot the animal, whether hobby trailers require periodic inspection, and figures on accidents and AID/nVWA inspection findings. The state secretary replied that the animals were not shot, that it was hobby transport in an unexamined horse trailer that met general Transport Regulation requirements, that no periodic inspection is planned, and that 36 deficiencies were found in controls from 2006 to 2011.
A veterinarian was present on site and determined that the animal had only sustained a minor abrasion to one of its hind legs.
Er is een dierenarts ter plaatse geweest en die heeft vastgesteld dat het rund slechts een kleine schaafwond had opgelopen aan één van de achterpoten.

Vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand (beiden Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over mogelijke belangenverstrengeling bij de EFSA (ingezonden 21 oktober 2011).

MPs asked the minister about alleged conflicts of interest among EFSA panel members advising on aspartame, including industry payments, and whether EFSA should re-examine aspartame after new studies and threatened legal action against a watchdog NGO. The minister mostly referred to a letter from another state secretary and to EU timelines, and said the NGO matter is for the parties involved to decide.
I gladly refer to the recent letter from the state secretary of I&M to your House of 9 November.
Ik verwijs graag naar de recente brief van de staatssecretaris van I&M aan uw Kamer van 9 november jl.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de toekomst van apen en andere proefdieren in verband met de reorganisatie bij MSD-Organon (ingezonden 5 okto

An MP asked the minister about the fate of primates and other laboratory animals remaining at MSD-Organon after its research closure, including whether a rehoming to sanctuaries can be guaranteed. The minister said animal numbers are only reported to the nVWA and not published per company, that welfare rules apply, that the destination of animals is the license holder's responsibility, and that the nVWA will be asked to monitor the case.
No data traceable to individual license holders are made public.
Er worden geen naar individuele vergunninghouders herleidbare gegevens openbaar gemaakt.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over microplastics in consumentenproducten die het water vervuilen (ingezonden 3 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about microplastics in cosmetic scrubs and peelings polluting marine ecosystems, their effects on fish, marine mammals and human health, and whether the government would push for an EU ban and raise the issue internationally. The state secretary acknowledged microplastics are in scrubs and that effects are unclear, said the topic will be addressed through the Marine Strategy Directive and international fora, but declined to commit to a ban, noting cosmetics rules are EU-level and contain no environmental criteria, while agreeing to raise the issue with the Commission.

However, I am willing to raise this topic with the European Commission within the framework of the Marine Strategy Framework Directive, with the aim of examining what options exist for reducing the emission of microplastics.

Ik ben evenwel bereid dit onderwerp bij de Europese Commissie aan de orde te stellen in het kader van de Kaderrichtlijn Mariene Strategie met het doel na te gaan welke mogelijkheden er zijn voor het terugdringen van de emissie van microplastics.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het plan van het Dolfinarium om Morgan te verhuizen naar een attractiepark op Tenerife (ingezo

MP Ouwehand asked the state secretary about the planned transfer of orca Morgan from the Dolfinarium to Loro Parque in Tenerife, including whether the park's shows and trainer qualifications conflict with release-to-the-wild commitments, and about the park's incidents and training standards. The state secretary referred most substantive questions to a separate letter on the Orka Coalitie objection, stated the Dolfinarium is a licensed zoo, and said that the Spanish authorities and the park, not the Dutch government, are responsible for trainer qualifications and the internal autopsy.
It is not for me to pass judgment on the qualifications of the trainers, which Loro Parque deems necessary for handling orcas.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel te vellen over de kwalificaties van de trainers, die Loro Parque nodig acht voor het omgaan met orka's.

Vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand (beiden Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het afwijken van landelijke stanknormen door een gemeente zodat melkveehouderijen kunnen uit

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked the state secretary whether they object to Kaag en Braassem municipality deviating from national odour distances so dairy farms can expand, and whether he will urge the municipality to keep national limits. The state secretary replied that the Wet geurhinder en veehouderij lets municipalities set tailored odour policy within set bandwidths, that courts can review such ordinances, and that he sees no reason to intervene.
Whether the ordinance meets the legal requirements can be reviewed by the administrative court in appeal proceedings against the granting of a permit for expanding a livestock farm.

Of de verordening aan de wettelijke vereisten voldoet, kan door de bestuursrechter worden getoetst in het kader van een beroepsprocedure tegen de verlening van een vergunning voor de uitbreiding van een veehouderij.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de veiling van een ernstig bedreigde haai op de visafslag in Scheveningen (ingezonden 26 augus

MP Ouwehand asked the state secretary why a threatened tope shark was auctioned at Scheveningen and sold, and what enforcement, penalties and controls exist. The state secretary replied that the nVWA investigated, that the Engish authorities will prosecute the fishing vessel for exceeding quota, and that current controls under EU rules are adequate, so no additional inspections are planned.
It is up to the English authorities to determine the penalty.
Het is aan de Engelse autoriteiten om de strafmaat vast te stellen.

Vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de doorgaande achteruitgang van de weidevogels (ingezonden 5 september 2011).

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked the state secretary about the continuing decline of meadow birds, intensive farming as a cause, and whether agri-environment subsidies require results and are checked for effectiveness. The state secretary acknowledged intensive farming as one cause, pointed to collective management and provincial responsibility, and stated that individual farmers are no longer subject to a result obligation under the SNL scheme.

The reason for abolishing the result obligation for the individual farmer is that, besides the measures the farmer can take himself, a multitude of factors beyond his influence can affect the outcome on his land.

De reden van het afschaffen van de resultaatverplichting bij de individuele boer is dat naast de maatregelen die de boer zelf kan nemen, tevens een veelheid van factoren waar de boer geen invloed op heeft het resultaat op zijn terrein kunnen beïnvloeden.

Vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het houden van powerboatraces in de Waddenzee (ingezond

MPs Ouwehand and Thieme asked whether a three-day powerboat race in the Wadden Sea, a protected Natura 2000 area, should be permitted given its disturbance to marine life, cumulative effects and the precautionary principle. The state secretary replied that the handhavingsverzoek lapsed because the organiser cancelled, that activities must pass the Natuurbeschermingswet test, and that the province of Noord-Holland is the competent authority, which has granted a permit now under appeal.
Gedeputeerde Staten of Noord-Holland is the competent authority in this matter.
Gedeputeerde Staten van Noord-Holland is in deze het bevoegd gezag.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de manege in Assendelft die in strijd met de wet opnieuw een pony gaat verloten (ingezonden 6

An MP asked the state secretary why a riding school in Assendelft announced again a pony raffle despite the legal ban, and whether enforcement had been adequate. The state secretary said the enforcement via an order under penalty had worked, refused to review past enforcement, and defended the existing penalties as sufficiently deterrent.
I am of the opinion that these penalties are sufficiently deterrent.
Ik ben van mening dat deze straffen voldoende afschrikwekkend zijn.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het lot van ooievaar Freedom (ingezonden 10 augustus 2011).

An MP from the Partij voor de Dieren asks the state secretary why no release permit has been granted for the stork Freedom, why the advice of the Lokkerij stork station is ignored, and whether the government will ban keeping and trading storks as pets. The state secretary answers that no permit has been requested, that reintroduction of captive-bred birds is only a last resort under IUCN guidelines, and that a general ban is not planned, with a positive list for mammals and possibly birds later.
Release of captive-bred animals can only be considered as a last resort, that is, when the wild population has become extinct or nearly extinct.
Uitzetten van in gevangenschap gefokte dieren kan pas aan de orde zijn als laatste redmiddel, dat wil zeggen als de wilde populatie inmiddels is uitgestorven of vrijwel is uitgestorven.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het uitsterven van de scholekster (ingezonden 14 juni 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation about the decline of the oystercatcher, its protection under Natura 2000, the Habitats Directive, cockle fishing in the Wadden Sea, agricultural management and Red List status. The secretary acknowledges the decline, cites causes and a Wadden Sea fishing agreement, but declines to change agricultural management and rejects concerns about unlisted species.
I am responsible for fulfilling the European obligations laid down in the Birds Directive and the Habitats Directive.
Ik ben verantwoordelijk voor het nakomen van de Europese verplichtingen zoals vastgelegd in de Vogelrichtlijn en Habitatrichtlijn.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de onterecht verleende vergunning voor de verplaatsing van orka Morgan naar Tenerife (ingezond

An MP asks the state secretary why a court found the permit for moving the orca Morgan to Tenerife was wrongly granted, whether the earlier decision ignored a parliamentary motion, why earlier questions went unanswered while a permit was quickly issued, and how the court's ruling will be followed up. The secretary acknowledges the court ruling, rejects the claim that parliament's motion was ignored, defers answers on the earlier questions and follow-up to a further reply pending a court procedure, and says the permit process was routine.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de import van vlees van mishandelde paarden uit Argentinië (ingezonden 10 juni 2011).

The MP Ouwehand asked the state secretary about GAIA footage of mistreated Argentine horses destined for Belgian consumption, whether the Netherlands imports horsemeat from Argentina, Mexico or Brazil, what animal welfare guarantees and checks apply, and whether a European import ban will be pushed. The state secretary expressed abhorrence, described EU-approved slaughterhouse rules and FVO inspections finding welfare respected, saw no ground for a ban, but will seek welfare clauses in trade agreements with Mercosur.
In view of the outcomes of the FVO inspections, there is no basis for an import ban on horsemeat from these three countries.
Gelet op de uitkomsten van de FVO-inspecties is er geen grond voor een importverbod van paardenvlees uit deze drie landen.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over ernstige welzijnsproblemen bij dolfijnen in gevangenschap en het overtreden van EU-richtlijnen

An MP asks the state secretary about welfare problems for captive dolphins and alleged breaches of EU Directive 1999/22/EC at Dolfinarium Harderwijk, including inspection frequency, shows, a ban on dolphin shows and import limits. The state secretary replies that the dolphinarium complies with the Zoo Decree, that only administrative breaches were found in inspections, and declines to ban shows, infringement proceedings or a public database.
I am not willing to ban dolphin shows.
Ik ben niet bereid om dolfijnenshows te verbieden.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economie, Landbouw en Innovatie over schade na storing van een luchtwasser (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about a malfunction at an air-scrubber at the DMV plant in Veghel that released white sodium hydroxide deposits, including how it happened, whether it has occurred before, who pays the cleanup costs, and how much subsidy is granted for scrubbers. The state secretary answers that a dosing error caused it, similar incidents have occurred in the past with the province or municipality as competent authority, the company is liable for cleanup costs, and no national overview of scrubber subsidies exists.
In these cases the competent authority is the province or municipality, where overviews of complaints and unusual incidents are also held.
Het bevoegd gezag is in deze gevallen de provincie of de gemeente waar ook overzichten van klachten en ongewone voorvallen aanwezig zijn.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over massale vissterfte bij waterkrachtcentrales (ingezonden 22 april 2011).

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the state secretary about mass fish mortality at hydropower plants, including protected eels and salmon, and whether existing plants should be fitted with working fish guidance or shut down. The government answered that no proven fish guidance system exists yet, that existing plants must have one by 2015 or turbines must be halted during migration peaks, and that the eel management plan sets a 35% mortality reduction target without a fixed end date.

By 2015 at the latest (end of the planning period of the Beheer- en Ontwikkelplan voor de Rijkswateren 2010–2015) existing plants must be equipped with a well-functioning and affordable fish guidance system.
Uiterlijk in 2015 (einde planperiode Beheer- en Ontwikkelplan voor de Rijkswateren 2010–2015) moeten de bestaande centrales voorzien zijn van een goed werkend en betaalbaar visgeleidingssysteem.

Vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand (beiden Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de lobby voor de vestiging van een Europees onderzoekscentrum van Heinz in Nederland

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked the minister whether the government lobbied Heinz to locate its European research centre in Nijmegen, whether subsidies, permits, deregulation or animal testing were involved. The minister answered that EL&I pitched the Netherlands and gave location information but made no agreements, subsidy promises or regulatory exemptions, that permits are for the municipality, and that no animal tests are registered for Heinz.
The cabinet is working to strengthen the investment climate to be attractive to national and international companies that create employment and innovation.
Het kabinet zet in op versterking van het vestigingsklimaat om aantrekkelijk te zijn voor nationale en internationale bedrijven die zorgen voor werkgelegenheid en innovatie.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het doden van duizenden in beslag genomen hamsters, muizen, ratten en andere knaagdieren (inge

An MP asked the state secretary about thousands of seized rodents from an animal trader in Sint Anthonis, whether they were being killed, and about the contract with the parrot shelter N.O.P., the independence of the earlier inquiry, and the regulation of pet trade. The state secretary answered that only 35 animals died in care, no animals were killed for lack of space, the N.O.P. complies with welfare rules and is periodically inspected, and a pet-trade decree is being prepared.
As usual, the animals were immediately inspected by a veterinarian at the storage holder.
Zoals gebruikelijk zijn de dieren bij de opslaghouder direct door een dierenarts geïnspecteerd.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het slachten van kippen in de uitzending van «Echte meisjes in de jungle» (ingezonden 29 maart 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether it is known that a reality TV show had Dutch girls kill and slaughter a chicken without stunning, which Dutch law prohibits, and what steps would prevent such abuses. The state secretary said he was unaware of the show, restated that animals must be treated with respect, and said he could take no steps because the Dutch slaughter decree does not apply in Suriname.
The Decree on the killing of animals does not apply to the killing of animals in Suriname.
Het Besluit doden van dieren is niet van toepassing op het doden van dieren in Suriname.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het doden van gezonde huisdieren (ingezonden 20 april 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether euthanising three healthy dogs, reportedly requested in a deceased owner's will, violated the animal welfare law, and whether the inspectorate would investigate. The state secretary said he could not confirm the case, saw no indication of a violation, declined to order an inspection, and said killing alone need not breach the law while the forthcoming Animal Act would specify when pets may be killed.

Vragen het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over verkoop en verhuur van paaskuikens die na Pasen massaal gedumpt worden (ingezonden 27 april 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether Easter chicks sold or rented by shops are being dumped after Easter, and whether such sales should be banned. The secretary denied receiving signals of rural chicken populations but acknowledged impulse-buy welfare risks and announced mandatory training and buyer information requirements for commercial pet traders.
Within the framework of the Pets decree recently offered for internet consultation, I intend to set requirements for the commercial trade in companion animals.
In het kader van het besluit Gezelschapsdieren dat onlangs ter internetconsultatie is aangeboden, wil ik eisen gaan stellen aan de bedrijfsmatige handel in gezelschapsdieren.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en aan de staatssecretaris van Economie, Landbouw en Innovatie over het schrappen van regels om de import van de A

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the health and agriculture ministers whether they will scrap the temporary rules on Lucky Bamboo imports that guard against the Asian tiger mosquito, and whether they will instead strengthen enforcement. The minister replies that the rules were revised into a permanent decree, that there has never been an import ban, and that the new food and consumer authority will enforce them while expert advice on eradication is awaited.
That is why I have, among other things, set requirements on the marketing of Lucky Bamboo.
Daarom heb ik onder andere voorschriften gesteld aan de verhandeling van Lucky Bamboo.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over geheimhouding van gegevens over de opgevangen orka Morgan door het Dolfinarium (ingezonden 29

MP Ouwehand asks the state secretary about the Dolfinarium's decision to stop releasing medical data on the captive orca Morgan, whether the public display and education role conflicts with the release goal, whether the government is responsible, and whether the protocol and family-search efforts are adequate. The state secretary replies that the Dolfinarium is not legally obliged to release the data, that responsibility for individual animal care lies with the facility, that no formal decisions requiring his approval are pending, and that he will send the protocol to the House.
The Dolfinarium is not obliged to do so, nor under the 'Opvang en rehabilitatie' protocol.
Daartoe is het ook niet verplicht, ook niet op basis van het protocol «Opvang en rehabilitatie».

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Dikkers (PvdA), Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren), Van Tongeren (GroenLinks), Gesthuizen (SP) en Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en In

MPs from six parties asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Foreign Minister about child labour and underpaid adult labour in Dutch cocoa and hazelnut supply chains, including whether hazelnut processors acting through the FNLI and the IDH business network can be held responsible. The government answered that industry bodies are meeting their supply-chain responsibility within the limits of reasonable expectation, describes FNLI and IDH activities, and says the SZW dialogue with Turkey has not yet taken place.
Our answer of 15 December 2010 stated that companies must simply do what can reasonably be expected of them to combat child labour in their chain.
In ons antwoord van 15 december 2010 is aangegeven dat bedrijven zonder meer dienen te doen wat redelijkerwijs van hen mag worden verwacht om kinderarbeid in hun keten te bestrijden.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het terugplaatsen van orka Morgan (ingezonden 14 maart 2011).

MP Ouwehand asked the state secretary whether the 'Free Morgan' plan for releasing the orca Morgan was seriously considered, whether Morgan's captivity at the Dolfinarium is acceptable, and whether a CITES permit for transfer abroad would be granted without parliamentary consent. The secretary referred to an earlier letter on the first two questions, stated that Dolfinarium facilities are adequate under existing law, and said Parliament need not decide on transfer plans because CITES authorities will assess them.
I do not consider it necessary for the House of Representatives to pronounce on plans for relocation and I rely on the judgment of the CITES authorities.
Ik acht het niet nodig dat de Tweede Kamer zich uitspreekt over voornemens tot verplaatsing en vertrouw op het oordeel van de CITES autoriteiten.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretarissen van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over nieuwe pathogenen in genetisch gemanipuleerde gewassen (ing

An MP asked whether a reported new pathogen linked to glyphosate-tolerant GM crops justified validation work, a moratorium and an immediate import and use ban on Roundup Ready crops. The State Secretary replied that no published study had identified such a pathogen, only an unpublished letter by Dr. Huber, and declined a ban, pointing to EFSA review if new data emerge.

As far as I am aware, Dr. Huber has not conducted any research, and no scientific study has been published showing that a new pathogen has been identified in GM crops tolerant to the herbicide Roundup.

Voor zover mij bekend heeft dr. Huber geen onderzoek verricht en is er ook geen wetenschappelijk onderzoek gepubliceerd waaruit blijkt dat er een nieuw pathogeen is geïdentificeerd in gg-gewassen die tolerant zijn voor het herbicide Roundup.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over ontsnapte tijgers bij circus Belly Wien in Alphen

An MP asked the state secretary about three escaped tigers at circus Belly Wien, the safety rules for circuses with wild animals, inspections, and why an exemption was granted to keep the animals. The government answered that the escape was not a public danger, that safety rules are mainly a municipal responsibility, and that it granted the exemption because the animals were legally obtained.
For public order and safety, the local authorities (police and municipalities) are responsible.
Voor openbare orde en veiligheid zijn de lokale autoriteiten (politie en gemeenten) verantwoordelijk.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de voortdurende dolfijnenslachtingen (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

Ouwehand asks the state secretary what action the government has taken to push Japan and the Faroe Islands to end dolphin slaughters, and whether the Netherlands will support a Belgian proposal to bring small cetaceans under the IWC. The state secretary answers that international outrage has not yet changed behaviour, that Nederland will raise its position at appropriate moments, and that a Belgian motion to extend IWC competence to small cetaceans failed to gain a majority, with the Netherlands committed to continued advocacy.
I will convey the Netherlands' position on this at appropriate moments.
Ik zal het standpunt van Nederland hieromtrent op gepaste momenten uitdragen.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over vliegreizen van Maastricht naar Amsterdam (ingezonden 8 februari 2011).

MP Ouwehand asked whether a Limburg company's planned flights from Maastricht to Amsterdam could be prevented, given their CO2 impact compared with car or train travel. The state secretary replied that EU law liberalises intra-community air services so national licensing cannot be imposed, that emissions data for these flights is not available, and that short flights likely emit more CO2 per passenger than rail or car.

Under EU Regulation 1008/2008 the internal market for Community air carriers is liberalised, and member states may not make the operation of air services on intra-Community routes subject to any licence or authorisation.

Op grond van EU Verordening 1008/2008 is de interne markt voor communautaire luchtvaartmaatschappijen geliberaliseerd en mogen lidstaten de exploitatie van luchtdiensten op intracommunautaire routes niet afhankelijk stellen van enige vergunning of toelating.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de in beslag genomen zeehonden (ingezonden 7 januari 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about seized seals, their transfer to Dolfinarium Harderwijk, possible release, how a fish trader obtained them, sanctions, and repeat illegal animal possession. The state secretary said the seals were taken into administrative custody, release depends on origin, the trader faces administrative and criminal action, and recidivism is undesirable, but gave no concrete targets.
In the interest of the criminal proceedings in this case, I cannot go into this further.
In het belang van de strafrechtelijke behandeling van deze zaak kan ik daar verder niet op ingaan.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over onnodige dierproeven voor toxicologisch onderzoek (ingezon

An MP asked whether multi-generation rodent reproduction toxicity studies could be dropped because the second generation adds no new knowledge, whether the OECD proposed replacing them, how many animals are used and under REACH, and the status of an inventory of obstacles to alternatives. The minister largely agreed the second generation could be dropped and favours the extended one-generation study, but said the OECD does not dictate EU policy and that the EU has not yet decided, and gave the RIVM study timing.
The Netherlands is of the view that these second-generation studies could be abolished.
Nederland is echter van mening dat deze studies naar de tweede generatie zouden kunnen worden afgeschaft.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over onzekerheid van natuurcompensatie bij vliegveld Twente (ing

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks whether accelerated creation of new nature around Twente airport is in doubt, whether compensation under the EHS rules is guaranteed, and whether existing nature is protected, and asks about enforcement of those rules. The state secretary answers that the matter is under a joint review with the provinces and that the province of Overijssel is primarily responsible for airport redevelopment, EHS application and nature development, so it is not the minister's direct responsibility.

The preparation of the redevelopment of Twente airport, the application of the EHS Rules, the determination of the size and boundaries of the EHS and the implementation of nature development are primarily the responsibility of the province of Overijssel.

De voorbereiding van de herontwikkeling vliegveld Twente, de toepassing van de Spelregels EHS, de vaststelling van de omvang en begrenzing van de EHS en de uitvoering van natuurontwikkeling, betreffen een primaire verantwoordelijkheid van de provincie Overijssel.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de verkoop van bedreigde tonijn in Nederlandse supermarkte

An MP asked the state secretary and health minister about canned tuna containing endangered and overfished species, citing a Greenpeace study, and asked whether labelling and mixing violate EU rules, how controls work, and whether an investigation, market bans or action against lure-fishing will follow. The government confirmed the labelling rule applies but said mixing is lawful, that existing sampling cannot detect cooked tuna species, and declined a new investigation or bans, pointing to EU and international action.
Such an investigation will not contribute to solving the problem and probably will not yield additional information compared with the Greenpeace report.
Dergelijk onderzoek zal niet bijdragen aan het oplossen van het probleem en waarschijnlijk ook geen additionele informatie opleveren in vergelijking met het rapport van Greenpeace.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de staatssecretarissen van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over nieuw onderzoek door een extern bureau naar een alternatief voor de ontpolde

MP Ouwehand asks why the government commissioned Deltares to find an alternative to depoldering the Hedwige polder, whether costs are covered, and how this squares with earlier assurances that the search would be internal. The state secretary confirms the study, says it implements the coalition agreement, states costs will come from existing Westerschelde nature budget, and says internal expertise was lacking.
I regard this as giving effect to the agreement on this matter in the coalition agreement.
Ik beschouw dit als invulling van de afspraak terzake in het Regeerakkoord

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de opvang van apen die als proefdier zijn gebruikt door de Universiteit Utrecht (inge

An MP asks ministers whether the University of Utrecht's decision to end monkey experiments is known, what will happen to the five remaining monkeys (including euthanasia as an option), whether animal shelter AAP will take them, and what the government plans for care of research animals. The minister confirms the facts, says AAP is willing to take the monkeys subject to expert approval the university is responsible for, and points to the upcoming EU directive implementation with the decision on post-experiment fate left to the veterinarian.
The board has indicated that it wishes to place the animals with the AAP foundation.
Het bestuur heeft aangegeven de dieren te willen onderbrengen bij de stichting AAP.

Vragen van de leden Jansen (SP), Van Tongeren (GroenLinks), Van der Staaij (SGP), Neppérus (VVD), Veldhoven-van der Meer (D66), Ouwehand (PvdD) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken en de st

MPs from several parties asked whether asbestos, pesticides and herbicides from the Stichting Machinale Landbouw have polluted the Wageningen area in Suriname, whether Dutch responsibility and cancer mortality are involved, and whether Dutch assistance is available. The minister answered that no recent research exists, that Suriname's authorities are investigating and planning awareness activities, and that the Netherlands will consider assistance if Suriname requests it.

Due to the lack of research data, the Surinamese authorities cannot determine the extent to which the operations of Stichting Machinale Landbouw have affected negative developments in the living environment of Wageningen and surroundings.

Vanwege het ontbreken van onderzoeksdata is door de Surinaamse autoriteiten niet vast te stellen in hoeverre de bedrijfsvoering van Stichting Machinale Landbouw van invloed is op negatieve ontwikkelingen in de leefomgeving van Wageningen en omstreken.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het terugplaatsen van orka Morgan (ingezonden 8 november 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary whether the goal of returning orca Morgan to the wild still stands, whether SeaWorld or similar dolphinariums can be ruled out as destinations, and when clarity on rehabilitation will come. The secretary answered that Dolfinarium Harderwijk concluded, on expert advice, that Morgan cannot be released, a decision it may take within its existing exemption and quality protocol.
Recently, Dolfinarium Harderwijk, on the basis of advice from experts it consulted, concluded that the orca Morgan cannot be returned to the wild.
Onlangs is het Dolfinarium Harderwijk – op grond van adviezen van door hen geraadpleegde deskundigen – tot de conclusie gekomen dat de orka Morgan niet teruggeplaatst kan worden in de vrije natuur.

Vragen van de leden Dikkers (PvdA), Voordewind (CU), Ouwerhand (PvdD) en Dijkhoff (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris voor Buitenlandse Zaken over het rapport van Human Rights Watch over de situatie in Burundi (ingezonden 26 n

MPs asked the Dutch government about a Human Rights Watch report on crackdowns on rights in Burundi, including whether it was unacceptable, whether it affects Dutch development aid, whether civil society should be supported, and the role of the Netherlands in the Great Lakes region. The government said it shares the concerns, has raised them bilaterally and multilaterally, will continue its security-sector and civil-society support, and will inform parliament in spring 2011 about its focus countries.
We share the concerns expressed in the report about the arrests of journalists, the documented cases of torture and the restriction of freedom for opposition parties and civil society.

Wij delen de in het rapport geuite zorgen over arrestaties van journalisten, de geconstateerde gevallen van marteling en de beperking van de vrijheid voor oppositiepartijen en het maatschappelijk middenveld.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over misstanden op de paardenmarkt in Hedel (ingezonden 11 november 2010).

MP Ouwehand asked the state secretary about animal welfare abuses (kicking, beating, dragging ponies, sick animals) at the Hedel horse market, whether such markets are generally harmful, why the AID was absent, inspection figures for 2009, and how weak animals fit the transport rules. The state secretary confirmed the violations, said a ban on horse markets is not warranted but enforcement will be intensified, and gave partial inspection data while stating that enforcement was carried out by the nVWA and LID.
However, the nVWA does not register the violations found and the measures based on them per location.
De nVWA registreert echter niet per locatie de geconstateerde overtredingen en de hierop gebaseerde maatregelen.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de plannen voor een «tijdelijke dierentuin» in Hoogeveen (ingezonden 1 november 2010).

MP Ouwehand asks the state secretary about a one-day zoo in Hoogeveen with wild animals including an elephant, whether the municipality licensed it, and about rules for wild animals in circuses and private hands. The state secretary says the municipality decides on events, the animals were privately owned rather than circus animals, and that the rules under the Gezondheids- en welzijnswet and Flora- en faunawet apply, promising to report on circus regulation soon.
Municipalities have their own authority to allow or not allow events and to take appropriate measures to guide the event properly.
Gemeenten hebben een eigen bevoegdheid om evenementen wel of niet toe te staan en passende maatregelen te nemen om het evenement in goede banen te leiden.

Vragen van de leden Dikkers en Van Dam (beiden PvdA), Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Irrgang (SP), El Fassed (GroenLinks) en Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het schenden van het wapenembargo door

MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that China is withholding a UN Panel of Experts report stating that UNAMID peacekeepers were fired on with Chinese-origin ammunition, and whether Chinese arms supplies to Sudan breach the UN and EU embargoes. The minister answered that the report is not yet public, that the Netherlands will press for its publication, that ammunition supplies to the Sudanese army are not per se a violation of the embargo, and that EU export licences are refused where an embargo applies.
The report of the UN Panel of Experts is not yet public.
Het rapport van de VN Panel of Experts is nog niet openbaar.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de ministers van Financiën, van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het heffen van hondenbelasting voor de financiering van de

MP Ouwehand asked ministers whether it is fair to fund the municipal duty to shelter stray animals through a dog tax on dog owners, and whether a levy on pet breeders and sellers should be introduced. The government answered that the dog tax is a general municipal tax whose use is a local decision, that it sees no need for an extra levy on the pet sector, and that it will not intervene in Veere's decision.
The cabinet cannot and does not want to intervene in this competence.
Het kabinet kan en wil niet in deze bevoegdheid treden.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de toekomst van orka Morgan (ingezonden 7 oktober 2010).

MP Ouwehand asks the minister about the future of orca Morgan: possible transfer to SeaWorld, plans for release into the wild versus display at Dolfinarium Harderwijk, care and monitoring, and expected timing of release. The state secretary answers that transfer is not currently on the table, that release remains the starting point if welfare permits, that brief public viewing is justified, and that a scientific report is due in November after which the Dolfinarium will submit its plans for ministerial review.
The Dolfinarium will draw conclusions from it and intends to submit its plans for Morgan to me for review.
Het Dolfinarium zal daaruit conclusies trekken en is voornemens zijn plannen met Morgan ter toetsing voor te leggen aan mij.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het afmaakbeleid van wilde dieren door circussen (ingezonden 28 september 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether the planned euthanasia of a tiger cub with cataracts by circus Belly Wien was acceptable, and whether the circus and the AID enforced welfare and CITES rules. The minister answered that euthanasia of a suffering animal is not prohibited, that CITES does not prevent it, that the AID found no violations in six 2010 inspections, and that new circus welfare rules are pending, without committing to new action.
No record is kept of this.
Hier wordt geen registratie van bijgehouden.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de handhaving van het verbod op het verloten van dieren (ingezonden 10 september 2010).

MP Ouwehand asks the minister whether a raffle of ponies with a voucher prize at riding schools violates the animal raffle ban in the Animal Health and Welfare Act, whether it is a loophole, and how the ban is enforced. The state secretary answers that the ban covers voucher prizes too, reports that the Public Prosecution Service has brought two cases and settled eight by transaction, and declines to disclose the outcome of the AID action in the Assendelft case for privacy reasons.
No public statement can be made about the action taken and its outcome, given the privacy of the person concerned.
Op de actie die hierop is ondernomen en de uitkomst daarvan, kan met het oog op de privacy van betrokkene publiekelijk geen mededeling worden gedaan.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het houden van roofvogels en uilen als huisdieren (ingezonden 9 september 2010).

An MP asked the minister about the growing private keeping of birds of prey and owls, the ease of purchase, certificate numbers, trade controls and regulation, and whether such keeping and falconry shows should be restricted. The minister acknowledged welfare concerns, pointed to owner responsibility and information campaigns, said certificate growth was not significant, and said a positive list for mammals is being developed with possible later extension to birds.
I can share the concerns mentioned, since I consider it very important for animal welfare that people make a well-considered choice for an animal.
Ik kan de genoemde zorgen delen, aangezien ik het van groot belang vind voor het welzijn van dieren dat mensen de keuze voor een dier weloverwogen maken.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over illegaal gehouden resusapen door Circus Renz Berlin (ingezonden 27 augustus 2010).

Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) asks the minister about two rhesus monkeys held by Circus Renz Berlin without a permit, including whether seizure, sanctions and a permit application are appropriate. The minister confirms the Flora- and faunawet ban applies, that a permit application is being processed, that the monkeys are not wild-caught, and outlines possible penalties and ongoing EU-level work on circus animals.
Keeping rhesus monkeys without an exemption is in breach of article 13 of the Flora- and faunawet.
Het zonder ontheffing houden van resusapen is in strijd met artikel 13 van de Flora- en faunawet.
Vragen van lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Justitie over een toename van hondengevechten in Rotterdam (ingezonden 10 september 2010).

MP Ouwehand asked whether dog fighting in Rotterdam is increasing, how prosecutions and penalties work, and whether dogs cropped abroad should be banned. The minister answered that police, inspection and prosecutors see no evidence of an increase, no one has been prosecuted under the relevant article in five years, and she opposes a ban on keeping cropped dogs.
None of these bodies can confirm that there is an increase in dog fights in Rotterdam.
Geen van deze instanties kan bevestigen dat er in Rotterdam sprake is van een toename van het aantal hondengevechten.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de ziekte Meervoudige chemische overgevoeligheid (MCS) (ingezonden 25 augustus 2010).

Ouwehand (PvdD) asked the health minister about multiple chemical sensitivity (MCS), its classification abroad, why the Netherlands does not recognise it as a disease, the Gezondheidsraad 1999 conclusions, research on chemical exposure, and reducing chemicals in consumer products. Minister Klink answered that MCS is not a classified disease, that complaints are addressed by professionals, that no new Gezondheidsraad advice is needed, and that existing product safety rules and a complaints portal apply.
At this moment I do not consider it necessary to ask the Gezondheidsraad for a new advice.
Ik vind het op dit moment niet nodig om de Gezondheidsraad om een nieuw advies te vragen.

Vragen van het leden Thieme en Ouwehand (beiden PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het bericht dat de voorzitter van het Europees Stamboek voor Shagyapaarden, Sportpaarden en Sportpony’s

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked the minister whether a stud-book chairman's threat to execute horses to force recognition by the PVE was acceptable and whether the law has a gap, and whether AID inspections would be used. The minister replied that the statement was personal, the EASP board distanced itself from it, a conversation was scheduled, and specific inspection measures were not considered opportune.
In view of the above, I do not consider it opportune to take specific measures.
Gezien het bovengenoemde acht ik het nemen van specifieke maatregelen niet opportuun.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de eenhoksraces met duiven (ingezonden 6 september 2010).

MP Ouwehand asks the minister about a pigeon single-loft race in Uden where the Dierenbescherming calculates 275 of 425 pigeons died or were lost, and asks what agreements were made with the NPO, why losses occurred, and whether a ban on multi-day races is needed. The minister says she cannot judge the loss figures, the NPO agreed to remove information and distance itself from large races but has not yet done so, no agreements exist for small races, and she prefers agreements over a ban.
I aim to make agreements with the NPO that reduce pigeon losses, and I will point the NPO to the agreement made regarding the large single-loft race.
Ik streef ernaar om met de NPO afspraken te maken die de uitval van duiven verminderen en ik zal de NPO wijzen op de gemaakte afspraak inzake de grote eenhoksrace.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het toelaten van chemische middelen ter bestrijding van de beschermde veenmol (ingezonden 9 september 2010).

The MP Ouwehand asks the minister whether the protected veenmol cricket is threatened by pesticides and why the carbamate pesticide Mesurol, containing methiocarb, is authorised to control it, and whether it will be withdrawn. The minister answers that the veenmol is not protected under the Flora- and Faunawet, that habitat loss rather than pesticides is the main cause of decline, that Mesurol's authorisation meets legal requirements, and that no withdrawal is planned.
No. As noted in the answer to question 1, the veenmol is not protected.
Nee. Zoals opgemerkt in het antwoord op vraag 1 is de veenmol niet beschermd.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken, van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de Europese export van afgekeurde voedi

An MP asked ministers whether the EU exports rejected food and banned chemicals such as DDT to Africa, and how export of non-compliant fish and expired food is controlled. The government answered that DDT export is banned under EU rules (transit possible, WHO-sanctioned malaria use), that prior-consent procedures apply to restricted chemicals, and that non-compliant Dutch fish must be destroyed and the VWA supervises, while offering no new commitments.
No. DDT is a substance listed under the Stockholm Convention on persistent organic pollutants, and European regulation prohibits exporting DDT from Europe.
Nee. DDT is een stof die op de lijst staat van het Verdrag van Stockholm inzake persistente organische verontreinigende stoffen en Europese regelgeving verbiedt het om DDT uit Europa te exporteren.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de toepassing van de Rollkür en Laag-Diep-Rondmethode (LDR) in de Nederlandse dres

An MP asked ministers about the use of Rollkür and LDR training methods in Dutch dressage, the controversy over the Dutch dressage coach's emails to a journalist, and rules on coach conduct. The government said it does not judge training methods, that the FEI and KNHS now permit only LDR and have steward guidelines, and that coach conduct and appointments are matters for the sports federation and private parties.
It is not my responsibility or that of the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality to form a judgment on the various training methods used in Dutch sport.

Het behoort niet tot mijn taak of de taak van de Minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit (LNV) om een oordeel te vormen over de verschillende trainingsmethoden die gebruikt worden in de Nederlandse sport.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de uitlatingen van de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat dat hij Sea Shepherd de Nederlandse vlag wil ontnemen (ingezonden 28 mei 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Transport about his plan to strip Sea Shepherd of its Dutch flag, the controversial Zeebrievenwet amendment, and the Dutch position on Japanese whaling and detained activists. The minister replies that a new national-ship-nationality law is being accelerated, that the IVW found Sea Shepherd ships broke collision rules but no criminal investigation occurred, that the Bob Barker received a nationality declaration, and that the Netherlands sees no reason to single out Japan's trial of activists.
This process is being internally accelerated so that it can be submitted to the House of Representatives after the summer recess.
Dit proces wordt intern versneld om zodoende na het zomerreces bij de Tweede Kamer te worden ingediend.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteiten van Buitenlandse Zaken over de jaarlijkse slachting van dolfijnen op de Faröereilanden (ingezonden 29 juli 2010).

An MP asked whether the minister had seen footage of the annual dolphin slaughter in the Faroe Islands, how it could be stopped, what was said to the Danish minister, and the progress on including small cetaceans under the IWC. The minister confirmed viewing the footage, referred to earlier letters, reported that a Belgian motion backed by the Netherlands failed to gain a majority, and pledged continued effort within the IWC.
I will continue to work within the IWC, together with other countries inside and outside the EU, for an extension of the IWC to small cetaceans.
Ik zal mij in het kader van de IWC, en in samenwerking met andere landen binnen en buiten de EU, blijven inzetten voor een verbreding van de IWC naar de kleine walvisachtigen.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de (on)mogelijkheid om bedrijven die zich niet aan hun milieuvergunning houden, te kunnen sluiten (ingezo

MP Ouwehand asks the minister whether firms repeatedly breaching their environmental permits should be closable, whether periodic review should replace permits, why advice for lighter, temporary permits was not followed, and whether temporary permits would have prevented cases like Sterigenics in Zoetermeer and Nijhoff in Almelo. The minister says closure must remain possible for structural non-compliance, that existing review duties suffice, that temporary permits already exist and will be widened by the Wabo, and that Gedeputeerde Staten's revocation of Nijhoff's permit is open to appeal.
In the Wabo, which enters into force on 1 October 2010, the power to grant permits temporarily is extended.
