In de Wet algemene bepalingen omgevingsrecht (Wabo), die op 1 oktober 2010 in werking treedt, wordt de bevoegdheid om vergunningen tijdelijk te verlenen uitgebreid.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de voortgang op het gebied van preventie van stalbranden (in

An MP asked ministers about the rising number of animals killed in barn fires, whether the government's consultation and study on preventing stable fires has been completed, how this relates to a new pig-farm fire safety network, and whether prevention should be mandated rather than left to voluntary agreements. The minister acknowledged the concern, said a study by the Dierenbescherming and LTO Nederland is due for discussion in late summer with a government position expected by end 2010, and gave no commitment to mandatory rules.
As soon as the outcomes of that consultation and the related position of the ministers concerned are known, the cabinet will inform you of them.
Zodra de uitkomsten van dat overleg en het daarop betrekking hebbende standpunt van de betrokken ministers bekend zijn, zult u daarover van de zijde van het kabinet worden geïnformeerd.

Vragen van de leden Ouwehand (PvdD), El Fassed en Peters (beiden Groen Links) en Van Gerven (SP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de rechtmatigheid van het proces t

MPs asked the government how it followed the trial of two Greenpeace activists in Japan, whether it would press Japan on fair process, and why it judged no breach of international treaties, despite UN criticism. The minister replied that the embassy follows the case, that the government does not interfere in another country's internal legal process, and that the UN findings do not justify discrediting the proceedings.
I will raise their situation in the run-up to the next EU human rights dialogue with Japan.
Ik zal hun situatie in de aanloop naar de volgende EU-mensenrechtendialoog met Japan doen op brengen.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de isolatieafstanden bij experimentele gentechaardappels (in

Ouwehand (PvdD) asks why no isolation distances apply to Avebe's experimental genetically modified potato field trial, whether COGEM covers economic risks and cisgenic health risks, and how contamination of conventional and organic crops and hobby growers is prevented. Minister Huizinga-Heringa answers that COGEM assesses environmental risks only, isolation distances are required only where environmental risk demands them with co-existence rules set by the sector, and the government sees no reason to amend the 2008 permit.
I have adopted the COGEM advice on this category 2 field trial of AVEBE.
Ik heb het advies van de COGEM over deze categorie 2 veldproef van AVEBE overgenomen.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de malafide paardenhandel (ingezonden 4 juni 2010).

MP Ouwehand asked the ministers of Justice and Agriculture about a dealer exposed on TV for selling sick and slaughter-bound horses as healthy riding horses, and about enforcement, possible bans on keeping horses, mandatory identification and registration, and self-regulation. The government answered that the dealer is unknown to inspectorates, that criminal investigation is pending and that the court, not the minister, decides on a keeping ban, while promising to consult the sector on extending horse registration to owners and holders.
Given the protection of the privacy of the person concerned, I cannot inform the House about any earlier actions taken by the police or the Public Prosecution Service.
Gelet op de bescherming van de privacy van de betrokkene, kan ik de Kamer niet informeren over eventuele eerdere acties die door politie of Openbaar Ministerie zijn ondernomen.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over gifgehalten in vis (ingezonden 2 juli 2010).

MP Ouwehand asked ministers whether dietary advice to eat fish twice weekly, based on average contaminant levels, adequately accounts for higher toxin exposure from fish caught in polluted areas, and whether fish origin and traceability should be communicated. The ministers replied that the advice follows the Health Council guidelines, that imported fish meets legal safety norms enforced by the VWA, and that further traceability beyond the FAO catch area offers little public health benefit.
Further traceability offers too little additional benefit from a public health perspective.
Verdere traceerbaarheid biedt vanuit volksgezondheidsoogpunt te weinig extra’s.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de handel in apen voor dierexperimenten door RC Hartelust bv (ingezonden 9 april 2010).

An MP asked the health minister for detailed figures on primate imports, origins, transport deaths, housing and inspections at RC Hartelust bv, a Tilburg primate trader for animal experiments, and about why a visit by the Party for the Animals was refused. The minister declined to give company-specific data citing the Wet openbaarheid van bestuur and privacy law, pointed to general CITES and Wod rules, said the 2005 transport deaths were handled by the VWA without criminal enforcement, and stated the company may decide whom it admits.
Under the Government Information (Public Access) Act and the Personal Data Protection Act, I cannot provide specific company information about individual businesses.
In het kader van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur en de wet bescherming persoonsgegevens kan ik over individuele bedrijven geen specifieke bedrijfsinformatie verschaffen.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de situatie van de opgevangen Orcinus orca (orka) (ingezonden 25 juni 2010).

An MP asked the minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the care of a stranded orca, including the rules for rescuing sick marine mammals, the conditions for its release, whether it would be used for research, and how it ended up alone in the Wadden Sea. The minister answered that a Flora- and faunawet exemption covers the Dolfinarium Harderwijk's care protocol, that release will be decided by its scientific leadership, that there are no plans to track it for research, and that the cause of its separation cannot be reconstructed.
There is no research method available to reconstruct how this weakened orca ended up in the Wadden Sea.
Er is geen onderzoeksmethode voorhanden om te reconstrueren hoe deze verzwakte orka in de Waddenzee verzeild is geraakt.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over dierproeven voor ruimteonderzoek (ingezonden 21 april 2010).

An MP asked ministers whether ESA-linked space research involving animal experiments, and claims about monkey experiments on the Mars500 website, were consistent with government statements and the Dutch animal experiments law. The minister answered that Mars500 involves no animal experiments, that the posting was removed at ESA's request, and that Dutch animal experiments are assessed by ethics committees under the law, with the government speaking only for the Dutch situation.
Because the Netherlands is not a contracting party in this, I asked ESA for further information about the Mars500 project.
Omdat Nederland hierin geen contractpartner is, heb ik ESA verzocht om nadere informatie over het Mars500-project.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over omstreden pijnexperimenten bij muizen (ingezonden 17 mei 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about a McGill University study that inflicted pain on mice to code their facial expressions, and whether Dutch ethics committees or government funding were involved. The minister replied that the Dutch animal experiments committee (DEC) does not assess foreign studies, that the Dutch government does not fund the research, and that the government has no specific programme on pain expression in lab animals.
This experiment was carried out in Canada and therefore is not subject to assessment by a Dutch DEC.
Deze proef is in Canada uitgevoerd en daarom is dit niet ter beoordeling van een Nederlandse DEC.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het importeren van reuzenpanda’s uit China (ingezonden 8 april 2010).

An MP asked the minister about plans by Dierenpark Emmen to import giant pandas from China, the welfare trade-off, the applicable rules and supervision, international breeding agreements, and the loan arrangements with China. The minister answered that the plans are still exploratory, that the conditions and any loan agreement are not yet known, and that the import is governed by CITES, EU transport and veterinary rules enforced by the AID, NVWA and Customs.
The conditions on the Chinese side are not yet known, but it is clear that they will be high.
De voorwaarden van Chinese zijde zijn nog niet bekend, maar wel is duidelijk dat deze hoog zullen zijn.
qn: Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over versoepeling van visserijregels na een intensieve lobby van Sportvisserij Nederland (ingezonde

The MP asks whether the state secretary plans to loosen fishing rules (lifting the ban on European catfish, scrapping the worm closed season and allowing year-round night fishing) after intensive lobbying by Sportvisserij Nederland, and whether scientific and nature organisations were consulted. The secretary answers that the changes follow earlier announced regulatory simplification based on Imares research and stakeholder and public consultation, and that the Kamer does not need to approve them under the Visserijwet 1963.
In accordance with the applicable rules of the Visserijwet 1963, there is no provision for submitting the proposed amendment to the States General.
Overeenkomstig de daarvoor geldende regels uit de Visserijwet 1963 is niet voorzien in het voorleggen van de voorgenomen wijziging aan de Staten-Generaal.

qa: Antwoord op vragen de leden Laçin, Paterenotte, Kröger, Van Brenk, Öztürk en Gijs van Dijk over de openstelling van de coronateststraat op Schiphol voor werknemers

MPs from SP, D66, GroenLinks, 50PLUS, DENK and PvdA asked why Schiphol workers who develop symptoms cannot be tested at the airport's test facility, whether the government will talk with the GGD and Schiphol, and how often the labour inspectorate checks Covid measures at Schiphol. The answer is a reference to a separate letter on the Covid situation, so the substance is not answered in this document.
The written questions ... have been answered by means of the letter <Status of COVID-19> (Parliamentary paper 25 295, no. 1422).

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over handhavingsacties op het NS-station Arnhem centraal

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about enforcement actions by rail-station inspectors at Arnhem Centraal, including whether they involve public-order or criminal-investigation grounds, ethnic profiling and the use-of-force framework. The minister answered that actions are intelligence-led, carried out by NS transport inspectors under the statutory framework without mayoral or prosecutorial authority, denied ethnic profiling, and described the limited force powers and the review of force use by the direct supervisor.
When the force powers are used during an enforcement action, the direct supervisor, among others, checks whether the inspector's conduct took place within the applicable legal framework.

Wanneer tijdens een handhavingsactie gebruik wordt gemaakt van de geweldsbevoegdheid, wordt door o.a. de direct toezichthouder getoetst of het optreden van de boa heeft plaatsgevonden binnen het geldend wettelijk kader.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Amhaouch, Wilders, Graus, Emiel van Dijk, Regterschot, Nijkerken-De Haan, Raemakers, Ploumen, Gijs van Dijk, Öztürk en Wassenberg over het advies van de Raad van Europa over a

Multiple MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether she shares the Council of Europe's view that Limburgish and other regional languages need more government attention, and what the government does to promote them. The minister answered that the government gives ample attention to regional languages, pointed to the 2019 Limburgish convenant with the province, the symposia, education and childcare provisions, and the province's leading role, without committing to new obligations such as recognising Limburgish as an official government language.
The government is not working on recognising Limburgish as an official government language.
De regering werkt niet aan het erkennen van het Limburgs als overheidstaal.
Antwoord op ragen van de leden Kröger, Paternotte, Gijs van Dijk, Van Raan, Öztürk, Bruins, Amhaouch, Laçin, Van Kooten-Arissen, Van Brenk en Stoffer over de teststraat op Schiphol

Eleven MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the Schiphol COVID-19 test facility should be scaled up and extended to match arrivals from orange-code countries such as Spain and France, and whether all travellers from those areas could be tested on arrival at Dutch airports. The answer, sent via a letter from Minister De Jonge, refers to the broader testing and tracing letter and does not address the specific questions.

The written questions from the eleven MPs to the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management, submitted 27 August 2020, have been answered by a letter titled 'Testing and tracing: together strategically combating the Corona pandemic'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Kröger (GroenLinks), Paternotte (D66), Gijs van Dijk (PvdA), Van Raan (PvdD), Öztürk (Denk), Bruins (ChristenUnie), Amhaouch (CDA), Laçin (SP), Van Kooten-Arissen (Van Kooten-Arissen), Van Brenk (50PLUS) en Stoffer (SGP) aan de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat ingezonden 27 augustus 2020, zijn beantwoord middels brief «Testen en traceren: samen strategisch de Corona-pandemie bestrijden».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azarkan en Öztürk over steunmaatregelen voor taxichauffeurs en marktkooplieden tijdens de coronacrisis

MPs Azarkan and Öztürk asked why taxi drivers and market traders were excluded from the Noodloket and later TOGS support schemes due to wrong SBI codes, and whether these groups would be admitted. The minister answered that both groups were added to the TOGS scheme (taxi from 15 April, non-food market traders from 30 March and 15 April) and that the technical problems with the Noodloket had been resolved, with applications open until 26 June 2020.
This group can submit an application to the Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RVO.nl) from 15 April 2020.
Deze groep kan vanaf 15 april 2020 een aanvraag indienen bij de Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO.nl).

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over de kilometerslange files bij de grensovergangen van Turkije, Bulgarije, Servië, Hongarije, Griekenland en Kroatië, en de intimidatie die reizigers ervaren

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked about long queues at EU external border crossings, systematic checks of EU citizens, mandatory paid vehicle disinfection in Bulgaria and intimidation of travellers. The minister said the government has no indications that countries withhold capacity, explained the EU framework for checks and disinfection, and noted the embassy raised complaints with Bulgarian authorities.
The Cabinet has no indications that the countries concerned do not deploy the available capacity.
Het Kabinet heeft geen aanwijzingen dat betrokken landen de beschikbare capaciteit niet inzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het optreden van KMar- en douanemedewerkers op Schiphol, Eindhoven Airport en Rotterdam The Hague Airport

An MP asks ministers about alleged ethnic profiling and discriminatory treatment by Customs and the Royal Netherlands Marechaussee at Schiphol and Eindhoven airports, including an Ombudsman finding on Customs cash checks. The government denies systematic profiling, acknowledges shortcomings in information provision and one inappropriate remark, cites ongoing complaint procedures, and declines a separate investigation while awaiting the Ombudsman's own inquiry.
Yes, Customs acknowledges that at the time of the complaint the provision of information at Eindhoven Airport was insufficient
Ja, de Douane erkent dat ten tijde van de klacht de informatieverstrekking op Eindhoven Airport onvoldoende was
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over de productconformiteit van PC’s, laptops, tablets, smart TV’s, slimme thermostaten en andere slimme apparatuur thuis

An MP asked the State Secretary whether consumer electronics with components that cannot be replaced cheaply conform to Dutch consumer sales law, and whether the manufacturers could be pressed to make parts replaceable at reasonable cost. The State Secretary answered that non-conformity requires free repair or replacement regardless of cost, that the burden of proof shifts after six months, and that manufacturers decide their own production choices, so no further action was committed.
It is up to manufacturers to make choices about how they organise their production process.
Het is aan fabrikanten om keuzes te maken over de inrichting van hun productieproces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azarkan en Öztürk over flitskredieten die worden aangeboden tegen woekerrentes

MPs Azarkan and Öztürk asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about flash loans offered to businesses at usurious rates, their exclusion from consumer credit rules, and whether research into their effects would be done. The minister answered that no serious abuses are known, that the sector is developing self-regulation, and that a general market study is planned, but declined specific research and extension of consumer credit protection to small businesses.
At present I have no signals of serious abuses or major problems in this sector due to high interest rates or other costs.
Op dit moment heb ik geen signalen over ernstige misstanden of grote problemen in deze branche vanwege hoge rentes of andere kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het gebruik van de dienstauto, in relatie tot transparantie en verantwoording afleggen aan de Kamer

The MP Öztürk asked the Minister of Interior about the use of the Speaker's official car, including who may ride along, requests for travel logs, cost per kilometre and the rules, linking this to transparency toward parliament. The Minister answered that the Tweede Kamer itself is responsible for correct use under the relevant law and tax rules, so the requested information is not held by her ministry.
The Tweede Kamer is responsible for the correct use of the official car under the stated legal as well as fiscal frameworks.
De Tweede Kamer is verantwoordelijk voor het correct gebruik van de dienstauto vanuit de genoemde wettelijke maar ook de fiscale kaders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het wethoudersbestand dat niet representatief blijkt te zijn

Parliamentary member Öztürk asked whether the low share of wethouders (aldermen) with a migration background reflects a structural problem and what the government will do about representativeness in local and mayoral appointments. The minister answered that college formation is a local matter, that she has no figures on targets, will not anticipate a study on barriers for other groups beyond disability, and describes existing diversity initiatives for mayors without committing to concrete new measures.
Coalition negotiations are a local matter. I therefore have no figures on what is being aimed for, nor insight into the considerations made locally when forming the colleges.

Collegeonderhandelingen zijn een lokale aangelegenheid. Ik heb dan ook geen cijfers over waarop wordt aangekoerst of inzicht in de afwegingen die lokaal worden gemaakt bij samenstelling van de colleges.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over een vorm van slavernij bij PostNL

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked whether working conditions for agency sorters at PostNL amount to a form of slavery, including pace of work, heavy lifting, breaks, standby pay, underpayment and bypassing the collective agreement. The ministers answered that employers bear primary responsibility under the Working Conditions Act and that the Labour Inspectorate enforces the rules, that the underpayment matter is before the civil court, and that they saw no reason to meet PostNL's management.
Following the findings of the investigation, the FNV summoned PostNL and agency InPerson before the civil court on 22 February 2018.
Naar aanleiding van de uitkomsten uit het onderzoek heeft de FNV op 22 februari 2018 PostNL en uitzendbureau InPerson voor de civiele rechter gedaagd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu, Azarkan en Öztürk over het bericht dat een Turks-Nederlandse vereniging in Rotterdam is besmeurd met PKK-leuzen door sympathisanten van de terroristische beweging PKK

MPs Kuzu, Azarkan and Öztürk asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of the Interior about the graffiti of PKK slogans on a Turkish-Dutch association building in Rotterdam, measures to protect members, and PKK demonstrations with flags. Minister Grapperhaus replied that local authorities and police are handling protection, a criminal investigation has no suspects yet, the PKK is monitored and on the terrorism sanctions list, and flag displays are regulated under the right to demonstrate.
I have viewed the defacement with abhorrence.
Ik heb met afkeer kennisgenomen van de bekladding.

The minister distanced himself from the remark, pointed to existing mosque security guidance and local contacts, and said the municipality of Nieuwegein must judge whether the employee's conduct breached the rules.

It is up to the college of mayor and aldermen of the municipality of Nieuwegein, as employer and competent authority, to assess whether the political statements made by Mr Van Deún lead to the conclusion that the so-called performance norm has been exceeded.

Het is aan het college van burgemeester en wethouders van de gemeente Nieuwegein als werkgever en bevoegd gezag om te beoordelen of de door de heer Deún gedane (politieke) uitlatingen leiden tot de conclusie dat de zogenaamde functioneringsnorm is overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het bericht dat de gemeenten Turkse Nederlanders discrimineren bij controles op uitkeringen

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the minister whether municipalities discriminate against Turkish Dutch people in benefit checks, whether outsourcing foreign asset investigations to private firms is lawful, and whether rules should be tightened. The state secretary acknowledged the Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling that Almelo and Eindhoven's practices breached the non-discrimination ban, said outsourcing to private parties is permissible within legal limits, and promised to bring the ruling to municipalities' attention via a circular letter while declining to draft a ban on outsourcing.

I will bring the ruling of the Centrale Raad van Beroep and its consequences, as well as the options offered by the IBF for cross-border fraud, to the attention of municipalities via the circular letter.

Ik zal de uitspraak van de Centrale Raad van Beroep (CRvB) en de gevolgen hiervan alsmede de mogelijkheden die het IBF biedt bij grensoverschrijdende fraude, onder de aandacht brengen bij gemeenten via de verzamelbrief
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azarkan en Öztürk over het bericht dat in korte tijd vijf Turkse Nederlanders zijn vermoord

Two DENK MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that five Turkish-Dutch men were killed in a short period, including whether the cases might be linked to the NSU murders and whether a special police unit should be set up. The Minister acknowledged the reports, said victims' families were offered victim support, and said no suspect had yet been identified, so he could not share further details such as possible motives; he described the police capacity deployed as flexibly scaled per case.
The criminal investigation into these cases has not yet led to the identification of a suspect. For that reason I cannot make further statements, such as about possible motives of suspects.

Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar deze zaken heeft nog niet geleid tot identificatie van een verdachte. Om die reden kan ik geen verdere mededelingen doen, zoals over mogelijke motieven van verdachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het bericht dat de nieuwe terreurdreiging van rechts komt

An MP asked the ministers whether far-right extremist groups exist within the armed forces, whether the government downplays right-wing extremism, and how much capacity is devoted to countering it. The government answered that the MIVD investigates threats from extremists within defence, that right-wing extremism is addressed generically without separate capacity figures, and that the threat is not underestimated.
It is therefore not possible to provide an overview of deployed capacity or financial resources on extremism with a specific ideological background.
Het is daarom niet mogelijk om een overzicht te geven van ingezette capaciteit of financiële middelen op extremisme met een specifieke ideologische achtergrond.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Özturk over de uitspraak van de Reclame Code Commissie over de informatievoorziening van het ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over orgaandonatie

Two MPs asked the health minister how the ministry responded to a Reclame Code Commissie ruling that its organ donation information failed to explain the legal meaning of brain death and death, and why similar shortcomings persisted after an earlier ruling and a parliamentary motion. The minister answered that website, brochure and letter texts were supplemented with explanations of brain and heart death, that information is continuously updated, and that all texts will be externally reviewed and the Chamber informed of the outcome.
I will inform the Chamber of the outcomes.
Ik zal de Kamer van de uitkomsten op de hoogte te stellen.

DENK MPs asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about the damage from hurricane Irma on Sint Maarten, Saba and Sint Eustatius, Dutch support for reconstruction, and whether authorities were prepared. The minister answered that damage is still being assessed, reconstruction funding is not yet determined, and military assistance was prepositioned before the storm.
It is still too early to say how the Dutch government will support the reconstruction of buildings and infrastructure on the islands and how much funding the government will allocate.

Het is nu nog te vroeg om aan te geven op welke wijze de Nederlandse overheid de wederopbouw van de gebouwen en de infrastructuur op de eilanden gaat ondersteunen en hoeveel middelen de regering hiervoor vrijmaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het bericht dat twee Rotterdamse studenten na aankomst in Amerika geweigerd zijn om het land te betreden

MPs asked whether the government would press the US after two Dutch students were refused entry and sent back, allegedly on religious grounds, and whether they would be assisted. The minister replied that no consular request was received, the ministry had no contact with US authorities, the US is sovereign in border decisions, no travel advice change is needed, and the ministry cannot help with damage claims.
The United States, like all other countries, subject to its international legal obligations, is sovereign in deciding who it admits to its territory.
De Verenigde Staten zijn, net als alle andere landen, met inachtneming van hun internationaalrechtelijke verplichtingen, soeverein in het bepalen wie zij toelaten tot hun grondgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het bericht dat de Gemeenteraad in Leiden in actie komt tegen de verschraling van de lokale journalistiek

An MP asked the Dutch government about the decline of local and regional journalism and whether municipalities or the national government should fund it, and how this affects local democratic oversight. The government answered that local media play an important role in oversight, pointed to financial pressure on local public broadcasters, mentioned a structural funding line, a guide for councillors and a forthcoming research outline, and said municipalities are responsible for funding local public media.
The importance of these roles only increases with the decentralisations in the social domain and the transfer of over €10 billion to the Municipal Fund.
Het belang van deze rollen neemt met de decentralisaties in het sociaal domein en de overheveling van ruim € 10 miljard naar het Gemeentefonds, alleen maar toe.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Öztürk, Azarkan en Kuzu over hoe de vrijheid van meningsuiting, de vrijheid van demonstratie en de vrijheid van vereniging zich verhouden tot de openbare orde

MPs Öztürk, Azarkan and Kuzu asked how freedom of expression, assembly and association relate to public order, including the bans on Eritrean and Turkish-minister-linked events, the Rotterdam police handling, and the expulsion of a Turkish minister. The government defended the mayors' powers under the Wet openbare manifestaties, declined to assess the mayors' conduct against human rights treaties (leaving that to courts), and said it could not judge mayoral decisions that fall to municipal councils.
It is for the court to form a judgement on that, if and insofar as such legal questions are submitted to a court in any procedure.
Het is aan de rechter om zich daarover een oordeel te vormen indien en voor zover aan de rechter in enigerlei procedure dergelijke rechtsvragen worden voorgelegd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu, Azarkan en Öztürk over het bericht dat er voor de zoveelste keer wordt gediscrimineerd tijdens de sollicitatieprocedure

MPs Kuzu, Azarkan and Öztürk asked ministers about reported job-application discrimination, the College voor de Rechten van de Mens's ruling against Yacht B.V., how such rulings relate to prosecution, whether the College and OM have enough capacity, and whether government contracts and staffing agency oversight should be tightened. The government calls discrimination unacceptable, says the College's equal-treatment track is separate from criminal law, rejects expanding OM capacity and a licensing system for agencies, and points to a study on procurement exclusion and an added Inspectie SZW budget.
On the question of a licensing system for the temporary staffing sector, I am focusing on improving public-private cooperation within the Stichting Normering Arbeid quality mark.
Ten aanzien van de vraag over een vergunningstelsel voor de uitzendbranche zet ik in op verbetering van de publiekprivate samenwerking in het kader van het keurmerk van de Stichting Normering Arbeid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Öztürk en Azarkan over het bericht dat de Algemene Rekenkamer het kabinet steeds minder goed kan controleren

MPs Öztürk and Azarkan asked whether budget cuts threaten the Algemene Rekenkamer's ability to check the executive, including financial functions in ministries and other Hoge Colleges van Staat. The minister replied that the colleges manage their own budgets under agreements, that finance capacity has fallen about 30% since 2009 with programmes to strengthen it, and that no current review of ministry finance departments is needed, while agreeing to a further analysis of the colleges' finances.
In the period 2009–2015 the capacity of the financial function fell by almost 30%.
In de periode 2009 – 2015 is de capaciteit van de financiële functie met bijna 30% afgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het feit dat voor de zoveelste keer een zelfmoord wordt gepleegd ten gevolge van sexting

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the ministers about a suicide linked to sexting and bullying, asking about school responsibility, investigation, victim support, internet providers, the Dutch Data Protection Authority budget, the Kindertelefoon, and legal action. The state secretary answered that school anti-bullying duties and sexting education exist, that a police investigation is ongoing, and that IP-address identification is increasingly unreliable, while stating that bullying itself is not a crime.
The police are currently investigating this case both online and offline.
De politie is op dit moment zowel online als offline bezig met een onderzoek naar deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het bericht '15-jarige scholier pleegt zelfmoord na pesterijen'

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked ministers how the government will act on bullying after a 15-year-old pupil took her life, including whether an independent investigation will be launched and what is done to prevent bullying. The state secretary answers that school-safety law, inspection oversight and an ongoing joint inspectorate review are in place, that an independent review into the authorities' conduct is underway, and that specific national suicide-by-bullying figures are not available.
Under the banner of the Social Domain Supervision/Joint Youth Supervision (TSD/STJ), a preliminary investigation is currently taking place.
Onder de vlag van het Toezicht Sociaal Domein/Samenwerkend Toezicht Jeugd (TSD/STJ) vindt momenteel een vooronderzoek plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het bericht dat het leven van een politieagent aan diggelen

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a press report on a police officer whose reputation was damaged after being wrongly suspected of breaching confidentiality, and about lessons learned, aftercare, and possible action. The minister confirmed the officer was wrongly treated as a suspect, said the investigation was justified and within legal bounds, declined to comment on the prosecution of the complaint or on individual cases, and refused an inquiry into media publication.
The Public Prosecution Service has taken note of the police officer's complaint. Given the stage the handling of this complaint is at, no further statements can be made about it.

Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft kennisgenomen van de aangifte van de betreffende agent. Gelet op de fase waarin de behandeling van deze aangifte zich bevindt, kunnen hier verder geen mededelingen over worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het bericht dat drie moskeeën zijn aangevallen

An MP asked ministers about reports that three mosques were attacked, the security of Islamic buildings, the rise in anti-Muslim incidents and whether protection should match that for Jewish sites. The government answered that violence against mosques is unacceptable, that compensation would be sought through civil or criminal channels, that no generic preventive measures are advised at present, and that an anti-discrimination action programme and a working group on mosque security are in place.
Violence against Muslims and mosques is unacceptable.
Geweld tegen moslims en moskeeën is onacceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het bericht dat dat de Kinderombudsman wordt bedreigd vanwege haar mening over Zwarte Piet

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the government about reports that the Children's Ombudsman was threatened over her views on Zwarte Piet, and about discrimination children experience and whether the tradition breaches the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child. The government condemned the threats, said security measures are taken when needed without detailing them, declined to take a cabinet position on Zwarte Piet, and offered facilitation of dialogue plus a planned new research study.
However, I cannot provide information about the content of any security measures.
Ik kan echter geen informatie verstrekken over inhoud van eventuele beveiligingsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Servaes, Van Bommel, Voordewind, Grashoff, Thieme en Öztürk over deelname aan onderhandelingen over een internationaal verbod op kernwapens

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands opposed paragraph 67 of the OEWG report recommending negotiations on a nuclear weapons ban, whether it would support the UNGA resolution to negotiate such a ban in 2017, and whether it would take part in the conference. The answer refers to a separate letter ('Onderhandelingen over een internationaal verbod op kernwapens') rather than answering the questions in this document.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het bericht dat islamitische slachthuizen tijdens het Offerfeest een slachtverbod opgelegd hebben gekregen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the NVWA imposed bans on unstunned cattle slaughter at Islamic abattoirs just before Eid al-Adha, whether this breaches the 2012 convenant, and about expertise and fines. The State Secretary answered that NVWA inspections found shortcomings, that abattoirs were given time to fix them, that the NVWA acted within law, and that any sanctions are still being assessed.
The NVWA's conduct is in line with the applicable laws and regulations.
Het optreden van de NVWA is conform de geldende wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het bericht dat PowNed Onno Hoes een schadevergoeding moet betalen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about a court ruling ordering PowNed to pay damages to Onno Hoes, including whether public money would be used and whether PowNed's leadership should be held liable. The State Secretary declined to judge the court's ruling, noted that appeal and a damages procedure remain open, said PowNed is insured, and stated that liability of its directors is not his matter.
The court has ruled on the matter and I cannot and will not comment on or pass judgment on that ruling, especially since an appeal is still open against it.
De rechter heeft zich erover gebogen en ik kan en wil niet treden in zijn oordeel of dat oordeel van commentaar voorzien, temeer omdat tegen de uitspraak nog hoger beroep open staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over mogelijk etnisch profileren van ondernemers

An MP asks several ministers whether inspection and licensing bodies may be ethnically profiling entrepreneurs through risk models, large joint enforcement teams and the 'slecht levensgedrag' licence criterion. The minister answers that ethnicity is not a selection variable, that the government opposes profiling and points to existing measures, but declines to provide lists, case-level quickscans or a fundamental investigation, pointing to municipal responsibility.
No, a list of fined companies alone cannot support any conclusion about how companies are selected.
Nee, uit alleen een overzicht van beboete bedrijven valt geen conclusie te trekken over de selectie van bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het bericht dat de subsidie-imam angst zaait

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the Expertise Unit Social Stability (ESS): planned staffing and budget, the 2015 external contracts and how they were awarded, selection of staff and network partners, and the training and advice given. The minister answers in detail on staffing (20 FTE for 2017-2019), budget breakdown (about EUR 2.1 million), the list of 59 municipalities, contracts totalling about EUR 180,000 awarded without public tender, and declines to name individual officials or network members.
I cannot make statements about individual civil servants.
Over individuele ambtenaren kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over de racistische en discriminatoire gebeurtenissen in de weken 22 en 23

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the government about racist incidents in Geesteren and elsewhere, victim support, police reporting practices, specialisation in discrimination cases, rising racist violence, and non-implementation of ECRI recommendations. The Minister said victim support follows standard procedure, the motorcop case is under investigation so no comment is possible, police reporting uses a multichannel approach, discrimination training is being strengthened, and the ECRI recommendations are partly addressed through the National Action Programme with a progress report due January 2017.
This case is currently being investigated. While the investigation is ongoing, I cannot make any statements about it.
Deze zaak wordt momenteel onderzocht. Lopende het onderzoek kan ik hier geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over een racistische aanval in Zwolle

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the government about a racist attack in Zwolle, victim support, rising racist violence, stronger penalties such as an educational sentence for discrimination, police specialisation in discrimination complaints, and budgets for combating discrimination and radicalisation. The government replied that victim support follows the regular procedure, existing sentencing options suffice, police already have discrimination contact persons, and gave the budget figures, but declined to answer the questions before the plenary debate.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het bericht dat volksvertegenwoordigers worden bedreigd

An MP asked the government how it responds to reports that elected officials are being threatened, whether figures show a trend, what protective and preventive measures exist, and how threats are prosecuted. The minister answered that threats are unacceptable, that reported incidents fell from 38% to 23% of local officials between 2012 and 2014, that a new monitor is pending, and that existing measures and prosecution practice are sufficient.
It cannot be clearly established what the effectiveness of these measures and instruments is individually.
Het is niet eenduidig vast te stellen wat de effectiviteit van deze maatregelen en instrumenten afzonderlijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het bericht dat de subsidie-imam angst zaait

MPs Öztürk asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Justice about a subsidised imam's warnings of an imminent attack in Amsterdam and about government funding of his organisations and of the Expertise-unit Sociale Stabiliteit (ESS). The minister declined to discuss the imam's motives, said police and the municipality saw no new information, and described ESS budget, projects, and hiring procedures, stating that some organisations receive subsidies or contracts.
I will not go further into individual contract awards here.
Ik ga hier verder niet in op individuele opdrachtverleningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over de schokkende uitspraken van een Gemeenteraadslid in Den Haag

An MP asked the Interior Minister to respond to a Hague councillor's statement that Islam may be wiped out, asking whether the minister condemns it, whether the councillor should resign or be removed, and whether PVV representatives' statements should be analysed. The minister replied that free speech is protected, that the councillor's removal is not within his power under the Kieswet, that whether the statements constitute a crime is for the courts, and that other matters are for the mayor or individuals.
There is no power on my part to dismiss the councillor from her position.
Van enige bevoegdheid mijnerzijds het betreffende raadslid uit haar functie te ontheffen, is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over de erkenning van non-EU rijbewijzen en certificaten in de sector transport en logistiek

An MP asks why Turkish truck driver licences and certificates are not recognised in the Netherlands, whether they can be exchanged, and whether this harms the transport sector's labour shortage. The ministers explain that non-EU licences are recognised only for temporary driving, that exchange requires a bilateral agreement, and that there is currently sufficient EU driver supply, and they decline to add the issue to the transport sector plan.
Turkish driving licences cannot be exchanged in the Netherlands for a Dutch driving licence.
Turkse rijbewijzen kunnen in Nederland niet omgewisseld worden tegen een Nederlands rijbewijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over dat de politie te weinig leert van klachten die worden ingediend door burgers

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the Justice Minister why nearly 3,000 of 10,898 citizen complaints against police in 2014 were not handled and why the police learn too little from complaints. The minister explains many unhandled complaints were misdirected or registered as received, points to measures already taken, and declines further investigation or an apology.
There can be various reasons why a complaint was not taken up in the complaints procedure or is still open at year-end.
Er kunnen diverse redenen zijn waarom een klacht niet in de klachtenprocedure in behandeling is genomen of aan het eind van het jaar nog open staat voor behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over Russische bombardementen op Turkmeense minderheden in Syrië

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Turkmen in Syria fled after Russian bombings, and about condemnation, EU/NATO/UN action, aid, casualty figures, and the Geneva talks. The minister answered that the government has repeatedly condemned Russian attacks on the moderate opposition, supports UN resolution 2254, provides humanitarian aid regardless of ethnicity, and cannot independently verify casualty figures, while withholding details on supported groups for security reasons.
For security reasons, the specific fate of the groups supported by the Netherlands cannot be addressed.
Uit veiligheidsoverwegingen kan niet worden ingegaan op de specifieke lotgevallen van de groeperingen die door Nederland worden gesteund.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk inzake het bericht dat een presentatrice is gediscrimineerd bij RTL Nieuws

Deputies Kuzu and Öztürk asked about reports that a RTL Nieuws presenter was discriminated against, and about diversity and representativeness in Dutch media and the public broadcaster NPO. The Secretary of State said RTL denies discrimination, that media diversity is ultimately the responsibility of broadcasters, that data limits exist due to privacy rules, and that he will urge media organisations and the NPO to improve diversity without committing to binding action.
It is unacceptable if someone is treated differently on the basis of their skin colour than another person.
Het is onacceptabel als iemand op basis van zijn/haar huidskleur op een andere manier wordt behandeld dan een ander persoon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het bericht ‘In Nederland dreigt nieuwe onderklasse van vluchtelingen te ontstaan’

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the government how it will prevent a new underclass of refugees, including waiting times, early language and labour-market preparation, and allowing work or study during the asylum procedure. The minister replies by pointing to existing letters on integration, early language courses, and an expanded pre-integration programme, without committing to new measures such as working during the procedure.
Are you willing, for the integration of newcomers, to let asylum migrants work and study already during their procedure?
Bent u bereid, ten behoeve van de integratie van de nieuwkomers, asielmigranten al tijdens hun procedure te laten werken en studeren?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Nijkerken-de Haan en Öztürk over de keuringen beperkt houdbare producten die via Maastricht Aachen Airport (MAA) ons land binnen komen in Zuid-Limburg

MPs asked why perishable goods imported via Maastricht Aachen Airport must be tested at a single NVWA laboratory in Wageningen, why more labs are not certified, and whether the long turnaround times disadvantage the airport compared with Germany and Belgium. The government confirmed the Wageningen lab handles high-risk non-EU produce under EU rules, and said an ongoing MAR-L study of laboratory procedures and tariffs will report by year end.
The results of this study are expected to be ready by the end of this year.
Naar verwachting zijn de resultaten van dit onderzoek eind dit jaar gereed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over de schokkende uitspraken op Twitter van een persoon die werkzaam is bij een onderwijsinstelling

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked ministers about a discriminatory tweet by a school employee, rising internet discrimination reports, and whether a racism register, educational measure, and stronger reporting channel would be introduced. The government answered that online speech is protected within legal limits, cited rising MiND reports, announced an expert meeting with platforms and promised to report results in the budget debate, but rejected a racism register and a new educational measure.
I am not in favour of a separate racism register as advocated by MPs Kuzu and Öztürk.
Ik ben geen voorstander van een apart racismeregister zoals dat wordt voorgestaan door de leden Kuzu en Öztürk
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk naar aanleiding van de uitzending van Medialogica Motivaction

MPs Öztürk and others asked Minister Asscher how the Motivaction survey on Turkish-Dutch youth was published by FORUM, who had access beforehand, and whether his interview with NU.nl fuelled a hype and stigmatisation. The minister denied orchestrating the publication, said the survey was flawed and regretted its effects, but refused an external inquiry and any apology, and rejected the claim that he had sought to shape the debate.
An external investigation therefore does not seem useful to me.
Een extern onderzoek vind ik daarom niet zinvol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over sociale uitkeringen voor Nederlanders woonachtig in illegale nederzettingen in bezet Palestijns gebied

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked whether the government will apply the Wet BEU consistently to Dutch residents of Israeli settlements in occupied Palestinian territory, in line with 2002 policy, and whether the SVB's position on the territories is correct. The government answered that the new AOW policy is consistent with the 2002 position: current recipients keep the single-person AOW up to 70% of the minimum wage, while from 1 January 2016 new single recipients in occupied areas receive the married-person norm of 50%.
This decision will be published and communicated as soon as possible.
Dit besluit zal zo spoedig mogelijk worden bekendgemaakt en gecommuniceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over de vermeende Sharia-driehoek in de Schilderswijk in Den Haag

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the alleged 'Sharia triangle' in The Hague's Schilderswijk, a 2013 Trouw story later found fabricated, and about stigmatisation of the neighbourhood and hate letters to residents. The minister says the article was false and Trouw dismissed the journalist, but sees no need for new measures beyond existing integration policy.
I see no need to take additional measures, but will instead continue to work on implementing existing initiatives and actions.
Ik zie geen noodzaak om extra maatregelen te nemen, maar zal mij juist in blijven zetten voor de uitvoering van bestaande initiatieven en acties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over "screening door de SVB van ouderen met een Turkse achtergrond op buitenlandse bezittingen"

MP Öztürk asked whether the SVB's assets-abroad checks on AIO recipients, which since 2013 include people with Turkish background, amount to discriminatory screening, and asked about costs, cross-border investigation methods, and privacy safeguards. The State Secretary answered that all AIO recipients are checked in rotating annual batches by country of origin, that the checks are lawful and cost-effective, that no commercial parties are used, and that no discrimination is involved.
I see no conflict with Article 1 of the Constitution.
Ik zie geen strijd met artikel 1 van de Grondwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over de discriminerende uitspraak van de burgemeester van Gilze-Rijen

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked whether the mayor of Gilze-Rijen, who made discriminatory remarks about the Turkish-Dutch community, should be sanctioned or should step down. The minister defended the mayor's crime-fighting role, noted the mayor apologised and that the dialogue was resumed, and saw no reason for intervention, saying the mayor is accountable to the municipal council.
I see no reason for further intervention regarding the mayor's position.
Ik zie geen reden tot een nadere interventie met betrekking tot de positie van de burgemeester.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het steeds moeilijker worden van het bouwen van moskeeën

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether it is becoming harder to build mosques, whether parking concerns should block them, and whether political climate and fear of Islam drive opposition. The minister answers that objections are a legal right decided by municipalities, that freedom of religion covers worship in any building, and that existing anti-discrimination initiatives suffice without new measures.
I see no need to take additional measures, but rather want to continue working on implementing existing initiatives and actions.
Ik zie geen noodzaak om extra maatregelen te nemen, maar wil mij juist in blijven zetten voor de uitvoering van bestaande initiatieven en acties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het onderzoek ‘Nederland en de islam: onbegrepen en moeizaam’

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the minister about an EO survey finding widespread lack of contact with Muslims, perceived threat and negative views, and what government will do about Islamophobia and integration. The minister answered that the EO poll's robustness is unclear, pointed to the SCP and SIM research and to anti-discrimination initiatives, and gave Eurobarometer comparisons while denying integration policy has failed.
There is no insight into the robustness of the results of the survey conducted by the EO.
Er is geen zicht op de robuustheid van de resultaten van de peiling die is uitgevoerd door de EO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over de stelselmatig onzorgvuldige manier van onderzoek doen door BING (Bureau Integriteit Nederlandse Gemeenten)

An MP asked the Interior Minister about alleged careless integrity investigations by the private firm BING, which has been sanctioned by the disciplinary court, and about its monopoly-like position with local governments, compensation, regulation and ex-politicians working there. The minister answered that BING is a private company responsible for its own conduct, that municipalities choose and supervise investigators, that regulation is not warranted, and that the government has instead strengthened client guidance and set up an advisory point, while declining to provide several figures.
I do not have such data. These are matters that concern the local governments themselves.
Ik beschik niet over dergelijke gegevens. Dit zijn aangelegenheden die de lokale overheden zelf betreffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het dreigende ontslag van een militair wegens haar relatie met een Turk

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the Defence and Social Affairs ministers about a female soldier facing dismissal because of her relationship with a Turkish partner, whom the MIVD cannot screen. The Defence minister answered that a tailored solution can prevent dismissal, that the MIVD has done what is required, that the commander's view is weighed, and that personnel will receive more information on partner policy.

As I explained in my letter of 21 May, no list can be released of the countries with which the intelligence and security services have a cooperation relationship on the basis of which personal data are exchanged.

Zoals ik heb toegelicht in mijn brief van 21 mei jl., kan geen lijst worden vrijgegeven van landen met wie de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten een samenwerkingsrelatie hebben op basis waarvan persoonsgegevens worden uitgewisseld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over de vermeende Sharia-driehoek in de Schilderswijk in Den Haag

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the reported 'Sharia triangle' in The Hague's Schilderswijk, a Trouw article later shown to be fabricated, and whether the minister took action on it, restored trust, sought damages, or filed a complaint. The minister answers that the article only prompted integration-policy measures, that the neighbourhood's problems are real but separate from the article, that the media outlet itself must repair trust, and that a complaint filed against the journalist is being assessed by the prosecution service.
The Trouw article has undoubtedly reinforced the negative image of the Schilderswijk.
Het artikel in Trouw heeft de negatieve beeldvorming rond de Schilderwijk ongetwijfeld versterkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over de golf van incidenten jegens moskeeën

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the government about a wave of incidents against mosques, including threats, vandalism and arson, and about police registration of anti-Muslim discrimination, protection of mosques and prosecution. Minister Opstelten answered that the government condemns such attacks, will improve registration of Muslim discrimination and report on it separately, will take protective measures where threat warrants, and will apply prosecution policy with aggravated sentencing for discriminatory offences.
No public statement is made about information received from the intelligence and security services.
Over ontvangen informatie van inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten wordt in het openbaar geen uitspraak gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het bericht dat de rechter opnieuw heeft bepaald dat het korten van kinderbijslag onwettig is

Two MPs asked the ministers whether the government will keep litigating over the export-residence principle (woonlandbeginsel) after courts repeatedly ruled that cutting child benefit for children in Morocco is unlawful, and asked about legal costs, Moroccan project funding, and diplomatic fallout from terminating the social security treaty with Morocco. The minister answered that the law was passed by parliament, that the government respects rulings and continues litigation where needed for clarity, that legal costs are budgeted within structural implementation costs, that a Moroccan funding freeze is Morocco's own decision, and that the government will seek to revise the treaty and submit a termination approval bill to parliament.
Where it turns out that the export-residence principle cannot be applied, the cabinet has of course respected those rulings.
Waar blijkt dat woonlandbeginsel niet kan worden toegepast, heeft het kabinet deze uitspraken uiteraard gerespecteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over een extra drempel die Rabobank opwerpt voor mkb-ondernemers die krediet willen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Rabobank requiring an online questionnaire for SME credit applications up to 1 million euro, reduced personal contact, and why Dutch SME credit approval rates are far lower than Germany's. The minister replied that the digital option is an added service, that no clarification from Rabobank is needed, that credit refusals reflect weaker borrower positions and weaker economic conditions, and that a 400 million euro guarantee budget and action lines are being pursued.
As indicated in the answer to question 2, this is an additional service for entrepreneurs who prefer to work digitally, and there is no contradiction with Mr Draijer's statements.
Zoals in het antwoord op vraag 2 aangegeven betreft dit een extra service voor ondernemers die liever digitaal werken en is er geen tegenspraak met de uitspraken van de heer Draijer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Öztürk en Fokke over het betaalgedrag van gemeenten

Opposition MPs Öztürk and Fokke asked ministers about municipalities paying invoices late, despite the 30-day statutory term, and what the government would do. The minister acknowledged the Ombudsman's findings, said a public monitor on municipal payment terms will be set up with the VNG and KING, and declined to send a circular or to suspend Municipality Fund payments.
You will be informed about this by the end of October at the latest, as promised in the aforementioned letter.
U wordt hierover uiterlijk eind oktober geïnformeerd, zoals toegezegd in voornoemde brief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over de regeldruk in de kappersbranche en andere bedrijven in de ambachtseconomie

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about administrative burden in the hairdressing and craft sectors, including survey findings that regulation costs 5 to 8 percent of salon costs, and what the government would do about it. The minister acknowledged the burden, committed to discussing it with the branch association and reviewing the Bedrijfseffectentoets, and gave an overview of craft-sector data and support measures without committing to a dedicated new priority.
The cabinet sees reason in the above to discuss the underlying report with ANKO and to examine whether, and if so how, administrative burden in the hairdressing sector can be (noticeably) reduced.

Het kabinet ziet in het bovenstaande aanleiding om met ANKO over het onderliggende rapport in gesprek te gaan en te bekijken of en zo ja, op welke wijze de regeldruk in de kappersbranche (merkbaar) kan worden verminderd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Öztürk over de sluiting van vrachtwagenparkeerplaats Traffic Port in Venlo

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister why the free truck parking area Traffic Port in Venlo is being closed, given its use by 150 to 500 trucks daily, and how the resulting nuisance and unsafe situations will be prevented. The minister answered that the lease will not be renewed and no longer fits the SecureLane market-transition model, that about 100 alternative night-time spaces exist nearby with signposting from 1 April 2014, and that keeping the site open is not an option.
As I indicated in my answer to questions 1, 2 and 3, keeping TrafficPort open is not an option.
Zoals ik in mijn antwoord op de vragen 1 2 en 3 heb aangegeven is het openhouden van TrafficPort geen optie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Öztürk over het opnieuw aanscherpen van de kredietvoorwaarden voor MKB-ondernemers

An MP asks the Economic Affairs minister about banks tightening credit conditions for SMEs in 2013, including whether Basel III and profit motives explain it and what the government will do to make banks fulfil their social responsibility. The minister acknowledges the problem, attributes much of it to weak demand and higher risk, points to guarantee schemes and Qredits, and says he will keep talking with banks without committing to a concrete new step.
Contacts with the banks explicitly concern the functioning of banks given this two-sided social interest.
De contacten met de banken gaan nadrukkelijk over het functioneren van banken gegeven dit tweeledige maatschappelijke belang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Oztürk over de ontwikkeling van winkelruimte

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers about rising retail vacancy and whether municipalities should be restrained from developing new shop space, including whether the Ladder for sustainable urbanisation is applied and supervised. The minister acknowledged rising vacancy, said local tailoring and the ladder suffice, rejected intervention at a set vacancy level and new provincial instruments, and did not commission research on the ladder's application.
I will not restrict municipalities in the development possibilities included in existing zoning plans.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over ‘dreigende bezuinigingen bij de politie’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about looming police budget cuts, including a 19 million euro efficiency target, and whether the government's promise of no police cuts in 2024 holds. The minister answered that the police expect to absorb the 2024 target through one-off windfalls, that cuts may follow in later years under the 'kiezen op korpsniveau' process, and that the target is part of the government-wide budget cover.
In 2024 the police will not implement specific cost-cutting measures.
In 2024 zal de politie geen specifieke bezuinigingsmaatregelen doorvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht ‘Een nieuwe fase in de drugscriminaliteit’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about explosions at homes and business premises linked to drug-related gang violence, particularly in Groningen, and about police capacity and drug-use drivers. The Minister confirmed the figures, called the explosions unacceptable, pointed to structural factors in Groningen, said police capacity is under pressure nationwide, and described an integrated anti-drug-crime approach and prevention efforts, without answering questions on the specific incidents, which are under investigation.
The police and the Public Prosecution Service are investigating these incidents. It is not for me as Minister of Justice and Security to comment on these incidents.
Politie en OM onderzoeken deze incidenten. Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om in te gaan op deze incidenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Kuik over begeleiding van probleemjongeren door de krijgsmacht

CDA MPs Krul and Kuik asked whether the Landmacht's BBJ-KL programme for at-risk youth, with 240 participants and 28 becoming soldiers, is successful, and whether it should be improved, expanded, linked to Justice's Preventie met Gezag, or combined with work and education. The State Secretary for Defence answered that the programme is not a core Defence task but is partly successful (136 returned to school or work), that expansion is capped at 200 youths a year with no added staff, that municipalities can refer youths, and that cooperation with Justice is being considered while broader goals are rejected.
Municipalities can refer youths to this guidance programme.
Gemeenten kunnen jongeren voordragen voor dit begeleidingstraject.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Kuik en Bikker over het bericht dat influencers via Telegram slachtoffers voor duizenden euro’s oplichten door neppe sportuitslagen te helpen promoten

MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that influencers promote fake sports results on Telegram to defraud young people, and about the harms of matchfixing and gambling. The minister answered that the influencers are described as inciting followers to crimes, that fraud prevention campaigns and gambling-integrity rules are in place, that the online gambling law will be evaluated in 2024, and that further measures on advertising and responsible gambling are planned.
I am aware of the report about influencers who lure young people into the arms of fraudsters.
Ik ben bekend met het bericht over influencers die jongeren in de armen van oplichters lokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Slootweg over het bericht 'Telegram treedt niet effectief op tegen op grote schaal delen van contactgegevens en naaktfoto’s van vrouwen'

MPs Kuik and Slootweg (CDA) asked the Minister of Justice and Security how the government will act against Telegram's failure to curb mass sharing of women's contact details and nude photos in exposure groups, including whether police and prosecutors can block such groups, identify account holders, protect minors, and whether fines like Germany's should apply. The minister answered that the government takes it seriously, is pressing platforms via the DSA and other EU instruments and a public-private partnership, notes that identifying anonymous posters and acting against Telegram are hard legally and technically, and says Dutch law (WBAOKM) only covers child sexual abuse material.
The cabinet is increasing efforts to hold these parties to their responsibilities, partly through new legislative instruments.
Het kabinet verhoogt de inspanningen om deze partijen op hun verantwoordelijkheden te wijzen, deels met behulp van nieuwe wetgevende instrumenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Kuik over het bericht 'WhatsApp en Signal dreigen VK te verlaten vanwege breken encryptie' van AG Connect

MPs Slootweg and Kuik asked the State Secretary and Minister of Justice and Security about reports that WhatsApp and Signal might leave the UK over encryption-breaking provisions in the Online Safety Bill, and whether scanning messaging apps for child abuse material should outweigh encryption. The Minister answered that the UK bill is still pending, that the EU CSAM regulation is under negotiation, that the government supports no proposal making end-to-end encryption impossible in line with the Van Raan motion, and that client-side scanning is being considered within those limits.
The Netherlands does not support European proposals that make end-to-end encryption impossible, in line with the motion-Van Raan adopted by the House of Representatives.
Nederland steunt geen Europese voorstellen die end-to-end encryptie onmogelijk maken, in lijn met de door uw Kamer aangenomen motie-Van Raan c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Krul en Boswijk over de beveiliging van luchthaven Schiphol

Three CDA MPs asked ministers how Schiphol's access controls fail when former staff keep passes, uniforms and radios, and who is responsible for fixing this. The government calls the situation unacceptable, says Royal Schiphol Group and employers hold responsibility, and lists audits, sanctions and an automatic alarm as steps taken.
Royal Schiphol Group further intensifies supervision of correct implementation by carrying out random audits of employers.
Royal Schiphol Group intensiveert verder het toezicht op de correcte uitvoering door steekproefsgewijs audits uit te voeren op werkgevers
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Slootweg over het bericht aantal getroffen websites met ernstig kindermisbruik in twee jaar tijd verdubbeld

CDA MPs asked the Justice Minister about a report that websites with severe child sexual abuse material doubled in two years, and why many are hosted on Dutch servers, what measures will be taken, and how encryption affects detection. The minister agreed the trend is worrying, pointed to voluntary takedown codes and a planned regulator (ATKM) with enforcement powers, and said encrypted communication makes investigation difficult while promising continued cooperation with the sector.
No figures are known for 2022 on sanctioning websites.
Over 2022 zijn geen cijfers bekend van het sanctioneren van websites.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Boswijk over het bericht ‘Het geheim van Brabant: hoe criminelen azen op boerenstallen’

The CDA MPs Kuik and Boswijk asked whether the voluntary livestock buy-out scheme accounts for the risk that criminals use vacated farm buildings for drug production and whether farmers can be protected and helped. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that demolition obligations and supervision by municipalities limit this risk, that farmers can report suspected criminal use to the police, and that a national resilience approach and a possible 'flying brigade' for drug waste are being explored, with updates promised later this autumn.
Supervision of timely demolition of the production capacity lies with the municipalities, which are informed about who has applied for a subsidy.
Toezicht op tijdige sloop van de productiecapaciteit ligt bij gemeenten, die geïnformeerd worden over wie een subsidie heeft aangevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Van Nispen en Kuik over de handhaving van het aanstaande verbod op ongerichte reclame voor online kansspelen door de Kansspelautoriteit

MPs asked whether the Kansspelautoriteit's chair signalled soft enforcement of the upcoming ban on untargeted online gambling advertising, and whether the regulator should fine every breach. The minister replied that enforcement is the regulator's responsibility, that normative talks precede fines, that operators had enough preparation time, and declined to discuss the chair's statements with the regulator.
It is up to the Ksa to give further substance to how it supervises and enforces compliance with the advertising ban.
Het is aan de Ksa om nader invulling te geven aan de wijze waarop zij toezicht houdt en handhaaft op naleving van het reclameverbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de toename van het aantal jonge mensen dat een beroerte krijgt, mogelijk veroorzaakt door drugsgebruik

An MP asked the state secretary whether rising strokes among young adults may be linked to drug use and what policy and research follow. The government says the cause is unknown, sees no need for new research specifically on drugs and strokes, and declines to add drug use to a stroke-prevention study with ZonMw.
I see no need to commission new research into the link between drugs and strokes.
Ik zie geen noodzaak om een nieuw onderzoek naar het verband tussen drugs en beroertes uit te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over drugsgebruik in gevangenissen

Member Kuik (CDA) asked the Justice and Health ministers about suspected widespread Spice use in Ter Apel prison, its health risks and detectability, sanctions for smuggling, addiction care, and measures to stop smuggling. Minister Weerwind answered that smuggling and use are punishable, detection is difficult and under study with new technology, no confirmed Spice deaths are known, and DJI is expanding information and reviewing foreign approaches, though no additional mortality testing is planned.
In addition, DJI also focuses on prevention of use and information provision.
Daarnaast zet DJI ook in op preventie van gebruik en voorlichting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Kuik over het bericht 'Nieuwe Gerrit Krolbrug minimaal een jaar vertraagd, gemeente stuurt brandbrief naar minister'

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the reported one-year-plus delay to the new Gerrit Krol bridge in Groningen, the lack of a temporary crossing over the Van Starkenborgh canal, and related public trust, traffic and stikstof risks. The minister acknowledged the delay (opening pushed to 2029 at the latest), said a temporary crossing is expected by end 2023 after technical setbacks, and committed to a joint working group with residents and the municipality.
The expected opening of the new bridge now shifts unfortunately from 2026 to 2029 at the latest.
De verwachte openstelling van de nieuwe brug verschuift nu helaas van 2026 naar uiterlijk 2029.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Bikker over de uitzending van Het Misdaadbureau waarin wordt gesproken over het project 'Onder mijn Ogen' dat wordt gebruikt op een aantal mbo-scholen in Noord-Brabant

MPs Kuik and Bikker asked about a broadcast on the 'Onder mijn Ogen' game used at Brabant vocational schools to spot criminal exploitation, and about data, teacher training, reporting duties and prevention. The Minister answered that no national picture exists, that schools bear safety duties while lacking investigative tasks, that the game is being evaluated and may be funded one more year, and that a reporting duty for serious incidents is being prepared for 2025.
At present there is no (total) picture of the number of signals or of the way and extent to which pupils and students are recruited by criminals.
Op dit moment bestaat er geen (totaal)beeld van het aantal signalen of op welke manier en in welke omvang scholieren en studenten worden geronseld door criminelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg, Kuik en Van den Berg over het bericht 'The jury is still out'

CDA MPs asked the state secretaries about a report linking smartphone and social media use to worsening mental health among teenage girls, including Dutch data on depression, suicide and self-harm. The government answered that Dutch data are limited, that a causal link between social media and depression is not established, and listed prevention measures, platform engagement and a forthcoming child-protection policy letter.
There is no data available on self-harm among young people in the Netherlands.
Er is geen data beschikbaar over automutilatie onder jongeren in Nederland.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht ‘Weinig agenten en geen vertrouwen. Platteland van Groningen een snoepwinkel voor criminelen. Zelfs met een trekker ontsnap je makkelijk’’ en het bericht ‘Drughandel i

MP Kuik (CDA) asks the Justice Minister about reports of thin police presence and low trust in rural Groningen that let drug crime flourish, asking about deployment, reporting willingness, the Ommeland report and the Groningen enquiry follow-up. The minister answers that police distribution is a shared responsibility, reporting channels are open, several concrete measures (trust persons, regional reinforcement funding, Theseus project, international cooperation) are cited, and the enquiry response is still pending.
The cabinet will still respond to the report of the parliamentary enquiry committee on Groningen gas extraction.
Het kabinet komt nog met een reactie op het rapport van de enquêtecommissie aardgaswinning Groningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Kuik over het bericht ‘Social Media is a Major Cause of the Mental Illness Epidemic in Teen Girls. Here’s the Evidence'

MPs Slootweg and Kuik asked whether Dutch longitudinal studies exist on social media use and teen mental health, and how the government views the claim that social media is a major cause of depression and anxiety in teen girls. The government answered that no simple direct causal link has been established, listed Dutch longitudinal studies, outlined prevention and regulatory measures, and promised a broader policy letter.
As stated above, we do not yet see a scientific consensus on a simple and direct causal relationship between social media use and the development of depression and anxiety.
Zoals boven gesteld zien wij nog geen wetenschappelijke consensus over een eenvoudige en directe causale relatie tussen sociale mediagebruik en de ontwikkeling van depressie en angsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuijk over het bericht 'Overheidsinstanties hebben blinde vlek voor licht verstandelijke beperkten'

A CDA MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that authorities have a blind spot for young people with mild intellectual disabilities who are recruited for drug trafficking and prostitution, and what will be done about protection, data sharing and cooperation. The government acknowledges the problem, points to existing programmes (Preventie met Gezag, Samen tegen mensenhandel, a pilot online platform), promises a study on the scale of exploitation and an overview of information-sharing obstacles, but leaves most measures unspecified.
We will ask the Research and Documentation Centre to conduct research into this and will inform the House of Representatives about it.
