Wij zullen het Onderzoeks- en Documentatiecentrum vragen om hier onderzoek naar te doen, en zullen uw Kamer hierover informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Van den Berg en Kuik over de berichten ‘Groen licht voor euthanasie, maar Nathalie wil verkrachter eerst nog een keer in de ogen kijken’ en ‘Na loodzwaar traject kreeg ik ‘groen l

Three CDA MPs asked the health minister about press reports of euthanasia requests linked to sexual trauma, asking for data, whether society is failing victims, waiting times and treatment availability for trauma care. The minister answered that no national data on trauma-linked euthanasia requests exists, acknowledged the tragedy, pointed to the national action programme and the Integral Care Agreement, and gave waiting-time and PTSS treatment figures.
No, no data on this is collected at the national level.
Nee, hierover worden op landelijk niveau geen gegevens verzameld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Peters over het bericht ‘Mensenhandelaren actief bij azc, asielzoekers stappen in geblindeerde busjes: ‘Moderne slavernij’

MPs Kuik and Peters asked the State Secretary about press reports of human trafficking, exploitation and sexual approaches to minors around asylum reception centres, and what is being done to detect and prevent it. The State Secretary answered that COA, police and municipalities cooperate, that the police prioritise trafficking, that COA trains contact persons and visitor controls exist, and that he takes the signals seriously while disputing some reported facts.
I find it serious if concerned residents were no longer reporting because of a lack of action and fear of retaliation.
Ik vind het ernstig als bezorgde omwonenden geen aangifte meer zouden doen wegens een gebrek aan actie en de angst voor vergelding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht ‘Aboutaleb: ‘Jonge drugsuithaler is meer gebaat bij gedwongen opvang in gesloten instelling dan met een taakstraf’’

CDA MP Kuik asked the Justice Minister to respond to Rotterdam mayor Aboutaleb's call for closed-institution detention rather than community sentences for minors caught with drugs, and asked about prevention, prosecution numbers and recidivism. The ministers answered that youth courts already have a range of sanctions available, that a meta-analysis shows lower recidivism after community sentences, and that they see no need for further study of alternative sentences.
We therefore see no reason at this time to examine this further.
Wij zien dan ook nu geen aanleiding om dit nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht ‘Die snuivende zanger maakt drugsgebruik doodnormaal’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a public drug-use incident by a singer and how the government would counter the normalisation of drug use, including campaigns, event organisers and municipal permit conditions. The minister condemned the incident and described a targeted prevention strategy aimed at high-use groups, while leaving the broader public campaign and permit-based proposals largely to other actors and existing practice.
I call on event organisers to distribute this intervention among their members.
Ik roep evenementenorganisatoren op deze interventie te verspreiden onder hun achterban.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht ‘Gebruik lachgas ondanks verbod nog onbestraft’

The CDA MP Kuik asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the nationwide nitrous oxide (lachgas) ban that took effect on 1 January 2023 cannot yet be fully enforced, what practical bottlenecks exist, and what will be done to enable enforcement quickly. The Minister answers that police are already seizing nitrous oxide and enforcement is possible under local bylaws and other laws, but full uniform enforcement under the Opiumwet requires logistics and procedures to be completed, targeted for 1 July 2023, with a temporary transport exemption in place.

The Public Prosecution Service and the police are doing everything they can to have all logistical and procedural aspects ready by 1 July 2023, so that the nitrous oxide ban can then be enforced fully and uniformly.

Het Openbaar Ministerie en de politie doen er alles aan om op 1 juli 2023 alle logistieke en procesmatige aspecten gereed te hebben, zodat er dan volledig en uniform gehandhaafd wordt op het lachgasverbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht 'Regelwerk weerhoudt boeren van melden drugsafval: 'Er moet een vliegende brigade komen die het opruimen overneemt''

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that heavy regulation and costs deter farmers from reporting illegal drug waste dumped on their land, and proposed a 'flying brigade' to clear it. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to an expanded subsidy scheme and invoice-based checks, said the flying brigade idea would be discussed with partners, and promised a letter by May 2023.
No data are known on either the abstention from reporting or the relocation of drug waste.
Over zowel het afzien van meldingen als het verplaatsen van drugsafval zijn geen gegevens bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van der Staaij, Bikker en Kuik over het bericht ‘Hulpverleners zien alarmerende groei probleemgedrag met online gokken’

Three MPs (Van der Staaij, Bikker, Kuik) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports of rising gambling addiction after the online gambling market was opened, and about enforcement, the Cruks self-exclusion register, and the gambling advertising ban. The minister answered that reliable data are not yet available, promised a monitor with first results in autumn 2023, said the Kansspelautoriteit is investigating operators' duty of care and that stricter limits may follow, noted a Cruks redesign due April 2023, and said the advertising ban decision is being finalised after Council of State advice.
That is why I want to monitor developments over a longer period to strengthen the information position and to be able to form a reliable picture.
Daarom wil ik de ontwikkelingen over een langere tijd monitoren om de informatiepositie te versterken en een betrouwbaar beeld te kunnen vormen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Knops over de toenemende georganiseerde criminaliteit in Limburg

Two CDA MPs asked the Justice Minister about rising organised crime in Limburg, including the police and prosecution capacity gap, the imbalance in international legal assistance requests, and cross-border cooperation. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to added funding for the regional approach, cross-border agreements and EU cooperation, and said more concrete steps were still being developed.
I am monitoring progress and expect to have a better view of the measures during the course of the year.
Ik hou de voortgang in de gaten en verwacht in de loop van het jaar beter zicht op de maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de uitbuiting van minderjarigen op YouTube

An MP asks the Justice Minister about exploitation of minors on YouTube, including sexualised thumbnails and a lack of oversight. The minister says such content is unacceptable, points to YouTube's community rules, criminal law, reporting channels and upcoming EU rules (Digital Services Act) and a planned Autoriteit, but offers no new oversight powers now.
I find it a worrying development that there are influencers who apparently are willing to push the boundaries of what is permissible.
Ik vind het een zorgelijke ontwikkeling dat er influencers zijn die blijkbaar bereid zijn de grenzen van het toelaatbare op te zoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de aanpak van criminele families

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the approach to criminal families, following reports that many drug suspects had relatives also suspected of drug offences, and asked about causes, definitions, prevention, a Tilburg coaching initiative and information sharing between RIECs and Zorg- en Veiligheidshuizen. The minister answered that the problem requires tailored, integrated, preventive action, described existing programmes and a pilot with Leger des Heils, and said an information-sharing framework is being concretised.
That is therefore not for me to determine.
Het is daarom niet aan mij om dit te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Agnes Mulder over ‘Zwarte Russen’ in Oekraïne: Afrikanen geronseld door Wagner en Russisch leger’

Two CDA MPs asked the minister about reports of Wagner recruiting convicted murderers and sex offenders from prisons in Russia and Africa, sexual violence by Russian forces in occupied Ukraine, aid for victims, and diplomatic responses. The government acknowledged signs of widespread sexual violence, noted under-reporting, described Dutch funding to UNFPA and humanitarian organisations, and said it lacks its own data on the recruited prisoners and sees no legal ban on recruiting convicts, while pointing to general EU and UN capacity programmes.
The cabinet has no independent information on the precise number of prisoners convicted of murder and sex offences recruited by the Wagner Group for the Russian army.

Het kabinet heeft geen eigenstandige informatie over de precieze omvang van de groep voor moord en zedenmisdrijven veroordeelde gevangenen die door de Wagner Groep zijn gerekruteerd voor het Russische leger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht ‘Tilburg verliest strijd tegen drugsindustrie’, is alarmerende boodschap van 35 professionals’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a report by 35 Tilburg professionals saying the fight against drug-related undermining crime is failing and that existing structures are not effective enough to keep youth from drug crime. The minister agreed on the need for prevention, acknowledged information-sharing and funding bottlenecks, and said a letter on the Michon-Derkzen motion follows in spring 2023, while rejecting a national publicity campaign.
That is why I, together with the Minister for Legal Protection, am investing heavily in a broad prevention approach to (organised and undermining) youth crime.
Daarom investeer ik, samen met de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming, fors in een brede preventieaanpak voor (georganiseerde en ondermijnende) jeugdcriminaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Mohandis en Bikker over het uitgesteld betalen bij het online afrekenen van alcoholische dranken

MPs Kuik, Mohandis and Bikker asked whether online alcohol shops offering buy-now-pay-later payment undermine the Alcohol Act and encourage overconsumption, and whether the state will stop or ban it. The state secretary agrees with the concerns, notes that the Alcohol Act still applies, says some shops are already exploring alternatives, and will examine legal measures if shops do not stop.
If the liquor stores do not stop, I am willing to examine legal measures and discuss this with my colleagues in the cabinet.
Als slijterijen niet stoppen, dan ben ik bereid om wettelijke maatregelen te onderzoeken en hierover in gesprek te gaan met mijn collega’s binnen het kabinet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Pouw-Verweij, Van der Staaij, Bevers, Van der Plas, Den Haan, Hijink en Kuik over het bericht ‘Openbaar Ministerie wil tien mensen vervolgen voor verstrekking 'Middel X'

MPs from several parties asked the Justice and Health ministers about prosecutions over the supply of suicide-enabling substance 'Middel X' linked to the Coöperatie Laatste Wil, and about prevention, victim research, and whether the criminal law or chemical sales rules should be tightened. The government said ten people are being considered for prosecution, that voluntary industry measures remain in place with no new substances found, that regulation by law is complex and of limited effect, and that research on victims and support for bereaved families is underway, while declining to comment on the ongoing criminal case or the adequacy of current law.
As long as the criminal case is ongoing, it is also not appropriate for me to give a judgement on the current legal framework.
Zolang de strafzaak loopt past het mij evenmin om een oordeel te geven over het huidige wettelijke kader.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Bikker en Verkuijlen over het bericht 'Centrum tegen Kinderhandel slaat alarm: 'Pa of ma soms pooier eigen kind''

MPs Kuik, Bikker and Verkuijlen asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a report by the Centre against Child Trafficking (CKM) showing rising, younger victims of exploitation, some exploited by their own parents, and whether official data and support reach them. The State Secretary acknowledges the concern, notes that registered figures underestimate true victim numbers, and promises further talks with partners, a 2023 follow-up on the Samen tegen Mensenhandel programme and a research and reporting process.

I will discuss the research results with the CKM/Fier and other relevant chain partners, such as other victim organisations, the police and the Public Prosecution Service, to interpret each other's information further and reach appropriate follow-up steps together.

Ik zal met het CKM/Fier en andere betrokken ketenpartners, zoals andere slachtofferpartijen, politie en OM, in gesprek gaan over de onderzoeksresultaten om elkaars informatie nader te duiden en samen tot passende vervolgstappen te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Kuik over het bericht “De meest gehate sites ter wereld, in de lucht via Flevoland”

MPs Bontenbal and Kuik asked whether Dutch hosting firms facilitate hate-speech and child-abuse websites such as 8kun and Daily Stormer, and what the government can do. The minister answers that hosts must act on known illegal content, that the ATKM will cover terrorist and child-abuse material while online hate speech remains outside its scope, and that an interdepartmental inventory on hate speech is underway.
There is no legal framework for supervising the content hosted in the Netherlands.
Er bestaat geen wettelijk kader voor toezicht op de content die in Nederland wordt gehost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik inzake het bericht ‘zelfs camera’s schrikken drugscriminelen niet af’

MP Kuik asked the Minister of Justice and Security about press reports that at least 25 Dutch nationals, including a 15-year-old, were arrested over shootings in Antwerp linked to drug crime, and about cooperation, a national drug coordinator and camera surveillance. The minister could not confirm the arrest figures, said cooperation with Belgium works well and is being strengthened, and described existing measures, including prevention, a sealing power for mayors and a broader anti-organised-crime approach.
No statements can be made about ongoing cases.
Er kunnen geen uitspraken worden gedaan met betrekking tot lopende zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de golf aan explosies en toename van (zelfgemaakte) explosieven

An MP asks the Justice Minister about the ease of buying explosive precursors, the rise in homemade explosives, and low arrest and conviction rates for explosive attacks. The minister says precursor rules apply and are being tightened with industry, a new awareness campaign is planned for early 2023, and it cannot verify the arrest and conviction figures because they are not recorded separately.
The police and Public Prosecution Service systems do not separately register this kind of information.
In de systemen van de politie en het Openbaar Ministerie wordt dit soort informatie niet apart geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht dat één op de vijf Rotterdamse jongeren een wapen heeft of wel eens draagt

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that one in five Rotterdam youths carries or has a weapon, asking about normalisation, trends, causes of insecurity and the knife-sales ban. The minister answered that weapon carrying is not normal, pointed to the Wapens en Jongeren action plan, police data showing stabilising stabbing suspect numbers, and an evaluation due in early 2023.
At the beginning of 2023 a decision will be taken on continuing the approach.
Begin 2023 wordt er een besluit genomen over de voortzetting van de aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Kuik over het bericht ‘Amalia in vizier Mocro-maffia’

CDA MPs Knops and Kuik asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a newspaper report that criminal networks were targeting Princess Amalia, and about alleged undermining of the rule of law in the Extra Beveiligde Inrichting (EBI). The minister acknowledged the report, said the government is taking far-reaching steps against organised crime in detention, including a planned bill for stronger individual restrictions on the most dangerous detainees and tighter EBI contact rules, while describing Italy's 41bis regime as not involving strict isolation.
I expect to submit this bill to your House in the first quarter of 2023.
Ik verwacht dit wetsvoorstel in het eerste kwartaal van 2023 bij uw Kamer in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht ‘Amalia in vizier Mocro-maffia’

MP Kuik (CDA) asked the Justice Minister how the government will respond to reported threats from criminal networks inside high-security detention, including contact between top criminals in the EBI and Italy's 41bis model. Minister Weerwind answers that the government is taking strong measures: a bill to impose individual restrictions on the most dangerous detainees is due in Q1 2023, EBI call and visit limits are being tightened, and a second EBI is being built, though he does not address the Italian ruling in depth.

That is why I am currently working urgently on a bill that would allow me to impose stronger and further restrictions on the most serious criminals on an individual level than is currently possible under the Penitentiary Principles Act.

Daarom werk ik momenteel met spoed aan een wetsvoorstel waarmee ik aan de meest zware criminelen op individueel niveau sterkere en nog verdergaande beperkingen kan opleggen dan nu onder Penitentiaire beginselenwet mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Bikker over wettelijke maatregelen om de kans op gehoorschade te beperken

Two MPs asked the state secretary for health about legal measures to limit hearing damage, including whether the voluntary prevention convenant should become a statutory duty of care and how to enforce volume limiters on earpods. The state secretary declined to pre-empt the Health Council's advice, said the convenant will be extended by a year and that more sectors should join, and said the NVWA will further investigate earpod risks.
I have asked the Health Council to advise on possible further measures that could be taken in the context of preventing hearing damage.
Ik heb de Gezondheidsraad gevraagd om te adviseren over mogelijke verdere maatregelen die genomen kunnen worden in het kader van de preventie van gehoorschade.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de verplichte asielopvang in Tubbergen

MP Kuik (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security why the Albergen hotel was chosen for mandatory asylum reception in Tubbergen, how municipal consultation was handled, and how trust with the municipality can be restored. The State Secretary answered that the hotel was offered to the COA, that talks with Tubbergen took place from April to June without agreement on asylum seekers, and that the government intends to use the RO-instrument if needed while pledging continued dialogue.
Granting a permit by the government through the so-called RO-instrument is a measure that is far from ideal in many respects.
Het verlenen van een vergunning door de overheid door middel van het zogenaamde RO-instrumentarium is een maatregel die in vele opzichten verre van ideaal is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Bikker over het bericht 'Gevaar loert voor Oekraïense vluchtelingen: 'Prostitutie, gedwongen adoptie en uitbuiting''

MPs Kuik (CDA) and Bikker (ChristenUnie) asked how Ukrainian refugees are protected against exploitation, trafficking, and unclear coordination of private reception, and whether a reception ambassador is needed. The State Secretary answered that the government works with partners on awareness, flyers, EMPACT information sharing, and a new reception organisation, while noting dozens of registered incidents and one investigation, with no trafficking found in controls.

The cabinet works with various chain partners, such as civil society organisations (including the Red Cross and the Salvation Army) and churches, to make displaced persons from Ukraine aware of the risks of exploitation when staying with private individuals.

Het kabinet zet zich met de verschillende ketenpartners, zoals maatschappelijke organisaties (zoals het Rode Kruis en het Leger des Heils) en kerken in om ontheemden uit Oekraïne bewust te maken van de risico's op uitbuiting als ze bij particulieren gaan verblijven.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht ‘Save the Children waarschuwt Repatriëring buitenlandse kinderen uit Syrische kampen kan nog wel 30 jaar duren’ en n.a.v. het Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland van a

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that repatriating foreign children from Syrian camps could take 30 years, the threat to national security, support in the camps, education, and how repatriated children are cared for. The government answered that the children are victims of their parents' choices, that repatriation is weighed case by case with security and foreign-relations considerations, and it described humanitarian aid, EU cooperation and the child-protection process without committing to new concrete steps.

If a situation arises in which the cabinet concludes that efforts must be made to transfer suspects to the Netherlands for prosecution because impunity threatens, the House will be informed in advance, in line with the Laan-Geselschap motion.

Als zich een situatie voordoet waarin het kabinet tot het oordeel komt dat een inspanning geleverd moet worden om verdachten ter berechting naar Nederland over te brengen, omdat straffeloosheid dreigt, wordt uw Kamer hierover conform de motie Laan-Geselschap voorafgaand geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van den Berg en Bikker over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars investeren in fastfoodketens

MPs asked whether health insurers' investments in fast-food chains are a wrong signal given the obesity problem, and whether fast food should be an exclusion category. The minister replied that insurers decide their own investment policy, that the holdings are small (about 8 million euros), that dialogue with chains like McDonald's has produced commitments, and that prevention talks and an upcoming letter will follow.
As private parties, health insurers themselves decide on their investment policy.
Als private partijen gaan zorgverzekeraars zelf over hun beleggingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht 'Halsema: drugseconomie draait op volle toeren, jongeren sneller in zware criminaliteit’

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Justice and Security about Amsterdam's regional safety report showing drug crime, youth involvement in serious crime and weapons possession, and about the effect of the stricter penalties for container 'uithalers'. The minister answers that organised crime is a top priority, that the new penalties appear to have reduced uithalers in Rotterdam though the total effect is hard to prove, and outlines prevention investments, neighbourhood-focused measures and an ongoing evaluation of preventive frisking.
Currently the instrument of preventive frisking is being evaluated.
Momenteel wordt het instrument preventief fouilleren geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht dat nicotinezakjes op middelbare scholen en zelfs op basisscholen verhandeld worden

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that nicotine pouches are sold in secondary and even primary schools in Hoorn, and about enforcement, the motion to bring them under the Tobacco Act, and planned measures. The State Secretary agreed the products are undesirable, said the NVWA is acting against pouches above 0.035 mg nicotine as unsafe food, will issue a policy rule by 1 May 2022, and promised a further letter before summer.
I find it very undesirable that young people use and sell nicotine pouches.
Ik vind het zeer ongewenst dat jongeren nicotinezakjes gebruiken en verhandelen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ceder, Kuik, Eppink en De Roon over de vernietiging van Armeens cultureel en religieus erfgoed door Azerbeidzjan in relatie tot de uitspraak van het Internationaal Gerechts

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie, CDA, JA21 and PVV asked the Foreign Minister how the government assesses Azerbaijan's destruction of Armenian cultural and religious heritage and its failure to comply with the ICJ's 2021 provisional measures, and what concrete steps it will take, including on EU aid and sanctions. The minister answered that the ICJ ruling is binding and that the Netherlands urges compliance and a UNESCO fact-finding mission, but declined to judge Azerbaijan's conduct, ruled out unilateral EU sanctions, and gave no firm new commitments.
The cabinet considers it of great importance that cultural and religious heritage is protected, as regularly emphasised in statements and conversations.
Het kabinet acht het van groot belang dat cultureel en religieus erfgoed beschermd wordt, zoals regelmatig onderstreept in verklaringen en gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de berichten ‘Miljoenen Oekrainers op de vlucht’ en ‘Noodopvang zonder plan’

The CDA MP Kuik asked about the refugee flow from Ukraine, available reception capacity, emergency planning, coordination of private initiatives, and residence rights for Ukrainians. The State Secretary answered almost every question by referring to earlier letters of 8 and 17 March, while noting that EU emergency plans exist and that a national coordination point for private initiatives is desirable.

For an overview of the latest situation regarding all efforts being made in response to the refugee flow from Ukraine, including the creation of 50,000 reception places coordinated by the safety regions, I refer you to the letters to the House of 8 March and 17 March.

Voor een overzicht van de laatste stand van zaken omtrent alle inspanningen die verricht worden naar aanleiding van de vluchtelingenstroom uit Oekraïne, waaronder de realisatie van 50.000 opvangplekken onder coördinatie van de veiligheidsregio’s, verwijs ik u naar de Kamerbrieven van 8 maart en 17 maart jl.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Jasper van Dijk en Kuik over naturalisatieverzoeken RANOV-vergunninghouders en de Kamerbrief over diverse onderwerpen migratiebeleid van 7 juli 2021 en het WODC rapport “(N)ooit Nede

MPs Podt, Jasper van Dijk and Kuik asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why RANOV permit holders may still be asked for identity and nationality documents, how many naturalisation applications were filed and refused since the July 2021 policy change, and whether the Van Dijk/Van Toorenburg motion was properly implemented. The State Secretary answered that about 2,070 RANOV holders filed applications, around 690 were granted and fewer than 10 refused, that the documentary requirement is waived for RANOV holders with the possibility of submitting documents voluntarily, and that the motion is considered implemented.
Do you think you are implementing the adopted Van Dijk/Van Toorenburg motion in a way consistent with its spirit and intent?
Vraag 5 Vindt u dat u de aangenomen Kamermotie Van Dijk/Van Toorenburg 5 uitvoert op een manier die in lijn is met de geest en de bedoeling van de motie?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Inge van Dijk en Peters over noodverordening op en rond azc Budel na steekpartijen

MPs Kuik, Inge van Dijk and Peters (CDA) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about violence and stabbings at the Budel asylum centre and the emergency ordinance that followed, including causes, short- and long-term actions and consequences for perpetrators' asylum claims. The State Secretary acknowledged serious incidents, listed security measures agreed with the mayor, the Commissioner of the King, and COA, and explained the legal grounds for refusing protection to offenders.
Of course I will inform your House of the outcomes of the research into options for action.
Uiteraard zal ik uw Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek naar handelingsperspectieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Kuik over het artikel 'In veel branches wordt werk geruild voor seks'

Two CDA MPs asked whether trading work for sex in various industries, reported by AD, falls under prostitution rules, whether it amounts to exploitation of vulnerable people, and what measures, reporting options and advertisement restrictions exist. The State Secretary answered that exchanging services for sex is not prostitution, is not prohibited but is condemned when it involves abuse, pointed to a pending bill on sexual offences, reporting options and branch self-regulation, and promised to draw branches' attention to the law.

The cabinet will ensure that the bill now with the Council of State, which makes it punishable to know or ought to know that the other person does not want sexual contact, is explicitly brought to the attention of the branches.

Het kabinet zal ervoor zorgen dat het wetsvoorstel dat bij de Raad van State ligt, waarmee geregeld wordt dat je strafbaar bent als je weet of had moeten weten dat de ander geen seksueel contact wil, uitdrukkelijk onder de aandacht wordt gebracht bij de branches.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de berichten ‘Daar sta je dan: mishandeld, vergeten en met lege handen’ en ‘Driekwart slachtoffers gelooft niet meer in aangifte doen’

A CDA MP asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about reports that most victims no longer report crimes and about victims' rights when the Public Prosecution Service settles serious assault and sexual cases by penalty order without a judge. The ministers answered that reporting willingness depends on offence type, that the OM considers victims' interests but acknowledges delays in sending victim letters and is working to fix them, and that victims can claim damages and complain to the OM.
The Public Prosecution Service has indicated it is working with priority on resolving these problems.
Het OM heeft aangegeven met prioriteit te werken aan het oplossen van deze problemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Kuik over het bericht ‘Enquête: klant moet sekswerker vragen naar de leeftijd’

MPs Kuik and Bikker asked the government about an survey showing many sex workers say clients should check age and identity, the sentences in the Valkenburg case, and measures to deter clients. The Staatssecretaris answered that a client-focused package and campaign are coming, that the Penal Code will treat paid sex with minors as aggravating, and declined to discuss individual court sentences citing the separation of powers.
I attach great importance to the separation of powers and consider it inappropriate, from my position as Staatssecretaris of Justice and Security, to give an opinion on individual judicial rulings.

Ik hecht sterk aan de scheiding der machten en acht het vanuit mijn functie als de Staatssecretaris van Justitie en Veiligheid niet passend over individuele uitspraken van de rechter een oordeel te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Kuik over de overstromingen in Zuid-Soedan (Jonglei State)

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign trade and development minister about the flooding in Jonglei State, South Sudan, including the humanitarian situation, hunger, disease, Dutch aid, the role of the South Sudanese government and the EU, causes, and the link to conflict. The minister answered at length, describing large humanitarian needs, Dutch funding through UN agencies, the Dutch Relief Alliance and a pooled fund, and a planned climate resilience programme with IOM; the answers are on substance and do not concern domestic executive oversight.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Kathmann, Kuik, Van Nispen, Van der Staaij, Pouw-Verweij, Ellemeet, Gündoğan, Omtzigt en Van Esch over de daadwerkelijke inwerkingtreding van de Wet kansspelen op afstand en het be

MPs from several parties asked the government about protecting minors and vulnerable groups from online gambling advertising, the 30% youth-audience interpretation in the industry gambling advertising code, enforcement by the Kansspelautoriteit, and the implementation of the Vos motion and amendment on warnings. The minister answered that the ban on targeting youth is absolute, enforcement lies with the Ksa, a time-slot restriction is currently not feasible, and a new warning text is being developed via Trimbos.
The Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) supervises compliance with advertising restriction measures laid down in laws and regulations.
De Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) houdt toezicht op de naleving van reclamebeperkende maatregelen die zijn neergelegd in wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht 'Honderden asielkinderen dreigen zonder hun ouders op te moeten groeien'

A CDA MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about an NRC report that IND policy on family reunification for unaccompanied minors had changed, including whether it was pushed through against IND leadership advice and why it was not shared with parliament. The State Secretary said the IND approach was an interpretation of 'alleenstaande' rather than a policy change, that a broad inventory led to abandoning it on 23 August 2021, and that parliament was informed promptly.
In March 2021 a memo was submitted to me proposing that the IND abandon this more generally applied working method.
In maart 2021 is mij een nota voorgelegd waarin mij is voorgesteld om deze door de IND meer generiek gehanteerde werkwijze los te laten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht ‘Erotisch ‘kinderboek’ Drs. P zorgt na vijftig jaar voor woede bij BN’ers’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a controversial erotic children's book by Drs. P and where the legal line lies between protected fiction and incitement to child abuse, and what priorities should be set against child sexual abuse. The minister answered that only incitement to a concrete offence crosses the criminal line, that the planned offence on preparatory acts targets instructional material rather than literary works, and that a broad, multi-pronged approach including internet regulation is being pursued.
The criminal boundary is crossed when artistic freedom is abused to deliberately incite, stir up or urge a concrete criminal offence, such as sexual child abuse.

De strafrechtelijke grens wordt overschreden wanneer artistieke vrijheid wordt misbruikt om opzettelijk aan te zetten, aan te hitsen of aan te sporen tot een concreet strafbaar feit, zoals seksueel kindermisbruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht dat documentatie van woningen zeer gemakkelijk op te vragen is

An MP asked whether building drawings of homes, including those of public figures under protection, can be requested too easily and whether this enables burglaries. The minister answered that building files are public under the Wob and Archiefwet, that municipalities may restrict access via exclusion lists for risk objects, and that she will consult the VNG but sees no need for new identity checks.
Providing building drawings is a responsibility of municipalities.
Het verstrekken van bouwtekeningen is een verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht ‘Taliban veroveren Kandahar, tweede stad van Afghanistan’

MP Kuik asked the Justice Minister whether the Taliban's takeover of Kandahar could lead to Dutch jihadist travellers and what preparations exist, and how the pending bill criminalising stay in a terrorist-controlled area would help. The minister said no signals of Dutch travellers were known, outlined existing travel-blocking tools, and said it was too early to say whether Afghan areas would be designated, while the bill's handling was deferred and a separate exemption bill is being prepared.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Bikker, Van den Berg en Kuik over de aanpak van mensenhandel in de Caribische delen van het Koninkrijk

MPs asked about the government's approach to human trafficking in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom, including prosecutions, victim reporting, information sharing and whether the National Rapporteur's mandate should extend to the BES islands. The government answered that combating trafficking is largely a country matter, gave case and reporting figures for Caribbean Netherlands, declined to extend the National Rapporteur's mandate, and committed to raising the issue at the next Justice Ministers' meeting and evaluating the MoU in 2022.

Are you willing to come to the budget debate for the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations with scenarios on how information gathering, information sharing, reception, investigation and prosecution of human trafficking in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom can be improved?

Bent u bereid voor de behandeling van de begroting Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties met scenario's te komen hoe de informatievergaring, informatiedeling, opvang, opsporing en vervolging op het gebied van mensenhandel in de Caribische delen van het Koninkrijk kan worden verbeterd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen, Van der Werf, Kuik, Bikker en Van der Staaij over het onderzoek naar de beveiligingssituatie van Peter R. de Vries

MPs asked the Justice Minister whether the investigation into protection of Peter R. de Vries should be broadened to earlier victims and whether the inquiry commission should be fully independent with an additional criminal-law expert. The minister answered that the Safety Board (OVV) will investigate lessons from protection of the brother, lawyer and confidant of the Marengo witness, and that the broader scope fits an OVV inquiry rather than the previously planned commission, while not doubting the commission members' suitability.

I have asked the Dutch Safety Board (OVV) to take on an investigation into the lessons that can be drawn from the security situations of the brother, the then lawyer and the confidant of the crown witness in the Marengo trial.

Ik heb de Onderzoeksraad voor de Veiligheid (OVV) gevraagd om het op zich te nemen in een onderzoek na te gaan welke lessen getrokken kunnen worden uit de beveiligingssituaties van de broer, de toenmalig advocaat en de vertrouwenspersoon van de kroongetuige in het Marengo-proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Stoffer, Kuik en Van Haga over de brief van 14 januari betreffende vrijwilligersreizen

Four MPs asked the Minister of Foreign Trade and Development about orphanage tourism, development policy on orphan care, the UN Child Rights resolution, ANBI charity status rules, timelines for regulatory follow-up, and sector campaigns. The minister answered that orphan care is not a separate policy focus, that ANBI rules are neutral and offer no basis for extra checks, that further regulatory options will be decided in Q4 2021, and that the sector should self-organise with government in an information role.
Several ministries are currently examining which of the listed courses of action are realistic, desirable and feasible, and which concrete actions could be attached to them.
Er wordt momenteel met verschillende ministeries bezien welke van de genoemde handelingsperspectieven realistisch, wenselijk en haalbaar zijn en welke concrete acties hieraan verbonden kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht 'Loekasjenko neemt wraak en zet sluis naar Europa open voor vluchtelingen'

A CDA MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about reports that Belarus was letting migrants pass into Lithuania as retaliation, including whether Belarusian border guards were involved, the adequacy of border control, the camp conditions and EU action. The government answered that it condemns instrumentalisation of migrants, described the sharp rise in crossings and the Belarus-linked flights, and listed Frontex, EASO and EU sanctions support, while not answering the smuggling-liability question in detail.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht dat meer dan 50 landen seksuele misstanden binnen de WHO melden

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister about reports that 53 countries expressed concern over sexual abuse by aid workers, including at the WHO, and about Dutch involvement, the independent inquiry, and actions by WHO, UNICEF and IOM. The minister answered most questions substantively, sharing the statement, describing the inquiry and organisational measures, and promising a further letter, while declining to answer all 25 questions before the debate.
As promised during the recent Humanitarian Aid committee debate, I will send the House a letter on the current state of affairs.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het recente Commissiedebat Noodhulp zal ik de Kamer een brief sturen over de huidige stand van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht dat artsen alarm slaan over lachgas

MP Kuik (CDA) asked the State Secretary for Health about doctors' warnings on nitrous oxide (lachgas) abuse, including cardiovascular and neurological harm, why it is seen as harmless, and why a national recreational-use ban on the Opiumwet list has not taken effect. The State Secretary reported rising incident figures, prevention plans, and that the ban was delayed by lack of police enforcement funding and is now left to a new cabinet, with no regulation expected before spring 2022.
I share the view that it is important to take national measures against the supply of nitrous oxide for recreational use as quickly as possible.
Ik deel de mening dat het belangrijk is om zo snel mogelijk landelijke maatregelen tegen het aanbod van lachgas voor recreatief gebruik te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht 'Uitzetting de mist in door fouten overheid'

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why about 14% of immigration detention orders were lifted because of government procedural errors, why detention yields low departure rates for Moroccan and Algerian nationals, and what is being done to secure returns of rejected asylum seekers. The State Secretary responded that the figures show an improving trend, that detention is a last resort and procedural pressure is being addressed through a longer detention-decision period, and that cooperation with origin countries and criminal-law coordination are ongoing, with a fuller response on the ACVZ report to follow.
Although it is unfortunate that detention orders have to be lifted for these reasons, this must be seen against the background of a favourable trend.
Hoewel het onfortuinlijk is dat bewaringen om deze redenen moeten worden opgeheven, staat dit tegen de achtergrond van een gunstige trend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Van der Staaij over bericht 'Fout in nieuwe gokwet zorgt voor ‘meer risico op matchfixing’, sportbonden boos'

MPs Kuik and Van der Staaij asked whether a flaw in the new online gambling law stops sports federations receiving timely matchfixing signals, and how that squares with their advisory right. The minister answered that a fast lane via FIU-Nederland and notification rules will get signals to sports bodies quickly, that no law change is needed, and that the sector's advisory role on black and white lists is maintained.
It has been agreed that a fast lane will be created at FIU-Nederland for matchfixing signals.
Afgesproken is dat voor signalen van matchfixing bij de FIU-Nederland een fast lane zal worden vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Palland over het bericht ‘Werkgevers: creatieve oplossing nodig voor meer stageplekken mbo’ers’

Two CDA MPs asked ministers whether creative solutions such as more trainees per company, variable internship length and retired supervisors could ease the shortage of MBO internship places, and what the SBB action plan has achieved. The minister answers that these options are already possible under the service document, cites about 20,000 students still seeking placements, and promises continued pressure on schools and employers and further action if needed.
If I find that this is not yet sufficient, I will work with SBB and other partners to ensure that the additional room from the service document is used as much as possible.
Als ik merk dat dit nog niet volstaat, zal ik mij samen met SBB en andere partners inspannen om te zorgen dat de extra ruimte uit het servicedocument zoveel mogelijk wordt benut.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeets, Kuik, Jasper van Dijk, Ceder en Piri over het bericht ‘Tina en Jacob moeten weg!’

MPs from D66, CDA, SP, ChristenUnie and PvdA asked whether Armenian Syrians facing revocation of asylum status are treated unequally, and why some keep their permits while others lose them. The State Secretary answered that re-assessment is individual, that the IND does not register these figures, and that a 2021 court ruling concerned insufficient reasoning on equality, not discrimination.
The requested numerical data cannot be provided.
De gevraagde cijfermatige gegeven kunnen niet verstrekt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Ellemeet, Ceder, Kuik en Koekkoek over de mogelijke uitzetting van Tina en Jacob

MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why Tina and Jacob, Syrian-Armenians, faced deportation to Armenia and whether their family ties and residence in the Netherlands should count. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case on privacy and confidentiality grounds, explained the IND's general approach to dual nationals and safe third countries, and noted that the IND had granted a residence permit.
As said, I cannot go into the individual case.
Zoals gezegd kan ik niet ingaan op de individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over met Nederlands geld gefinancierde pick-uptrucks in Oeganda

Dutch MP Kuik (CDA) asked the minister whether Dutch-funded pick-up trucks were used by Ugandan police against the opposition, and about Dutch support to the JLOS justice sector including monitoring and whether aid should continue. The minister answered that the trucks are under investigation and the police cooperation component is on hold, that JLOS aid is earmarked and monitored with payments partly delayed, and that the Netherlands is pursuing diplomatic engagement with Uganda.
The ministry is still determining exactly what happened and is in contact with the Ugandan authorities and the police for this purpose.
Het ministerie zoekt nog uit wat er precies is gebeurd en is daarvoor in contact met de Oegandese autoriteiten en de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van den Berg en Kuik over het bericht 'Schrikbarend veel misbruik van ADHD-medicatie onder Nederlandse studenten'

CDA MPs asked the ministers whether they were alarmed by reports of widespread non-medical use of ADHD medication by Dutch students to boost academic performance, what the Trimbos/RIVM monitor shows, and what action will be taken, including about illegal online medicine sellers registered abroad. The minister answered that the monitor results arrive in mid-2021, that signals are being taken seriously and that action will follow if the monitor does not reassure, and that IGJ has no formal power over websites hosted abroad, though it takes part in Interpol's Operation PANGEA.
If the outcome does not provide a reassuring picture, I am prepared to take action to curb the undesirable development.
Als de uitkomst geen geruststellend beeld oplevert, ben ik bereid over te gaan tot actie om de ongewenste ontwikkeling af te remmen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de situatie in Oeganda

An MP from the CDA asked the Dutch government about the social media and internet blockade in Uganda around the January 2021 elections, the security situation, EU engagement, civil society restrictions, the detention of human rights lawyer Opiyo, and Bobi Wine's house arrest. The minister answered that social media was blocked and internet restored only slowly, that the EU has raised concerns through political dialogue and statements, that Dutch embassy staff attended hearings and visited Wine, and that international observers were largely limited to the AU, IGAD and EAC.
The Netherlands will work within the EU to ensure that the mentioned topics remain high on the EU dialogue agenda with Uganda.
Nederland zal zich er in EU-verband voor inspannen dat de genoemde onderwerpen hoog op de agenda van de EU-dialoog met Oeganda blijven staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Rog en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Fors meer scholieren geschorst voor wapenbezit op school

MPs asked the ministers about the rise in school suspensions for weapon possession, the number of police reports by schools, and whether schools can check pupils and what sanctions apply. The minister confirmed the increase is worrying, cited rising suspension counts and police incident figures, said no data explain the rise, and pointed to the existing Actieplan Wapens en Jongeren for local cooperation with youth work.
Police systems cannot automatically generate how many schools have filed reports.
Antwoord 4 Uit de politiesystemen valt niet automatisch to genereren door hoeveel scholen aangifte is gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Van den Berg over het bericht dat alle landen om ons heen al vaccineren tegen het rotavirus

Two CDA MPs asked whether rotavirus vaccination for all infants should be introduced or reconsidered early to relieve hospital pressure during the COVID crisis. The State Secretary answered that the Health Council will advise on rotavirus vaccination this year, that a temporary extra vaccination needs the same thorough assessment, and that COVID-related measures and a healthy lifestyle campaign are the current prevention focus.
The advice on rotavirus vaccination will be taken up by the Health Council later this year.
Het advies rondom rotavirusvaccinatie zal in de loop van dit jaar worden opgepakt door de Gezondheidsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht "Geen 4 maanden, maar één dag cel en taakstraf voor man (46) die betaalde seks met 16-jarig meisje had"

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a court sentence of one day in prison and a community service order for a man who paid for sex with a 16-year-old, and about whether sentencing circumvents the ban on community service for article 248b Sr, the trend in such sentences, prioritising human trafficking cases, and the measures promised under the Kuik motion on deterring buyers of sex with minors. The State Secretary answers that buyers should be punished, that the judge has discretion within the legal framework, that only 11 of 121 convictions since 2012 involved 1-2 days' custody plus community service, and that the promised package and a planned statutory strengthening of the payment element are being developed.
I consider it desirable that clients of sex with minors are punished.
Ik acht het wenselijk dat klanten van seks met minderjarigen worden bestraft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Voordewind over kwetsbare kinderen die in arme landen door de coronacrisis uit beeld raken

MPs Kuik and Voordewind asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about vulnerable children in poor countries who risk falling out of view during the COVID-19 crisis, including school closures, child marriage, FGM, online abuse and child trafficking. The minister confirmed the figures in part, cited UNESCO, UNFPA, UNICEF and other sources, and pointed to existing programmes and a commitment to raise the issue in EU Council conclusions.
The Netherlands will also raise the position of vulnerable children in the context of EU Council conclusions on the consequences of the coronavirus pandemic for human rights.
Nederland zal de positie van kwetsbare kinderen ook aan de orde stellen in het kader van EU Raadsconclusies over de consequenties van de Coronapandemie op mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Nieuwenhuijzen en Kuik over het bericht dat de Soedanese paramilitaire groep RSF steun krijgt van de Europese Unie

Two MPs (GroenLinks and CDA) asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that the EU funds training for the Sudanese paramilitary RSF, and about the EU's role in Sudan's transition. The minister answers that the EU does not finance RSF training, that OHCHR activities exclude the RSF, that vetting measures apply, and that no further EU guidelines are deemed necessary.
Both claims are incorrect. The EU does not provide financial support for the said training and does not plan to do so in the future.
Beide stellingen kloppen niet. De EU geeft geen financiële ondersteuning aan genoemde trainingen en is ook niet van plan dit in de toekomst te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Slootweg over het tekort aan griepprikken

Two CDA MPs asked why there is a shortage of flu vaccines, whether healthcare workers can be prioritised, and how supply will be secured next year. State Secretary Blokhuis answered that extra vaccines were purchased and additional stock may arrive, that the state is not directly responsible for healthcare employers' vaccination offers, and that preparations for 2021 are being brought forward.
Vaccination of healthcare staff helps to prevent this transmission.
Vaccinatie van zorgpersoneel helpt om deze overdacht te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het de leden Van der Berg en Kuik over het bericht 'Termunten is slecht bereik zat: 'We moeten op de dijk staan om te kunnen bellen'’

MPs Van den Berg and Kuik asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about poor mobile coverage in Termunten and Termunterzijl that reportedly leaves residents, businesses and emergency calls unreachable, and about the broader rollout of fast internet and mobile coverage. The State Secretary answered that no complaints are known to the regulator, that emergency-call success rates are high, that a new mast site is being sought with a provider, and that rollout targets are being monitored with updates promised for early 2021.
I am not aware of that.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het artikel ‘Ouders mbo-leerlingen hebben weinig vertrouwen in coronarooster: "Vier uur naar school in de week is veel te weinig"’

MP Kuik (CDA) asked the Minister of Education about a newspaper report on mbo students receiving only about four hours of in-person teaching per week, and about hybrid schedules, the 1.5-metre rule versus practical training, and online teaching quality. The Minister acknowledged parents' concerns, explained that schools decide the blend of in-person and remote teaching within a 1,600-hour study load, said data on hours are not kept, and committed to further steps such as sharing good practices and informing parliament in autumn.
No, these data are not kept.
Nee, deze gegevens worden niet bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over rookvrije ruimte om op te groeien

An MP from the CDA asks the state secretary for health about smoke-free playgrounds, farms and sports fields for children, citing support polls and the Prevention Agreement targets for 2020. The state secretary answers that most targets are delayed by COVID-19, with smoke-free farms expected by Q1 2021 and playgrounds and sports clubs supported by sector bodies.
The expectation is that all farms for children will be smoke-free in the first quarter of 2021.
De verwachting is dat alle kinderboerderijen in het eerste kwartaal van 2021 rookvrij zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Kuik over de arrestatie en gevangenneming van mensenrechtenverdedigers in Niger

MPs Van Helvert and Kuik asked the ministers about the detention of human rights defenders in Niger, including two trade union leaders, and whether Dutch aid to youth employment programmes is hindered as a result. The ministers said they raised the case with Nigerien authorities through several diplomatic channels, will keep following it while respecting judicial independence, and that the detentions are hindering one part of the programme but the Dutch youth employment efforts continue.
The Netherlands will continue to follow this matter closely, with respect for the independent judicial process in Niger.
Nederland blijft deze kwestie nauwlettend volgen, met respect voor de onafhankelijke rechtsgang in Niger.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van den Berg en Von Martels over berichten dat mensen met overgewicht meer risico lopen bij het coronavirus

Three CDA MPs asked the state secretary for Health about links between overweight and severe COVID-19, and about strengthening healthy-lifestyle policy, including UK measures and coordination of local prevention and sport agreements. The state secretary agreed the link is plausible, pointed to existing prevention agreements, promised to monitor UK measures, and announced a RIVM evaluation and further steps on children's marketing and local funding.
By preventively countering overweight, a great deal of disease burden can be prevented.
Met het preventief tegengaan van overgewicht kan veel ziektelast worden voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Rog en Van Toorenburg over het rapport van het Centrum tegen Kinderhandel en Mensenhandel

MPs Kuik, Rog and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about a report on criminal exploitation of Dutch pupils, including the number of awareness programmes run, schools' reluctance to be open about incidents, victim and perpetrator data, and monitoring of progress. The State Secretary answered that schools are being supported, that programme rollout is ongoing, that data-gathering with statistics bodies and the Rapporteur is being explored, and that the Chamber will be informed through progress letters.
Your House will be further informed in the progress letter of the programme Samen tegen mensenhandel about the outcomes of these discussions.
Uw Kamer wordt in de voortgangsbrief van het programma Samen tegen mensenhandel nader geïnformeerd over de uitkomsten van deze gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kuik over zelfmoordpreventie ten tijde van corona

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about suicide prevention during the coronavirus crisis, including whether research into the impact on suicides is under way, whether the crisis could increase suicides, whether 113 Zelfmoordpreventie has enough resources, and the status of the national suicide prevention agenda. The government answered that monitoring is ongoing via a weekly commission, several studies are underway coordinated by ZonMw, contact with 113 is active with an update promised before the 8 June debate, and a new national agenda will be sent by October 2020.
I will inform the House of the outcomes of my contact with 113 Suicide Prevention in the letter I will send to the House ahead of the consultation meeting on 8 June.
Ik zal de Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten van mijn contact met 113 Zelfmoordpreventie in de brief die ik voor het notaoverleg op 8 juni aanstaande naar de Kamer zal sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf, Kuik en Kuiken over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor mensen in de prostitutie

MPs asked the government about the consequences of the COVID-19 crisis for people in prostitution, including unregistered workers without income support, bed-bath-bread shelter, exit programmes, police raids, and online advertising for physical services. The minister answered that sex workers can access existing support schemes and municipal shelters, that a ban on prostitution applies under the emergency ordinance, that exit demand has not yet grown substantially, and that the ordinance may be amended to address online advertising.
Such possibilities are currently being examined.
Op dit moment worden zulke mogelijkheden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het mondiale tekort aan vaccinaties

Kuik (CDA) asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the global shortage of vaccinations during COVID-19, including which countries face shortages, the impact of physical distancing, and the risk of excess deaths from HIV, TB and malaria. Minister Kaag answered that vaccination campaigns are being suspended rather than vaccine supply, that Dutch funding is directed at strengthening health systems, but declined to answer the questions for the scheduled written consultation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het Onderzoek Meisjes in de gevarenzone 'Ik verlang naar een veilige plek´

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about exploitation of vulnerable girls by loverboys, police and prosecution capacity, specialist care, and measures targeting clients and hotels. The State Secretary answered that data on case outcomes cannot be isolated, that police and zeden teams cooperate, and that research and a package of measures on clients are in preparation, with a concrete package promised before summer.
It turns out it is not possible to retrieve from the systems specifically for this target group how many cases over the past three years led to criminal investigations and convictions.

Het blijkt tenslotte niet mogelijk om specifiek voor deze doelgroep uit de systemen te halen hoeveel zaken er de afgelopen drie jaar hebben geleid tot opsporingsonderzoeken en uiteindelijke veroordelingen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Peters over het bericht ‘MBO Raad waarschuwt: nieuwkomers moeten snelle toegang houden tot mbo’.

MPs Kuik and Peters asked ministers about the COVID-19 impact on language courses and MBO access for newcomers, and whether the government would act. Minister Koolmees answered that remote learning rules were relaxed, the integration deadline extended, MBO schools may admit students without full entry requirements, and no separate budget is planned for now, while monitoring the situation.
I will continue to closely monitor the situation and the effects of the measures taken.
Ik blijf de situatie en de uitwerking van de genomen maatregelen nauwgezet monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Rog en Van Toorenburg over het rapport van het Centrum tegen Kinderhandel en Mensenhandel (CKM) aangaande criminele uitbuiting onder Nederlandse scholieren

MPs Kuik, Rog and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked the government about a CKM report on criminal exploitation and drug-related recruitment of Dutch schoolchildren, including school protocols, normalisation of drugs, prosecution statistics, non-punishment protection and the UK approach. The state secretary answered that protocols and prevention programmes exist, that data on drug-related trafficking cases is not registered separately, and that the government will explore closer cooperation and learn from the UK.
The Public Prosecution Service does not register in how many of these cases the exploitation is drug-related, nor whether it occurs among schoolchildren.
Het OM registreert niet in hoeveel van deze gevallen het gaat om drugsgerelateerde uitbuiting, en ook niet of dat gebeurt onder scholieren.
Antwoord op vagen van de leden Kuik, Bouali en Voordewind over de opschorting van de steun van de VS aan de WHO

Three MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether the Netherlands was warned about the US suspension of WHO funding, what consequences it has for COVID-19 response, and whether the EU will press the US to reverse it. The minister answered that the Netherlands learned of it via media, opposes suspension, will press US counterparts and coordinate an EU resolution, and pledged additional funds to the WHO.
On behalf of the Dutch government I have expressed support for the WHO.
Namens de Nederlandse regering heb ik steun uitgesproken voor de WHO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Toorenburg over de uitspraak van het Kifid: ‘Softdrug niet illegaal, schade door beroving wel gedekt’

CDA MPs asked the Justice Minister whether preparatory acts for soft-drug dealing are punishable, and how to respond to a Kifid complaints-body ruling that a robbery-related damage claim was covered and soft drugs were not illegal. The minister confirmed that preparatory acts for soft-drug trade are punishable under the Opium Act when commercial or large-quantity, but declined to comment on or engage with Kifid's individual ruling, citing its independence.
I do not intervene in the assessment of Kifid rulings in individual disputes.
Ik treed niet in de beoordeling van uitspraken van Kifid in individuele geschillen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van den Berg en Kuik over de berichten ‘Prestatiedruk in het hoger onderwijs leidt tot misbruik ADHD-medicatie’ en ‘Braindrug modafinil is populair onder studenten, maar ‘je

CDA MPs asked the ministers of Education and Medical Care about reports of ADHD medication and modafinil misuse by students under performance pressure, and about illegal trade, monitoring, prevention and campaigns. The ministers answered that the Amsterdam study is qualitative and not representative, that a RIVM and Trimbos monitor on student mental health and substance use is underway with results expected in 2020 and 2021, that prevention measures will be considered depending on those results, and that the Health Inspectorate (IGJ) is working against illegal online trade within the limits of cross-border enforcement.
The exact scale and extent of trade in ADHD medication and modafinil is insufficiently known.
De exacte schaal en omvang van de handel in ADHD-medicatie en modafinil is onvoldoende bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Van Helvert en Kuik over seksueel geweld tegen christelijke vrouwen

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie and CDA asked the ministers about reported sexual violence against Christian women and the Open Doors gender-specific persecution report, including what Dutch foreign and development policy can do about it. The ministers condemn such persecution, describe existing programmes on women's legal equality, child marriage, religious freedom and a EUR 750,000 contribution to psychological care for persecuted believers, but do not change any institutional check.
Persecution on account of a belief or conviction deviating from the majority is considered unacceptable by the cabinet.
Vervolging wegens een (van de meerderheid afwijkende) geloofs- of levensovertuiging vindt het kabinet onaanvaardbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over maximale 'veilige' geluidsniveaus bij concerten die alleen met oordoppen veilig blijken te zijn

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary for Health about the 103 dB concert noise norm, which is only safe with earplugs, the adequacy of the earplug awareness campaign, the convention on hearing damage prevention, enforcement and monitoring, and the follow-up to a motion on statutory noise limits. The State Secretary acknowledges the concerns, defends the campaign and convention, says legislation options will be reported by year-end, and promises a progress report and stakeholder analysis in April.
I will therefore continue to facilitate the I Love My Ears campaign and the implementation of the Convenant Preventie Gehoorschade.
Ik zal daarom de I Love My Ears campagne en de uitvoering van het Convenant Preventie Gehoorschade blijven faciliteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de vierdelige reportage van Nieuwsuur en het bericht ‘Officier mensenhandel waarschuwt: veel seksuele uitbuiting in de prostitutie’

An MP asked the State Secretary about Nieuwsuur reporting on sexual exploitation in prostitution, including local variation in rules, enforcement, and the effects of lifting the brothel ban. The State Secretary answered that the regulation bill (Wrs) is meant to create uniform national rules and licensing, that municipalities keep local enforcement, and committed to consulting the sector on transparency and cash use.
I do not have an overview of the differences in licensing requirements that municipalities impose.
Ik beschik niet over een overzicht van verschillen in vergunningseisen die gemeenten stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van Helvert, Van den Berg en Omtzigt over het coronavirus (COVID-19), dat nu in Gangelt is vastgesteld, direct grenzend aan Limburg

MPs of the CDA asked the ministers about COVID-19 cases in Gangelt near the Dutch border, cross-border coordination, quarantine and airport controls, hospital bed capacity, and travel advice. The minister answered that the GGD Zuid-Limburg coordinates with Germany, that airport controls are not considered appropriate, that at least 250 isolation ICU beds exist, and that travel advice follows RIVM risk assessments.
I will answer these questions as soon as possible.
Ik beantwoord deze vragen zo spoedig mogelijk.
Antwoord op van de leden Kuik, Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de uitbraak van het coronavirus.

Three CDA MPs asked the ministers of Health and Foreign Affairs about the coronavirus outbreak, including its infectiousness during incubation, passenger tracing from the Westerdam, EU coordination, travel restrictions and travel advice. The minister answered that transmission during incubation plays a very limited role per RIVM, that EU coordination runs through ECDC and the HSC, and that WHO and ECDC advise against trade or travel restrictions.
Based on the scientific knowledge of the RIVM, we assume that the new coronavirus is transmitted through coughing and sneezing.
Op basis van de wetenschappelijke kennis van het RIVM nemen wij aan dat het nieuwe coronavirus wordt overgedragen door hoesten en niezen.
Antwoord op de eerste drie vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van den Berg, Kuik en Van Helvert over het coronavirus (COVID-19), dat nu in Noordrijn-Westfalen is vastgesteld, vlakbij Limburg

CDA MPs asked ministers for an update on new COVID-19 infections near the Dutch border, whether German schools had closed, and what advice applies to Dutch schools, firms and travellers. The Minister of Medical Care answered that contact tracing is ongoing in Germany with no need for extra Dutch measures, that German schools closing is noted, and that Dutch schools and workplaces can stay open.
The situation is being closely monitored and measures will follow if necessary.
De situatie wordt op de voet gevolgd en indien nodig volgen maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de passagiers op het schip Westerdam

MPs Kuik, Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked about passengers stranded on the cruise ship Westerdam in Cambodia, their information, repatriation, passenger lists, and the RIVM's earlier claim that people are only contagious once symptomatic. The minister answered that most questions were addressed in an earlier letter, that about 30 Dutch nationals have returned, that returnees are monitored by the GGD, and that current RIVM knowledge supports the incubation and transmission figures, while acknowledging the contagiousness statement as based on current evidence.
Answer 2, 3, 4, 5 and 7 These questions I have already answered in the letter to the House of 17 February.
Antwoord 2, 3, 4, 5 en 7 Deze vragen heb ik reeds beantwoord in de Kamerbrief van 17 februari jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht ‘Keuzegids mbo 2020: mbo-opleiding met de hoogste baankans trekt weinig studenten’

An MP asks the Minister of Education about a 2020 study guide finding that vocational programmes with the best job prospects attract few students, and about shortages in key sectors like care, construction and technology, and what concrete steps the government will take. The Minister acknowledges the shortages, points to existing measures (labour-market obligation for programmes, career guidance, sector pacts and the care action programme) and promises a broader strategy letter before summer.
Regarding the Kuik/Smals motion, the letter on the broad strategy for opportunity programmes will be sent to your House before the summer.
Voor wat betreft de motie Kuik en Smals, de brief inzake de brede strategie voor de kansopleidingen zal voor de zomer aan uw Kamer worden toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van den Berg, Amhaouch en Omtzigt over het feit dat Italië alle vluchten tussen Italië en China heeft opgeschort

Four CDA MPs asked ministers about Italy suspending China flights, Chinese tourists with coronavirus in Italy, KLM suspending China flights, travel advice, EU coordination, quarantine of returnees, and international support for vulnerable countries. The government answered that Dutch procedures match Italy's, that EU health measures remain with member states, that it follows WHO advice against disproportionate restrictions, and that no additional Dutch funding seems necessary now.
Measures regarding health are reserved to the member states.
Maatregelen ten aanzien van de gezondheid zijn voorbehouden aan de lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Kuik over het Coronavirus

MPs Van den Berg and Kuik asked the government about the new coronavirus, including its mortality compared with Ebola, WHO coordination, Dutch preparedness, travel advice and European measures. The minister answered that mortality is about 2%, that the WHO declared a PHEIC, that Dutch hospitals are prepared with at least 250 isolation ICU beds, and that travel advice and monitoring are being adjusted in line with WHO and ECDC advice.
The Netherlands is well prepared and follows the advice of the WHO and the ECDC.
Nederland is goed voorbereid en volgt hierbij de adviezen van de WHO en het ECDC.
Antwoord op vragen van het de leden Smals en Kuik over het bericht ‘Alarm over vervalste mbo-diploma’s’

MPs Smals and Kuik asked the Minister of Education about reports of rising fraud with vocational (mbo) diplomas, including risks in healthcare and whether forged diplomas can be registered in the BIG register. The minister replied that only a few cases per year are known, that no increase can be established, that employers can verify diplomas via DUO's Diplomaregister, and that fraud should be reported to police, with the issue raised with the Justice Ministry.
I therefore see no reason to investigate how large the group is that is active on the labour market on the basis of a forged diploma.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om te onderzoeken hoe groot de groep is die op basis van een vervalst diploma actief is op de arbeidsmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de berichten ‘Door de privacywetgeving verdwijnen de slachtoffers van mensenhandel uit beeld’ en ‘Minder meldingen seksuele uitbuiting, niet minder zaken’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about reports that registered human trafficking victims nearly halved, and whether GDPR privacy rules are to blame. The State Secretary answered that privacy rules may have contributed but do not fully explain the decline, promised a policy response in Q1 2020, and declined to create a statutory basis for processing victims' data without consent.
I do not recognise the National Rapporteur's claim that the policy is built on loose sand.
Ik herken de stelling van de Nationaal Rapporteur dat er bij het beleid sprake is van «los zand» niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Van der Graaf over de uitzending van Undercover Nederland over de misstanden die plaatsvinden in een legale seksinrichting in Doetinchem

MPs Kuik and Van der Graaf asked how the government would respond to reported abuse, including coerced prostitution, in a licensed sex establishment in Doetinchem, and whether such establishments should be closed and perpetrators prosecuted. The Staatssecretaris answered that licensing, enforcement and closure are local competences, that municipal and police checks found no confirmed abuse or grounds for criminal investigation, and pointed to a planned national licensing requirement in the sex work regulation bill.
Licensing, supervision and enforcement within the sex industry are local competences.
Vergunningverlening en toezicht en handhaving binnen de seksbranche zijn lokale bevoegdheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van Toorenburg en Van der Graaf over de impact van gokelementen in games op jongeren

MPs from the CDA and ChristenUnie asked the state secretaries about rising problematic gaming among young people, the spread of gambling-like loot boxes, the slow enforcement by the Kansspelautoriteit against game developers, and age classification. The government answered that the rise may not be confirmed by current data pending a legal basis for LADIS, rejected a national ban as ineffective, said enforcement is complex and partly confidential, and pointed to prevention, industry dialogue and PEGI self-regulation.
Not everything happens in public. It is a careful process that must also be able to withstand scrutiny in court.
Niet alles gebeurt in de openbaarheid. Het is een zorgvuldig proces dat ook bij de rechter moet kunnen standhouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Amhaouch over het bericht over misstanden in projecten van FMO

CDA MPs Kuik and Amhaouch asked the minister, following a Trouw report, about alleged abuses (including land grabbing) in FMO-financed projects, FMO's risk management, the ministry's role, and whether local authorities prosecute. The minister confirmed the projects are known and under policy dialogue, explained the ministry's oversight role and risk monitoring, but declined to share FMO's problem list citing ongoing investigations and commercial confidentiality.
It is generally not in the interest of the ongoing investigation to share information about this with external parties.
Het is doorgaans niet in het belang van het lopende onderzoek om informatie hierover te delen met externe partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de zelfmoordpreventielijn

An MP from the CDA asked why the suicide prevention line widely known as 113 cannot be reached on that number and whether the 0900-0113 number is free of charge. The Secretary of State acknowledged that callers to 1-1-3 receive a message that the number does not exist, said the 113 name caused confusion, and committed to adjusting the referral message in the short term and to a letter to parliament.
I am now in discussion with the Ministry of EZK to take action on this and to adjust the message into a clear referral or redirection to the correct number.
Ik ben inmiddels met het Ministerie van EZK in gesprek om hier actie op te ondernemen en de melding aan te passen in een duidelijke verwijzing of doorschakeling naar het juiste nummer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Peters en Van den Berg over het gebruik van melatonine als slaapmiddel

MPs from the CDA asked the Minister about calls by about 500 scientists to make melatonin prescription-only, its sale and youth use, the rules under which it is sold, and whether labelling and enforcement are adequate.
