The Minister answered that melatonin products of 0.3 mg or more are treated as medicines by the IGJ, that jet-lag products sold without prescription are not approved for children, that enforcement is being intensified, but that he does not support making all melatonin prescription-only.
From September the IGJ is intensifying enforcement against unregistered medicines containing melatonin, based on a previously drawn-up enforcement plan that has recently been completed.
De IGJ intensiveert vanaf september de handhaving van niet-geregistreerde geneesmiddelen met melatonine, op basis van een eerder opgesteld handhavingsplan dat recent is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de gevolgen van lachgas in het verkeer

Two CDA MPs asked ministers about rising nitrous oxide (lachgas) use among drivers, its effects, casualty figures, enforcement options and whether recreational use should be banned. The state secretary answered that casualty data are not available, that existing criminal and CBR administrative tools can already be used, that a risk assessment is pending, and that a youth awareness campaign is planned, but did not fully answer the deadline request.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de onrechtmatige financiering van Soedanese veiligheidstroepen uit het European Union Emergency Trust Fund (EUTF)

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about alleged EU funding of Sudanese security forces via the EUTF, including the status of the BMM programme, monitoring, and whether EU-funded materials reached the RSF. The minister answered that BMM was not stopped but training was paused, that the Netherlands is not a direct financier, that EU safeguards exclude RSF participation and repressive-use equipment, and that no further investigation was deemed necessary.
I do not consider further investigation into this necessary.
Verder onderzoek hiernaar acht ik niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Van den Berg over de stijging van het aantal oxycodonverslaafden

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister about the rising number of oxycodone addicts, the lack of a clear treatment approach, prescribing practices, and patient information. The Minister acknowledged the trend, cited rising NVIC overdose notifications, and described a task force working on a national approach, prescribing guidance and patient information, with a progress letter promised for the second half of 2019.
Unfortunately I cannot give you national figures on the number of users in addiction care because these are not available.
Landelijke cijfers van het aantal gebruikers in de verslavingszorg kan ik u helaas niet geven omdat deze niet voorhanden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Segers over het bericht ‘Verscherpte aanpak klanten van jeugdprostitutie door politie en OM’

MPs Kuik and Segers asked the Justice minister about OM and police plans to target clients of youth prostitution, including numbers of minor victims, prosecutions of clients, reporting, use of online lure profiles, and EU comparisons. The minister answered that 107 suspects were prosecuted in 2015-2018 with 93 convicted, that sentencing has moved toward unconditional prison terms, and that the Samen tegen Mensenhandel programme has no specific client-side measures and no data on mandatory client reports.
No figures are currently available on the number of mandatory reports by clients of suspected sexual exploitation of minors, because such figures are not recorded in this way by the police.

Er zijn op dit moment geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal verplichte meldingen door klanten bij vermoedens van seksuele uitbuiting van minderjarigen, omdat cijfers niet op deze wijze worden geregistreerd bij de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Kuik en Peters over het bericht 'Schuldhulpverlening lastig voor studenten met schulden'

MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Education and the State Secretary of Social Affairs about the rising number of young people, including students, seeking debt assistance, and about municipal measures, study-stopping rules, DUO paying tuition directly, and a warning banner on DUO's website. The government gave partial answers: it had no exact figures, supported initiatives and dialogue with municipalities, declined the banner and direct tuition payment for now, and pointed to ongoing experiments and measures.
We cannot give you exact numbers and percentages.
We kunnen u geen exacte aantallen en procenten geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over eetstoornissen en social media

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health whether Instagram's promotion of eating disorders, as shown by a BBC investigation, also applies to Dutch youth, and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary acknowledged the risk, described existing platform and government measures such as blocked hashtags and help pop-ups, said no specific agreements with Instagram exist beyond EU codes, and said the UK measures will be monitored.
I do not have specific figures for young people with an eating disorder.
Over specifieke cijfers voor jongeren met een eetstoornis beschik ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht ‘Ritalin is populair op het schoolplein. Kan dat kwaad?’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Education whether non-medical use of Ritalin among pupils and students is problematic, how such use is obtained and combated, and whether more research on effects on school performance is needed. The minister answered that non-medical use is illegal and unacceptable, that enforcement and public information efforts exist, that research on school-performance effects is limited, and that the government will examine further research needs.
I will examine in the coming period whether, and if so what, further scientific knowledge is needed.
Ik zal in de komende periode onderzoeken of en zo ja, aan welke wetenschappelijke kennis er nog meer behoefte is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht dat sigaretten kopen onder de achttien te makkelijk blijft

An MP asked the state secretary for Health about press reports that minors can still easily buy cigarettes, with a university study finding 49% compliance and asking whether independent compliance research should be commissioned. The state secretary acknowledged compliance should be 100%, cited NVWA enforcement data showing improvement on risk locations, and declined to commission additional independent tobacco compliance research because NVWA data is available.
Because I have access to the NVWA enforcement figures, I do not intend to commission additional compliance research on tobacco.
Omdat ik beschik over de handhavingscijfers van de NVWA ben ik niet voornemens extra nalevingsonderzoek op tabak in te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het overmatig gebruik van cafeïnepillen

An MP from the CDA asked the government about excessive use of caffeine pills after a broadcast, including rising poisoning cases, cheap bulk sales without warnings, varying actual caffeine content, and whether limits and warnings should apply. The minister answered that caffeine pills are sold as food supplements under existing labelling rules, that the NVWA lacks data on actual content per pill, and that caffeine will be proposed for inclusion in the EU annex to Regulation 1925/2006 to allow EU-level limits.

Given the possible health risks of using caffeine pills, I want to have caffeine included in the annex to Regulation (EC) No 1925/2006, so that limits such as a maximum quantity of caffeine pills can be set at EU level.
Gezien de mogelijke gezondheidsrisico´s van het gebruik van cafeïnepillen wil ik cafeïne in de bijlage van de Verordening (EG) Nr. 1925/2006 op laten nemen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Kuik en Agnes Mulder over het verdwijnen van de spoedeisende zorg in Hoogeveen en Stadskanaal

Three CDA MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care about the planned closure of the emergency departments in Hoogeveen and Stadskanaal, including ambulance response times, the role of the ambulance services and regional administrators, and the RIVM accessibility analysis. The Minister replied that the regional core team's plan is not yet a decision, that the RIVM analysis shows the 45-minute norm would still be met, and that the ambulance services are involved in a regional steering group with IGJ and NZa monitoring continuity and quality.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik inzake het bericht ‘te snelle keus dreigt door beperkte plekken’

An MP asked the education minister about rising numerus fixus admissions limits in vocational (mbo) courses and the risks of first-come-first-served selection. The minister said the monitor will report before summer 2019, that the government does not yet know which institutions have limits or why, and that no new notification duty is planned until the monitor's results are known.
We currently do not know which institutions have introduced a numerus fixus for which courses, and for what reason.
We weten op dit moment niet welke instellingen voor welke opleidingen met welke reden een fixus hebben ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Pieter Heerma over het bericht ‘Zorgen om uitbuiting in goedkope nagelsalons’

CDA MPs Kuik and Heerma asked the State Secretaries of Justice and Social Affairs about reported exploitation, human trafficking and money laundering in cheap nail salons. The government answered that few signals reach the Inspectorate or police, that it will keep attention on the sector, run a study within the inspection programme, and strengthen municipal anti-trafficking efforts and international cooperation.
The Inspectorate SZW has informed me upon request that addressing abuses in nail salons will continue to receive attention from the Inspectorate.
De Inspectie SZW heeft mij desgevraagd laten weten dat de aanpak van misstanden in de nagelsalons blijvende aandacht van de Inspectie heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de verwoestende effecten van GHB-gebruik

An MP asked the state secretary for Health about GHB addiction, relapse rates, waiting lists and driving under the influence. The state secretary acknowledged serious harms but said evidence on hidden scale was lacking, promised a fuller overview to parliament in early 2019, and pointed to a pilot in Twenterand with a guidance document expected in 2019.
I will ask the addiction care institutions to make the waiting list data at substance level transparent.
Ik zal de verslavingszorginstellingen verzoeken de wachtlijstgegevens op middelniveau inzichtelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Bouali over gedwongen huwelijken van vrouwen uit Myanmar in China

MPs Kuik and Bouali asked the minister about a John Hopkins/KWAT study on forced marriages of women and girls from Myanmar in China, Dutch support for victim protection, and whether Dutch aid and diplomacy address trafficking. The minister described the study's estimates as hard to verify, listed Dutch-funded projects in Kachin and China, and said the issue will be raised in the next human rights dialogue with China.
The Netherlands will raise the issue during the next round of the bilateral human rights dialogue with China.
Nederland zal de kwestie ter sprake brengen tijdens de eerstvolgende ronde van de bilaterale mensenrechtendialoog met China
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Kuik over het bericht 'Criminele asielzoekers van de straat houden'

MPs Van Toorenburg and Kuik asked whether nuisance-causing and criminal asylum seekers, including those from safe countries, should be placed in extra supervised locations where they cannot leave the grounds, and how police response times at the Ter Apel centre are handled. Secretary Harbers answered that nuisance is unacceptable and that transfer to such locations is used case by case, that residents may leave during the day under a reporting duty and that stricter detention rules are constrained by EU law, while police response data were provided, with statistics only partly available.
As I have written to your House several times, the starting point is that nuisance behaviour, as caused by a limited group of asylum seekers, is completely unacceptable.
Zoals ik meermaals aan uw Kamer heb geschreven staat voorop dat overlastgevend gedrag, zoals wordt veroorzaakt door een beperkte groep asielzoekers, volstrekt onacceptabel is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Kuik over de uitzending ‘Voodoo maffia’

MPs Segers and Kuik asked the Justice Minister about a Brandpunt+ broadcast on undocumented Nigerian trafficking victims bound by voodoo rituals, and whether police should specialise in Nigerian trafficking networks. The State Secretary answered that a dedicated police specialism is not desirable, pointing to existing specialised teams, international cooperation with Nigeria, Italy, Belgium and the EMPACT framework, and expecting better radar on networks through these measures.
A specialised team within the police focused solely on this target group is not something I consider desirable.
Een specialistisch team dat zich binnen de politie alleen op deze doelgroep richt acht ik niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Kuik over handhaving van het rookbeleid op festivals door de NVWA

MPs Bruins Slot and Kuik asked the State Secretary about NVWA enforcement of the smoking ban at festivals, including fines for big versus small volunteer-run events and whether volunteers should be expected to remove smokers. The State Secretary reported 60 fines and 2 warnings from 111 controls, said the organiser bears the duty to enforce the ban, and announced a meeting with festival organisers to share experiences and consider support.
The NVWA cannot distinguish small from large festivals in its analysis of the data from all inspected festivals.
De NVWA kan in de analyse van de data van alle gecontroleerde festivals geen onderscheid maken in kleine en grote festivals.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de snelheid van reageren op een levensgevaarlijke uitbraak van een infectieziekte

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Health why the government reacted slowly to a possible meningococcal W outbreak, including the RIVM's handling of manufacturer signals, the advisory timelines and the procurement rules for vaccines. The State Secretary answered each question in substance, describing RIVM procedures, the OMT/BAO crisis route, the Health Council's standing advice timetable and the limits of the procurement shortcut, while stating that the Health Council is independent.
On 19 December 2017 I requested advice from the Health Council on meningococcal vaccination.
Ik heb op 19 december 2017 advies gevraagd aan de Gezondheidsraad over meningokokkenvaccinatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de berichtgeving dat de gezondheid van modellen in de mode-industrie ondanks beloftes nog steeds ver onder de maat is

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary for Health about reports that models in the fashion industry remain pressured to be unhealthily thin despite pledges, and about evaluation of the 2016 convenant. The state secretary acknowledged the problems, pointed to The Model's Health Pledge with 55 signatories as the chosen approach, and said he will evaluate it at the end of 2019 rather than pursue French-style legislation for now.
I intend to evaluate this approach at the end of 2019 and on that basis assess, where possible, whether it offers sufficient protection to models.
Ik ben voornemens deze aanpak eind 2019 te evalueren en op basis daarvan zo mogelijk te beoordelen of deze voldoende bescherming biedt aan modellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Omtzigt en Voordewind over de berichtgeving dat hulpgelden niet terechtkomen bij yezidi’s en christenen

MPs Kuik, Omtzigt and Voordewind asked the minister whether EU and Dutch aid reaches Yazidis and Christians in northern Iraq, how EU funds are controlled, and what is being done to free abducted Yazidi women and children. The minister disputed the reports, described Dutch and EU humanitarian funding and partner-vetting mechanisms, and gave overviews of projects, while pointing to the Iraqi government for inclusive governance and promising a country strategy and an annual letter on EU external financing.
Based on the GNI distribution key, the Dutch share of this contribution is approximately 4.7%.
Op basis van de BNI-verdeelsleutel is het Nederlandse aandeel in deze bijdrage circa 4,7%.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de aangiftebereidheid van minderjarige slachtoffers mensenhandel

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the very low willingness of minor victims of human trafficking to file reports, the reasons for it, police pilots, and whether the forthcoming action plan will include measures on definitions, faster procedures, sentencing and proactive investigation. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, said the police will run a pilot and a plan of action will follow after the summer, but gave no concrete commitments on specific measures and declined to expand sentencing.
I therefore cannot yet go into specific measures that will be included in it.
Ik kan daarom nog niet ingaan op specifieke maatregelen die hierin zullen worden opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali, Kuik en Voordewind over de opvang van Venezolanen in Colombia

MPs Bouali, Kuik and Voordewind asked the minister about the number of Venezuelan refugees in Colombia and neighbouring countries, Dutch contributions and support, and the situation of women and girls forced into prostitution. The minister replied with estimates of roughly 600,000 to 700,000 (UNHCR: about 1 million) Venezuelans in Colombia, a EUR 500,000 unearmarked contribution, and general statements on monitoring vulnerable groups, while stating that further support depends on priorities and available funds.
The cabinet is concerned about the humanitarian crisis in Venezuela and its consequences for the region, and will continue to closely monitor the situation.
Het kabinet is bezorgd over de humanitaire crisis in Venezuela en de gevolgen voor de regio, en blijft de situatie nauwlettend volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht 'Nergens in Europa wordt meer xtc geslikt dan in Nederland'

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary for Health about EMCDDA figures showing the Netherlands has the highest ecstasy and amphetamine use in Europe, and about related drug lab, drug death and health-effects reports. The State Secretary acknowledges concern, cites Trimbos explanations and prevention measures, and says some questions are still under study.
I will continue to step up prevention efforts.
Ik zal doorgaan met het extra inzetten op preventie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de snel oprukkende dodelijke bacterie Meningokokken W

The MP Kuik asked the State Secretary for Health about the rise of the deadly meningococcal W bacterium, the vaccine shortage, the timing of the vaccination programme and whether the advisory process is fast enough. The State Secretary answered that the rise is not clearly explained, that the government followed expert advice to vaccinate infants and 14-year-olds, and that vaccine supply and advisory timelines constrain faster action.
I have asked the Health Council whether vaccination against other meningococcal types should also be given and whether other age groups may also be eligible.
Aan de Gezondheidsraad heb ik gevraagd of ook tegen andere typen meningokokken gevaccineerd moet worden en of wellicht ook andere leeftijdsgroepen daarvoor in aanmerking komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Voordewind, Kuik en Bouali over het bericht dat OS-ontvanger Rwanda de nieuwe shirtsponsor van voetbalclub Arsenal wordt

MPs from VVD, ChristenUnie, CDA and D66 asked the minister whether Rwanda, a development aid recipient, becoming Arsenal's shirt sponsor is consistent with aid dependency concerns and whether the government would raise this with Rwanda. The minister answered that the choice of partner is Rwanda's, that the Netherlands continues a transition relationship with bilateral aid being phased out, and that it will keep discussing the effectiveness of such tourism investments with Rwanda's development board.
The Rwanda Development Board has made no statements about the costs associated with this partnership.
De Rwanda Development Board heeft geen uitspraken gedaan over de kosten die gepaard gaan met dit partnerschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht ‘Help verstandelijk gehandicapten gezonder te leven’

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about a blog reporting worse health and substance use among people with intellectual disabilities, and about prevention efforts and the role of the VGN in the National Prevention Agreement. The State Secretary answered that data are scarce but risk of problematic use is higher, pointed to existing programmes such as Open en Alert and ZonMw research, and explained the VGN's current role in the agreement process.
According to Van der Nagel there are no hard figures on alcohol and drug use among people with mild intellectual disabilities, and the estimates vary widely.
Volgens Van der Nagel zijn er geen harde cijfers over alcohol- en drugsgebruik bij mensen met LVB en de schattingen lopen zeer uiteen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Diks, Van den Hul en Kuik over buitenlandse investeringen in Ethiopië

MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about foreign investment in Ethiopia after a documentary on large-scale land grabs, and how Dutch investment, World Bank programmes and civil society support could prevent harm to people and the environment. The minister acknowledged the problems in large-scale projects, said Dutch investments are generally much smaller and that the embassy requires due diligence and IMVO compliance, and committed to pressing the World Bank on FPIC and civil society space.
Alleged violations of the OECD Guidelines can be reported to the National Contact Point for the OECD Guidelines (NCP).
Vermeende schendingen van de OESO-richtlijnen kunnen worden gemeld bij het Nationaal Contact Punt voor de OESO-richtlijnen (NCP).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya, Kuik en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Promotiemeisjes van Heineken verkopen bier met hun lichaam’

MPs Alkaya, Kuik and Voordewind asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that Heineken promotion girls in Africa are subjected to sexual harassment, and about the responsibility of parent companies, legal options, and Heineken subsidies. The minister said companies must address abuses throughout their supply chain under UN and OECD guidelines, that the government lacks legal powers to compel them, that a call with Heineken's CEO produced a commitment to prioritise the issue, and that a 2019 evaluation of the IMVO covenants will determine whether legislation is needed.
The government has no legal means to compel Dutch companies to take measures in such cases.
De overheid heeft geen juridische mogelijkheden om Nederlandse bedrijven te dwingen tot het nemen van maatregelen in dergelijke gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Kuik over sugardating

MPs Van der Staaij and Kuik asked whether sugardating platforms that connect young women with wealthy men for sex amount to illegal prostitution or trafficking, whether they should be regulated or investigated, and whether municipalities can act against their advertising. The state secretary answered that no specific permit is needed, existing criminal law (art. 273f) suffices against exploitation, consultations with site operators are constructive, no indications of exploitation are known to the prosecution service, and no further investigation or new municipal powers are planned.
I currently see no reason to conduct further research into this.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om hier verder onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Van der Graaf over het bericht 'Honderden Roma-kinderen in Nederland uitgebuit'

MPs Kuik and Van der Graaf asked about reports that hundreds of Roma children in the Netherlands are exploited, the discrepancy in figures, and what is being done about child exploitation, including handover of minors to unverified relatives. The State Secretary answered that ethnicity is not recorded, estimates are tens of cases with a broader humanitarian definition giving higher numbers, and pointed to continued programmes, a child exploitation expert group, an EU project, and planned measures.
The exact numbers of Roma children are not known to me because ethnicity is not registered by the Public Prosecution Service (OM) and the police.
De exacte aantallen Roma-kinderen zijn mij niet bekend omdat niet wordt geregistreerd op etniciteit door Openbaar Ministerie (hierna: OM) en politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Becker en Kuik over het naar voren halen van de Nederlandse bijdrage aan UNRWA

MPs Voordewind, Becker and Kuik asked why the Netherlands should fill budget gaps at UNRWA caused by the US funding freeze, and about effects on Israel, the PA, other donors and future funding. Minister Kaag answered that the Dutch annual contribution of EUR 13 million was brought forward to address an acute liquidity problem, not to replace US money, and that the government will reassess later in the year without a commitment to top up.
The cabinet decided to make the planned annual contribution to UNRWA available early to mitigate an acute financing problem and give UNRWA the chance and time to find other donors.

Het kabinet heeft besloten de geplande jaarbijdrage voor UNRWA versneld beschikbaar te stellen om een acuut financieringsprobleem te mitigeren en UNRWA de kans en tijd te geven om andere donoren te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de normalisering van gebruik van lachgas voor recreatieve doeleinden

MP Kuik (CDA) asks the government about the normalisation of recreational nitrous oxide use among young people, its benign image, online and retail sales, and enforcement against hospitality businesses supplying it. Minister Bruins answers that a Trimbos study shows concentrated but mostly incidental use, that Trimbos will add prevention on nitrous oxide, and that talks with retailers on voluntary restrictions are ongoing, with stronger measures to be considered if these fail.
I have asked the Trimbos Institute to include nitrous oxide as a specific theme in their current prevention offer to schools, parents and nightlife visitors.
Ik heb het Trimbos-instituut gevraagd lachgas als specifiek thema mee te nemen in hun huidige preventie-aanbod aan scholen, ouders en uitgaanders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kuik over het bericht dat Groninger winkeliers duizenden euro’s aan boetes krijgen

MPs Hijink and Kuik asked whether it is desirable that tenant and owner shopkeepers be forced to open on Sunday shopping days under penalty, and about the burden on small shopkeepers and staff. The State Secretary answered that contractual obligations are permissible but penalties should be a last resort, that the Arnhem-Leeuwarden court ruling clarifies limits on unilateral changes to opening hours, and that the courts, not the government, would judge whether a clause or penalty is unreasonable.
There are no figures on the number of cases in which a penalty is actually imposed.
Er zijn geen cijfers bekend over het aantal gevallen waarin daadwerkelijk een boete wordt opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het promoten van onbeperkt zonnen

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary about a sunbed chain offering unlimited monthly tanning without staff or age checks, in light of the SCHEER report on UV and skin cancer. The minister acknowledged the health risks, said the NVWA would visit the provider to check compliance, and judged additional information measures unnecessary while awaiting EU action.
I have asked the NVWA to visit the Dutch branch of the Danish sunbed provider to check whether the operator complies with the statutory rules for safe use of sunbeds.

Ik heb de NVWA gevraagd om een bezoek te brengen aan de Nederlandse vestiging van de Deense aanbieder van zonnebanken om na te gaan of de ondernemer zich houdt aan de wettelijke voorschriften voor het veilig gebruik van zonnebanken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Kuik over de begeleiding van functiebeperkte studenten die te kort schiet

MPs Van der Molen and Kuik asked the ministers about the 2017 annual report on students with disabilities, uneven support across institutions, the inspectorate's role, and implementation of the UN disability convention. The minister replied that institutions are broadly adequate, that an Inspectorate study is underway with results expected spring 2018, and that a motion-based action plan is being worked out.
Furthermore, I can inform you that the inspectorate is currently conducting a study into the accessibility of higher education for students with a disability.
Verder kan ik u berichten dat de inspectie momenteel een onderzoek uitvoert naar de toegankelijkheid van het hoger onderwijs voor studenten met een functiebeperking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Kuik over het bericht '95 procent van gemeenten heeft geen beleid voor aanpak mensenhandel'

MPs Segers and Kuik asked the State Secretary about reports that 95 percent of municipalities lack anti-trafficking policy, the responsibility of municipalities for victim care, implementation of the Lenferink commission's recommendations, and inconsistent thresholds for the reflection period across border-control agencies. The State Secretary replied that only 4.5 percent of municipalities have specific trafficking policy, promised joint work with stakeholders on victim care and a uniform reflection-period approach, and said a further plan would follow.
Following this report, I will agree further arrangements with the police, the Royal Netherlands Marechaussee and the Inspectorate SZW to reach a uniform way of offering the reflection period.

Naar aanleiding van dit rapport zal ik in overleg met de politie, de Koninklijke Marechaussee en de Inspectie SZW nadere afspraken maken om te komen tot een uniforme wijze van aanbieden van de bedenktijd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de achterblijvende resultaten van het Deltaplan Dementie n.a.v. het artikel op Zorgvisie d.d. 21 september 2017

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Health about press reports that the Deltaplan Dementie has produced few concrete results, including the shelving of the national dementia register and care portal and disputes over research funding. The State Secretary replied that results take time, pointed to ongoing care and awareness programmes, explained that the register and portal were reshaped rather than abandoned, and said research funding is balanced across themes although demand exceeds available money.
Yes, I am in regular contact with the board of the Deltaplan Dementie.
Ja, ik heb regelmatig contact met het bestuur van het Deltaplan Dementie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht dat de Vereniging Gehandicaptenzorg Nederland de noodklok luidt over de zorg van meervoudig ernstig  gehandicapten

An MP asks the State Secretary whether the care standard for people with severe multiple disabilities is met, why financing changes prevent providers from covering losses, and whether the meerzorg budget is sufficient for 2017 and 2018. The State Secretary answers that quality standards and inspection apply, that the sector is financially healthy on average, that meerzorg is part of regional contracting space without a separate budget, and that the Wlz framework was raised by 200 million euros.
The Wlz-wide cost price study carried out by the NZa in the second half of 2017 will provide information on the adequacy of tariffs for care to clients with severe multiple disabilities.

Het Wlz-brede kostprijsonderzoek dat door de NZa wordt uitgevoerd in de tweede helft van 2017 zal informatie opleveren over de toereikendheid van de tarieven voor zorg aan cliënten met ernstige meervoudige beperking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht aangaande de gedwongen verhuizing van een cliënt van een Fokuszorg naar een zelfstandige woning om de benodigde 24-uurszorg te krijgen

An MP asked the State Secretary about a client with severe disability who was forced to move from a Fokus care home to an independent dwelling to obtain 24-hour care, and about the timeline for housing, whether this is systemic, and inter-municipal cooperation. The State Secretary acknowledged the case, said persoonlijke assistentie should start without waiting for relocation, and committed to evaluating the scheme and to further analysis of rolstoel delivery problems with the VNG.

In situations where no other suitable dwelling has yet been found and the client still lives in the ADL home, the client's safety should take priority and an application for personal assistance need not wait until a move has taken place.

In situaties waarin nog geen andere geschikte woning is gevonden en de cliënt nog woonachtig is in de ADL-woning behoort de veiligheid van de cliënt voorop te staan en hoeft een aanvraag voor persoonlijke assistentie niet te wachten tot een verhuizing heeft plaatsgevonden.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Dibi ter vervanging van nr. 19 over de mogelijkheid voor oudkomers een centraal inburgeringsexamen af te leggen en aanspraak te maken op het sociale leenstelsel

Amends the integration law so that long-term lawful residents (oudkomers), who are not obliged to integrate, may also access the social loan scheme and the Wet inburgering for courses and the integration exam.
This amendment makes it possible for oudkomers to claim the social loan scheme for following an integration course or taking the integration exam.
Dit amendement maakt het mogelijk dat oudkomers aanspraak mogen maken op het sociale leenstelsel voor het volgen van een inburgeringscursus of het afleggen van het inburgeringsexamen.
Motie Dibi over opnemen van een eis over duale trajecten in het keurmerk
Asks the government to require in the Blik op Werk quality mark that language providers keep offering dual integration tracks.
requests the government to include a requirement on dual tracks in the Blik op Werk quality mark
verzoekt de regering, in het Blik op Werk Keurmerk een eis op te nemen over duale trajecten
Motie Dibi/Van Dam over het examenonderdeel Kennis van de Nederlandse Samenleving
Asks the government to redesign the civic integration exam component on Dutch society, with more attention to fundamental rights and principles, and to report progress before the summer recess.
to redesign the exam component Knowledge of Dutch Society and give ample attention to fundamental rights
het examenonderdeel Kennis van de Nederlandse Samenleving opnieuw in te richten en daarbij ruime aandacht te besteden aan de grondrechten

Amendement van het lid Dibi c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 26 dat het mogelijk maakt dat vrijwillige inburgeraars een centraal inburgeringsexamen kunnen afleggen en dat zij aanspraak maken op het sociaal
Lets the general administrative order on loans also set rules for loans to non-mandatory participants in civic integration, widening executive rule-making.
rules may also be set on providing a loan to persons other than civic integration obligees
kunnen tevens regels worden gesteld omtrent het verstrekken van een lening aan anderen dan inburgeringsplichtigen
Motie Dibi over een evaluatie van de wet
Asks the government to evaluate the effectiveness of the amended Wet inburgering two years after entry into force, monitoring participation effects.
requests the government to evaluate the effectiveness of the amended Integration Act two years after the changes take effect
verzoekt de regering, de effectiviteit van de gewijzigde Wet inburgering te evalueren twee jaar nadat de wijzigingen in werking zijn getreden
Amendement van het lid Dibi over het vaststellen van de termijn voor het aflossen van de lening
Sets the repayment deadline for the integration loan at one year after the integration period ends or after the integration obligation is met, instead of six months.
in Article 17, first paragraph, first sentence, the phrase 'six months' is replaced in each case by: one year
wordt in artikel 17, eerste lid, eerste volzin, de zinsnede «zes maanden» telkens vervangen door: een jaar

Amendement van de leden Dibi en Schouw ter vervanging van nr. 23 dat het mogelijk maakt dat vrijwillige inburgeraars een centraal inburgeringsexamen kunnen afleggen en dat zij aanspraak mogen maken op
Allows voluntary integrants to take the central integration exam and access the social loan system, extending the Wet inburgering to a group not obliged to integrate.
This amendment makes it possible for voluntary integrants to take a central integration exam and to be eligible for the social loan system.
Dit amendement maakt het mogelijk dat vrijwillige inburgeraars een centraal inburgeringsexamen kunnen afleggen en dat zij aanspraak mogen maken op het sociale leenstelsel.
Amendement van het lid Dibi over het component Kennis van de Nederlandse Grondrechten
Replaces the Dutch society knowledge component of the civic integration exam with knowledge of Dutch constitutional fundamental rights.
the phrase 'knowledge of Dutch society' is replaced by: knowledge of Dutch fundamental rights.
wordt de zinsnede «kennis van de Nederlandse samenleving» vervangen door: kennis van de Nederlandse grondrechten.

Amendement van het lid Dibi dat regelt dat asielgerechtigden nog steeds recht hebben op een vergoeding indien zij binnen drie jaar het door Onze Minister vastgestelde inburgeringsexamen hebben behaald
Asylum holders who pass the civic integration exam within three years keep the right to a reimbursement of literacy course and integration costs, with asylum holders treated as an exception group.
With this amendment, asylum holders are treated as an exception group regarding the independent funding of a possible literacy course and the financing of integration costs.

Met dit amendement worden asielgerechtigden aangemerkt als een uitzonderingsgroep voor wat betreft de eigenstandige bekostiging van een eventuele alfabetiseringscursus en de financiering van de inburgeringskosten.
Amendement van het lid Dibi over de ontkoppeling van het inburgeringsvereiste aan het recht op verblijf
Decouples the civic integration requirement from residence rights by deleting the grounds for revoking or refusing residence permits when the integration exam is failed.
Failing the civic integration exam therefore does not lead to withdrawal of the regular temporary residence permit.
Het niet slagen voor het inburgeringsexamen leidt daarmee niet tot intrekking van de reguliere verblijfsvergunning voor bepaalde tijd.
Amendement van het lid Dibi dat het mogelijk maakt dat vrijwillige inburgeraars een centraal inburgeringsexamen kunnen afleggen en dat zij aanspraak mogen maken op het sociale leenstelsel
Allows voluntary integration migrants to take the central integration exam and access the social loan scheme.
This amendment makes it possible for voluntary integration migrants to take the central integration exam and to claim the social loan scheme
Dit amendement maakt het mogelijk dat vrijwillige inburgeraars een centraal inburgeringsexamen kunnen afleggen en dat zij aanspraak mogen maken op het sociale leenstelsel
Amendement van het lid Dibi over het vertrekken van een sociale lening voor een alfabetiseringscursus
Extends the social loan for the integration exam to cover literacy courses for people who cannot read or write.
With this amendment it is arranged that the social loan is also provided for a literacy course.
Met dit amendement wordt geregeld dat de sociale lening ook verstrekt wordt voor een alfabetiseringscursus.
Amendement van het lid Dibi over de mogelijkheid voor oudkomers een centraal inburgeringsexamen af te leggen en aanspraak te maken op het sociale leenstelsel
Amendment letting older immigrants (oudkomers) take the central integration exam and claim social loans, without making them compulsory, by extending the Integration Act to them.
This amendment makes it possible for oudkomers to take a central integration exam and to be entitled to the social loan system.
Dit amendement maakt het mogelijk dat oudkomers een centraal inburgeringsexamen kunnen afleggen en dat zij aanspraak mogen maken op het sociale leenstelsel.
Motie-Dibi/Berndsen over versterking van de rechtsbeschermende werking

Motion asks the government to investigate how legal protection through objection and appeal can be strengthened in Bibob procedures, where the advice may not be fully disclosed and courts review only marginally.
requests the government to investigate how the legal protection offered by objection and appeal possibilities in Bibob procedures can be strengthened
verzoekt de regering om te onderzoeken hoe de rechtsbeschermende werking van bezwaar- en beroepsmogelijkheden in Bibob-procedures versterkt kan worden
Motie Dibi/Jasper van Dijk over het predikaat zeer zwak voor scholen voor speciaal onderwijs
Asks the government to adopt a policy principle that a special education school may hold the 'very weak' (zeer zwak) inspection rating for no longer than one year.
requests the government, in policy for special secondary education, to adopt the principle that a school may not hold the 'very weak' rating for longer than one year
verzoekt de regering in het beleid voor (voortgezet) speciaal onderwijs het uitgangspunt te hanteren dat een school niet langer dan een jaar het predicaat «zeer zwak» kan hebben
Motie Dibi/Dijsselbloem over de gevolgen van klassenvergroting
Asks the government to map the effects of class enlargement in special education on education quality and inform the House.
requests the government to map the consequences of class enlargement in (secondary) special education for education quality and to inform the House about it
verzoekt de regering de gevolgen van de klassenvergroting in het (voortgezet) speciaal onderwijs voor de kwaliteit van het onderwijs in kaart te brengen en de Kamer hierover te informeren
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Dibi ter vervanging van nr. 10 over het opnemen van een evaluatiebepaling
Adds an evaluation clause requiring the Minister of Justice and Security to report to parliament within three years on the effects of the law on involuntary medical treatment of detainees.
The Minister of Justice and Security sends the States General a report within three years of entry into force on the effectiveness and effects of this law in practice.

Onze Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie zendt binnen drie jaar na de inwerkingtreding van de artikelen I tot en met VI van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk.
Amendement van het lid Dibi dat ertoe strekt de toepassing van onvrijwillige geneeskundige behandelingen te beperken tot bij AMvB vast te stellen psychiatrische stoornissen
Limits compulsory medical treatment to psychiatric disorders designated by general administrative order, and requires public consultation and submission to both chambers before such an order is made.
The proposal for a general administrative order to be set under the first paragraph, under 0a, is not made until the draft has been published in the State Gazette
De voordracht voor een krachtens het eerste lid, onder 0a, vast te stellen algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt niet gedaan dan nadat het ontwerp in de Staatscourant is bekendgemaakt
Motie Slob c.s. over versterking van het brandpreventiebeleid
Asks the government to explore additional ways to strengthen fire prevention policy and report to the House.
requests the government, in consultation with relevant parties, to examine what additional options exist to further strengthen fire prevention policy
verzoekt de regering in overleg met betrokken partijen te onderzoeken welke aanvullende mogelijkheden er nog zijn
Motie Berndsen c.s. over de informatiehuishouding voor brand- en rampenbestrijding
Asks the government to keep information management for fire and disaster response under the Minister of Safety and Justice until its placement within the Institute for Physical Safety is clear.
Requests the government to keep information management for fire and disaster response temporarily under the Minister of Safety and Justice.
verzoekt de regering de informatiehuishouding voor brand- en rampenbestrijding voorlopig in het beheer van de minister voor Veiligheid en Justitie te houden
Amendement van het lid Dibi dat ertoe strekt te verhinderen dat onvrijwillige geneeskundige behandelingen al te lichtvaardig worden toegepast
Replaces 'aannemelijk' with 'aangetoond' so that involuntary medical treatment requires that the danger be proven rather than merely made plausible.
In the submitter's view, the danger must be proven.
Het gevaar moet naar het oordeel van indiener aangetoond worden.
Amendement van het lid Dibi over het opnemen van een evaluatiebepaling
Requires the Minister of Security and Justice to report to the States General within two years on the effectiveness and effects of the involuntary medical treatment law for detainees.

Asks the government to ensure the teacher grant can be used to fund the bridging year needed before a master's as a first-degree teacher.
requests the government to ensure that the teacher grant may be used to fund that bridging year
verzoekt de regering ervoor te zorgen dat de lerarenbeurs gebruikt mag worden om dat schakeljaar te bekostigen
Motie Kraneveldt-van der Veen c.s. over verdere professionalisering van schoolleiders
Asks the government to agree multi-year arrangements with school leader bodies to professionalise all school leaders.
requests the government to enter into consultation with the Dutch school leaders association and school board representatives
verzoekt de regering om samen met de Nederlandse Vereniging van Schoolleiders en de vertegenwoordigers van de schoolbesturen in overleg te treden
Motie Kraneveldt-van der Veen/Dibi over de schoolleider als volwaardige gesprekspartner van de inspectie
Asks the government to restore the school leader's formal position as a full discussion partner in inspectorate talks under the new supervision system.
requests the government to again give the school leader a formal position in the new inspectorate supervision
verzoekt de regering om de schoolleider in het nieuwe inspectietoezicht weer formeel een positie te geven
Motie Kraneveldt-van der Veen c.s. over intensief toezicht op nieuw gestichte scholen
Asks the government to propose that the inspectorate keep intensive supervision of newly founded schools, relaxing it once quality conditions are met.
requests the government to formulate proposals so that the inspectorate standardly conducts intensive supervision of newly founded schools
verzoekt de regering om voorstellen te formuleren om de inspectie bij nieuw gestichte scholen standaard intensief toezicht te laten houden
Motie Dibi/Depla over afspraken over energiebesparing en duurzaam inkopen voor het onderwijs

Asks the government to take the initiative so that energy-saving and sustainable procurement agreements, like those with the HBO council and VSNU, are also made for primary, secondary and vocational education.
requests the government to take the initiative so that agreements also come for primary education, secondary education and vocational education
verzoekt de regering het initiatief te nemen zodat er ook afspraken komen voor het primair onderwijs, het voortgezet onderwijs en het beroepsonderwijs
Motie Bosma c.s. over een rapport van de AIVD, waarin ingegaan wordt op dezelfde onderwerpen als de BVD-rapportage uit 2002
Asks the government to provide the House with an AIVD report comparable in scope to the 2002 BVD report on Islamic schools.
requests the government to provide a report from the AIVD to the House
verzoekt de regering een rapport van de AIVD aan de Kamer te verstrekken
Motie Dibi en Van der Ham over een voorstel voor collegegeldvrij besturen
Asks the government, with student organisations and institutions, to design a proposal for tuition-free full-time board membership and inform the Kamer by 1 May 2009.
requests the government, in consultation with student organisations and institutions, to design a proposal for tuition-free board membership
verzoekt de regering in overleg met studentenorganisaties en de instellingen een voorstel voor collegegeldvrij besturen te ontwerpen
Motie Van der Ham en Dibi over een flexibel tarief voor verblijfsvergunningen voor buitenlandse studenten en onderzoekers
Asks the government to develop a flexible residence permit fee for foreign students and researchers at Dutch higher education institutions.
requests the government to develop a flexible tariff for residence permits
verzoekt de regering een flexibel tarief voor verblijfsvergunningen te ontwikkelen
Motie Dibi over een afgeronde bacheloropleiding als een volwaardige opleiding voor de arbeidsmarkt
Asks the government to examine to what extent a completed bachelor's degree is adequate as a full qualification for the labour market.
requests the government to examine to what extent a completed bachelor's programme qualifies as a full education for the labour market
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken in hoeverre een afgeronde bacheloropleiding voldoet als een volwaardige opleiding voor de arbeidsmarkt
Motie Dibi en Van Gent over de mogelijkheden van "job on the block"
Asks the government to investigate and report to parliament before the spring budget on possibilities for a 'Job on the Block' part-time neighbourhood work scheme for young people.
requests the government to investigate the possibilities of a 'Job on the Block' or part-time job in the neighbourhood and inform the House before the spring budget
verzoekt de regering de mogelijkheden van een «Job on the Block» ofwel bijbaan in de wijk te onderzoeken en de Kamer hierover te informeren
Motie Dibi over het niet verschillend straffen op basis van etniciteit
Asks the government to ensure that no differences in punishment are made on the basis of ethnicity.
requests the government to ensure that no difference is made in punishment on the basis of ethnicity
verzoekt de regering erop toe te zien dat er geen verschil wordt gemaakt in straf op basis van etniciteit
Motie Karabulut c.s. over een taalcursus voor werknemers uit MOE-landen
Asks the government to ensure that workers from Central and Eastern European countries registering in the municipal population register receive an offered language course.
all workers from MOE countries who register in the municipal basic administration receive an offered language course
alle werknemers uit MOE-landen die zich inschrijven in de gemeentelijke basisadministratie, een taalcursus krijgen aangeboden
Motie Dibi en Van Gent over goedkopere huisvesting voor studenten in ruil voor vrijwilligerswerk
Asks the government to explore offering cheaper student housing in exchange for substantial volunteer work in neighbourhoods.
requests the government to examine the possibilities of offering students cheaper housing in exchange for a substantial number of hours of volunteer work in a neighbourhood
verzoekt de regering de mogelijkheden te onderzoeken, studenten goedkoper huisvesting te bieden in ruil voor een substantieel aantal uren vrijwilligerswerk binnen een wijk
Motie Dijsselbloem c.s. over informatie over specifieke problemen binnen specifieke bevolkingsgroepen
Asks the government to report annually in the Integration Yearbook on developments among specific population groups such as Iraqis, Afghans, Somalis, Roma and Sinti and Moluccans.
requests the government to also annually provide insight in the Integration Yearbook into relevant developments among specific population groups
verzoekt de regering in het Jaarrapport Integratie ook jaarlijks inzicht te geven in relevante ontwikkelingen onder specifieke bevolkingsgroepen
Motie Dijsselbloem c.s. over van taalcursussen op ETV
Motion asks the government to secure continuity of funding for language courses broadcast on the educational channel ETV, which so far had only temporary project subsidy.
requests the government to ensure the continuity of the offer of language courses on the educational channel ETV
verzoekt de regering de continuïteit van het aanbod van taalcursussen op de educatieve zender ETV zeker te stellen
Motie-Koser Kaya/Dibi over het niet meer dan twee bestuurslagen verantwoordelijk maken voor het welzijn van kinderen
Asks the government for a plan within six months ensuring no more than two administrative layers are responsible for child welfare.
requests the government to send the House within six months a worked-out plan on how it will ensure that no more than two administrative layers are responsible for child welfare
verzoekt de regering de Kamer binnen zes maanden een uitgewerkt plan te sturen hoe zij ervoor gaat zorgen dat er niet meer dan twee bestuurslagen
Motie-Dibi c.s. over verdeling van de verantwoordelijkheid voor het wegwerken van de wachtlijsten in de jeugdzorg
Asks the government, together with provinces and city regions, to have each share responsibility for clearing youth care waiting lists.
requests the government, in consultation with the provinces and the three city regions, that each take its own share of responsibility
verzoekt de regering in samenspraak met de provincies en de drie stadsregio’s ieder zijn eigen deel van de verantwoordelijkheid te nemen
Motie-Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink c.s. over een actieplan voor terugdringing van de tekorten aan zorgverleners
Asks the government to submit to the House, before the 2009 accountability debate, an action plan analysing and tackling the shortage of youth care workers.
requests the government to present the House with an action plan before the Accountability 2009.
verzoekt de regering uiterlijk vóór de Verantwoording 2009 de Kamer een actieplan voor te leggen
Motie van het lid Dibi over de mogelijkheid voor jongeren om na een uitspraak van de kinderrechter in hoger beroep te gaan
Asks the government to make it possible for young people to appeal to the court of appeal after a ruling by the juvenile judge.
it is not possible for young people to appeal after a ruling by the juvenile judge
het niet mogelijk is dat jongeren in hoger beroep gaan na een uitspraak van de kinderrechter
Motie-Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink/Dibi over een midterm review over medebetrokkenheid bij beleidsterreinen waarvoor andere bewindspersonen primair verantwoordelijk zijn

Asks the government to give parliament a midterm review by February 2009 on how the Youth and Family minister's shared involvement in policy areas led by other ministers has worked financially and substantively.
requests the government to give the House a midterm review by February 2009 on how this shared involvement has financially and substantively worked in practice
verzoekt de regering de Kamer uiterlijk februari 2009 een midterm review te geven over hoe deze medebetrokkenheid financieel en inhoudelijk in de praktijk wel en niet heeft gewerkt
Motie-Dibi over aanpassing van kerndoel 34 in het basisonderwijs ten behoeve van meer seksuele voorlichting
Asks the government to amend basic-school core objective 34 to include sexual health in the pupils' learning goals.
requests the government to amend core objective 34 so that its text reads
verzoekt de regering kerndoel 34 zodanig aan te passen dat de tekst komt te luiden
qa: Antwoord vragen van het lid Dibi over ondeugdelijke politiecellen

An MP asked the government why a newly built Apeldoorn police custody complex and the Netherlands' police cells fall short of European standards, and what safeguards exist, and asked about child immigration detention and handcuffing of detainees. The minister answered that the cells meet guidelines via daylight openings, that regional custody commissions and the Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie provide oversight, that children are only rarely detained, and that handcuffing has been restricted to a not-by-default principle.
In addition, a Custody Supervisory Commission has been established in every region, in accordance with the Decree on the management of regional police forces.
Daarnaast is in elke regio een Commissie van Toezicht Politiecellen ingesteld, conform het Besluit beheer regionale politiekorpsen.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed en Dibi over schending door Eritrea van het VN wapenembargo

MPs El Fassed and Dibi asked the government about Eritrea's reported 2% diaspora tax funding its military in apparent breach of the UN arms embargo, and whether such practices occur in the Netherlands. The minister said the tax is not judged to breach the embargo, that police and prosecutors depend on victim complaints, that the Eritrean chargé was summoned, and that the issue is raised in EU fora.
While an investigation is ongoing, no statements are made about it.
Lopende een onderzoek worden geen mededelingen daarover gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dibi over het bericht dat de verkoop van wiet is verplaatst naar de straat

An MP asked the Justice minister about reports that cannabis sales had moved from coffeeshops to the street after the wietpas introduction, asking about complaints, arrests, member-list obligations, and an earlier evaluation. The minister said street dealing has occurred and police act on it, gave 386 arrests in Limburg (not all drug-dealing related), said a full national complaint count does not exist, confirmed coffeeshops must produce controllable member lists, and promised a report to parliament in October 2012 with the evaluation's interim report expected in spring 2013.
A quantitative overall picture does not exist.
Een kwantitatief totaalbeeld is er niet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dibi over de wietpas in Maastricht

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the cannabis 'wietpas' in Maastricht, which reportedly pushed buyers toward illegal street dealing, should be reversed given rising nuisance and public health concerns. The Minister says police act against street dealing, he is in continuous consultation with the regional tripartite bodies, drug tourism has fallen sharply, and he will report to parliament in October 2012 without committing to reversal.
Antwoord vragen van de leden El Fassed en Dibi over de opvang van Syrische vluchtelingen

GroenLinks MPs El Fassed and Dibi asked the foreign minister whether the Netherlands should admit Syrian refugees given the strain on Turkey and neighbouring countries, and whether he would press EU partners on this. The minister replied that refugee relief should remain in the region, that the Netherlands has offered extra support to host countries, and that the refugee issue was raised at the Gymnich meeting, without committing to admitting refugees.
Refugee reception should take place in the region.
Opvang van vluchtelingen dient in de regio te gebeuren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dibi over het bericht dat naar Sri Lanka uitgezette Tamils zijn gedetineerd en gemarteld

An MP from GroenLinks asked the immigration minister about two Tamils deported to Sri Lanka in August 2012, one reportedly detained and tortured on arrival, and whether deportations should halt pending a review of risks for Tamils returning. The minister declined to discuss the individual cases because court proceedings were ongoing, and said current policy would stay in place until a new country report is published in November.
In both cases a court procedure is still ongoing. Partly in the interest of those involved, I cannot go into the substance of these cases at this time.
In beide zaken loopt nog een rechterlijke procedure. Mede in het belang van betrokkenen, kan ik op dit moment niet ingaan op de inhoud van deze zaken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Klaver en Dibi over "het bericht dat de werkloosheid sterk is toegenomen"

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the sharp rise in unemployment to 510,000 and rising youth unemployment, asking for extra measures, a European youth guarantee and a special Eurotop. The minister replied that the rise is mainly due to weak growth and expected to continue until 2014, that budget consolidation and structural reforms are the answer, and that the youth unemployment level compares well within Europe.
Only with a strong and healthy economy can employment grow.
Alleen met een sterke en gezonde economie kan de werkgelegenheid groeien.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dibi over het bericht dat de Nationale Ombudsman concludeert dat de vreemdelingenbewaring inhumaan is

MP Dibi asked the ministers whether they accept the Ombudsman's conclusion that immigration detention is inhumane, whether detention should be a last resort with alternatives preferred, and how the government responds to detention conditions. The minister replied that detention is a last resort, pilots with alternatives run until a 2013 evaluation, minors are largely no longer detained, and the government rejects that detention conditions are inhuman while promising incremental improvements.
Unlike the National Ombudsman, we are of the view that there is no question of inhuman detention conditions in detention centres.
Anders dan de Nationale ombudsman zijn wij van mening dat er geen sprake is van mensonwaardige detentieomstandigheden in detentiecentra.
Antwoord vragen van de leden El Fassed en Dibi over inperking van vrijheid van meningsuiting door verschillende landen

MPs El Fassed and Dibi asked the Foreign Minister about restrictions on freedom of expression abroad, including the arrests in Belarus and Morocco and the Pussy Riot trial in Russia. The minister listed Dutch efforts on internet freedom and religious freedom, condemned the Belarus detentions, and said the EU and Dutch officials had raised concerns with Russia and Morocco.
I strongly condemn the intimidation, arrest and detention of journalists, human rights activists and other Belarusian citizens who exercise their universal rights, including Anton Suryapin.

Ik veroordeel de intimidatie, arrestatie en detentie van journalisten, mensenrechtenactivisten en andere Wit-Russische burgers die gebruik maken van hun universele rechten, waaronder Anton Suryapin, ten stelligste.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dibi over Griekse acties tegen illegaal in Griekenland verblijvende vreemdelingen

An MP asked the immigration minister about Greek police sweeps arresting undocumented migrants, including lawfully resident foreigners, and whether the Netherlands would stop Dublin transfers to Greece and assist Greece. The minister said Greece's operation targets only undocumented migrants, that Dublin transfers to Greece were already halted in 2011, and that the Netherlands supports Greece via Frontex and EASO while stressing Greece bears primary responsibility.
I will continue to emphasise the importance of humane treatment of foreigners, both within the EU and bilaterally.
Antwoord 5 Ik zal het belang van een menswaardige behandeling van de vreemdeling blijven benadrukken, zowel in EU-verband als bilateraal.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dibi, Schouw en Dijksma over een (voorlopige) stop op uitzetting vreemdelingen met een 1F-status

MPs Dibi, Schouw and Dijksma asked the minister whether the 1F asylum policy (excluding persons with serious crime or war crime suspicions) should be suspended pending European Court rulings and a new cabinet, and whether the families concerned would be informed. The minister replied that there is no reason to change the policy, that Court interim measures are individual and do not imply policy change, and that he will not suspend departures, citing the need for clarity.
I therefore see no reason to adjust the policy.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om het beleid aan te passen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dibi over de aanpak van kindersekstoerisme

An MP asked whether child sex tourism cases should be registered separately and whether a separate criminal offence should be created, given concerns about weak insight into its scale. The state secretary replied that child sex tourism is not a specific offence but is already punishable under Dutch law when committed abroad, that separate registration would not add effectiveness, and that the real problem is weak investigation abroad.
A separate registration of child sex tourism by the police and the Public Prosecution Service does not strengthen the effectiveness of the Dutch approach.
Een afzonderlijke registratie van kindersekstoerisme bij politie en OM versterkt de effectiviteit van de Nederlandse aanpak niet.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat een DJ hardhandig is gearresteerd door politie (ingezonden 30 juli 2012).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a viral report of a DJ being forcibly arrested by police in Eindhoven and whether an investigation would be requested. The minister said an investigation was started as usual after use of force, described the grounds for the arrest and the crowd-control measures, and defended the restrictive enforcement policy.
As is usual with a use of force, an investigation was launched immediately after the incident.
Zoals te doen gebruikelijk bij een geweldsaanwending, is direct na het incident een onderzoek in gang gezet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dibi in reactie op Kamerstuk 30573, nr. 108 om de leges voor langdurig ingezeten derdelanders te verlagen naar 130 euro

MP Dibi asked the minister why the fee for long-term resident third-country nationals was cut to 130 euro without referencing EU averages, why the 1250 euro family reunification fee was not also reduced, and why overpaid fees are not all refunded. The minister answered that the CJEU ruling required a substantial reduction, declined substantive comment on family reunification fees because the matter is pending before the Council of State, and set out a refund scheme covering open or new applications but not decisions already final.
As long as this procedure is before the court, I cannot comment on it in substance.
Zolang deze procedure onder de rechter is, kan ik daar niet inhoudelijk op ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dibi over verwestering als verblijfsgrond voor een Somalische vluchteling

An MP asks the minister whether a Raad van State ruling on Westernisation as a risk factor for Somali refugees returning through Al-Shabaab territory changes asylum policy, how many Somalis are affected, and whether similar reassessments apply to other countries and to rooted Somali children. The minister answers that the test applies individually only to Central and South Somalia cases, cannot give numbers, will review other countries via country reports, and rejects a structural child-asylum scheme.
I therefore cannot give you a number of the Somali foreign nationals to whom this ruling applies.
Ik kan u dan ook geen aantal geven van het aantal Somalische vreemdelingen op wie deze uitspraak betrekking heeft.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dibi over grootschalige schending van de Wet Bescherming Persoonsgegevens door de politie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police forces widely violate privacy rules and what emergency measures and safeguards will be taken. The minister confirmed awareness, clarified the law at issue is the Police Data Act, described an action plan on authorisation, logging and privacy officers, and pointed to audit cycles and the data protection supervisor as safeguards.
The regional police chiefs drew up an action plan in early 2012 following the external privacy audit report.
De verantwoordelijke korpsbeheerders hebben naar aanleiding van de rapportage van de externe privacy audit bij de korpsen aan het begin van 2012 een actieplan opgesteld.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dibi, Voordewind, Gesthuizen, Dijksma, Thieme, Schouw over het bericht 'Syrische asielzoekers eisen duidelijkheid'

Six MPs asked the minister about a report that Syrian asylum seekers demanded clarity on their status, including whether group-wide protection under the Qualification Directive applies and how hunger strikes could be prevented. The minister replied that a 3 August letter sets out the policy, that individual assessment remains the starting point, and that Syrians not shown to be active supporters of the regime may receive temporary asylum residence permits under the Aliens Act.
On 3 August I informed your House about how I have shaped the country-based asylum policy regarding Syria.
Op 3 augustus jl. heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de wijze waarop ik het landgebonden asielbeleid ten aanzien van Syrië heb vormgegeven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dibi over het adviseurschap van het instituut Dar-al-‘Ilm

MP Dibi asked whether the government takes advice from the Dar-al-'Ilm institute, which hosts the controversial preacher Haitham al-Haddad, and whether it is transparent about external advisers. The minister said he rejects al-Haddad's views, will not use the institute's services himself, cannot confirm which bodies have used it, and that full transparency on external advisers across government is not feasible.

From my position and from the position of the minister of BZK, it is however not possible to have a complete overview of the external hiring of advisers across the whole government and all Dutch institutions.

Vanuit mijn positie en vanuit de positie van de minister van BZK is het echter niet mogelijk om een volledig overzicht te hebben van de externe inhuur van adviseurs bij de gehele overheid en bij alle Nederlandse instellingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dibi over de aanpak van kindersekstoerisme

MP Dibi asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about child sex tourism, including a Limburg suspect in Ghana who was released on bail and can travel freely, and whether Dutch enforcement lacks effectiveness. State Secretary Teeven answered that no separate offence exists, that cases are not registered separately, that the suspect was not pursued for lack of hard evidence, and that a follow-up campaign and a crime analysis are planned.
Child sex tourism is therefore not registered separately in the Public Prosecution Service systems, so it cannot be stated how many cases ended in a conviction.
Kindersekstoerisme wordt derhalve niet afzonderlijk geregistreerd in de systemen van het Openbaar Ministerie, zodat niet aan te geven is hoeveel zaken in een veroordeling zijn geëindigd.
Antwoord vragen Dibi over het bericht 'Honderden ontslagen door de wietpas'

Dibi (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that hundreds were dismissed due to the 'wietpas' (cannabis pass) and whether the policy should be ended immediately. Staatssecretaris Teeven acknowledged the report and refused to end the stricter coffeeshop policy, stating implementation is proceeding as expected.
I therefore see no reason to stop the policy.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om het beleid stop te zetten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dibi over de dood van een Turkse arrestant in een politiecel

MP Dibi asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the relatives of a Turkish man who died in a police cell have been given full access to the investigation files, and if not, why not and whether all information will be shared. The minister replies that the public prosecutor keeps the relatives informed and has shared all information currently available, but that full sharing is not possible while the investigation is ongoing.
Because the investigation is still ongoing, it is however not possible to share all available information with them.
Omdat het onderzoek nog loopt is het echter niet mogelijk om alle beschikbare informatie met hen te delen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dibi en Klaver over werkgevers die particuliere recherchebureaus inschakelen

MPs Dibi and Klaver asked ministers whether private detective agencies hired by employers are inadequately supervised after licensing, whether this violates employees' privacy, and whether such agencies should access government databases. Minister Opstelten replied that a risk-based police inspection and a privacy-focused CBP supervision effort are being strengthened, that privacy violations are for courts to judge, and that private detectives get no access to the municipal population register or sensitive vehicle registry data.
In consultation with the police and the CBP, I am examining how supervision of compliance with privacy rules by private detective agencies can be strengthened.
In samenspraak met politie en CBP onderzoek ik op welke wijze het toezicht op de naleving van de privacyregels door particuliere recherchebureaus kan worden versterkt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden El Fassed en Dibi over de communicatiemogelijkheden van gedetineerde vreemdelingen

MPs El Fassed and Dibi asked about the limited internet access, and the lack of email and social media access, for foreign nationals in immigration detention, and whether the UK and Australia are models. The state secretary answered that a pilot in two detention centres allowed restricted access to a whitelist of approved sites, that the pilot was positively evaluated, and that internet facilities will be further developed with a decision on continuation to follow.
Following the positive outcomes of the pilot evaluation, the internet facility for detainees will be further developed, after which a decision on continuation will be taken.

Naar aanleiding van de positieve uitkomsten van de evaluatie van de pilot zal de internetfaciliteit voor ingeslotenen verder ontwikkeld worden, waarna besluitvorming over voortzetting plaats zal vinden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dibi en Voortman over de overwegingen van de GGD bij het keuren van uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers

MPs Voortman and Dibi asked whether GGD doctors assessing rejected asylum seekers are influenced by non-medical considerations, whether untreated dental cases reflect this, and whether the Inspectorate should investigate. Minister Schippers said doctors must judge objectively, defended excluding specialist dental care from the care fund as parallel to insured patients, and said the Inspectorate will address vulnerable groups broadly rather than a separate inquiry.
I prefer such a broad approach over an approach that only looks at the role of one target group and/or actor.
Ik geef de voorkeur aan een dergelijke brede insteek boven een insteek die slechts toeziet op de rol van één doelgroep en/of actor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Fassed en Dibi over de onrechtmatige huiszoeken tegen Megaupload

MPs El Fassed and Dibi asked whether Dutch police and justice cooperated with a US request in the Megaupload case after a New Zealand court ruled the search warrants unlawful for lack of specificity, and whether an independent judicial review will be arranged. The minister answered that the Netherlands has no role in US-to-New Zealand requests, that the incoming request was tested against treaty and Dutch law and carried out under an investigating judge, and that all incoming requests are checked before execution with the same safeguards as domestic investigations.
The Netherlands has no role in legal assistance requests that the American authorities address to the New Zealand authorities.
Nederland heeft geen tussenkomst bij rechtshulpverzoeken die de Amerikaanse autoriteiten richten tot de Nieuw-Zeelandse autoriteiten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dibi naar aanleiding van het nieuwsbericht “Journalisten spioneerden voor de AIVD” in de Telegraaf van 15 juni 2012

An MP asked whether the AIVD paid journalists to gather intelligence during the 2008 Beijing Olympics and whether it should be restricted from using journalists as sources. The minister declined to confirm or deny the report in public, said AIVD staff follow a careful weighing process and internal instructions when approaching anyone, and rejected excluding journalists in principle.
I cannot make any public statement about whether the report is correct or incorrect.
Over de juistheid, dan wel de onjuistheid van het bericht kan ik in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen, Dijksma, Voordewind, Dibi en Schouw over de ontstane situatie in Ter Apel

Five MPs asked the minister whether a clearance of the tent camp of rejected asylum seekers in Ter Apel had begun, and about its course, the pending summary proceedings, and the medical condition of residents. The minister replied that residents were offered temporary shelter with a freedom-restriction measure, that the Iraqi group left voluntarily, and that the mayor issued an emergency order to end the action on safety grounds.
In line with my commitment made in the emergency debate of 15 May 2012, I will inform you fully in writing as soon as possible once the action has ended.
Conform mijn toezegging gedaan in het spoeddebat van 15 mei 2012, zal ik u schriftelijk zo spoedig mogelijk volledig informeren zodra de actie is afgelopen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dibi over de op handen zijnde uitzetting van een Kosovaarse familie die al 18 jaar in Groesbeek woont

An MP asked the immigration minister whether a Kosovar family living 18 years in Groesbeek was about to be deported, whether the head of household was deported in 2002, why his stay in Luxembourg counted against the family under the general pardon, and whether the government would reconsider given UNICEF findings on harm to minors. The minister replied that the report was inaccurate, the family chose voluntary return with IOM support and left on 25 April, the 2002 claim was wrong, and the general pardon condition of uninterrupted residence since 2001 was not met due to Luxembourg asylum applications.
I apply the principle of being reticent about providing information on individual cases.
Ik hanteer het uitgangspunt om terughoudend om te gaan met het verstrekken van informatie over individuele zaken.
Antwoord vragen Van Dam, Gesthuizen, Dibi, Schouw en Voordewind over het stopzetten van zestien hoger beroepprocedures en het niet uitzetten van zestien Somaliërs

MPs from five parties asked the immigration minister why he withdrew appeals in sixteen Somali asylum cases and stopped detention and removals, given the security situation in Mogadishu. The minister replied that return to North Somalia remains possible via Mogadishu airport, that the appeals were withdrawn because forced return could not be organised in a way he considered responsible at present, that detention was lifted, and that returnees without state-funded shelter are not entitled to accommodation.
That is why the appeals were withdrawn.
Daarom zijn de hoger beroepen ingetrokken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dibi over de vraag wie de handhaving van de wietpas voor zijn rekening neemt

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Security and Justice who is responsible for enforcing the 'wietpas' (membership pass for cannabis coffeeshops), privacy aspects and whether implementation should be delayed. The minister replied that responsibility remains with the mayor and police as before, that the privacy advice was already sent to parliament, and that no delay is needed.
