There is no lack of clarity. The tightened coffeeshop policy brings no changes to the existing enforcement responsibilities.
Er is geen sprake van onduidelijkheid. Het aangescherpte coffeeshopbeleid brengt geen wijzigingen in de bestaande verantwoordelijkheden in de handhaving.
Antwoord vragen Van Dam en Dibi over de overplaatsing van een Afghaans gezin met kinderen uit Akkrum naar de gezinslocatie in Katwijk

MPs Van Dam and Dibi asked whether an Afghan family with two Dutch-born school-age children would be moved from Akkrum to a family detention-style location in Katwijk, and why, given the parents' willingness to cooperate on return. The minister replied that the transfer is not going ahead, the family may stay in Akkrum pending a new hardship-based application, and he generally declined to discuss individual files.
I always exercise restraint in providing information about individual files.
Ik betracht steeds terughoudendheid met het verstrekken van informatie over individuele dossiers.
Antwoord vragen Dibi over huiszoekingen in aanloop naar Koninginnedag

Dibi (GroenLinks) asked whether the Rhenen mayor could carry out house searches and arrests before Queen's Day 2012 when residents refused entry, and whether this breaches constitutional home protections. Minister Spies replied that no search was planned, entry without consent requires a legal basis and warrant under the Koninginnedag emergency ordinance and general bylaw, and proportionality is reviewable by courts, but declined to talk to the mayor.
Entry without the resident's consent is a restriction of the right to the home, as guaranteed in Article 12 of the Constitution.
Binnentreden zonder toestemming van de bewoner is een inperking van het huisrecht, zoals gegarandeerd in artikel 12 van de Grondwet.
Antwoord vragen Dibi over de voedingsbodem voor extremisme gelet op de schokkende aanslagen op een joodse school in Toulouse, een moskee in Brussel en diepgewortelde islamofobie in Nederland

An MP asked ministers how intelligence services will stay alert to online jihadist mobilisation and Islamophobia after the Toulouse and Brussels attacks, and whether a dialogue with Jewish and Islamic organisations will be initiated. The ministers answered that the counterterrorism strategy prioritises jihadism and that the AIVD investigates jihadist networks online, while on Islamophobia and dialogue they pointed to existing contacts and monitoring without committing to new steps.
The cabinet is always vigilant regarding discrimination and/or extremism, regardless of the ideology underlying it.
Het kabinet is altijd waakzaam waar het gaat om discriminatie en/of extremisme, ongeacht welke ideologie daar aan ten grondslag ligt.
Antwoord vragen Dibi over de aanhouding van een journalist van de omroep Zeeland tijdens een oefening

MP Dibi asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police wrongly detained a regional broadcaster's journalist during an exercise on the Oosterscheldekering, and whether press freedom is being hindered by police discretion, and proposed agreed conduct rules with the journalists' association. The minister confirmed the detention due to confusion with an exercise actor, expressed regret, announced an evaluation, and stated journalists may report freely but must follow local rules, declining to commit to new agreements with the journalists' association.
The day after the incident, a conversation took place between the journalist and representatives of the police and defence.
De dag na het incident heeft een gesprek tussen de journalist en afgevaardigden van politie en defensie plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord vragen Dibi, Hilkens, Schouw, Voordewind en Gesthuizen over het groeiende aantal gemeenten dat kritiek uit op het illegalenbeleid

MPs from five parties asked the immigration and justice ministers about municipalities criticising the government's policy on undocumented migrants and whether municipalities may set their own police priorities on this. Minister Leers answered that the police keep priority on criminal and nuisance-causing foreigners, that municipal mayors have authority over local police priorities, and that the police will still address vulnerable illegals with due regard for their situation.
Within his authority, the mayor can independently set priorities regarding police deployment in his municipality.
In het kader van zijn gezag kan de burgemeester eigenstandig prioriteiten stellen met betrekking tot de politie-inzet in zijn gemeente.
Antwoord vragen Dibi over liegende politieagenten

MP Dibi asked the Justice Minister about police officers who allegedly lied in official reports, whether internal integrity investigations and suspensions had followed, how many integrity investigations occurred over five years, and whether the minister will report annually on police integrity. The minister answered that the prosecutor is appealing a court ruling, that no separate investigation or suspension is planned pending appeal, that about 1,400 internal investigations occur yearly with around 450 involving the prosecutor, and that annual integrity reporting will be included in the police annual report.
I have previously committed to reporting on this. I intend to include the annual report in the Dutch Police annual report.
Ik heb eerder toegezegd hierover te rapporteren. Ik ben voornemens de jaarlijkse rapportage op te nemen in het jaarverslag Nederlandse Politie.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Dibi, Samsom en Gesthuizen over de gevolgen van verschillende gerechtelijke uitspraken voor lopende procedures van Iraanse bekeerlingen

MPs from several parties asked the minister how pending CJEU prejudicial questions and an ECtHR interim measure on Iranian converts affect asylum cases, and whether processing and removals should be suspended. The minister replied that the questions do not specifically target Iranian converts, that the interim measure is unreasoned and has no general effect, and that Dutch policy on religious persecution remains unchanged, so no suspension is planned.
The interim measure taken by the European Court of Human Rights is not reasoned.
De door het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens getroffen voorlopige maatregel (interim measure) is niet gemotiveerd.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Timmermans, Van Bommel, Van der Staaij en Dibi over het bericht dat speciale milities in Irak jacht maken op homoseksuele, biseksuele, lesbische en transgender Irakezen

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Affairs and Immigration ministers whether reports of militias hunting LGBT Iraqis are confirmed, whether Iraq's interior ministry should be challenged, and whether LGBT asylum seekers should be returned to Iraq. Minister Rosenthal confirmed the reports, said the Dutch embassy warned Iraqi officials, stated Nederland currently funds no related projects, and pointed to a more lenient policy for this group.
Antwoord vragen Dibi over de strengere bestraffing van verdachten met een buitenlands uiterlijk

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police judges sentence suspects with a foreign appearance more harshly than Dutch suspects, what causes this, and whether further research will be done. The minister referred to his earlier answers to parliamentary questions from another MP, without restating substance here.
I refer to my answers to the questions from Mr Recourt of your House.
Ik verwijs naar mijn antwoorden op de vragen van het lid Recourt van uw Kamer
Antwoord vragen Dibi over een zaak waarbij een Congolese man mogelijk wordt uitgezet.

An MP asks the immigration minister about a Congolese man facing deportation, including whether a corrupt embassy-written country report influenced his case, whether he risks the death penalty, and whether he may await a European Court ruling in the Netherlands. The minister denies the corruption allegation, says the courts upheld the country reports, and refuses to suspend deportation pending the Strasbourg complaint absent an interim measure.
I consider this suspicion unfounded and incorrect.
Dit vermoeden acht ik ongegrond en onjuist.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dibi over de arrestatie van een getraumatiseerde bootvluchteling

An MP asked the immigration minister why a traumatised boat survivor with an Italian residence permit was detained for deportation under the Dublin rules, and whether detention would be lifted in favour of appropriate care. The minister said the detention was proportionate given his refusal to leave, but after the Council of State's interim order barring transfer to Italy he lifted detention and moved him to COA reception.
Because the detention might therefore no longer be of short duration, I decided to lift the detention and saw reason to place the person in COA reception.
Omdat de inbewaringstelling hierdoor mogelijk niet meer van korte duur zou zijn, heb ik besloten de bewaring op te heffen en heb ik reden gezien de betrokkene te laten plaatsen in de COA-opvang.
Antwoord vragen Dibi over het bericht dat het kabinet af wil van de dubbele nationaliteit

An MP asks the Interior Minister why the government wants to abolish dual nationality, questioning its priority and the consistency of MPs holding two passports. The minister answers that a single nationality clarifies citizens' legal position, that the bill only applies to future cases, and that loss of Dutch nationality follows only voluntary acquisition of another nationality.
The bill will only apply to new cases, that is, to persons who change nationality in the future.
Het wetsvoorstel zal alleen betrekking hebben op nieuwe gevallen, dat wil zeggen, voor personen die in de toekomst van nationaliteit veranderen.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Recourt, Dibi, Schouw en Gesthuizen over het bericht ‘Zorgen over quotum aanhouden illegalen’

MPs from five parties asked the immigration and justice ministers about reports that police were given a quota of undocumented migrants to apprehend, and how this affects their access to care and education. The minister answered that the agreement aims to keep the police migration-enforcement task prioritised within existing capacity, that illegal residents keep their right to necessary care and minors to education, and that police decide how to implement the task.
The WODC presented in 2011 the results of a study estimating the number of illegal residents in the Netherlands in 2009.
Het WODC heeft in 2011 de resultaten van een onderzoek naar het geschatte aantal illegalen in Nederland in 2009 gepresenteerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Schouw, Samsom, Dibi en Voordewind over de uitzetting van een Georgisch gezin



G.B.M. Leers

Five MPs asked the minister about the planned deportation of a 17-year-old Georgian girl after ten years in the Netherlands, including her mother's disability, the duration of asylum procedures, the father's alleged risks in Georgia, and whether she should be spared removal pending answers. The minister's reply was sent only for confidential inspection, citing privacy sensitivity, so the substantive answers are not public.

Given the privacy-sensitive aspects, I request that the answers be made available solely for confidential inspection at the Central Information Point of the House of Representatives of the States General.
Gelet op de privacygevoelige aspecten verzoek ik u de antwoorden enkel ter vertrouwelijke inzage bij het Centraal Informatiepunt van de Tweede Kamer der Staten-Generaal te leggen.
Antwoord vragen Dibi over het bericht dat kindermishandeling langdurige schade kan veroorzaken

An MP asked the state secretary whether she would act on research showing that physical punishment of children harms their development, and what measures are in place against corrective smacking. The secretary said child abuse is a top priority, pointed to the Kinderen Veilig 2012–2016 action plan, a mandatory reporting code bill and training for professionals, and noted that physical punishment has been banned by law since 2007.
I am convinced that professionals, including those working at the CJG, will better identify cases when they have a reporting code, including when it concerns physical punishment.
Ik ben er van overtuigd dat professionals, waaronder professionals die werkzaam zijn in het CJG, beter zullen signaleren wanneer zij beschikken over een meldcode, ook als het gaat om fysiek straffen.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed en Dibi over de Amerikaanse actie tegen Megaupload en de arrestatie van een Nederlander

MPs El Fassed and Dibi (GroenLinks) asked about the US shutdown of Megaupload, the arrest of a Dutch national, Dutch cooperation via mutual legal assistance requests, and the seizure of Dutch servers. The minister said Dutch cooperation rested on existing treaties, that the servers were seized at US request under a pending foreign investigation, and declined to disclose further details.
I cannot provide further information on the background of the seizure or the content of the servers, because this concerns an ongoing foreign investigation.
Over de achtergronden van de inbeslagname en over de inhoud van de servers kan ik verder geen mededelingen doen omdat het hier een lopend (buitenlands) onderzoek betreft.
Antwoord vragen Dibi over de jacht op illegale werksters door de vreemdelingenpolitie

Dibi (GroenLinks) asked whether police hunting undocumented domestic workers based on ethnic appearance, and continuing after a court ruling, was lawful and why it was not stopped or compensated. Minister Leers answered that the police kept acting until the Council of State ruled, found no reason for a special compensation scheme, and said the victims can claim damages via the detention-related appeal route.
In doing so, the general profile relied on the physical features of part of the target group in a way that is not compatible with the applicable provisions.
Daarbij is bij het algemene signalement geleund op de uiterlijke kenmerken van een deel van de doelgroep op een wijze die zich niet verhoudt met de daarvoor geldende bepalingen.
Antwoord vragen Dibi over het bericht dat een kind in het buitenland bijna nooit naar een ouder mag reizen die al een verblijfsvergunning heeft

Dibi (GroenLinks) asked the minister about reports that children abroad almost never get permission to join a parent already granted residence in the Netherlands, and whether the strict family reunification policy, evidentiary burden and hearing practice fit EU rules and the Convention on the Rights of the Child. Minister Leers answered that fraud, especially among Somali applicants, justifies the strict approach, that the high refusal rate reflects referrals for further investigation, and that child-friendly hearings and priority handling for unaccompanied children are in place.
I am aware of the Defence for Children report.
Ik ken het bericht van Defence for Children.

Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister voor Immigratie, Integratie en Asiel over het bericht dat in Nederland geboren kinderen worden meegeteld in de immigratiecijfers (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

Dibi asked the minister whether children born in the Netherlands are counted in immigration figures, including about 20 percent of family-migration applications at the IND. Minister Leers answered that CBS does not count these children as immigrants, that IND counts their residence-permit applications, and that he sees no reason to change the IND registration method.
Children who are born in the Netherlands are not regular immigrants.
Kinderen die in Nederland worden geboren zijn geen reguliere immigranten.
Vragen van de leden Dibi (GroenLinks) en Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de aanscherping van de gedoogcriteria (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

MPs Dibi and Van der Ham asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the tightened coffeeshop criteria (wietpas/club card) should not wait for a plenary drugs debate, how many municipal councils oppose it, and whether irreversible measures could be deferred. The minister replied that the policy is government policy, that enforcement will be phased in from 1 May 2012 in three southern provinces with municipalities and the Public Prosecution Service enforcing under existing responsibilities, and that the change is not irreversible.
I would have preferred to hold the debate with your House earlier.
Ik zou liever eerder het debat met uw Kamer hebben gevoerd.

Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de uitspraken van de gedoogpartner dat Nederland een opt-out moet eisen op immigratiegebied (ingezonden 1 december 2011).

An MP asks the immigration minister whether the Netherlands should seek an EU opt-out on immigration, as the government's coalition partner Wilders proposes, and how the government views the Commission's migration Green Paper. The minister replies that a Dutch opt-out is not on the table because it requires treaty change agreed by all member states, and that the government will instead push for changes to EU legislation within the current treaties and coordinate with other member states.
A Dutch opt-out on immigration and asylum is not currently on the table.
Een Nederlandse opt-out op het gebied van immigratie en asiel is nu niet aan de orde.

Vragen van de leden Voortman en Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de opvang van uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers in Katwijk (ingezonden 7 november 2011

Green Left MPs asked the ministers whether medical care for rejected asylum seekers in the Katwijk reception centre was guaranteed after GPs ended cooperation with the COA, and whether medical dossiers and transfers were handled properly. The minister answered that care is guaranteed, that agreements were made with GPs and the COA on transfers, and that the COA is responsible for implementing the family-location framework.
In addition, I have explicitly instructed that a transfer will only take place after continuation of medical treatment at the new location has been guaranteed.
Daarnaast heb ik expliciet de opdracht gegeven dat een overplaatsing pas zal plaatsvinden nadat het continueren van de medische behandeling op de nieuwe locatie is gewaarborgd.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Recourt (PvdA) en Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de gedragingen van bewindsperson

MPs Pechtold, Recourt and Dibi asked whether ministers pressured Geert Wilders not to broadcast Fitna, whether intelligence services were used against him or Parliament members, and related conduct shown in the HUMAN documentary. The minister answered that conversations with Wilders are public, declined to disclose Council of Ministers deliberations or the Landsadvocaat advice, denied AIVD involvement in a decision, and confirmed that the Wiv 2002 bars surveillance of parliamentarians absent serious threat grounds.
As is known, no statements may be made about the deliberation and decision-making in the Council of Ministers.
Zoals bekend mogen geen mededelingen worden gedaan over de beraadslaging en de besluitvorming in de Raad van Ministers.
Vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Van der Steur (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de wapenvergunning van Tristan van der V. (ingezonden 15 juli 2011).

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police violated the Archives Act by deleting a file on the weapons permit of T. Van der V., whether a missing pdf in the Alphen murder case was mishandled, and why offers of outside expert help were refused, and whether independent investigation will be done. The minister denied any appearance of a cover-up, pointed to NFI and Fox-IT second opinions, stated the Archives Act does not apply to data processing under the Wet Politiegegevens article 13, and said external audits of police data retention were underway and no further investigation was needed, referring the case to earlier answers.
I therefore see no reason at this time for further investigation on this point.
Ik zie daarom op dit moment geen reden voor nader onderzoek op dit punt.

Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie, van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het gebrek aan daadkracht bij de bestrijding v

An MP asks ministers whether local governments are neglecting loverboy (pimp-boy) trafficking shifting to smaller towns, and whether there are enough anonymous shelters for victims. The minister denies concrete signs of displacement, promises a Rijks-wide action plan with municipal involvement, and says research into youth care and women's shelters is underway with results expected by year-end.
For this reason I will present an action plan this year with a nationwide approach to the loverboy problem.
Om deze reden zal ik nog dit jaar een actieplan presenteren met een Rijksbrede aanpak van de loverboyproblematiek.

Vragen van de leden Spekman (PvdA), Schouw (D66), Gesthuizen (SP), Dibi (GroenLinks) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het onderzoek op basis waarvan een project voor ex-ama’s is

Five MPs asked the minister for Immigration and Asylum whether the government's claim that the project for former unaccompanied minor asylum seekers performed worse than the Dienst Terugkeer & Vertrek was a misreading of the CVO research, and whether a scientifically sound comparison would be made. The minister answered that a sound comparison was not feasible for research reasons, that the CVO findings were correctly interpreted, and that the conclusion that the project was not performing stands.
No, there is no question of an incorrect interpretation of the CVO research.
Nee, van een onjuiste interpretatie van het onderzoek van CVO is geen sprake.

Vragen van de leden Dibi en Van Gent (beiden GroenLinks) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de onterechte afwijzing van asielverzoeken van homoseksuele asielzoekers (in

MPs Dibi and Van Gent asked whether the asylum procedure wrongly rejects gay asylum seekers on prejudice and stereotypes, and whether late disclosure of sexual orientation is handled fairly. The minister denies that the picture is accurate, describes IND training and procedural rules, and promises a separate response to the report.

However, I do not recognise the picture painted in the report, that asylum applications from homosexual asylum seekers in the Netherlands are often rejected on the basis of prejudices and stereotypes.
Ik herken echter niet het in het rapport geschetste beeld, dat asielverzoeken van homoseksuele asielzoekers ook in Nederland vaak worden afgewezen op grond van vooroordelen en stereotypen.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de dood van een Turkse arrestant (ingezonden 7 oktober 2011).

Dibi (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether he knows of a newspaper report that a Turkish autopsy report on a Turkish man who died in custody this year differs substantially from the Dutch findings, and if so how the differences are explained. The minister answered that the Public Prosecution Service has repeatedly requested the report from the next-of-kin's lawyer but has not received it, so it cannot comment on its contents.
The Public Prosecution Service therefore cannot comment on the content of the report compared with the Dutch investigation.
Het Openbaar Ministerie kan om die reden geen uitspraken doen over de inhoud van het rapport in vergelijking met het Nederlandse onderzoek.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de aanhouding van een fotograaf op Utrecht CS (ingezonden 30 augustus 2011).

Dibi (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police detaining a freelance photographer at Utrecht Central station, and demanding a columnist delete a photo, were justified and proportionate. The state secretary answered that taking photos alone is not grounds for intervention, that the arrest was based on an alleged violation of the Wet personenvervoer 2000 and refusal to identify, that the KLPD evaluation found no provable nuisance, that excuses were given, and that no further investigation is needed.
Taking photographs in itself does not give rise to police intervention.
Het maken van foto's op zichzelf vormt geen aanleiding tot politieoptreden.
Vragen van de leden Dibi (GroenLinks) en Schouw (D66) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de strafbaarstelling van illegaliteit (ingezonden 22 september 2011).

MPs Dibi and Schouw asked the immigration minister whether the EU Return Directive, as interpreted in the El-Dridi ruling, precludes criminalising illegal stay, what would happen if a fine imposed on an illegal migrant is not paid, and why the Directive is still not fully implemented. The minister referred to a letter sent the same day for the first set of questions and explained the legislative history of the implementing bill, which is still awaiting plenary debate.
For the answer to these questions I refer to my letter of today to your House.
Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik hier naar mijn brief van heden aan uw Kamer.

Vragen van de leden Dibi (GroenLinks), Gesthuizen (SP) en Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de steun van overige lidstaten voor de kabinetsplannen om EU-regelgeving op het gebied van asiel en i

MPs asked which EU member states support the cabinet's plans to make EU asylum and immigration rules stricter, how they expressed that support, and on what timeline the changes could be adopted. The minister answered that support is expressed informally, names no specific states, says a timeline depends on EU procedures, and declines to share support details because of negotiation considerations.
Finally, I would point out that from a negotiating standpoint it is unwise to share widely in advance with outsiders which country has expressed how much support for what.
Tot slot wil ik u er op wijzen dat het vanuit onderhandelingsoogpunt onverstandig is al op voorhand breed met de buitenwereld te delen wie, hoeveel steun, waarvoor kenbaar heeft gemaakt.

Vragen van de leden Spekman (PvdA), Dibi (GroenLinks) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het lot van de Iraakse familie Karim naar aanleiding van een uitzending van VARA Uitgesprok

MPs Spekman, Dibi and Voordewind asked the immigration minister why he did not assess a VARA broadcast showing risks of blood revenge against the Karim family after their forced return to Iraq, and whether he would investigate or allow a new asylum application. The minister refused further investigation, arguing a broadcast is not an objective source and reopening cases would undermine the asylum procedure, while partly explaining the six-year IND decision delay by a lengthy investigation into the father and a moratorium on Iraq decisions.
My starting point is that information on individual cases is treated confidentially.
Uitgangspunt is voor mij dat informatie over individuele zaken vertrouwelijk wordt behandeld.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Spekman (PvdA), Dibi (GroenLinks) en Schouw (D66) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de berichten dat er geen sprake zou zijn geweest van gedwong

MPs from five parties asked the immigration minister whether an Iranian asylum seeker who took his own life was told that forced removal was not possible, whether detention without realistic prospects of removal is acceptable, and whether courts are misled by claims of 'prospect of removal'. The minister confirmed the matter was discussed in a 2009 departure interview, stated that forced return to Iran is not impossible in all cases if the person cooperates, and denied that courts are misled.
The conversation report can be found in the annex for confidential inspection.
Het gespreksverslag vindt u in de bijlage ter vertrouwelijke inzage.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de voortdurende detentie van de waxinelichtgooier (ingezonden 21 juli 2011).

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the suspect who threw a candle holder at the Golden Coach on Prinsjesdag 2010 is still in pre-trial detention, why, where he is held, and whether a psychiatric report exists. The minister answered that the court extended pre-trial detention to 21 August, that no typical duration exists, that the suspect is not in the EBI, that privacy prevents further detail on his detention conditions, and that the report is ready with a hearing set for 6 September 2011.
In the interest of the suspect's privacy, the Public Prosecution Service cannot make further statements about the suspect's detention conditions and place of detention.
In het kader van de privacy van de verdachte kan het Openbaar Ministerie geen verdere mededelingen doen over de detentieomstandigheden van de verdachte en de plaats waar gedetineerd zit.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over weggepeste buurtbewoners wegens hun seksuele voorkeur (ingezonden 8 juli 2011).

MP Dibi asks the Minister of Security and Justice how the government's anti-discrimination commitments fit with the Arnhem Court of Appeal's finding that police and prosecutors did not act adequately and promptly on complaints about a harassed gay couple in Utrecht, and whether the case will be investigated and what measures will prevent such incidents. The minister confirms the court's finding, says an inventory of police and prosecution handling is underway and results will be published later, and points to planned anti-discrimination measures sent to parliament in July.
Following the Court's finding, an inventory is currently being made of the actions taken by the police and the Public Prosecution Service in response to the complaints.

Naar aanleiding van de constatering van het Hof vindt momenteel een inventarisatie plaats naar de handelingen die door de politie en het Openbaar Ministerie zijn verricht naar aanleiding van de aangiften.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de dood van een Turkse man na zijn aanhouding door de politie (ingezonden 12 juli 2011).

MP Dibi asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the results of the investigation into the death of a Turkish man after his police arrest in Beverwijk would be sent to parliament. The state secretary replied that the Rijksrecherche and NFI parts are finished and their findings were already made public via the Public Prosecution Service, while the medical-care investigation is still ongoing and the OM will publish its conclusions once complete.
Once the investigation has been completed and assessed, the OM will make its conclusions public.
Als het onderzoek is afgerond en beoordeeld, zal het OM zijn conclusies openbaar maken.

Vragen van de leden Arib (PvdA), Gesthuizen (SP) en Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over nazorg van misbruik in de Rooms-katholiek

MPs Arib, Gesthuizen and Dibi asked the health and justice ministers whether aftercare for victims of sexual abuse in the Catholic Church is sufficient and whether the state should support victim gatherings and urgently provide aftercare before the Samson and Deetman inquiries report. The minister answered that existing arrangements with Slachtofferhulp Nederland and regular mental health care are adequate, that no extra measures are needed now, and that the state has no role in organising victim meetings.
I therefore see no reason at this moment to provide extra assistance and prefer to first await the results of the ongoing investigations.
Ik zie daarom op dit moment geen aanleiding om in extra hulpverlening te voorzien en geef er de voorkeur aan nu eerst de resultaten van de lopende onderzoeken af te wachten.
Vragen van de leden Peters en Dibi (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over demonstraties in Marokko (ingezonden 17 juni 2011).

GroenLinks MPs asked the foreign minister about the Moroccan authorities' handling of protests, expected royal reforms, whether the Netherlands would press for democratisation and non-violent policing, and press freedom. The minister answered that the constitutional reform was a step toward democracy and that the Netherlands would keep encouraging reform bilaterally and through the EU, while noting mixed signs on repression.
The Dutch government is closely following the reforms in Morocco and will continue to encourage the Moroccan government directly and through the EU to take steps toward further democratisation.
De Nederlandse regering volgt de hervormingen in Marokko op de voet en zal rechtstreeks en via de EU de Marokkaanse regering blijven aanmoedigen stappen naar verdere democratisering te zetten.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over weggepeste buurtbewoners wegens hun seksuele gerichtheid (ingezonden 13 mei 2011).

Dibi (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a gay man allegedly harassed out of his Amsterdam Bijlmer home, whether police advised him not to go public, how many similar cases are known, whether conduct rules exist for victims, and how to prevent and combat such harassment. The Minister denied police advised silence, pointed to Poldis figures and the new victims' rights legislation, and said the government will inform parliament further on anti-discrimination measures.
The report that the police advised him not to do this is incorrect.
Het bericht dat de politie betrokkene zou hebben geadviseerd om dit niet te doen is onjuist.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het arrest van het Europese Hof van Justitie inzake El Dridi (ingezonden 2 mei 2011).

Dibi (GroenLinks) asked the immigration minister whether the EU Court of Justice's El Dridi ruling, that the Return Directive precludes imprisonment for illegal stay, affects the planned criminalisation of illegal residence and whether the government will refrain from it or seek a preliminary ruling. Minister Leers answered that a bill is in preparation that will take the ruling into account, that he will not pre-empt its parliamentary treatment, and that referring questions to the Court is for the judiciary, not him.
That bill will, after prior consultation with the most involved parties, be submitted to the Council of State's Advisory Division.
Dat wetsvoorstel zal, na voorafgaande consultatie van de meest betrokken partijen, aan de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State worden aangeboden.

Vragen van de leden Spekman (PvdA), Schouw (D66), Gesthuizen (SP), Dibi (GroenLinks) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie waarin in een

MPs from several parties asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum how the government will respond to a CJEU ruling that imprisoning an irregular migrant for illegal stay conflicts with the Return Directive, and whether the planned criminalisation of illegal stay and breach of entry bans is therefore incompatible with EU law. The Minister declined to pre-judge the pending bill and the Raad van State advice, said the ruling concerned Italian law, and stated the government will respect EU law while seeking to change EU rules.
It does not seem appropriate to anticipate the handling of this bill now.
Het lijkt mij niet opportuun nu reeds op de behandeling van dit wetsvoorstel vooruit te lopen.

Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken, voor Immigratie en Asiel en van Defensie over het bericht dat de NAVO 61 bootvluchtelingen heeft laten sterven op de Middellandse Zee (ingezon

An MP asked the foreign and immigration ministers whether NATO ignored a boat of migrants in distress in the Mediterranean, causing 61 deaths, and whether they would press for an investigation and preventive measures. The minister said a NATO internal review found no NATO ships were involved, no distress signals were received, and that the review is complete, while pointing to EU and Frontex efforts to prevent such incidents.
The NATO investigation has been concluded.

Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over een vonnis van de Iranese autoriteiten die betrekking heeft op een zaak waarin een tot het christendom bekeerde Iraanse familie geen asie

An MP asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum whether a Tabriz Revolutionary Court judgment concerning a converted Christian Iranian family should lead to reconsidering the asylum refusal. The minister said no, because the judgment's authenticity can only be examined in a dedicated procedure and the family has no open asylum procedure.
No. The authenticity of the judgment and any significance of its content can first be examined in a dedicated procedure.
Nee. De authenticiteit van het vonnis en de eventuele betekenis van de inhoud daarvan kunnen eerst worden onderzocht in een daartoe strekkende procedure.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over een homoseksuele Iranese cartoonist die door de IND niet wordt geloofd (ingezonden 6 april 2011).

An MP asks the Minister for Immigration and Asylum about an gay Iranian cartoonist whose asylum claim was rejected by the IND on suspicion of plagiarism, and whether he faces risks if returned. The minister says doubts arose about the authenticity of his work during the hearing, that protection rules are sufficient, and that because the case is before the court no further information or reconsideration will be provided.
Given that this case is now before the court, I do not consider it desirable to provide further information at this time.
Gelet op het feit dat deze zaak onder de rechter is, acht ik het nu niet wenselijk nadere informatie te verstrekken.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het Jaarbericht 2010 van De Inspectie Jeugdzorg (ingezonden 2 mei 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary for health, welfare and sport about the Youth Inspectorate's 2010 annual report, covering non-implementation of national youth care agreements, oversight of foster placements before screening, and missing certificates of good conduct (VOG) in staff files. The state secretary answered that the inspectorate has enforcement tools, that new screening quality frameworks and protocols are being introduced, that a VOG requirement will be made statutory, and that no further measures are needed.
I have asked the inspectorate to keep me closely informed of this.
Ik heb de inspectie gevraagd mij hier nadrukkelijk van op de hoogte te houden.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over een groepsuitzetting naar Irak waar veel jonge kinderen bij zijn betrokken (ingezonden 7 april 2011).

An MP asked the immigration minister whether a planned group deportation to Iraq involving many minor children was accurate, how it fits the October 2010 European Court ruling on returns to Iraq, and whether the children would avoid detention on arrival. The minister confirmed six families were deported on 7 April 2011, said returns to Iraq had resumed after the Court's November 2010 letter, and said he had no reason to think the families were detained on arrival.
As I stated in these letters, since the Court's letter of 23 November 2010, deportations to Iraq can take place again.
Zoals ik in deze brieven heb gemeld, kunnen sinds de brief van het Hof van 23 november 2010 weer uitzettingen naar Irak plaatsvinden.

Vragen van de leden Spekman (PvdA), Rik Janssen (SP), Schouw (D66), Dibi (GroenLinks) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de uitzetting van acht Iraakse gezinnen naar Irak (ingezond

MPs from several parties asked the minister about the forced deportation of eight Iraqi families, including thirteen minors, their detention in Rotterdam, and alleged rough treatment by police. The minister confirmed six families were deported, said families were informed of legal remedies, defended detention periods as within policy, denied reported mistreatment, and described the escort arrangements.

All aliens were explicitly informed, through information leaflets and my letter to the House of 30 November 2010 and the answers to earlier parliamentary questions, of the possibility to pursue legal remedies against the planned deportation and to contact their lawyer.

Alle vreemdelingen zijn door middel van informatiebladen en mijn brief aan de Tweede Kamer van 30 november 2010 over de uitvoering van de motie Voordewind en door uitreiking van de beantwoording van de Kamervragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) van 25 november 2010 expliciet gewezen op de mogelijkheid rechtsmiddelen aan te wenden tegen de voorgenomen uitzetting en op de mogelijkheid om contact op te nemen met hun advocaat.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over een door de politie in beslag genomen anti-PVV-spandoek (ingezonden 26 april 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police banned and seized an anti-PVV banner at a demonstration, what it said, and how this fits with constitutional freedoms of expression and assembly. The minister answered that police did not seize or ban the banner; the demonstration organiser (FNV) removed it, and the minister does not know its text or the reason for removal, so no constitutional infringement occurred.
However, there is no question of seizure or a ban by the police.
Er is echter geen sprake van inbeslagname of verbod door de politie.

Vragen van de leden Spekman (PvdA), Rik Janssen (SP), Schouw (D66), Dibi (GroenLinks) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het aantal lang verblijvende, verwesterde Afghaanse meisjes

Opposition MPs asked the immigration minister how many long-resident Afghan girls resembling Sahar Hbrahimgel face removal, and whether her case and her family's circumstances should weigh in residence decisions. The minister answered that the family will receive a residence permit, that a few dozen to about a hundred girls may qualify under new policy, and that he cannot say how many of the 110 pending cases involve fathers subject to Article 1F, citing limits of the IND information system.
It is not possible to provide figures, because asylum seekers and their family members do not always arrive at the same time.
Het is niet mogelijk om cijfers te geven, omdat asielzoekers en hun gezinsleden niet altijd gelijktijdig inreizen

Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister-president, de minister van Algemene Zaken en de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de beveiliging van opinievor

An MP asked the government about the protection of an artist and a cartoonist receiving threats over controversial work, and whether national protection should cover nationally known opinion makers and a complaints point should be set up. The government said threats are taken seriously and that protection is tailored to threat levels, with no change to the national/decentralised split and no complaints point planned.
I see no reason to set up a complaints point.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om een meldpunt in te richten.

Vragen van de leden Spekman (PvdA), Rik Janssen (SP), Schouw (D66), Dibi (GroenLinks), Voordewind (CU) en Thieme (PVDD) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over uitspraken van de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel in

Six MPs asked the immigration minister whether his media remarks linking the Hbrahimgel family's repeated asylum procedures to delay were accurate, and whether the family's prolonged stay and their children's interests were fairly weighed. The minister said the remarks were about future procedural policy, that the case was reassessed under new policy on westernised girls to Afghanistan, and that because a residence permit will be granted, his appeal will be withdrawn.
Since the Hbrahimgel family will be granted a residence permit, the appeal will be withdrawn.
Aangezien aan het gezin Hbrahimgel een vergunning zal worden verleend, wordt het hoger beroep ingetrokken.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Schouw (D66), Dibi (Groenlinks), Spekman (PvdA), Rik Janssen (SP) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de eventuele uitzetting van een Somal

MPs asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum about the planned deportation of a Somali former Muslim convert to Christianity to Somaliland, citing Somaliland's constitution and sharia, and whether the IND's position on Christians being able to practise faith quietly holds. The minister answered that the courts found no risk of persecution or Article 3 ECHR violation, that such cases are assessed individually, and saw no reason to change deportation policy or the decision.
In view of the above, I do not share your view that the person concerned fears for his life upon return to Somaliland.
Gezien het bovenstaande deel ik uw mening dat betrokkene te vrezen heeft voor zijn leven bij terugkeer naar Somaliland niet.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de voorgenomen uitzetting van de heer Mopidi naar Libië (ingezonden 25 februari 2011).

GroenLinks MP Dibi asks the immigration minister whether a Libyan national, Mr Mopidi, will be deported to Libya, whether the security situation in Tripoli is safe, and whether deportations will be suspended and no irreversible steps taken. The minister answers that deportations to Libya are currently not on the agenda given the unpredictable situation there, that this applies to Mr Mopidi, and that he will take no irreversible steps until the questions are answered.

As I explained in answering the questions from MPs Spekman and Timmermans (both PvdA, reference 2011Z03927), deportations to Libya are currently not an option given the unpredictable situation in Libya.

Zoals ik heb toegelicht bij de beantwoording van de vragen van de leden Spekman en Timmermans (beiden PvdA, kenmerk 2011Z03927 ) zijn uitzettingen naar Libië thans niet aan de orde gezien de huidige onvoorspelbare situatie in Libië.

Vragen van de leden El Fassed en Dibi (beiden GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Veiligheid en Justitie over een mogelijke Amerikaanse strafvervolging van Rop Gonggrijp wegens zijn vermeende betro

MPs El Fassed and Dibi asked whether the Netherlands would cooperate with a possible US prosecution of Rop Gonggrijp over alleged Wikileaks involvement, and about treatment of detainees such as Bradley Manning. The government answered that the US investigation is ongoing with no formal charge known, that any Dutch cooperation would be assessed on a formal request, and that human rights concerns would be raised in the UPR process.
As long as there is no formal summons or charge, the US authorities make no statements about it.
Zolang er geen sprake is van een formele oproep of aanklacht, doen de Amerikaanse autoriteiten daarover geen mededelingen.

Vragen van de leden Dibi en El Fassed (beiden GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Veiligheid en Justitie over een verkenning om strafvervolging van buitenlandse politici in Nederland tegen te gaan

GroenLinks MPs asked whether the government is examining how to prevent prosecution in the Netherlands of foreign politicians for human rights violations, and whether this undermines international justice. The minister replied that the study concerns only how the state should handle threatened legal action against foreign officials under international law, that immunity is procedural and not impunity, and that no change of policy is intended.

What I am having examined is how the State should deal with situations in which legal action threatens against foreign government officials who are resident in the Netherlands or intend to come to the Netherlands.

Wat ik laat onderzoeken is hoe de Staat zou moeten omgaan met situaties waarin juridische acties dreigen tegen buitenlandse overheidsfunctionarissen die in Nederland verblijven of voornemens zijn naar Nederland te komen

Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het voorstel om burgemeesters in uitzonderlijke gevallen beslissingsbevoegdheid te geven over de verblijfsstatus van vreemdelingen (ingez

An MP asks whether the minister still supports giving mayors discretionary power to grant residence status in hardship cases, and when a worked-out proposal can be expected. The minister confirms support for exploring a role for municipalities, stresses that he alone keeps the power to grant residence permits, and has asked the advisory committee (ACVZ) to advise, consulting the VNG and the mayors' association.
I have asked the Advisory Committee on Immigration Affairs to advise me on possibilities to grant residence to rejected asylum seekers
Ik heb de Adviescommissie voor Vreemdelingenzaken gevraagd om mij te adviseren omtrent mogelijkheden verblijf te bieden aan uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de toegenomen naleving van leeftijdsgrenzen voor games en films (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

GreenLeft MP Dibi asked the Justice Minister about improved compliance with age limits for games and films and whether a criminal ban on extremely violent games should be prepared or dropped. The state secretary answered that voluntary industry measures and intensified enforcement are working, that a ban would be of limited effectiveness, and that no preparations for such legislation have been made since 2010.
I note that the policy of improving and intensifying compliance with the age limits is bearing fruit.
Ik constateer dat het beleid van verbetering en intensivering van de naleving van de leeftijdsgrenzen zijn vruchten afwerpt.

Vragen van de leden Dibi en Voortman (beiden GroenLinks) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een zieke zwangere vrouw die is overgebracht naar het vertrekcentrum in Ter

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether a pregnant asylum seeker with bleeding was moved from Leersum reception centre to the Ter Apel detention centre, and whether she could return for medical reasons. The minister denied the transfer was to Ter Apel, stating she was placed at the Vlagtwedde restricted-liberty location after a medical check, and that necessary care is available there, so no return is needed.
The DT&V imposed on her the restriction-of-liberty measure under article 56 Vw 2000 for this purpose.
Door de DT&V is haar daartoe de vrijheidsbeperkende maatregel ex artikel 56 Vw 2000 opgelegd.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over asielzoekers die te lang vast zitten op Schiphol (ingezonden 24 januari 2011).

MP Dibi asks the Minister for Immigration and Asylum about asylum seekers held too long at Schiphol airport, citing a report claiming average detention of two months, and asks whether the Gesloten Opvang Centrum (GOC/GVA) procedure should be abolished and alternatives to detention used. The minister disputes the report's conclusion, defends border detention and the GVA procedure as legally grounded and compatible with human rights guidelines, and says cases are reviewed by courts and figures will be reported later in 2011.
The question of whether continuing the measure is lawful can always be submitted to the judge by the foreigner's lawyer.
De vraag of de voortzetting van de maatregel rechtmatig is, kan steeds door de advocaat van de vreemdeling aan de rechter worden voorgelegd.

Vragen van de leden Dibi (GroenLinks), Schouw (D66), Spekman (PvdA), Rik Janssen (SP), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken en de minister voor Immigratie en A

MPs from six parties asked the Prime Minister whether he would accept a request for a meeting with civil servants about a 17 September 2010 discussion on the numerical effects of the government's migration and asylum plans. The Prime Minister declined, saying the conclusion was a political one for which the government took responsibility and referring to ministerial contact rules under the Aanwijzingen inzake externe contacten.

No. In the debate with the House of Representatives on 3 March I explained that in the discussion, based on information orally provided by expert civil servants, a substantive conclusion was drawn for which we then took political responsibility.

Nee. In het debat met de Tweede Kamer op 3 maart jl. heb ik toegelicht dat in het gesprek op basis van door deskundige ambtenaren mondeling verstrekte informatie een inhoudelijke conclusie is getrokken waarvoor wij vervolgens politieke verantwoording hebben genomen.
Vragen van de leden Voortman en Dibi (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het artikel «Vinex-wijk dreigt getto te worden» (ingezonden 23 februari 2011).

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether neighbourhood design in Vinex districts ignored the link between housing, work and recreation, and whether municipalities should invest and whether wijkenbeleid budget cuts threaten these areas. The minister answered that neighbourhood quality is primarily a municipal responsibility, that research found good links between housing and amenities, and that he would discuss the wijkenaanpak with aldermen and inform parliament by July 2011.
On 27 April I am meeting the aldermen concerned, among other things about the progress of the neighbourhood approach and the role of central government in this new phase.
Ik spreek 27 april aanstaande met de betrokken wethouders onder andere over de voortgang van de wijkenaanpak en de rol van het Rijk in deze nieuwe fase.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht «De totale oorlog van de elite tegen ’t volk» (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Interior whether he reacted to statements by a coalition partner that European multicultural elites are waging total war against their populations, and asked about views on Islamisation, secularisation of Dutch Muslims, and integration. The minister declined to hold the government accountable for what a party says in court, stated the government does not expect history to repeat itself, affirmed the rule of law protects free speech, church-state separation and gender equality, and promised to outline the integration vision in March.
Just as members of parliament cannot be held legally accountable for what they say in parliamentary debate, they or the government cannot be held politically accountable for what they say in court.

Zo min als parlementsleden in rechte ter verantwoording kunnen worden geroepen voor wat zij in het parlementaire debat zeggen, kunnen zij of de regering politiek verantwoordelijk gehouden worden voor wat zij voor de rechter zeggen.

Vragen van de leden Dibi (GroenLinks) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over commerciële zenders die FunX weren uit het radioluisteronderzoek (ingezonden 17 februari 2011).

MPs Dibi and Voordewind asked the minister whether commercial radio broadcasters were sabotaging improvements to the Continuous Listening Survey (CLO), which excludes urban youth and minorities such as FunX's audience, and what could be done. The minister denied sabotage, said the survey is the responsibility of the broadcasters through the RAB, pointed to a tender for a new 2012 survey with attention to representativeness, and said talks were underway about earlier improvements.
The listening survey is a responsibility of the radio broadcasters themselves. I have no direct influence on it.
Het luisteronderzoek is een verantwoordelijkheid van de radiozenders zelf. Ik heb daar geen directe invloed op.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over kinderrechterlijke problemen rondom gezinsmigratie (ingezonden 13 januari 2011).

An MP asked the immigration minister whether the Aliens Act should require an individual, documented best-interests-of-the-child assessment in every family reunification case involving a minor, and whether Aliens Decree article 3.14 should cover the parent of a minor main applicant. The minister replied that such assessments already occur under article 8 ECHR and that the child's interests are sufficiently safeguarded, so no statutory change is needed.
I therefore do not consider it necessary to amend the Aliens Act 2000 as the question proposes.
Ik acht het dan ook niet nodig om een wijziging van de Vreemdelingenwet 2000 door te voeren zoals in de vraagstelling bedoeld.

Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het bericht dat de Nederlandse afgeschreven detentieboten mogelijk in Griekenland worden ingezet (ingezonden 2 februari 2011).

An MP asked the Immigration minister whether Dutch decommissioned detention boats would be given to Greece to address its migrant problem, and whether the Netherlands would offer other practical help. The minister replied that no concrete plans are known, the boats are privately owned and were leased rather than given away, and the Netherlands will support Greece's action plan via EASO asylum support teams and an expert pool.
No. The boats are not the property of the Dutch State but were rented by the State from private owners.
Nee. De boten zijn geen eigendom van de Nederlandse Staat, maar door de Staat gehuurd van particuliere eigenaren.

Vragen van de leden El Fassed en Dibi (beiden GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de dagvaarding van het bedrijf Twitter door Amerikaanse autoriteiten

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice and the Foreign Minister about a US subpoena to Twitter for user data of Dutch and European citizens, and whether such data is adequately protected abroad. The government answered that the request is a US internal matter, that it concerns non-content user and traffic data, that EU data protection depends on adequacy findings, and that Twitter Inc. is not evidently covered by Safe Harbor.
The request concerns an internal American matter that must therefore be assessed by the American authorities.
Het verzoek betreft een interne Amerikaanse aangelegenheid die dan ook door de Amerikaanse autoriteiten moet worden beoordeeld.

Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over een zaak waarin een tot het christendom bekeerde Iraanse familie geen asiel wordt verleend (ingezonden 10 december 2010).

An MP asks the Minister for Immigration and Asylum why a Iranian family converted to Christianity in the Netherlands was refused asylum, and how this fits the adopted motion on converted Iranian asylum seekers. The minister replies that the first claims were rejected as not credible, that conversion alone does not suffice under the 2007 policy without other problems, and that no reconsideration will be undertaken.
I therefore see no reason to reconsider this case.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om deze zaak in heroverweging te nemen.

Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over vrouwelijke inburgeraars die leren voor huisvrouw en niet voor een baan (ingezonden 22 december 2010).

An MP asks the minister whether the civic integration OGO profile (upbringing, health, education) steers women towards housekeeping rather than paid work, and whether it should be abolished or opened to all participants. The minister rejects that reading, notes 87% of OGO participants are women but 52% of women took the Work profile, and says the whole integration system, including the exam, will be reconsidered.
When the system is adjusted, all components of the civic integration system will be reconsidered, therefore also the design of the integration exam.
Bij de aanpassing van het stelsel zullen alle onderdelen van het inburgeringsstelsel worden heroverwogen, derhalve ook de vormgeving van het inburgeringsexamen.

Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over populaire, maar ineffectieve gebiedsverboden (ingezonden 15 december 2010).

Dibi (GroenLinks) asked whether area bans (gebiedsverboden) are popular but ineffective, whether the English ASBO model should prompt suspension or stricter conditions for the Dutch football law. The state secretary answered that the English and Dutch systems cannot be directly compared, that no evaluation is planned yet, and that the Wet mbveo will be evaluated after two years of experience.
Evaluation of the Wet mbveo is planned after two years of experience with the law.
Evaluatie van de Wet mbveo is voorzien nadat twee jaar met de wet ervaring is opgedaan.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het internetfilter tegen kinderpornografie (ingezonden 10 december 2010).

Dibi (GroenLinks) asked whether the minister is considering Deep Packet Inspection to block child pornography online, whether that is ineffective and disproportionate, and whether filtering budgets should instead fund police and prosecution. The minister denied having taken a position on DPI, said it is still under study with a progress letter planned for February 2011, and said the link between filtering budgets and enforcement budgets does not exist because one is private and the other public money.
I have therefore not taken a substantive position on it.
Ik heb er derhalve geen inhoudelijk standpunt over ingenomen.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over vingerafdrukken in een landelijke database (ingezonden 22 november 2010).

Dibi (GroenLinks) asked the Interior Minister about risks of a central fingerprint database for passports, citing the Data Protection Authority's (CBP) concerns and WRR warnings about errors and fraud. Minister Donner rejected the CBP's view, deferred to earlier answers on the substance, and said no irreversible steps would be taken while he studies the matter.
In the meantime, no irreversible steps are being taken toward establishing the central travel document administration.
In de tussentijd worden er geen onomkeerbare stappen gezet richting de vorming van de centrale reisdocumentenadministratie.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de inperking van het advocatengeheim (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security whether talks with the Dutch Bar on limiting lawyers' confidentiality, including powers for the BFT to inspect client files, breach due process and ECHR rights, and what evidence supports claims that lawyers facilitate financial crime. The state secretary replies that the aim is a new supervision regime rather than limiting confidentiality, that BFT is an independent body not part of the ministry or prosecution, that no definitive decisions have been taken, and that FIU data show few suspicious transactions reported by lawyers.
The aim of the talks with the Dutch Bar Association is not to limit the duty of confidentiality, but to arrive at a supervisory system for lawyers that meets present-day requirements.

Het doel van de gesprekken met de Nederlandse Orde van Advocaten (hierna: de Orde) is niet de inperking van de geheimhoudingsplicht, maar het komen tot een, aan de eisen van de huidige tijd beantwoordend stelsel van toezicht op advocaten
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister voor Jeugd en Gezin over medicatie voor Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) (ingezonden 7 oktober 2010).

MP Dibi asks the minister about rising ADHD medication use among children, adults and girls, whether school pressure drives diagnoses, the pharmaceutical industry's influence, and whether DSM diagnostic criteria are too broad. The government attributes the rise to better recognition, reduced stigma and social change, says existing checks on industry and professional guidelines suffice, declines new research on industry lobbying and diagnostic criteria, and promises to keep the topic on the agenda in consultations.
I will therefore ensure that in the discussions held with the field in that context, the issue of increasing medication use remains on the agenda.
Ik zal daarom zorgen dat in de gesprekken die in het kader daarvan gevoerd gaan worden met het veld, ook het punt van het toenemend medicijngebruik op de agenda blijft staan.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de uitspraak van de minister dat Grieken zelf hun asielprobleem moeten oplossen (ingezonden 6 december 2010).

An MP asked the immigration minister whether his statement that Greece must solve its own asylum problems fits with a common European asylum system, and what Netherlands will do to help Greece and to handle Dublin transfers to Greece. The minister confirmed the statement, said each member state is primarily responsible for implementation while cooperating practically, committed Dutch staff and expertise to Greece's action plan, and deferred on Dublin policy pending a pending European Court ruling.
I do not consider it prudent to anticipate that now.
Ik acht het niet zorgvuldig daar thans op vooruit te lopen.
Vragen van de leden Voortman en Dibi (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de reconstructie van de Schipholbrand (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether staff had warned management of the Schiphol cell complex about leadership gaps and inexperienced colleagues before the 2005 fire, and what became of the staff survey. The minister replied that the survey's action points were not followed up after the fire, that the Rijksrecherche and Onderzoeksraad received all relevant documents including the survey, and that DJI now uses a digital risk inventory and periodic staff satisfaction surveys.
The Rijksrecherche and the Onderzoeksraad voor de Veiligheid have received all relevant documents relating to the Schiphol fire file, including the staff survey.
De Rijksrecherche en de Onderzoeksraad voor de Veiligheid hebben alle relevante stukken ontvangen die betrekking hebben op het dossier Schipholbrand, ook de personeelsenquête.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de plaatsing van bodyscanfoto’s op internet (ingezonden 18 november 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether body scan images published online in the US could come from Dutch scanners and whether Dutch scan images could ever be copied or leaked. The Minister answered that Schiphol uses a different scanner model, that the equipment generates no images, and that storing or exporting raw scan data requires add-on hardware not used in the Netherlands.
Storing and exporting raw scan data is only possible with additional peripheral equipment connected to the security scanners that is specifically suited for storing and/or sending data.

Het opslaan en exporteren van ruwe scangegevens is alleen mogelijk met extra randapparatuur die op de security scanners wordt aangesloten en die specifiek geschikt is voor het opslaan en/of versturen van gegevens.

Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) voor de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over het bericht dat gemeenten uit de losse pols strooien met religieuze subsidies (ingezonden 27 september 2010).

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister about reports that municipalities grant religious subsidies arbitrarily and whether this conflicts with the separation of church and state. The minister said subsidies to religious bodies need not violate that principle, acknowledged that municipal criteria are often unclear, pointed to a joint framework (Tweeluik) for municipalities, and promised to consider additional support in consultation with the VNG.
In principle, decentralised authorities are free – within the limits of the law – to determine their own subsidy policy.
In principe zijn decentrale overheden vrij om – binnen de grenzen van de wet – zelf hun subsidiebeleid te bepalen.

Vragen van de leden Dibi en Braakhuis (beiden GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretarisvan Buitenlandse Zaken en de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de arrestatie van een journalist (ingezonden 9 november 2010).

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether the arrest of a journalist at Brussels North station for photographing a police action against asylum seekers, later dropped, violated press freedom, and whether the Netherlands could change EU law on newsgathering. The government answered that the arrest is a Belgian internal matter, that the EU Charter already guarantees freedom of expression, and that the EU lacks competence to regulate press freedom in member states.
This concerns an internal Belgian matter that must therefore be assessed by the Belgian authorities.
Het betreft hier een interne Belgische aangelegenheid die dan ook door de Belgische autoriteiten moet worden beoordeeld.

Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel en van Veiligheid en Justitie over onderzoek naar de uitvoerbaarheid van strafbaarstelling van illegaliteit (ingezonden 19 november 2010).

An MP asks whether a previous minister's internal study into criminalising illegal residence was ever made public, its main conclusions, whether circumstances have changed, and whether it can be sent to parliament before the budget debate. The minister replies that it was internal advice summarised in a 2004 note, that the coalition agreement commits to criminalising illegality, and that a vision with a proposal will follow next year.
There is no question of a study, but of internal civil-service advice whose results were set out in the illegals note sent to the House of Representatives in 2004.
Er is geen sprake van een onderzoek, maar van interne ambtelijke advisering waarvan de resultaten zijn neergelegd in de illegalennota die in 2004 naar de Tweede Kamer is gezonden

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Sterk (CDA), Van Nieuwenhuizen (VVD), Spekman (PvdA), Schouw (D66), Van Klaveren (PVV), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel ov

MPs from several parties asked the immigration minister about a Stichting Gave survey reporting discrimination and threats against Christians and ex-Muslims in asylum centres, and about COA rules, reporting, police complaints, a confidential contact point and detention or revocation of asylum for perpetrators. The minister answered that the survey was methodologically flawed and small, that COA records show only three incidents between Muslims and Christians in two years, that complaints channels already exist, and that a separate confidential contact person is unnecessary; he declined to add a new study or automatic asylum revocation.
The COA will address this survey in the regular consultation with Stichting Gave.
Het COA zal in het reguliere overleg met Stichting Gave aandacht besteden aan deze peiling.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Justitie over de stelselmatige weigering van verzekeraars om personen met een strafblad te verzekeren (ingezonden 23 september 2010).

Dibi asked the Justice Minister whether insurers systematically refuse customers with a criminal record and whether people with records should be able to insure on equal footing. The minister acknowledged the reports, said the affected group is small, and explained the disclosure duties and risk-classification rules, but declined to introduce additional legal measures.
I am not in favour of taking additional legal measures under article 7:928 paragraph 5 of the Civil Code.
Ik ben geen voorstander van het nemen van op artikel 7:928 lid 5 BW aanvullende wettelijke maatregelen.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over binnenlandse adoptie door lesbische ouderparen (ingezonden 10 september 2010).

An MP asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about costs and leave rights for lesbian parent couples in domestic adoption, and whether the legal treatment is unequal. The state secretary replied that a draft bill would establish legal parenthood for the co-mother by operation of law, that adoption costs are comparable to other parentage procedures, and that the sex of the partner is irrelevant to adoption and birth leave entitlements.
The sex of the partner is not relevant here.
Het geslacht van de partner is hierbij niet van belang.
Vragen van de leden Dibi en Van Gent (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Justitie over de stand van zaken rondom proeftuin Modern Migratiebeleid (ingezonden 23 september 2010).

MPs Dibi and Van Gent asked the Minister of Justice about the status of the Modern Migration Policy pilot, including admission of new au pair agencies, the admission and supervision criteria, and whether a code of conduct is required. The minister answered that thirteen agencies were admitted after interviews, listed the admission conditions and IND monitoring, and stated that a code of conduct is the sector's own responsibility rather than an admission criterion.
A total of thirteen new au pair agencies have been admitted to the first phase of the Au Pair Pilot.
Er zijn in totaal dertien nieuwe au-pairbureaus toegelaten tot de eerste fase van de Proeftuin Au Pair.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Justitie over een op handen zijnde groepsuitzetting naar Irak (ingezonden 23 september 2010).

An MP asks the Justice minister whether a group deportation to Iraq was planned, whether he will halt forced returns given Amnesty's warnings and a pending European Court of Human Rights case, and whether he will refrain from irreversible steps until a new country report is available. The minister confirms nine Iraqis were deported on 22 September 2010, maintains that returns to Iraq should continue, and states no reason to suspend them.
No. As you can read in the response of the former Minister of Justice to the Vluchtelingenwerk letter, I see no reason to halt forced returns to Iraq.
Nee. Zoals u kunt lezen in de reactie van de toenmalig minister van Justitie op de brief van Vluchtelingenwerk
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de beschieting van een moskee te Dordrecht (ingezonden 18 oktober 2010).

MP Dibi asked the Justice minister about a shooting at a Dordrecht mosque, the scale and motives of attacks on religious buildings, security measures, and government policy on tolerance. The minister confirmed the incident, declined to give details during the ongoing investigation or on security measures, cited police statistics on incidents, and referred to existing policy and a previous answer.
I cannot provide you with any information during the ongoing investigation.
Ik kan u gedurende het lopende onderzoek geen mededelingen doen.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Justitie en voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over bekladding op en brandstichting bij moskeeën (ingezonden 30 september 2010).

MP Dibi asks the ministers of Justice and Housing whether a series of arson, vandalism and threat incidents at mosques shows a structural problem and what the government has done and will do about anti-Islamic violence. The government answers that it sees no evidence of coordination or a trend, that police and prosecutors investigate such incidents, and that it sees no need for additional measures at this time.
I have no indications that there is a connection between the various incidents, nor that there are coordinated actions.
Ik beschik niet over aanwijzingen dat er sprake is van een verband tussen de verschillende incidenten, noch dat er sprake is van gecoördineerde acties.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Justitie over het voornemen van mevrouw Post tot oprichting van een herzieningfonds (ingezonden 11 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Justice whether the government would support Ina Post's plan to set up a retrial fund with part of her compensation after acquittal, and questioned whether the legal aid system and the CEAS commission were adequate. The minister answered that no financial support is needed because the planned reform of the retrial procedure, including a Procurator-General investigation route with state-funded legal aid, addresses the problem, and that the CEAS will become redundant; the Public Prosecution Service is prepared to apologise to Ms Post.
The Public Prosecution Service has indicated that it is willing to apologise to Ms Post.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft aangegeven bereid te zijn excuses aan te bieden aan mevrouw Post.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Justitie over de niet verdere vervolging van een cartoonist (ingezonden 24 september 2010).

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Justice Minister why prosecutors dropped prosecution of cartoonist Nekschot despite finding his cartoons criminal, calling this inconsistent and asking about chilling effects on free speech and whether a College of Procurators General guideline on speech offences is needed. The Minister replied that the decision was on grounds of opportunity given the impact of the arrest on the suspect, saw no inconsistency, referred to his letter of the same day for the rest, and said such weighing is not a matter of rules or protocols.
The argument for that was precisely partly based on the impact this case had had on the suspect.
De argumentatie daarvoor was juist mede gelegen in de impact die deze zaak op de verdachte had gehad.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Justitie over de strafzaak tegen een journalist (ingezonden 7 september 2010).

Rep. Dibi asked the Justice Minister about the prosecution of a journalist, whether the Public Prosecution Service acted on its own rather than on Wilders' complaint, and whether judges and prosecutors need specialised knowledge of new media offences. The minister confirmed the reports, said the OM acts on its own assessment, noted that the Judiciary Council sees no need for specialisation, and gave no concrete commitment to new measures.
The OM is working on improving insight into and knowledge of the use of new media.
Het OM werkt aan het verbeteren van het inzicht en de kennis van het gebruik van nieuwe media.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over de hoge werkloosheid onder allochtone moeders (ingezonden 15 juli 2010).

An MP asks the minister for Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration about the high unemployment among non-Western immigrant mothers, and whether the government will promote their economic independence, including the approach of welfare work and neighbourhood policy.
