The minister answers that labour participation is a priority, that employment policy is primarily the responsibility of the social affairs ministry, and that concrete additional measures and a research study are underway, while neighbourhood measures are left to municipalities.
Promoting labour market participation falls under the primary responsibility of my colleague at SZW.
Het bevorderen van de arbeidsmarktparticipatie valt onder de primaire verantwoordelijkheid van mijn collega van SZW.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister voor Jeugd en Gezin over Bureau Jeugdzorg Rotterdam dat de noodklok luidt over de wachtlijsten in de jeugdzorg (ingezonden 23 juni 2010).

MP Dibi asked the minister for Youth and Family about Bureau Jeugdzorg Rotterdam's alarm over doubling youth care waiting lists, whether the minister would act, how to get more foster families in Rotterdam, and whether funding allocation should better reflect regional problem severity. The minister said the stadsregio Rotterdam is primarily responsible, pointed to a June convenant and the Afsprakenkader, described foster care campaigns and a wetsvoorstel, and noted the funding model is being developed with a report expected in 2011.
It is therefore primarily up to the stadsregio Rotterdam to take action on this.
Het is daarmee primair aan de stadsregio Rotterdam om hier actie op te ondernemen.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Justitie over het gratis verstrekken van een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag aan vrijwilligers (ingezonden 1 juli 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Justice why free or cheaper Verklaringen Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) for volunteers have not materialised, whether the digital VOG system will reduce costs and why it is delayed, and whether the subsidy to a child-volunteer federation will end. The minister answered that an online VOG pilot started on 1 July 2010, that costs are expected to fall once municipal fees are dropped, that the subsidy is being phased out for lack of funds, and that the cost level will be reviewed after the pilot.
I will inform you further about this before 1 July 2011.
Ik zal u hierover voor 1 juli 2011 nader informeren.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Justitie over de wenselijkheid van een verbod op gewelddadige computerspelletjes (ingezonden 15 juli 2010).

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the case for a criminal ban on violent computer games, citing research suggesting parental information is more important than prohibition, and asked about the existing legal framework and parental responsibility. The minister answered that a limited ban on extremely violent games is preferred, that Dutch law lacks an absolute ban tool, that parents are informed via Nicam classifications, and that industry agreements are being monitored with possible legislation if progress is insufficient.
If this does not lead to the desired result, the government will have to consider stricter measures.
Mocht dit niet tot het gewenste resultaat leiden, dan zal de overheid zich op strengere maatregelen moeten bezinnen.

Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretarissen van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de open brief van de onderwijsbonden (ingezonden 20 mei 2010).

An MP asked ministers whether they would end uncertainty over 2010 wage increases for education staff and whether they would implement a motion on applying the reference model in full. The minister answered that the government will not promise to apply the reference model unconditionally and cannot carry out the Azough motion, because a general wage freeze applies to all government staff, including education personnel.
The cabinet therefore can never promise to apply the reference model in full under all circumstances.
Het kabinet kan daarom nimmer toezeggen onder alle omstandigheden onverkort het referentiemodel toe te passen.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over de vrijheid van meningsuiting en religiekritiek (ingezonden 26 april 2010).

An MP asked the government about the pressure on freedom of expression when religious criticism is made, citing cases such as cartoonist Kurt Westergaard and others, and asked what role the government sees for itself and whether it will act. The minister declined to judge the Westergaard matter, said the government has already taken initiatives such as a commission on core constitutional values, and promised to inform parliament after EU discussions on the topic.
However, it is not my task to interfere in the relationship between the Danish newspaper Jyllands-Posten and Mr Westergaard.
Het is echter niet mijn taak om mij in de relatie tussen de Deense krant Jyllands-Posten en de heer Westergaard te mengen.
qn: Vragen van de leden Ferrier (CDA), Kraneveldt-van der Veen (PvdA), Anker (ChristenUnie), Van der Vlies (SGP), Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink (VVD) en Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over

MPs from six parties asked the Minister of Education about the PO-Raad's claim that cuts to Passend Onderwijs would force school dismissals, the basis for harmonising the rugzak funding for special primary education, and how this fits earlier commitments and the cabinet's caretaker status. The minister confirmed the amounts, explained the harmonisation as a response to rising indications exceeding the 2010 budget, and said hardship cases would get tailored solutions.
The press release, however, concerns the current situation.
Het persbericht ziet echter op de huidige situatie.

Asks the government with provinces to clarify options for interim projects that lack a permit under the Habitat Directive to obtain a permit application.
requests the government, together with the provinces, to make clear as soon as possible which options interim projects have to reach an appropriate permit application.
verzoekt de regering, samen met de provincies zo spoedig mogelijk inzichtelijk te maken welke opties «interim-mers» hebben om tot een passende vergunningaanvraag te komen

whereby landowners are actively informed of the intention to assign the 'nitrogen-sensitive' label
waarbij de grondeigenaren actief op de hoogte worden gesteld van het voornemen om het label «stikstofgevoelig» toe te kennen
Motie van de leden Harbers en Geurts over opkoop van gronden niet verplicht stellen in de landelijke beëindigingsregeling
Asks the government to lobby the European Commission so that buying up land is not a mandatory condition in the national livestock termination scheme.
to work with the European Commission so that buying up land does not become a mandatory condition in the national termination scheme
zich er bij de Europese Commissie voor in te zetten dat opkoop van gronden geen verplichtende voorwaarde wordt in de landelijke beëindigingsregeling
Motie van het lid Harbers c.s. over een emissiearm managementsysteem
Asks the government to allow farms to deviate from new-build or renovation requirements for low-emission stables if farm-level emission targets are met through managed low-emission practices.
requests the government to offer an option to deviate from new-build or renovation of stables with low-emission measures
verzoekt de regering, om een optie te bieden om af te wijken van nieuw- of verbouw van stallen met emissiearme maatregelen
Amendement van de leden Geurts en Harbers over rekening houden met vereisten op economisch, sociaal en cultureel gebied
Requires the minister to take into account economic, social and cultural requirements and regional and local particularities when applying the habitat rules.
In doing so the Minister takes into account the requirements in the economic, social and cultural fields and the regional and local particularities.
Daarbij houdt Onze Minister rekening met de vereisten op economisch, sociaal en cultureel gebied en met de regionale en lokale bijzonderheden.
Motie van het lid Geurts c.s. over de maatregel maatwerk piekbelasters
Asks the government to consider the impact of local industrial peak polluters and whether provinces can play a role in the nitrogen peak-load measure.
requests the government, when elaborating the peak-load tailoring measure, to account for the impact of local specific peak polluters
verzoekt de regering, om bij de uitwerking van de maatregel maatwerk piekbelasters industrie rekening te houden met de impact van lokale specifieke piekbelasters
Motie van de leden Van Otterloo en Harbers over intensivering van bronmaatregelen voor de kustprovincies
Asks the government to explore intensifying source measures for nitrogen in coastal provinces, such as shore power and shipping route changes.
requests the government to explore options for intensifying source measures for the coastal provinces
verzoekt de regering, mogelijkheden te onderzoeken voor intensivering van bronmaatregelen voor de kustprovincies
Motie van de leden Geurts en Harbers over een maatschappelijke kosten-batenanalyse van Natura 2000-gebieden
Asks the government to build a model ensemble for nitrogen deposition and to carry out a social cost-benefit analysis of Natura 2000 areas.
requests the government also to swiftly carry out a social cost-benefit analysis of Natura 2000 areas in the Netherlands
verzoekt de regering, tevens spoedig een maatschappelijke kosten-batenanalyse van Natura 2000-gebieden in Nederland uit te voeren
Amendement van de leden Harbers en Geurts over een hardheidsclausule
Asks that, if a Natura 2000 conservation target cannot be met due to nitrogen from other EU member states, the minister consult those states and then the European Commission.
the Minister consults the member states from which the nitrogen mainly originates on measures in those states
overlegt Onze Minister met de lidstaten waaruit de stikstof overwegend afkomstig is, over maatregelen in die lidstaten
Motie van de leden Geurts en Harbers over een internationaal leidende positie voor de Nederlandse land- en tuinbouw in 2030
Asks the government to map how Dutch agriculture can keep sufficient critical mass and quality to stay internationally leading by 2030.
requests the government to map how Dutch agriculture and horticulture retain sufficient critical mass and quality in 2030
verzoekt de regering, in beeld te brengen hoe de Nederlandse land- en tuinbouw in 2030 voldoende kritische massa en kwaliteit behoudt
Amendement van het lid Bisschop c.s. over een aanvullend legalisatieprogramma
Obliges the minister to legalise permit-free Natura 2000 projects with low nitrogen deposition and to adopt a mitigation programme, with a review and implementation deadline.
In the interest of legal certainty, the Minister together with the provincial executives ensures the legalisation of projects with low nitrogen deposition
Onze Minister draagt in het belang van de rechtszekerheid tezamen met gedeputeerde staten van de provincies zorg voor het legaliseren van de projecten met een geringe stikstofdepositie
Motie van het lid Harbers c.s. over bedrijfsfinanciering voor initiatiefnemers van meldingen en meldingsvrije activiteiten
Asks the cabinet to explore with financial institutions how initiatives lacking permits after the PAS ruling can still obtain business financing before permits are granted.
requests the cabinet, together with financial sector institutions, to examine whether and how initiators can be financed
verzoekt het kabinet, om samen met de instellingen uit de financiële sector te onderzoeken of en op welke wijze initiatiefnemers
Motie van de leden Agnes Mulder en Harbers over in kaart brengen van de no-regretmaatregelen voor investeren in de energie-infrastructuur
Asks the government to map no-regret measures for energy infrastructure investment for industry and present them to the House in the coming spring.
and present these to the House next spring.
en deze komend voorjaar aan de Kamer voor te leggen
Motie van het lid Bruins c.s. over financiële participatie bij hernieuwbare-energieprojecten borgen
Asks the government to better support provinces and municipalities in securing financial participation in renewable energy projects, and to consider whether additional legal instruments are needed.
to consider whether additional legal instruments are needed for this
te bezien of hiervoor aanvullend juridisch instrumentarium nodig is
Motie van het lid Sienot c.s. over de ontwikkeling van groene waterstof ten bate van schone energieopwekking

Asks the government to address in its hydrogen programme how green hydrogen development goes with clean power generation, use of gas infrastructure and imports, and to report to the House in early 2021.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Sienot c.s. over het met 63 miljoen euro verhogen van het subsidiebudget voor de postcoderoosregeling
Raises the subsidy commitment budget for the postcode rose solar scheme by 63 million euros, funded from the sustainable energy reserve.
to increase the commitment budget for the renewed postcode rose scheme by 63 million euros
om het verplichtingenbudget voor de vernieuwde postcoderoosregeling te verhogen met 63 miljoen euro
Motie van het lid Sienot c.s. over overleg met netbeheerders om verdere vertraging in aansluiting te voorkomen
Asks the government to consult grid operators and run a market consultation on alternatives such as batteries to avoid delays in grid connections in congested areas.
requests the government to consult with grid operators so that where congestion occurs further delay in connection is prevented
verzoekt de regering, om met netbeheerders in overleg te gaan, zodat zij daar waar congestie optreedt, verdere vertraging in aansluiting voorkomen
Amendement van het lid Dik-Faber c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 35 over de mogelijkheid voor gegevensuitwisseling
Amendment adding a legal basis for the Groningen damage institute, the minister and municipalities to exchange information, including personal data, for integrated damage and reinforcement handling.
the Groningen Mining Damage Institute, the Minister of BZK and municipalities are given the power to exchange information, including personal data
het Instituut Mijnbouwschade Groningen, de Minister van BZK en gemeenten de bevoegdheid krijgt om informatie uit te wisselen, waaronder persoonsgegevens
Amendement van het lid Dik-Faber c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 22 over de mogelijkheid voor gegevensuitwisseling
Asks that the Instituut Mijnbouwschade Groningen, the Minister of BZK and the municipalities may exchange information, including personal data, on damage handling and reinforcement decisions.
The Institute, the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the municipal executives of the municipalities concerned provide each other, on request, with data, including personal data

Het Instituut, de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en het college van burgemeester en wethouders van de betrokken gemeenten verstrekken elkaar desgevraagd de gegevens, waaronder persoonsgegevens
Amendement van het lid Dik-Faber c.s. over de mogelijkheid voor gegevensuitwisseling
Amendment adding a duty for the Groningen damage institute, the Interior Minister and municipalities to share information, including personal data, on damage claims and reinforcement decisions.
The Institute, the Minister of the Interior and the municipal executives concerned provide each other, upon request, with data, including personal data

Het Instituut, de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en het college van burgemeester en wethouders van de betrokken gemeenten verstrekken elkaar desgevraagd de gegevens, waaronder persoonsgegevens
Motie van het lid Sienot c.s. over afspraken maken over doorlooptijden voor schadevergoeding
Asks the government to agree on processing times for the different damage types under the Groningen compensation scheme and report them in its annual report.
requests the government to make agreements on processing times for the various damage types and report on them in its annual report
verzoekt de regering, om afspraken te maken over de doorlooptijden van de verschillende schadevormen en hierover te rapporteren in haar jaarverslag
Amendement van het lid Sienot c.s. t.v.v. nr. 17 over een ruimhartige schadeafhandeling als uitgangspunt
Amendment adding to the Groningen damage-compensation institute's procedure a principle of generous claims handling, to protect the existing practice of the legal presumption of causation.
The procedure and working method of the Institute shall take generous damage handling as a starting point.
De procedure en werkwijze van het Instituut kennen een ruimhartige schadeafhandeling als uitgangspunt.
Motie van de leden Geurts en Harbers over een geloofwaardig en effectief pakket van praktische natuurherstelmaatregelen
Asks the government with the provinces to present a credible package of practical nature-restoration measures for Natura 2000 areas by early 2020.
requests the government, together with the provinces, to come up by early 2020 with a credible and effective package of practical nature-restoration measures
verzoekt de regering, samen met de provincies begin 2020 te komen met een geloofwaardig en effectief pakket van praktische natuurherstelmaatregelen
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Geurts en Harbers tvv nr 19 over een voorhang bij de ministeriële regeling over diervoeder en milieu

I have asked the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to give extra attention to the Yezidis in the upcoming general country report on Iraq, which I expect early next year.
Ik heb het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken gevraagd bij het komende algemeen ambtsbericht over Irak, dat ik begin volgend jaar verwacht, extra aandacht te besteden aan de jezidi’s
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Omtzigt over  het  bericht 'Nederland stuurt Yezidi’s terug naar de tentenkampen en dat is tegen eigen regels zeggen advocaten'

CDA MPs Van Dam and Omtzigt asked whether the Netherlands is returning Yazidis to camps in northern Iraq, whether the policy changed, and how many genocide victims received protection and perpetrators are prosecuted. The State Secretary answered that individual asylum assessments apply, that Yazidis who lived in the Kurdistan Region after fleeing other parts of Iraq are no longer treated as having a normal residence there, and that the Netherlands prosecutes international crimes while leading international evidence mechanisms, though the government does not register asylum grounds by group and gave no case figures.
I have asked the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to pay extra attention to the Yazidis in the upcoming general country report on Iraq, which I expect early next year.
Ik heb het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken gevraagd bij het komende algemeen ambtsbericht over Irak, dat ik begin volgend jaar verwacht, extra aandacht te besteden aan de jezidi's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst en Fritsma over de speciale asielbus in Ter Apel

PVV MPs asked why a special asylum shuttle bus from Ter Apel to Emmen is priced cheaper than regular public transport, who pays for tickets, who protects drivers and whether the government will remove disruptive asylum seekers. The State Secretary answered that the three-month pilot is priced close to regular line 73, that tickets are paid from the statutory leefgeld, that the operator handles security and no incidents were reported in the first five weeks, and that no total asylum stop is planned.
On the deployment of the various measures and the implementation of adopted motions in this regard, you will be informed in the separate letter on disruptive asylum seekers.
Over de inzet van de verschillende maatregelen en de uitvoering van aangenomen moties daaromtrent wordt u geïnformeerd in de separate brief over overlastgevende asielzoekers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht ‘Meer  migranten claimen slachtoffer van mensenhandel te zijn’

MPs Becker and Van Wijngaarden asked whether rising numbers of African migrants claiming to be trafficking victims undermine the trafficking regime and asylum procedures, and whether the law could be changed. The State Secretary confirmed a sharp rise in trafficking reports, especially from Nigerian Dublin claimants, said this overloads police and prosecution and that the Dublin claim lapses when a residence permit is granted, and said a package of measures would follow.
By letter of 28 June 2019 I informed your House about an integrated package of measures addressing the above problems.
Bij brief van 28 juni 2019 heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd over een integraal pakket aan maatregelen die bovengenoemde problematiek adresseert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Sjoerdsma, Kuiken en Voordewind over het bericht ‘VN: 1.500 migranten in levensgevaar in Libië’

Four MPs asked the government about reports that about 1,500 migrants held in detention centres south of Tripoli were in danger from fighting, and about the evacuation of detainees, reports of forced participation in the conflict, and possible Dutch action. The ministers answered that the Netherlands is following the situation closely, supports UNHCR and IOM evacuations and resettlement via the Emergency Transit Mechanism, is considering additional funding, and says forced use of civilians in fighting would violate international humanitarian law, while the forced-participation reports were not confirmed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Becker over het bericht 'Ter Apel wil van opvangcentrum af wil, tenzij er meer politie komt'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Security ministers about reports that Westerwolde wanted to end its reception centre contract unless more police were deployed, and about the police capacity agreed for Ter Apel. The minister answered that police allocation is handled regionally and nationally, outlined the 2010 agreement and the current capacity arrangements, and committed to a meeting with the regional mayor and the Westerwolde mayor and a further letter before the summer recess.

As I also reported to your House in the Police committee meeting on 4 June, I have nonetheless arranged a separate meeting in the short term with the regional mayor of Noord-Nederland and the mayor of Westerwolde to discuss this problem.

Zoals ik uw Kamer ook in het AO Politie op 4 juni jl. heb gemeld, heb ik desalniettemin op korte termijn een aparte afspraak met de regioburgemeester Noord-Nederland en de burgemeester van Westerwolde om over deze problematiek te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Emiel van Dijk en Van Aalst over het bericht dat Sea-Watch weer uit mag varen

Three PVV MPs asked why the government cannot keep NGO rescue ships like Sea-Watch in port, as Italy and Panama do, and called for a halt to asylum and the detention of the ship. The minister answered that Dutch flag and safety rules govern the ship, that the government supports rescue at sea but not operations that aid smugglers, and that it cannot impose an asylum stop because that would breach international obligations.
Regarding the asylum stop you propose, I refer you to the earlier answer from the State Secretary for Justice and Security.
Ten aanzien van de door u voorgestelde asielstop, verwijs ik u naar de eerdere beantwoording van de Staatssecretaris van Justitie en Veiligheid

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Drost en Segers over het bericht ‘Ombudsman slaat alarm: 'Het centrum van Amsterdam is 's nachts een wetteloze jungle’ en daarbij het conceptrapport van de Ombudsman van Amsterdam

MPs Drost and Segers asked ministers about the Amsterdam Ombudsman's draft report on lawlessness, nightlife, ATMs, prostitution and tourism in the city centre. The government replied that these are mainly local matters, outlined police capacity increases, RIEC cooperation, ATM oversight limits, and exit programmes, while declining to take a national lead on most suggested measures.
The draft report of the Ombudsman metropolitan Amsterdam concerns a local matter.
Het conceptrapport van de Ombudsman metropool Amsterdam betreft een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Harbers en Aukje de Vries over de resolutie van de Banco Popular Español

MPs Harbers and Aukje de Vries asked the Finance Minister about the resolution of Banco Popular Español, its takeover by Santander, compliance with BRRD and banking union rules, the state of the Spanish banking sector, and the handling of Italian banks. The minister answered that the case was a resolution with bail-in under the BRRD/SRM framework, that no taxpayer money was used, that Spanish banks have strengthened since 2012, and that Member States may still choose preventive recapitalisation within EU rules.
The chosen solution for Banco Popular Español did use a bail-in, consisting of writing down capital instruments and converting subordinated debt.
Bij de gekozen oplossing voor Banco Popular Español is juist wel gebruik gemaakt van een bail in, bestaande uit het afschrijven van kapitaalinstrumenten en het omzetten van achtergestelde schulden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Harbers en Van der Linde over het bericht 'Brusselse eis zet Rotterdamse haven in financiële klem”

MPs from the VVD asked the government about the Rotterdam port's financial squeeze after the European Commission ended the corporate tax exemption for ports, and about the level playing field across EU ports. The minister replied that port investment room is not currently under pressure, that the Commission's state aid procedures against Belgium and France and the port regulation are on track, and that the Netherlands continues to press for fair competition.
At present the investment room of HbR is not under pressure and the port company is able to carry out the planned investments.
Op dit moment staat de investeringsruimte van HbR niet onder druk en is het Havenbedrijf in staat de geplande investeringen uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Harbers over de berichten 'the Secret Debt Plan?, 'Is there a secret debt plan?' en 'Commission confirms work on securitisation of EU sovereign bonds'?

An MP asked the Finance Minister about press reports of a secret EU debt plan (European Safe Bonds, securitisation of sovereign bonds) and whether Germany objects. The minister answered that no concrete proposal exists yet from the ESRB or the Commission, the topic is not on Eurogroup or Ecofin agendas, and the government values private bearing of risk without giving a substantive assessment.
If the topic is put on the agenda, the House will be informed as usual in the annotated agenda for these meetings.
Indien het onderwerp wordt geagendeerd zal de Kamer zoals gebruikelijk hierover geïnformeerd worden in de geannoteerde agenda voor deze overleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Harbers over het bericht ‘Italy’s cabinet approves Monte dei Paschi bailout’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that Italy's cabinet approved a bailout of Monte dei Paschi, including its compatibility with BRRD and state aid rules, Commission approval, compensation of retail bondholders, budget and Stability Pact effects, and commitment to banking union. The minister answered that the Commission has not objected to liquidity support, that a final Commission view on recapitalisation is still pending, that compensation details are unknown, and that the budget impact is uncertain.
No final judgement has yet been given by the European Commission on this.
Hierover is nog geen definitief oordeel door de Europese Commissie gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Harbers over de vervolging van een Griekse statisticus en de onafhankelijkheid van de Griekse statistiek

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the prosecution of former Greek statistics chief Andreas Georgiou and whether Syriza is intimidating independent institutions such as ELSTAT and the central bank. The minister said he had no further information on the incidents, stressed the importance of judicial independence, and noted that Eurostat has validated ELSTAT's data and that the court process should run its course.
I attach great importance to the independence of the judiciary, also in Greece.
Ik hecht sterk aan de onafhankelijkheid van de rechtelijke macht, ook in Griekenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Harbers over het vervolgen van een statisticus en de onafhankelijkheid van de Griekse statistiek

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the hearing where former ELSTAT head Georgiou warned of pressure on Greek statisticians, the prosecution of Georgiou, and a Greek minister's call to investigate deficit figures. The minister answered that ELSTAT was set up as an independent authority, that Eurostat has no open reservations on Greek deficit data, that politicians should not question official statistics, and that the court case must run its course without comment.
Of course it is important to keep monitoring this under the programme.
Het is uiteraard van belang om dit onder het programma te blijven monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Harbers, Visser, De Boer en Van Veen over het bericht ‘Nederland traag met investeren via Europa’

VVD MPs asked why the Netherlands uses relatively little EFSI investment funding, whether projects were rejected, and whether EFSI should be extended beyond 2018. The minister replied that seven Dutch EFSI transactions worth EUR 287 million have been approved, that rejections are not recorded, that the NIA was set up to help pipeline projects, and that the government will assess any extension constructively, demanding budget clarity and evaluation.
The number of rejections for EFSI is not recorded, because that may contain business-sensitive information.
Het aantal afwijzingen voor EFSI wordt niet geregistreerd, omdat dat bedrijfsgevoelige informatie kan bevatten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Harbers over de berichten 'European Commission Authorized Italian Government to Support Banks' en 'Duitsland hekelt bankenplan Italië'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports on an EU-approved Italian plan to support banks and German criticism of it, asking about the rules, the state aid basis, budget consequences, and German objections. The minister answered that the plan is a precautionary liquidity guarantee facility (up to 150 billion euro) for solvent banks under Commission conditions, that it is for the Commission to judge state aid, that no budget consequence arises unless the facility is used, and that EU bail-in rules will not be set aside.
On this measure too, I have no independent judgement.
Ook over deze maatregel heb ik geen zelfstandig oordeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Harbers over het bericht ’EU liet 113 miljard begrotingsboetes voorbij gaan'

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether the European Commission's reluctance to impose fines under the Stability and Growth Pact undermines fiscal discipline and the euro, citing reports on France, Spain, Portugal and Italy. The Minister replies that fines are only one step, that Commission application of the rules involves discretion and flexibility which has increased, that he rejects claims of favouritism towards France, and that he supports greater transparency and simplicity of the Pact.
It is essential for the credibility of the rules that the Commission does not shy away from taking steps when the budgetary situation in member states gives cause for them.
Het is essentieel voor de geloofwaardigheid van de regels dat de Commissie er niet voor terugdeinst stappen te zetten, indien de begrotingssituatie in lidstaten daar aanleiding toe geeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Harbers en Aukje de Vries over het op te richten Italiaanse noodfonds

MPs Harbers and Aukje de Vries asked the Finance Minister about a proposed Italian private rescue fund for weak banks, its governance, state aid and bail-in implications, and whether it circumvents the BRRD. The minister answered that information is limited to public reports, that state aid compatibility is for the European Commission to judge, and that a private fund on market terms would fall outside the bail-in rules.
My information about such a fund is limited to public reporting.
Mijn informatie over een dergelijk fonds is beperkt tot openbare berichtgeving
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Harbers en Aukje de Vries over de reddingsactie van de Portugese overheid bij de Banco Novo

MPs Harbers and Aukje de Vries asked the Finance Minister about Portugal's rescue of Banco Novo, whether it followed EU state aid and BRRD rules, whether it was timed to avoid the new BRRD, and about a similar Italian bad bank deal. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the state aid approval, BRRD and state aid rules were followed, that the ECB had no role in the Portuguese resolution decision, and that he cannot judge investor claims.
I have no indication that the measures at Novo Banco violate the European state aid rules or the applicable BRRD rules.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat de maatregelen bij Novo Banco in strijd zijn met de Europese staatssteunregels of de geldende regels uit de BRRD.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Harbers over de ANFA en het opkoopbeleid van nationale centrale banken

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the ANFA agreement and national central banks' purchases of government bonds, including whether they bought bonds to support their own governments and what DNB holds. The minister answered that NCBs may hold sovereign bonds within ECB limits, that ANFA caps their net financial assets, that he supports the ban on monetary financing, and that he will discuss publishing ANFA with DNB.
Ultimately, however, this is up to the ECB and the national central banks.
Dit is uiteindelijk echter aan de ECB en de nationale centrale banken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Harbers over het bericht "Provincie belegt weer 50 miljoen"

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a province investing 50 million in a hybrid tier 1 instrument issued by BNG Bank, whether this circumvents mandatory treasury banking and which other authorities did similar investments. The minister answered that the investment is permitted as fulfilling a public task under the financing law, listing the other participating authorities, and denied circumvention.
If the province of Friesland therefore regards BNG Bank and NWB Bank as institutions performing a public task, these funds may be provided to those banks.
Wanneer de provincie Friesland BNG Bank en NWB Bank dus aanmerkt als instellingen die een publieke taak verrichten, mogen deze middelen verschaft worden aan deze banken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Harbers over het bericht ‘De enorme interesse voor vergunningen voor internetgokken in Nederland’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Harbers asked about the expected size of the online gambling market, the revenue impact of uniform gambling tax rates of 24% or 25%, expected channelling rates and enforcement options. The government estimated the 2014 market at about 232 million euros, reported a lower revenue estimate than previously assumed if uniform rates were adopted, and said full enforcement against illegal online operators is unrealistic, so successful initial channelling is crucial.
At my request, three trade associations of online gambling operators made a closer estimate of the size of the Dutch online gambling market in 2014.

Op mijn verzoek hebben drie brancheorganisaties van online kansspelaanbieders, Speel Verantwoord, European Gaming and Betting Association en Remote Gaming Association, een nadere inschatting gemaakt van de omvang van de Nederlandse markt voor online kansspelen in 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Harbers over het bericht dat de Griekse overheid onderzoek doet naar een statisticus

Harbers (VVD) asked the Finance Minister about reports that Greek authorities are investigating the statistics chief Georgiou over the 2009 deficit figure, and about independence of statistics and Greek fiscal oversight. The minister said the investigating judge will decide on prosecution, that statistical independence is important and required under EU rules and the Greek loan programme, and that he awaits talks with the Greek authorities.
It is not for me to speculate now on the outcome of a Greek judicial investigation.
Het is niet aan mij om nu te gaan speculeren over de uitkomst van een Grieks gerechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Harbers over het bericht dat de Portugese overheid de Banco Espírito Santo (BES) redt

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that Portugal is rescuing Banco Espírito Santo, including whether state aid was tested under EU rules, why junior creditors were not fully bailed in, and whether the bail-in principle agreed in Eurogroup/ECOFIN was respected. The Minister answered that the Commission found the BES resolution compliant with current state aid rules, and that losses fall on shareholders and subordinated bondholders.
Because losses on the bad assets fall on shareholders and subordinated bondholders, bail-in of private creditors takes place in line with the state aid rules.
Doordat verliezen op de slechte activa neerslaan bij de aandeelhouders en achtergestelde obligatiehouders vindt er bail-in plaats van private crediteuren confom de staatssteunregels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Harbers over een leningsverzoek van Curaçao ter grootte van 60 miljoen Antilliaanse Guldens

MPs Bosman and Harbers asked the Finance Minister about Curaçao's 60 million ANG loan request, the CFT's advice, whether the Rijkswet's conditions were met, why the Netherlands subscribes despite CFT concerns about financial management, and transparency of state-owned enterprises. The Minister answered that the CFT found the requirements met and advised positively, that Dutch subscription is mandatory under the Rijkswet, and that Aruba's protocol is not currently active.
On the basis of this assessment, the CFT gave positive advice on Curaçao's loan request.
Het Cft heeft op basis van deze toets positief geadviseerd over het leningverzoek van Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Harbers over het bericht ‘Investitionsprogramm für Griechenland’

An MP from the VVD asked the Finance Minister about a planned 500 million euro investment fund for Greece, whether other eurozone states were being asked to contribute, and whether Dutch funds should go in outside the EFSF/ESM framework. The minister confirmed the fund for Greek SMEs, listed contributions from Germany (via KfW), the EIB and EU structural funds, and said the Netherlands had received no official request, leaving contributions to member states' own choice.
The Netherlands has so far received no official request.
Nederland heeft tot op heden geen officieel verzoek ontvangen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Harbers over het bericht ‘Dijsselbloem wil af van rol IMF bij reddingsoperaties’

MP Harbers asked whether the minister wants to review the IMF's role in future eurozone rescue operations and why the government's long-standing demand for IMF participation seems to be changing. The minister replied that the Netherlands' position is unchanged, that the IMF should stay involved in the Troika for its financial capacity and expertise, and that any review of the IMF's role would only be considered after the eurozone crisis ends.
The Dutch position on IMF involvement in the current crisis in Europe is therefore unchanged.
Het Nederlandse standpunt over IMF-betrokkenheid in de huidige crisis in Europa is derhalve ongewijzigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkhoff en Harbers over het bericht dat het Oekraïense parlement uitingen van homoseksualiteit wil verbieden

Two VVD MPs asked the foreign minister about a Ukrainian bill banning expressions and information about homosexuality, and what the Netherlands and EU could do in response. The minister said the bill was off the 6 July agenda, that the Netherlands raised the issue bilaterally and with the EU, that the bill violates international human rights obligations, and that LGBT rights are part of EU association and visa conditions.
Within the existing financial and programmatic frameworks, the embassy provides support to LGBT organisations and activities.
De ambassade verleent binnen de bestaande financiële en programmatische kaders ondersteuning aan LHBT-organisaties en -activiteiten.

Vragen van het lid Harbers (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het terugsluizen van geld door de publieke omroep via een eigen muziekuitgeverij (ingezonden 20 mei 2010).

MP Harbers asked the state secretary whether the public broadcaster NPO channels 3 to 4 million euros yearly to its own music publisher Crossmex by forcing composers to assign rights, and whether this is an abuse of its position and whether sanctions will follow. The minister acknowledged the practice of rights assignment and mandatory placement with Crossmex, found it undesirable and proposed to address it in the forthcoming copyright contract law bill, but said no Mediawet provisions are breached so no sanctions have a legal basis, and that abuse of market power is for the competition authority to judge.
I consider this practice undesirable, because it can disadvantage the position of individual creators.
Ik acht deze praktijk onwenselijk, omdat het de positie van de individuele makers kan benadelen.

Vragen van de leden De Krom en Harbers (beiden VVD) aan de ministers voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over subsidie voor het aantrekken en begeleiden van niet-westerse allochtone s

MPs De Krom and Harbers asked whether the Ministry of Education allocates EUR 3 million to Randstad universities specifically to attract and support non-Western allochtone students, and why such support is not extended to autochthonous students. The state secretary confirmed the EUR 3 million per year from 2011 to 2014, framed as part of broader study-success policy for all students, with performance agreements and a 2013 review pending.
At the end of 2013, based on the results and the inspectorate's evaluation, a decision will be taken on whether the arrangement continues and, if so, in what form.
Eind 2013 vindt, op basis van de resultaten en de evaluatie van de inspectie, besluitvorming plaats over de vraag of het arrangement wordt voortgezet en zo ja, in welke vorm.
Vragen van het lid Harbers (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de reclame voor de Publieke Omroep op de Publieke omroep (ingezonden 18 juni 2010).

MP Harbers asks the state secretary about publicly funded self-promotion spots by the Publieke Omroep, their cost, the basis of the statistics they cite, and whether public money should fund campaigns for the broadcaster's support. The state secretary says self-promotion is part of the broadcaster's public task funded from its marketing budget, that the statistics come from NPO-commissioned research, and declines to reconsider.
Self-promotion, like programme promotion, is a suitable means for this.
Zelfpromotie is daar – net als programmapromotie – een geschikt middel voor.
Vragen van het lid Harbers (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de nieuwe collegegeldtarieven van de Universiteit van Tilburg (ingezonden 13 april 2010).

The MP asks the state secretary about Tilburg University's new 2010-2011 tuition rates, which charge students who did not enrol in 2009-2010 full institutional tuition for a second master or bachelor, and whether this conflicts with the covenant accompanying the Versterking Besturing bill. The state secretary answers that institutions set their own tuition policy, that the covenant concerns students completing a parallel second study at statutory tuition, that the university appears to implement the covenant, and that funding decisions belong to the spring memorandum.
It is up to each institution to determine, with reasons, what institutional tuition it charges students.
Het is aan elke instelling om gemotiveerd te bepalen welk instellingscollegegeld zij studenten in rekening brengt.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis, De Hoop, Pierik, Postma, Stoffer en Vedder over de voortgang van de verruiming van het sluizencomplex bij Kornwerderzand

MPs asked about the delayed and costlier widening of the Kornwerderzand lock complex, including whether cost increases stem from tighter Rijk standards, the salinity problem, the bridges, and whether the Rijk should bear costs. The minister answered that the cost rise reflects a more realistic estimate rather than new norms, that the regional province must make a substantial contribution, and that talks with the region are being restarted, without firm commitments on financing.

In the consultation with the deputy it was indicated that if the region chooses to realise the project, IenW first expects a substantial contribution from the regional governments towards the identified cost increase.

In het overleg met de gedeputeerde is aangegeven dat als de regio ervoor kiest het project te willen realiseren, IenW eerst een substantiële bijdrage van de regionale overheden verwacht voor de geconstateerde kostenstijging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en De Hoop over onveiligheidsgevoelens van vrouwen in de openbare ruimte.

MPs Mutluer and De Hoop asked ministers about high levels of feeling unsafe among women in public space and on public transport, and what measures are taken. The minister acknowledges the problem, cites Veiligheidsmonitor data, says public transport partners are responsible and will act, and promises further engagement and evaluation without firm new commitments.
I call on the parties involved to take up their role in this and, where necessary, to come up with additional measures.
Ik vraag de betrokken partijen om hierin hun rol te pakken en waar noodzakelijk te komen met aanvullende maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Kent over het nieuws dat omwonenden van zware industrie structureel hogere zorgkosten hebben

MPs Dobbe and Van Kent asked the government how it will respond to reports that residents near heavy industry pay on average 7 percent more in healthcare costs, and what it will do to protect them. The government says health effects of industry are known and points to the Actieagenda Industrie en Omwonenden, existing permit and enforcement reforms, and studies by RIVM, but rejects charging polluting firms directly for residents' healthcare costs.
That is therefore an incentive for the cabinet to work on further improving the living environment for residents near industry.
Dat is voor het kabinet dan ook een aansporing om te werken aan het verder verbeteren van de leefomgeving voor omwonenden van de industrie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Gabriëls en Thijssen over het bericht ‘145 euro meer kwijt aan zorg bij zware industrie in de buurt: grote bezorgdheid bij experts’

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the ministers whether they were concerned that residents near heavy industry face higher healthcare costs, why those costs are high, and what the government will do about health risks from industry. The government acknowledges industry can affect residents' health but says healthcare costs depend on many factors, points to ongoing studies and the Actieagenda Industrie en Omwonenden, and declines a new expert group and a large-scale costs study for now.
It is understandable that residents of these areas may be alarmed by this article, but there is a caveat to be made.
Het is begrijpelijk dat de inwoners van deze gebieden kunnen schrikken van dit artikel, maar er is hier ook een opmerking naast te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Bamenga over de verontreiniging met PFAS op Vliegbasis Gilze-Rijen en elf andere defensieterreinen

MPs Van der Werf and Bamenga asked ministers about severe PFAS contamination at Gilze-Rijen air base and eleven other defence sites, including whether soil norms are exceeded, why 2019-2020 measurements were not published earlier, what remediation and prevention steps are planned, and whether health risks exist. The government answers that the contamination is known to the competent authority, that a risk-based remediation plan was approved in 2024, that no health risks have been identified so far, and that the Chamber will be kept informed periodically.
Yes, the reporting by Pointer (KRO-NCRV) is known.
Ja, de berichtgeving van Pointer (KRO-NCRV) is bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriëls over het bericht ‘Vliegbasis Gilze Rijen en 11 andere Defensieterreinen ernstig verontreinigd met giftig PFAS’

An MP asked the Defence and Infrastructure ministers about reports that Gilze-Rijen air base and eleven other defence sites are heavily contaminated with PFAS, including why the 2013 data was not shared with parliament and what remediation and health measures follow. The government answered that the authorities were informed in 2020-2021, that no health risks were identified for current site use, and that remediation plans and costs will follow once risks are mapped, with a handreiking expected in autumn 2024.

Defence will periodically keep your House informed of the progress of the remediation programme and the results of any follow-up investigations into PFAS contamination on defence sites via the 'Stand van Defensie'.

Defensie zal uw Kamer via de «Stand van Defensie» periodiek op de hoogte houden van de voortgang van het saneringsprogramma en de resultaten van eventuele vervolgonderzoeken naar PFAS-vervuiling op defensieterreinen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Boswijk over het bericht ‘Als de politie alle Amsterdamse taxi’s aan de kant zet, dan heb je de grootste drugsvangst ooit’

MPs Krul and Boswijk asked the ministers about a report that police could seize large drug shipments if they stopped Amsterdam taxis, and about criminality in the taxi sector, vetting, enforcement and possible law changes. The minister answered that police do monitor taxi-linked crime through checks and investigations, that vetting and licensing rules apply, and that the sector's criminality will be addressed through partner-based measures and a review of the Wp2000 without committing to a specific legal change.
The Wp2000 is intended to safeguard the quality of taxi transport in the Netherlands.
De Wp2000 is bedoeld om de kwaliteit van het taxivervoer in Nederland te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bamenga over de procedure van Nederland en Australië tegen Rusland bij ICAO ten gevolge van de aanslag op vlucht MH17

MPs Paternotte and Bamenga asked whether Russia's withdrawal from the ICAO proceedings over MH17 is sabotage, what steps the government will take, whether Russia's voting rights should be suspended, and whether the issue will be raised at the current ICAO Council meeting. The government regrets Russia's withdrawal, says the Netherlands and Australia will pursue the case and asked the Council to decide in their favour, and states that suspending voting rights requires a finding of a Chicago Convention violation, which the withdrawal alone is not, though the claim already requested such suspension.
The Netherlands and Australia are determined to pursue the proceedings in order to achieve truth-finding, justice and accountability.
Nederland en Australië zijn vastbesloten de procedure door te zetten, om waarheidsvinding, gerechtigheid en rekenschap te bewerkstelligen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over hinder en omgevingsrisico’s door afvalverwerkingsindustrie in Sluiskil

An MP asked the Minister about dust nuisance and health risks from waste processor Heros in Sluiskil, including lead and iron in bottom ash, monitoring, enforcement and exemptions from new dust rules. The State Secretary answered that provincial monitoring found no exceedance of limits and no evidence of bottom ash deposition, that additional source research is being done by the province and municipality, and that a study on the effects of the new rules on the metal recycling and waste sectors will be carried out.
Carrying out additional measurements is the responsibility of the competent authority.
Het uitvoeren van extra metingen is aan het bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Gabriëls over de inzet van innovatieve waterzuiveringstechnieken

MPs Stoffer and Gabriëls asked the minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about innovative water treatment techniques for PFAS, medicine residues and other pollutants, including who should pay and whether reuse can be encouraged. The minister answered that existing measures, a fourth treatment stage and an extended producer responsibility are underway, while the choice of technique and cost recovery largely rest with water managers, and that the effects of future substances cannot be fully anticipated.
It is up to the drinking water companies to assess which treatments of the abstracted water are needed to produce drinking water from it.
Het is aan de drinkwaterbedrijven om te beoordelen welke behandelingen van het ingenomen water nodig zijn om hier drinkwater van te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het nieuws dat rondom Chemours eieren vol PFAS zijn aangetroffen

An SP MP asked the government about reports of PFAS levels in backyard hen eggs near Chemours, including health risks, causes, public warnings, swimming advice and a national PFAS ban. The state secretary answered that the findings are unwelcome but not new, that the source is unknown and is being investigated by municipalities and RIVM, and that a European ban is preferred over a national one.
The RIVM research confirms the picture that was also obtained from other research in recent months and shared with the House.
Het onderzoek van het RIVM bevestigt het beeld dat de afgelopen maanden ook uit ander onderzoek is verkregen en met de Kamer is gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het nieuws dat Chemours een vergunning aanvraagt voor TFA

An SP MP asked the Infrastructure minister about Chemours' permit application for TFA emissions, drinking water effects, whether emissions should be barred until proven safe, and available abatement techniques. The government answered that the competent authority will assess the permit, that RIVM advised an indicative drinking water guideline, that emissions require proof of safety under the environmental law duty of care, and that PFAS emissions should be reduced as far as possible with support for local authorities.
It is up to the competent authority to assess this permit application.
Het is aan het bevoegd gezag om deze vergunningaanvraag te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het artikel in de Telegraaf van 30 mei 2024: ‘Vrees voor onderhoudsproblemen van monumentale kerken door milieuzone: Niet te betalen’

An MP asked the ministers whether zero-emission zones threaten maintenance of historic churches and specialist craftsmen, given that exemptions are limited to 12 day-permits per year. The government answered that the exemption package, including longer-term permits, adequately addresses these concerns, that municipalities set exemption policy, and that it will evaluate the Central Desk and share results with parliament by year end.
Exemption policy falls under municipal responsibility, so it is up to municipalities to decide which exemptions they grant.
Het ontheffingenbeleid valt onder verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten, daarmee is het aan gemeenten om te bepalen welke ontheffingen zij verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het nieuws dat bij Chemours tweemaal PFAS is vrijgekomen als gevolg van stroomstoringen

An MP asked the minister how PFAS and other substances could be released from Chemours and Delrin during emergency shutdowns caused by grid failures, and asked for substance overviews, research results and monitoring improvements. The state secretary answered that the province of Zuid-Holland is the competent authority, that investigations are ongoing with results to be published later, and that RIVM and an industry-residents action agenda are studying monitoring improvements expected in early 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de arbeidsomstandigheden in het regionale openbaar vervoer

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about sick leave, staff shortages, workload and temporary-agency use among regional public transport drivers, including Arriva's reported 30 percent absence in Twente. The minister answered that employers are responsible for staffing, that the ministry and provinces hold no staffing data, and that the NOVB only shares lessons without agreements on working conditions.
IenW has no insight into the staff records of the various transport companies.
IenW heeft geen inzicht in de personeelsbestanden van de verschillende vervoersbedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Gabriëls over het bericht 'Vervuiling Jelsumer Feart komt van vliegbasis Leeuwarden'

Two MPs asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Defence about reports that PFOS contamination in the Jelsumer Feart originates from Leeuwarden air base, including exceedances far above the water-framework norm, spread risks, health risks, remediation timing and other defence sites. The government confirmed the source is on the base, described containment measures, notification of the Public Prosecution Service, a remediation plan to be tendered in Q3 2024 with intent to remediate by year-end, and an ongoing source investigation and programmatic PFAS approach across defence sites.
The Rijksvastgoedbedrijf (RVB) has therefore been instructed to remediate the soil at the former fire-training site and the sediment in the watercourses on the air base.
Het RVB heeft daarom opdracht gekregen om de grond op de voormalige oefenbrandweerplek en het baggerslib in de watergangen op de vliegbasis te saneren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heutink over de verzorgingsplaatsen

MP Heutink (PVV) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the planned exclusive charging-tender model at motorway rest stops, which would bar operators from offering both EV chargers and fossil fuel, unduly harms fuel station operators and their profitability. The minister rejects the premise of a forced choice, defends a single large charging plot per stop allocated by tender for equal access and competition reasons, and says a transitional policy rule currently limits new charger permits.
The picture that there is a forced choice between offering fossil fuel and fast chargers is not one I recognise.
Het beeld dat er sprake is van een gedwongen keuze tussen het aanbieden van fossiele brandstof en snellaadpalen herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel op de website van De Telegraaf van 24 mei 2024: ‘Luchtvaartsector woest over nieuwe ingreep Schiphol: ‘Harbers regeert over zijn graf’

An MP from JA21 asked the minister about a press report criticising a new Schiphol noise measure, the timing of the consultation, the possible night closure, and the impact on air cargo. The minister defended the balanced approach process, said the night closure is not in the current package, and said the aircraft ban and the LVNL feasibility assessments would be addressed in the ongoing consultation.
The cabinet has previously stated that it wants to take steps as quickly as possible to reduce the noise burden around Schiphol.
Het kabinet heeft eerder aangegeven zo snel mogelijk stappen te willen zetten om de geluidbelasting rondom Schiphol omlaag te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over varend ontgassen

Parliamentary questions from MP Van Kent (SP) asked whether fraudulent reclassification of substances (omkatten) to evade the sailing-degassing ban is undermining the ban, and whether fines, degassing facilities, and enforcement capacity are adequate. Minister Harbers answered that the practice is known and deplored, fines are a matter for the Public Prosecution Service, enforcement will intensify but is only partly in place, and the sector is responsible for building degassing installations.
Supervision of sailing degassing will intensify after 1 July.
Het toezicht op varend ontgassen zal na 1 juli intensiveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen, Bromet, Vedder en Holman over het rondetafelgesprek Wolf van 4 april 2024

MPs from four parties asked the ministers about LIFE and Regional Development Fund subsidy options for wolf coexistence measures raised at a round-table meeting, and whether these had been examined. The minister replied that LIFE and EFRO funding are possible in principle but no concrete study was done, provinces are responsible, and she will raise the options with the provinces and set up a long-term coexistence vision.
I will bring these options to the attention of the provinces.
Ik zaldeze mogelijkheden onder de aandacht brengen bij de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de aanpak van recidive bij verkeersovertredingen

An MP asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers how serious recidivism in traffic offences under the administrative enforcement law could be tackled sooner and more strictly, including higher fines, driving bans and criminal-law routes. The minister acknowledged the link between repeat offences and accidents, said the WODC evaluation is ongoing with results expected in 2025, and stated that higher fines or driving bans for recidivists are currently not legally possible under that law.
Depending on the outcomes of this evaluation, follow-up steps must be determined regarding the implementation of the Administrative Enforcement of Traffic Rules Act.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten van deze evaluatie moeten vervolgstappen worden bepaald ten aanzien van (de uitvoering) van de Wet administratiefrechtelijke handhaving verkeersvoorschriften.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veltman over de verplichte ‘Intelligente Snelheidsassistentie’ (ISA) in auto's

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the mandatory Intelligent Speed Assistance (ISA) in new cars from 7 July 2024, including its accuracy, effectiveness, data privacy, cost and consumer information. The minister answered that ISA is a warning-only system, EU type-approval requires correct speed limit detection for at least 90% of distance, the EU will evaluate effectiveness by 2027, and monitoring, data-protection rules and follow-up actions are in place or planned.
The European Commission will evaluate the actual effectiveness of this measure no later than 7 July 2027.
De Europese Commissie gaat de daadwerkelijke effectiviteit van deze maatregel uiterlijk op 7 juli 2027 evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriëls over de plannen van de Waalse overheid om mijnbouw te vergunnen, vlak over de grens bij Vaals

An MP asked the minister whether Walloon plans to permit mining just across the border near Vaals were known and whether the Netherlands was involved, along with groundwater and environmental impact questions and avenues for Dutch participation. The minister answered that no concrete permit application exists, that the Netherlands asked in 2019 to be involved under the Espoo Convention, and that transboundary EIA and public participation rights apply once a concrete application is filed.
In addition, participation is also possible on a concrete permit application and on the decision of the competent authority thereon.
Daarnaast is ook op een concrete vergunningaanvraag en het besluit van het bevoegd gezag daarop inspraak mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over het bericht 'Duitsland verhoogt vliegtaks: nu 70 euro belasting op verre vlucht'

MP Bamenga asked the government about Germany's distance-based aviation tax increase and whether the Netherlands should differentiate its flat flight tax by distance and include transfer passengers, as well as the effects on emissions, noise and state revenue. The State Secretary answered that the Dutch tax is kept flat for simplicity, that further changes are for a new cabinet, and that the government will not act on the alternatives in the February report.
The caretaker cabinet therefore did not follow up on the report.
Het demissionaire kabinet heeft zodoende geen vervolg gegeven aan het rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Michon- Derkzen over het gebruik van drones door state operators

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Peter de Groot asked why Dutch state operators such as police and fire services may not fly drones beyond visual line of sight, whether EASA rules allow it, and how other countries and commercial operators are treated. The minister answered that state operations are under national rules for certain activities, that BVLOS flights are assessed on risk by the ILT, that a police pilot at Twente Airport is underway, and that a decision on the applicable rules for state operations is expected in Q3 2024.
A decision on the applicable rules for state operations in the Netherlands is expected to be taken in the third quarter of 2024.
Naar verwachting kan in het derde kwartaal van 2024 een besluit worden genomen over de toepasselijke regelgeving voor staatsoperaties in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chakor en Bushoff over gasboring in de Waddenzee

Two MPs from GroenLinks/PvdA asked the government why it cannot refuse the NAM's gas production drilling at Ternaard under the Waddenzee, citing the NAM's track record, the Mijnbouwwet grounds for refusal and withdrawal, and the UNESCO World Heritage status. The state secretary answered that existing permits cannot be refused under article 9, that withdrawal under article 21 is limited by property protection under ECHR Protocol 1, that article 36 grounds are limited, and that a decision on the winningsplan is still pending after new subsidence advice.
Withdrawing a production permit can, however, only take place if the requirements of Article 1 of the First Protocol of the European Convention on Human Rights are met.
Intrekken van een winningsvergunning kan echter alleen als is voldaan aan artikel 1 van het Eerste Protocol van het Europees Verdrag voor de Rechten van de Mens.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Podt over de uitspraken van Commandant der Strijdkrachten van Estland over Russische activiteiten in de Baltische regio met betrekking tot GPS-verstoringen.

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about Estonian military remarks on Russian GNSS jamming and spoofing and the resulting risks to aviation, NAVO operations and critical infrastructure, including measures, airspace safety and cyber/electronic warfare strategy. The government acknowledges the threat as a destabilising hybrid one, points to existing rules (Wbni), sector-led protection, NAVO policy and Galileo PRS work, and answers each question without committing to new oversight or parliamentary reporting.
The cabinet is aware of this statement.
Het kabinet is bekend met deze stelling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Kröger, Bromet en Thijssen over het Akkoord voor de Noordzee

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked about Greenpeace leaving the North Sea Consultation, gas extraction acceleration versus the Paris Agreement, and delays in closing parts of the North Sea to bottom trawling. State Secretary Vijlbrief answered that the government stays within Paris-aligned targets, that accelerated extraction only shifts production forward in time, and that the 2023 trawling closure target was missed but will be pursued via an EU procedure with a proposal by end 2024.
I have told the NZO that our aim is to submit the joint recommendation (to reach 13.7%) to the European Commission by the end of 2024.
Ik heb aan het NZO aangegeven dat onze inzet is om de gezamenlijke aanbeveling (om te komen tot 13,7%) uiterlijk eind 2024 bij de Europese Commissie in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de Dual Fuel tractoren van Blue Fuel Solutions

An MP asks why the RDW has not yet type-approved Blue Fuel Solutions' dual-fuel hydrogen tractors despite contact since 2021, why registrations were withdrawn, and what route (Article 35 procedure) and emissions testing are needed. The Staatssecretaris answers that an Article 35 procedure with emissions tests is required, that registrations were issued wrongly as diesel vehicles, that the EU-level route is preferred and that talks with the initiator and RDW continue.
I am still awaiting the results of these emissions tests.
Ik ben nog in afwachting van de resultaten van deze emissietesten.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Gabriëls over het project Maascleanup

An MP asked about the Maascleanup volunteer project, informal arrangements for removing collected litter, and whether Rijkswaterstaat should take responsibility after a 2023 incident where collected waste was left unremoved. The state secretary said Rijkswaterstaat can collect litter under the ZOR scheme if placed at the public road, described the 2023 Grensmaas incident as a coordination failure between land managers, and saw no need for new initiatives.
Since the situation at the Grensmaas is an incident, I currently see no need to take additional initiatives.
Aangezien de situatie aan de Grensmaas een incident betreft, zie ik op dit moment geen noodzaak om aanvullende initiatieven te nemen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Palmen, White, Ceder, Bamenga, Van der Plas, Vedder, Van Nispen, Ergin, Van Houwelingen, Stoffer, Koekkoek, Eerdmans,Van der Velde en Martens-America over het rapport 'Geen afgesl

MPs asked the government to respond to the ACOI report on opening the Bijlmer air disaster archives, including timelines, a balancing-test commission, and whether oversight should sit with a single minister. The minister answers that 27 dossiers are being checked for release within about ten weeks, that a commission is proposed but not yet set up, and that the current division of responsibility between BZK and OCW is retained.
The aim is to complete the review of the 27 dossiers within 10 weeks.
Het streven is om het onderzoek naar de 27 dossiers binnen 10 weken af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet whether its 2030 targets (housing, social rental share, insulation, affordable rent quotas) were still achievable. The minister answered that progress is on track for most targets, with some delays in housing and insulation of rental homes, and promised further reporting.
For the National Insulation Programme the targets are not out of sight.
Voor het Nationaal Isolatieprogramma zijn de doelstellingen niet uit beeld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Olger van Dijk, Tuinman, De Roon en Stoffer over meldingen in het veiligheidssysteem ECCAIRS over het luchtruim boven Oekraïne voor 17 juli 2014, de datum waarop vlucht MH17/KL410

MPs asked the minister for details of three Eccairs safety reports on Ukrainian airspace filed in 2014 before MH17 was shot down, and for the reports to be shared with parliament. The minister declined, citing a pending Council of State case and EU Regulation 376/2014 confidentiality rules, and promised to inform parliament after the ruling expected in Q3 2024.
Because this procedure is still ongoing, no further information can be provided.
Omdat deze procedure nog loopt, kan verder geen informatie worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet to state, for each 2030 target, whether it is still achievable, including nitrogen halving and 15% organic farmland. The ministers answered that nitrogen deposition targets are out of reach due to revised critical deposition values, and that organic farmland is growing steadily but a large gap remains, with extra funding reserved.
The nitrogen targets are currently out of reach.
De stikstofdoelen liggen op dit moment buiten bereik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked about progress toward the cabinet's 2030 targets on poverty and debt, and whether current measures suffice. The minister answers that poverty and child poverty targets will not be met without additional policy per the CPB forecast, while the debt target shows a slight rise with no CBS forecast, and commits to informing parliament in early June.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

Two MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the cabinet whether four education and research targets (zero truant children, 3% R&D spending, fewer than 18,000 early school leavers by 2026, and basic skills by 2028) remain achievable and why. The Minister answered that the targets are not hopeless, described the measures taken, and acknowledged that R&D spending (2.30% of GDP) and truancy figures are behind track, without changing the cabinet's commitments.
The picture that the targets under K, Q, U and V have become hopelessly out of reach is not one we recognise.
Het beeld dat de genoemde doelstellingen onder K, Q, U en V hopeloos uit beeld zijn geraakt herkennen wij niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet for the current progress on 19 government targets for 2030 and beyond, with concrete figures per target. The answer, limited to the target of 50% less raw material use, says the government is replacing that target with a new set of national circular-economy goals and that PBL will monitor progress in its next report in 2025.
In the National Circular Economy Programme 2023–2030 it was announced that the target of using 50% fewer abiotic raw materials by 2030 will be replaced by a set of overarching national goals.

In het Nationaal Programma Circulaire Economie (NPCE) 2023–2030 ... is aangekondigd dat de doelstelling om in 2030 50% minder abiotische grondstoffen te gebruiken, vervangen zal worden door een set aan overkoepelende doelen op nationaal niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet to report progress on its 2030 targets, including 100% clean water by 2027 under the EU Water Framework Directive. The minister answered only that sub-question, stating that roughly three-quarters of about 100,000 water-body targets are currently met, that many planned measures risk not being completed by 2027, and that a progress update will come before a June debate and an evaluation at year end.
In the run-up to the Water committee debate of 25 June, the House will receive an update on the progress of the KRW impulse programme.
In aanloop naar het Commissiedebat Water van 25 juni ontvangt de Kamer een update over de voortgang van het KRW-impulsprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the government for the progress on its 2030 targets for CO2 reduction and R&D spending, citing reports that the targets were out of reach. The ministers answer that the 55-60% CO2 target is within reach given PBL projections of 46-57% plus further measures, and that the 3% GDP R&D target is ambitious, with uncertainty from the paused National Growth Fund.

The PBL indicates that the expected greenhouse gas emission reduction in the Netherlands in 2030, based on the policy on the agenda for which an effect estimate could be made, comes to about 46–57% compared with 1990.

Het PBL geeft aan dat de verwachte broeikasgasemissiereductie in Nederland in 2030 op basis van het geagendeerde beleid, waarvoor een effectschatting kon worden gemaakt, uitkomt op circa 46–57% ten opzichte van 1990.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en De Hoop over het bericht dat vijf jaar na ramp met MSC Zoe duidelijk wordt waar de troep ligt

MPs Bamenga and De Hoop asked why the Master Target List of the MSC Zoe wreck debris was withheld for years, whether the shipping company was asked to publish it, and whether the remaining cargo will be recovered. The minister answered that the operation is closed, MSC cannot be forced to salvage more, the list was made public in December 2023 after an open-government request, and remaining objects are largely not MSC Zoe cargo.
MSC refused to make the Master Target List available to anyone other than Rijkswaterstaat, and gave no reasons for doing so.
MSC weigerde de Master Target List ter beschikking te stellen aan anderen dan Rijkswaterstaat. MSC heeft daarvoor geen redenen aangevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Kostić over ‘het onder druk zetten van de minister van LNV om glyfosaat niet te verbieden’

MPs Ouwehand and Kostić asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that he opposed the Minister of Agriculture's plan to vote against renewing glyphosate approval, despite a Chamber motion. Minister Harbers confirmed discussion in the cabinet, deferred to the independent scientific advice (EFSA, Ctgb) and denied external lobbying contacts, but gave no direct answer on his own motives.
I have not held any discussions on this subject with external companies, institutions or organisations during this period.
Ik heb in deze periode geen gesprekken over dit onderwerp gevoerd met externe bedrijven, instellingen of organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hertzberger en Olger van Dijk over het bericht ‘Kabinet versoepelde exclusief voor Schiphol de bestaande stikstofregels’

MPs Hertzberger and Olger van Dijk asked the government why Schiphol's nitrogen permit allowed external netting without an additionality requirement, why 500,000 flights were permitted despite advice pointing to 440,000, and about nearby habitat overload. The Minister of Nature and Nitrogen answered that the permit followed a technical assessment and that the reference situations and external netting were applied as before, with limited nitrogen increases, while partly deferring to other responsibilities and procedures.
I was advised by officials to make the decision, as I did in September 2023.
Mij is ambtelijk geadviseerd om het besluit te nemen, zoals ik dat in september 2023 genomen heb.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet for the current status of its 2030 targets, including halving road deaths. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management answers only the road-casualty sub-question: the target is likely too ambitious, the cabinet keeps existing measures and will examine an extra step, with results expected mid-2024.
For question 2, under e, you will receive a separate answer from me shortly.
Voor vraag 2, onder e, zult u op korte termijn een separaat antwoord van mij ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen zoals in deze vragen geformuleerd onder i, j, r, s en t

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the government about progress on cabinet targets for 2030 and 2040, including zero homelessness, zero youth in closed youth care, reducing health inequalities and reducing overweight.
