The State Secretary replied that targets are ambitious but progress is partial: homelessness and overweight targets are unlikely to be met without intensified measures, closed placements have fallen but zero is not yet reached, and the health-inequality mission has no quantitative forecast yet.
The calculation shows that the agreements do contribute to fewer people with overweight, but with the actions from the NPA introduced in recent years the ambitions for 2040 will not be achieved.

De doorrekening laat zien dat de afspraken weliswaar bijdragen aan minder mensen die overgewicht hebben, maar met de acties uit het NPA die de afgelopen jaren zijn ingevoerd worden de ambities voor 2040 niet bereikt.
Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Gabriëls over granuliet

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the current classification of granuliet as soil rests on 2020 parliamentary answers and a 2021 Council of State ruling, and whether granuliet differs from granite sand because of polyacrylamide. The State Secretary confirmed that granuliet meets the Soil Quality Decree definition of soil, upheld by the Council of State, and that polyacrylamide does not change this, but deferred answers to questions 6 onward on timing grounds.
The Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State confirmed on 31 October 2021 that the presence of polyacrylamide is no reason to classify granuliet differently from soil.
De Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State heeft op 31 oktober 2021 bevestigd dat de aanwezigheid van polyacrylamide geen reden is om granuliet anders te classificeren dan grond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veltman over bevoegdheden van gemeenten en provincies voor het verbeteren van verkeersveiligheid

MP Veltman asked whether the government supports giving municipalities and provinces their own powers to buy and place speed cameras, and whether boa's (special investigating officers) can enforce speeding and alcohol checks. The Minister answered that the proposal needs further study, lists existing municipal options and the planned expansion of cameras, but rejects municipal camera ownership and boa enforcement of speeding and alcohol offences, citing criminal-justice capacity and governance concerns.
In addition, we will shortly invite the parties involved in traffic enforcement to discuss the concerns and proposals as shared with us in the proposal.
Daarnaast nodigen wij de betrokken partijen bij verkeershandhaving binnenkort uit om in gesprek te gaan over de zorgen en voorstellen zoals deze in de propositie met ons zijn gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heutink en Madlener over het bericht in diverse media dat drinkwaterbedrijf Vitens de noodklok luidt vanwege het toenemende tekort aan drinkwater in Nederland

MPs Heutink and Madlener asked the ministers about reports that Vitens warns of a drinking water shortage that could block connections for new housing and businesses, and about refusals of business clients, planned measures, and whether permit refusals should be eased. The minister answered that water supply concerns are recognised, pointed to the Actieprogramma beschikbaarheid drinkwaterbronnen 2023–2030 and a drinking water saving plan, said Rijk intervention is not preferred but not excluded, and that permit decisions rest with the competent authority, while committing to further work with provinces.
I do not rule out intervention by the national government, but given the administrative relationship this is not the preferred option.
Ingrijpen door het Rijk sluit ik niet uit, maar dit heeft gezien de bestuurlijke verhouding niet de voorkeur.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Paternotte over de berichten 'Vitens: mogelijk geendrinkwateraansluiting bij nieuwe woningen' en 'Al tientallen bedrijven krijgengeen aansluiting op drinkwater'

D66 MPs Bamenga and Paternotte asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that drinking water shortages may prevent new housing and businesses from getting connections, and whether the crisis affects schools, hospitals and infrastructure. The minister acknowledged the shortage, said Rijk intervention is not excluded but not preferred, outlined an action programme with provinces, and committed to a national drinking-water saving plan and further information, while giving partly general answers on guarantees and the human-right angle.
I do not rule out intervention by the national government, but given the administrative relationship this is not the preferred option.
Ingrijpen door het Rijk sluit ik niet uit, maar dit heeft gezien de bestuurlijke verhouding niet de voorkeur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over een noodkreet van het Dijklander ziekenhuis over de geplande wegwerkzaamheden bij de versterking van brug A7 ter hoogte van Purmerend

Ms Van der Plas (BBB) asked the ministers about the Dijklander hospital's alarm over bridge works on the A7 near Purmerend, including traffic disruption for ambulances, emergency care and births, compensation, and how the ministries coordinated. The government answered that Rijkswaterstaat manages mitigation measures, that a temporary bridge was ruled out for traffic, emissions and permit reasons, and that care providers coordinate through the regional acute care body, while committing to improve future coordination with the care sector.

For future projects, Rijkswaterstaat will, in consultation with the Ministry of VWS and together with the sector, make arrangements on how they are involved in such projects, for the accessibility of care.

Voor toekomstige projecten zal Rijkswaterstaat in afstemming met het Ministerie van VWS samen met de sector afspraken maken over wijze waarop zij betrokken worden bij dergelijke projecten, ten behoeve van de bereikbaarheid van de zorg.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls en Bromet over de aanwezigheid van hoge concentraties van het verboden gewasbeschermingsmiddel dinoterb in oppervlaktewater in het Natura 2000-gebied het Zwanenwater

MPs Gabriëls and Bromet asked about dinoterb, a banned pesticide, found in surface water in the Natura 2000 area Zwanenwater, including its origin, enforcement capacity, sanctions and whether enforcement should be tightened. The minister said a HHNK investigation into sources is underway, that residues may leach from soil or illegal use is possible, that NVWA found no dinoterb in inspections, and that enforcement was adequate while the ministries explore improving oversight.
I am waiting for the results of the investigation before deciding whether further action is necessary.
Ik wacht de resultaten van het onderzoek af om te kunnen bepalen of verdere actie noodzakelijk is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Synhaeve, Mohandis, Van Kent, Ceder en Koekkoek over de uitspraak van het gerechtshof Den Haag dat de Nederlandse Staat en twee drinkwaterbedrijven onrechtmatig handelen door niet al het r

MPs asked the government to respond to a Hague Court of Appeal ruling that the State and two water companies acted unlawfully by not preventing children from losing access to drinking water, and about measures, a water fund and changes to disconnection rules. The minister answered that the companies will restore supply to occupied homes with children, that a study on child protection including a water fund will be sent to parliament before summer, and that the disconnection regulation will be reviewed.
The judgment calls for action in two areas.
Het arrest vraagt om actie op twee gebieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot, Brekelmans en Erkens over het artikel ‘Russische schepen die bijtanken bij Vlissingen’

VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a NRC report that Russian-linked shadow fleet ships refuel and anchor at Everingen near Vlissingen, raising sanctions evasion, safety and enforcement concerns. The minister answered that anchorage fees are not charged, ship numbers have not risen sharply, no Russian-flagged ships anchored there, the ILT is still assessing accident risk, and enforcement and EU coordination are being strengthened, while rejecting a ban on anchoring and ruling out a mayoral enforcement role.
It is undesirable that ships can circumvent the European sanctions rules and may also pose a danger to people and the environment.
Het is onwenselijk dat schepen de Europese sanctieregels kunnen omzeilen en daarbij ook mogelijk een gevaar zijn voor mens en milieu.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veltman over het bericht ‘Familieleden missen uitvaart door files, Luuk Wilson deed 2,5 uur over een stuk van 10 minuten’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the full closure of the Beneluxtunnel northbound, the traffic chaos it caused, and the choice of timing and communication. The minister answered that the asphalt was overdue for replacement, that partial closure was unsafe, and that communication was broad, while acknowledging the high expected disruption.
The road surface was so poor that there was a risk of such damage that the road would have to be closed immediately for safety reasons to repair the surface.
Het wegdek was zo slecht, dat het risico zou ontstaan op zodanige schade dat de weg per direct om redenen van veiligheid zou moeten worden gesloten om het wegdek te herstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel 'Klimaatactie treft reizigers Eindhoven Airport'

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about XR climate protests at Eindhoven Airport, including prosecutions, whether to ban the 23 March 2024 demonstration, security measures, costs, and civil damages claims. The Minister answered that the mayor is competent to ban demonstrations, that the State suffered no damage warranting civil action, and that prosecution decisions are pending while security details cannot be disclosed.
No statements can be made about the nature of the measures.
Over de aard van de maatregelen kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over Borselse Voorwaarden

An MP asked about Borsele municipal conditions for new nuclear plants, including a 2050 final repository and zoning of salt caverns, and the timing of the 2130 repository policy. The state secretary answered that the conditions will be negotiated with the province and municipality without guarantees, that the 2130 policy remains, and that the NPRA update with an environmental assessment and public participation will follow later.
Current policy on radioactive waste concerns putting a geological final repository into operation in 2130.
Het huidige beleid ten aanzien van radioactief afval ziet op het in bedrijf nemen van een geologische eindberging in 2130.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heutink en Emiel van Dijk over het bericht dat het Europees Parlement heeft ingestemd met een nieuwe rijbewijsrichtlijn

MPs Heutink and Emiel van Dijk asked whether the government's plan to end the tolerance arrangement for driving electric vans with a B licence on 1 July 2024 would change after the European Parliament's first-reading vote on the new driving licence directive, and whether the arrangement could be extended. The minister replied that the first reading does not yet change the decision, that further trilogue negotiations and a later procedure must be awaited with no certain outcome, and that no new grounds for extending the tolerance are seen.
This does not currently give new grounds to change the earlier decision to end the tolerance period on 1 July 2024.
Dit geeft op dit moment nog geen nieuwe grond voor verandering van het eerder genomen besluit om de gedoogperiode op 1 juli 2024 te beëindigen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oostenbruggen over de blootstelling van werknemers aan kerosinemotoremissie op Schiphol

An MP asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and Infrastructure about the Labour Inspectorate's finding that Schiphol and platform employers are not doing enough to protect workers from kerosene engine emissions, including a 2007 internal report and delays in the sustainable taxiing programme. The government says it expects Schiphol and employers to comply with the inspectorate's demands, that the Health Council is assessing a classification and limit value, and that sector talks on faster rollout of taxibots and alternative towing continue.
I expect that Schiphol and the employers will follow the requirements set by the Netherlands Labour Inspectorate.
Ik ga ervan uit dat Schiphol en de werkgevers de eisen die zijn gesteld door de Nederlandse Arbeidsinspectie opvolgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het nieuws dat werknemers op Schiphol worden blootgesteld aan kankerverwekkende stoffen

The SP MP Van Kent asked ministers about reports that Schiphol platform workers are exposed to carcinogenic aircraft engine emissions, and what measures, health monitoring and compensation exist. The minister answered that the Arbeidsinspectie's demands require Schiphol and employers to do more, cited phased measures such as APU limits and a green zone by 2027, said the Gezondheidsraad is reviewing classification of kerosene engine emissions, and declined to commit to immediate mandatory electrification or a site visit.
I have asked the Health Council to determine whether kerosene engine emissions as a whole should be classified as carcinogenic.
Ik heb de Gezondheidsraad gevraagd te bepalen of kerosinemotoremissie als geheel als kankerverwekkend moet worden geclassificeerd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Olger van Dijk over het artikel ‘Schiphol hield explosief rapport over krimp luchthaven onder de pet, na dreigement KLM’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a newspaper report that Schiphol withheld a cost-benefit study on shrinking the airport after a KLM threat, and about the study's findings on flight taxes, leakage and emissions. The minister said the report's commissioners must agree on publication, that the study offers no detailed evidence on network effects, and that further research on flight taxes is a matter for a new cabinet.
It is up to the commissioners of the report, namely Schiphol, BARIN and KLM, to make mutual agreements about its publication.
Het is aan de opdrachtgevers van het rapport, te weten Schiphol, BARIN en KLM, om onderling afspraken te maken over de openbaarmaking hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de campagne íkwilveiligvliegen.nl

An MP from JA21 asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the campaign 'Ikwilveiligvliegen.nl' and the aviation industry's plans for reduced crew operations with one pilot instead of two. The minister answered that the concept is not yet proven safe, that EASA research is pending, that the government will follow developments closely and only accept new technology once shown to be safe, but made no concrete commitments such as a joint statement with other member states.
The Netherlands' starting point is that with the introduction of new concepts at least a safety level equal to that of current flight operations must be guaranteed.
Nederland heeft als uitgangspunt, dat met de introductie van nieuwe concepten er minimaal een veiligheidsniveau wordt gewaarborgd dat gelijk is aan het niveau van de huidige vliegoperatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Pierik over amfetamine in mestvergisters

MPs Van der Plas and Pierik asked the government about amphetamine found in digestate from manure digesters, the applicability of the Opiumwet and Meststoffenwet, and compensation for affected operators. The minister answered that the Opiumwet is not directly applicable given the mixed-in residues, that digestate may be traded as fertiliser only if it poses no health or environmental risk, that responsibility for waste enforcement lies with provinces and municipalities, and that she declines to offer compensation.
The Ministry of LNV was not involved in this action, but only afterwards provided a view at the request of the provinces on the interpretation of the Meststoffenwet.
Het Ministerie van LNV is in dit handelen niet betrokken, maar heeft op verzoek van de provincies pas naderhand een zienswijze verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bamenga over 438 studentenwoningen op Kronenburg

MPs Paternotte and Bamenga asked why only about 438 student homes will be built at Kronenburg instead of the planned 2,500-plus, and about short-stay and self-contained housing. The minister says 438 is a first phase chosen for noise and safety reasons under the Schiphol flight path, that short-stay units may be added, and that a new plan and an adjustment of the LIB are still needed, with progress reported by mid-2024.
The aim is to inform the House of progress by mid-2024.
Het streven is uw Kamer medio 2024 over de voortgang te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over noodsituaties met hard varende watertaxi's tussen Waddeneilanden en de vaste wal

An MP asked the minister about emergencies justifying fast watertaxi trips between the Wadden islands and the mainland, the frequency of speeding and permission, crew professionalism, night-time access, extra safety requirements, AIS enforcement, and revoking licences for repeat offenders. The minister said the coast guard post cannot judge whether emergencies were real, recorded 44 cases (12 emergencies, 32 patient transport) without treating them as permission to speed, and promised reconsideration in the concession and accident-report responses.
In that case it concerned 12 times an emergency and 32 times patient transport.
Daarbij ging het 12 keer om een spoedgeval en 32 keer om patiëntenvervoer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het artikel “Wadplaten verdrinken, schelpen leggen het loodje: opwarming bedreigt Waddennatuur''

An MP from D66 asks the Ministers of Nature and Nitrogen and of Infrastructure and Water Management how the government's Wadden Sea policy squares with research showing climate change is salinising the Wadden Sea, drowning tidal flats and threatening its ecosystem, and how this bears on gas drilling permits near Ternaard. The ministers answer that climate pressure is acknowledged, point to the Beleidskader Natuur Waddenzee and a range of short- and long-term measures, and say a separate permit decision on the drilling will take into account the advisory assessment.
The Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate is currently conducting a study into the sediment-supplying capacity of the Vlie storage basin.
Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat heeft op dit moment een studie lopen naar het sediment leverend vermogen in de komberging Vlie.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Van Houwelingen over bouwvergunningen die de afgelopen jaren (versneld) zijn afgegeven aan (drink)waterbedrijven

An MP asked the minister for examples of building permits recently granted, possibly expedited, to drinking water companies under water-and-soil-guiding policy. The minister replied that no national overview exists because municipalities issue these permits, and that the policy affects them only indirectly, while noting drinking water interests may need greater weight in decisions on new sources.
There is no national overview of these environmental permits, because they are issued by municipalities.
Er is geen landelijk overzicht van deze omgevingsvergunningen, omdat ze worden uitgegeven door gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over olievervuiling op Bonaire

An MP from the SP asked the cabinet about oil pollution on the coast of Bonaire, including the environmental damage, the source (possibly the abandoned tanker Gulfstream), and whether the owner can be held liable. The government answered that the impact on nature appears limited for now, the long-term damage is not yet known, the situation is said to be under control, and liability is still being examined because the ship's owner has not been identified.
It is being examined whether there are possibilities to recover the damage.
Er wordt bezien of er mogelijkheden zijn om schade te kunnen verhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de impact van lozingen op het IJsselmeer

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the minister about reports that toxic discharges into the IJsselmeer endanger drinking water, including indirect industrial discharges via sewers, weak permit and enforcement control, and the Grip op indirecte lozingen pilot. The minister replied that water quality has generally improved, that a broader review of the VTH permitting, supervision and enforcement system with water boards is planned, and that a pilot report is expected in spring 2024.

At the legislative consultation on water on 29 January 2024 the Chamber was promised that the ministry, together with the water boards, would investigate the functioning of the permitting, supervision and enforcement system.

Tijdens het wetgevingsoverleg Water op 29 januari 2024 is aan de Kamer toegezegd dat het ministerie onder meer samen met de waterschappen een onderzoek gaat doen naar het functioneren van het stelsel van vergunningverlening, toezicht en handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministry meetings after the November 2023 election let civil servants voice concerns about the winning parties, and whether such meetings are compatible with civil service neutrality. The government answered that the meetings were regular discussions of the election outcome, denied that working attitudes changed, declined to say how many staff attended, and said no similar meetings are planned.
No, it is not recorded how many staff members took part in regular staff meetings and consultations on the election outcome during the day.
Nee, er wordt niet bijgehouden hoeveel medewerkers gedurende de dag in reguliere staven en overleggen over de verkiezingsuitslag hebben gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over het bericht 'Brug Maastricht dreigt in te storten na aanvaring losgeslagen woonboot'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how Rijkswaterstaat handled the damaged Borgharen weir, the overflow dam and the Stuwweg before the Maastricht bridge and houseboat incident, and what it will do now. The minister replied that the overflow dam was inspected and repaired in 2021, that the risks were assessed as very small, that the November 2023 communication was adequate, and that repairs are planned before the 2024 high-water season.
Rijkswaterstaat has commissioned Deltares to investigate how the overflow dam could collapse suddenly. The results are expected in May 2024.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft opdracht gegeven aan Deltares om te onderzoeken hoe de overlaatdam acuut heeft kunnen bezwijken. De resultaten hiervan worden in mei 2024 verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministry meetings after the November 2023 election let civil servants voice their feelings about the outcome, whether this places civil servants who voted for winning parties in an awkward position, and whether such meetings will be held again. The VWS minister answered that discussions about what the result means for policy work took place, that attendance was not recorded, that civil servants must remain politically neutral, and that the ministry values an open and safe working climate.
It was not recorded how many employees were present.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel medewerkers aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the outcome, and whether this undermines their neutrality. The government confirmed that BZK held two meetings to interpret the result, stated civil servants must remain politically neutral, and said such sessions fit an open workplace culture without committing to avoid them in future.
Civil servants have a supporting, advisory and executing role, in which they are expected, on the basis of professionalism, to advise objectively.
Ambtenaren hebben hierbij een ondersteunende, adviserende en uitvoerende rol, waarin zij op basis van professionaliteit worden geacht om objectief te adviseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether the Ministry of Defence organised meetings for officials after the November 2023 election, including whether such meetings put civil servants in a difficult position and whether they will be repeated. The minister answered that no departmental, DG or directorate-level meetings were held, only regular discussions of the election result, and that a safe working environment and political neutrality of officials are important.
No meetings were organised at the Ministry of Defence at departmental, directorate-general or directorate level following the election result.
Op het Ministerie van Defensie zijn geen bijeenkomsten georganiseerd op departementaal, dan wel op directoraat-generaal of directieniveau naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether civil servants were gathered after the November 2023 election to voice concerns about winning parties, and whether such meetings would recur. The minister replied that no formal meetings were held, only routine discussions on the election result, and that civil servants should be free to share reflections while staying politically neutral.
No formal meetings were organised by the ministry or at Directorate-General level.
Er zijn geen formele bijeenkomsten georganiseerd door het ministerie of op DG-niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings for civil servants after the November 2023 election result, what they were for, and whether such gatherings undermine civil servant neutrality. The minister confirmed meetings were held to reflect on the result, said staff were encouraged to share views without restriction, declined to give attendance numbers, and said such meetings may be repeated after a new coalition agreement.
It was not recorded how many colleagues attended the various meetings.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel collega's de verschillende bijeenkomsten hebben bijgewoond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministries held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election results, what their purpose was, whether staff could voice how their working approach would change, and whether such meetings threaten civil servants' neutrality. The Minister of Social Affairs replied that the ministry held an online briefing on the election outcome for all staff, with no interactive input, plus internal directorate discussions, that such briefings are standard after elections and planned after the coalition agreement, and that civil servants remain politically neutral.
Because many employees watched the online presentation together on one screen, it cannot be determined exactly how many employees attended.
Omdat veel medewerkers de online presentatie samen op een scherm hebben bekeken, is niet exact te achterhalen hoeveel medewerkers hierbij aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether OCW held internal meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the outcome and how this affects their neutrality. The minister confirmed a departmental meeting and several directorate meetings focused on the implications of the results and the primacy of politics, stating civil servants remain politically neutral and that such reflection is part of their work.
It is important that civil servants remain politically neutral in their work.
Het is belangrijk dat ambtenaren politiek neutraal zijn en blijven in hun werk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election, whether staff could voice how the result changed their work, and whether such meetings threaten civil service neutrality. The minister replied that no formal meetings were organised, only informal discussions in some units, that such open dialogue fits a safe working climate, and that civil servants remain politically neutral and execute decisions made by ministers.
There is no insight into how many people participated.
Er is geen zicht op hoeveel personen deelnamen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministries whether they held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election, what was discussed, and whether such meetings threaten civil servant neutrality. The Minister of LNV answered that meetings were held to anticipate policy implications, that no restrictions were placed on input, and that such meetings remain acceptable, while stressing civil servant political neutrality.
It was not recorded how many civil servants attended the meetings.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel ambtenaren bij de bijeenkomsten aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the election result, and whether this undermines their neutrality. The government answered that such discussions took place only within existing regular meetings, that no separate meetings are planned, and that civil servants must remain politically neutral.
This is not possible; no overviews are kept of how many and which employees attended which meetings.
Dit is niet mogelijk, er worden geen overzichten bijgehouden van hoeveel en welke medewerkers er bij welke overleggen aanwezig zijn geweest
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van     22 november 2023

An MP asked ministries whether civil servants were invited to meetings after the November 2023 election about how their working conditions might change under a new coalition, and whether such meetings threaten civil servant neutrality. The government answered that no departmental meetings were held beyond regular discussions of the election, that it does not rule out future meetings about election outcomes, and that civil servants must remain politically neutral.
No, I do not rule out that in the future meetings will take place where the outcome of elections is discussed.
Nee, ik sluit niet uit dat in de toekomst bijeenkomsten plaatsvinden waar over de uitkomst van verkiezingen wordt gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veltman en Peter de Groot over de berichtgeving over vertraging op de A28 richting Utrecht vanwege slecht wegdek

MPs Veltman and Peter de Groot (VVD) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why road surface damage on the A28 near Nijkerk led to a sudden lane closure, how often the section was inspected, and what Rijkswaterstaat will do to reduce delays. The minister answered that inspections were weekly, the lane closure followed a deterioration after frost, and the section has been repaired and reopened, but gave only limited measures beyond advising peak-hour avoidance.
The affected road section has been repaired again and fully reopened to traffic.
Het betreffende wegvak is weer gerepareerd en volledig opengesteld voor het verkeer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over gezondheidsschade bij omwonenden nabij de A8-Coenbrug

A GroenLinks-PvdA MP asks why noise, vibration and fine-particle nuisance from the A8 Coenbrug remain unresolved despite earlier promises, including unfulfilled commitments on a sound-damping layer and higher noise barriers. The Minister explains that the bridge's mechanism is too weak to carry the added weight, that renovation of the noise barriers is postponed to 2026 at the earliest, and that current legal norms are met, so no further measures are planned for now.

Rijkswaterstaat is currently consulting the municipality of Zaanstad on repairing the operation and moving mechanism of the Coenbrug, also examining whether fitting cladding under the bridge is structurally feasible.

Rijkswaterstaat is momenteel in overleg met de gemeente Zaanstad over het repareren van de bediening en het bewegingswerk van de Coenbrug, waarbij ook wordt onderzocht of het aanbrengen van beplating onder de brug constructief mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Wassenberg over Nederlandse paling, vol met giftig PFAS

Two MPs asked the government about eel from Dutch waters containing PFAS above the EFSA tolerable intake, and whether consumption advice, warnings for pregnant women, eel-fishing closures or PFAS-based closures should change. The minister answered that eating large amounts of such eel is undesirable, that the Voedingscentrum advice is to vary fish, that no mandatory health warnings or PFAS-based fishery closures will be introduced, and that producers bear responsibility for safe products.
I will not make health warnings mandatory when selling eel and the other mentioned fish for pregnant women.
Ik ga geen gezondheidswaarschuwingen verplichten bij de verkoop van paling en ander genoemde vis voor zwangere vrouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over de brief “Informeren gedoogsituatie zero-emissie bedrijfsvoertuigen van 3.501 tot en met 4.250 kg”

MP Bamenga (D66) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the tolerance arrangement letting zero-emission commercial vehicles of 3,501 to 4,250 kg be driven on a category B licence, and why the government changed course from making the exemption permanent, including road safety effects and whether the exemption could be extended to 1 January 2025. The minister answered that no accident data exists yet, that SWOV research will report by April 2024, that the arrangement cannot be legalised under current EU rules, and that the tolerance will end on 1 July 2024 as the Public Prosecution Service has agreed.

To assess the link between the increased mass of these vehicles and the risk of more serious injury to other road users, broader studies of larger groups of vehicles over a longer period will be needed.

Voor het verband tussen toegenomen massa van deze voertuigen en de kans op zwaarder letsel bij andere verkeersdeelnemers zal moeten worden gekeken naar bredere onderzoeken op grotere groepen voertuigen en een langere periode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de Dag van de Vrachtwagenchauffeur

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the lack of truck driver vacancies, traffic congestion, rest-time rules, the shortage of truck parking, and falling truck driver training places. The minister answered that the sector and government take various measures, that no congestion charge is planned, and that rest rules are European and should not be deviated from.
It is undesirable to deviate from the rest and driving times; this endangers road safety.
Het is onwenselijk om af te wijken van de rust- en rijtijden; dit brengt de verkeersveiligheid in het geding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Vedder en Grinwis over het sluiten van de nautische verkeerspost Ouddorp en het niet langer inzetten van vuurtorenwachters op vuurtoren Westhoofd

Three MPs (SGP, CDA, ChristenUnie) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the nautical traffic post at Ouddorp and the Westhoofd lighthouse watch were closed, raising safety concerns for the Slijkgat channel. The Minister answered that the area is not a VTS zone, that replacing the radar and systems was too costly, that information remains available through other public channels, and that the Slijkgat depth commitments continue, but gave no commitment to restore the post.
Discussions are ongoing with parties about users' information needs and how these can be better served.
Er wordt verder overlegd met partijen over de informatiebehoefte van de gebruikers en hoe daar nog beter in kan worden voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het bericht 'Politie wil meer autowrakken optakelen om misdrijven op te lossen'

An MP asked whether recovering sunken cars could help solve crimes, why such wrecks are not always recovered given costs, and whether police and Rijkswaterstaat should coordinate on this. The minister agreed recovery can yield leads, said the number of wrecks yielding criminal evidence is unknown, and explained that waterway managers prioritise navigation safety while police decide case by case, with cooperation talks ongoing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriels over het artikel ´Mercedes muss über hunderttausend Diesel-Auto’s zurückrufen´

Gabriels (GroenLinks/PvdA) asked about the Mercedes diesel recall ordered by Germany's KBA, the emission defeat method, whether other manufacturers are affected, what the government has done since the 2022 EU Court ruling, the number of vehicles and extra nitrogen emissions in the Netherlands, and whether damages can be recovered from industry. The State Secretary answered that the RDW found no unlawful manipulation in its later tests, that the Netherlands supports recalls where defeat devices are found, and that recovering social damage from manufacturers is legally difficult because the State has no direct loss.
I am not aware of models from other manufacturers that are manipulated in a comparable way.
Ik ben niet bekend met modellen van andere fabrikanten die op een vergelijkbare manier worden gemanipuleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over breken belofte krimp Schiphol

Van Raan (PvdD) asks Minister Harbers why the government suspended the Schiphol capacity reduction (spoor 1), breaking a promise to residents, and presses on legal risks of continued anticipatory enforcement, the legal basis for around 500,000 movements, and internal ministry assessments. The minister answers that the balance with residents remains a goal via the balanced approach, cites new EU Commission and US signals as reasons for suspension, and withholds much of the legal analysis citing ongoing procedures.
Given the ongoing legal proceedings, this cannot be discussed further.
Gelet op de lopende juridische procedures kan hier verder niet op worden ingegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de lozingsvergunning van Sitech

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why Sitech may discharge contaminated Chemelot wastewater into the Maas, whether the discharge point on the Zijtak Ur is correctly shown on the waterboard's map, and whether Rijkswaterstaat rather than Waterschap Limburg should be the competent authority. The minister answered that the permit was lawfully issued by Waterschap Limburg, that the Zijtak Ur qualifies as surface water under a 1985 Supreme Court ruling still applicable under the Omgevingswet, and that the legger will be clarified at the next update.
The waterboard incorporated the advice in full into the permit.
Het waterschap heeft het advies onverkort in de vergunning verwerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Olger van Dijk over het activistisch aandeelhouderschap van Schiphol door de gemeente Amsterdam en de inzet op krimp tot maximaal 440.000 vluchten

Two NSC MPs asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers how the state views Amsterdam's activist shareholding in Schiphol and its push to cap flights at 440,000, and how the state's shareholder strategy and public-interest criteria apply. The minister welcomed Amsterdam's focus on the living environment, explained that the state's strategy review and MVO criteria cover sustainability and environmental quality, and said a new strategy process would start this year while shareholders act independently.
For that I refer you to the shareholding policy of the respective shareholders.
Ik verwijs u daarvoor graag door naar (het deelnemingenbeleid van) de desbetreffende aandeelhouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg, Van Esch en Van Raan over Vergunning, Toezicht en Handhaving op de BES-Eilanden

Green MPs asked the government whether permit, supervision and enforcement (VTH) on Bonaire is adequate in light of a critical Inspectorate (ILT) report, covering coastal hotels without permits, coral damage, unpermitted businesses in the marine park, and related questions on delegation to regional environmental services and planned development at Bolivia plantation. The state secretary acknowledged serious shortcomings and announced a VTH improvement programme and written responses from the island authorities, but declined to call it neglect of duty, said no binding instruction would be issued, and gave largely non-committal or deferred answers on specific sites.
I will inform the chamber shortly about the process for arriving at an assessment of the conclusions and recommendations of the ILT report.
Ik zal de kamer op korte termijn informeren over het proces om te komen tot een waardering van de conclusies en aanbevelingen van het ILT-rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Brink, Krul en Inge van Dijk over het niet doorgaan van amateur wielrenwedstrijden

MPs from the CDA asked the ministers why amateur cycling races are being cancelled because police motorcycle escorts are unavailable, and whether volunteer civilian motorcyclists could be deployed, including via a pilot and changes to traffic rules. The minister answered that a study by Antea Group is underway with results expected in summer 2024, that a temporary experiment would need a legal amendment and AMvB taking about a year, and that changing traffic rules awaits the study's outcome.
I expect the results of the above-mentioned study in the summer of 2024.
De uitkomsten van het bovengenoemde onderzoek verwacht ik in de zomer van 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heutink over het besluit om Elektrische bestelbussen onder een B-rijbewijs niet langer te gedogen per 1 juli 2024

Heutink (PVV) asks why the government ended the tolerance for electric vans driven on a B licence from 1 July 2024 and why it does not permanently codify the exemption as Germany did. The minister answers that legal anchoring is currently unfeasible due to enforcement, fraud-risk and EU weight-rule problems, that the tolerance is extended to 1 July 2024, and that talks with the European Commission continue without guarantee of a solution.
That is why I currently consider legal anchoring of an exemption in the Netherlands unfeasible.
Daarom acht ik momenteel een wettelijke verankering van een vrijstelling in Nederland onhaalbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Pijpelink over de scheur in de Westerscheldetunnel

Two MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the crack in the Westerscheldetunnel, the timing of repairs, and safeguarding access for Zeeuws-Vlaanderen. The minister replied that the tunnel is safe, that repair planning is the responsibility of the NV Westerscheldetunnel (owned by the province of Zeeland), that the ministry is a stakeholder, and that temporary measures may follow if monitoring warrants it.
The repair is a responsibility of the NV WST, of which the province of Zeeland is the sole shareholder.
De reparatie is een verantwoordelijkheid van de NV WST, waarvan de provincie Zeeland enig aandeelhouder is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de voortgang van de raffinageroute en het belang ervan voor de ontwikkeling van groene waterstofproductie

An MP asked the government about the progress, timing and market effects of the planned raffinage route for renewable hydrogen, and about long-term investment certainty and lessons from other member states. The minister answered that the route is well advanced, will open in 2025 with a draft decree to parliament in early 2024, and outlined subsidies and normering as ways to secure supply, while offering no firm mitigation for delay.

The planned timeline of the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management is to send the bill and the amendment to the Energy Transport Decree to the House of Representatives in the first half of 2024.

De voorgenomen tijdslijn van de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat is om in de eerste helft van 2024 het wetsvoorstel en wijziging voor het Besluit energie vervoer aan de Tweede Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over OV-geweld

An MP asks the government about violence on public transport, including tougher penalties, a lifetime transport ban, conductors on risk lines, the migration background of perpetrators, and expulsion or loss of Dutch nationality for offenders. The State Secretary replies that action is underway through a joint action programme, that penalties and transport bans are already governed by existing rules, that ethnicity of suspects cannot be registered so the requested overview is not provided, and that asylum and nationality measures are limited by law.

It is not possible to retrieve from police systems an overview of violent incidents on public transport with the background of the suspects, because the police are not allowed to register the ethnicity of the suspect.

Het is niet mogelijk om een overzicht van geweldsincidenten in het OV met daarbij de achtergrond van de verdachten uit de politiesystemen op te halen, omdat Politie de etniciteit van de verdachte niet mag registreren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het voorkomen van medicijnresten in water

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the ministers about pharmaceutical residues in surface water, including diclofenac gels, diabetes drugs, and whether water quality norms should be set. The minister replies that the chain approach and EU proposals for advanced treatment and priority-substance norms are underway, and that a new implementation plan is due in January 2024.
A new implementation plan for the Chain Approach to Pharmaceutical Residues from Water is currently being developed.
Op dit moment wordt gewerkt aan een nieuw uitvoeringsplan voor de Ketenaanpak Medicijnresten uit Water.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over de vrijstelling van het C-rijbewijs voor zero-emissie (ZE) bestelvoertuigen tot 4.250 kilogram

An MP asked whether the temporary exemption from the C driving licence for zero-emission vans between 3,500 and 4,250 kg expires on 1 January 2024, how many vehicles benefit, what legal basis is needed for a permanent scheme, and whether delays harm sustainable logistics firms. The minister extends the tolerance period to 1 July 2024 for vehicles ordered before 1 October 2023, but states a permanent legal anchor is not enforceable under current EU rules and that the arrangement will be revisited only after EU clarification.
To accommodate entrepreneurs, I am extending the current tolerance period until 1 July 2024.
Om ondernemers tegemoet te komen, verleng ik de huidige gedoogperiode tot 1 juli 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over de brief betreffende ‘Zero-emissie bedrijfsvoertuigen tot en met 4.250 kg’

MP Van Ginneken (D66) asked why information on the continuation of the temporary driving-licence exemption for zero-emission vans of 3,501-4,250 kg came only after it expired, and about its effects on investment and enforcement. Minister Harbers answers that the exemption lapsed at the end of 2022, that a tolerance arrangement is extended to 1 July 2024 because permanent legislation is not enforceable under current EU rules, and that talks with the European Commission on the issue are ongoing without certainty of a solution.
Because of the reason given in the answer to the previous question 5, uniform implementation and enforcement in practice is already difficult.
Het is door de reden in het antwoord op voorgaande vraag 5 reeds moeilijk (uniform) uitvoer- en handhaafbaar in de praktijk.
Antwoord op vraag van het lid Sjoerdsma over de beantwoording van vragen

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the ministers to convey appreciation to civil servants for timely, careful answers to parliamentary questions. The Prime Minister answered yes, a brief acknowledgement with no substantive commitment.
Are you willing to convey great appreciation to your civil servants for answering all written, factual and oral questions that the questioner has asked in recent years
Bent u bereid de grote waardering over te brengen aan uw ambtenaren voor de beantwoording van alle schriftelijke, feitelijk en mondelinge vragen die vragensteller de afgelopen jaren stelde
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Temmink over het artikel ‘Het CBR weet al jaren van fraude bij theorie-examens. Het doet bijna niks tegen “turbo-opleiders”, wel tegen klokkenluiders.’

An SP MP asked the ministers about CBR knowledge of exam fraud by 'turbo' driving schools, the CBR's response to whistleblower evidence, and whether whistleblowers were prosecuted. The minister answered that CBR has taken many anti-fraud measures, filed a complaint and report against an individual, denied prosecuting whistleblowers under the Whistleblower Act, and said consultations on further measures are ongoing.
It is incorrect that the CBR would have taken the persons who supplied the evidence to court.
Het is onjuist dat het CBR de personen die het bewijs aanleverden voor de rechter zou hebben gedaagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Van der Graaf over het bericht 'Plotseling tekort van 126 miljoen voor tolvrije tunnel: ‘We kunnen in 2030 toch niet weer poortjes neerzetten?'

MPs Grinwis and Van der Graaf asked about a reported 126 million euro shortfall for making the Westerscheldetunnel toll-free, linked to the controversial status of Betalen naar Gebruik. The minister said a toll-free tunnel from 2025 is agreed with Zeeland, that the Rijk has committed to funding 2030–2033, but declined to give firm guarantees about future tolling and deferred the matter to a new cabinet.
Declaring Betalen naar Gebruik controversial does not yet mean that BNG will not go ahead.
Het controversieel verklaren van Betalen naar Gebruik (BNG) betekent nog niet dat BNG niet doorgaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het bericht ‘Tata, Dow en Shell riskeren rechtszaken met giflozingen’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that Tata Steel, Dow and Shell risk lawsuits over discharges, given that discharge permits may not meet tightened EU standards and supervisors lack capacity to re-check them. The minister acknowledges a backlog in reviewing discharge permits at Rijkswaterstaat, attributes it to capacity shortages, describes an ongoing catch-up and capacity programme, and states the 12 companies' permits were issued lawfully though some are older and may need updating.
There is no obligation to keep an overview or register of this.
Er bestaat geen verplichting daarvoor een overzicht of register bij te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Akerboom over begrenzing natuurvergunning Schiphol

Two Party for the Animals MPs asked the ministers for Infrastructure and for Nature and Nitrogen why the Schiphol nature permit treats the 44 million passenger cap and the 2000 designation order as limiting the reference situation, and questioned the legal basis, consultation of the advisory committee, legal reviews and a possible second opinion. The ministers answered that the 460,000 flight movement limit is the most relevant constraint, the permit's reference situation is correctly formulated, legal advice cannot be released, and no second opinion or rights-based review is planned.
Advice from the State Advocate is only made public when it concerns general policy advice.
Adviezen van de Landsadvocaat worden uitsluitend openbaar gemaakt als het gaat om (algemene) beleidsadviezen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over de berichten 'Acht maanden' totale ellende' op A7' en 'Zo'n verkeersinfarct kun je gebied echt niet aandoen'' en 'Je kunt brug ook aan onderzijde verstevigen'; verkeer Transportbe

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about newspaper reports on months of traffic disruption from renovating the A7 viaduct near Purmerend, including the weight restriction, alternative repair from below, and mitigation plans. The Minister answered at length, describing mitigation measures, consultations with stakeholders, and why the below-deck repair option was rejected on technical and lifespan grounds.
Rijkswaterstaat will carry out the following actions in the coming period: theoretical modelling of traffic disruption and impact analysis for the entire Noord-Holland traffic network.
Rijkswaterstaat voert de komende periode de volgende acties uit: – Theoretische modellering verkeershinder/impactanalyse voor het volledige verkeersnetwerk van Noord-Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht ‘Veense Put vervuild door zandstort: “We varen nu door een plastic soep.”’

An MP asked the minister about contamination of the Veense Put from soil and dredging spoil dumping, possible effects on drinking water intake and bathing water, and links to algal blooms. The government answered that no violations of the soil quality decree were found under regular and extra inspections, that drinking water intake was not halted, and that no causal link to blue-green algae could be established.
In regular supervision and the extra checks during the shallowing of the Veense Put, no violations of the rules in the Soil Quality Decree have been found to date.
In het regulier toezicht en de extra controles bij de verondieping van de Veense Put zijn er tot op heden geen overtredingen van de regels in het Besluit Bodemkwaliteit geconstateerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de waterkwaliteit in Nederland en de gevolgen van schadelijke stoffen in oppervlakte- en drinkwater voor de volksgezondheid

An MP asked ministers about bisphenol A, pharmaceutical residues and other pollutants in surface and drinking water, their health effects, and whether monitoring and reporting should be tightened. The minister answered that existing EU rules and monitoring apply, that BPA is being tightened and pharmaceutical residues addressed through sector programmes, and declined to commit to annual reporting of BPA levels in people because such data is not measured.
Because BPA values are not measured annually in children and adults in combination with health complaints, annual reporting on this is not possible.
Omdat de waardes BPA niet jaarlijks worden gemeten bij kinderen en volwassen in combinatie met gezondheidsklachten, kan hier niet jaarlijks over gerapporteerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de koeiensterfte aan de dijk van het Reevediep

An MP asked about cattle deaths on a farm beside the Reevediep dike and about the investigation into soil used in the dike, including contact with the water board and the farmer's cooperation. The state secretary answered that the province of Gelderland has commissioned soil research, that the dike was built under the soil quality rules with 98.7% of the soil in the cleanest class, that the farmer has withdrawn cooperation, and that results are expected in November 2023 with the parliament to be informed.
Once the final results of the research are known and any follow-up steps, I will inform your House about this.
Zodra de definitieve resultaten van het onderzoek bekend zijn en eventuele vervolgstappen zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het verbeteren van het zicht op de werken bij de Afsluitdijk

MP De Hoop asked whether the Vlietermonument on the Afsluitdijk will stay dark at night and whether reflective lighting or illumination of the Steenzetter artwork and Lely statue could be considered. Minister Harbers answered that the monument will be partly lit during works and illuminated once the associated catering is open, and rejected reflective markings and additional lighting to preserve the intended simplicity and the darkness experience.
No. The 'Sky Brightness' map of the Atlas Leefomgeving shows that the Wadden Sea and the Afsluitdijk are considered one of the few places in the Netherlands where true darkness still prevails.
Nee. Uit de kaart «Hemelhelderheid» van de Atlas Leefomgeving blijkt dat de Waddenzee en de Afsluitdijk worden beschouwd als een van de weinige plaatsen in Nederland waar nog echte duisternis heerst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Koerhuis over het bericht 'Ondernemers desnoods naar rechter om Kooybrug open te houden. 'We voelen ons in de kou staan''

MPs Krul and Koerhuis asked the minister about the planned closure of the Kooybrug, traffic safety, the absence of a temporary bridge, compensation for affected businesses, and coordination with ProRail. The minister answered that the renovation is postponed and will be rescheduled, that detour routes and incident scenarios exist, that compensation under the general regulation applies, and that Rijkswaterstaat will stay in close contact with the region, though many answers give no concrete timeline.
At this moment nothing can yet be said about the expected duration of the closure.
Op dit moment kan er nog niets gezegd worden over de verwachte duur van de afsluiting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Kathmann over het bericht ‘Bagagemedewerkers mogen maximaal 216 koffers per dag tillen op Schiphol, maar zitten vaak aan de 200 per uur’

MPs De Hoop and Kathmann asked the government about a report finding that baggage handlers at Schiphol are exposed to excessive physical strain, and about employer responsibility, liability, enforcement and timelines. The minister answered that employers are primarily responsible under the Working Conditions Act, that the Labour Inspectorate has imposed penalty payments and conducts inspections, and that mechanisation will take 8-10 years while interim measures are required now.

With the penalty payments imposed on the baggage handling companies, the Labour Inspectorate is forcing employers to take technical and organisational measures to limit physical strain as much as possible.

Met de lasten onder dwangsom die zijn opgelegd aan de bagageafhandelaren dwingt de Arbeidsinspectie de werkgevers technische en organisatorische maatregelen te nemen om de fysieke belasting zoveel mogelijk te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het nieuws dat schippers vrezen voor een tekort aan ontgassingsinstallaties

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about industry fears of a shortage of degassing installations ahead of the 1 July 2024 ban on onboard degassing of tank barges. The minister answers that responsibility is shared among government bodies, industry and provinces, that a stakeholder roadmap is being prepared with a Kamer update after a November meeting, and that provinces grant permits and the ILT is assessing enforceability.
It is not for the national government to intervene in the competences of other authorities or to carry out actions that the market must take to prepare for the ban.
Het is niet aan de Rijksoverheid om in de bevoegdheid te treden van andere overheden of om acties uit te voeren die de markt moet nemen om zich voor te bereiden op het verbod.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Thijssen over kwijtschelding van de waterschapsbelasting

MPs Kathmann and Thijssen asked whether water boards can grant remission of the water board levy to people earning above the welfare norm, whether a progressive levy should be studied, and about social collection practices. The minister answered that boards already may extend remission (cost-of-living norm up to 100% of the welfare norm, higher asset threshold) and that a progressive levy will not be studied because the levy principles of the water system must be preserved.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat de Gerrit Krolbrug in Groningen tot eind dit jaar dichtblijft

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that the Gerrit Krolbrug in Groningen stays closed until year end, and about a promised working group and an alternative crossing during construction. The minister said temporary ramps will open in early 2024, a working group has been set up, options for a crossing during construction will be studied, and a decision is expected in early 2024.
This connection will in any case remain in place until the moment construction of the new bridge starts.
Deze verbinding blijft in ieder geval in stand tot het moment waarop de bouw van de nieuwe brug start.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot vragen gesteld over de wateroverlast in Zuid-Limburg

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about flooding in South Limburg, including damage, sewer capacity, funding and regional responsibility. The minister answered that damage is still being assessed, that sewer systems are designed for lower-intensity rainfall, and pointed to existing funds, regional programmes and planned standards without new commitments on funding.
Over 1,200 reports of various kinds have now been received in Maastricht.
Er zijn in Maastricht inmiddels ruim 1.200 meldingen binnengekomen van uiteenlopende aard.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het rapport 'Parkeerbeleid als stuurmiddel voor woon-werkverkeer'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why a 2019 study on parking policy and commuting was not sent to Parliament, what was done with it, and whether the government will stimulate municipalities to use parking policy to reduce car use. The Minister answers that the report was published online and shared with municipalities, that parking policy is a municipal responsibility, and that no active stimulation is planned, though some further knowledge development is ongoing.
There was then no reason to also actively send this research report to the House.
Er was toen geen aanleiding om dit onderzoeksrapport ook actief naar de Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden De Kort en Koerhuis over het artikel 'Utrecht wil parkeerkosten voor lage inkomens vergoeden, ook als ze geen auto hebben'

MPs De Kort and Koerhuis asked whether Utrecht's plan to compensate low-income U-pas holders for paid parking, including those without a car, is proportionate, redistributive, or an indirect form of income policy. The minister replied that parking and minima policy fall within municipal competence, that the mobility budget was raised for all U-pas holders because the law does not allow distinguishing car owners, and that no national enforcement is planned.
It falls within the competence of municipalities to make independent considerations and choices regarding parking policy.
Het valt binnen de bevoegdheid van gemeenten om op het gebied van parkeerbeleid eigenstandige afwegingen en keuzes te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over het bericht "Liters kankerverwekkende stoffen laat Claessen Tankcleaning zo de Maas in stromen"

An MP (D66) asked the ministers about NRC reports that tank cleaner Claessen Tankcleaning discharged benzene-laden waste water into the Maas, and about enforcement history. The state secretary answered that waste water is treated on-site and discharged via the municipal sewer and the Waterschap plant, that enforcement began in 2020, and that a penalty order was issued in July 2023 with follow-up checks.

On 31 July 2023 the municipality of Venlo sent Claessen Tankcleaning an order subject to a penalty after it was established that benzene tank cleaning was carried out differently, in method and installations, than described in the permit.

Op 31 juli 2023 is er door gemeente Venlo een last onder dwangsom verstuurd aan Claessen Tankcleaning nadat is vastgesteld dat de reiniging van tankwagens met benzeen anders wordt uitgevoerd qua werkwijze en installaties dan in de vergunning is omschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de documenten bij Wob-besluit over criteria legalisatie PAS-melders van de rijksoverheid.nl

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the ministry pressured the agriculture ministry to legalise the PAS notification of Lelystad Airport, citing an internal email, and asked about the legal basis and current status. The minister denied setting legalisation as a condition, said the matter lies with the competent authority (the nature minister) and that no ministerial agreements remain, while stating that Lelystad must obtain a Nature Conservation Act permit.
The Ministry of I&W did not make the legalisation of Lelystad Airport a condition when adopting the Nature Conservation Regulation.
Het Ministerie van IenW heeft bij het vaststellen van de Regeling natuurbescherming de legalisatie van Lelystad Airport niet als voorwaarde gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht ‘Lobby voor veilige N35 bij Enschede strandt: Minister pakt weg voorlopig niet aan’

Mr Krul (CDA) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the lack of planned safety upgrades on a stretch of the N35 near Enschede with frequent accidents, and about the consistency of prioritising traffic safety against nitrogen and budget constraints. The minister replied that the stretch was not prioritised within the 200 million euro traffic safety budget, that no new investment is possible under the demissionary cabinet, and that the nitrogen-linked Mariënheem bypass and a motion on restoring trust are still being explored with the province.
At this moment new investments are not on the agenda and therefore this bottleneck cannot be addressed.
Op dit moment zijn nieuwe investeringen niet aan de orde en daarom kan dit knelpunt niet worden aangepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over directe en indirecte lozingen en/of afvalinjecties onder de Waddenzee

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked whether wastewater from gas and oil extraction near the Wadden Sea, including injection at Borgsweer and Ameland-Westgat, could reach the Natura 2000 area, and whether the operator's classification of cadmium and other substances as less hazardous was acceptable. The Secretary of State answered that migration beneath the Wadden Sea cannot be excluded but poses no realistic contamination risk due to thick impermeable layers, and that produced water may contain hazardous substances, to be tested by the license holder under existing waste rules.
I cannot rule out that wastewater released in the production of oil and gas contains hazardous substances.
Ik kan niet uitsluiten dat afvalwater dat vrijkomt bij de productie van olie en gas gevaarlijke stoffen bevat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over het bericht ‘Kabinet blijft onvermurwbaar: geen broodnodige studentenhuizen of woningen onder aanvliegroute Schiphol’

Opposition MP Boulakjar (D66) asked ministers why the government blocks student and other housing at Kronenburg under the Schiphol flight path, despite the regional housing shortage, and why an advisor's options were not adopted. The minister answers that noise and safety rules under the LIB restrict housing there, that a 438-home first phase or short-stay units could be explored with Amstelveen, and that no quick route to building is available.
The national government asked in an official-level meeting with the municipality of Amstelveen to examine whether housing plans for Kronenburg could be made that address this complex problem.
Het Rijk heeft hierop in een ambtelijk gesprek met de gemeente Amstelveen gevraagd om te kijken of er woningbouwplannen voor Kronenburg zijn te maken die recht doen aan deze complexe problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over (het toelatingsbeleid van) gewasbeschermingsmiddelen

An MP from D66 asked the ministers whether the Ctgb's pesticide approval practice adequately addresses cocktail and cumulative environmental effects, neurotoxicity, Parkinson's as an occupational disease, buffer zones near residences and alignment with the Water Framework Directive, following a court ruling. The minister answered that the Ctgb assesses risks within the EU framework, that cumulative assessment methods are still being developed at EU level, that RIVM will study exposure and health effects, and that the government is exploring legal options on the Water Framework Directive.
I have asked the European Commission to take up the development of such a methodology.
Ik heb daarom de Europese Commissie gevraagd de ontwikkeling van zo’n methodiek op te pakken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het schrijnende bericht van een rolstoelgebruiker, zoals beschreven in het artikel ‘Rolstoelgebruiker Annemarie in de kou laten staan door NS: ‘Dit mag niet gebeuren’

An MP asked ministers about a wheelchair user left stranded in the cold by NS after a station lift failed, and whether rules and oversight protect such travellers. The state secretary acknowledged the incident, pointed to existing concession and Bestuursakkoord obligations, and said NS will reflect internally, while maintaining that the existing enforcement tools are sufficient and no new rules are proposed.
I have various steering instruments at my disposal.
Ik heb hiervoor diverse sturingsinstrumenten tot mijn beschikking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boutkan over de berichten 'Chemiereus 3M schikt pfas-rechtszaken in VS voor 10 miljard dollar' en 'Chemiebedrijf DuPont kende risico’s van PFAS al decennia en zweeg'

An MP (Boutkan) asked the minister about reports that DuPont/Chemours knew of PFAS health risks for decades and withheld information, and about the 3M settlement in US PFAS lawsuits, including causality, monitoring and cost estimates. The government said permit authorities judge whether all relevant data were submitted, that the public prosecutor is considering reopening a criminal probe, and gave largely general answers on science, cost estimates and monitoring.
It is up to the competent authority to assess whether all relevant data were provided with the permit application and, if not, whether there is reason to revoke or amend the permit.

Het is aan het bevoegd gezag om te beoordelen of bij de vergunningaanvraag alle relevante gegevens zijn verstrekt en of er, als dat niet het geval is, er reden is om de vergunning in te trekken of te wijzingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen, Van Esch, Bouchallikh, Beckerman en Thijssen over PFAS

MPs Hagen, Van Esch, Bouchallikh, Beckerman and Thijssen asked about PFAS: licensed emitters, drinking water, health and economic effects, contaminated sites, enforcement against Chemours and 3M, and whether the government knew of harms. The minister answered that no central emissions register exists, outlined permitting and monitoring responsibilities, and said ongoing RIVM research and legal action continue, while declining to comment on several pending matters.
No, there is no centralised overview of this.
Nee, hiervan is geen gecentraliseerd overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Bontenbal over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over de regels rond verlichting van windmolens

Two CDA MPs asked about the status of ILT approval for proximity detection to switch wind turbine obstacle lighting, notably for the Wieringermeer park, and about funding and provincial frameworks for retrofitting existing turbines. The minister replied that the ILT assessment is ongoing without a date, that new parks' costs are built into SDE++ rates, that a one-off 60/20/20 cost split with provinces is being prepared for a specific grant expected in autumn 2023, and that provinces are developing their own frameworks on individual timelines.
It is not possible during the assessment process of the application to state when the ILT will decide on its approval.
Het is niet mogelijk om gedurende het beoordelingsproces van de aanvraag een uitspraak te doen over het moment waarop besloten wordt over de instemming door de ILT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de (mogelijke) begrenzing Natuurvergunning Schiphol op 44 miljoen passagiers

The MP asks whether the 1995 PKB or the 1996 Aanwijzingsbesluit caps Schiphol at 44 million passengers in the natural-resources permit baseline, and how this affects LVB-1 and the permit. The minister says the baseline follows the most restrictive decision, that the permit and LVB decisions will follow a formal procedure and be published, and declines to give the calculations and a definitive view on the cap for now.
The calculations carried out by the initiator on the basis of these starting points are part of the preparation of a decision on the application for a nature permit.
De berekeningen die door de initiatiefnemer op basis van deze uitgangspunten worden gedaan zijn een onderdeel van de voorbereiding van een besluit op de aanvraag om een natuurvergunning
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de uitstoot van zeer zorgwekkende stoffen (ZZS) door de luchtvaart

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether emissions of very high-concern substances (ZZS) from aviation, especially during the idle taxi phase inside Schiphol, fall under the minimisation duty of the Activiteitenbesluit and why aircraft are regulated differently from cars. The minister answered that aviation activities fall under the Wet luchtvaart rather than the Wet milieubeheer, that a minimisation and reporting obligation for aviation ZZS will be addressed in a letter in Q3 2023, and that it is still being examined whether additional rules are needed.
A possible minimisation and information obligation will be addressed at a later time, when the ongoing studies into ZZS emissions have been completed.
Over een mogelijke minimalisatie- en informatieverplichting zal op een later moment worden ingegaan, wanneer de lopende onderzoeken naar ZZS-emissies afgerond zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over de aangehouden motie Eppink en Koerhuis over in overleg met de sector de omvang en samenstelling van een structureel fonds voor het verduurzamen van de luchtvaart bepalen

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why a motion for a structural aviation decarbonisation fund, funded from the higher flight ticket tax, was not implemented. The minister replies that no structural funds are available, that only incidental Growth Fund money is invested, that the tax revenue goes to general funds, and refuses to establish such a fund.
There is unfortunately no funding to use a part of the flight tax revenue structurally and more directly for this purpose.
Er is helaas geen dekking om een deel van de opbrengsten van de vliegbelasting structureel en meer direct in te zetten voor dit doel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boutkan over het bericht Regeringstoestel PH-GOV voor het eerst op Groningen Airport Eelde

MP Boutkan asked the government why a 19-minute domestic flight without passengers was used to collect the King from Groningen Airport for a trip to Madrid, and why the King did not travel by train or car, and whether this is justifiable amid climate change and poverty. The government answered that the flight carried a delegation, that the choice was the most suitable after weighing efficiency, safety, cost, sustainability and availability, and that the flight request form was recently revised.
The flight was therefore not operated without passengers and was the most suitable choice for transport to Spain.
De vlucht is derhalve niet zonder passagiers afgelegd en was de meest geschikte keuze voor het vervoer naar Spanje.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht ‘plattelandsbewoners die onevenredig hard worden geraakt door rekeningrijden’

MP Van Haga asked the minister whether road pricing (Betalen naar Gebruik) unfairly burdens rural residents given poor public transport there, and why the government pursues it, and whether preparations should stop after the cabinet fell. The minister answered that the government studies regional public transport measures, that research shows average rural mileage is slightly lower than urban, and that the cabinet has not yet decided on the tariff structure; on stopping preparations, the answer defers to Parliament's decision on controversial status.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Boucke over de ingroei van elektrische auto’s

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretary about the uptake of electric cars under the planned post-2025 stimulus package, covering sales forecasts, total cost of ownership, the SEPP subsidy slowdown, the used-EV market, and international comparisons. The state secretary reaffirmed the 2030 zero-emission goal, forecast about 60% EV share of new sales in 2030 under the package, admitted falling subsidy applications and promised further research, and answered most questions substantively while committing to studies and a letter in 2024.
I expect to be able to inform the House by the first quarter of 2024 at the latest about the outcome of the study.
Ik verwacht de Kamer uiterlijk in het eerste kwartaal van 2024 te kunnen informeren over de uitkomst van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat het rijbewijs steeds duurder wordt.

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether it is acceptable that obtaining a driving licence is becoming more expensive, how EU tariffs compare, and what is done to keep licences accessible and cheaper. The minister answers that driving lesson prices are set by the market, that Dutch rates are comparable to other EU countries, that the government has limited direct influence on private driving schools, and that CBR tariffs are a CBR decision discussed with the ministry.
The government has limited possibilities to exert direct influence on the rates that private driving schools charge.
De overheid heeft beperkte mogelijkheden om directe invloed uit te oefenen op de tarieven die private rijscholen hanteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de beantwoording over het bericht dat Amsterdam autoroutes dwars door de stad wil afsluiten

MP Koerhuis (VVD) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether Rijkswaterstaat's mandate to intervene in Amsterdam's Weesperstraat pilot is as broad as the minister stated, what triggers intervention, and what the escalation procedure is. The minister confirmed the earlier answers, said intervention depends on A10 traffic jams and that ending the pilot lies with the Amsterdam alderman, and pointed to the earlier answer for the escalation question.
