As Minister, I do not have the mandate to end the pilot; that mandate lies with the alderman of Amsterdam.
Als Minister heb ik niet het mandaat om de pilot te beëindigen; dat mandaat ligt bij de wethouder van Amsterdam.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het artikel “Overleden bestuurder uit Zwaag zoveelste slachtoffer op de N247, automobilisten rijden te hard en halen in waar het niet mag: ’Hoeveel doden moeten er nog vallen?’”

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about fatal crashes on provincial road N247 and proposed local safety measures. The minister answered that the road is provincial and primarily the responsibility of the road manager, while pointing to national support programmes for road safety.
The N247 is a provincial N-road. It is therefore not under the management of the national government.
De N247 is een provinciale N-weg. Daarmee is deze niet in het beheer van het Rijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de verloren 13.000 banen door inkrimping Schiphol

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about job losses and lost value added from the planned Schiphol flight reduction, including support for affected workers, Lelystad Airport, and alternatives such as innovation. The minister answers that net employment effects are limited because most displaced workers find new jobs within about six months, that a reduction is needed since fleet innovation is no short-term alternative, and that the government keeps working on balancing Schiphol with the living environment.

In the next progress letters the House will be kept informed of the efforts of the Ministry and the employers at Schiphol to limit the negative employment effects of the main decision as far as possible.
In de volgende voortgangsbrieven zal de Kamer op de hoogte worden gehouden over de inspanningen van het Ministerie en de werkgevers op Schiphol
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Krul en Boswijk over de beveiliging van luchthaven Schiphol

Three CDA MPs asked ministers how Schiphol's access controls fail when former staff keep passes, uniforms and radios, and who is responsible for fixing this. The government calls the situation unacceptable, says Royal Schiphol Group and employers hold responsibility, and lists audits, sanctions and an automatic alarm as steps taken.
Royal Schiphol Group further intensifies supervision of correct implementation by carrying out random audits of employers.
Royal Schiphol Group intensiveert verder het toezicht op de correcte uitvoering door steekproefsgewijs audits uit te voeren op werkgevers
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en De Hoop over de inperking van veerdiensten naar Ameland

MPs Bromet and De Hoop asked about the restriction of ferry services to Ameland, the broken road bridge at Holwert, and compensation for affected residents and businesses. The state secretary defended allowing a temporary force-majeure timetable for six weeks pending MARIN research, said no compensation is currently provided, and said the bridge renovation was not delayed and a second spare bridge section is already in use.
I have decided not to agree to a structural adjustment of the timetable between Holwert and Ameland.
Ik heb besloten niet in te stemmen met een structurele aanpassing van de dienstregeling tussen Holwert en Ameland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over Zeer Zorgwekkende Stoffen (ZZS)

MP Kröger asked why Schiphol measures ultrafine particles but not ZZS such as benzene and formaldehyde, whether workers are protected, and about FNV's exit from the emissions taskforce, claims exposure, and enforcement. The minister answered that Arbo rules already require employers to assess and minimise exposure to harmful substances, that the Arbeidsinspectie enforces this with deadlines and fines, and that exposure research (including possibly ZZS) is being explored with IRAS.
Schiphol and the handling companies must comply with the Arbo rules and the Labour Inspectorate's requirements within the set deadlines.
Schiphol en de afhandelingsbedrijven hebben aan de Arboregels en de eisen van de Arbeidsinspectie te voldoen binnen de gestelde termijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Bevers over het bericht dat Terschelling het havengebied met 30 centimeter ophoogt, maar dat Rijkswaterstaat niet meedoet

Two VVD MPs asked why Terschelling municipality can raise its harbour terrain by 30 cm while Rijkswaterstaat will not raise its part, and whether a joint approach is possible. The minister answered that Rijkswaterstaat sees no current need to raise its land, that the municipality has not yet applied for a permit, and that the parties will keep talking and combine works where useful.
Rijkswaterstaat sees no possibility or necessity for a raising at this moment.
Rijkswaterstaat ziet voor een verhoging op dit moment geen mogelijkheid en noodzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht ‘Qatar Airways CEO says aviation industry will miss 2050 net zero target’

MP Van Raan asked the minister to respond to Qatar Airways CEO claims that the aviation industry will miss its 2050 net zero target and that its targets are a PR exercise, unrealistic and not achievable. The minister rejected these analyses, pointed to binding Dutch, EU and ICAO targets and instruments such as the CO2 ceiling, ReFuelEU and the EU ETS, and said the sector can decarbonise without shrinking.
The Netherlands, the EU and ICAO have set various climate targets for aviation that have been made concrete, for example through the national CO2 ceiling, the EU ETS or ReFuelEU.
Nederland, de EU en ICAO hebben verschillende klimaatdoelen voor de luchtvaart gesteld, welke geconcretiseerd zijn, zoals bijvoorbeeld met het nationale CO 2 -plafond, het EU ETS of ReFuelEU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over scheepvaartveiligheid op de Noordzee

An MP asked the minister about ship-safety risks from offshore wind farms in the North Sea, including the Petra L collision, whether the Programma Noordzee safety targets are met, and whether a quantitative safety norm will be set. The minister confirmed that more wind farms raise collision risk without extra measures, listed mitigation measures, said quantified effects cannot yet be given, and promised a quantitative-norm assessment with results expected in spring 2024.
That cannot yet be indicated given the short analysis period.
Antwoord 9 Dat is nu nog niet aan te geven gezien de korte analyseperiode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht dat de N9 te smal, te saai en te gevaarlijk is

MPs Koerhuis and Heerema asked the minister about road safety at the N9 pedestrian and cycle crossings at the Burgervlotbrug and Sint Maartensvlotbrug, including costs, whether the crossings are too small, and whether funding schemes or the MIRT shift could be used. The minister acknowledged the risks, outlined about EUR 1 million of planned measures funded from the EUR 200 million Rijks-N-wegen package, noted that the bridges and roads on them are the responsibility of the province and municipality, and said MIRT funds cannot finance new investment decisions.
Implementing road safety measures on the bridges is therefore the responsibility of the municipality.
Het realiseren van verkeersveiligheidsmaatregelen op de bruggen is dan ook de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Van Campen over het adviesrapport 'Goed water goed geregeld' van de Raad voor de leefomgeving en infrastructuur (Rli)

Two VVD MPs (Minhas and Van Campen) asked the minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how the government responds to the Rli advice on the Water Framework Directive, whether the 2027 targets are achievable, what the main obstacles are, and whether projects could stall. The minister answers that urgency is high, the KRW impulse programme has started, exemptions are possible only under strict conditions, and that project stalling is not expected generically though specific projects may be affected, referring largely to the separate cabinet response for further measures.
As indicated in the Water Committee debate of 7 June, achieving the goals of the Water Framework Directive is a top priority.
Zoals aangegeven in het Commissiedebat Water van 7 juni is het behalen van de doelen van de Kaderrichtlijn Water een topprioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het aansprakelijk stellen van bedrijven voor schade door PFAS-vervuiling

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked whether the government would hold Chemours, Schiphol, Sabic and other polluters civilly liable for PFAS damage, as it did with 3M in Belgium. The minister answered that the municipalities are already suing Chemours and DuPont and the province has held Chemours liable, that private-law liability is only one tool among several, and that no separate investigation into Schiphol or Sabic is currently planned.
Holding companies liable is only one of the options for keeping a company's environmental impact as small as possible.
Aansprakelijkheidsstelling is maar een van de mogelijkheden om de impact van een bedrijf op het milieu zo klein mogelijk te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat de verbreding van de snelweg A4 tussen het Knooppunt Burgerveen en de N14 is stilgelegd

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure about the suspended widening of the A4 between Burgerveen and N14, along with traffic safety and congestion near Leiderdorp. The minister confirmed the project was halted over nitrogen priorities and budget shortfalls, promised to restart planning when nitrogen space and capacity allow, and said signage and lane changes are adequate or will be addressed through the project.
The project was not included a year ago in the list of so-called nitrogen priorities.
Het project is een jaar geleden niet opgenomen in de lijst van de zogenoemde stikstofprioriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de beantwoording over het bericht dat Amsterdam autoroutes dwars door de stad wil afsluiten

MP Koerhuis (VVD) asks the infrastructure minister how Amsterdam's plan to close through-routes will affect emergency response times, hospitals, neighbouring municipalities and the A10 ring road, and whether the plan should be halted pending an impact analysis. The minister says the ring road must keep flowing, a pilot with emergency-service override is planned, impact analyses are not yet done, and the ministry will ask Amsterdam to conduct one and agrees to joint review.
This has not yet been analysed by the municipality of Amsterdam.
Dit is nog niet geanalyseerd door de gemeente Amsterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de omvangrijke onderhoudswerkzaamheden aan de Velsertraverse

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the large maintenance works on the Velsertraverse, their traffic impact, communication with local authorities, and the refusal to reopen the locks route more widely. The minister acknowledged the impact, described the consultation and Hinderaanpak measures, explained the locks route's safety limits, and committed to a pilot and a joint study with the municipality of Velsen.
Rijkswaterstaat is working on a pilot to use the locks route during incidents lasting longer than one hour on the main road network.
Rijkswaterstaat werkt aan een proef om de sluizenroute in te zetten bij incidenten van langer dan 1 uur op het Hoofdwegennet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het nieuws dat de provinciale staten van Utrecht zich heeft uitgesproken tegen de voorgestelde nieuwe aanvliegroute naar Schiphol

Mr Alkaya (SP) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how she would respond to the Utrecht provincial council's motion opposing a fourth Schiphol approach route, and how stakeholders were engaged in the airspace redesign. Minister Harbers answered that the redesign aims at sustainability and military training space, that consultation with provinces and residents continues, that a fuller implementation decision follows after the summer recess, and that the government will decide on further elaboration after reviewing effect analyses and participation.
After the summer recess, the Integrale Programma Beslissing (IPB) will be sent to the House of Representatives.
Na het zomerreces wordt de Integrale Programma Beslissing (IPB) naar de Kamer verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over directe en indirecte lozingen en/of afvalinjecties onder de Waddenzee

MPs Van Esch and Van Raan asked about direct and indirect discharges and waste injection of oil and gas production water under the Wadden Sea, including legal storage duties, alternatives, and whether NAM could be denied new permits if prosecuted. The state secretary answered that no waste is injected under the Wadden Sea, that reporting on production water exists, and that he cannot anticipate prosecution consequences for future permit decisions.
I cannot anticipate a possible prosecution of NAM and its possible consequences for future permit granting.
Ik kan niet vooruitlopen op een mogelijke vervolging van NAM en de eventuele gevolgen daarvan voor toekomstige vergunningverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over de brief van het Overleg Zeeuwse Overheden (OZO) met betrekking tot instandhoudingsopgave bruggen en andere kunstwerken

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the Zeeland provincial bodies' letter on the maintenance backlog for bridges and other structures, including reachability, emergency services and the Zeelandbrug, which is not state-owned. The minister answered that the concerns are shared, that Rijkswaterstaat coordinates works with regional partners, that a joint nuisance-reduction approach and a Midden-Zeeland vision are being developed, and that renovation of the Schelde-Rijn bridges is being analysed.
The concerns of the province of Zeeland about accessibility and dependence on well-functioning infrastructure due to the island structure of this province are shared.
De zorgen van de provincie Zeeland over de bereikbaarheid en de afhankelijkheid van een goed functionerende infrastructuur als gevolg van de eilandenstructuur van deze provincie worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis, Van den Hil, Van der Plas en Stoffer over het bericht dat Meander opvanglocaties voor schipperskinderen sluit in Maasbracht, Nieuwegein, Lemmer en Terneuzen

MPs asked whether the government will prevent the closure of four boarding houses for bargee children run by Stichting Meander and whether the economic claim right on the buildings blocks relocation. The State Secretary answered that closures are a business decision for the boarding houses, that talks are ongoing and the KPMG study will be shared before summer, and that Meander is not blocked from moving to smaller locations.
The Ministry of VWS is currently in talks with the Meander bargee boarding house, so we cannot agree with the term 'stuck in the Ministry of Health's procedures'.

Het Ministerie van VWS is momenteel in gesprek met schippersinternaat Meander, dus in de term «vastlopen in de procedures van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport » kunnen wij ons niet vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Kuik over het bericht 'Nieuwe Gerrit Krolbrug minimaal een jaar vertraagd, gemeente stuurt brandbrief naar minister'

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the reported one-year-plus delay to the new Gerrit Krol bridge in Groningen, the lack of a temporary crossing over the Van Starkenborgh canal, and related public trust, traffic and stikstof risks. The minister acknowledged the delay (opening pushed to 2029 at the latest), said a temporary crossing is expected by end 2023 after technical setbacks, and committed to a joint working group with residents and the municipality.
The expected opening of the new bridge now shifts unfortunately from 2026 to 2029 at the latest.
De verwachte openstelling van de nieuwe brug verschuift nu helaas van 2026 naar uiterlijk 2029.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over het bericht ‘Belangrijkste maatregel om luchtvaart te verduurzamen sneuvelt: kabinet schrapt 14 procent bijmengverplichting’

MP Boucke (D66) asked the minister whether the government still supports the Akkoord Duurzame Luchtvaart after reports that the national 14% sustainable aviation fuel blending target was dropped in favour of an EU 6% obligation. The minister says the 14% national target remains government policy, that the EU rule does not affect the CO2 goals, and that the ministry is studying additional incentives and talking with fuel producers and airlines.
That target remains in place and is cabinet policy.
Die doelstelling staat overeind en is kabinetsbeleid.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘Natuur- en actieclubs maken zich zorgen om hernieuwde interesse in zandwinning op het IJsselmeer en laten het Rijk opnieuw weten: 'Wy wiene, binne en bliuwe tsjin s

MP Bromet asked the ministers about reports of renewed interest in sand extraction in the IJsselmeer, why only the IJsselmeer area gets an environmental impact assessment, whether extraction outside shipping channels is possible under Natura 2000 and Ramsar status, how it fits with water and soil policy, and whether the province of Fryslân has been consulted. The government answered that the sand extraction policy is being renewed with regional involvement, that a planMER will assess ecological effects, that extraction outside shipping channels is possible only if the research shows natural features are not harmed, and that there has been contact with the province.
No environmental impact assessment (planMER) has been drawn up yet. This is expected to happen next year.
Er is nog geen milieueffectrapportage (planMER) opgesteld. Dit gebeurt naar verwachting volgend jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger naar aanleiding van een artikel in de Stentor getiteld 'Overlast snelwegen ondanks elektrische auto’s: Ze produceren soms zelfs meer geluid'

MP Kröger asks whether road noise reduction from electric cars and quieter tyres falls short of predictions, and how calculations relate to measured noise. The State Secretary acknowledges quieter tyres had less effect than expected, that calculation methods will be adjusted with the Omgevingswet, and describes validation, monitoring and complaint routes while stating that electric cars are too few yet to change averages.
This insight has already led to adjustments in the calculation methodology that will apply under the Environment and Planning Act.
Dit inzicht heeft al geleid tot aanpassingen in de rekensystematiek zoals die onder de Omgevingswet zal gelden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht 'Populariteit van SUV’s drukt gewicht Nederlandse auto omhoog (en vertraagt daling uitstoot)'

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the growing popularity of SUVs is raising the weight of the average Dutch car and slowing the fall in CO2 emissions, and what tools government has to steer car size and weight. The State Secretary acknowledged that heavier cars raise CO2 emissions but argued the trend is not solely SUV-driven, described existing tax levers (BPM, MRB, fuel excise) as sufficient, and offered no new steering measures.
Because there is no statutory definition of an SUV, we can only give estimates on whether SUVs have slowed CO2 emissions from the Dutch car fleet and, if so, by how much.

Omdat er geen bij wet vastgestelde definitie van een SUV is (zie mijn antwoorden op vraag 4 en 5) kunnen we alleen schattingen geven op de vraag of SUV’s de CO 2 -uitstoot van het Nederlandse wagenpark hebben afgeremd en zo ja, hoeveel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Krul over het bericht ‘Laat KLM zich aan de afspraken over miljarden aan coronasteun houden’

MPs Slootweg and Krul asked whether the government will enforce KLM's compliance with corona aid conditions, including legal action, use of the 2 billion NOW aid and tax deferral, and pressure via the shareholder Air France-KLM. Minister Kaag answered that the contract could not be terminated for partial non-compliance, litigation was judged uncertain, generic measures cannot be used as leverage, and the government will assess compliance and consider further steps.
The cabinet will use its shareholder powers to keep questioning and assessing KLM's board and supervisory board on this matter.
Het kabinet zal zijn aandeelhoudersbevoegdheden inzetten om het bestuur van KLM en de raad van commissarissen hierover te blijven bevragen en te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht 'Transportsector vreest verkeersinfarct nu ook stuk N9 wordt afgesloten voor zwaar verkeer: ’Waarom zoveel wegen tegelijk dicht?’'

MP Krul (CDA) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why many roads are closed at once, including an axle-load restriction on the N9 after cracks were found in a culvert, and about duration, mitigation, traffic safety and cyclist safety. The minister answered that this is an emergency, not planned works, that the duration is not yet known, and that Rijkswaterstaat is monitoring traffic with the municipality of Alkmaar and will take extra measures if needed.
Currently it is still being investigated what is needed to repair the culvert under the N9 and how long the work will take, so unfortunately the answer to the question is not yet available.
Momenteel wordt nog onderzocht wat er voor nodig is om de duiker onder de N9 te herstellen en hoe lang de werkzaamheden gaan duren, dus het antwoord op de vraag is helaas nog niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat een noodhulpsleepboot een stuurloos schip weghoudt bij windpark Borssele

An MP asked the minister about reports of a rescue tug holding back a drifting ship near the Borssele wind farm, and about safety measures, tug capacity and maritime traffic management in the North Sea. The minister answered that two rescue tugs are stationed at the wind farms, that existing measures are considered sufficient for the planned capacity, and that further measures and tug expansion are planned, while detailed follow-up on the motion is deferred to a separate letter.
In the collective letter I will send to your House before the Maritime Committee debate of 30 May 2023, I will go into the implementation of the motion in more detail.
10 Antwoord 10 In de verzamelbrief die ik uw Kamer nog voor het Commissiedebat Maritiem van 30 mei 2023 zal doen toekomen ga ik nader op de uitvoering van de motie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht 'Hollands Kroon roept Minister op regels rond verlichting windmolens per 2024 aan te passen'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about aviation obstacle lighting on wind turbines, its nuisance, and why the needed regulation is tied to the Environment and Planning Act. The Minister answered that new rules will be set in the wind turbine provisions, that approval-based proximity detection is already possible, and that a stepwise action plan and coordination with the municipality will follow.
Work is being done to anchor this process in formal regulation under the Environment and Planning Act and its implementing decrees as quickly as possible.
Er wordt aan gewerkt om dit proces zo snel als mogelijk in formele regelgeving te verankeren onder de Omgevingswet en de bijbehorende uitvoeringsbesluiten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot, Boulakjar en Van Ginneken over de Kaderrichtlijn Water (hierna: KRW) en het rapport ‘Een KRW-risicoanalyse voor de vergunningverlening voor de bouw- en infrasector’

MPs from D66 asked the government whether the Water Framework Directive (KRW) targets will be met, and about the construction-sector risk analysis claiming large losses if permits are restricted by missed targets. The minister answered that no guarantee can be given, disputes the report's conclusions and scale of risk, and says the government will consult the European Commission on possible exceptions.
However, guarantees that all KRW targets will be met cannot be given.
Garanties dat alle KRW-doelen gehaald worden kunnen echter niet gegeven worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de beantwoording op de schriftelijke vragen over het bericht dat klimaatactivisten Eindhoven Airport betreden

An MP asked the minister whether airlines and the government can recover damages from climate activists who disrupted Schiphol and Eindhoven Airport, and about the number identified, flight delays, and costs. The minister answered that 62 and 182 people were identified, eight flights were delayed and one cancelled at Eindhoven, that the state suffered no damage warranting a civil suit, and that civil or criminal routes for airlines exist but no decision on prosecution has been taken.
At this moment I therefore see no reason to start a civil procedure, jointly or otherwise, against (certain) climate demonstrators.
Op dit moment zie ik dan ook geen aanleiding om een civiele procedure, al dan niet gezamenlijk, te beginnen tegen (bepaalde) klimaatdemonstranten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Ouwehand, Azarkan, Dassen en Sylvana Simons over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

Five MPs asked the government about progress toward its 2030 targets, including a halving of nitrogen emissions and 15% organic farmland. The ministers answered that the nitrogen target is set as deposition thresholds rather than halving, that the latest projection shows only 43% of nature area meeting the norm with a risk of missing the target, and that a new projection will follow in late 2023 with additional measures and a 15% organic farmland plan under monitoring.
The cabinet indicated in 2021 that it wanted to respond to the call.
Het kabinet heeft in 2021 aangegeven gehoor te willen geven aan de oproep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Bevers over het bericht dat de diepte van vaargeul Boontjes nog ter discussie staat

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that the depth of the Boontjes fairway is still under discussion, and whether the new Kornwerderzand lock will cause ships to run aground and raise container volumes at Harlingen. The minister rejected the link between the lock and the Boontjes depth, said no decision on maintenance has been taken yet, and declined to commit to extending the main waterway network to Harlingen, citing existing routes and the NWP.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Peter de Groot over het bericht dat in de wijk van de toekomst plek is voor 10.000 mensen, 21.500 fietsen en 0 auto’s

Two VVD MPs asked the Infrastructure and Water Management and Housing ministers about a report on the car-free Merwede neighbourhood in Utrecht, including emergency access, affordable housing share, completion timing and use of national housing-impulse funds. The minister answered that the municipality is responsible for local mobility, that the neighbourhood is not fully car-free (underground parking and car hubs are planned), that emergency access is ensured through consultation, that 55% of homes are affordable, and that construction timelines are monitored under funding agreements.
The choice of transport mode is made by the residents themselves. The municipality is responsible for local mobility policy.
De keuze voor de vervoerwijze maken de bewoners zelf. De gemeente is daarbij verantwoordelijk voor het lokale mobiliteitsbeleid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Ouwehand, Azarkan, Dassen en Sylvana Simons over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

Six opposition MPs asked the cabinet for the latest 2030 forecasts on its policy targets, including road-death halving, and whether each target will be met. The minister answers only the road-safety item, citing SWOV research that halving serious injuries is likely too ambitious, and gives no answers on the other targets, apologising for the delay.
Unfortunately it has not been possible to answer within the three-week period.
Helaas is het niet gelukt om de beantwoording binnen de termijn van drie weken te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Koerhuis, Rajkowski en Valstar over het bericht ‘‘Verdachte’ Chinese kranen staan ook in Nederlandse havens: zorgen om spionage’

The VVD MPs asked the ministers whether Chinese ZPMC cranes in Dutch ports could enable Chinese digital access, espionage, or disruption of military transports, and about Logink data links and subsidies. The government answered that the risks are being investigated in an interdepartmental review due in autumn 2023, that port facilities are responsible for securing their systems, that no Logink cooperation exists in Rotterdam, and that EU rules and NIS2/CER directives may address the risks.

Whether it is possible for the ZPMC facilities in China to gain digital access to the cranes, or whether they are connected in any way or have access to information in the port of Rotterdam, is being investigated in consultation with the Port of Rotterdam Authority.

Of het mogelijk is om vanuit de ZPMC-faciliteiten in China digitale toegang te krijgen tot de kranen, of dat deze op enigerlei wijze verbonden zijn of toegang hebben tot informatie in de Rotterdamse haven, wordt onderzocht in afstemming met het Havenbedrijf Rotterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over PFAS-besmetting op verschillende kusten in Jutland en Zeeland

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports of PFAS contamination on Danish and Zeeland coasts, including whether grass sampling, monitoring of grazing animals and consultation with farmers should be part of the Dutch approach. The State Secretary answered that PFAS monitoring already occurs where there are signs of high concentrations, that further grass sampling adds little value now, and that consultation with farmers will take place when further investigation is needed.
Given the many measurements in soil, water and biota that already take place and are analysed, there is little added value in now adding a specific analysis of grass samples to the work programme.

Gegeven de veelheid aan metingen in bodem, water en biota die nu al plaatsvinden en geanalyseerd worden, is er weinig meerwaarde om nu een specifieke analyse van grasmonsters toe te voegen aan het werkprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de berichtgeving dat de gemeente Amsterdam routes door Amsterdam autoluw wil maken

MP Koerhuis asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about Amsterdam's plan to close through-routes for cars and its possible effect on congestion on the Ring A10 and on the Zuidasdok project. The minister answered that the municipality is responsible for local mobility policy, that the effects on the A10 are not yet known, and that IenW is in consultation with Amsterdam about avoiding reduced flow on the A10.
The Ministry of IenW is in consultation with the municipality of Amsterdam on this matter.
Het Ministerie van IenW is met de gemeente Amsterdam hierover in overleg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over het artikel ‘Landbouwlobby liet maatregelen uit nieuw waterbeleid van het Rijk afzwakken’

MPs Dassen and Koekkoek asked whether the agricultural lobby (LTO) influenced the new national water policy after a press report, and about the nature of its contacts with ministers. The government answered that the meetings were consultations tied to a policy letter rather than formal administrative consultation, that no minutes were kept, and that some suggestions were adopted while others were not.
No meeting report was made, but an appointment was made for a follow-up meeting.
Er is geen gespreksverslag gemaakt, wel een afspraak voor een vervolggesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over een nieuw ongeluk naast bocht van de A59 naar de A2 bij knooppunt Empel

An MP asked the minister whether, after a new non-fatal crash at the Empel junction, a guardrail would finally be installed where two people had died earlier, and whether the government would act now. The minister said Rijkswaterstaat found the infrastructure contributed to the severity, that guardrails and other measures will be installed at all four junction curves, with the first guardrail placed on 3-4 May 2023 and the rest planned within the year.
On the evening and night of 3 to 4 May, the first guardrail will be installed.
In de avond en nacht van 3 op 4 mei wordt de eerste geleiderail geplaatst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de aanleg van de A15 tussen Bemmel en Duiven/Zevenaar

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure about the Raad van State's interim ruling on nitrogen calculations for extending the A15, the resulting delay, and whether the government would pressure for the project. The minister welcomed the interim ruling, said the final judgment rests with the Raad van State and that no pressure would be exerted on that procedure, and noted that nitrogen issues and capacity constraints slow other projects.
On that procedure I do not want to and cannot exert any pressure.
Op die procedure wil en kan ik geen druk uitoefenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over verkeershinder door afsluitingen Heinenoordtunnel

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether Rijkswaterstaat is failing to limit traffic disruption for Dordrecht businesses caused by closures of the Heinenoordtunnel, and about proposed alternatives such as adjusted lane allocations and traffic controllers. The minister rejected the claim that Rijkswaterstaat falls short, described the lane and road measures being taken, and said the measures can limit but not remove the nuisance.
Rijkswaterstaat, municipalities, the province and the water board are deploying an extensive package of measures to limit the nuisance.
Rijkswaterstaat, gemeenten, provincie en waterschap zetten een uitgebreid pakket aan maatregelen in om de hinder te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over et bericht ‘Landbouwlobby liet beleid voor water en bodem afzwakken’

An MP from D66 asks the minister why measures on groundwater abstraction (permit requirement, 1 km buffer around nature areas) and extensification were weakened under agricultural lobby pressure, and why nature and environmental groups were not consulted. The minister answers that a meet-and-register obligation is introduced instead, that a blanket permit requirement and buffer are not structural choices, that consultation took place with many parties, and that the agricultural transition remains part of other policy tracks.
That is why a blanket permit requirement and a hard boundary of at least 1 km from nature areas are not part of the structuring choices.
Daarom is een algehele vergunningplicht en een harde grens van tenminste 1 km van natuurgebieden geen onderdeel van de structurerende keuzes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het bericht ‘Ministerie vindt veiligheidsonderzoek naar krimp Schiphol niet nodig’

MP Eppink asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why no integrated safety analysis is planned for stopping anticipatory enforcement at Schiphol, despite OVV recommendations and the Alderstafel's concerns about combining old and new systems. The Minister replies that the experiment does not significantly change air traffic so no further safety analysis is foreseen, that the safety consequences are judged acceptable, and that an integrated safety analysis will be carried out for significant changes under the later tracks.
Should a limit value at an enforcement point threaten to be exceeded, for example towards the end of a usage year, less preferred runway combinations may possibly be deployed.

In het geval dat een grenswaarde in een handhavingspunt overschreden dreigt te worden, bijvoorbeeld richting het einde van een gebruikersjaar, kunnen eventueel minder preferente baancombinaties worden ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over de zorgelijke situatie omtrent de inzet van stagiairs en onervaren personeel bij de afhandeling op Schiphol

An MP asked ministers about the use of interns and inexperienced staff in Schiphol ground handling amid staff shortages and whether this threatens flight safety, pay levels and whether government can intervene. The minister answered that inexperienced staff must be properly supervised, that flight safety remains adequate per the ILT, and that wage disputes and the handling sector are for employers and unions, with government having limited options and monitoring talks.
It is up to employers and employees to jointly make agreements on terms of employment and working conditions.
Het is aan werkgevers en werknemers om gezamenlijk afspraken te maken over arbeidsvoorwaarden en arbeidsomstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Bromet over enkele berichten over de voorkeurslocatie van een militaire kazerne in Zeewolde

Two MPs asked the ministers about reports on the preferred location of a military barracks in Zeewolde, including nitrogen space, PAS-melders, farmland, flood risk and nature impacts. The government answered that the Zeewolde site is only a provisional preferred location, no permit has been filed, nitrogen needs are not yet calculated, and the final choice will be communicated to parliament later.
Once a final location choice is made, Defence will inform your House of Representatives about it.
Zodra er een definitieve locatiekeuze is, wordt uw Kamer daarover geïnformeerd door Defensie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Vestering over het artikel van SchipholWatch van 27 maart jl., getiteld ‘Onderhoud Schiphol loopt wéér uit, bewoners nog langer in de herrie’

MPs Van Raan and Vestering asked why Schiphol's runway maintenance was delayed again, whether the minister had intervened despite warnings, whether nitrogen emissions from maintenance traffic and equipment were assessed, and what action will be taken. The minister replied that Schiphol is responsible for planning and execution, that weather buffers were built in, that the 'bestaand recht' from 1994 covers the maintenance, and that Schiphol's processes will be evaluated without committing to sanctions.
Schiphol is responsible for the planning and execution of the maintenance work at Schiphol.
Schiphol is verantwoordelijk voor de planning en uitvoering van de onderhoudswerkzaamheden op Schiphol.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de berichten van NOS Nieuws  ‘Vliegtuigmaatschappijen versus de staat: mag Schiphol krimpen?’ en ‘Rechter fluit kabinet terug: Schiphol hoeft dit jaar niet te krimpen’ en het be

An MP asks about the court ruling that the state cannot end anticipatory enforcement at Schiphol without following the EU balanced approach procedure, and about Schiphol's readiness, staffing, hazardous emissions and capacity reduction. The minister answers that an appeal is pending, the procedure is being pursued, staffing and emissions reports are being monitored, and reduction requires a regulatory change.
An appeal has been lodged against the judgment of the interim relief judge.
Er is hoger beroep aangetekend tegen het vonnis van de voorzieningenrechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over de rechterlijke uitspraak betreffende het kort geding over de experimenteerregeling Schiphol

An MP asked the minister about the court ruling on the Schiphol experiment and the reduction to 460,000 flights, including whether the state would appeal and why outdated data was used. The minister answered that the state is appealing, declined to go into substance given the pending appeal, and said a night curfew option is being studied with results expected after summer 2023.
Given the appeal, it is not possible to go into the substance of this further.
Gelet op het hoger beroep kan hier niet nader inhoudelijk op worden ingegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het artikel ‘Het geld is op, en dus verliest dit dorp twee derde van zijn bruggen: ‘Alsof we er hier niet toe doen’’

MP Krul (CDA) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the loss of bridges in Pekela due to municipal budget shortfalls, asking whether the Rijk can help finance maintenance, whether it has a moral duty, and how cost-benefit analysis should be treated. The minister answered that the canal falls under municipal responsibility with no Rijk financing option, pointed to the Gemeentefonds distribution model, and said a parliamentary motion on MKBA will be taken into account in revising the guidance.
The Pekelerhoofddiep falls under the municipality and Rijkswaterstaat or the Ministry of IenW has no role there.
Het Pekelerhoofddiep valt onder de gemeente en daar heeft Rijkswaterstaat of het Ministerie van IenW geen rol bij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over de sluiting van de Ketheltunnel door een technische storing

An MP asked the minister about the closure of the Kethel tunnel after a technical fault that caused a major traffic jam, including the cause, prevention measures, why the whole tunnel had to close, and whether cameras could keep it open. The minister explained the fault was caused by a faulty installation of a component, outlined the closure rules under the national tunnel standard, and said limited time could be gained in the restoration process.
This specific fault will not occur again in the future, because the direct cause has been removed.
Deze specifieke storing zal in de toekomst niet meer optreden, omdat de directe oorzaak is weggenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat klimaatactivisten Eindhoven Airport betreden

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about climate activists entering Eindhoven Airport's non-public area and how such intrusions could be prevented and enforced under the Aviation Act. The minister confirmed that the local authority decided on the response, that no flights were endangered, and described the arrests and enforcement, but did not commit to new measures.
Decisions on whether to act against demonstrations rest with the local authority.
Besluitvorming over het al dan niet optreden tegen demonstraties ligt bij het lokale gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg, Vestering, Van Esch en Van Raan over het adequaat beschermen van kwetsbare en unieke natuur en koraal op en rondom de BES-eilanden

MPs from the Party for the Animals asked how a motion to halt irreversible building steps at Plantage Bolivia on Bonaire, port expansion near Hato, coral damage, and enforcement against coastal construction on Sint Eustatius were being implemented. The government answered that no irreversible steps are legally possible before the environmental impact assessment is complete, that the port and coral issues will be examined in the MER, and that the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport report on local enforcement capacity and related follow-ups will be sent by end May 2023.

Since the revision of the Bonaire spatial development plan will not be started in procedure until the MER has been established and assessed, I note that it is currently not legally possible to take irreversible steps.

Aangezien de herziening van het Ruimtelijke Ordeningsplan Bonaire (ROB) niet in procedure worden gebracht, zolang de MER niet is vastgesteld en beoordeeld, constateer ik dat het op dit moment juridisch niet mogelijk is om onomkeerbare stappen te zetten.
Antwoorden op vragen die de leden Krul en Amhaouch over het helpen van ons MKB bij de omschakeling naar onderhoudsprojecten.

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the government will halt road and rail construction due to nitrogen, inflation and labour shortages, and what this means for infrastructure SMEs and public transport and road safety. The minister confirmed a shift from new construction to maintenance on the national road and waterway networks, said affected projects are not yet identified, and promised updates before the July MIRT debate.
Since it is currently not known which projects are involved, it is also not possible at this time to reflect on the impact per project.
Gezien het momenteel niet bekend is om welke projecten het gaat, is het op dit moment ook niet mogelijk te reflecteren op de impact per project.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Zorgen en ergernis na wéér een afsluiting van Vlaketunnel'

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the repeated closure of the Vlaketunnel after an intercom fault, the options Rijkswaterstaat has, why the tunnel was not kept open at reduced speed, and how Zeeland's accessibility will be protected during planned maintenance. The minister answers that closure was necessary for safety during testing, that a speed limit and inspection were used until then, and that mitigation measures and regional coordination are planned for autumn maintenance.
Given the circumstances and for the safety of road users and workers, closing the tunnel was however necessary.
Gezien de omstandigheden en omwille van de veiligheid van weggebruikers en werknemers was afsluiting van de tunnel echter noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering, Van Esch en Wassenberg over mogelijk illegale afvalinjecties door de NAM in de Noordzee en het Waddengebied

MPs from the Party for the Animals asked whether NAM's disposal of gas-extraction wastewater by injection into the deep subsurface in the North Sea and Wadden area is illegal, whether injection is safe for mercury-containing waste, and whether a criminal investigation should follow. The minister answered that the Public Prosecution Service's investigation into the Wadden is ongoing and cannot be discussed, that the North Sea investigation is concluded, that mercury occurs naturally in the deep subsurface, that SodM supervises strict injection conditions, and that initiating a criminal investigation is not for the minister to decide.
The cabinet cannot make further statements about this because the investigation is being conducted by the Public Prosecution Service.
Het kabinet kan daar nu geen nadere mededelingen over doen omdat het onderzoek door het OM wordt gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen ontvangen van het lid Van Esch over de situatie in de Lutkemeerpolder en de consequenties van het kabinetsbeleid dat water en bodem sturend moet worden

An MP asked whether the Lutkemeerpolder, a low-lying fertile clay polder, should be developed mainly into distribution warehouses under the water-and-soil-guiding policy, and whether the government would curb warehouse growth and cooperate on a local food park. The minister acknowledged the risks and noted the polder is a local and provincial decision, with the national government holding no role in the Amsterdam warehouse decisions and declining to work on the food park.
The national government has no role in the decision-making on business locations in the Lutkemeerpolder in Amsterdam.
Het Rijk heeft geen rol in de besluitvorming rondom de bedrijfsvestigingen in de Lutkemeerpolder in Amsterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het gelijkwaardigheidscriteria in de Wet Luchtvaart

An MP asked the minister whether the Aviation Act's equivalence criteria for Schiphol airport (noise, external safety, local air pollution) bar any later decision from worsening protection relative to the first 2003 decisions, and sought emissions data and related details. The minister confirmed the equivalence rule applies on an annual, net ('per saldo') basis, reported emissions and enforcement figures showing no breach in 2019, and committed to later sharing the permit application with the Chamber.
As indicated in the answer to question 3, the statutory framework of RBML has applied to these airports since 2009.
Zoals in het antwoord op vraag 3 aangegeven geldt voor deze luchthavens sinds 2009 het wettelijk kader van RBML.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Krul en Grinwis over het bericht 'Ministerie betaalde al 15.000 euro aan actiegroep Lelystad Airport: ‘Dit is van de zotte’

Three MPs (Boswijk, Krul, Grinwis) asked why the government pays penalty payments rather than fulfilling a Woo freedom-of-information request from Stichting Laagvliegen, whether aviation emissions above 3,000 feet must be reported under the NEC directive, what sanctions apply for incomplete reporting, and how that affects the nitrogen approach. The minister acknowledges delay and agrees phased publication, says the NEC reporting is not legally binding but commits to including above-3,000-foot emissions from 2024, and maintains that the nitrogen contribution of aviation is about 0.01%.
I regret that it took longer than the applicable statutory deadlines, as a result of which a penalty payment was imposed.
Ik betreur het dat het langer heeft geduurd dan de daarvoor geldende wettelijke termijnen, waardoor er een dwangsom is opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van den Hil over het bericht dat de sluiting van rijtestlocaties definitief is

MPs Koerhuis and Van den Hil asked the minister about the definitive closure of driving-test locations, including Terneuzen, and why only Winschoten was reopened. The minister replied that the 2016 CBR evaluation and 2018 client survey justified concentrating tests in 30 locations, that Goes now takes Terneuzen's tests, and that there is no reason to reconsider the decision.
The CBR does not know how many residents of Zuid- and Noord-Beveland take a driving test in Goes.
Het is bij het CBR niet bekend hoeveel inwoners uit Zuid- en Noord-Beveland een rijtest afnemen in Goes.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over de ernstige bezorgdheid bij de gemeenteraad van Hoeksche Waard over de toegenomen verkeersdrukte, het sluipverkeer en de daarmee afgenomen veiligheid van de inwoners op d

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the municipal council's concern over traffic congestion, rat-running and reduced road safety in Hoeksche Waard during closures of the Heinenoordtunnel and Haringvlietbrug, including delayed emergency services and a request for extra measures. The minister responds that renovation closures are unavoidable, that a package of measures with the regional authorities is being implemented and monitored, that emergency response measures were agreed with four safety regions, and that the works cannot be postponed.
Rijkswaterstaat is still consulting with the Ministry of Health and the safety regions on the need for additional measures.
Rijkswaterstaat is nog in overleg met het Ministerie van VWS en de veiligheidsregio's over de noodzaak van aanvullende maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Van den Berg over de afsluiting van de Heinenoordtunnel en de Haringvlietbrug

MPs Krul and Van den Berg asked the minister how a motion on a traffic-overflow plan and emergency-service access for the Heinenoordtunnel and Haringvlietbrug closures would be carried out, and what is planned for acute care access. The minister answered that a plan with traffic diversions, extra ambulances and fire services, a temporary ferry and possible helicopter use has been drawn up, and committed to further consultation and to informing parliament by June.
Consultation on implementing the motion in general terms is ongoing with the Ministry of VWS, and your House will be informed by June of this year at the latest.
Over de uitvoering van de motie in algemene zin is overleg gaande met het Ministerie van VWS en uw Kamer zal uiterlijk in juni van dit jaar worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en De Hoop over het bericht 'Krakkemikkige boogbrug over het Julianakanaal wordt ineens niet meer vervangen: Itteren houdt zijn hart vast'

MPs Krul and De Hoop asked the minister why the Itteren bridge over the Julianakanaal will be renovated instead of replaced, the timeline, consultation with the Itteren village council, traffic and noise effects, shipping implications, and the stance on the Maastricht council's letter. The minister answered that replacement costs had more than doubled so renovation was chosen within budget, outlined a consultation process with a target decision in 2024, and said inspections show no short-term safety problem.

In the second quarter of 2023 Rijkswaterstaat will consult the municipality of Maastricht, the Itteren village council and other local parties on the precise scope of the renovation of the Itteren bridge.

In het tweede kwartaal van 2023 zal Rijkswaterstaat in gesprek gaan met gemeente Maastricht, de dorpsraad Itteren en andere omgevingspartijen over de precieze invulling van de renovatie van brug Itteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht 'Krakkemikkige boogbrug over het Julianakanaal wordt ineens niet meer vervangen: Itteren houdt zijn hart vast'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the 85-year-old Itteren bridge will now be renovated rather than replaced, and what this means for safety, the inland shipping modal shift, nearby businesses and residents. The minister confirmed that rising costs drove the change, said the bridge is structurally safe for now with interim measures until mid-2024, and gave only partial detail on renovation scope and timing.
Until mid-2024, Rijkswaterstaat will first work out the scope of the renovation.
Tot medio 2024 gaat Rijkswaterstaat eerst de scope van de renovatie uitwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat er geen snelle oplossing is voor de files op de A2 tussen Weert en Eindhoven

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why there is no quick fix for congestion on the A2 between Weert and Eindhoven, and whether the widening or lane reconfiguration is being considered. The minister replied that widening is not on the MIRT agenda, that no-regret and collective-transport measures are being pursued instead, and that converting hard shoulders to peak lanes is not planned, while acknowledging concerns about rat-running through villages.
Converting hard shoulders into peak-hour lanes is not on the table.
Het aanpassen van vluchtstroken tot spitsstroken is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Boucke over de Voorkeursbeslissing voor de herziening van het luchtruim

MPs Van der Graaf and Boucke asked the minister about the air-space redesign decision, including a fourth approach route, its effect on noise, climate, nitrogen and capacity, and how objections were handled. The minister answered at length that the fourth approach point mainly reduces noise and CO2 and does not aim to grow flight numbers, that capacity gains serve sustainable traffic handling, and that the decision is directional with detailed participation to follow.
The preferred decision is a directional decision in broad outline and thereby marks the start of the next phase of the programme.
De Voorkeursbeslissing is een richtinggevend besluit op hoofdlijnen en markeert daarmee de start van de volgende fase van het programma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht ‘Megaclaim gloort in slepend arbeidsgeschil bij de KLM’

An MP asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about a reported 478 million euro legal claim against KLM by Martinair pilots, and whether the state knew of it when approving a loan and state aid. The government answered that KLM, not the state, assesses and provides for the claim (22 million euro provision), that the state is not a party, and that it will monitor cost reductions under the aid conditions without taking a direct role.
The Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management are not parties to this legal dispute and its aftermath; it is a matter between KLM and the Martinair pilots group.

Het Ministerie van Financiën en het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat zijn geen partij in dit juridische conflict en de nasleep daarvan, dat is iets tussen KLM en de groep Martinair-piloten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Strolenberg over het bericht dat honderden bagagemedewerkers zich melden voor een claimzaak tegen Schiphol en dat ook de Nederlandse Arbeidsinspectie ingrijpt

Two VVD MPs asked why Schiphol is not automating baggage handling sooner after the Labour Inspectorate found excessive physical strain and Arbo violations, and whether the minister would press Schiphol on timelines, lifting aids, worker surveys and international comparison. The minister answered that the inspectorate set binding deadlines of two years for automation and immediate use of aids, that Schiphol plans a new baggage cellar from 2026, and that the minister will raise timelines at the regular overleg with Schiphol and a bestuurlijk overleg in April, with an international comparison to follow after an outsourced study due before summer.
The Labour Inspectorate imposed these definitive requirements on the baggage handlers at Schiphol on 14 March.
Deze definitieve eisen heeft de Arbeidsinspectie op 14 maart jl. aan de bagage afhandelaars op Schiphol opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het bericht ‘Gif in de grond’

An MP from Volt asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports on the herbicide bentazon in groundwater, its effects on drinking water and whether a general ban is warranted. The minister replied that bentazon is authorised under EU rules and periodically reassessed, that use in groundwater protection areas was banned from 2023, and that a general national ban is not possible under the current EU system.
The Netherlands cannot simply ban an active substance in general.
Nederland kan een werkzame stof niet zomaar algemeen verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht 'Campaigners urge EU to rethink green investment label’

An MP asked the minister whether the European Commission plans to label investment in new aircraft as climate-friendly, and whether this is credible given fossil-fuel aviation. The minister answered that the Commission has not formally decided, that the EU platform recommended treating new efficient aircraft as a transition activity, and that the government will keep pressing the Commission for realistic criteria and will assess a concrete proposal when it is tabled.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Vestering over de noodzaak om regenwater beter vast te houden

MPs Van Esch and Vestering asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management what was done differently on drought and water retention, how rainwater is being stored, whether indicators exist, and how natural measures and water-level increases are being implemented. Minister Harbers answered that many drought recommendations have been implemented, cites concrete projects and budgets, notes indicators are being developed, and points to provinces, municipalities and water boards as responsible for implementation.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management actively encourages the restoration of stream valleys toward more natural systems, with the aim among others of retaining rainwater better.
Het Ministerie van IenW stimuleert actief het herstel van beekdalen naar meer natuurlijke systemen, met onder andere als doel om regenwater beter vast te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Boucke over het initiatief voor energiebesparing op De Zuidas en het voorzien van alle straatverlichting van een led-lichtbron

Two MPs asked the ministers about a campaign to switch off night-time office lighting on the Zuidas and about fully converting street lighting to LED, including whether the government would support the initiative and how energy savings could be mandated. The ministers confirmed support for the campaign, pointed to the energy-saving obligation and the updated measures list, and said about 32% of motorway lighting is LED with the rest to be replaced at natural replacement moments, rather than accelerating full conversion.
Almost all provinces will fit the remaining street lighting with LED lamps in the coming years.
Vrijwel alle provincies gaan de komende jaren de resterende straatverlichting van ledlampen voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat het bijna niet meer rendabel is om als binnenvaartschipper te varen

MP Koerhuis asked the minister whether EU/CCR technical rules on cabin height and other requirements for existing inland vessels threaten their profitability and raise a domestic-right conflict under the ECHR. The minister answers that these are long-standing transitional rules (2035/2049), that a hardship clause exists, that the government will publish research on the effects by spring 2023, and that some questions are answered only by reference to earlier letters.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management advises ship owners to use the hardship clause if they cannot comply with the rules and will cooperate fully with applications for it.

Het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat adviseert scheepseigenaren om van de hardheidsclausule gebruik te maken als zij niet aan de regels kunnen voldoen en zal alle medewerking verlenen aan aanvragen hiervoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de tijdelijke beleidsregel inzake elektrische laadpunten op verzorgingsplaatsen

An MP asks whether the temporary policy rule on EV charging points at service areas amounts to a moratorium on new fast chargers until 2028, and whether it conflicts with the 1.8 million charge-point target and with protections for existing tankstation rights. The Minister denies a moratorium, explains that new permits are tied to a minimum five-year term to ease transition to exclusive charging rights, and says he will not lift the rule or extend the permit terms, while answering the questions one by one.
No, the temporary policy rule is an important step in developing new policy, which will give entrepreneurs more clarity and is expected to lead to more charging points being realised.

Nee, de tijdelijke beleidsregel is een belangrijke stap in de totstandkoming van een nieuw beleid, dat ondernemers meer duidelijkheid zal gaan bieden en naar verwachting leidt tot de realisatie van meer laadpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over vervanging geluidsschermen A10 Noord bij Amsterdam

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the delayed replacement of noise barriers along the A10 North in Amsterdam, which left thousands of residents with more traffic noise and asked for faster replacement and a temporary fix. The minister answered that Rijkswaterstaat will lay quieter asphalt before summer 2023, aims to bring the barrier replacement forward from 2025 to 2024, and will reduce speed to 80 km/h only as a less effective option.
The quieter asphalt is expected to be laid in the North region before the summer holidays of 2023.
Naar verwachting wordt het stillere asfalt voor de zomervakantie regio Noord 2023 aangebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Strolenberg over het bericht dat dagelijkse dronevluchten tussen ziekenhuizen Meppel en Zwolle een stap dichterbij zijn

MPs Koerhuis and Strolenberg asked the minister about drone deliveries of medicines and organs between hospitals and to the Wadden islands, including the Besluit Beperkingen Burgerluchtverkeer Waddenzee restrictions. The minister said the government supports drone testing and experimentation, will amend the Waddenzee decree to replace the blanket ban with a geographic zone under strict conditions, and will facilitate pilots but gave no firm timetable.
The Ministry of IenW wants to replace the total ban on drones with a geographic zone in which drone operations are possible under strict conditions.
Het Ministerie van IenW wil het totale verbod op drones vervangen door een geografische zone waarin drone operaties onder strikte voorwaarden mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het actualiseren van de efficiënte CO2-prijs uit de WLO studies en de maatschappelijke kosten-batenanalyse (MKBA) oliewinning Schoonebeek

An MP asks about updating the efficient CO2 price from the WLO studies, the delayed new WLO study, and whether the Schoonebeek oil extraction cost-benefit analysis should be tested against the two-degree scenario rather than only the WLO low and high scenarios. The minister answers that the new WLO study will appear in 2024, that the two-degree scenario is used only as a supplementary sensitivity check, and that multiple scenarios are kept deliberately to test robustness.
It is precisely important to use multiple scenarios because the future is uncertain and this allows checking whether policy measures are robust.
Het is juist van belang meerdere scenario's te hanteren omdat de toekomst onzeker is en zo gecheckt kan worden of de beleidsmaatregelen robuust zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over duidelijkheid over de toekomst van vuurtoren Lange Jaap

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management for a timeline of the investigations into the Lange Jaap lighthouse and whether the findings would be shared with parliament, and asked for a decision before year-end. The minister promised to send three reports (foundation, access route, crack inspection) by end of Q1 2023 and expects clarity on future scenarios by end of 2023, while committing to speed without compromising care.
Yes, the above three reports will be sent separately to the House as soon as they are final.
Ja, bovenstaande drie rapporten zullen separaat aan de Kamer worden toegezonden zodra deze definitief zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het bericht 'Gedeputeerde over natuurregels op vaarroute naar Ameland: 'Dweilen met de kraan open''

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the minister about the Ameland ferry route, its navigation channel problems, and the ongoing study into a durable connection after 2030, including protection of Wadden Sea nature. The minister answered that the ferry operator has stopped sailing at low water levels for safety reasons, that the 2030 study will assess alternatives by end 2023 with a decision then, and that extra dredging and more frequent buoy repositioning are being introduced.
I therefore understand the operator's decision not to sail when, in its judgement, this safety is at stake.
Ik heb dan ook begrip voor de beslissing van de rederij om niet te varen wanneer deze veiligheid naar haar oordeel in het geding is.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de SLAPP (Strategic Lawsuit Against Public Participation) tactiek van reisorganisatie TUI tegen natuurorganisatie STINAPA (Stichting Nationale Parken Bonaire)

MPs Van Raan and Vestering asked whether TUI's threat of legal action against STINAPA, which had flagged that the Chogogo resort on Bonaire lacked proper permits and a compliant seawall, amounts to a SLAPP tactic, and asked how the government would enforce and remedy the sand runoff damaging coral. The government answered that a compliance order (last onder dwangsom) was imposed on the permit holder, that whether the threat is an abuse of procedure is for the courts, that the EU anti-SLAPP directive is still under negotiation, and that enforcement and coral-restoration measures are being pursued with the Bonaire public body.
The Bonaire executive board informed the permit holder that the construction height does not meet the requirements in the permit.
Het bestuurscollege van Bonaire heeft de vergunninghouder medegedeeld dat de bouwhoogte niet voldoet aan de eisen in de vergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over ‘De latente stikstofruimte en extern salderen’

An MP (Omtzigt) asked the ministers about buy-outs of farms for nitrogen permit space, unregistered latent permit capacity, the unrecorded 30% deduction in external netting, and the AERIUS model update, requesting lists and data. The minister answered that the external netting evaluation is ongoing with results expected mid-2023, that stricter external netting rules and registration of freed space are being pursued, and that a complete picture of latent space cannot be obtained.
I expect to be able to share the results of the evaluation with the House around mid-2023.
Ik verwacht de resultaten van de evaluatie medio 2023 met de Kamer te kunnen delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de regionale zorgen omtrent de afsluiting van de Haringvlietbrug en de Heinenoordtunnel in verband met renovatiewerkzaamheden

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about regional concerns over closures of the Haringvlietbrug and Heinenoordtunnel for renovation, including traffic congestion, emergency care access and alternative transport. The minister acknowledged the concerns, described mitigation measures, communication with municipalities and emergency services, ferry and toll arrangements, and said Rijkswaterstaat is working with stakeholders without committing to new structural changes.
Rijkswaterstaat informs stakeholders periodically and will continue to do so until the end of the project.
Rijkswaterstaat informeert de stakeholders periodiek en zal dat blijven doen tot het einde van het project.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga naar aanleiding van het bericht over nieuwe CCR-eisen voor de binnenvaart

An MP asks the minister about reported new CCR rules for inland shipping that could make skippering unprofitable, and about the modal shift from water to road. The minister clarifies these are existing ES-TRIN transition deadlines (2035), says research is ongoing with results to parliament in spring 2023, and points to the hardship clause and a forthcoming action agenda.
Research is currently being conducted into the (economic) effects of these transitional provisions expiring on the number of (small) vessels.
Op dit moment wordt onderzoek gedaan naar de (economische) effecten van het aflopen van deze overgangsbepalingen op het aantal (kleine) schepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over ecoducten

An MP asks whether a wildlife crossing (ecoduct) at Oud Reemst was fenced off, whether other crossings are closed, and what the state of the Meerjarenprogramma Ontsnippering is, plus several questions on road-kill data and cross-border connectivity. The minister says responsibility for wildlife connectivity lies with the provinces, gives a status update on the MJPO (12 bottlenecks remain, one Rijkswaterstaat ecoduct stalled), declines to provide a national overview of closed crossings, and promises to ask provinces for an inventory and to include the bottleneck overview in the next nature progress report.
Due to the decentralisation of nature policy in 2011, I cannot provide an overview for the whole country of how many and which ecoducts and/or wildlife passages have been closed.
Vanwege de decentralisatie van het natuurbeleid in 2011 kan ik niet een overzicht geven voor het hele land van hoeveel en welke ecoducten en/of faunapassages zijn afgesloten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het bericht ‘Transportsector is blij, dorpen rond A7 zijn niet overtuigd van afname verkeer na opening Prinses Margriettunnel. 'Rijgedrag niet te voorspellen’'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the damage to the Prinses Margriettunnel, the reopening, speed enforcement, the condition of nearby bridges and traffic and accident effects in surrounding villages. The minister answered each question, giving repair timelines, the speed-control arrangement with the Public Prosecution Service, bridge maintenance plans and monitoring by the relevant authorities.
Enforcement of speed and the decision whether to conduct an on-site speed check is a decision that must be taken not by Rijkswaterstaat but by the Public Prosecution Service.
Handhaving op snelheid en het wel of niet overgaan tot een snelheidscontrole ter plaatse is namelijk een besluit dat niet door Rijkswaterstaat, maar door het Openbaar Ministerie genomen moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de inzet van dieselaggregaten

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers about the use, air-quality and CO2 impact, municipal and provincial levers, EU emission standards and alternatives for diesel generators, and whether a strategy and a three-year phase-out by grid operators are planned. The state secretary answered that diesel generators (about 11,000, mostly in construction) have limited national impact but local effects, that municipalities rarely use their powers, that a routekaart and convenant are being prepared, and that a three-year phase-out is too short, proposing about ten years.
Once the routekaart SEB is final and the convenant signed, I will inform your House about this.
Zodra de routekaart SEB definitief is en het convenant ondertekend, zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over varend ontgassen

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the Netherlands has no national ban on venting toxic vapours from cargo while Belgium and Germany do, and how the government is handling the problem with shippers, shippers' clients and enforcement. The minister replies that no national ban exists in Germany or Belgium as described, that a national ban is legally blocked by the Rhine Navigation Act and the CDNI treaty, that a phased international ban is expected in 2024, and that talks with cargo owners and enforcement cooperation are ongoing.
The ministry takes the position that a national ban would conflict with the object and purpose of the treaty and is therefore not possible.
Het ministerie hanteert het uitgangspunt dat een nationaal verbod in strijd is met het doel en voorwerp van het verdrag en daarom niet mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke en Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht “Schiphol Group heeft boeren uitgekocht voor extra stikstofruimte Schiphol en Lelystad Airport

D66 MPs asked whether Schiphol's buyout of farms for nitrogen space is known, how much space is freed, the status of Schiphol's nature permit, and how Lelystad Airport's nitrogen offsetting and a planned pre-emption right fit together. The government answered that nine farms were bought for Schiphol and three for Lelystad Airport, that the appropriate assessment is still being supplemented, and that a pre-emption right bill is targeted for entry into force on 1 January 2024.
It is important that Schiphol obtains the required nature permit as soon as possible.
Het is van belang dat Schiphol zo spoedig mogelijk over de vereiste natuurvergunning beschikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over het bericht 'Schiphol gaf al ruim 16 miljoen euro uit in jacht op stikstofrechten'

GroenLinks MPs asked whether Schiphol's purchases of farms for nitrogen rights (over EUR 16 million) were known to ministries, whether more purchases are planned, and how this relates to parliamentary motions and state-aid rules. The minister confirms awareness, says ministries were not involved, says Schiphol's external netting is allowed under current rules, and promises new policy to gain more regie over nitrogen space.
Private transactions have been concluded. I cannot comment on those.
Er zijn private transacties gesloten. Ik kan daar niet in treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht 'Deskundige wil extra controles van oude tunnels na problemen in Friesland'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how Rijkswaterstaat will inspect old immersed tunnels after the Prinses Margriet tunnel incident in Friesland, including timelines, the scope of invasive inspection, and interim measures such as sensors. The minister replied that the cause is still under investigation, so no timeline, scope or structural measures can yet be committed to, though sensor options are being explored.
Once more is known about this, Rijkswaterstaat can determine whether and how tunnel approaches can be monitored.
Zodra hier meer bekend over is, kan Rijkswaterstaat bepalen of en hoe tunneltoeritten gemonitord kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Alkaya en Van der Plas over het bericht dat sluiting dreigt voor groen vmbo in Noord-Brabant wegens nieuwe aanbesteding van het openbaar vervoer

Three MPs asked whether the threatened closure of a green vocational school in Andel, linked to a provincial public transport tender cutting pupil buses, is acceptable, and what the government will do about it. The minister replied that the closure threat is premature, that the province guarantees accessibility in its draft programme of requirements, and that it is for decentralised authorities to decide, so the government declines to intervene.
Since both municipalities and the province have their own democratically elected checks, the government exercises restraint here.
Aangezien zowel gemeenten als de provincie hun eigen democratisch verkozen controles hebben past de regering hier terughoudendheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de mogelijke gevolgen van de boycots op olie uit Rusland

An MP asked the ministers whether the national oil crisis plan and diesel distribution plan would be finished before the Russian oil import ban, what scenarios and impact analyses exist, and which sectors would be prioritised. The minister answered that the concept plans are nearly ready and will be formally adopted soon, that a concept diesel distribution plan is due before the 5 February 2023 sanctions start, and that the logistics sector and priority users will be addressed through the plan's scenario work, while impact monitoring falls partly under the NCTV and EU-level analysis.
Formal approval and adoption will take place in the short term, after which it will be shared with your House.
Formele goedkeuring en vaststelling zal op korte termijn plaatsvinden, waarna het met uw Kamer gedeeld zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Ook Lelystad Airport omstreden stikstofmarkt op: vliegveld is op zoek naar boeren voor opkoop'

CDA MPs asked ministers whether buying up nitrogen rights by Lelystad Airport and the state-linked Schiphol Group, while PAS-melder farmers remain unresolved, is acceptable, and whether the government should stop it and apply the motion on a transparent nitrogen bank. The minister answered that the airport acts within the principle that initiators must mitigate their own emissions, that it only bought from farms that volunteered, that a nitrogen bank does not yet exist, and that Schiphol's operational permit matters are for its board.
The airport's conduct is in line with the nitrogen policy principle that initiators are themselves responsible for mitigating nitrogen emissions.
Het handelen van de luchthaven is in lijn met het uitgangspunt van het stikstofbeleid dat initiatiefnemers zelf verantwoordelijk zijn om stikstofuitstoot te mitigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht ‘Russische olietankers verdwenen van de radar vlak voor sancties’
