An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how Russian oil tankers evading sanctions are monitored, including whether monitoring should extend beyond Russian ships and Dutch waters, and whether AIS data and oil samples are checked. The government answered that the Coast Guard and Customs jointly monitor tankers from Russian ports bound for the Netherlands regardless of flag, but that Customs makes the final origin assessment and that sampling is less effective, with enforcement details withheld for confidentiality.
Regarding the precise enforcement, no statement can be made for reasons of confidentiality.
Over de precieze handhaving kan omwille van vertrouwelijkheid geen uitspraak worden gedaan.

Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het bericht ‘Europese Ministers vertragen en verzwakken bescherming drinkwaterbronnen tegen bestrijdingsmiddelen’ van de VEWIN, de vereniging van waterbedrijven in Nederlan

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about EU ministers delaying and weakening protection of drinking water sources against pesticides, and about the risks to meeting Water Framework Directive goals by 2027. The minister confirms awareness, says the Netherlands opposed the additional impact assessment but a majority supported it, and states the national approach to meet WFD goals will continue regardless of EU outcomes.
Regardless of further European handling of the proposed Regulation on sustainable use of plant protection products, the Netherlands will continue the approach to achieve the WFD goals.
Ongeacht de verdere Europese behandeling van de beoogde Verordening duurzaam gebruik gewasbeschermingsmiddelen zal Nederland de aanpak doorzetten om de KRW-doelen te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over ‘De gebrekkige antwoorden aangaande stikstof’

MP Van Raan asked why Schiphol's nature permit application could allow more nitrogen emissions and why the aviation sector is exempted from proportional reductions, and questioned whether voluntary buyouts make compulsory buyouts more likely. The minister answered that the Wnb permit will be assessed objectively against the statutory framework without political judgement, that aviation must contribute proportionally, and that a compulsory buyout decision will be evaluated in autumn 2023.
Once the application is complete, I will assess it, with the Nature Conservation Act forming the assessment framework.
Als de aanvraag volledig is, zal ik die beoordelen, waarbij het toetsingskader wordt gevormd door de Wet natuurbescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Heerema over het bericht dat de N9 te smal, te saai en te gevaarlijk is

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about press reports calling the N9 road too narrow, dull and dangerous, and why only parts of the N9 are being made safer. The minister confirmed planned safety measures (tunnel and roundabout at Kogendijk, removal of risky bus stop and bike path), but declined to fund a physical lane separation across the whole N9 because the €200 million budget is prioritised for other road sections.
From the €200 million this cabinet has made available for road safety on national N-roads, funds are therefore being allocated to improve road safety on the N9.
Vanuit de € 200 miljoen die dit kabinet beschikbaar heeft gesteld voor verkeersveiligheid Rijks-N-wegen worden daarom middelen beschikbaar gesteld om de verkeersveiligheid op de N9 te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht 'Geheime covid-cijfers Schiphol lagen ver boven het gemiddelde'

An MP asked the minister whether covid sewage concentrations at Schiphol were above average, why they were not published on the dashboard, and whether an independent study into incoming flights was warranted. The minister answered that Schiphol sewage data cannot be compared with residential catchments, so it is not dashboard material, that variant sequencing has been intensified, and that no conclusion on flight-driven spread can be drawn, though the government will keep monitoring incoming variants and report on wastewater testing of arriving aircraft.
For that reason we are actively keeping track of incoming variants.
Daarom houden we hier actief zicht op de binnenkomende varianten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Minhas over de motie Koerhuis en Minhas om te onderzoeken hoe het probleem op de spoorwegen van de Maasvlakte voor goederenvervoer kan worden opgelost

MPs Koerhuis and Minhas asked about their motion to study how rail freight bottlenecks on the Maasvlakte can be solved, including costs and possible state funding. The State Secretary says a bottleneck will emerge, that the state lacks the funds for the proposed €400 million infrastructure and is still negotiating reuse of remaining MIRT money, and that funding the remaining €195 million depends on future Mobility Fund space.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de vlootvervanging van de Rijksrederij

An MP asked the minister about the state of the Rijksrederij fleet replacement, whether the investment can pay for itself, which ships are near end of life, and the maintenance costs and emissions effects of replacement. The minister referred to the earlier letter, said the planning is still current, gave age and cost figures, and stated that business cases are still being prepared without yet quantifying maintenance savings or access to climate funds.
Whether, and if so to what extent, the maintenance costs of the ships will fall, I cannot yet say at this moment.
Of, en zo ja in welke mate, de onderhoudskosten van de schepen dalen, kan ik op dit moment nog niet zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het nieuws dat er grote verschillen worden gemeten in overlast van vliegverkeer

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why noise complaints and noise measurements about aircraft over the Leiden region differ between Schiphol/LVNL and the Omgevingsdienst/BAS, and what the government's data basis is. The minister attributes the differences to different measurement methods (radar tracks versus noise monitors) and the rising complaints to wind conditions favouring the Kaagbaan, and says the enforcement and policy basis is calculated noise.
The differences can be explained by the different methods used by the Omgevingsdienst and LVNL and their purposes of use.
De verschillen zijn te verklaren uit de verschillende methoden die de Omgevingsdienst en LNVL gebruiken en de gebruiksdoelen ervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht ‘20 euro subsidie per container die van weg naar water gaat’

MP Alkaya (SP) asked the minister about reports of a 20 euro subsidy per container moving from road to water, and about the risk that small inland vessels disappear, including questions on the study of expiring transitional rules, bridge operation, CO2 effects and subsidy scope. The minister answered that modal shift is promoted, that a study due spring 2023 will assess the effects on small vessels and related business, that no broader Modal Shift scope is planned, and that CO2 effects cannot yet be estimated.
In spring 2023 the House will be informed about the results of the study.
In het voorjaar van 2023 wordt uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de resultaten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over belemmeringen in het gebruik van elektrische voertuigen, terwijl we dit gebruik juist willen stimuleren

An MP asks the minister why electric vehicles that resemble cars or fall between existing categories face obstacles in licensing and fiscal support, despite government aims to promote their use. The minister replies that the vehicle-category system is complete with no gaps, explains the licence requirements per category, rejects reinstating VAMIL/MIA subsidies for L-category vehicles, and commits to advancing the LEV framework.
In this way we ensure road safety with a 'closed' system without intermediate categories falling outside laws or regulations.
Zodoende borgen we de verkeersveiligheid met een «sluitend» systeem zonder tussencategorieën die buiten wet- of regelgeving vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over de dreigende stop van nachttochten van watertaxi’s naar en tussen de Waddeneilanden

An MP asks the minister about the threatened end of night watertaxi services to and between the Wadden islands, given a 20 km/h night speed limit and the need for emergency exceptions. The minister explains the existing speed rules, the Natura 2000 permit route for faster night sailing, emergency exemptions, and ongoing talks with local authorities and operators, promising further work on exception practice.
At official level there has been contact with the municipality of Ameland, the province of Fryslân and the Safety Region Fryslân.
Er is op ambtelijk niveau contact geweest met de gemeente Ameland, de provincie Fryslân en de Veiligheidsregio Fryslân.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Bevers over het bericht dat er onrust is in de industriehaven van Harlingen omdat er miljoenen in de sluis Kornwerderzand worden geïnvesteerd maar dat vaargeul Boontjes mogelij

MPs Koerhuis and Bevers asked about reports that the Harlingen port fears the Boontjes fairway may silt up despite large investment in the Kornwerderzand lock, and about how the Boontjes was scored in the Integrale Mobiliteitsanalyse. The minister answered that the 3.8m NAP depth will be maintained until a decision in 2023 after evaluation with Fryslân and the Omgevingsberaad Wadden, that there is no direct link to the lock, and that the Boontjes is not a main waterway so was not analysed as a capacity bottleneck.
Until that decision has been taken, the depth of NAP-3.8m will in any case be maintained.
Tot dat dit besluit genomen is, zal in ieder geval de diepte van NAP-3,8m worden gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boulakjar en Wuite over de Nationale aanpak Klimaatadaptatie gebouwde omgeving fase 1

MPs Boulakjar and Wuite asked why the national climate adaptation approach for the built environment (phase 1) excludes the Caribbean Netherlands and its public bodies, and when a spatial development agenda for the islands will be sent to parliament. The minister answers that the strategy covers European Netherlands only, that the island bodies bear primary responsibility with national support, and that the spatial agenda will reach parliament in January 2023 and a programme after summer 2023.
That is why it was chosen to have the National Climate Adaptation Approach for the built environment also cover European Netherlands.
Daarom is er voor gekozen ook de Nationale aanpak Klimaatadaptatie gebouwde omgeving betrekking te laten hebben op Europees Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat Nelis uit De Lutte het verkeerslawaai van de A1 meer dan beu is

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a newspaper report that residents of De Lutte are fed up with traffic noise from the A1 motorway, and whether noise limits are being exceeded and whether Rijkswaterstaat should measure, act or work with the municipality of Losser. The minister replied that the noise production ceilings are not exceeded, that the monitoring reports are sent to parliament, that bronmaatregelen such as quieter asphalt would be considered if a breach threatened, and that joint action with the municipality is not currently needed.
The GPPs are not exceeded on the A1 at De Lutte.
De GPP's worden bij de A1 bij de Lutte niet overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de motie Koerhuis/Van der Molen om de ratificatie van het luchtvaartverdrag Qatar op te schorten

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management what suspending ratification of the EU-Qatar air transport agreement means in practice, given its provisional application, the additional Qatari flights and slot rights, and what legal options Netherlands has to suspend provisional application. The minister answered that the next ratification step is withheld pending the corruption investigation, that provisional application continues because suspension would expose the state to claims from Qatari airlines, and listed current flight frequencies.
In implementing the motion, this step will not be taken pending the corruption investigation.
Als invulling van de motie zal deze stap niet genomen worden in afwachting van het corruptieonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van der Molen over het bericht ‘Bruggen, viaducten en nu een aquaduct dicht: dat kan geen toeval zijn, denken transporteurs’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the closure of the Prinses Margriet tunnel on the A7, the risk of overlapping maintenance, regional nuisance, the state of Dutch infrastructure maintenance, and whether a national infrastructure safety coordinator should be appointed. The minister answered that the closure was an unforeseen calamity rather than neglected maintenance, that Rijkswaterstaat will report the cause to parliament, and that a national coordinator is not considered necessary.
Yes, I will inform the House as soon as possible once the cause is known.
Ja, ik zal de Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk informeren zodra de oorzaak bekend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Hoop over het bericht ‘Grondwater duwt weg omhoog, A7 tussen Joure en Sneek mogelijk maanden dicht’

An MP asks the minister about the closure of the A7 near Joure and Sneek after groundwater pressure damaged anchors holding the Prinses Margriet tunnel, asking the cause, repair time, and temporary solutions. The minister answers that the cause is not yet known, repair time cannot be given, Rijkswaterstaat is investigating and working with local authorities on detours and possible partial reopening.
The exact cause of the problem at the Prinses Margriet tunnel is not yet clear at this time.
De exacte oorzaak van het probleem bij de Prinses Margriettunnel is op dit moment nog niet duidelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Boswijk over de opkoop van boerderijen ten behoeve van de verbreding van de A27 bij Utrecht

MPs Grinwis and Boswijk asked whether the national government's buyout of farms for the A27 widening near Amelisweerd, and its use of nitrogen space, undermines provincial area processes, PAS-melder legalisation and fair rules on extern salderen. The minister denies any breach of inter-governmental agreements, rejects claims that Rijk buys nitrogen space for Schiphol, and announces tighter rules, a first-purchase right, a possible pre-emption right, a register of nitrogen banks and an independent enforcement study.

To prevent governments surprising each other, the national government and provinces have inter-governmental agreements on extern salderen, under which the Rijk informs provinces in advance of planned transactions.

Om te voorkomen dat overheden elkaar verrassen, hebben Rijk en provincies interbestuurlijke afspraken over extern salderen, waarbij is afgesproken dat het Rijk de provincies vooraf informeert over voorgenomen transacties op basis van extern salderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het rapporteren van luchtvaartemissies boven 3000 voet

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the Netherlands reports NOx emissions from aviation above 3,000 feet to the European Commission, whether the Commission challenged this, and whether it will start reporting them. The Minister answered that only LTO-cycle emissions are required under the NEC Directive, denied being challenged by the Commission, and said RIVM will begin registering these emissions from 2023 with a first report expected in 2024.
At the Ministry of I&W's request, RIVM will from 2023 map and register NOx emissions from air traffic above 3,000 feet in the Emission Registry.
Het RIVM zal, op verzoek van het Ministerie van IenW, vanaf 2023 de emissies NO X van vliegverkeer boven 3.000 in beeld brengen en registreren in de Emissieregistratie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over het bericht ‘Nieuwkoop roept bewoners op bezwaar te maken tegen extra nachtvluchten Schiphol’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about Nieuwkoop's call for residents to object to extra night flights at Schiphol due to temporary use of the Aalsmeer runway during Zwanenburg runway maintenance. The minister confirmed the nighttime use is limited to roughly 5 to 10 nights, that no talks with Nieuwkoop are planned, and that the consultation results will inform the final regulation and a review of runway maintenance rules, though the temporary regulation is maintained.
In light of the internet consultation, the approach to runway maintenance will be examined.
Mede naar aanleiding van de internetconsultatie zal naar de systematiek rond baanonderhoud worden gekeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen, Van Raan en Sylvana Simons over het bericht ‘Nederland doet te weinig om Bonaire te beschermen tegen bedreiging klimaatverandering’

MPs Teunissen, Van Raan and Simons asked whether the government will do enough to protect Bonaire, Saba and Sint Eustatius from climate change, citing a VU report, and questioned the lack of adaptation strategies, water safety standards and Rijk funding for the islands. The State Secretary replied that climate scenarios for the Caribbean Netherlands are being developed by KNMI with results expected end 2023, that the public bodies bear primary responsibility for adaptation with Rijk support in knowledge and tools, and that no specific Rijk adaptation programme or new funding is planned.
On the basis of the outcomes of these studies it will be determined in which area further research is needed.
Op basis van de uitkomsten van deze onderzoeken zal bepaald worden op welk vlak vervolgonderzoek nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over het bericht ‘Krimp Schiphol niet haalbaar, voorlopig meer vluchten dan gepland’

An MP asks why the government's target of reducing Schiphol to 440,000 flights for winter 2023/24 is not achieved and why residents learned this from news reports, and asks about delays in the balanced approach procedure, the nature-permit process and the CO2 cap. The minister answers that the information was already shared earlier, that anticipatory enforcement ends in November 2023, that the 440,000 cap is to be legally anchored by winter 2024/25 and that the timetable and a further update will follow in a separate progress letter.

For a full overview you are referred to the answers to the written consultation on the Schiphol main-lines letter of 29 September and the third progress letter on the Schiphol Airport Environment Programme of 16 December 2022.

Voor een volledig overzicht wordt u verwezen naar de beantwoording van het Schriftelijk Overleg Hoofdlijnenbrief Schiphol van 29 september jl. en de derde voortgangsbrief Programma Omgeving Luchthaven Schiphol van 16 december 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over het bericht 'Hong Kong’s Cathay Pacific to restart polar route flight path over Russia after it was axed in March because of invasion of Ukraine'.

An MP asked whether the Russian-airspace polar route used by non-sanctioning airlines creates unfair competition and safety risks, and whether the minister would ban its use and strengthen airspace risk management. The minister replied that Russia itself restricted access for airlines from listed sanctioning countries, that the EU ban covers only EU airspace, and that the government will not seek a ban or wider sanctions, while noting ICAO work on conflict-zone risks.
I cannot prohibit commercial airlines from countries that may still operate through Russian airspace from using the so-called polar route, because I have no legal powers to do so.

Ik kan commerciële luchtvaartmaatschappijen afkomstig uit landen die nog wel via het Russisch luchtruim mogen opereren niet verbieden om gebruik te maken van de zogenaamde «polar route», omdat ik daar geen juridische bevoegdheden toe heb.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de grootschalige vervuiling door het gebruik van scrubbers in de scheepvaart

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the minister, through about twenty-two questions, why open-loop scrubber wash water discharges into the North Sea are allowed, citing RIVM and other studies on pollution and acidification, and asks for an EU/IMO ban. The minister answers that the risks are known, that IMO discussions and a RIVM follow-up study due in 2023 will inform possible next steps, and that current discharge rules are enforced by the ILT.
National figures for the amount of sludge from exhaust gas cleaners (scrubber sludge) delivered each year to Dutch seaports are not known to me.
Landelijke cijfers voor de hoeveelheid slib afkomstig van rookgasreinigers (scrubber sludge) die jaarlijks in de Nederlandse zeehavens wordt afgegeven, zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Raan en Vestering over de Tijdelijke regeling groot onderhoud banenstelsel Schiphol 2023 en de natuurvergunning voor dit groot onderhoud

MPs Van Raan and Vestering asked whether Schiphol needed a nature permit for stikstof emissions from the 2023 runway maintenance, and questioned truck movements, weather risks, PFAS-contaminated soil, asphalt pollution and why traffic rules were relaxed instead of capacity cut. The minister answered nearly all questions by pointing to the pending nature-permit and enforcement request handled by the minister for Natuur en Stikstof, with substantive answers only on truck numbers, scheduling, PFAS handling and why capacity was not reduced.
Once a decision on the enforcement request has been taken, the Minister for Natuur en Stikstof will inform the House and answer questions 2 through 9.
Zodra een beslissing op het handhavingsverzoek is genomen, zal de Minister voor Natuur en Stikstof de Kamer daarover informeren en de vragen 2 tot en met 9 beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Stoffer over het bericht ‘Kwart van gecontroleerde truckers bij bloemenveiling Aalsmeer zit mogelijk met drugs op achter het stuur’

MPs Van der Staaij and Stoffer asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers about reports that a quarter of truck drivers checked at the Aalsmeer flower auction may have had drugs in their system, and about enforcement, sanctions and prevention. The government condemned drug driving, said enforcement is local and risk-based, described the testing and sanction process, and said no specific research into causes or public campaign was planned.
The police record information on individual suspects in the context of drug checks in traffic, not on occupational groups or vehicles.
De politie registreert informatie over de individuele verdachten in het kader van drugscontroles in het verkeer, niet over beroepsgroepen of voertuigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht “vragen over de motie-Koerhuis om de continuïteit van Groningen Airport Eelde te waarborgen’’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the motion to safeguard Groningen Airport Eelde's continuity, and about funding of ancillary costs (NEDAB) for regional airports, including Caribbean airports and Maastricht Aachen Airport. The minister replied that talks with the airport and provinces are ongoing, that the state does not fund airport operations, and that Caribbean airport funding and NEDAB costs fall outside national airport policy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over garanties om de Haringvlietbrug en de Heinenoordtunnel nooit tegelijk dicht te doen voor verkeer

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the Haringvlietbrug and Heinenoordtunnel can be guaranteed never to be closed to traffic at the same time, given the severe disruption this would cause. The minister guarantees they will not be closed simultaneously, sets out three risks and mitigation and fallback scenarios, and notes that the regional authorities were informed.
That is why the Haringvlietbrug and the Heinenoordtunnel will not be closed simultaneously.
Daarom zullen de Haringvlietbrug en de Heinenoordtunnel niet gelijktijdig afgesloten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Haverkort over het bericht dat Bouwend Nederland waarschuwt dat er gaten in de weg komen door een dreigende asfaltcrisis

Two VVD MPs asked whether the government would delay scrapping the approved measure for asphalt production, warning of asphalt shortages and effects on roads, circularity and costs. The Staatssecretaris answered that asphalt plants can meet the emission norms, so production will not stop, that the measure was withdrawn because it could not guarantee compliance, and that she will not relax the emission norms.
No, the approved measure has been withdrawn, see the answer to question 4.
Nee, de erkende maatregel is ingetrokken, zie antwoord onder vraag 4.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de beantwoording op de schriftelijke vragen over het bericht dat de vierbaans N18 waar 100 kilometer mag worden gereden blijft staan als piketpaal

An MP asks the minister to explain how the N18 can have low accident density but high monetised casualty risk, why its road-safety costs are low, what causes accidents between Varsseveld and Groenlo, what planned measures will achieve, and whether MIRT funds can be used. The minister answers that the criteria measure different things, identifies unregulated junctions as the main cause, lists planned junction and verge measures and existing funding, and confirms the answers will be provided before the MIRT meeting.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Madlener over het in Brussel bereikte principeakkoord over de uitfasering van de nieuwverkoop van personenvoertuigen en lichte bedrijfsvoertuigen met een interne verbrandingsmotor

PVV MPs Kops and Madlener asked the government to react to the EU agreement phasing out new petrol and diesel car sales by 2035 and to explain how ordinary motorists can keep driving and afford cars. State Secretary Heijnen defended the EU deal, said the 2035 phase-out does not ban existing cars, pointed to EV subsidies, a forthcoming IBO-klimaat review and studies of post-2025 scenarios, and did not accept the characterisations of policy as absurd.
Following the Bontenbal motion, I committed to the Chamber to develop scenarios for EV stimulation after 2025.
Naar aanleiding van de motie Bontenbal 2 heb ik de Kamer toegezegd om scenario’s voor EV-stimulering na 2025 uit te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over de verwerking van persoonsgegevens door vervoersbedrijven

MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked whether anonymous international train travel is practically impossible, who is responsible for processing passenger data, and why ticket counters are closing. The state secretary answered that anonymous travel is still possible to about 200 destinations, that there is no general legal duty on carriers to prevent anonymous travel, that the GDPR governs data processing with controllers identified per ticket sale, and that the number of international ticket counters fell from 10 to 5 with personal assistance offered elsewhere.
Providing personal data when travelling is not unusual.
Het afgeven van persoonsgegevens bij vervoer is niet ongebruikelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat burgemeesters strijd aanbinden tegen extreme hardrijders na dodelijk ongeval Oud Gastel

MPs asked whether mayors have adequate tools against extreme speeding drivers, including ANPR cameras, geotagging, licence withdrawal and vehicle seizure. The minister said existing tools suffice locally, ANPR cannot be used for repeat speeders for lack of legal basis, geotagging is used sparingly under Police Act art. 3, and licence and vehicle measures exist with data not separately recorded.
Figures on licence withdrawal for speeding are not recorded separately.
Cijfers over invordering van het rijbewijs voor te hard rijden worden niet apart geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat een taskforce een einde moet maken aan de Rijnbrug-impasse

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how the widening of the Rijnbrug at Rhenen can be called a provincial project when it is a national bridge, and whether a new administrative agreement or extra national funding is warranted given rising housing targets. The minister answers that the bridge is part of provincial road N233, that a national lump-sum contribution of EUR 40 million (2022 prices) has been agreed with the Foodvalley region, that the region carries the risks, and declines to commit to a new agreement or to shifting housing funds.
The widening can be carried out for EUR 120 million, with the agreement that the risks lie with the region.
De verbreding kan voor € 120 mln worden uitgevoerd, met de afspraak dat de risico’s bij de regio liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het feit dat sollicitanten niet op Schiphol worden aangenomen omdat zij te ver weg wonen

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether security firms at Schiphol reject applicants living too far away, and whether this is justified given staff shortages. The minister answered that firms weigh commute distance for continuity reasons, that exact numbers of rejected applicants cannot be obtained, and that the matter is the responsibility of the firms and Schiphol.
Exacte aantallen zijn niet te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Van der Molen over het artikel ‘Bestuurder scootmobiel raakt te water in Stadskanaal’

CDA MPs asked about rising scooter-mobility accidents, the SWOV safety recommendations, the relation between the Wegenverkeerswet and the Wmo, and mandatory training. The minister says reliable injury data are lacking, cites CBS fatality counts, says a new framework for mobility vehicles is being developed with SWOV and RDW input, and declines to make training mandatory.
There are no recent, reliable data available on the number of (seriously) injured traffic casualties among scooter-mobility users.
Er zijn geen recente, betrouwbare gegevens beschikbaar over het aantal (ernstig) verkeersgewonden onder scootmobielrijders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht 'Alles op alles voor verbreding A27'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether serious alternatives to widening the A27 that would spare the Amelisweerd nature area were ignored, including a 12-lane variant, and about the status of a regional alternative. The Minister replied that the 12-lane variants were studied but rejected for not giving a road-safety outcome, that the Schoof Commission reviewed the decision process, and that the region is preparing its own alternative in consultation with the ministry.
When the region has an alternative ready, we would gladly consult with the region, and we will continue to keep the House informed about the state of affairs.
Als de regio een alternatief gereed heeft, treden wij graag met hen in overleg en we zullen de Kamer blijven informeren over de stand van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de veiligheid van het knooppunt Empel

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about prior accidents at the Empel junction, what measures were taken since 2009, and whether the junction's safety would be investigated after a fatal crash. The minister acknowledged prior accidents, described signage and a 2021 guardrail addition, explained that the junction was not in the Meer Veilig priority programme and that guardrail extension would occur only at the next major reconstruction, and said RWS analyses fatal crashes and will inform Parliament if the police investigation reveals new road-design information.
Should new information emerge from the ongoing police investigation and/or the RWS accident analysis regarding the role of the road design in the accident, follow-up will of course be given.

Mocht uit het lopende politieonderzoek en/of de ongevalsanalyse van RWS nieuwe informatie komen met betrekking tot de rol van de weginrichting bij het ongeval, zal hier uiteraard opvolging aan gegeven worden.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over het 'kanaaldrama' bij het kanaal Almelo-De Haandrik

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about residents of the Almelo-De Haandrik canal whose homes were damaged and who feel compensation from the province of Overijssel is inadequate, asking about contacts, objections, the burden of proof and national intervention. The minister repeatedly declined substantive comment, stating that the canal is a provincial waterway managed by Overijssel and that the Rijk has no authority over it, while offering that the provincial deputy could brief the House on request.
Management of the Almelo-De Haandrik canal is in the hands of the province of Overijssel because it is a provincial waterway.
Het beheer van het kanaal Almelo-De Haandrik is in handen van de provincie Overijssel omdat het gaat om een provinciale vaarweg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht dat chemiefabriek Chemours maandenlang veel meer GenX in water loosde dan toegestaan

MPs Hagen and Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked whether Chemours discharged far more GenX into water than permitted, and whether monitoring data pointed to illegal discharges. Minister Harbers answered that the national monitoring data are not suited to attributing discharges to a single firm, that Chemours' permits allow 2 kg and 5 kg per year, and that enforcement was not possible because the source could not be identified.
None of these measurements show that Chemours exceeded the set GenX standard at the end of 2021.
Uit geen van deze metingen blijkt dat Chemours eind 2021 de gestelde norm voor GenX heeft overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de ongekende droogte en de rol van de landbouw

An MP asks the minister about irreversible drought damage to nature, water allocation priorities, irrigation bans, groundwater abstraction by farms, and fire risk in dune areas. The minister answers that the water allocation order is applied by water boards and provinces, that regional bans are a decentralised decision, and that groundwater measures are being prepared in regional programmes due in 2023.
Provinces can, through a provincial regulation, establish a priority order for groundwater (article 2.9 Water Act). No province has done so yet.
De provincies kunnen, via een provinciale verordening, een verdringingsreeks voor grondwater instellen (artikel 2.9 Waterwet). Dit heeft nog geen enkele provincie gedaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Wassenberg en Sylvana Simons over het volbouwen van de kust, zonder vergunningen op Bonaire, met bedreiging van het koraal tot gevolg, met actieve medewerking van de hoogste geza

MPs from PvdD and BIJ1 asked whether the appointed governor of Bonaire facilitated coastal construction without permits, threatening coral, and how enforcement and permitting are being strengthened. The government answered that the island council and executive are responsible for investigating, that it is reviewing staffing and rules (including a new environmental regulation), that the Inspectorate will audit permitting and enforcement, and that it has made arrangements to monitor implementation.
I have now asked the Inspectorate for Environment and Transport (ILT) to carry out an audit of permitting, supervision and enforcement.
Ik heb de Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) inmiddels gevraagd om een onderzoek (visitatie) te laten uitvoeren op het gebied van vergunningsverlening, toezicht en handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Hagen over aanspoelen stookolie langs de kust

Two MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about oil washing ashore along the Dutch coast, the timing of Rijkswaterstaat's response, cleanup, polluter liability, illegal bilge discharges, the revision of cleanup and bird-rescue arrangements after the MSC Zoe incident, volunteer involvement, and monitoring and Coast Guard capacity. The minister answered that cleanup and daily inspections were carried out, the polluter will be held liable once identified, the revised regulations are expected in the first half of 2023, and existing monitoring and equipment are sufficient.
Rijkswaterstaat acted immediately upon reports of washed-up oil pollution following the applied approach and launched an investigation into the extent of the pollution.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft direct na melding van aangespoelde olieverontreiniging ingegrepen volgens de gehanteerde aanpak
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over het bericht 'Verduurzaming van Europese luchtvaart bedreigd, blijkt uit nieuwe studie'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a study warning that scarce European feedstocks could limit sustainable aviation fuel and cut aviation emissions by only 40%, and about the implications for Dutch blending obligations, hydrogen aircraft certification and non-CO2 climate effects. The minister answered that feedstock availability is considered sufficient in principle, that the national 14% 2030 target stays, that a CO2 cap is being pursued, and that monitoring, a National Energy System Plan and further studies are planned.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management is currently commissioning research to map the specific hydrogen demand for aviation for 2030–2050.
Het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat laat op dit moment een onderzoek uitvoeren om de specifieke waterstofbehoefte voor luchtvaart 2030–2050 in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het plotseling afsluiten van afloopsteigers voor de binnenvaart bij Hansweert

An MP asked the minister why eleven of fourteen barge mooring and landing facilities at Hansweert were suddenly closed for overdue maintenance and why the shipping sector and province were not informed earlier. The minister answered that the structures are too corroded for temporary reopening, that the budget is insufficient, that closures cannot be ruled out elsewhere, and that stakeholders were informed from late May.
To prevent unsafe situations for users, it was decided in April 2022 that these jetties must be closed.
Om onveilige situaties voor gebruikers te voorkomen is in april 2022 besloten dat deze steigers moeten worden afgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over de bescherming van vangrails voor moderne auto’s

MP Madlener asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether guardrails on Dutch roads still meet current quality standards and whether they still protect modern heavier cars. The minister answered that Rijkswegen guardrails meet the current EN 1317-2 standard, that provincial roads are the responsibility of local road managers, and that no tightening of standards is planned.
Rijkswaterstaat has no information available on the quality of the guardrails on provincial roads.
Over de kwaliteit van de geleiderails op provinciale wegen heeft Rijkswaterstaat geen informatie beschikbaar.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over de stand van zaken met betrekking tot het voorstel van de leden Bromet en Tjeerd de Groot tot wijziging van de Waterschapswet, de Kieswet en de Algemene wet bestuursrecht in ver

An MP asked the minister about the status of the Bromet/De Groot bill to democratise water board elections and whether delays in its Eerste Kamer treatment would leave the 2023 water board elections without clarity or changes. The minister confirmed the 8 November plenary date, said clarity cannot yet be given, and noted that the law would need to be published by 1 December to apply to the 2023 registration deadlines, with current law applying otherwise.
By 4 November 2022 at the latest, the questions of the Eerste Kamer will be answered.
Uiterlijk 4 november 2022 zal op de vragen van de Eerste Kamer worden gereageerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van der Molen over het bericht ‘Grote zorgen Nederland over nieuwe Belgische bron PFAS-lozingen in Westerschelde’

Christian Democrat MP Van der Molen asked the minister about reports that Belgian Indaver emissions of PFAS are polluting the Westerschelde, including questions on responsibilities, licensing history and enforcement. The minister responded that a joint Dutch-Flemish approach is underway, that Flanders has tightened the emission limits, and that the ILT and Flemish authorities oversee waste transport and enforcement, with the matter to be monitored closely.
Flanders cannot unambiguously conclude from the licensing history that illegal PFAS discharges have taken place.
Vlaanderen kan vanuit de vergunningsgeschiedenis niet eenduidig concluderen dat er illegale PFAS-lozingen hebben plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh, Bromet en Ellemeet over het PFAS-schandaal

MPs Bouchallikh, Bromet and Ellemeet asked the government about the PFAS contamination scandal, including breast milk levels near Dordrecht, the export of PFAS waste to Antwerp, Rijkswaterstaat permits for PFOA and GenX discharges, and the EU-wide PFAS ban. The state secretary answered all twelve questions in substance, defending existing health norms, the permitting framework and the planned EU restriction, while promising further study of exposure routes.
For a number of pending export permit applications, the ILT has requested additional information from the notifiers and the Flemish authorities.
Voor een aantal lopende aanvragen voor exportvergunningen heeft de ILT aanvullende informatie opgevraagd bij de kennisgevers en de Vlaamse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Tjeerd de Groot over nieuwe risicogrenzen voor PFAS in oppervlaktewater

MPs Hagen and Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked about new RIVM risk limits for PFAS in surface water and their consequences for the Hedwige polder de-embankment and the Westerschelde. The minister confirmed the new limits, said a decision on adopting them as norms is still pending, and maintained that PFAS levels do not obstruct the nature goals of the de-embankment.
I will, partly on the basis of RIVM's advice, decide whether the PFAS standards for surface water need to be adjusted.
Ik zal mede op basis van het advies van het RIVM een besluit nemen of de normen voor PFAS in oppervlaktewater aangepast moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht 'Rijkswaterstaat drukt damwanden door in Zwarte Water'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about Rijkswaterstaat's plan to drive steel sheet piles into the Zwarte Water, covering the purpose, alternatives, groundwater and boating effects, the consultation process and the handling of objections. The Minister replied that the piles create low-flow zones to improve fish stocks, that alternatives were examined, that a nature test found no groundwater effects, and that objectors may use legal remedies.
I am of the view that Rijkswaterstaat went through a balanced process with stakeholders, in which the concerns were properly assessed in arriving at the proposed plan.
Ik ben van mening dat Rijkswaterstaat een afgewogen proces met belanghebbende partijen heeft doorlopen, waarbij de zorgen goed zijn beoordeeld in het komen tot het voorgestelde plan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over de Zembla uitzending van 9 september 2022 over PFAS

An MP asked the ministers about a Zembla broadcast on PFAS contamination in the Westerschelde, Indaver's discharge permits, Dutch objections to Flemish permits, and contacts with Flanders. The minister answered that the VU study's breast milk conclusions were wrong, that Indaver now complies with tightened limits, that Rijkswaterstaat advised Flanders in writing, and that a national health study will be announced.
Rijkswaterstaat sent letters on my behalf to the Antwerp city council and the Flemish Department of the Environment.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft namens mij brieven verzonden aan het college van burgemeester en schepenen en het Vlaams departement Omgeving
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de berichtgeving omtrent arbeidsomstandigheden bagageafhandelaars Schiphol

An ChristenUnie MP asked ministers about reports that Schiphol baggage handlers exceeded occupational exposure limits for years while the Labour Inspectorate did not inspect them for about twelve years, and about how self-regulation and self-inspection tools work. The minister responded that the employer bears primary responsibility, that the inspectorate tests sector codes but not individual firms, that inspections are being carried out after recent media reports with results pending, and that the inspectorate's capacity allocation and the evaluation of self-regulation will be reviewed.
I have asked the Labour Inspectorate to examine whether improvements are possible.
Ik heb de Arbeidsinspectie gevraagd te bezien of er verbeteringen mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Van der Molen over het bericht 'Arbonormen bagagepersoneel Schiphol jarenlang overschreden, deel heeft gezondheidsklachten'

MPs Palland and Van der Molen (CDA) asked the ministers of Social Affairs, Infrastructure and Finance about reports that baggage handling staff at Schiphol worked beyond Arbo limits for years and that the Labour Inspectorate had not inspected these firms for twelve years. The government replied that employers bear primary responsibility, that the Inspectorate has started investigations and will report further, and that sector CAO, access restrictions on handlers and talks with Schiphol and KLM are underway.
I have asked the Labour Inspectorate to examine whether improvements are possible. Parliament will be informed further on this.
Ik heb de Arbeidsinspectie gevraagd te bezien of er verbeteringen mogelijk zijn. Hierover wordt uw Kamer nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en De Hoop over de arbeidsvoorwaarden en arbeidsomstandigheden bij bagagepersoneel op Schiphol

MPs Alkaya and De Hoop asked ministers whether baggage staff at Schiphol had for years been required to lift beyond health limits despite a 2009 inspection demand, and what the government would do. The ministers answered that the employers are primarily responsible, that the Labour Inspectorate has launched inspections and will report, and that Schiphol and the ministries are pressing for structural improvements including limiting the number of handlers, though no independent new investigation will be set up.
The Minister of SZW sees no reason to set up a new independent investigation on top of everything already underway.
De Minister van SZW ziet geen aanleiding om naast alles wat nu al loopt een nieuw onafhankelijk onderzoek in te stellen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts, Podt en Boucke over de berichten 'Inspectie controleerde twaalf jaar niet op Schiphol' en 'Schiphol geeft toe: we hadden te weinig oog voor arbeidsomstandigheden'

D66 MPs asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and of Infrastructure about press reports that the labour inspectorate did not inspect physical workload at Schiphol baggage handling for twelve years and that many workers became incapacitated. The government answered that employers bear primary responsibility, the Inspectorate has started an investigation and will report on its past inspections at Schiphol, and it committed to talks with Schiphol and KLM and to a site visit in November.
Following the press reports, the Labour Inspectorate has meanwhile started an investigation into the situation of baggage staff at Schiphol.
De Arbeidsinspectie is, naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving, inmiddels een onderzoek gestart naar de situatie bij het bagagepersoneel op Schiphol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Maatoug over de arbonormen van het bagagepersoneel op Schiphol

GroenLinks MPs Kröger and Maatoug asked the ministers about occupational health standards for Schiphol baggage handlers, why the labour inspectorate had not inspected since 2009, and whether Schiphol and the handling firms should compensate workers. The ministers answered that the inspectorate has started an investigation, that employers bear primary responsibility, that Schiphol should take a larger role and is pursuing a social accord, and that compensation is a matter between workers and employers.
The Minister of SZW has asked the Labour Inspectorate to consider whether improvements are possible.
De Minister van SZW heeft de Arbeidsinspectie gevraagd te bezien of er verbeteringen mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het artikel “Steeds meer 70-plussers onder verkeersdoden op de fiets”

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about rising cycling deaths among people over 70, including whether e-bikes explain the trend and whether e-bike crashes should be better registered. The minister rejected the e-bike causation claim, said police and ambulance registration of e-bike crashes is being improved, and pointed to ongoing road safety programmes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Bontenbal over de stijging van het aantal korte vluchten van en naar Nederlandse luchthavens

MPs Van der Molen and Bontenbal asked the government about the rise in short private and government flights from Dutch airports, including whether cabinet members set an example and whether flights without passengers can be curbed. Minister Harbers answered that government has no control over private flights, that a cabinet-wide guideline on short government flights is being drafted, and that no legal basis or policy exists to restrict specific flights, though the impact on climate will be examined.
Furthermore, research has started into establishing an interdepartmental guideline regulating the use of the government aircraft for short flights and/or repositioning flights.
Verder is een onderzoek gestart naar de realisatie van een interdepartementale richtlijn, die het gebruik van het regeringsvliegtuig voor korte vluchten en/of positioneringsvluchten reguleert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Van den Hil over het bericht 'Kwart Zeeuwse waterkeringen voldoet niet aan veiligheidsnorm'

MPs Minhas and Van den Hil asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that a quarter of Zeeland's flood defences fail the safety standard, the expected 1.5 billion euro reinforcement cost, cost sharing between the state and water boards, and how completion by 2050 and sea-level rise will be ensured. The minister confirmed the assessments are still ongoing, with results due end 2023, cost estimates are not yet firm, cost sharing follows the Water Act, and the programme and Water Act evaluation will address funding adequacy.
The House will, in line with the law and earlier commitments, be informed at the end of 2023 about the national results of these assessments.
De Kamer wordt, conform de wet en eerdere toezeggingen, eind 2023 over de landelijke uitkomsten van deze beoordelingen geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over de VN-conferentie over het wereldzeeënverdrag

MPs Wassenberg and Teunissen asked how the Netherlands is pushing, at the UN conference on the high seas treaty (BBNJ), for ambitious and effective marine protection, including binding area-based measures, mandatory environmental impact assessments and a scientific body. The minister replied that the EU and member states negotiate with one voice, that no agreement was reached on the full package in August 2022, and that the Netherlands supports binding area protection, mandatory EIAs with a two-tiered threshold approach, and access and benefit sharing for marine genetic resources.
The Netherlands, together with the EU and the other member states, will again actively work toward finalising an effective and future-proof treaty at the next UN conference.
Nederland, gezamenlijk met de EU en de andere lidstaten, zal zich tijdens de volgende VN-conferentie wederom actief inzetten voor de afronding van een effectief en toekomstbestendig verdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Van Esch en Vestering over de mogelijke bouw van huizen ten kosten van waardevolle natuur op Bonaire

MPs from the Party for the Animals asked whether housing construction on Plantage Bolivia on Bonaire, a valuable nature area, can be prevented and how the zoning plan and intent agreement are handled. The minister answered that the island authority is responsible for the zoning plan, that the current zoning protects the area, and that the national government will review any draft plan and can issue a reactive direction if needed.
Once the (draft) plan has been released, it will be assessed by the national government and a response will be given.
Nadat het (voor)ontwerp is vrijgegeven, zal dit door het Rijk worden beoordeeld en zal daarop worden gereageerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over de dreigende overschrijding van handhavingspunten op Rotterdam The Hague Airport

MP Boucke (D66) asked how a possible exceedance of noise enforcement points at Rotterdam The Hague Airport would affect commercial, police and trauma helicopter flights, and whether emergency services should get a separate noise allowance. Minister Harbers answered that the airport and its users must keep flights within limits, that a separate allowance for emergency and police flights is not yet legally possible but is planned in the Luchthavenbesluit, and that the effects of restrictions on trauma and police helicopters cannot yet be stated.
There is no decision: as indicated in the letter of 12 September, creating a separate noise allowance for emergency medical services and police tasks is currently not legally possible.

Er is geen sprake van een besluit: zoals in de brief van 12 september jl. aangegeven, is het creëren van een aparte gebruiksruimte voor geluid voor spoedeisende hulpverlening en politietaken op dit moment juridisch niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het KiM rapport ‘De zakelijke reiziger centraal’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a KiM report and UK and German evidence on frequent flyer programmes, including how many extra flights and emissions they cause, whether points should be taxed, and their climate impact. The minister answered that the extra flights and emissions are unknown, that the Finance Minister is responsible for taxing points, and that the government sees no need to make these programmes less attractive, while promising to answer for the next aviation debate.
How many additional flights to and from the Netherlands, and how much emissions, are caused by frequent flyer programmes is unknown.
Hoeveel extra vluchten van en naar Nederland en hoeveel uitstoot wordt veroorzaakt door frequent flyer programma’s is onbekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Bevers over het bericht 'Bereikbaarheid Ameland op het spel: boot te vaak te laat'

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary and minister about reports that the Ameland ferry is often late, threatening reliability and accessibility before the storm season. The ministers answered that Rijkswaterstaat is studying long-term solutions for the period after 2030, with a decision expected in 2023, while acknowledging ferry delays caused largely by silting of the shipping channel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over privéjachten en privévliegtuigen naar aanleiding van de artikelen ‘The huge impact of private jets’ en ‘Superyachs symbolize climate breakdown’

An MP asked the minister about the large climate impact of private jets and superyachts, the low taxation of private aviation, and possible tax avoidance through charter structures. The government answered that it pursues international rules and EU measures such as the Fit for 55 package, that Dutch influence is limited because superyachts are foreign-owned and registered abroad, and that it will push for stricter international regulation rather than bilateral action with Malta.
That is why I focus my efforts on making ambitious international agreements.
Daarom richt ik mijn inzet op het maken van ambitieuze internationale afspraken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat de verdachte van het drama in Oud Gastel in een huurauto reed en West-Brabantse burgemeesters verontwaardigd zijn over ‘jonge mannen die keihard rijden’

An MP asked the minister whether the fatal Oud Gastel crash involving a driver in a rented car, and mayors' calls to tackle young speeders in rented cars, reflect a growing trend, and what measures exist or are planned. The minister answered that rental status is not recorded in accident or offence data, so no trend can be established, outlined existing risk-based enforcement and planned educational measures, and pointed to the local security triangle for additional local action.
These registrations do not distinguish between rented and non-rented cars.
In deze registraties wordt geen onderscheid gemaakt tussen gehuurde auto's en niet-gehuurde auto's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en De Graaf over de opkoop van stikstofruimte uit boerderijen ten behoeve van het verbreden van de A27 bij Amelisweerd

MPs Grinwis and De Graaf asked why the government bought nitrogen emission rights from eight farms to enable widening the A27 at Amelisweerd, questioning the fairness, prices, procedure and consistency with other sectors and policy. The minister defended the approach as voluntary, lawful and conforming to inter-governmental agreements, withheld purchase prices as commercially sensitive, and said no policy change occurred.
The amounts stated in the agreement are sensitive information that affects the State's negotiating position.
De in de overeenkomst genoemde bedragen betreffen gevoelige informatie die de onderhandelingspositie van de Staat raakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat heel Schiphol sinds 2008 onrechtmatig in bedrijf is

An MP asked whether the 2008 Schiphol airport traffic decree (LVB) was lawfully adopted, given reports that no complete appropriate assessment of nitrogen effects on Natura 2000 areas was carried out, and what this means for the airport's current operation. The minister answers that the decree was lawfully adopted and remains in force, that Schiphol must now apply for a nature permit which is under way, and rejects claims of deliberate illegal operation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het bericht dat autofabrikanten alleen nog grote auto’s willen bouwen

Two Party for the Animals MPs asked whether car manufacturers are only building large, heavy cars and whether this conflicts with space, energy, circularity and emissions goals. The State Secretary disagreed with the framing, argued electric cars are more efficient despite their weight, pointed to innovation in batteries and to policies promoting cycling, public transport and shared mobility.
I recognise the picture. Cars have become heavier for several reasons.
Ik herken het beeld. Auto's zijn om verschillende redenen zwaarder geworden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over het artikel 'Nederlands datacenter Microsoft verbruikte vier keer meer water dan gedacht'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that a Microsoft data centre used four times more drinking water for cooling than previously stated, and what this means for water scarcity and environmental discharge. The minister called drinking-water use for cooling undesirable, said the drinking-water utility decides on supply, and pointed to existing policy on 'the right water for the right use' and strict regulation of hyperscale data centres.
The drinking-water company (PWN) does not provide information on the drinking-water use of individual companies.
Over het drinkwatergebruik van individuele bedrijven wordt door het betrokken drinkwaterbedrijf (PWN) geen informatie verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over het bericht ’Minder vluchten en toch nieuwbouw’

An MP asked the minister whether Schiphol's plans for a new Terminal Zuid, a tender consultation, signal growth despite the 440,000 flight movement cap, and questioned the scrapping of staff summer bonuses, stikstof permits and any growth ambitions. The minister answered that no investment decision has been taken, that the tender was a market consultation, that the need for the terminal will be reassessed after the cap, and that the cap will be anchored through further steps.
Should Schiphol want to invest in a new terminal, the planned investment decision will have to be approved by Schiphol's shareholders, because it is a large investment.

Mocht Schiphol willen investeren in een nieuwe terminal dan zal het voorgenomen investeringsbesluit moeten worden goedgekeurd door de aandeelhouders van Schiphol, omdat het om een grote investering gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht dat de aanpak van de fileknelpunten op de A4 op de lange baan is geschoven

An MP asks whether the A4 Leidschendam-Leimuiden widening, and other A4 bottlenecks, are being postponed because too few experts are available for nitrogen calculations, and whether compensation is due to the flower sector. The minister confirms the project is delayed, explains prioritisation between projects and mobility measures, and says compensation is not appropriate because capacity is not reduced.
The project will be delayed more than the priority projects.
Het project zal meer vertraging oplopen dan bij de prioritaire projecten het geval is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de mogelijke komst van de Noordtak Betuweroute en de druk op de (groene) ruimte in bredere zin in Twente en de Achterhoek

An MP asks the government about public opposition to a proposed Noordtak rail line through Twente and the Achterhoek, its legal status, the pressure on rural space, and whether cheaper alternatives such as inland shipping should replace it. The Staatssecretaris answers that a joint options paper found the need for a new freight route not yet established, that the line is far from certain, and that further study with stakeholders will follow before conclusions are drawn.
I will discuss with stakeholders what exactly still needs to be investigated and how we will do this.
Ik zal met belanghebbenden bespreken wat er precies nog verder moet worden onderzocht en hoe we dit gaan doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over de 'Hoofdlijnenbrief Schiphol' van 24 juni 2022

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the 24 June 2022 Schiphol main-lines letter, questioning the abandonment of a legally fixed maximum of flight movements, the number of night flights, the legal basis for the new capacity regime, and individual legal protection of residents. The minister answered that a 440,000 movement cap will be fixed in an amended Luchthavenverkeerbesluit, anticipatory enforcement will end, night flights will fall to 29,000, and that a study of residents' legal protection and a proposal to bring LVB appeals before the administrative court are planned.
The new maximum of 440,000 aircraft movements will be laid down in an amendment to the Schiphol Airport Traffic Decree (LVB).
Het nieuwe maximum van 440.000 vliegtuigbewegingen wordt vastgelegd in een wijziging van het Luchthavenverkeerbesluit (LVB) Schiphol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Kops over de dieselvoorraad in Nederland

MPs Madlener and Kops asked the government about diesel and other fuel stocks in the Netherlands, the risk of shortages if Russian oil is boycotted, and crisis plans, including bunker supplies for shipping. The minister answers that strategic stocks still cover about 85 days of domestic demand, that restocking is starting, that the Landelijk Crisisplan Olie is being updated, and that import data is publicly available.
At this moment, the restocking and expansion of these strategic stocks is being started.
Op dit moment wordt gestart met het opnieuw aanvullen en uitbreiden van deze strategische voorraden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de Visserij

An MP asked the minister why Dutch fishing vessels cannot recruit foreign fishers through bilateral STCW-F recognition agreements, and whether agreements with Poland, Lithuania and Portugal will be concluded quickly. The minister acknowledges the shortage and the difficulty of such agreements, but offers only a prioritisation process with the sector and a plan to assess training quality by early next year.
I am therefore in discussion with the sector about which countries could be given priority in reaching bilateral agreements.
Met de sector ben ik daarom in gesprek over welke landen prioriteit zouden kunnen krijgen bij het komen tot bilaterale overeenkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Werf over de gevaren die boeren op snelwegen veroorzaken

An MP asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers about dangers caused by farmers blocking motorways during a June 2022 protest and why police did not enforce more strictly, including how many fines and arrests occurred. The minister acknowledged accidents and dangers, explained police discretion and that offences are pursued afterwards, reported roughly 700 extra fines and over a hundred arrests, and set out advisory principles for local authorities, while admitting Rijkswaterstaat and police do not track the number of tractors or drivers involved.
Rijkswaterstaat does not have a system in place to collect that information.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft namelijk geen systeem waarmee die informatie wordt verzameld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Dassen, Azarkan en van der Plas over de stukken van de aandeelhoudersvergadering van 2022 van Schiphol

MPs Omtzigt, Dassen, Azarkan and Van der Plas asked why the government refused to share the minutes and documents of Schiphol's 2022 shareholders' meeting, and how parliament can scrutinise the state's shareholder role. Minister Kaag answered that the minutes are confidential business information, provided a summary of operational challenges, promised confidential inspection of the draft minutes, and said parliament has no power to review individual shareholder meetings.
The report of the General Meeting of Shareholders (including the relevant documents) is classified as commercially confidential information and therefore cannot be shared with your House.
Het verslag van de Algemene Vergadering van Aandeelhouders (inclusief de relevante stukken) wordt aangemerkt als bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie en kan daarom niet worden gedeeld met uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het bericht dat er 8 olietankers met Russische fossiele brandstof op weg zijn naar de havens van Rotterdam en Amsterdam

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether eight tankers carrying Russian fossil fuels bound for Rotterdam and Amsterdam could be refused entry, and whether the government would act against such vessels. The government answered that Dutch law under current EU sanctions does not allow refusal of non-Russian-flagged tankers, that an EU oil import ban will take effect after transition periods, and that it has no further legal grounds to block the ships.
At present it is not possible for the government to refuse non-Russian-flagged ships carrying Russian oil products.
Van regeringswege is het op dit moment niet mogelijk om niet-Russisch gevlagde schepen met Russische olie(producten) te weren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de vergunningverlening aan Chogogo Resort

MP Van Esch asked the ministers about the permitting of Chogogo Dive & Beach Resort on Bonaire, including whether conditions on a seawall were met, the enforcement memo, a fine for unpermitted sand dumping, and oversight of nearby developments. The Staatssecretaris answered that the authority believes the seawall conditions are met and is legalising the existing wall, that the enforcement memo and related documents will be shared, and that enforcement and VTH capacity on Bonaire will be strengthened with a monitoring plan and checks and balances.
I am willing to share all information with the House and am also willing to have it assessed by experts if necessary.
Ik ben bereid om alle informatie met de Kamer te delen en ben ook bereid deze zonodig te laten beoordelen door experts.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Haverkort en Koerhuis over het bericht dat chemisch afval massaal wordt gebruikt als scheepsbrandstof

MPs Haverkort and Koerhuis asked the government about reports that chemical waste is being mixed into marine fuel, including questions on enforcement, EU waste definitions and the financial incentive to mix waste. The State Secretary and Minister mostly deferred substantive answers to a promised letter to parliament on ILT enforcement results, while describing existing REACH, MARPOL and Dutch fuel rules.
The further answering of these questions will address existing regulations and efforts, pending the results of the commitments being carried out.
De verdere beantwoording van deze vragen zal ingaan op bestaande regelgeving en inzet, in afwachting van de resultaten van de in uitvoering zijnde toezeggingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Van Esch over oeverbeschoeiing die behandeld is met een kankerverwekkende stof

MPs Vestering and Van Esch asked about roughly 245 km of riverbank piling in the Noordoostpolder treated with carcinogenic creosote, exceedances of fluoranthene norms, and whether such piling should be banned or replaced by 2027. The minister answered that the fluoranthene norm must be met by 2033, that creosote piling is largely replaced and no structural exceedances are known, and that alternatives are in use, while the water board has not yet decided on replacement.
The water board has not yet taken a decision on this.
Het waterschap heeft hierover nog geen besluit genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het plan om af te willen van overstappassagiers op Schiphol

An MP asked the minister whether his reported plan to phase out cheap transfer passengers at Schiphol was government policy, and how it fits the coalition agreement's hub ambition, with nine questions in total. The minister denied it is official policy, said he only noted higher costs and a shift toward quality, and reaffirmed commitment to Schiphol's hub function, while promising to clarify the position with KLM.
No, the position expressed in the Bloomberg interview is neither my own position nor an official cabinet position.
Nee, het standpunt dat wordt verwoord in het Bloomberg-interview is noch mijn eigen standpunt, noch een officieel kabinetsstandpunt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de problematische renovatie van het Rijkswaterstaatkantoor in Utrecht

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked about defects in the renovation of the Rijkswaterstaat office in Utrecht, including broken windows, a leaking pond, total costs and who bore responsibility. The minister answered that the windows posed no safety risk, that costs were around 8.2 million euro after updated figures, and that the Chamber was informed through the regular process, while declining to itemise costs per defect due to confidential contractor repair costs.
The repair costs incurred by the building consortium are not public in accordance with the WOB decision reference 4279186 dated 4 April 2022 concerning the Westraven government office.
De herstelkosten die de bouwcombinatie heeft gemaakt, zijn niet openbaar conform het WOB besluit kenmerk 4279186 d.d. 4 april 2022 inzake het rijkskantoor Westraven.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Koerhuis over de Rijnbrug Rhenen taskforce

An MP asked the minister whether the national government would contribute the remaining 80 million euros to widening the Rijnbrug between Rhenen and Kesteren, given its traffic importance and new national funding. The minister replied that the bridge is a provincial project outside the national main road network, the Rijk has no financial role under a 2012 agreement, and it will not contribute.
I have no insight into the updated estimate and budget of the project.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de geactualiseerde raming en het budget van het project.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over ziekmakende cabinelucht in vliegtuigen

MP Van Esch asks the ministers whether toxic cabin air in aircraft is making crew ill, whether standards, sensors, bleed-air bans, Arbeidsinspectie action, and monitoring of occupational diseases are adequate, and questions the independence of the FACTS research. The ministers reply that the cause of the complaints is still unclear, that the NAC advises on the issue, that standards and follow-up research are underway with Dutch participation, and that the Arbeidsinspectie sees no current reason to intervene, while committing to no new concrete measures.
According to the NAC, the cause of the complaints is not clear.
De oorzaak van de klachten is volgens de NAC niet duidelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Chroom 6 aangetroffen in grondwater bij Tata Steel’

An SP MP asked the ministers about reported chromium-6 contamination of groundwater at Tata Steel, the lack of health protection, the implementation of a motion on health gains, the smoke incident, the timeline for sustainability agreements, and subsidies. The government answered that the GGD sees no health risk because there is no exposure, that the environmental service has ordered follow-up research and tightened permits, and that binding maatwerk agreements depend on a complete business case, so no firm timeline is given.
However, I will not make concessions on a careful assessment of the business case; I will not take irresponsible risks with taxpayers' money.
Ik ga echter geen concessies doen aan een zorgvuldige beoordeling van de business case, ik ga geen onverantwoorde risico's nemen met belastinggeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Kröger over een reis per vliegtuig m.b.t. het staatsbezoek van de Koning en Koningin aan Oostenrijk

GroenLinks MPs asked why the royal state visit to Austria used a plane rather than a train, whether the royal carriage could be used for international rail travel, and how this fits sustainable transport policy. The minister replied that a train took over 12 hours versus about 1.5 hours by plane, that trains are considered but not always suitable, and that the royal carriage is already internationally approved and was last used abroad years ago.
For the route from the Netherlands to Austria, the train unfortunately was not (yet) a full alternative.
Voor het traject van Nederland naar Oostenrijk bleek de trein helaas (nog) geen volwaardig alternatief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie bereid is derogaties toe te staan van milieuvereisten uit het Gemeenschappelijk Landbouwbeleid (GLB)

An MP from D66 asked the agriculture minister whether the Netherlands will use EU derogations from Common Agricultural Policy environmental conditions (GLMC 7 and 8a) to protect food security, and what the expected effects on water, soil, nitrogen and nature are. The minister answered that the Netherlands will apply the derogation to ensure a level playing field and give farmers more time, that environmental ambitions remain unchanged over the full CAP period, and that no new environmental impact assessment was made.
I have decided that the Netherlands will use this derogation option to ensure a level playing field within the EU
Ik heb besloten als Nederland gebruik te maken van deze mogelijkheid tot derogatieverlening uit hoofde van het waarborgen van een gelijk speelveld binnen de EU
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de belasting op leidingwater

An MP from DENK asked ministers whether the leidingwaterbelasting (tap water levy) is too favourable to large water users, since a capped levy gives them little incentive to save water, and whether raising it for large firms would help. The minister confirmed the levy's capped structure, acknowledged reduced incentives for large users, said a raise combined with a higher cap could promote saving, and promised to inform parliament in the autumn after an ongoing study.
A study is underway into measures and instruments to promote water saving by households and businesses.
Er loopt een onderzoek naar de maatregelen en instrumenten om waterbesparing door huishoudens en bedrijven te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Vierbaans N18 waar 100 km mag worden gereden blijft staan als piketpaal’

MP Koerhuis asked the minister why the N18 remains a single-carriageway road in parts despite a newsreport about four-lane demands, and about the IMA scores and criteria used. Minister Harbers answered that the 2018 N18 upgrade met safety and liveability goals, that a full 2x2 widening lacks priority and regional benefit, and that the IMA shows no major network bottlenecks, so no full widening is currently planned.
At present no area-based or network-based bottlenecks or challenges have been identified that would give cause to widen the entire N18 to a 2x2 road.
Op dit moment zijn er geen gebiedsgerichte of netwerkgerichte knelpunten of opgaven vastgesteld die aanleiding geven om de N18 in het geheel tot een 2x2 weg te verbreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de helmplicht voor snorfietsers

An MP from GroenLinks asks why the government did not adopt SWOV's advice to permit only the motorcycle helmet for snorfiets riders, and questions the safety, enforcement and effects of allowing the speed-pedelec helmet. The minister defends allowing the speed-pedelec helmet on TNO research, says enforcement is feasible, and rejects delaying the rule.
Permitting the speed-pedelec helmet for the snorfiets rider is a well-considered choice based on thorough TNO research into road safety.
Het toestaan van de speed-pedelec-helm voor de snorfietser is een weloverwogen keuze op basis van gedegen onderzoek door TNO naar de verkeersveiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het aantal toegenomen vluchten op Rotterdam The Hague Airport

An MP asked the minister about a sudden increase in flights and noise at Rotterdam The Hague Airport, including whether the airport took over Schiphol flights and whether noise limits and compensation were respected. The minister answered that unused winter slot capacity was shifted to summer without changing total annual capacity, that a prompted reversal was made to avoid exceeding a noise enforcement point, and that the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport supervises compliance, with a new airport decision targeted for 2024.
It is the responsibility of the airport to remain within the norms set in the Omzettingsregeling.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de luchthaven om binnen de normen te blijven die in de Omzettingsregeling zijn gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat veteranen niet naar de herdenking van WOII kunnen gaan door Schiphol-chaos en corona

MP Koerhuis (VVD) asked whether twelve WWII veterans were unable to attend a commemoration because of Schiphol chaos and COVID, and what would be done to guarantee their travel next month.
