Minister Harbers said Schiphol and the KMAR were unaware of the request because it was filed differently than usual, regretted the miscommunication, agreed arrangements to prevent recurrence, and noted the organiser had cancelled the trip, so no further action was taken on that trip.
Schiphol and the KMAR contacted the organiser, explained the situation and made arrangements for the future to prevent a repetition.
Schiphol en de KMAR hebben contact opgenomen met de organisator en de situatie uitgelegd en afspraken gemaakt voor de toekomst om herhaling te voorkomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het toeslagenschandaal op het gebied van hardheden en d

The SP MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked the Prime Minister and the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management which measures the ministry has taken after the childcare benefits scandal on harsh rules and information management, including inventories of harsh legislation, methods used, new-proposal safeguards, chat-message retention and FOI request backlogs. The minister answered that each department is conducting an inventory of harsh regulations under the Ploumen/Jetten motion, referred to letters and annexes for timelines and methods, said chat messages need only be kept when the decision is not recorded elsewhere, and provided a FOI overview in an annex.
To implement the Ploumen/Jetten motion, each department is conducting an inventory of laws and regulations that turn out harshly for people.
1 , 2 , 3 Antwoord 1 Ter uitvoering van de motie Ploumen/Jetten 4 verricht elk departement een inventarisatie naar wet- en regelgeving die hardvochtig uitpakt voor mensen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts, Podt en Boucke over het artikel 'Op de banenmarkt van Schiphol voelen werkzoekenden zich ‘heel speciaal’ – mits ze uit Nederland komen'

MPs from D66 asked the ministers whether the government shares a newspaper's claim that only people resident in the Netherlands for eight years can obtain a security clearance (VGB) for Schiphol jobs, and how employers' misconceptions could be addressed. The minister denies any legal eight-year rule, explains that the Wvo has no nationality or residence requirement but foreign stays can lengthen screening, and promises to raise the issue with Schiphol and employers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh, Bromet en Kröger over het bericht dat Nederland geen gezonde leefomgeving biedt aan kinderen

MPs Bouchallikh, Bromet and Kröger asked the government about a UNICEF report finding that the Netherlands does not offer children a healthy living environment, covering air pollution, energy poverty, breakfast, noise, lead, pesticides and damp/mould. The government replied that the situation is not 'very worrying' but that there are attention points, pointed to the forthcoming National Environmental Programme, the Clean Air Agreement, energy allowances, lead-pipe measures and a broad mould-prevention approach, and promised to answer each question individually.
For that reason I would not call the situation in the Netherlands very worrying, although there are certainly points of attention that the Netherlands wants to address.
Om die reden zou ik de situatie in Nederland niet zeer zorgelijk willen noemen, al zijn er zeker aandachtspunten waar Nederland een been bij wil trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het Unicef-rapport 'Places and Spaces. Environments and Childrens Well-Being'

An MP asked the government how it responds to a UNICEF report showing the Netherlands scores poorly on children's environments (pesticide exposure, noise, global environmental impact) and what actions, monitoring and UN resolution follow-up it will take. The minister answered at length, outlining existing measures on pesticides, noise, air quality, lead, damp/mould and monitoring, and stated the government is not in favour of a separate integrated child-environment monitor.
For that reason, the cabinet is not in favour of an additional specific integrated monitoring of the quality of the living environment for children.
Om die reden is het kabinet geen voorstander van een aanvullende specifieke integrale monitoring van de kwaliteit van de leefomgeving voor kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Goudzwaard over het bericht dat de Minister inzet op krimp van het aantal vliegtuigbewegingen op Schiphol

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management, in 15 questions, about the planned reduction of Schiphol flight movements to 440,000 and its effects on the economy, competitors, noise, nitrogen, EU Balanced Approach procedures and legal certainty. The minister answered that the analysis shows 440,000 flights keep Schiphol well connected, that a cap-based norm and a stop to anticipatory enforcement are planned, and that the required EU and environmental procedures are being started, while several answers refer to the Hoofdlijnenbrief and to future procedures.
The cabinet will stop anticipatory enforcement in combination with continuing strict preferential runway use.
Het kabinet zal stoppen met anticiperend handhaven in combinatie met het voortzetten van het strikt preferentieel baangebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke, Boulakjar en Podt over het bericht ‘Vluchteling mag wel in herrie’

MPs Boucke, Boulakjar and Podt asked why student housing is blocked near Schiphol under the LIB noise rules while refugee housing at Kronenburg is allowed, and about the duration, permit (vvgb) and planned LIB revisions. The minister replied that temporary stays up to six months are exempt from LIB rules, longer stays need a vvgb which the ILT is assessing, and a LIB revision decision is targeted for year-end.
The ILT will assess whether a vvgb can be issued.
De ILT zal beoordelen of een vvgb kan worden afgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht dat wetgeving doorrijden na een aanrijding aanzienlijk aangescherpt dient te worden

MPs Koerhuis and Michon-Derkzen asked the ministers whether hit-and-run laws should be tightened after a report by a victims' association, including the 12-hour self-reporting rule, drink-driving detection, prosecution and sentencing figures, and comparisons with neighbouring countries. The minister says the 2020 law already raised maximum penalties, that the 12-hour rule is meant to encourage self-reporting, that prosecution remains the burden of the public prosecutor, and that the 12-hour rule and tightening will be examined with police and the prosecution service following an adopted motion, but the questions were not answered one by one in time.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over inbeslagname rijbewijs buitenland

An MP asked whether Dutch truck drivers losing their foreign driving licence for minor offences face job loss, whether the minister had raised this with foreign counterparts, and whether a temporary replacement licence could be provided. The minister replied that no widespread problem is known, that foreign sanctions fall under national law without harmonised rules, that EU licence law does not allow a temporary replacement, and that drivers should comply with local rules.
First of all, it must be noted that the application of this sanction falls under the national criminal or administrative law of a country, for which no harmonised rules or agreements exist.
Voorop moet worden gesteld dat de toepassing van deze sanctie onder het nationale strafrecht of bestuursrecht van een land valt, waarvoor geen geharmoniseerde regels of afspraken bestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over de eigendomsstatus van de Maasbrug tussen Gennep en Oeffelt

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the Maasbrug bridge and its cycle path, which the Rijk owns, are the responsibility of the Rijk for management and major maintenance, and whether the widening of the cycle path can be included in planned works. The Minister answered that the Rijk is responsible only for the structural part and major maintenance of the deck, while routine maintenance and any widening of the cycle path fall to the two provinces, and that the Rijk will consider facilitating a regional initiative only if the region funds it.
Specifically regarding the Maasbrug, I therefore maintain my position that widening the cycle path is not the responsibility of the Rijk but of the two provinces as road managers.
Toegespitst op de Maasbrug blijf ik daarom bij mijn standpunt dat het vergroten/verbreden van het fietspad geen verantwoordelijkheid van het Rijk is, maar van beide provincies als wegbeheerders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Boucke over de veiligheid van maritieme en energie gerelateerde activiteiten op de Noordzee

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about safety measures around offshore wind farms for shipping and energy supply, including ship collisions, risks to energy supply, and innovative solutions. The minister outlined existing and planned measures (ERTVs, Kustwacht oversight, MOSWOZ research, Programma Noordzee 2022-2027), said a full wind-farm outage is unlikely and that no specific scenarios or new integral study are planned, while committing to further collision-consequence research with results expected in 2023.
A follow-up study is underway. The next interim results are expected in the first half of 2023.
Een vervolgonderzoek loopt. De eerstvolgende tussenresultaten worden in de eerste helft van 2023 verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de opvolging van het advies van de commissie-Hordijk over AERIUS

Bisschop (SGP) asks why the government has not adopted areal-level assessment, a higher calculation threshold, kg-based units, or removed the measurement correction for the coastal dune gap in AERIUS nitrogen modelling, and how independence of the RIVM-managed tool is ensured. The minister replies that hexagon-level calculation is kept because heterogeneity would be lost at higher aggregation, that a threshold study (TNO) will report after summer, that units can be shown in kg, and that the coastal measurement correction remains until RIVM research clarifies the cause.
In phase 2 of this research, an exploration is carried out of the level of a computational lower bound supported by scientific physics-based arguments.
In fase 2 van dit onderzoek wordt onder meer een verkenning uitgevoerd naar de hoogte van een rekenkundige ondergrens die is onderbouwd met wetenschappelijke argumenten vanuit de fysica.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht 'Ministerie negeerde ‘desa-streus' stikstofadvies zodat bouwprojecten gewoon door konden gaan'

An MP asked whether the Infrastructure Ministry overrode an advisory committee's recommendations on nitrogen calculation so that infrastructure permits could proceed, and whether the sectors were disadvantaged. The minister denies this, saying the committee's recommendations were taken up, including a uniform 25 km calculation radius for all emission sources, and that AERIUS remains the best available tool.

That is not correct. In cooperation with the departments concerned, other competent bodies and knowledge institutions, under the coordination of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, it was examined how the advice of the Advisory Committee could be followed up.

Dat klopt niet. In samenwerking met de betrokken departementen, andere bevoegde instanties en kennisinstellingen is onder coördinatie van het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit onderzocht hoe opvolging gegeven kon worden aan de adviezen van het Adviescollege.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over vervuiling door de scheepvaart

Van Raan (PvdD) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about large-scale ocean and air pollution from shipping, including open-loop scrubbers, bilge water, washing discharges and varend ontgassen, and whether the Netherlands would ban these practices. The Minister answered that the RIVM found scrubber discharges unlikely to breach current water quality norms, that the IMO guidelines are being evaluated, that the Netherlands will push for stricter rules if evidence shows unacceptable effects, and that a national ban on open-loop scrubbers or bilge discharge is not planned for now.
No. At the request of the Ministry of I&W, the RIVM carried out an initial study into the effects of scrubber discharges on water quality.
Nee. Het RIVM heeft in opdracht van het Ministerie van I&W een eerste onderzoek laten uitvoeren naar de effecten van scrubber-lozingen op de waterkwaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chris Simons en Koerhuis over het artikel 'Mee op pad met de arbeidsinspectie: ‘Het deugt niet, maar jij wilt wel je pakketje morgen bezorgd hebben’'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a press report on harsh working conditions and possible exploitation in parcel delivery, and whether principal contractors such as PostNL bear responsibility for subcontractors. The minister answered that client liability for health and safety exists only in construction, that the SER is advising on redistributing responsibility, and that the Arbeidsinspectie targets the parcel sector through risk-based enforcement.
I see that, partly due to a changing labour market, this allocation of responsibility for prevention and for healthy and safe work does not always work (optimally).
Ik zie dat, mede door een veranderende arbeidsmarkt, deze verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling als het gaat om preventie en de zorg voor gezond en veilig werken, niet in alle gevallen (optimaal) werkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over verdrinkingen in Nederland

An SP MP asked about the true number of drownings in the Netherlands, CBS reporting methods, a possible repeat of a 2009 traffic-drowning campaign, suicide prevention with Stichting 113, and aftercare for lifeguards facing suicide attempts. The minister explains that CBS counts accidental drownings under the cause-of-death classification while broader reporting is planned, says the 2009 campaign had measurable awareness effects but limited proven impact on drownings, and promises to discuss suicide prevention with Stichting 113 and to raise lifeguard aftercare with open-water supervisors.
With the broader perspective that CBS adopts in future publications, I expect that we will have a complete picture of all drownings in the Netherlands in the future.
Met de bredere blik die het CBS in volgende publicaties hanteert, ga ik ervan uit dat we in de toekomst een compleet beeld hebben van alle verdrinkingen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht '‘Veilige’ rotondes vaak het onveiligst voor fietsers'

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that roundabouts are often the most dangerous for cyclists, the rise in cycling accidents on roundabouts, and whether cyclist priority should be removed. The minister answered that roundabouts are generally safer than other junctions, that the rise in serious cycling injuries is mainly single-vehicle accidents, and that CROW guidelines are advisory, with the final decision left to road managers.
According to SWOV, roundabouts are safer than ordinary junctions because roundabouts have fewer conflict points than other junction types.
Rotondes zijn volgens SWOV veiliger dan gewone kruispunten, doordat rotondes minder conflictpunten hebben dan andere kruispunttypen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Vestering over de ‘ongekende droogte’

MPs Van Esch and Vestering asked the government about the 2022 drought, groundwater abstraction, illegal wells, enforcement, the water tax and compensation claims. The minister answered most questions substantively, pointing to existing measures, a ongoing review of the water tax, and declining to judge a pending collective claim.
I therefore refrain from giving a judgment on that.
Ik onthoud mij daarom van een oordeel daarover.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘Extra maatregelen CBR om wachttijden terug te dringen’

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about new CBR measures to reduce driving-test waiting times, including longer waits before retakes and expiry of booking authorisations after 12 months or two cancellations. The minister confirmed the measures were agreed with driving school associations, justified them as discouraging low pass rates and misuse of the booking system, and stated an intended start date of 1 September 2022.
The intended introduction date is 1 September 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over nieuwe onaanvaardbare chaos op Schiphol

An MP asked the minister whether the army should be deployed to ease staffing shortages and chaos at Schiphol, whether the chaos harms the economy, what is being done on recruitment and wages, and whether the airport director should be reprimanded. The minister said airport staffing is Schiphol's responsibility, only Marechaussee deployment is in play, recruitment and a social agreement are underway, and the director's position is for the supervisory board.
Primarily it is the responsibility of Schiphol to solve its staff shortage.
Het is primair de verantwoordelijkheid Schiphol om hun personeelstekort op te lossen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de hoge werkdruk voor medewerkers in de burgerluchtvaart

MPs Alkaya (SP) asked ministers about high workload for air sector staff, the VNC's call for a baseline measurement, division of inspection responsibilities, under-reporting of incidents by cabin crew, and Schiphol congestion. The government answered that employers bear primary responsibility, that the Arbeidsinspectie and ILT share oversight, that it will discuss concerns in the aviation safety and social issues platform and with Schiphol, and that existing EU rules already allow cabin crew to report safety risks.
Of course I consider it important that employers adhere to good employership.
Ik vind het uiteraard belangrijk dat werkgevers zich houden aan goed werkgeverschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en De Hoop over het antwoord van de Minister op eerdere vragen over het bericht 'Nog hoop voor pont Breukelen'

MPs Van der Molen and De Hoop asked the minister to explain why Rijkswaterstaat says the Breukelen ferry poses a nautical safety risk despite the OvV finding no structural shortcomings, and questioned the MARIN study, the 1888 and 1942 agreements, and shipping growth. The minister replied that six Rijkswaterstaat reports rate the ferry as medium-to-high risk, that the agreements are legally weak, that traffic has grown, and that he intends to take the ferry out of service while exploring alternatives with local stakeholders.
The original agreement unfortunately is not in the possession of Rijkswaterstaat.
De oorspronkelijke overeenkomst is helaas niet in bezit van Rijkswaterstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over miljoenen aan meerkosten renovatie Afsluitdijk

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether officials knew in advance that the Afsluitdijk renovation would fail, causing hundreds of millions in extra costs, and whether investigation of those officials is warranted. The minister answered that a technical risk was flagged in 2018, formally raised with contractor Levvel in 2019, the minister informed in 2019, and that no investigation of officials is warranted, while acknowledging that cost overruns on complex projects cannot be fully excluded and describing new contracting approaches.
Contrary to what the above article suggests, the view is not shared that RWS officials knew in advance that the Afsluitdijk renovation would run into these problems.
Anders dan het bovengenoemde artikel suggereert wordt de mening niet gedeeld dat ambtenaren van RWS vooraf op de hoogte waren dat de renovatie van de Afsluitdijk tegen deze problemen zou aanlopen.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Haga over de bereikbaarheid in Den Helder en de Kop van Noord-Holland

An MP asked the minister about poor accessibility of Den Helder and the Kop van Noord-Holland, including the N9 road, rail link, N9-A7 connection and bus services, and the status of road widening and rail doubling. The government acknowledged an accessibility challenge in the region but stated there are currently no plans to widen the N9 or build the A7 connection, nor to double the rail line, citing low congestion, and pointed to the province for bus services.
Currently there are no plans to widen the N9 between Alkmaar and Den Helder to a four-lane road (2x2) along the Noordhollandsch Kanaal and to realise the N9 connection to the A7.
Momenteel zijn er geen plannen om de N9 tussen Alkmaar en Den Helder te verbreden tot een vierbaansweg (2x2) langs het Noordhollandsch Kanaal en om de aansluiting van de N9 op de A7 te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht ‘Megaclaim in de maak voor schade door droogte: waterbedrijven voor 300 miljoen aangeslagen’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a reported claim by farmers for drought damage that would burden water companies, raising concerns about drinking water supply, the legal basis, the priority order (verdringingsreeks) and whether the system should be revised. The minister answered that the claim stems from the Waterwet compensation scheme, that drinking water supply is not affected, that the existing priority order is sufficiently future-proof, and that no legal revision is currently planned.
There is currently no intention to change this system.
Er is op dit moment geen intentie om dit systeem aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Sylvana Simons over het meest recente IPCC-rapport in relatie tot Bonaire, Statia en Saba

MPs Van Raan and Simons asked the government about the latest IPCC report and its implications for Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, including climate adaptation, water safety, the 1.5-degree target, and energy transition. The government answered that the report lacks a Caribbean-specific assessment, that these islands are largely excluded from national climate laws and plans, and that a sustainable energy route map is promised before the summer recess.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het uitkopen van boeren in Gelderland

An MP asked the ministers whether the buyout of farmers for the A15 road project in Gelderland went against the province's wishes, and questioned the informal style and 'surprise' tactics used by the minister and deputy. The government answered that the buyouts were voluntary, agreed within existing province-state policy frameworks, and that the minister acknowledged the 'overvallen' wording was sharp but had not informed officials in advance of a commitment made in talks with provincial deputies.
The Minister had not informed her officials in advance that she wanted to make this commitment, and the officials only heard of it after the administrative agreement had been made.
De Minister had van tevoren niet gemeld aan haar ambtenaren dat ze deze toezegging wilde doen en de ambtenaren hoorden dit nadat deze bestuurlijke afspraak was gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht 'Opkopen boeren voor A15 ging tegen wens van provincie in: 'Ik heb ze overvallen''

An MP asked the infrastructure minister about her role, and her direct contacts with a provincial deputy, in buying out farms for the A15 motorway, and about the 'overvallen' remark in leaked messages. The minister answered that contacts concerned administrative agreements, not the voluntary farm buy-out contracts, admitted the remark was sharply worded, and described voluntary nitrogen-mitigation agreements as the route to free up nitrogen space.
The contact between the Minister and the deputy concerned the administrative agreements made, not the agreements with the agricultural businesses.
Het contact tussen Minister en gedeputeerde betrof de gemaakte bestuurlijke afspraken en niet de overeenkomsten met de agrarische bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over Maastricht Aachen Airport

MP Van Haga asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Waterstaat about the future of Maastricht Aachen Airport, the alleged information gap of Limburg provincial councillors, measures to limit noise nuisance for South Limburg, and economic benefits such as local employment. The minister answered that the airport is a regional matter for its owner the province of Limburg, that the state will not fund operations and gives no legal means to direct flights, and listed noise-reduction agreements and a provincial decision process still pending.
It is therefore up to the airports (and their shareholders), in cooperation with the region, to determine the future.
Het is daarom aan de luchthavens (en hun aandeelhouders) om in samenwerking met de regio de toekomst te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Tjeerd de Groot over MIRT-projecten

D66 MPs asked the government to reconcile its 2019 pledge to reserve nitrogen room in the SSRS for seven MIRT infrastructure projects, funded partly by a national speed reduction, with its 2021 decision not to use that speed reduction for MIRT projects, and asked about the nitrogen mitigation for the A27 and the consequences of a April 2022 court ruling. The minister answered that the 2021 decision merely nuanced the 2019 pledge because the speed-reduction yield could not be guaranteed, that no SSRS nitrogen room from the speed reduction is used for these projects, that the A27/A12 amendment is still being prepared, and that the court ruling and the decision have no consequences for the pending plans.

With the second statement, your House was informed that the national speed reduction will not be used, because there is a risk that after each annual update and due to the effects of COVID-19 on mobility, the precise yield of the national speed reduction is not certain at the required level of detail.

Met de tweede uitspraak is uw Kamer geïnformeerd dat geen gebruik wordt gemaakt van de landelijke snelheidsverlaging, omdat het risico bestaat dat na elke jaarlijkse actualisatie en vanwege de effecten van COVID-19 op de mobiliteit de precieze opbrengst van de landelijke snelheidsverlaging niet op het vereiste detailniveau zeker is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en van Ginneken over automobiliteit van vluchtelingen uit Oekraïne in Nederland

MPs Podt and Van Ginneken asked whether Ukrainian refugees can renew Ukrainian car insurance or obtain Dutch insurance, and whether their Ukrainian driving licences lapse after 185 days, with consequences for work and life in the Netherlands. The government answered that Ukrainian insurers still issue green cards so policies can be extended, the Vereende offers short-term cover as a fallback, and the European Commission is preparing an EU-wide extension of the licence validity.
That insurance provides cover for three months and can be extended for a maximum of three months.
Die verzekering biedt voor drie maanden dekking en kan voor maximaal drie maanden worden verlengd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden  Boucke en Wuite over het bericht 'Bedrijven en instellingen werken samen om in 2030 elektrisch vliegen mogelijk te maken'

MPs Boucke and Wuite asked the minister about government support for the Electric Flying Collective, funding and instruments for electric aviation, the Clean Aviation programme, the Caribbean roadmaps, and sustainability of Winair. The minister answered that the ministry supports the collective only through dialogue and existing schemes, and gave substantive but largely policy-restating replies with several commitments to further talks and exploration.
At present the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management provides no direct financial support to this initiative and there is no request for it.
Op dit moment verleent het Ministerie van IenW geen rechtstreekse financiële ondersteuning aan dit initiatief en er ligt hier ook geen verzoek voor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over de bescherming en het behoud van het koraal en de natuur in Caribisch Nederland

An MP asked about a resort on Bonaire that built an artificial beach without permits, the threat to coral, why the permit was granted quickly against advice, and enforcement of nature protection in the Caribbean Netherlands, totalling 15 questions. The government confirmed unpermitted sand dumping, a fine of 1.2 million US dollars, and a later permit with coral-protection conditions, while describing shared responsibilities between the island council and the Rijk and listing planned reforms to permitting and enforcement.
The island executive did not follow the advice of the Bonaire nature commission. It is also not obliged to do so.
Het bestuurscollege heeft daarbij niet het advies van de natuurcommissie Bonaire gevolgd. Het bestuurscollege is daartoe ook niet verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de drukte op Schiphol

An MP from Groep Van Haga asked the minister about the chaos at Schiphol over the May holidays, whether it could have been foreseen, the CEO's absence, the airport charge increase and staff shortages. The minister answered that bookings rose faster than expected alongside rising staff sickness, that Schiphol apologised and has four action lines, and that operational and personnel matters are the responsibility of Schiphol's management and employers, with the Autoriteit Consument en Markt handling charge complaints.
The Ministry of IenW has no role in determining the airport charges.
Het Ministerie van IenW heeft in de vaststelling van de luchthavengelden geen rol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over de situatie op Schiphol

An MP asked the minister about staffing shortages at Schiphol, reported requests to airlines to limit departing passengers, cancelled flights, passenger rights, and security staff conditions. The minister answered that Schiphol asked airlines to reduce passenger numbers rather than cancel flights, that cancellation data is not yet available, and described recruitment efforts and security contractors' wages.
Schiphol cannot yet answer that question because it has no visibility into how many flights airlines themselves cancelled.
Schiphol kan die vraag nu nog niet beantwoorden omdat ze geen zicht heeft op hoeveel vluchten door luchtvaartmaatschappijen zelf zijn geannuleerd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de aanhoudende wateroverlast bij Sluiskil

An MP from the SGP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about persistent water nuisance near Sluiskil and whether canal water levels, dam wall length and canal bed profile contribute to it. The minister denied the cited analysis, said additional geohydrological research is under way with results expected in Q3 2022, and promised to involve residents and to explore responsibility for farmland flooding with the province and water board.
The geohydrological research is currently under way. It is therefore still too early to conclude whether there are other insights than those that emerged from the earlier research.
Het geohydrologisch onderzoek loopt op dit moment. Het is daarmee nog te vroeg om te concluderen of er andere inzichten zijn dan uit het eerdere onderzoek naar voren kwamen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht “200 miljoen die kabinet uittrekt voor veilige N-wegen 'druppel op gloeiende plaat'”

An MP asked the Infrastructure Minister whether the EUR 200 million for safer Rijks-N-wegen is enough, and about provincial investments and national investment plans through 2030. The minister answered that the funds will be prioritised, that provinces are primarily responsible for provincial N-roads with support from the Investeringsimpuls, and that a full overview of provincial investments is not available.
Such an overview cannot be provided.
Een dergelijk overzicht is niet te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de bonus van 3,3 miljoen euro voor Air France-KLM topman Ben Smith

An SP MP asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about the EUR 3.3 million bonus paid to Air France-KLM CEO Ben Smith despite state support, and what the government had done to prevent it. The ministers said the bonus is unacceptable, that they lobbied the company and the European Commission, but that the final decision lies with shareholders where the Netherlands holds 9.3% and is unlikely to block it.
Ultimately, the final decision on awarding the bonus rests with the general meeting of shareholders.
Uiteindelijk ligt het definitieve besluit over het toekennen van de bonus bij de algemene vergadering van aandeelhouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de verkeersveiligheid van de N50 bij Kampen

MP Van Haga asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the road safety of the N50 near Kampen, after a fatal accident and a transport company's offer to fund improvements, and whether the state had long known of the dangers. The minister acknowledged the urgency, listed past measures, explained that nitrogen-permit delays slowed the Kampen–Kampen Zuid project, which is now prioritised, and promised a study, short-term measures and a Kamer update before the June MIRT debate.
On the research into the possibilities for these short-term measures, your House will in any case be informed of the state of affairs before the MIRT committee debate of 30 June.
Over het onderzoek naar de mogelijkheden van deze korte termijn maatregelen zal uw Kamer in elk geval voorafgaand aan het Commissiedebat MIRT van 30 juni worden geïnformeerd over de stand van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en van Nispen over de kosten van het opruimen van drugsdumpingen en de zaak van de 90-jarige gedupeerde landeigenaar

MPs Van Nispen and Beckerman asked about municipal and provincial demands that a 90-year-old landowner pay for clean-up of chemical drug waste dumped on his land, and about the adequacy of the national compensation scheme. The minister declined to comment on the individual case citing a pending objection procedure, acknowledged the scheme's EUR 25,000 cap is being exceeded in large cases, and said talks with the provinces and BIJ12 are ongoing with an update promised before summer.
There is an objection procedure ongoing in this case with the competent authority.
Er loopt in deze zaak een bezwaarprocedure bij het bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Van Der Molen over het bericht 'Wachttijd voor identiteitsbewijzen loopt op tot maanden'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Van Der Molen asked about reported months-long waiting times for passports, ID cards and driving licences, and what causes them. The government answered that waiting times are not centrally tracked, that a sample showed up to 13 weeks with most municipalities offering appointments within two weeks, and pointed to Ukrainian refugee registration, elections and seasonal peaks, while declining to extend document validity beyond legal limits.
It is not centrally tracked what the waiting time is at municipalities.
Er wordt niet centraal bijgehouden wat de wachttijd is bij gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the public agendas of cabinet members and how the motion on publishing them is being implemented. The Finance ministers answered that they will follow the agreed guidelines, have updated their agendas, and can answer individually for them.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of cabinet members was discussed several times in the Voorlichtingsraad.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van Ginneken over dwingend recht en het toepassen van de menselijke maat door het CBR

MPs Sneller and Van Ginneken asked whether the CBR (driving licence authority) and the courts can take personal circumstances into account, given that the Wegenverkeerswet and RMRG leave little room for balancing interests, and how this fits with proportionality and the Raad van State's reflection report. Minister Harbers answered that the legal framework is strict by design, the CBR uses passend contact and mitigating measures within it, the government is considering an Awb provision allowing administrative bodies to depart from mandatory rules, and a CBR knelpuntenbrief is expected in Q2 2022.

The cabinet is considering various amendments to better safeguard the general principles of proper administration, increase room for tailored decisions, and put the citizen's perspective at the forefront of service delivery.

Het kabinet overweegt diverse wijzigingen om de algemene beginselen van behoorlijk bestuur beter te borgen, ruimte voor maatwerk te vergroten en het burgerperspectief in de dienstverlening voorop te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Haverkort, Koerhuis en Peter de Groot over de uitzending van EenVandaag over mogelijke tekorten in industriezand en grind

VVD MPs asked the government whether extraction permits for sand and gravel are expiring, whether shortages will arise, and how supply will meet the infrastructure and housing ambitions. The minister answered that a monitoring system and a national demand forecast are being developed, that circularity measures are underway, and that talks with provinces and the sector are ongoing.
At present, the need for sand and gravel is being mapped in cooperation with knowledge institutes and industry organisations. The House will be informed of the results before the end of the year.

Op dit moment wordt – in samenwerking met kennisinstituten en brancheorganisaties – de behoefte aan zand en grind in beeld gebracht. De Kamer zal voor het eind van het jaar over het resultaat worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Vewin: drinkwater voor 900.000 nieuwe woningen niet zeker’

MPs Minhas and Peter de Groot asked the ministers about reports that drinking water supply for 900,000 new homes to 2030 is uncertain, and about the state of water sources, coordination with the housing sector, and planned measures. The minister answers that supply is secured for at least 10 years through supply plans supervised by the ILT, and points to ongoing studies, strategic reserves, a 800 million euro Deltaplan and a planned water-saving exploration, but gives no concrete figures on new sources.
RIVM is working on a supplementary report on the availability of sources, to be completed by mid-2022.
RIVM werkt aan een aanvullend rapport over de beschikbaarheid van bronnen, dat medio 2022 zal worden afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over het T-rijbewijs in de grensregio

Three CDA MPs asked why T-category agricultural licences are not harmonised in the EU, why Belgian and German T-licences are not recognised in the Netherlands, and what cross-border options exist for residents of the border region. The minister answers that T-licences fall outside EU harmonisation, that mutual recognition is being explored pending a comparative study by CBR, and that residence requirements apply, with several questions answered by cross-reference.
The CBR has been asked to produce a comparative overview of the national examination requirements in the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany.
Aan het CBR is gevraagd om een vergelijkend overzicht te maken van de nationale exameneisen in Nederland, België en Duitsland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over plastickorrels in de Westerschelde

An SGP MP asked the minister about a report on plastic nurdle pollution in the Westerschelde, its implications for the Hedwige polder and Natura 2000 values, and follow-up in Flemish talks. The minister said the conclusions are not yet sufficiently verified, pointed to the Schone Schelde 2022 programme and knowledge investment, and noted Dutch pressure in the International Scheldt Commission.
Although I appreciate the effort of this specific research, I think it is too early to comment on the conclusions.
Hoewel ik de inzet van dit specifieke onderzoek waardeer, vind ik het te vroeg om me over de conclusies uit te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Van Campen over het bericht 'Schoon water is in Nederland nog ver weg'

MPs Minhas and Van Campen (VVD) asked the ministers about a news report that clean water is far off in the Netherlands, including the EU Water Framework Directive risks for 2027. Minister Harbers answered that the water quality picture is complex, that most chemical norms are met but biological and nutrient norms lag, and that further measures and possible use of exemptions are planned.
I do not share the view that water quality is not good in all respects.
Het beeld dat de waterkwaliteit op alle onderdelen niet goed is, deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de wachttijden bij het CBR

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about driving-test waiting times at the CBR, the possible raising of the exam age, and the shortage of examiners. The minister answered in detail on waiting times, examiner recruitment, and the rejection of temporary emergency measures, while stating he would inform parliament before any such measures are used.
Furthermore, my predecessor committed to informing the House before temporary emergency measures are deployed.
Daarnaast heeft mijn voorganger toegezegd de Kamer te informeren voorafgaand aan de inzet van tijdelijke noodmaatregelen.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden van de leden Koerhuis en Haverkort over ongelukken met e-bikes en drukte op fietspaden

MPs Koerhuis and Haverkort asked the minister about reports of more accidents with fast e-bikes and crowded cycle paths, including causes, prevention, sales information, speed tuning, and path design. The minister answered that the role of e-bikes is still being studied with results due by end 2022, outlined educational campaigns and infrastructure investments, and said the government will inform parliament before year end.
By the end of 2022 at the latest, your House will be informed of the results.
Uiterlijk eind 2022 wordt uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de resultaten.
Antwoord op van het lid Eppink over dat jongeren vaker betrokken zijn bij ongelukken met e-bikes

MP Eppink (JA21) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that young e-bike riders are more often involved in accidents, and about speed differences on bike paths, a possible speed cap of 25 km/h, a ban on e-bikes for children, and improvements to bike path design. The minister acknowledged the issue, pointed to ongoing research on light electric vehicles, existing speed limits, and planned measures, but gave no firm new commitments.
On this, your House will be informed in the road safety letter that will be sent before the road safety committee debate of 20 April.
Hierover wordt uw Kamer geïnformeerd in de verzamelbrief verkeersveiligheid die voor het commissiedebat verkeersveiligheid van 20 april wordt verstuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de onderschatte explosie bij het opblazen van oude Middensluis in Terneuzen

An MP asked the minister about the underestimated blast when the old Middensluis in Terneuzen was demolished, including damage, compensation, causes, and resident communication. The minister said the blast was larger than expected, about 130 damage claims are being handled by the contractor, and an evaluation is underway with results expected mid-April.
That is unfortunately not yet possible at this moment. Despite extensive preparation, the blast was larger than expected.
Dat is op dit moment helaas nog niet mogelijk. Ondanks dat er veel voorbereiding is geweest, was de plof groter dan verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda’s

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the handling of the motion on public agendas of ministers and whether the 2022 guidance and the Open State findings on non-compliance would be acted upon. The Minister of Defence answered that the guidance has been adopted, that agendas will be retroactively updated and kept compliant, and that each minister can answer individually.
We will update the public agendas with retroactive effect.
Wij zullen de openbare agenda’s met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het naleven van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur en rechterlijke uitspraken

An MP asked ministers why documents on Schiphol aviation safety were withheld despite a court ruling ordering their full disclosure under the Wob. The minister agreed that disclosure should be the norm, but withholds 17 of the 54 documents under the Rijkswet Ovv and EU Regulation 376/2014, and has referred the matter to the Council of State.
I cannot make the 17 documents public because I want to comply with the regulations that protect information from investigations into civil aviation incidents.
Ik kan de 17 documenten niet openbaar maken omdat ik de regelgeving wil naleven die ervoor zorgt dat informatie uit onderzoek naar voorvallen in de burgerluchtvaart wordt beschermd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de kamerbrief Stand van Zaken Ring Utrecht

An SP MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management what became of the coalition agreement's intention to explore an alternative for the A27/Amelisweerd Ring Utrecht project, and why the Tracébesluit procedure continues before the regional alternative exists. The minister answers that talks with the region are ongoing, no concrete alternative exists yet, no deadline has been set, and the Raad van State appeal proceeds, so the procedure cannot be paused.
When the region has this ready, we would gladly enter into consultation with them.
Als de regio dit gereed heeft, treden wij graag met hen in overleg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht 'Zelfs milieuminister hoeft in Nederland niet elektrisch te rijden'

MPs Van Raan asked why ministers still drive mostly non-electric cars despite government climate pledges, and why only 2 of 31 service cars are fully electric. The minister confirmed the figures, said the civil fleet aims for zero-emission by 2028 with a 'zero-emission unless' policy, and cited contracts, security needs, and vehicle availability as reasons for slow progress.
The cabinet is fully committed to sustainability and is aware of its exemplary role.
Het kabinet zet vol in op verduurzaming en is zich bewust van zijn voorbeeldrol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication and completeness of their public agendas under the motion on ministerial agendas. Minister Schreinemacher answered that she accepts the motion and the 2022 guidance notes, will update her agenda retroactively to her appointment, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether the requirements were being met and whether agendas would be corrected retroactively. Minister Hoekstra answered that he accepts the guidance, acknowledges his agenda is not yet fully compliant, and will update it retroactively to his appointment.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boulakjar en Boucke over maatwerkafspraken voor woningbouw

MPs Boulakjar and Boucke asked about maintenance-style exceptions (maatwerk) allowing housing near Schiphol under the airport zoning decree (LIB), the student housing at Kronenburg, and whether a revised LIB should follow the new noise and enforcement rules. The minister answered that only a limited number of exemptions have been granted, that a revised LIB will follow the pending LVB change and could free some land for housing, and that talks with the regional authority are ongoing.
In the LIB 4 area the noise exposure is such that caution must be exercised when adding housing.
In het LIB 4 gebied is de geluidbelasting dusdanig dat er terughoudend moet worden omgegaan met het toevoegen van woningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over de zuidelijke vaarroute op de Waddenzee voor grote containerschepen

The MP asks the minister about large container ships using the southern shipping route over the Wadden Sea despite Coast Guard warnings to take the northern route, including counts of such voyages and the state of more active traffic guidance. The minister confirms several incidents, reports the figures from AIS data, notes that the southern route lies largely outside territorial waters so closing it requires IMO agreement, and says a non-binding IMO proposal is planned.
During the Maritime Two-Minute Debate on 2 February I committed to examining the options for letting the captain know in such cases that the Coast Guard's advice is not non-binding.

Tijdens het Tweeminutendebat Maritiem op 2 februari jl. heb ik toegezegd te zullen bezien wat de mogelijkheden zijn om de kapitein in voorkomende gevallen te laten weten dat het advies van de Kustwacht niet vrijblijvend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over "hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether agendas are complete and whether they will be retroactively corrected. Ministers Van Gennip and Schouten answered that the Voorlichtingsraad handbook now serves as the instruction, that agendas are published a week ahead with corrections for the past week, and that they will answer jointly rather than individually.
That is why it was chosen to publish one week ahead and to correct the past week so that the picture afterwards is correct.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen een week vooruit te publiceren en de afgelopen week te corrigeren zodat het beeld achteraf correct is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over de wachttijden bij het CBR

An MP from the PVV asked the minister about long waiting times for driving tests at the CBR, whether it should raise the exam age and drop optional tests, and whether a second organisation should be mandated to hold exams. The minister answered that the CBR is responsible for its own operations, blamed staff absences and a tight labour market, said temporary emergency measures would first be discussed with parliament, and rejected a second exam provider and intervention.
Furthermore, my predecessor committed that the use of any temporary emergency measure will first be discussed with the House before it is implemented.
Daarnaast heeft mijn voorganger toegezegd dat de inzet van een tijdelijke noodmaatregel éérst met de Kamer zal worden besproken voordat deze wordt geëffectueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van der Molen en De Hoop over het bericht ‘Nog hoop voor pont Breukelen’

MPs Van der Molen and De Hoop asked the minister about plans to remove the Nieuwer Ter Aa bicycle-pedestrian ferry over the Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal, covering costs, safety, the 1888 and 1942 agreements, public participation and cycling detours. The minister answered that the ferry poses a nautical safety risk, that operating costs are 440,000 euro per year, that the agreements can be terminated because their legal value is low, and that a definitive decision is expected shortly after summer 2022.
The intention is to take the ferry out of service by 31 December 2022 at the latest.
Het voornemen is om de veerpont uiterlijk 31 december 2022 uit de vaart te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over omgang met explosieven door overheden

Senator Stoffer (SGP) asked ministers about the handling of explosives by government, after a WWII aircraft bomb exploded on a Wassenaar beach, including steps, coordination, responsibilities, costs and whether a central authority is needed. The government answered that the process runs through municipalities, police and the EODD, that existing coordination suffices, that no central authority or further centralisation is warranted, and it declined to consult additional expert bodies.
Further coordination and centralisation does not lead to more efficient policy, and therefore not to a reduction in costs.
Verdere coördinatie en centralisatie leidt niet tot doelmatiger beleid, en daarmee dus niet tot reductie van kosten.
Antwoord op van het lid Van Baarle over de privacyrisico’s van de Intelligente Snelheidsassistent

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about privacy risks of the Intelligent Speed Assistant and the mandatory Event Data Recorder, including who can access the data and whether the Data Protection Authority reviewed it. The minister answered that the ISA only warns drivers, the EDR contains no identifying data and is for accident analysis and statistics, and that no further privacy assessment is needed.
EDR data contain no location data and therefore cannot be used to detect speeding offences.
EDR-gegevens bevatten geen locatiegegevens en zijn daarmee niet te gebruiken voor het constateren van snelheidsovertredingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Amhaouch over het bericht dat bewoners van de nieuwbouw rond de Roermondse Roertunnel hinder ondervinden van laagfrequent geluid

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about low-frequency noise and vibration affecting new housing near the Roermond Roertunnel, including the Movares findings, the state's responsibility, possible fixes, the 2023 maintenance, communication with local authorities, health effects and the absence of legal noise standards. The minister confirmed the Movares study indicates 129 addresses may be affected, that Rijkswaterstaat and Roermond are jointly investigating, listed possible measures needing further study, and stated no legal standard for low-frequency noise currently exists.

Rijkswaterstaat is therefore jointly investigating with the municipality of Roermond, in the interest of residents' quality of life, the cause of this nuisance to see which possible solutions could be implemented.

Rijkswaterstaat onderzoekt daarom samen met de gemeente Roermond – in het belang van de leefkwaliteit van bewoners – de oorzaak van deze hinder, om te bezien welke mogelijke oplossingen getroffen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en De Hoop over de schades aan huizen na werkzaamheden aan het kanaal Almelo-De Haandrik

MPs Nijboer and De Hoop asked the minister about damage to around 400 homes caused by works on the Almelo-De Haandrik canal, including forced relocations, unacceptably long procedures, and who is responsible for the errors. The minister replied that the canal is a provincial waterway managed by Overijssel, that the ministry has no direct role, and that 288 damage claims have been granted compensation or subsidy so far.
The Almelo-De Haandrik canal is a provincial waterway. Its management is in the hands of the province of Overijssel.
Het kanaal Almelo-De Haandrik is een provinciale vaarweg. Het beheer daarvan is in handen van de provincie Overijssel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over medische rijbewijskeuringen

MP De Hoop asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about overcharging by medical driving-licence examination providers, the NZa's enforcement, CBR referrals, and fee levels. The minister answered that providers must inform consumers of costs and send correct bills, that the NZa handles complaints and takes measures, and that a review of the examination process is ongoing with an update promised by Q3 2022.
It is indeed good that consumers do this and put any questions about the accuracy of the bill to the provider concerned.
Het is juist goed dat consumenten dit doen en hun eventuele vragen over de juistheid van de rekening stellen aan de betreffende zorgaanbieder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on public ministerial agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required standards. The minister answered that EZK largely follows the guidance, will improve some points, will backdate its public agenda to the start of office, and that the answers are given jointly for all EZK ministers.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over onze openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the ministers and state secretary of OCW and PO about how their public agendas are kept and whether they comply with the motion and the Rijksvoorlichtingsdienst guidance on public agendas. The government answers that agendas are kept systematically and categorised, acknowledges incomplete entries such as missing contact persons and topic descriptions, and commits to correcting agendas retroactively and to consistent future compliance.
We will update the public agenda retroactively in line with the previously mentioned improvement points.
Wij werken de openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bij volgens de eerder genoemde verbeterpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over de verbreding van het fietspad langs de Maasbrug tussen Gennep en Oeffelt

An MP asked the minister why widening the cycle path on the Maas bridge between Gennep and Oeffelt is not a priority, and whether it can be done alongside the Flessenhals Maas works. The minister answered that the widening was not included in the Ruimte voor de Maas project, that no national norms apply, that it will be put on the MIRT agenda this autumn, and that regional parties must bear the costs.
That is why the region has been proposed to discuss the widening, separately from the co-funding opportunity, at the MIRT administrative consultations this autumn.
Daarom is aan de regio voorgesteld de verbreding, los van de meekoppelkans te bespreken tijdens de Bestuurlijke Overleggen MIRT dit najaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was raised, whether it will be implemented, and how compliance will be improved after a study found most agenda entries lack required information. Minister Helder answered that she will update her agenda retroactively, add contact details and descriptions, follow the agreed guidelines, and confirm she can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required information standard. The Secretary of State answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details, descriptions and categorisation, that past entries will be updated retroactively, and that the individual ministerial responsibility principle applies.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, citing a study finding most agenda entries lack required information. The Prime Minister answered that the government will improve agenda transparency, update his agenda retroactively, and that each minister can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Prime Minister of the current cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister-President van het huidige kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether the RVD guidance is followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Kuipers says he will follow the motion, update his agenda retroactively, and that ministers answer individually, while acknowledging some agenda gaps were already being corrected.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht dat laadpalenbedrijf Allego stopt met investeringen in langzame laders

Member Bontenbal (CDA) asked the minister whether charging company Allego's decision to stop investing in slow public chargers, and the resulting need for a new placement strategy, was recognised, and what the government would do about it. The state secretary acknowledged the news, said the 'pole follows car' approach still works but new methods such as proactive placement and charging squares are being pursued under the national agenda, and undertook to re-examine the Klimaatakkoord charger targets.
I see that the transition to electric driving is taking place ever faster.
Ik zie dat de transitie naar elektrisch rijden steeds sneller plaats vindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of ministers was raised and implemented, whether the notes on public agendas are followed, and how compliance will be improved. Minister De Jonge replied that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with adjusted agenda practices, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet de openbare agenda van de bewindspersonen van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about implementing the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas, and the notice on compliance with the Open State finding that only 14% of agenda entries met the guideline. The ministers answer that they endorse the seven agreements, have updated their agendas retroactively, and that each minister answers individually.
Yes. Our public agendas are now fully updated.
Ja. Onze openbare agenda's zijn nu volledig bijgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas was implemented, whether it is being followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Bruins Slot replied that the agendas will be improved via a guidance note, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication of their public agendas, including compliance with the motion and the 2022 guidance note. The state secretary answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details and descriptions, that her agenda will be brought up to date retroactively, and that individual ministerial responsibility allows each minister to answer.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Boucke over het bericht ‘Groot-Brittannië doet Aeroflot in de ban als gevolg van Russische agressie’

MPs Boucke and Sjoerdsma asked whether Britain closed its airspace to Aeroflot, how many Russian airlines fly from Dutch airports, whether the Netherlands will investigate an EU-level ban, and whether Dutch airlines still fly over Russia. The minister confirmed the UK closure, said no Russian airlines currently fly from Dutch airports due to the EU airspace closure, and said Dutch airlines no longer fly over Russia because Russia banned them.
Due to the current closure of European airspace to Russian airlines, no Russian airlines fly from Dutch airports.
Door de huidige sluiting van het Europese luchtruim voor Russische luchtvaartmaatschappijen vliegen er geen Russische luchtvaartmaatschappijen op Nederlandse luchthavens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Bouchallikh over PFAS in de Westerschelde

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the government about PFAS contamination of fish and shellfish in the Westerschelde, public warnings, the Hedwigepolder managed-realignment project, and coordination with Flanders. The ministers answered that GGD Zeeland issued consumption advice, that EU restriction and Flemish emission measures are underway, that the Hedwigepolder project may proceed because PFAS levels are within legal limits, and that a senior-official coordinator will be appointed.

In response to the letter from the Zeeland provincial executive, the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management has indicated that he wants to appoint a coordinator at senior official level in both central government and the province of Zeeland.

In reactie op de brief van gedeputeerde staten van Zeeland heeft de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat aangegeven bij zowel de rijksoverheid als de provincie Zeeland op hoogambtelijk niveau een coördinator te willen aanwijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Straks kan Zeeland alleen nog een bordje naast de met PFAS-water gevulde Hedwigepolder zetten: 'Geen vis eten!''

MPs Van der Molen and Van den Berg (CDA) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about PFAS contamination in the Westerschelde and the planned flooding of the Hedwigepolder, including whether work should wait for the RIVM study, a pending Raad van State request, Belgian coordination and appointing a coordinator. The Minister answered that the flooding will proceed because the sediment PFAS levels do not breach the Waterwet duty of care, that the RIVM study will not change expectations, that a coordinator will be appointed in consultation with Zeeland.

In response to the letter from the Zeeland Provincial Executive, the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management has indicated that he wishes to appoint a coordinator at senior civil service level in both central government and the province of Zeeland.

In reactie op de brief van GedeputeerdeStaten van Zeeland heeft de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat aangegeven bij zowel de rijksoverheid als de provincie Zeeland op hoogambtelijk niveau een coördinator te willen aanwijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Kröger over het containerverlies van de Marcos V boven de Waddeneilanden

MPs De Hoop and Kröger asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the loss of 26 containers from the Marcos V above the Wadden islands, including salvage costs, Kustwacht powers during storms, the Julietta D incident, and protection of offshore infrastructure. The minister answered that the shipowner pays for salvage, that the Kustwacht can advise but cannot forbid routes or intervene generically under the Wbmo, and that Dutch-German-Danish proposals to the IMO are underway, with further letters promised before the summer recess.
I therefore cannot apply the intervention power in a generic sense, for example to a certain category of ships or in certain circumstances.
Ik kan de interventiebevoegdheid dus niet in generieke zin toepassen, bijvoorbeeld op een bepaalde categorie schepen, of in bepaalde omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Boucke over het bericht dat Rusland BUK-afweersystemen bij de grens met Oekraïne plaatst

Two D66 MPs asked the government about reports that Russia placed BUK and S-300/S-400 air defence systems near the Ukrainian border and what this means for civil aviation safety, including IFALPA and ECA warnings and recommendations from the Dutch Safety Board on airspace closure criteria. The ministers answered that monitoring continues, that KLM and other airlines suspended Ukraine flights, that Dutch airspace-closure powers for airlines face legal and practical objections, and that the government is working on international criteria.
Dutch airlines did not fly there.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether they will comply with the 2022 agreements, and whether their agendas meet the rules. The minister replied that the motion is being implemented through a 2022 notice, that her agenda has already been updated and complies, and that all ministers can answer individually.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of ministers was repeatedly discussed in the Information Council.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of office-holders was handled, whether it will be implemented, and whether agendas comply with the guidelines. Minister Staghouwer answered that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with improvements such as contact details and categorisation, that his own agenda is already updated and compliant, and that he will continue to comply.
I already keep my agenda as far as possible in line with the agreements in the note 'Public agenda office-holders' and will continue to do so for the rest of this cabinet period.
Ik houd mijn agenda op dit moment al zoveel mogelijk bij conform de afspraken uit de notitie «Openbare agenda bewindslieden» en zal dit ook voor de rest van deze kabinetsperiode blijven doen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het meedoen van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat aan de Nationale Week Zonder Vlees & Zuivel en het invoeren van het principe 'Carnivoor? Geef het door!'

MPs Ouwehand asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the ministry's participation in a national meat-free week and about adopting a plant-based default in ministry catering, along with related questions on diet, climate and school meals. The minister replied that government canteens follow healthy catering criteria, that the ministry joined the circular catering vision with plant-based food as a key element, and that it did not manage to send answers before the deadline.
I am aware of the positive contribution a balanced diet can make to people and the environment.
Ik ben bekend met de positieve bijdrage die een gebalanceerd voedingspatroon kan leveren aan mens en milieu.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Rijk en provincie in gesprek over project Kornwerderzand’

MP Van der Molen (CDA) asked the minister about delays and cost risks in the Kornwerderzand lock widening, bridge replacement and IJsselmeer channel deepening, including salinity and sand extraction. The minister answered that the province bears the project risks under the administrative agreement, that Rijkswaterstaat expects no blocking of the bridge timeline, that salinity studies are ongoing, and that the market contribution is being discussed.
Under the administrative agreement, responsibility for these risks lies with the province.
Op grond van de bestuursovereenkomst ligt de verantwoordelijkheid voor deze risico’s bij de provincie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het bericht ‘Na jaar vertraging levert Schiphol onvolledige data over gifstoffen’

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch asked about reports that Schiphol delivered late and incomplete data on emissions of carcinogenic substances, and whether the Omgevingsdienst NZKG should enforce before assessing the report and how citizens are protected. The minister replies that the reported emissions concern only 0.1% of Schiphol's total ZZS emissions under the environmental permit, that the regulator granted two extensions and gave Schiphol two months for supplementary data, that enforcement is not ruled out but no sanctions yet, and that the government will examine in the first half of 2022 whether aviation ZZS emissions require reduction.
Therefore I will examine in the first half of this year whether emissions of ZZS from aviation affect the surroundings of airports to such an extent that these emissions must be reduced.
Daarom zal ik nog in de eerste helft van dit jaar bezien of de uitstoot van ZZS door de luchtvaart, de omgeving van luchthavens dusdanig negatief beïnvloedt, dat die uitstoot moet verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht 'Op bezoek bij omstreden fietskoeriers: 'We zullen nooit pushen om harder te rijden''

An MP asked the ministers whether the rapid rise of quick-delivery couriers causes traffic danger, nuisance and streetscape decline, what tools municipalities have, and about research, consultations and youth-courier initiatives. The minister answered that municipalities hold the main instruments, that research results are due later in 2022 and that consultations with the G4 will be shared after the summer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het bericht ‘Luchtvaartonderzoek houdt vliegherrie buiten beeld, waarschuwt GGD’

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch asked why the aviation cost-benefit guidance (MKBA werkwijzer) treats aircraft noise in ways that allegedly favour the aviation sector and diverge from WHO noise guidelines, and whether this undermines trust of residents. The minister replied that the guidance is an adequate first version, that noise valuation will be improved through a research agenda, that the ministry did not influence the noise norms, and that no 'rekentrucs' (calculation tricks) occurred.
It is indeed important that noise nuisance is taken into account properly in cost-benefit analyses.
Het is inderdaad van belang dat geluidhinder op goede wijze wordt meegenomen in MKBA's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de uitstoot van zeer zorgwekkende stoffen (ZZS) die mogelijk niet door Schiphol gerapporteerd worden

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management which activities at Schiphol must report emissions of very high-concern substances (ZZS), and whether platform activities such as taxiing, take-off and landing are covered. The minister listed the permitted activities under the environmental permit, explained that taxiing, take-off and landing fall under the Aviation Act and the Schiphol airport traffic decree rather than the environmental permit, and pointed to the national emissions register for reporting.
Taxiing, take-off and landing therefore do not form part of the environmental permit.
Taxiën, starten en landen maken dus geen deel uit van de omgevingsvergunning milieu.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat de A1 ter hoogte van afrit Hoevelaken en oprit Hoevelaken wordt afgesloten

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the closure of the A1 parallel carriageway and the Hoevelaken on/off ramps, its expected duration, why no temporary fix was chosen, and how similar failures of road-bridge joints will be prevented. The minister confirmed the six-week closure, explained that a permanent joint replacement was chosen for safety and that prevention depends on maintenance programming and budget choices to be communicated to parliament.
Last December my predecessor informed your House about this matter.
Afgelopen december is uw Kamer hierover door mijn voorganger geïnformeerd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat de noodklok wordt geluid door het gevaar op N-wegen

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports of dangerous N-roads, including fatality figures, planned road safety measures, and progress on specific N-roads such as the N36. The minister disputed the figures as not comparable, described the €25m verge-safety programme and €200m investment, and listed the timeline of works and a campaign on driver behaviour.
The precise number and share of fatal traffic accidents and traffic deaths on all N-roads of the various road managers will be included in the research needed to implement the Madlener motion.

Het precieze aantal en aandeel dodelijke verkeersongevallen en verkeersdoden op alle N-wegen van de verschillende wegbeheerders zal worden meegenomen in het benodigde onderzoek voor de uitwerking van de motie-Madlener.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het stopzetten van het programma file-aanpak 2018-2021

Madlener (PVV) asked whether the government stopped funding for the temporary File-aanpak 2018–2021 programme on advice from DGMo, whether parliament was informed, and how staff losses and rising traffic are addressed. Minister Harbers denied DGMo advice was the basis, explained the one-off funding ends with the programme in 2022, pointed to earlier notice in 2018 and the 2022 budget, and cited a broad set of other traffic measures.
The decision not to extend the File-aanpak 2018–2021 programme was taken before the end of 2021.
Het besluit om het Programma File-aanpak 2018–2021 niet te verlengen is genomen voor het einde van 2021.
