Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Boosheid om schrappen van de pont over Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management, in 14 questions, why the Nieuwer Ter Aa ferry across the Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal should be removed without a structural alternative, why there was no public participation, and whether a bridge or budget is available. The minister answered that no final decision has been taken, that the ferry is a nautical safety risk, that an alternative cycle route is safe though longer, and that talks with the municipality continue.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht 'Rijbewijs halen? Dan moet je bij deze rijschool minstens één keer in een elektrische auto lessen?'

An MP asked the minister whether driving schools offer lessons in electric cars, whether the curriculum and CBR exams cover EV-specific skills, and how government encourages EV lessons. The minister answered that reliable data are lacking, that schools choose their own curriculum, and that the government will pursue pilots, national working groups and EU action on the automatic-transmission code, but made no binding commitment on a driving-school EV plan beyond exploring options.
Inquiries with the driving school sector show that reliable figures are not available.
Uit navraag bij de rijscholenbranche komt naar voren dat betrouwbare cijfers niet voorhanden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het bericht ‘Woede en verbijstering, Rijkswaterstaat wil na 130 jaar pontje Nieuwer ter Aa opdoeken: Onacceptabel’

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the Nieuwer ter Aa ferry is being taken out of service despite heavy use by schoolchildren, whether the route is safe, and whether a bridge must be built first. The Minister answers that the ferry poses navigation risks from larger ships on the Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal, that a decision is not yet final, that a safe alternative cycling route exists, and that the municipality is responsible for any replacement bridge.
That is why we intend to take the ferry De Aa out of service, but we are still consulting with the municipality.
Daarom hebben we het voornemen om de veerpont De Aa uit de vaart te nemen, maar we zijn nog in overleg met de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jansen over snelwegverlichting en reflectoren

An MP from FvD asked the minister how many km of motorway lack lighting, whether lighting is essential for safety and will be expanded, and whether road-surface reflectors between the centre lines should be studied. The minister answered that about 1,300 of roughly 2,500 km is unlit, that lighting is installed on busier roads and night-time switch-offs are being reversed, and that earlier studies found reflectors impractical, so no further research is planned.
This spring I will inform your House about this in more detail.
Dit voorjaar zal ik uw Kamer hierover nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de restricties die veel landen nu opleggen aan Aeroflot en andere Russische luchtvaartmaatschappijen

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether KLM should keep code-sharing with Aeroflot and whether the Netherlands will close its airspace to Russian civil aviation. The minister answered that KLM has suspended the code-sharing with Aeroflot and that Dutch airspace has been closed to Russian aviation, but did not address whether the alliance choice was otherwise desirable beyond citing commercial reasons.
KLM has suspended the code sharing with Aeroflot and is working on the technical implementation of this.
KLM heeft de code sharing met Aeroflot opgeschort en is bezig met de technische verwerking daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de staking van veerschippers bij de Maasveren

An SP MP asked the ministers whether they would intervene when the Maasveren ferry company sidelines the FNV union in wage negotiations with striking ferry crews, and whether the ferries should be brought into public hands. The ministers replied that collective bargaining is a matter for social partners under freedom of contract, that ferry responsibility lies with municipalities and provinces, and that they would not take further action.
In the Netherlands the principle of freedom of contract applies. Social partners themselves decide with whom they sit down at the table and make agreements.
In Nederland geldt het principe van contractsvrijheid. Sociale partners bepalen zelf met wie ze om tafel gaan zitten en afspraken maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Houwelingen over Known Traveller Digital Identity (KTDI) van het World Economic Forum (WEF) van 12 januari 2022

MP Van Houwelingen asked whether the Dutch government is a KTDI pilot partner of the World Economic Forum and requested all related documents. The state secretary confirmed the Netherlands was approached in 2018, joined a public-private consortium with a 2019 letter of intent signed by the ambassador to Canada, and that the pilot is now very uncertain; documents were promised before summer.
This request is extensive and takes time. I aim to send you these documents before the summer.
Dit verzoek is omvangrijk en kost tijd. Ik streef ernaar u deze documenten voor de zomer te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat de ouders van Gio (4) het stilzwijgen verbreken na een dodelijk ongeluk met voetballer Vloet

An MP asked the minister about a fatal crash involving footballer Vloet, the club's social and road-safety role, and penalties and campaigns against extreme speeding and drink driving. The minister gave a mostly general answer, declining to comment on the specific case, deferring club decisions to the clubs, and describing existing campaigns, penalty levels and an expert group under way.
Furthermore, I will not go into this specific situation as the case is still under investigation.
Verder ga ik niet in op deze specifieke situatie gezien de zaak nog in onderzoek is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Gebiedsverboden en mobiele flitspalen: zo wil Haagse VVD verkeersaso’s aanpakken'

MPs Koerhuis and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked the ministers about enforcement of traffic rules on municipal roads, the number and use of speed cameras, and how the Public Prosecution Service decides where to place them. The government answered that enforcement is set locally by the tripartite consultation (mayor, police, prosecution), that flitspaal placement follows a published policy framework, and that it will inform the House in early 2022 on new enforcement tools for notorious offenders.
Police deployment for traffic enforcement is determined locally in the tripartite consultation (mayor, police and Public Prosecution Service).
De inzet van de politie op verkeershandhaving wordt lokaal in de driehoek (burgemeester, politie en OM) bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over de snelheidsbegrenzer in nieuwe auto’s

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the mandatory intelligent speed assistance (ISA) in new cars: its privacy safeguards, sign-recognition error margins, possible tax use of data, and whether it could later become compulsory for existing cars. The minister answered that ISA only warns the driver, stores no data on trips or drivers, is not planned to become mandatory retroactively, and cannot be used for taxation.
ISA does not record any data about the trip or about the driver.
ISA legt geen gegevens vast over de rit danwel over de bestuurder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wuite en Boucke over het artikel 'Bonaire krijgt een E-Flight Academy voor elektrisch vliegen'

MPs Wuite and Boucke (D66) asked about a plan for an electric flight academy on Bonaire, the outcomes of a student challenge, the masterplan for electric aviation in the Caribbean, public service obligations on inter-island routes, and exclusion of Caribbean Netherlands from electric vehicle and energy subsidies. The minister answered most questions substantively, noting the masterplan, the challenge winners, a forthcoming exploration of public service obligations in the autumn, and that subsidy questions fall under the climate and energy minister.
Following this evaluation, the possibility is being explored of using the public service obligation instrument to better safeguard accessibility of this part of the Netherlands.

Naar aanleiding van deze evaluatie wordt de mogelijkheid verkend om het instrument van de openbaredienstverplichting in te zetten teneinde de bereikbaarheid van dit deel van Nederland beter te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over het bericht 'Luchtvaartonderzoek houdt vliegherrie buiten beeld, waarschuwt GGD'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the aviation cost-benefit guidance should adopt the WHO noise thresholds and monetise noise as the UK does, after GGD criticism. The minister defended the guidance as an independently prepared first version, promised further research and a second opinion for state-involved analyses, and committed to updating the guidance later.

Yes, as the guidance states, when an MKBA is drawn up for an airport (traffic) decision for Schiphol and airports of national significance, for which central government is the competent authority, the ministry should commission a second opinion.

Ja, zoals ook in de werkwijzer staat aangegeven is het gewenst dat indien een MKBA wordt opgesteld ten behoeve van een luchthaven(verkeer)besluit voor Schiphol en de luchthavens van nationale betekenis (waarvoor het Rijk het bevoegd gezag is) het ministerie een second opinion laat uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het verplichten van een snelheidsbegrenzer in nieuwe auto’s

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the mandatory intelligent speed assistant in new cars, including its privacy consequences, data recipients, insurance use, CO2 taxation and whether the systems can be permanently switched off. The minister answers that the system only compares speed with the limit, stores no data and shares nothing with third parties, that the EDR records only technical crash data, and that the ISA resets on each start but can be switched off for the rest of a trip.
For the speed assistant, no data are stored.
Voor de Snelheidsassistent geldt dat er geen data worden opgeslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over de trage afhandeling van verzoeken op basis van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur bij het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MP Madlener asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why Wob freedom-of-information requests at the ministry take so long, citing an Open State Foundation study. The minister acknowledges regular delays, disputes the study's page-based measure and the case count, and lists centralisation of handling, staffing increases, and digitisation as remedies, while noting courts can impose penalties for missed deadlines.
I attach great importance to handling Wob requests in a timely manner.
Ik hecht groot belang aan het tijdig afhandelen van Wob-verzoeken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het contact met de regio (Achterhoek en Twente) over de noordtak van de Betuwelijn en een verzoek om ter plaatste het traject te zien en het gesprek aan te gaan

An MP asked the minister about regional opposition to a northern branch of the Betuwe freight line, consultation with the Achterhoek and Twente, costs, and a request to visit and talk with residents. The state secretary replied that no decision has been taken, that consultation has been broad but without specific talks on the branch, and that a visit to the region is planned.
I cannot go into the possible consequences for Doetinchem, Haaksbergen, Hengelo/Oldenzaal.
Ik kan niet in gaan op de eventuele gevolgen voor Doetinchem, Haaksbergen, Hengelo/ Oldenzaal.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Michon-Derkzen over de berichten ‘Verkeerde waterstanden en gebrek aan regie: veel ging mis bij aanpak watersnood Limburg’ en ‘Waterschap was niet voorbereid op watersnood Limbur

MPs Minhas and Michon-Derkzen asked the ministers about press reports that the Limburg flood response suffered from wrong water-level forecasts and poor coordination, and about the water board's preparedness and the COT evaluation. The minister answered that the water board will implement the COT recommendations, that a flood emergency plan for the Heuvelland is being prepared, and that broader crisis-system reforms and risk mapping are underway, without giving a firm timeline for every point.
The Limburg Water Board is responsible for implementing the recommendations of the COT.
Het Waterschap Limburg is verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van de aanbevelingen van het COT.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Bikker over het bericht ‘Meer verkeersongelukken in 2021, politie maakt zich zorgen’

MPs Grinwis and Bikker asked about police concern over rising traffic accidents in 2021, including risky behaviour, nitrous oxide use in traffic, and the road safety targets and funding for dangerous N-roads. The minister outlined prevention and enforcement measures, said the nitrous oxide ban cannot take effect by 1 July 2022 due to procedure, and committed to a road safety target and prioritisation of N-road investments.
The cabinet is committed to reducing traffic participation under the influence of all drugs, and specifically nitrous oxide.
Het kabinet zet zich ervoor in om verkeersdeelname onder invloed van alle drugs, en ook specifiek van lachgas, terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over Rijtestlocatie terugbrengen naar Terneuzen

An MP asked the minister why the CBR driving test location in Terneuzen was moved to Goes, arguing that older residents of Zeeuws-Vlaanderen now face longer trips, tolls and unequal treatment. The minister defended the 2016 evaluation and concentration of locations, said the same national criteria apply everywhere, and declined to reinstate tests in Terneuzen.
I will inform your House shortly, as requested by MP de Hoop during the procedural meeting of 1 February, about the medical assessments for driving fitness.
Ik zal uw Kamer conform het verzoek van het lid de Hoop tijdens de regeling van werkzaamheden van 1 februari op korte termijn nader informeren over de medische keuringen voor rijgeschiktheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over ‘de beruchte bocht bij de afrit A1 richting snelweg A30 bij Barneveld’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the causes of frequent accidents at a sharp bend near Barneveld, what measures have been taken or considered, and the timeline for reconstruction. The minister reported accident patterns, existing signage measures, a voorkeursalternatief already adopted, and that further willingness to talk with stakeholders exists while large-scale measures are not planned pending reconstruction.
There are no measuring loops in the bend in question. The speed at which accidents occurred therefore cannot be stated exactly.
In de bewuste bocht liggen geen meetlussen. De snelheid waarbij ongelukken plaatsvonden kan daarom niet exact worden aangegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'Na 40 jaar verwaarlozing ligt het lot van Lange Jaap in de handen van Mark Harbers'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how the Lange Jaap lighthouse's maintenance history unfolded, why cracks noted in 1998 led to no action, and who would bear costs of repair, demolition or rebuilding. The minister answered that cracks were found in 1998, reinforcements were agreed with the municipality and heritage body in 2001-2002, the priority is preserving the tower, costs cannot yet be estimated, and an external review of the process has been requested.
My attention is now first focused on preserving the tower if that is technically and safely possible.
Mijn aandacht is nu eerst gericht op het behouden van de toren indien dat technisch en veilig mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over de eis van goedkeuring door een andere rijschool voordat een kandidaat mag afrijden

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the CBR plans to require a second driving school's approval before a candidate may take the practical driving test, and related questions on fraud and cost impacts. The minister denied that such a requirement is under consideration, explained that a pilot on collegial assessment is being prepared, and said a full response to the Roemer advice will follow.
No, the CBR is currently not considering asking driving schools to have the approval of another driving school before a candidate can take the practical exam.
Nee, het CBR overweegt momenteel niet om aan rijscholen te verzoeken om een goedkeuring van een andere rijschool te hebben alvorens een kandidaat praktijkexamen kan doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Van Wijngaarden en Koerhuis over de actuele veiligheidsrisico’s voor Nederlanders in Oekraïne

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Infrastructure about security risks for Dutch nationals in Ukraine, including travel advice, evacuation preparations and airspace safety. The government answered that there is no reason yet to speak of a threatening situation, kept the current travel advice, said evacuation is not being organised, and pointed to existing EU and national airspace risk assessments.
That number need not be representative of the actual number of Dutch nationals in Ukraine, because there is no registration obligation for Dutch nationals abroad (due to privacy).
Dat getal hoeft niet per se representatief te zijn voor het daadwerkelijke aantal Nederlanders in Oekraïne, omdat er geen registratieplicht is voor Nederlanders in het buitenland (vanwege privacy).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Nederland stuurt Yezidi’s terug naar de tentenkampen en dat is tegen de eigen regels zeggen advocaten’

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the IND returns Yezidi asylum seekers to Iraqi Kurdistan camps that the UNHCR considers unsafe, and how it assesses conditions there. The State Secretary answered that cases are assessed individually, that Yezidis displaced from other parts of Iraq are now treated as coming from Central Iraq under the vulnerable minorities policy, and that the ministry will review the position in the next country report.
I have asked the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to pay extra attention to the Yezidis in the upcoming general country report on Iraq, which I expect early next year.
Ik heb het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken gevraagd bij het komende algemeen ambtsbericht over Irak, dat ik begin volgend jaar verwacht, extra aandacht te besteden aan de jezidi's
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het uitzetten van Yezidi’s

MP Van Ojik (GroenLinks) asked whether the state secretary intends to deport Yezidis to Kurdish refugee camps in Iraq, citing UNHCR concerns about capacity and the group's vulnerable status. The state secretary replied that asylum claims are assessed individually, that the Kurdish Autonomous Region is no longer treated as the normal residence for Yezidis arriving from other parts of Iraq, and that the vulnerable-minority policy applies to them.
I have exceptionally asked the Repatriation and Departure Service to manually review the files of Iraqi nationals in immigration detention.
Ik heb bij uitzondering de Dienst Terugkeer en Vertrek gevraagd om handmatig de dossiers van Irakese staatburgers die in vreemdelingenbewaring zitten door te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘IND schendt godsdienstvrijheid Chinese christenen’

MP Bisschop asked whether the IND may rule on theological questions about baptism and reincarnation, and whether its reasoning on Chinese Christian asylum claims fits the government's own analysis of restricted religious freedom in China. The Staatssecretaris answered that the IND does not take theological positions but may ask follow-up questions on the claimant's religious practice, that it relies on official country reports for facts, that state interference in China is acknowledged and assessed case by case, and that claimants need not conceal their faith or join only registered churches.
It is not the task nor the intention of the IND to take its own position on theological issues and the interpretation of the Bible.
Het is niet de taak en ook niet de intentie van de IND om een eigen standpunt in te nemen ten aanzien van theologische kwesties en de interpretatie van de Bijbel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over de ongerustheid in Amsterdam rond de pilot landelijke vreemdelingen voorziening (LVV)

An MP from the VVD asks the State Secretary of Justice and Security about local unrest in Amsterdam over the national reception pilot for irregular migrants (LVV), including the alderman's stance on enforcement, police discretion, site selection and resident consultation. The State Secretary confirms the pilot's departure-oriented approach, states that police migration enforcement is under her authority, says site selection and resident consultation are municipal responsibilities, and promises a letter after the summer and a WODC evaluation.
I will inform your House after the summer about the state of affairs regarding the development of the pilot LVVs.
Ik zal uw Kamer na de zomer informeren over de stand van de zaken wat betreft de ontwikkeling van de pilot-LVV's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over vluchtelingenkinderen op straat door verkeerde registratie

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about unaccompanied minors from Eritrea left on the street after age registration errors in Italy, and whether the IND's practice of treating them as adults when a shouw is inconclusive is sound. The State Secretary defended the practice under the interstate trust principle, said nothing forces people onto the street, and declined to include these cases in the study of minors who left with unknown destination.
If the inspection shows doubt about the claimed minority, the IND, on the basis of the interstate trust principle, accepts the age registered in another member state, even when this shows adulthood.

Als de schouw uitwijst dat er twijfel bestaat over de gestelde minderjarigheid, neemt de IND op grond van het interstatelijk vertrouwensbeginsel de in een andere lidstaat geregistreerde leeftijd aan, ook wanneer hieruit meerderjarigheid blijkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Ronnes over het bericht 'Overloon vraagt om actie tegen ‘foute vluchtelingen’'

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about residents of Overloon reporting an asylum centre with disproportionate nuisance from a small group of asylum seekers, and feelings of powerlessness, including advice to residents to get a dog, install a fence and report incidents. The State Secretary denied advising residents to get dogs or fences, acknowledged the nuisance, described stepped-up measures (including faster transfers to the EBTL facility) and stated that the Overloon-specific details and wider measures would be reported before summer recess.
On the progress of the measures I will inform your House extensively by letter before the summer recess.
Over de vorderingen van de maatregelen zal ik uw Kamer voor het zomerreces uitgebreid per brief informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Segers over het bericht ‘Verscherpte aanpak klanten van jeugdprostitutie door politie en OM’

MPs Kuik and Segers asked the Justice minister about OM and police plans to target clients of youth prostitution, including numbers of minor victims, prosecutions of clients, reporting, use of online lure profiles, and EU comparisons. The minister answered that 107 suspects were prosecuted in 2015-2018 with 93 convicted, that sentencing has moved toward unconditional prison terms, and that the Samen tegen Mensenhandel programme has no specific client-side measures and no data on mandatory client reports.
No figures are currently available on the number of mandatory reports by clients of suspected sexual exploitation of minors, because such figures are not recorded in this way by the police.

Er zijn op dit moment geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal verplichte meldingen door klanten bij vermoedens van seksuele uitbuiting van minderjarigen, omdat cijfers niet op deze wijze worden geregistreerd bij de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Becker over het bericht ‘Koppositie Schiphol als poort naar VS onder druk’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that US pressure threatens Schiphol's position and about the state of the pre-clearance negotiations, including costs, benefits and the government's role. The minister replied that there is no pressure, that the negotiations are ongoing, that any treaty must comply with Dutch, EU and international law and that parliament will approve the treaty after negotiations conclude.
Afterwards the treaty will be submitted to parliament for approval.
Daarna zal het verdrag ter goedkeuring aan het parlement worden voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over verdwenen Vietnamese kinderen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about Vietnamese unaccompanied minors disappearing from protected reception, including whether the government will investigate possible trafficking and act to prevent further disappearances. The State Secretary confirmed roughly 1,400 unaccompanied minors left reception since 2014 (about 40 Vietnamese from protected care), said disappearances cannot be fully prevented, and committed to an EMM phenomenon study and data analysis with results due in autumn 2019.
In addition, I am having an analysis carried out of data available within the migration chain on the disappearances of unaccompanied minors from reception facilities.
Daarnaast laat ik een analyse uitvoeren van binnen de migratieketen beschikbare gegevens over de verdwijningen van amv’s
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Kuiken en Ploumen over de toegang weigeren van een haatprediker tot Nederland

MPs Van den Hul, Kuiken and Ploumen asked whether the government would refuse entry to a preacher whose statements about LGBTI people and the Holocaust they condemned, and what legal powers exist to deny or expel him. The Secretary of State answered that hate speech has no place in the Dutch rule of law, referred to the earlier integrated approach to extremist speakers and the LGBTI safety action plan, and stated that measures have been taken to prevent the person's entry into the Schengen zone.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Buitenweg over het bericht ‘COC wil dat Nederland Amerikaanse haatprediker weert’

MPs Bergkamp and Buitenweg asked whether the Netherlands can refuse entry to US preacher Steven Anderson and prosecute or prevent his hate speech, and whether the government will act. The State Secretary answered that entry can be refused under Schengen rules and extremist speakers can be barred under existing instruments, that Dutch criminal law cannot prosecute speech made abroad, and that contact with the municipality exists, while declining to comment on other countries' decisions.
I cannot provide information about possible refusals of entry by other countries.
Over eventuele toegangsweigeringen van andere landen kan ik geen informatie geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azmani en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht dat COC wil dat Nederland Amerikaanse haatprediker weert

VVD MPs Azmani and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked whether the US preacher Steve Anderson, who has made hateful statements about LGBT people, could be barred from the Netherlands, whether Dutch authorities could prevent his public appearances, and whether the EU could jointly blacklist such preachers. The government referred the core questions to earlier answers, said the EU partner states had been informed at official level, and said it will keep raising the issue in the EU ministers' group on extremist speakers.
I refer you for these questions to the answers to the questions from MPs Van den Hul, Kuiken and Ploumen (PvdA) on refusing a hate preacher entry to the Netherlands.
Ik verwijs u voor deze vragen naar de beantwoording van de vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Kuiken en Ploumen (PvdA) over de toegang weigeren van een haatprediker tot Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het staken van reddingsacties op de Middellandse Zee

An SP MP asks the State Secretary why naval ships under EU operation Sophia were withdrawn, how rescue and smuggling interdiction are guaranteed, how the Libyan coast guard is monitored, whether the remaining ships carried helicopters and medical facilities, and whether Libyans have a right to asylum in Europe, along with questions on non-refoulement, detention centres and root causes of migration. The government answers that the remaining ships had helicopters and medical facilities, that asylum applications are assessed individually, that Libyan coast guard rescues do not amount to refoulement, and that it is pressing for registration systems and detention reform while pursuing an integrated migration agenda.
The cabinet is following developments closely.
Het kabinet volgt de ontwikkelingen nauwgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Van Aalst over de asielbus tussen Ter Apel en Emmen

Two MPs from the PVV asked whether a pilot shuttle bus between Ter Apel and Emmen rewards asylum seekers who intimidate bus staff, and whether a shuttle to Marrakech should replace it. The State Secretary answered that nuisance is unacceptable and the bus is a temporary pilot within a broader Top-X approach to the most serious nuisance offenders, and refused the Marrakech proposal.
Regarding the arrangement of the transport, further agreements will be made in the short term with carriers and other stakeholders.
Over de invulling van het vervoer worden op korte termijn nadere afspraken gemaakt met vervoerders en andere betrokkenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over uitspraken van de Raad van State inzake jihadisten

The MP asks whether the Dutch government is sure two jihadists identified in Raad van State rulings are not in the Netherlands, and whether it will ensure they never return and are imprisoned and deported if they do. The minister declines to comment on individual cases, says the State Secretary is examining the rulings' consequences for citizenship revocations, and describes the steps for returnees including arrest, prosecution and possible revocation of Dutch nationality.
The State Secretary is currently examining the Raad van State ruling to see what it means for these and other already taken decisions to revoke Dutch nationality.
Momenteel onderzoekt de Staatssecretaris de uitspraak van de Raad van State om te bezien wat dit betekent voor deze en andere reeds genomen besluiten tot intrekking Nederlanderschap
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Tielen over het bericht ‘Ook asielzoeker krijgt hulp bij eerwraak’

MPs Becker and Tielen asked the government about reports of honour-based violence and threats against asylum seekers in reception centres, including how many cases were recorded, whether perpetrators were removed, and whether residence permits were revoked. The State Secretary answered that COA-registration is limited for safety reasons, that perpetrators can be moved to an EBTL and victims to women's shelters, and that the government will audit social safety in late 2019 and agree with municipalities to fund shelter access for victims awaiting residence decisions.
Quantitative information on the number of reports made to Veilig Thuis is currently not available.
Kwantitatieve informatie omtrent het aantal meldingen gedaan bij Veilig Thuis is op dit moment echter niet voor handen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ojik over oplichters die in het bezit zijn van gegevens van Kinderpardonaanvragers

An MP asked whether the state secretary knows of reports that Kinderpardon applicants are called by fraudsters demanding fees, and how such people could know who applied. The state secretary confirmed the reports, said it is unknown how fraudsters obtain applicant names, described the IND's website warning and internal investigation, and said the Bureau Integriteit is looking into the reported call.
The IND's Bureau Integriteit is, however, investigating this report with further information from VWN.
Wel verricht het Bureau Integriteit van de IND met nadere informatie van VWN onderzoek naar deze melding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een visumplicht voor Albanezen

An SP MP asked the government about reintroducing a visa requirement for Albanian nationals, citing criminality, overstaying, asylum claims and irregular migration. The ministers answered that registered Albanian suspects are declining, that the visa requirement was lifted after Albania met the conditions, and that reintroduction would need broad EU support, so they will keep using cooperation and may revisit the emergency brake later.
In 2010 the visa requirement for citizens of Albanian nationality was abolished, after it was established that Albania meets the conditions for this.
In 2010 is de visumplicht voor burgers met de Albanese nationaliteit afgeschaft, nadat was vastgesteld dat Albanië voldoet aan de voorwaarden hiervoor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Den Boer en Sjoerdsma over een oppositieleider die vastzit in een Tadzjiekse gevangenis

MPs from D66 asked the government about opposition leader Gadojev, detained in Tajikistan after apparently being arrested in Russia, and whether Interpol listings are being misused against political critics. The government replied that Gadojev returned to the Netherlands with consular help via the German embassy, that Interpol's rules forbid political interventions but full guarantees cannot be given, and that human rights are raised regularly in bilateral and multilateral settings.
However, I cannot speculate on the circumstances in individual cases listed on the Interpol list.
Ik kan echter niet speculeren over de toedracht in individuele casussen die op de Interpol-lijst staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het bericht 'Kabinet komt afspraken hervestiging kwetsbare vluchtelingen niet meer na'

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the State Secretary about reports that the cabinet would not honour resettlement commitments for vulnerable refugees, including a shortfall of 610 against 750 selected in 2018 and whether this breaks agreements. The State Secretary answered that resettlement is voluntary, that the shortfall in 2018 will not be compensated, that the claimed backlog is based on a misreading of arrival versus selection figures, that UNHCR expressed concern, and that the national quota of 500 per year is maintained.
Resettlement is a humanitarian programme that countries carry out on a voluntary basis; it is not an obligation.
Hervestiging is een humanitair programma dat landen op vrijwillige basis uitvoeren, het betreft geen verplichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘IND voorkomt principiële uitspraak over staatlozen in Nederland’

An MP from D66 asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security why the IND and DT&V revised a statelessness case late, how responsibility is divided between them, how the burden of proof for statelessness registration works, and how other EU countries handle residence for stateless people. The State Secretary answers that the DT&V assesses individual circumstances under the buitenschuld policy, that stateless persons are not automatically entitled to a residence permit, that municipalities are cautious in registering statelessness in the BRP, and that practice varies across the EU, referring to attached reports.
There is no referral to the buitenschuld procedure.
Er is geen sprake van een doorverwijzing naar de buitenschuldprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over onveiligheid in asielzoekerscentra

An MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about violence and threats against staff in asylum reception centres, prompted by a union's alarm, and whether the problem is structural and whether those responsible are mainly from safe countries. The State Secretary acknowledges the problem, points to incident registration and an Inspectorate report, and describes existing and planned measures without committing to new concrete steps.
In April I will inform your House about the status of these recommendations.
In april zal ik uw Kamer informeren over de status hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een onderzoek van FNV naar onveiligheid en geweld in asielzoekerscentra

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about an FNV study reporting serious aggression against COA asylum-centre staff, linking it to asylum seekers from safe countries, staffing, staff voice and a new facility for disruptive residents. State Secretary Harbers acknowledged the problem, said the government pursues return agreements with safe countries, pointed to existing measures and the EBTL pilot, promised to inform parliament after the Inspectorate's recommendations, and maintained that intensified measures are ongoing.
I have started working on the Inspectorate's recommendations and will inform your House about them soon.
Ik ben aan de slag gegaan met de aanbevelingen van de Inspectie en zal uw Kamer binnenkort hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Onverbeterlijke criminele asielzoeker heeft vrij spel’

CDA MPs asked whether criminal asylum seekers move between reception centres without follow-up or shared records, and whether a national database should be created, citing police criticism. The State Secretary said existing registration and information-sharing have been improved and that a new database would take long, so existing structures will be used in the short term, and he denied that transfers merely shift the problem.
At the JBZ committee meeting on 6 March I indicated that I am willing to examine whether an additional database would add value.
Tijdens het AO JBZ op 6 maart jl. heb ik aangegeven dat ik bereid ben te kijken of een additionele databank meerwaarde heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van Ojik over het bericht 'Sea-Watch 3 op last van Nederland aan ketting gelegd'

MPs Kröger and Van Ojik asked why the Dutch government requested Italy to detain the Sea-Watch 3 rescue ship, whether this conflicted with earlier assurances to NGOs, and about rescue capacity in the Mediterranean. The minister answered that the ILT inspection followed Italian port-state findings, that safety comes first, that the inspection was not caused by foreign pressure, and that the ship is not chained, while largely refusing to explain policy-change timing and deferring to the letter for detailed conclusions.
The Netherlands asked Italy not to grant the ship permission to sail while the investigation was ongoing.
Nederland heeft Italië verzocht het schip geen toestemming te verlenen om uit te varen zolang het onderzoek liep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Europa stopt met oppikken van vluchtelingen op Middellandse Zee’

An MP asked whether EU operation Sophia in the Mediterranean was being halted, who would take over its work, how monitoring of the Libyan coast guard and rights compliance is ensured, and what the consequences of stopping it would be for migrant rescue and smuggling. The minister answered that Sophia is not stopped but its mandate was extended unchanged for six months, with the two ships recalled to port and surveillance and Libyan coast guard support strengthened, and that the government will keep monitoring the Libyan coast guard critically.
Operation Sophia has not been halted.
De operatie Sophia is niet stilgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Maeijer over de juridische werking van het Migratiepact van Marrakesh

PVV MPs asked the government to confirm the authenticity of a leaked European Commission legal note suggesting the UN Global Compact for Migration could have binding effects via EU law, and asked why ministers had said the Compact was not legally binding. The government answered that the Commission described the note as an unofficial document by an individual staff member, that the Compact remains legally non-binding and creates no enforceable rights, and that the earlier legal analysis stands.
The fact remains that the Compact is a legally non-binding document and does not generate enforceable rights.
Feit blijft dat het Compact een juridisch niet-bindend document is en geen afdwingbare rechten genereert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het bericht dat een door Nederland uitgezette asielzoeker uit Bahrein zonder eerlijk proces is veroordeeld tot levenslang

An MP asked whether the Dutch government would acknowledge that the deportation of a Bahraini asylum seeker, later sentenced to life imprisonment without a fair trial, breached non-refoulement, and what it would do about his case. The state secretary refused to discuss individual case details citing privacy, rejected the non-refoulement claim as not established on the information available at the time, and said it would raise concerns with Bahraini authorities and follow the appeal.
Out of respect for personal privacy, I am not free to make individual facts and circumstances from an asylum file public.
Met het oog op de eerbiediging van de persoonlijke levenssfeer, ben ik niet vrij individuele feiten en omstandigheden uit een asieldossier in de openbaarheid te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het bericht dat een uitgezette asielzoeker in Bahrein levenslang kreeg

PvdA MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked whether the deteriorating human rights situation in Bahrain, and reports that a deported asylum seeker received a life sentence there, should change asylum policy toward Bahrainis and whether the discretionary power should have been used. State Secretary Harbers answered that the IND takes the worsened situation into account in individual asylum assessments, that refoulement is excluded where a real risk exists, and that the discretionary power was not applicable because protection law governs such cases.
I refer you to my answer to question 2.
Ik verwijs u naar mijn antwoord op vraag 2.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Uitgezette Bahreini zonder eerlijk proces veroordeeld tot levenslang’

MPs Groothuizen and Voordewind asked the State Secretary about reports that a deported Bahraini asylum seeker was sentenced to life imprisonment after an unfair trial, including questions on torture reports, monitoring, Sudan deportations and independent investigation. The government answered that it monitors the case via the Kuwait embassy, cannot confirm torture reports, declines an independent inquiry and deportation suspension, and says it will request an updated Sudan country report.
Out of respect for private life, I am not free to make individual facts and circumstances from an asylum file public.
Met het oog op de eerbiediging van de persoonlijke levenssfeer, ben ik niet vrij individuele feiten en omstandigheden uit een asieldossier in de openbaarheid te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Vrouwelijke IS’er wil naar Nederland’

An MP from the CDA asked how a female IS member married to a Dutch citizen could obtain Dutch nationality, whether marriages in IS-controlled areas are recognised, whether her children could secure residence, and whether Dutch nationality can be blocked or withdrawn in national security cases. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, set out the general naturalisation conditions and the national security grounds for refusal, and said information from other countries will be considered where possible.
As you know, I do not comment on individual cases.
Zoals u weet ga ik niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Recordaantal migranten: Griekenland bezwijkt opnieuw onder grote toestroom’

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the government about reports of record migrant arrivals in Greece, the CPT's criticism of camp conditions, and whether Europe should relocate people from the Greek islands. The State Secretary answered that the government urges Greece and the Commission for structural solutions via faster asylum and return procedures, rejects further transfers or relocations as a fix, and sees some improvements in Greek camp conditions.
More transfers to the mainland or new efforts to relocate asylum seekers from Greece do not contribute to that.
Meer transfers naar het vasteland of nieuwe inspanningen om asielzoekers vanuit Griekenland te herplaatsen, dragen daar niet aan bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over de Rapportage Vreemdelingenketen januari-juni 2018

MPs Groothuizen and Voordewind asked about the 2018 resettlement quota, missions, Turkey-related resettlement and selection withdrawals. The State Secretary reported about 610 selections and 530 arrivals under the national quota, cut the 2019 quota to 500, and admitted earlier Turkey figures in the Rapportage were wrong.
The national quota you ask about is part of the multi-year resettlement policy framework 2016–2019.
Het nationale quotum waarnaar wordt gevraagd maakt deel uit van het meerjarig beleidskader hervestiging 2016–2019.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Bergkamp en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Deze gastarbeiders zijn oud in een land dat een tussenstop had moeten zijn’

D66 MPs asked the ministers of Health and Social Affairs about reports that older guest workers face poorer health, reduced AOW pensions, and low remigration uptake, and what support or follow-up is planned. The government answered that it cannot precisely estimate pension counts, that AOW reductions average about 32.5% falling to 27.8%, that care is meant to be person-centred with programmes like Langer Thuis and Een tegen Eenzaamheid, and that remigration uptake may be affected by pension levels, family ties and health care in the origin country.
I have instructed that the knowledge gained about what works and what does not be bundled.
Ik heb opdracht gegeven om de geleerde kennis over wat werkt en wat niet te bundelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over Dublinoverdrachten naar Griekenland

An MP asked how many Dublin transfers occurred last year, how many Dublin claims were accepted, and whether the government finds the return figures for Greece acceptable. The Secretary of State reported 1,870 completed transfers and 7,330 accepted claims, admitted very low effectuation for Greece, and outlined reforms and a legal amendment to enable forced transfers.
The cabinet sees shortcomings in the current Dublin system and would like to see an increase in the number of Dublin transfers carried out.
Het kabinet ziet tekortkomingen in het huidige Dublinsysteem en zou graag een verhoging in het aantal geëffectueerde Dublinoverdrachten zien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders over de kinderen die bij het kinderpardon zijn afgewezen en nu een herbeoordeling krijgen zoals vermeld in de brief van 29 januari 2019

PVV MPs Fritsma and Wilders asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about household size, countries of origin, number of asylum and regular procedures, periods of illegal stay, IND appeals, and the use of the cooperation criterion for children rejected under the kinderpardon who now face re-assessment. The State Secretary answered that household size averages 2.2 members and gave the top five nationalities, but said the remaining data are not available in aggregate and require reviewing each file, with figures promised later this year in a letter on the Afsluitingsregeling.
The data requested in these questions are not available at an aggregated level.
De gegevens waar in deze vragen om wordt verzocht zijn niet op een geaggregeerd niveau beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het bericht dat de IND nauwelijks asielaanvragen van oorlogsvluchtelingen behandelt

Two PvdA MPs asked whether the IND rarely processes asylum applications from war refugees, whether this is deliberate deterrence, and what waiting times are. The State Secretary answered that war refugees are not a registered category, that priority goes to Dublin and safe-country cases, that waiting times are tracked only as processing times, and that extra staff are being recruited to shorten delays.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Van Nispen over het bericht dat slechte arbeidsomstandigheden en uitbuiting bij nagelsalons geen prioriteit hebben bij de Inspectie SZW

MPs Aartsen and Van Nispen asked why the Inspectorate SZW does not prioritise exploitation, illegal employment and underpayment in nail salons despite its stated priorities and warnings from the National Rapporteur on Human Trafficking and the Public Prosecution Service. The government replied that the Inspectorate runs a risk-based programme covering the wellness sector including nail studios, that 29 salons were inspected with violations found in half, that enforcement and signals receive continued attention, and that cooperation with police and partners exists, though exploitation is hard to detect.
Within this programme there is indeed attention for the wellness sector, and within it for nail studios.
Binnen dit programma is er wel degelijk aandacht voor de wellnessbranche, en daarbinnen voor nagelstudio's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Pieter Heerma over het bericht ‘Zorgen om uitbuiting in goedkope nagelsalons’

CDA MPs Kuik and Heerma asked the State Secretaries of Justice and Social Affairs about reported exploitation, human trafficking and money laundering in cheap nail salons. The government answered that few signals reach the Inspectorate or police, that it will keep attention on the sector, run a study within the inspection programme, and strengthen municipal anti-trafficking efforts and international cooperation.
The Inspectorate SZW has informed me upon request that addressing abuses in nail salons will continue to receive attention from the Inspectorate.
De Inspectie SZW heeft mij desgevraagd laten weten dat de aanpak van misstanden in de nagelsalons blijvende aandacht van de Inspectie heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over het rapport ‘Vulnerable and abandoned’ van Oxfam Novib

MPs Groothuizen and Voordewind asked the government about the Oxfam Novib report on vulnerable refugees on the Greek islands, covering medical care, vulnerability screening, EU expert deployment, detention conditions, safety of women and children, and EU funding. The State Secretary acknowledges shortcomings in medical staffing and reception, outlines the vulnerability procedures and expert numbers, and says the government will keep raising the issue with Greece and the Commission, without disclosing the content of diplomatic talks.
Given the confidentiality of diplomatic communications, I cannot go into the remarks of my Greek colleague.
In het kader van de vertrouwelijkheid van het diplomatieke verkeer, kan ik niet ingaan op de uitlatingen van mijn Griekse collega.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over de aanpak van criminele asielzoekers

An MP from PVV asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security what concrete steps had been taken to tighten EU rules on immigration detention and allow asylum applications of criminal asylum seekers to be rejected for sentences under six months, and which states support this. The State Secretary answered that the Commission presented a Return Directive revision in September 2018 at Dutch urging, that Dutch priorities are broader grounds for detention based on criminal conduct and simplified procedures, that a broad majority of member states agree on broadening, and that the six-month limit reflects the limit of what is possible under EU and refugee law.
The cabinet is of the view that we have reached the limit of what we can do on this point, respecting European rules.
Het kabinet is van oordeel dat we hiermee de grens hebben bereikt van wat we op dit punt kunnen doen met inachtneming van de Europese regels
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het rapport van Amnesty International Nederland inzake uitzettingen naar Soedan

An MP asked whether deportations to Sudan should be suspended in light of an Amnesty report on detention and torture of returnees, and whether the case of one individual should be halted. The Secretary of State answered that he sees no reason to adopt Amnesty's recommendations, stating that the asylum procedure already assesses Article 3 ECHR risks and he will monitor Sudan and act if needed.
I will not go further into individual cases.
Op individuele zaken ga ik verder niet in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over uitzettingen naar Soedan

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security how the ongoing popular unrest in Sudan (about 40 dead, 1,000 detained) affects the safety assessment for deportations, why no new Sudan country report has been published since 2017, and whether a decision and departure moratorium is planned. The State Secretary answers that the situation is monitored and risk groups are already covered, that a new country report is expected around June 2019, and that no moratorium or suspension of removals is currently warranted.
At this moment I see no reason to introduce a decision and departure moratorium for Sudan.
Op dit moment zie ik geen aanleiding om een besluit- en vertrekmoratorium in te stellen voor Soedan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over het bericht "IND huurt onderbetaalde krachten in"

Two PvdA MPs asked why temporary staff hired via agencies at the IND are paid less than permanent colleagues doing the same work, and whether this will be remedied and enforced in future tenders. The minister answered that the Waadi equal-pay rule applies but can be set aside by collective agreement, that pay is a matter between the agency and the worker, that the IND requires compliance via the framework contract, and that no extra conditions are considered necessary.
In case of underpayment, the employee can of course claim the back pay from the employer (in this case the staffing agency).
In geval van onderbetaling kan de werknemer uiteraard bij de werkgever (in dit geval het detacheringsbureau) dat achterstallig loon vorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Diertens en Bouali over het bericht 'Caribische eilanden kunnen grotere toestroom Venezolanen verwachten'

MPs Groothuizen, Diertens and Bouali asked whether UNHCR projections of a rising Venezuelan refugee flow to the Caribbean reflect a real threat, and about funding, detention, asylum procedures and rights on Aruba and Curaçao. The government answered that the UNHCR figures cover the wider Caribbean, that interceptions fell in 2018, that Curaçao has requested assistance on detention and the asylum procedure, and that asylum applications are assessed individually.

The Ministry of Justice and Security asks the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for a country report when a high number of asylum applications from nationals of a given country is lodged in the Netherlands.

Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid vraagt het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken om een ambtsbericht als er in Nederland een hoog aantal asielaanvragen wordt ingediend van personen uit een bepaald land.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Paternotte over het bericht 'Huizen zijn er wel, statushouders niet'

MPs Groothuizen and Paternotte asked the State Secretary why about 3,000 refugee status holders were housed less than the 22,000 target in 2018, why Den Bosch received fewer matches than its target, and whether municipalities are blamed for shortfalls caused by COA allocation. The State Secretary acknowledged the shortfall of 2,934, attributed it mainly to the housing market, COA matching criteria and family reunification, and said municipalities are not penalised for unmet targets that carry over to the next period.

I rely on effective enforcement by the supervisory body toward the municipalities concerned and on COA deploying smart allocation of the available permit holders to those municipalities that received too few matches in 2018.

Ik reken daarbij op effectieve handhaving door de toezichthouder ten aanzien van bedoelde gemeenten en de inzet van het COA bij het slim verdelen van de beschikbare vergunninghouders over die gemeenten die in 2018 te weinig koppelingen hebben gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het uitzetten van gewortelde kinderen in afwachting van een Kinderpardon

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether deportations of rooted children who have lived in the Netherlands over five years while awaiting their residence procedure would be suspended, and whether their cases would be reassessed under discretionary power. The State Secretary referred to his letter of 29 January 2019 on the coalition's new agreements, including ending the DRLVK regulation and reassessing applications of those refused on the cooperation criterion, with transitional measures.
Among other things, I have taken the measure to end the Definitive Regulation for Long-Term Resident Children (DRLVK) as of 29 January 2019.
Ik heb onder andere de maatregel genomen om de Definitieve Regeling Langdurig Verblijvende Kinderen (DRLVK) per 29 januari 2019 te beëindigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de EU-missie EUCAP in Niger

An MP asks the government about the EU mission EUCAP Sahel Niger, the funding for alternative livelihoods for former smugglers in Agadez, and alleged police corruption shown in a VPRO documentary. The minister answers that the EU spent 31 million euros on the mission, of which the Netherlands contributes about 5% via the EU budget, and describes the PAIERA programme where 287 of 981 eligible applications were funded in a pilot, with 694 placed on a waiting list for a second phase.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over de aanpak van een Algerijn die bijna een Groningse held doodstak en over criminele Dublinclaimanten

An MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security how a Dutch-based Algerian offender who nearly killed a victim will be removed after his sentence and not return, whether Dublin claimants with criminal records can be kept out of the Netherlands, and whether the Netherlands should impose an asylum stop. The State Secretary declines to comment on individual cases, describes removal and Dublin transfer policy in general terms, notes that detention is used only under strict criteria, and rejects a total asylum stop as unrealistic.
In principle I do not comment on individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen doe ik in beginsel geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Groothuizen over gouden paspoorten en visa

MPs Den Boer and Groothuizen asked whether golden passports and golden visas, which let wealthy investors obtain EU residence or citizenship, pose crime and terrorism risks and whether the Netherlands should abolish its investor residence permit. The government acknowledged the risk if screening is inadequate, said Dutch investor permits are strictly checked, and promised an evaluation of the Modern Migration Policy Act in Q2 2019 and participation in EU-level discussion.
Based on this evaluation, it can in due course be assessed whether it is desirable to adjust admission schemes.
Op basis van deze evaluatie kan te zijner tijd worden beoordeeld of het wenselijk is dat toelatingsregelingen worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over de gevolgen van recente ontwikkelingen in de verhouding tussen Nederland en Iran voor het Nederlandse asielbeleid ten aanzien van Iran

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security how recent tensions with Iran, including reported Iranian involvement in killings in the Netherlands, affect Dutch asylum policy on Iran, including asylum numbers, risk groups and the Ahwazi. The State Secretary answered with asylum statistics, said the policy rests on the 2017 general country report and the individual assessment, and saw no reason to change the Iran country policy now.
I expect that the Ministry of Foreign Affairs will publish the new general country report on Iran in the spring.
Ik verwacht dat het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken in het voorjaar het nieuwe algemeen ambtsbericht over Iran publiceert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over het Oxfam rapport over vluchtelingenopvangkampen in Griekenland

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Kuiken asked about the Oxfam report on Greek refugee camps, including a death from cold, the lack of medical screening of vulnerable people, and contacts with EU partners. The State Secretary answered that Greece remains responsible, that the Netherlands repeatedly raises the issue with Greece and the Commission, and that it will be on the agenda of his next visit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het bericht dat drie passagiers zijn opgepakt in vliegtuig na protest tegen de uitzetting van vluchteling

An MP asked whether marechaussee officers threatened passengers with arrest and deleted footage, and whether force used to remove a protesting woman was proportionate. The government denied the threat and deletion claims, saying passengers were asked by the crew to stop filming and one deleted footage voluntarily, and described the force used as light and proportionate.
I do not recognise the picture painted in the article.
Ik herken mij in het beeld dat wordt geschetst in het artikel niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de afwezigheid van de IND in rechtszaken

An MP asked why the immigration service IND is often absent from court hearings on rejected asylum seekers, whether this harms due process, and what will be done to restore attendance. The State Secretary answered that IND attends only part of hearings due to high workload, that written submissions keep proceedings going, and that IND is recruiting about 35 extra staff to be present at nearly all hearings by year end.
The IND has now started a recruitment process aimed at having enough staff recruited, trained and onboarded by end 2019 to attend all hearings again.
De IND is inmiddels een wervingstraject gestart, dat erop gericht is om eind 2019 weer voldoende mensen te hebben geworven, opgeleid en ingewerkt om bij alle zittingen te kunnen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over promotieonderzoek naar de rechterlijke toetsing in het asielrecht

An MP asks the State Secretary about a PhD study concluding that judicial review in asylum cases is too deferential and that the IND's credibility assessments and the Council of State's case law weaken asylum seekers' protection. The State Secretary largely rejects these conclusions, arguing that judicial review has intensified since 2015, that EU and ECHR standards are met, and that the burden of proof is shared with the authorities.

The Dutch administrative law system of legal protection in asylum cases as a whole ensures that an asylum seeker in the Netherlands receives the protection to which he is entitled under EU law and the ECHR.

Het Nederlandse bestuursrechtelijke stelsel van rechtsbescherming in asielzaken als geheel waarborgt dat in Nederland een asielzoeker de bescherming wordt gegeven die hem op grond van het unierecht en het EVRM toekomt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht 'IND ontbreekt vaak in de rechtszaal bij zaken afgewezen asielzoekers'

An MP asked the State Secretary why the IND (immigration service) is absent from roughly 75% of asylum hearings and how this relates to its waiting-time problems and staffing. The State Secretary answered that the IND attends hearings in most cases but sends written positions in about 20% of cases, that absence does not automatically delay cases, and outlined recruitment and personnel planning measures.
In these cases a judgment was made not to attend the hearing and a written position was submitted.
In deze gevallen is een afweging gemaakt om niet ter zitting aanwezig te zijn en is een schriftelijk standpunt ingestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat migranten van Sea Watch welkom zijn in Nederland

PVV MP Fritsma asked the State Secretary whether the government agreed to take in migrants rescued by the Sea Watch ship, and argued this encourages people smuggling and illegality, asking for the decision to be reversed and an asylum stop. The State Secretary answered that Nederland upholds the duty to rescue at sea but will no longer take migrants from Sea Watch 3 in principle, refused to reverse the decision or impose an asylum stop, and said the approach is aimed at controlling migration and combating smuggling.

However, I have informed the European Commission that the Netherlands, without a concrete prospect of a structural solution, will no longer participate in ad hoc measures within the framework of disembarkation.

Wel heb ik de Europese Commissie laten weten dat Nederland, zonder concreet perspectief op een structurele oplossing, in het vervolg niet meer zal deelnemen aan ad hoc maatregelen in het kader van de ontscheping.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het bericht dat een asielzoeker uit Bahrein na zijn uitzetting direct is gearresteerd

An MP asked whether an asylum seeker deported to Bahrain was arrested and tortured on arrival, whether the IND assessed non-refoulement correctly, and whether a Bahrain-specific moratorium or new assessment is warranted. The State Secretary declined to comment on the individual case citing privacy, said Bahrain has no country-specific asylum policy, acknowledged worsened human rights, and refused a moratorium or new assessment while promising no concrete action.
As your House is aware, for reasons of privacy of the person concerned I cannot make statements about individual cases and possible deportations.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend kan ik in verband met de privacy van de betrokken persoon geen uitspraken doen over individuele zaken en eventuele uitzettingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over een naar Bahrein uitgezette man

MPs Van Dijk and Karabulut asked whether a rejected asylum seeker deported to Bahrain was arrested and possibly mistreated, why the IND did not weigh this risk, and whether deportations to Bahrain should be suspended with an independent investigation. The State Secretary declined to comment on the individual case citing privacy, said the IND assesses each application on its merits and acknowledges worsening human rights, but refused a moratorium or investigation, while promising to monitor developments.
As your House is aware, in connection with the privacy of the person concerned I cannot make statements about individual cases and possible deportations.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend kan ik in verband met de privacy van de betrokken persoon geen uitspraken doen over individuele zaken en eventuele uitzettingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over het bericht 'Asielzoeker uit Bahrein na gedwongen vertrek uit Nederland meteen gearresteerd'

Two MPs asked whether the Netherlands deported a Bahraini asylum seeker who was arrested on arrival, and about his legal status, access to counsel, risk groups and whether deportations to Bahrain should be suspended. The Secretary of State declined to comment on the individual case citing privacy, held that the general asylum framework and sources suffice, saw no reason for a moratorium or an Inspectorate investigation, and promised only to monitor developments.
As your House is aware, for privacy reasons relating to the person concerned I cannot comment on individual cases and possible deportations.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend kan ik in verband met de privacy van de betrokken persoon geen uitspraken doen over individuele zaken en eventuele uitzettingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het personeelstekort bij de IND

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the IND's frequent absence from court hearings, staff shortages, vacancies, and reliance on underpaid agency workers. The State Secretary answered that the IND attends about 80% of hearings, that absence does not automatically delay cases, and that recruitment of around 200 staff is underway, with agency practices said to comply with labour law.
In these cases a consideration was made not to attend the hearing, and a written position (statement of defence) from the IND was submitted before the hearing.
In deze gevallen is een afweging gemaakt om niet ter zitting aanwezig te zijn en is voor de zitting een schriftelijk standpunt (verweerschrift) van de IND ingestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Toorenburg, Groothuizen en Van Ojik over het rapport ‘Extra beschermd of extra beschadigd?’

MPs asked the State Secretary about a report finding that disabled and seriously ill children in asylum procedures and reception centres are not protected under UN child and disability treaties, and how the IND's medical assessments differ from treating doctors' views. The State Secretary responded that COA adapts housing and care case by case, that medical permits follow a separate IND/BMA assessment with discretionary power, and that individual cases are not addressed.
From that standpoint I cannot answer your question.
Ik kan uw vraag vanuit dat oogpunt dus niet beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Kuik over het bericht 'Criminele asielzoekers van de straat houden'

MPs Van Toorenburg and Kuik asked whether nuisance-causing and criminal asylum seekers, including those from safe countries, should be placed in extra supervised locations where they cannot leave the grounds, and how police response times at the Ter Apel centre are handled. Secretary Harbers answered that nuisance is unacceptable and that transfer to such locations is used case by case, that residents may leave during the day under a reporting duty and that stricter detention rules are constrained by EU law, while police response data were provided, with statistics only partly available.
As I have written to your House several times, the starting point is that nuisance behaviour, as caused by a limited group of asylum seekers, is completely unacceptable.
Zoals ik meermaals aan uw Kamer heb geschreven staat voorop dat overlastgevend gedrag, zoals wordt veroorzaakt door een beperkte groep asielzoekers, volstrekt onacceptabel is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht 'Meisjes bedreigd door asielzoekers'

Christian Democrat MP Van Toorenburg asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about reports of threats and nuisance by asylum seekers toward girls and local residents, including on public transport, and what powers reception centre management has. The State Secretary acknowledges the nuisance as unacceptable, describes a broad palette of criminal, administrative and immigration measures, the COA's sanction policy, and a local casus-based approach that led to extra cameras at the Leersum centre and a camera at a bus stop, without giving statistics on frequency.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Groothuizen over overlast en geweld door bepaalde groepen asielzoekers in asielzoekerscentra

MPs Voordewind and Groothuizen asked the State Secretary about reports that a group of young men from Morocco and Algeria placed in the Beverwaard asylum centre caused rising nuisance and violence, including whether COA staff avoid intervening, how placement in the special supervision location works, and why return of safe-country asylum seekers is problematic. The State Secretary confirmed the placement and rising police involvement, said COA and partners share information and apply tailored measures, and pointed to existing return cooperation efforts and capacity of 100 places, largely without new commitments.
When placing people, COA applies the principle of spreading groups and, together with partners, works to adequately deploy available measures to ensure manageability and safety at locations.

Het COA hanteert bij plaatsing het uitgangspunt van spreiding van groepen en zet daarnaast, samen met betrokken partijen, in op adequate inzet van beschikbare maatregelen om de beheersbaarheid en veiligheid op locaties te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, De Roon, Bosma en Fritsma over het bericht dat het Chinese leger massaal onderzoekers stuurt naar westerse universiteiten

PVV MPs asked whether Chinese military-linked researchers are entering Dutch universities such as TU Delft to develop dual-use technologies, and how immigration screening and a possible ban would work. The government answered that the intelligence services do not comment on their knowledge, that universities bear primary responsibility for screening students, and that a review of the policy framework is ongoing, with no statutory ban beyond the North Korea rule.
The intelligence and security services make no statements about their current level of knowledge.
De inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten doen geen uitspraken over hun actuele kennisniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders over criminele asielzoekers in Leersum

PVV MPs Fritsma and Wilders asked why criminal asylum seekers at the Leersum centre who threaten schoolgirls and bus drivers are allowed to continue, and called for an asylum stop. State Secretary Harbers acknowledged the nuisance, said it requires a targeted approach using criminal, administrative and immigration measures, and refused an asylum stop as contrary to international obligations.
This nuisance therefore calls for a targeted approach, deploying the broad range of criminal, administrative and immigration law measures available for this purpose.

Deze overlast vraagt dan ook om een gerichte aanpak, waar op wordt ingezet middels het brede palet aan strafrechtelijke, bestuursrechtelijke en vreemdelingenrechtelijke maatregelen dat hiervoor ter beschikking staat
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over het bericht 'Loverboys maken jonge meisjes binnen een dag prostituee'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about how to lower barriers for girls to report sexual exploitation by 'loverboys', including reporting outside police stations, female detectives, sentencing levels, and terminology. The government answered that pilots are planned to raise reporting willingness, that off-site reporting is generally not possible for trafficking cases due to recording rules, that average sentences were 709 days and maximum sentences are rarely imposed, and that 'mensenhandelaar' is preferred over 'pooierboy'.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de IND de eigen regels overtreedt bij het beoordelen van verblijfsvergunningen

An SP MP asked whether IND officials who handled initial decisions also handled objections against withdrawals of residence permits, potentially violating GALA rules and possibly forcing staff to sign under other names, and whether the IND has an independent supervisor. The Secretary of State acknowledged the rule, said an integrity investigation is underway, denied any deliberate decision to allow this, stated the IND has no separate supervisor but a ministerial ownership role and an internal whistleblower scheme, and gave no outcome yet.
As long as the investigation has not been concluded, the question of whether, why and to what extent this happened cannot yet be answered.
Zo lang het onderzoek nog niet is afgerond, kan de vraag of, waarom en in welke mate dit is gebeurd nog niet beantwoord worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali en Groothuizen over het verdwijnen van Vietnamese minderjarigen uit opvanglocaties

MPs Bouali and Groothuizen asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the disappearance of Vietnamese unaccompanied minors from reception locations, including whether the protocol will be revised and whether prosecutors will start a people-smuggling investigation. The State Secretary gave yearly figures (7 to 31 per year, 13 in 2018), said the protocol is being updated, and stated that no criminal facts have been established and the Public Prosecution Service assesses signals case by case without commenting on ongoing investigations.
The protocol no longer matches current work processes and is therefore being updated at this time.
Het protocol komt niet meer overeen met de huidige werkprocessen en wordt daarom op dit moment geactualiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over problemen met veiligelanders

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about asylum seekers from safe countries causing nuisance, including whether they could be held in closed reception centres and how to pressure countries to take back returnees. The State Secretary answered that a targeted approach with a range of measures is used, that closed reception is legally not possible, and that Extra Beveiligde Toezichtlocaties offer 100 places.
It is legally not possible to operate a closed reception location.
Het is juridisch niet mogelijk om een gesloten opvanglocatie te hanteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘EU zet bij grenscontrole dubieuze leugendetectie in’

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice Minister about an EU pilot (IBORDER CTRL) using a lie-detection system at external borders, questioning its scientific basis, ethical review, and whether the Netherlands would take part. The Minister answered that the pilot runs until August 2019 so effects cannot yet be judged, that the Netherlands does not participate, and that deployment must respect Schengen Borders Code and GDPR rules, while detailed conditions are unknown to him.
The concrete arrangements and conditions for implementing this pilot are not known to me.
De concrete invulling en voorwaarden voor de implementatie van deze pilot zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over gevangen gezette vluchtelingenreddingswerkers in Griekenland

An MP asked whether Greek rescue workers Sarah Mardini, Sean Binder and Nassos Karakitsos were detained without legal grounds, whether this is acceptable, and whether the Dutch government would raise concerns with Greek counterparts. The government answered that the four ERCI members were released on bail on 4 December, that it does not intervene in Greek legal proceedings, and that it sees no reason to contact Greek or other European colleagues.
The Netherlands does not intervene in the Greek legal process.
Nederland intervenieert niet in de Griekse rechtsgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat er een schaderegeling komt voor ondernemers die te maken hebben met diefstal door asielzoekers uit veilige landen
