An SP MP asks whether a compensation fund for shopkeepers hit by theft by asylum seekers from safe countries exists, why offenders cannot be billed directly, and who finances it. The Staatssecretaris says a dedicated fund is not warranted, that criminal law and existing schemes such as SODA should be used, and that SODA and COA are discussing how COA can support this.
There is therefore no immediate reason for a specific compensation fund set up for this purpose.
Voor een specifiek hiervoor in het leven geroepen schadefonds bestaat dan ook niet meteen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het voornemen van de Staatssecretaris tot ondertekenen namens de Nederlandse regering van het Global Compact for Migration (“Marrakesh Immigratiepact”)

An MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the Netherlands' planned signing of the UN Global Compact for Migration, its legal status, its binding effect, and its implications for migration policy. The government answers that the Compact is non-binding, that Dutch policy freedom is preserved, and that the optional measures largely fit existing policy, while defending its position on migration, detention, smuggling and integration.
The GCM is not a legally binding document. It is also not a treaty and is therefore not ratified by member states.
Het GCM is geen juridisch bindend document. Het is ook geen verdrag en wordt daarom ook niet geratificeerd door lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht  van Vluchtelingenwerk dat asielcentra vol zitten door het personeelstekort bij de IND

MP Groothuizen (D66) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports that asylum centres are full due to IND staff shortages, long waiting times (especially in the extended asylum procedure), redeployment of IND staff, and whether flexible asylum system work has enough priority. The State Secretary answered that about 200 extra FTE are being recruited, that longer processing times in the extended procedure are expected to persist into 2019, and that the IND needs flexibility and better long-term staff planning.
Recently it was decided to open about 80 additional vacancies at the IND for processing asylum applications.
Onlangs is besloten om circa 80 vacatures extra bij de IND open te stellen voor het behandelen van asielaanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de hervestiging van zieke vluchtelingen

An SP MP asked the state secretary about the resettlement of refugees with serious illnesses, including the medical sub-quota of 30 places, UNHCR funding shortfalls for cancer treatment in Lebanon, and EU donor and resettlement contributions. The government answered that medical need is one of several UNHCR vulnerability categories, that the medical sub-quota is increasingly irrelevant and under internal review, and that Nederland gives substantial but not sufficient humanitarian funding.
This sub-quota was set up because of the greater workload that these kinds of cases entail.
Dit sub quotum is ingesteld vanwege de grotere werkbelasting die dit soort zaken met zich meebrengt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Voordewind over het bericht dat Nederland bewust geen vluchtelingen met medische problemen selecteert voor hervestiging

MPs Van Ojik and Voordewind asked whether the Netherlands caps medical refugee resettlement at 30 people including family, and whether this burden-based reasoning is justified. The State Secretary denied any binding cap, explained the medical sub-quota as a maximum within the total quota, and stated that medical cases are accepted outside it, citing Lebanon figures.
It is not correct that the Netherlands has set a maximum on the number of refugees with a medical indication who can be selected and resettled to the Netherlands.
Het klopt niet dat Nederland een maximum heeft gesteld aan het aantal vluchtelingen met een medische indicatie dat kan worden geselecteerd en hervestigd naar Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Diertens over het rapport 'Opgesloten en uitgezet' van Amnesty International

MPs Groothuizen and Diertens asked the State Secretaries about the Amnesty report on detention and expulsion of Venezuelans in the Caribbean Kingdom islands, covering numbers, UNHCR registration, asylum procedures, detention conditions, and independent investigation. The government answered that Curaçao is responsible for its own asylum and detention matters, confirmed it will not commission independent investigations there, and offered only support for optimising Curaçao's Article 3 ECHR procedure.
The constitutional relations within the Kingdom do not allow me to unilaterally commission research into matters that concern an autonomous responsibility of the country of Curaçao.

De staatkundige verhoudingen binnen het Koninkrijk staan mij niet toe om eenzijdig onderzoek te laten verrichten naar zaken die betrekking hebben op een autonome verantwoordelijkheid van het land Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over verdwenen minderjarige asielzoekers

An MP asks the State Secretary why the number of unaccompanied minor asylum seekers disappearing from reception has roughly doubled, whether they risk criminal exploitation or trafficking, where they go, and whether foster care could prevent disappearances. The State Secretary acknowledges the concern, notes that protective measures were taken and that disappearances fell in 2017 and 2018 partly due to a changed nationality mix, says it is unknown where most leaving minors go, and defers the foster care question until the new reception model evaluation is complete.
Unfortunately it still happens that children leave reception without the government knowing where these children are going.
Helaas komt het nog steeds voor dat kinderen de opvang verlaten zonder dat de overheid weet waar deze kinderen naartoe gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Bouali over het bericht ‘Zorgen om verdwijnen van minderjarige asielzoekers’

MPs Groothuizen and Bouali asked about reports that unaccompanied minor asylum seekers are disappearing and falling victim to trafficking and sexual violence, and what measures prevent this. The State Secretary replied that protective reception measures, risk analyses and police notification have been strengthened and that the reception model is under evaluation, awaiting its outcome before further steps.
The asylum minors reception model is currently being evaluated. I look forward to the outcome of this study.
Op dit moment wordt het amv-opvangmodel geëvalueerd. Ik wacht graag de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders over ‘De enorme toename van criminaliteit in Kampen door asielzoekers’

MPs Fritsma and Wilders asked why criminal asylum seekers in Kampen and elsewhere are not quickly rejected, detained and deported, what share of criminal asylum seekers previously applied elsewhere, and whether an asylum stop will be introduced. The State Secretary replied that overlap is handled case by case with partners, cites measures already taken and data-based early warning, says the number of convicted criminal asylum seekers cannot be derived from systems, and rejects a full asylum stop while accepting targeted measures.
I am not willing to do so because I value a careful asylum policy that offers protection to those who need it.
Daartoe ben ik niet bereid omdat ik hecht aan een zorgvuldig asielbeleid dat bescherming biedt aan degenen die dat nodig hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Enorme toename van criminaliteit in Kampen door asielzoekers’

MP Azmani asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why convicted asylum seekers in Dronten and the reported surge in shoplifting in Kampen were not being expelled or fast-tracked. The State Secretary answered that serious offenders can lose asylum status, cited existing measures such as fast procedures, extra supervised locations and coordinated local case consultation, and said a joint approach with the municipality would be discussed.
This number cannot simply be generated from the automated system of the migration chain.
Dit aantal is niet zonder meer uit het geautomatiseerde systeem van de migratieketen te genereren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over gevaarlijke vluchtroutes in Griekenland

The SP MP asked the State Secretary about the deaths of 11 migrants on the Evros route from Turkey to Greece, whether the EU-Turkey deal caused the rise in crossings, and whether closing routes without legal alternatives pushes migrants into more dangerous routes, citing UNHCR. The government called the deaths tragic, denied a clear link to the EU-Turkey deal citing changing nationality mix and other factors, and pointed to resettlement expansion, a scholarship programme and migration cooperation as legal routes without committing to a concrete new action.
The cabinet does not consider it likely that this increase is a consequence of the EU-Turkey Statement.
Het kabinet acht het niet waarschijnlijk dat de betreffende toename een gevolg is van de EU-Turkije Verklaring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Azmani over het bericht ‘Verblijfsvergunning brengt verantwoordelijkheid met zich mee’

MPs Van Oosten and Azmani asked whether courts weigh the loss of a residence permit when sentencing offenders, and whether revocation should follow automatically after serious convictions. The minister answered that judges weigh all circumstances without binding guidelines on this point, that IND revocation uses a sliding scale with individual assessment reviewable by the administrative court, and that no change of policy is planned though signals will be monitored.
It is for the independent judge to weigh all facts and circumstances in the individual case and reach a judgment.
Het is aan de onafhankelijke rechter om in het individuele geval alle feiten en omstandigheden te wegen en tot een oordeel te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de asielindustrie

An MP asked the State Secretary about asylum procedure length, backlogs, child cases, subsidies to refugee organisations, a discretionary residence permit for Armenian children, and appeal procedures. The government answered with figures, stated it would not grant a general pardon, and said it will set up an independent inquiry and streamline procedures.
The figures you requested cannot be generated from the IND data warehouse.
De door u gevraagde cijfers zijn niet te genereren uit het datawarehouse van de IND.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over in AZC’s gescheiden Christenen en Moslims

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a report that asylum centre staff separate Christians and Muslims in rooms to prevent problems, and about the scale of nuisance by some residents. The State Secretary said mixed rooming is the standard, separate placement is not structural, COA may tailor rooms in tension situations, and data on religion and ethnicity are not systematically registered so the requested overview cannot be given.
Data on, among other things, ethnicity and religion are not systematically recorded in COA's automated systems.
Gegevens over onder meer etniciteit en religie worden niet structureel geregistreerd in de geautomatiseerde systemen van het COA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Jasper van Dijk over Albanese migranten die bij de gemeente Moerdijk in vrachtwagen klimmen

MPs Kuiken and Van Dijk asked about Albanian migrants climbing into trucks near Moerdijk bound for England, and about the mayor's plea for help. The State Secretary described the involved agencies, possible offences and removal procedures, said an inter-agency framework was being prepared, and promised to meet the mayor.
I will myself, together with the Minister of Justice and Security, enter into consultation with the mayor of Moerdijk.
Ik zal zelf eveneens, samen met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, in overleg treden met de burgemeester van Moerdijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Paternotte over het bericht dat het COA te kampen heeft met overcapaciteit aan AZC's in Nederland

MPs Groothuizen and Paternotte asked about reports of overcapacity at COA reception centres and the criteria for closing them, including integration and municipal consultation. The State Secretary listed eleven affected locations, described COA's closure criteria and consultation with municipalities, and said a review of integration aspects is underway, though without committing to a specific new step.
To align reception capacity with the forecasts at the time, COA decided on 29 March 2018 to reduce reception capacity to 27,000 places.
Om de opvangcapaciteit in lijn te brengen met de toenmalige prognoses heeft het COA op 29 maart 2018 het besluit genomen de opvangcapaciteit terug te brengen tot 27.000 plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht 'Libya keeps coast guards rejected by the EU'

MP Groothuizen asked whether Libyan coast guard personnel rejected by EU training screening remain employed, what the government will do to prevent smugglers joining, and how EU monitoring of the coast guard is being strengthened. The government replied that Libyan authorities are responsible for recruitment and vetting, that EU screening of trainees continues and monitoring has been added to the Sophia mandate, but that incidents cannot be excluded and monitoring is difficult.
Therefore, as the article also states, it is primarily up to the Libyans to vet their own people.
Daarmee is het, zoals ook in het artikel wordt gesteld, primair aan de Libiërs om hun eigen mensen te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het intrekken van een Nederlands visum door Zweden

An SP MP asked the government about Sweden withdrawing a valid Dutch Schengen visa held by two Senegalese brothers who were detained in Sweden for six weeks, and whether the Netherlands could intervene. The government answered that Sweden acted independently under EU law, that the Netherlands cannot block such withdrawals or interfere in Swedish detention proceedings, and that new visa applications are assessed on their merits.
The Netherlands cannot and may not interfere in the legal proceedings of another country.
Nederland kan en mag zich niet mengen in de rechtsgang van een ander land.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over het bericht dat eenvijfde van de Syriërs wordt afgewezen vanwege extremistische of conservatieve denkbeelden

MPs Groothuizen and Voordewind asked whether one-fifth of Syrian refugees nominated by UNHCR for resettlement from Turkey are rejected for extremist or conservative views, how the integration screening works, and about conditions in Greek camps. The State Secretary says the one-fifth figure conflates all rejection grounds, that conservative views alone are not a ground for refusal, and that integration screening does not reduce the national resettlement quota; the Greek camp questions were referred to earlier answers.
Holding conservative views is in itself not a ground for refusal.
Het hebben van conservatieve denkbeelden is op zichzelf geen grond voor weigering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over het bericht 'Opvang op Griekse eilanden kraakt'

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked about reports that reception conditions on Greek islands are inhumane, including child suicide attempts, and about EU monitoring and asylum procedure reform. The Dutch state secretary acknowledged the concerns, attributed problems mainly to overcrowding and slow asylum procedures, described EU and Dutch support and new Greek asylum law, but said no exact figures on child suicide attempts were available and opposed transfers to the mainland as a long-term solution.
Inquiries have revealed that no exact figures on suicide attempts can be obtained.
Navraag heeft geleerd dat geen exacte cijfers over pogingen tot zelfmoord zijn te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hiddema over het aandeel van de asieladvocatuur binnen de gefinancierde rechtshulp

An FvD MP asked how much publicly funded legal aid goes to asylum and immigration procedures, what lawyers are paid in those cases, and whether lawyers in hopeless asylum cases could be denied legal-aid payment via court ruling. The minister answered that data for 2000-2001 are unavailable, pointed to a table for the budget figures, and declined to investigate court-based denial of lawyers' income, citing the ongoing asylum procedure review.
Figures for the years 2000 and 2001 are not available, because this was not separately registered in the Justice budget.
De cijfers voor de jaren 2000 en 2001 zijn niet beschikbaar, omdat dit niet apart geregistreerd werd in de Justitiebegroting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over uitgezette kinderen die met een toeristenvisum Nederland weer binnen zijn gekomen

Fritsma (PVV) asked whether children deported from the Netherlands could return on tourist visas because no entry ban was imposed, and why children were exempt from such bans. Harbers replied that individual cases are not discussed, that minors are in principle exempt from entry bans under the Vreemdelingenbesluit (subject to public order or security exceptions), that individual weighing applies, and that he does not recognise the claimed pattern of frequent returns.

It is currently not registered at an aggregate level how often the imposition of an entry ban is omitted for foreigners whose asylum application was rejected and who did not leave the Netherlands within the deadline.

Er wordt momenteel niet op geaggregeerd niveau geregistreerd hoe vaak het opleggen van een inreisverbod aan vreemdelingen van wie het asielverzoek is afgewezen en die Nederland niet binnen de termijn hebben verlaten achterwege wordt gelaten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Kuiken, Van Ojik en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de staatssecretaris in hoger beroep is gegaan in de zaak van Lili en Howick en daarmee het advies van de Raad voor kind

MPs asked why the State Secretary appealed the Lili and Howick ruling and disregarded Raad voor de Kinderbescherming conditions, and whether removal of supervised children without achieved goals is responsible. The State Secretary answered that asylum law under the CJEU M'Bodj judgment excludes these socio-economic circumstances from Article 3 ECHR, that the Raad van State ruled in his favour, that the children may now stay after events of 8 September 2018, and that the RvdK, IND and DT&V cooperate while each applies its own context.

The circumstances invoked in this case, namely that the goals formulated by the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming have not yet been achieved, cannot and may not, according to this case law of the Court of Justice, lead to asylum status.

De aangevoerde omstandigheden in deze zaak, erin gelegen dat de door de Raad voor de Kinderbescherming geformuleerde doelen nog niet zijn bereikt, kunnen en mogen volgens deze jurisprudentie van het Hof van Justitie niet leiden tot een asielstatus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Kuiken, Voordewind en Jasper van Dijk over uitzettingen naar Afghanistan

MPs from GroenLinks, PvdA, ChristenUnie and SP asked the State Secretary about deportations of Afghan families with minor children, the compatibility with children's rights, recognition rates across EU states, and the number of families in return procedures. The State Secretary rejected the claim that the deportation endangered the family, defended the policy change and the Afghan recognition rate, and said unaccompanied minors are not returned where no family or adequate care is available.
I do not share this conclusion.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht over nauwelijks gebruikte ebtl’s

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the low use of the extra supervision and guidance locations (EBTL) in Amsterdam and Hoogeveen, their costs, the placement criteria, and the treatment of minors and safe-country asylum seekers. The State Secretary answered that the locations were in a startup pilot phase, promised a fuller report in autumn 2018 and a WODC evaluation by summer 2019, and gave cost estimates, but withheld or deferred several specifics such as overlast incident counts and outflow figures.
As promised in the committee debate of 14 December 2017, I will inform your House more extensively this autumn about the functioning of the EBTL.
Zoals toegezegd in het AO van 14 december 2017 3 , zal ik uw Kamer dit najaar uitgebreider informeren over het functioneren van de ebtl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Kuiken en Jasper van Dijk over de negatieve gevolgen van uitzetting naar Armenië voor de PTSS-klachten van Howick en Lili

MPs Van Ojik, Kuiken and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the IND adequately investigated the PTSD complaints of children Howick and Lili and their deportation to Armenia, and whether deportation should be halted pending new investigation. The Staatssecretaris declined to address individual medical circumstances, citing privacy of special personal data, and confirmed no irreversible steps had yet been taken.
As your House is aware, I do not go into individual and personal aspects in public answers to parliamentary questions.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is ga ik in openbare beantwoording van Kamervragen niet in op individuele en persoonlijke aspecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de voorbereiding van voorstellen ter modernisering van het nationaliteitsrecht

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security what has been done to prepare modernising Dutch nationality law, including allowing multiple nationalities, whether Dutch nationals in the UK can benefit given Brexit, and why Dutch emigrants who unknowingly lost nationality are not offered restoration. The State Secretary answered that a bill is in preparation pending a CJEU ruling, that UK-based Dutch citizens are informed through embassy channels without a fast-track change, and that the government will not add a special option regime beyond the existing rules.
A bill to that end is currently being prepared.
Een wetsvoorstel daartoe is op dit moment in voorbereiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Van den Hul over het tekort van de VN voor vluchtelingenopvang in de regio

MPs Asscher and Van den Hul asked the government about the UN funding shortfall for Syrian refugee support in the region, Jordanian schools, employment for refugees (including women), the rules of origin, and whether denying aid workers access can be a war crime. Minister Kaag answered that Nederland commits EUR 400 million over four years, contributes to education and job programmes, supports EU flexibilisation of the rules of origin, and that the Wet Internationale Misdrijven now covers starvation and blocking aid in non-international armed conflicts.
The cabinet will allocate at least EUR 400 million over the next four years to improve prospects for refugees and host communities in the Syria region.
Het kabinet trekt de komende vier jaar ten minste EUR 400 miljoen uit voor de verbetering van de perspectieven van vluchtelingen en gastgemeenschappen in de Syrië regio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over ernstige problemen na gezinshereniging van Eritrese vluchtelingen

An SP MP asked the ministers about serious problems (domestic violence, child abuse, health, integration) faced by Eritrean family reunification migrants and whether support, information and shelter are adequate. The government acknowledges the risks, points to existing guidance and Pharos research, promises to raise the issue with VNG, shelter and Veilig Thuis organisations, and says the residence permit type does not hinder seeking protection.

I will bring the Pharos exploration and the Argos article and broadcast to the attention of the VNG, the 35 centre municipalities for women's shelters, the women's shelter institutions and the national Veilig Thuis network.

Ik zal de verkenning van Pharos en het artikel en de uitzending van Argos onder de aandacht brengen van de VNG, de 35 centrumgemeenten vrouwenopvang, de vrouwenopvanginstellingen en het landelijk Netwerk Veilig Thuis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Fritsma over het opheffen van de visumplicht voor Kosovo

PVV MPs Maeijer and Fritsma asked whether the Commission's finding that Kosovo meets visa liberalisation conditions is accepted, whether the government will consent, and why it is nonetheless pursued given past crime and security concerns. The Minister replied that the government will study the Commission report carefully before taking a position, that each country is assessed separately with flanking safeguards, and that visa liberalisation is conditional and monitored after adoption.
The cabinet will study this report carefully before taking a position. Your House will be informed about this.
Het kabinet zal dit rapport nauwgezet bestuderen alvorens een standpunt in te nemen. Uw Kamer zal hierover worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Anne Mulder en Asscher over de gevolgen van het no deal-scenario voor Nederlandse en EU-burgers in het Verenigd Koninkrijk

MPs Omtzigt, Mulder and Asscher asked the government about the consequences of a no-deal Brexit for Dutch and EU citizens in the UK, including settled status, the need for a helpdesk, and timely information. The government answered that the UK's Settlement Scheme offers no hard guarantees, that a no-deal scenario is being prepared for, that information is provided via IND and the embassy, and that the Chamber will be briefed in September and a closed technical briefing in October.
However, this Statement of Intent offers no hard guarantees.
Dit Statement of Intent biedt echter geen harde garanties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de aangiftebereidheid van minderjarige slachtoffers mensenhandel

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the very low willingness of minor victims of human trafficking to file reports, the reasons for it, police pilots, and whether the forthcoming action plan will include measures on definitions, faster procedures, sentencing and proactive investigation. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, said the police will run a pilot and a plan of action will follow after the summer, but gave no concrete commitments on specific measures and declined to expand sentencing.
I therefore cannot yet go into specific measures that will be included in it.
Ik kan daarom nog niet ingaan op specifieke maatregelen die hierin zullen worden opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het onderzoek naar de onveilige situatie van sekswerkers

MP Van Nispen asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security how he responds to research findings on the unsafe situation of sex workers and about the timing and effect of the revised prostitution regulation bill. The State Secretary condemns violence, promises to discuss the research findings with stakeholders and send a substantive reaction this autumn, and says the bill will be consulted after summer with the aim of enabling safe legal work.
I will discuss the findings and recommendations of the reports with the various stakeholders and on that basis examine whether additional measures are needed.
Ik zal de uitkomsten en aanbevelingen van de rapporten bespreken met de verschillende betrokken actoren en aan de hand daarvan bezien of er aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van den Berg over de steekpartij in Den Haag

CDA MPs asked the Justice Minister why a Den Haag stabbing was quickly attributed to confused behaviour, what the asylum status of the suspect was, what support exists for asylum seekers with confused behaviour, and what the state of policy on such persons is. The minister answered that the suspect has a residence permit with no prior IND warning signs, described existing care and reception facilities, and promised a letter on the policy this autumn.
The foreign-national legal aspects of this individual case will not be discussed further.
Er wordt niet verder ingegaan op de vreemdelingrechtelijke aspecten van deze individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over de gevolgen van de uitspraak van het Hof van Justitie van de EU in de zaak Chavez-Vilchez

An MP asked the State Secretary how many residence permits were granted under the Chavez-Vilchez CJEU ruling, their illegal-stay history, nationalities, rejections, and whether the government would resist EU rules that reward births in the Netherlands. The State Secretary reported 1,930 permits granted, a main nationality list, 90 rejections, and that birth in the Netherlands confers no residence right, while noting that the policy had been adjusted following the ruling.
The IND's automated system cannot show at case level whether a parent was staying illegally in the Netherlands at the time of the application.
Uit het geautomatiseerde systeem van de IND valt niet op dossierniveau af te leiden of een ouder illegaal in Nederland verbleef op het moment van de aanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het asielbeleid voor LHBTI’s

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the State Secretary about IND asylum assessment of LGBTI applicants, including reliance on a 'self-acceptance' criterion and the treatment of photographic and witness evidence. The State Secretary said the emphasis on awareness and self-acceptance will be dropped, that sexually explicit imagery cannot be used but other imagery can, and that open questioning will be emphasised, though he could not say how many refusals rest on the criterion.
The IND does not record whether an asylum application is rejected on grounds of (lack of credibility of) sexual orientation.
De IND registreert niet of een asielverzoek wordt afgewezen op grond van (ongeloofwaardigheid van) seksuele gerichtheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Maeijer en Wilders over de mededeling dat Nederland een deel van de migranten van het schip 'Lifeline' gaat opvangen

PVV MPs asked whether the government agreed to take in part of the migrants from the Lifeline ship, how many, and why it acted without parliamentary approval, and urged an asylum stop. The State Secretary confirmed Netherlands offered a one-off responsibility for up to 20 asylum seekers from Malta and referred the rest to a separate letter to parliament.
For the considerations on which and the terms under which this gesture is made, I refer you to the cover letter accompanying the annotated agenda.
Voor de overwegingen op grond waarvan en de modaliteiten waaronder deze geste wordt gedaan, verwijs ik u naar de aanbiedingsbrief
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Dit zijn de schepen en organisaties die migranten oppikken’

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about NGO rescue ships picking up migrants at sea, several of which sail under or are associated with the Dutch flag, and whether the government would act to stop them as Italy requests. The State Secretary answered that only one ship is Dutch-flagged, that the government supports lifesaving in general but shares Italy's concerns about safety and coordination, and that it will examine how to create better frameworks for such vessels.
The cabinet is examining the possibilities to create better frameworks for this.
Het kabinet beziet de mogelijkheden om hier betere kaders voor te scheppen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over een geliquideerde man in Almere

MPs Karabulut and Van Dijk asked whether the man liquidated in Almere in 2015 was a Iranian-convicted attacker who had received a residence permit under an alias, whether Iran contacted the Netherlands, and whether the MKO is considered terrorist. The government said no signals of a different identity were known during the asylum procedure, that some indications later emerged in the criminal investigation and were reported to ministers, that no reason was seen to further examine the identification process, and that no Iranian correspondence was found.
In this case no reason is seen to further investigate the identification and registration process.
Er wordt in deze casus geen aanleiding gezien om het I&R-proces verder te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het bericht 'Waarom het KhAD-WAD ambtsbericht van 29 februari 2000 onjuist en onbetrouwbaar is'

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice about a critique of the 2000 KhAD-WAD country report, which relied on anonymous sources and claimed all Afghan intelligence officers were involved in human rights abuses via rotation, and about the resulting exclusion of asylum seekers under Article 1F. The ministers defended the sources as confidential but credible, said the 2008 UNHCR critique did not refute the report, and rejected calls for a new assessment.
The sources consulted are not anonymous but confidential.
De geraadpleegde bronnen zijn niet anoniem maar vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Voordewind over het bericht 'IND-beleid bekeerlingen geregeld onzorgvuldig'

MPs Bisschop and Voordewind asked whether the IND handles conversion-based asylum claims carelessly, citing an open letter from Stichting Gave, and asked about assessment criteria and implementation of the Groothuizen motion. The Secretary of State rejects Gave's conclusions, says the IND has the expertise for a careful integral assessment, and promises a letter before the summer recess covering the motion, third-party reports and the assessment framework.
As you know, I will send your House a response before the summer recess to the Groothuizen et al. motion on the IND's credibility assessment of LGBT asylum seekers and converts.
Zoals u bekend is, zal ik uw Kamer voor het zomerreces een reactie sturen op de motie Groothuizen c.s inzake de geloofwaardigheidsbeoordeling van lhbt-asielzoekers en bekeerlingen door de IND.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over het bericht 'Noodkreet Vluchtelingenwerk over retourtickets migranten'

MPs Groothuizen and Voordewind asked about reports that the Netherlands is resuming Dublin transfers of asylum seekers to Greece and whether tickets were issued, and about reception conditions and Article 3 ECHR concerns. The State Secretary confirmed limited resumption of take-back claims for non-vulnerable persons, said no transfer decisions or tickets have been issued yet, and said individual guarantees from Greece will be assessed.
So far, none of the claims already sent have led to a decision that the asylum seeker must be transferred to Greece.
Vooralsnog hebben geen van de al verzonden claims geleid tot een besluit met de strekking dat de asielzoeker overgedragen dient te worden aan Griekenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat Amsterdam 24-uursopvang gaat bieden aan illegalen

Fritsma (PVV) asks whether the government will block Amsterdam's plan for 24-hour shelter for undocumented migrants, tackle other municipalities doing the same, and force rejected asylum seekers to leave or be detained. Staatssecretaris Harbers answers that he will discuss the plans with Amsterdam and is in talks with the VNG, that the Raad van State has ruled such shelter unlawful favouritism, and that he will not close the borders because asylum is a universal right.
I am willing to discuss the plans with the college.
Ik ben bereid om over de plannen in gesprek te gaan met het college.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over asielzoekers in Weert

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about asylum seekers in Weert, including staffing shortages for minors, COA transparency, overlast-causing asylum seekers and their placement in the EBTL, and forced return. The State Secretary denied any staffing shortage for unaccompanied minors, said extra staff was added independently of media attention, and pointed to the migration agenda and letter on overlast for return measures.
There is no staffing shortage for the supervision of unaccompanied minor asylum seekers (amv) in Weert or in other amv reception locations.
Er is geen sprake van een personeelstekort voor de begeleiding van alleenstaande minderjarige asielzoekers (amv) in Weert of in andere amv-opvanglocaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Weverling over het bericht 'Gegevens huisdieren en hun baasjes op straat'

MPs Koopmans and Weverling asked whether pet owners' data from pet chip databases was exposed online, whether breaches were reported to the Data Protection Authority, and how the ministry prepared affiliated bodies for GDPR. The minister replied that no sensitive data reportedly leaked, databases blocked bulk queries, one database filed a breach report, and a DPIA and processing agreements were in place.
Following the NOS finding, the databases took measures so that querying multiple chip numbers from a single IP address is now impossible.
Naar aanleiding van de constatering door de Nederlandse Omroep Stichting (NOS) hebben databanken maatregelen genomen, waardoor opvraag van meerdere chipnummers vanaf één IP adres nu onmogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Kops en Fritsma over het bericht “Miljardairsfamilie Van der Vorm koopt huizen voor Syriërs (en jij betaalt mee)”

PVV MPs asked why a Rotterdam housing initiative by the SNTR foundation reserves 200 homes for Syrian status holders, calling it discrimination against Dutch citizens, and whether such schemes should be stopped. The minister answered that the scheme responds to housing needs of status holders, that whether it constitutes discrimination is for a court to judge, and that no comparable initiatives are known; he rejected the call to restrict social housing to Dutch nationals.
Whether in this case there is also discrimination is not for the cabinet but for a judge to assess.
Of in het onderhavige geval ook sprake is van discriminatie is niet aan het kabinet, maar aan een rechter om te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Groothuizen over de pushbacks van vluchtelingen door Griekenland

MPs Voordewind and Groothuizen asked whether Greece is pushing refugees back to Turkey without allowing asylum claims, whether this breaches the Refugee Convention, and whether the Netherlands will confront Greece about it. The Secretary of State says the government takes such reports seriously, that Greece denies pushbacks at its borders, and that the Commission is responsible for enforcing EU law, while listing EU and bilateral financial and personnel support to Greece.
Incidentally, it is primarily the responsibility of the European Commission to monitor the application of the EU acquis.
Overigens is het primair aan de Europese Commissie om toe te zien op de toepassing van het EU-acquis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de lange wachttijd bij gezinshereniging

Dutch MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about long waiting times in family reunification for Eritrean asylum holders, including the use of indicative documents, DNA testing, appeal success rates, backlog in appeals and staffing. The State Secretary answered that the IND applies a framework based on plausible explanations for missing documents, that appeal grant rates rose from 14% to 27% after the new framework, that 49% of open appeal cases exceed the statutory deadline, and that extra staff are being deployed.
The IND does not record in how many cases hardship is accepted.
De IND registreert niet in hoeveel zaken bewijsnood wordt aangenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de samenwerking tussen Italië en Libië

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about Italy coordinating and supporting the Libyan coast guard, and whether this makes the EU complicit in refoulement of migrants, including a legal case against Italy. The State Secretary answered that Italy has provided at least one ship, that there is coordination but no direct steering of the Libyan coast guard, that the EU supports human rights training and detention-centre improvements, and that the EU and Netherlands do not accept the complicity claim.
As far as is known, there is no question of Italy directing the Libyan coast guard.
Er is, voor zover bekend, geen sprake van aansturing door Italië van de Libische kustwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het bericht dat het aantal migranten dat wordt opgesloten in onmenselijke Libische detentiecentra sterk is toegenomen

Green Left MP Van Ojik asked the ministers about reports that the number of migrants detained in Libyan detention centres rose sharply, and whether Dutch support for the Libyan coastguard and alleged Italian direction amounted to unlawful pushbacks. The government replied that Libyan coastguard tasks are lawful, denied Italian direction beyond coordination, and described its efforts to improve conditions and close the centres, noting progress remains slow.
As previously shared with your House, the cabinet is working with the AU, EU and UN to improve the situation in the centres, including promoting access to medical care and food supplies.

Zoals eerder met uw Kamer gedeeld 6 , zet het kabinet zich in om samen met de AU, EU en VN de situatie in de centra te verbeteren, waaronder het bevorderen van de toegang tot medische zorg en voedselvoorziening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Fritsma over de berichten "Aanrander nog hier" en "Doodsbang voor het monster uit Hoorn."

PVV MPs Helder and Fritsma asked why a convicted rapist, Mohammed M., was still in the Netherlands after his unconditional sentence ended, and why the victim was not actively informed and was left in fear. The State Secretary answered that he was placed in immigration detention, could not be deported due to a subsequent asylum application rejected through the courts, and was deported to Mogadishu on 25 May 2018, while denying that the prosecution had promised the victim deportation.
The prosecutor's office informed the victim about the convicted person's release on 22 February 2018 once he had served the unconditional part of his sentence.
De zaaksofficier van justitie heeft het slachtoffer geïnformeerd over de invrijheidsstelling van de veroordeelde op 22 februari 2018
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de uitzetting van de in de Hoornse zedenzaak voor verkrachting veroordeelde Mohamed M.

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the deportation of Mohamed M., convicted of rape in the Hoorn case, including the status of withdrawing his residence permit, detention, measures to keep him away from his victim, and whether he had been declared undesirable. The State Secretary answered that the IND began withdrawal in August 2017, the permit was withdrawn in November 2017, a later asylum application delayed removal, and he was deported to Mogadishu on 25 May 2018 with a 10-year entry ban instead of an undesirability declaration, which is not legally possible.
On 25 May 2018 the person concerned was successfully deported to Mogadishu.
Op 25 mei 2018 is betrokkene succesvol uitgezet naar Mogadishu.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Hoornse Zedenzaak: Somalische verkrachter nog in Nederland’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why a convicted Somali rapist from the Hoorn case had not yet been deported, whether he would be deported as the previous minister intended, and whether the victim was kept informed. The State Secretary answered that the man was placed in immigration detention after serving his sentence, could not be deported at once due to a follow-up asylum application that was rejected, and was deported to Mogadishu on 25 May 2018, and described the standard victim-information procedures.
After serving his criminal detention, the person concerned was immediately placed in immigration detention with a view to deportation.
Na het uitzitten van zijn strafdetentie is betrokkene aansluitend in vreemdelingenbewaring gesteld ter fine van uitzetting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Groothuizen, Jasper van Dijk, Van Ojik en Kuiken over het rapport van Amnesty over de situatie van migranten in Libië

MPs from five parties asked the government about Amnesty's report on abuses against migrants in Libya, including how to close detention centres, EU/Dutch support to Libyan authorities, UNHCR access, IOM return programmes, and the Libyan coast guard. The government answered that it presses Libya for better conditions and closure of centres, notes four centres closed, defends continued support to stabilise Libya, and says it has urged monitoring improvements while lacking evidence of transponder non-compliance.
The ultimate goal is to close these detention centres and move to alternative reception and transit centres.
Het uiteindelijke doel is deze detentiecentra te sluiten en te komen tot alternatieve ontvangst- en transitcentra.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht 'Hiaat in IND-regels voor pardonners'

MP Azmani asks whether the IND's practice of using the 'doortoets' to obtain lower fees for pardoned asylum seekers conflicts with cost-recovery, whether it should charge extra costs, and whether rules should change before abuse occurs. The Staatssecretaris answers that no abuse signals exist yet, that the IND is studying options such as charging the highest fee in doortoets cases, and that benefit-cut options for non-integration already exist at municipal level.
At present I am examining the possibilities to undo this undesirable situation without other foreigners being put into problems as a result.
Op dit moment onderzoek ik de mogelijkheden om deze onwenselijke situatie ongedaan te maken zonder dat andere vreemdelingen daardoor in problemen komen.
Antwoord op vragen de leden De Graaf, Fritsma en De Jong over “Statushouder Werkloos”

MPs De Graaf, Fritsma and De Jong (PVV) asked the ministers whether refugees with status are poorly educated, whether economic migration has enriched the Netherlands, and whether residence permits of asylum seekers from safe countries should be revoked and an asylum stop introduced. The government answered that refugees are a diverse group, that it pursues activating policy and regional protection, that the IND judges protection needs, and that it will not introduce a full asylum stop in line with international treaties.
However, for status holders, as for Dutch people on social assistance, an activating policy applies that aims at rapid transition to work.
Voor statushouders geldt echter, net als voor Nederlanders in de bijstand, een activerend beleid dat gericht is op snelle uitstroom naar werk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders over de daling van het aantal uitzettingen

PVV MPs Fritsma and Wilders asked why rejected asylum seekers are left at large, why they are not detained and deported, and why countries refusing to take back nationals are not sanctioned. The State Secretary referred to earlier answers, said EU and bilateral pressure is used via positive and negative incentives, and said detention without a prospect of removal would violate the ECHR, while committing to expand detention possibilities within those limits.
Without a prospect of removal, detention is contrary to that treaty.
Zonder zicht op uitzetting is bewaring in strijd met dat verdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Kuiken over de continuïteit van onderwijs van asielkinderen door de sluiting van het AZC Goes

MPs Van den Hul and Kuiken asked the State Secretary and Minister whether the closure of the Goes asylum reception centre, and the forced relocation of families with school-age children, was communicated in time and whether education continuity is protected. The State Secretary answered that the closure is a justified capacity decision, that schools and parents were informed promptly, and that COA plans relocations during school holidays to protect continuity, without committing to a new meeting with COA.
However, I do not consider this to outweigh the (societal) costs of maintaining too many reception places.
Ik vind dit echter niet opwegen tegen de (maatschappelijke) kosten die gepaard gaan met het in stand houden van teveel opvangplekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat asielzoekers weigeren om toiletten schoon te maken in een asielzoekerscentrum

Fritsma (PVV) asks the State Secretary whether asylum seekers refusing to clean toilets at an Alkmaar reception centre should be denied asylum and expelled, and whether a full asylum stop should be introduced. Harbers answers that residents are jointly responsible for cleaning, that cleanliness is not relevant to protection needs assessed by the IND, and refers to earlier answers on regional reception and international obligations.
Whether an individual asylum seeker is willing to clean toilets says nothing about whether that person needs protection.
Of een individuele asielzoeker wel of niet bereid is om toiletten schoon te maken, zegt niets over de vraag of deze persoon wel of geen bescherming nodig heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over de bevindingen van de onderzoekscommissie Gezondheidsklachten Ter Apel

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Laçin asked whether the government would answer earlier questions on health complaints among COA staff at Ter Apel now that the investigative commission has reported, and whether it endorses its conclusions and what technical and psychosocial measures will follow. The Secretary of State endorses the commission's conclusions, reports that COA has begun cleaning, ventilation and lighting fixes with monitoring planned, and describes conversations with staff to restore trust.
I endorse the recommendations and conclusions of the investigative commission.
Ik onderschrijf de aanbevelingen en conclusies van de onderzoekscommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over het bericht dat de EU meebetaalt aan dodelijke grensbewaking in Turkije

MPs Van Dijk and Karabulut asked whether EU funds paid for armoured vehicles used in lethal border guarding in Turkey, how much Dutch money is involved, and whether non-refoulement is breached. The government answered that the IPA-funded surveillance project serves border security, that the vehicles are unarmed and restricted to surveillance by contract, that reports of killings could not be independently verified, and that Turkey's border management is understandable given the refugee burden.
However, there is currently insufficient support for suspension.
Voor opschorting bestaat momenteel echter onvoldoende draagvlak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Kops over het bericht dat Amsterdam krakende asielzoekers laat zitten

Two PVV MPs asked why undocumented asylum seekers in Amsterdam ('we are here') have been able to squat buildings for years, why the municipality does not enforce the squatting ban, and why they are not detained and deported. The State Secretary answered that the group is under a departure obligation, that forced return is not always possible due to missing travel documents and lack of cooperation by countries of origin, and that courts have largely upheld eviction orders, while referring to a separate letter for the specific case.
For more information on the case the news report concerns, I refer you to the letter the Minister of Justice and Security will send to your House alongside these questions.
Voor meer informatie over de casus waarop het nieuwsbericht van de Telegraaf betrekking heeft, verwijs ik u naar de brief die de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Kuik over sugardating

MPs Van der Staaij and Kuik asked whether sugardating platforms that connect young women with wealthy men for sex amount to illegal prostitution or trafficking, whether they should be regulated or investigated, and whether municipalities can act against their advertising. The state secretary answered that no specific permit is needed, existing criminal law (art. 273f) suffices against exploitation, consultations with site operators are constructive, no indications of exploitation are known to the prosecution service, and no further investigation or new municipal powers are planned.
I currently see no reason to conduct further research into this.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om hier verder onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht 'Kerncijfers Asiel en Migratie'

An MP asked the State Secretary for figures on immigrants from Islamic countries for 2016 and 2017, and why earlier answers said the CBS used no such list. The government gave the 2016 and 2017 numbers of granted asylum and regular residence applications, but said no list of Islamic countries is kept and that such figures have limited significance.
For answering earlier parliamentary questions on migration from 'Islamic countries' in the Justice and Security budget, a list of countries whose majority of inhabitants adhere to Islam was used.

Voor de beantwoording van eerdere Kamervragen in het kader van de JenV-begroting omtrent migratie uit «islamitische landen» is gebruik gemaakt van een lijst van landen waarvan de meerderheid van de inwoners zich tot het islamitische geloof rekent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over veiligheid over verhoogde leges voor RANOV-vergunninghouders

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why RANOV permit holders must now pay 401 euro in fees to extend their residence permits, questioning the burden on low-income families and why naturalisation is still difficult. The State Secretary replied that after ten years of residence the exemption no longer applies, that alternative permits cost 161 euro, and that the IND gave advance notice, while declining to change the naturalisation document requirements.
After at least 10 years of residence in the Netherlands on the basis of a RANOV permit, there is no longer any ground to exempt this group from fee charges.
Na minimaal 10 jaar verblijf in Nederland op grond van een RANOV-vergunning is er geen grond meer om deze groep vrij te stellen van legesheffing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht dat Parijs een strenger en sneller asielbeleid wil

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about France's plan for stricter and faster asylum policy, including detention, repeat applications and criminalising irregular border crossing. The State Secretary replied that Dutch detention rules already reach EU maximums, that criminal conduct cannot generally justify detention under the Return Directive, that the French border-crossing offence was dropped by the Conseil d'Etat, and that the government cooperates with France and other EU states.
In consultation with a number of other Member States, I am examining whether broadening the possibilities for this is possible, in compliance with European regulations and case law.
In afstemming met een aantal andere lidstaten onderzoek ik of verbreding van de mogelijkheden hiertoe, met inachtneming van Europese regelgeving en jurisprudentie, mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over tien jaar generaal pardon

An MP asked the State Secretary about children and adults who received residence permits under the 2007 RANOV amnesty and now struggle to obtain Dutch nationality because they cannot prove their nationality, including questions on fees, minors' self-representation and applicable exceptions. The State Secretary answered that no exception for proof of nationality will be made, that the burden of obtaining documents lies with the applicant, and that the requested figures cannot be generated from IND systems.
No, I am not willing to do so.
Nee, daartoe ben ik niet bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Van der Graaf over het bericht 'Honderden Roma-kinderen in Nederland uitgebuit'

MPs Kuik and Van der Graaf asked about reports that hundreds of Roma children in the Netherlands are exploited, the discrepancy in figures, and what is being done about child exploitation, including handover of minors to unverified relatives. The State Secretary answered that ethnicity is not recorded, estimates are tens of cases with a broader humanitarian definition giving higher numbers, and pointed to continued programmes, a child exploitation expert group, an EU project, and planned measures.
The exact numbers of Roma children are not known to me because ethnicity is not registered by the Public Prosecution Service (OM) and the police.
De exacte aantallen Roma-kinderen zijn mij niet bekend omdat niet wordt geregistreerd op etniciteit door Openbaar Ministerie (hierna: OM) en politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het uitzetten van mensen met een dubbele nationaliteit

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the treatment of asylum seekers holding dual Syrian-Armenian nationality, including why some are returned to Armenia years later, how many are affected, and whether living conditions there are poor. The State Secretary replied that dual nationals are assessed for safe return to their other country, that Armenian-Syrians who concealed Armenian nationality may have their status reviewed, that data on their numbers is not registered separately, and that conditions in Armenia are considered reasonable.
How many people this concerns is unknown, since this is not separately registered in the automated systems of the IND and the DT&V.
Om hoeveel personen het hierbij gaat is onbekend, aangezien dit in het geautomatiseerde systeem van de IND en in dat van de Dienst Terugkeer en Vertrek (DT&V) niet apart wordt geregistreerd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de berichten 'Ex-moslims regelmatig bedreigd in Nederland' (Reformatorisch Dagblad, 20 januari 2018) en 'Duits parlement wil antisemitische asielzoekers uitzetten'

An SGP MP asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and Justice about reports on threats against ex-Muslims in the Netherlands and German proposals to deport antisemitic asylum seekers, asking about frequency, response and whether asylum status should be affected. The government said it knows of no confirmed cases of secret gatherings, outlined victim-support and anti-discrimination measures, and said antisemitism and deportations for it are not separately registered.
Whether there is antisemitism among asylum seekers is not registered.
Of er sprake is van antisemitisme onder asielzoekers, wordt niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht “Asielzoeker mag tweede vrouw uit Syrië halen in belang van kinderen”

Rep. Azmani asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether a news report that an asylum seeker may bring a second wife from Syria in the children's interest was accurate, whether such requests occurred before, and whether Dutch policy would reject polygamous family reunification. The State Secretary answered that polygamous family reunification is refused under public order and is not in the child's interest, that the IND has rejected such requests, and that the rules are clear.
A polygamous marriage is contrary to public order.
Een polygaam huwelijk is in strijd met de openbare orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat illegalen in Nederland te lang worden opgesloten in detentiecentra

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports that immigration detainees are held too long, about Amnesty International's reports, legal aid at first hearings, detention of persons who cooperate with return, the 18-month limit, detention conditions and the Zeist family facility. The State Secretary largely defended the current system as adequate and compliant with EU rules, and promised a fuller reaction in the upcoming debate on the return and immigration detention bill.
I am of the view that the legal protection of aliens in immigration detention is adequately safeguarded.
Ik ben van mening dat de rechtsbescherming van vreemdelingen in vreemdelingenbewaring adequaat is geborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht 'Kerncijfers Asiel en Migratie'

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why Syrians cannot be returned to Turkey under the EU-Turkey deal yet still receive residence permits in the Netherlands, and urged halting permits and asylum for Syrians and immigrants from Islamic countries. The State Secretary answered that the EU-Turkey deal reduced crossings, that a country-of-origin report on Syria is due in summer 2018, that the Netherlands grants asylum only after careful procedure, and refused to halt asylum or admission of immigrants from Islamic countries, saying no such list is used.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de veranderde situatie in Turkije en vluchtelingen in Turkije

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about the effect of the diplomatic freeze with Turkey on the EU-Turkey migrant deal, the Turkish offensive in Afrin, reports of Turkish border guards shooting Syrian refugees, and whether the EU itself should investigate rights abuses. The government answered that the freeze does not affect implementation, which the European Commission monitors, that border shootings are unacceptable but no instructions to shoot exist, and that Turkey itself bears responsibility for refugees while the Commission monitors the deal; it declined to draft a new country report for now.
It is therefore not for the European Union to provide guarantees on this.
Het is dan ook niet aan de Europese Unie om hier garanties op te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht dat een groeiende groep Syriërs terug wil naar huis

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why IOM does not help Syrians who want to return voluntarily to relatively safe regions, and whether Dutch obstacles exist and when a new country report on Syria will come. The government explained IOM's reasons for not assisting (limited presence, unsafe situation, UN relations with the Assad regime), stated that no Dutch obstacles exist and that DT&V can help returnees, and said a new country report is expected in summer 2018.
On the Dutch government's side there are no obstacles preventing the voluntary return of Syrians.
Van de zijde van de Nederlandse overheid zijn er geen obstakels die de vrijwillige terugkeer van Syriërs verhinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Groeiende groep vluchtelingen uit Syrië wil terug naar huis’

MP Bisschop asked why IOM does not assist Syrian refugees who voluntarily want to return, whether asylum policy for Syria should be revised, how permits are reviewed, and what support for return is possible. The State Secretary answered that IOM's operational limits and UN considerations prevent its help, that DT&V can assist individuals, and that no policy change is planned before the new Syria country report expected in summer 2018.
On the basis of that country report I will determine whether a policy adjustment is needed.
Op basis van dat ambtsbericht zal ik bepalen of aanpassing van beleid aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat een vierjarige alleen wordt uitgezet naar Liberia

MP Jasper van Dijk asks the State Secretary whether the IND planned to deport a four-year-old alone to Liberia because her great-grandmother followed the wrong procedure, and what policy applies to deporting young children. The State Secretary replies that a residence permit has already been granted, explains the MVV requirement and the general return policy for minors, and states there was never a plan to send the child alone.
Contrary to what the report states, there has never been a plan to deport the minor alone to Liberia.
Anders dan weergegeven in het bericht is er geen sprake geweest van een plan om de minderjarige alleen naar Liberia uit te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht 'Marine (19) wil officier van justitie worden, maar waar blijft haar paspoort?'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a news report on a 19-year-old Marine whose naturalisation under the general pardon scheme was delayed, and about the handling of naturalisation applications. The State Secretary answered that 48% of pardon-scheme recipients had become Dutch, that communication channels with municipalities were being reinforced without a firm timeline, and that children cannot be naturalised separately if the parent's application is refused.
I have therefore once again brought to attention the existing instruction for staff of the chain service line to connect to a specialised employee for substantive questions.

Ik heb daarom de – al bestaande – instructie voor medewerkers van de ketenservicelijn om bij inhoudelijke vragen door te verbinden met een gespecialiseerde medewerker nogmaals onder de aandacht gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het niet verlenen van asiel aan LHBTI’s afkomstig uit Cuba

The MP asks why the government introduced a transit visa requirement for Cubans that may block LGBTI asylum seekers, and why it does not reassess Cuba asylum policy given reported discrimination. The State Secretary answers that the transit visa aims to check travel documents and intentions, that the IND assesses each asylum claim individually, and that there is no general reason to assume LGBTI people need protection from return to Cuba.
I cannot judge on the basis of that article whether and to what extent these stories are truthful.
Ik kan op grond van dat artikel niet beoordelen of en in hoeverre deze verhalen waarheidsgetrouw zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Jong, Fritsma, De Graaf, en Wildersover het bericht "Te weinig geld voor bijstandsuitkeringen vluchtelingen”.

PVV MPs asked whether municipalities' welfare shortfalls caused by migrant inflow should be addressed by ending benefits for status holders, requiring ten years' residence before benefit eligibility, and closing borders. The minister replied that benefits are a legal right for all residents below the minimum income, that the shortfall is partly offset by temporary Rijk advances, that existing language-related benefit reductions stay, and that no rule changes are planned.
I see no reason to change the rules in this regard.
Ik zie geen reden om de regels hieromtrent aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het ambtsbericht Afghanistan

The SP MP Jasper van Dijk asked why the November 2016 Afghanistan country report omitted UNHCR Eligibility Guidelines points on persecution risks for westernised returnees, supporters of the government, former KhAD/WAD staff and Christians, and when a new report would come. State Secretary Harbers replied that UNHCR guidelines are authoritative but not primarily fact-finding sources, that Christians are covered in the report, and that a new thematic report is expected in May with a policy assessment to follow.
The UNHCR Eligibility Guidelines were not primarily drafted as a source of factual country information.
De Eligibility Guidelines van de UNHCR zijn niet primair opgesteld als bron van feitelijke landeninformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Wel hier geboren, maar géén nationaliteit: 112 Amsterdamse kinderen zijn 'staatloos'

MPs Groothuizen and Bergkamp asked about reports that 112 Amsterdam children born in the Netherlands are stateless, including whether parents without lawful residence are denied benefits and whether a procedure to establish statelessness exists. The State Secretary replied that a bill creating a court procedure to establish statelessness and an option right for stateless children is forthcoming, and that the Koppelingsbeginsel bars benefits to unlawfully resident parents while lawfully resident stateless persons remain entitled.
The Cabinet then committed to close this gap and to develop a establishment procedure on a statutory basis.
Het Kabinet heeft daarop toegezegd deze leemte op te vullen en een vaststellingsprocedure te zullen ontwikkelen op wettelijke grondslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het uitzetten van uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers naar Soedan

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the government would reconsider returns to Sudan after Belgium reportedly saw a deported Sudanese man tortured on return, and whether it would investigate or impose a moratorium. The State Secretary answered that the Dutch situation differs from the Belgian one, that no concrete signal of serious irregularities after Dutch returns had been received, and that no monitoring after return is part of the policy, so no investigation or policy change is planned.
Furthermore, only a concrete and substantiated signal of serious irregularities after a removal from the Netherlands can give cause to start an investigation in an individual case.
Verder kan slechts een concreet en onderbouwd signaal van ernstige onregelmatigheden na een uitzetting vanuit Nederland aanleiding vormen om in een individueel geval onderzoek te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Jasper van Dijk, Groothuizen en Kuiken over de uitzettingen van afgewezen asielzoekers naar Soedan

Four MPs asked whether the Netherlands should investigate the fate of Sudanese asylum seekers deported to Sudan after Belgium opened an inquiry into alleged torture of deportees, whether Sudanese diplomats played a role in deportations, and whether they gather information on asylum seekers in the Netherlands. The Secretary of State refused to start an own investigation or pause deportations, arguing the Dutch situation differs from Belgium's and no concrete signal of irregularities was received, and denied knowledge of diplomats gathering information.

The investigation started by the Belgian government into statements from some Sudanese foreigners expelled by Belgium is for me no reason to conduct an independent investigation into deportation to Sudan or to suspend return to Sudan.

Het onderzoek dat de Belgische regering is gestart naar de verklaring van enkele door België uitgezette Sudanese vreemdelingen vormt voor mij geen reden om een eigenstandig onderzoek te doen naar uitzetting naar Sudan dan wel om terugkeer naar Sudan op te schorten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het doel van 3FM Serious Request, het herenigen van ouders en vermiste kinderen na een ramp of conflict

An MP asked the ministers whether they know of the Red Cross Restoring Family Links work to reunite families and missing children after disasters and conflicts, how the government supports it, whether it will put prevention of child disappearance on the EU and UN agenda, and how it reduces the vulnerability of young migrants in Europe. The government answered that it funds the ICRC and UNHCR, supports family reunification projects, pushes for child protection in the UN Global Compacts, and works on child trafficking via EMPACT, without new binding commitments.
The Netherlands works to trace missing persons, restore contact with family and make reunification possible.
Nederland zet zich in om vermiste personen op te sporen, contacten met familie te herstellen en hereniging mogelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jetten over het uitstempelen van zeevarenden in de haven van Rotterdam

An MP asked whether stamping departing non-EU seafarers' documents in Rotterdam harbour, after a practice change in 2016, distorts the level playing field for the maritime repair sector and whether it is in line with the Schengen Border Code given a 2017 court ruling. The State Secretary answered that the Schengen Code applies uniformly across member states, that exit stamps are only placed when departure is imminent, and that the government is appealing the court ruling and negotiating working arrangements with the sector.
In my view this ruling does not do justice to the provisions of the Schengen Border Code. I have therefore lodged an appeal against the ruling of the Hague District Court, Rotterdam sitting.

Naar mijn mening doet deze uitspraak geen recht aan de bepalingen van de Schengengrenscode. Ik heb daarom tegen de uitspraak van de rechtbank Den Haag, zittingsplaats Rotterdam, hoger beroep ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de behandeling van Faisal S, een homoseksuele asielzoeker die dreigde te worden uitgezet naar Pakistan

An MP asks the State Secretary about the treatment of a gay Pakistani asylum seeker, including reports of naked detention, arrest by non-police officers at a COA centre, late lawyer involvement, and whether the asylum claim should be granted. The State Secretary declines to discuss individual cases, says asylum claims from Pakistan are assessed on their merits, and rejects an independent complaints committee while promising to review IND credibility assessment practice with interest groups.
I will not go into individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over reddingsmissies op zee

Two SP MPs asked the government whether Libya is unsafe for refugees, whether EU support for the Libyan coast guard makes the EU complicit in returns, and about rescue NGOs, corruption and an alleged Italian intelligence infiltration of a Save the Children ship. The government agreed Libya is unsafe, said it works with UNHCR and IOM on conditions and voluntary return, defended EU training with vetting, said rescued persons fall under Libyan jurisdiction, and declined to comment on foreign investigations.
The Netherlands cannot provide information about foreign investigations.
Nederland kan geen informatie verstrekken over buitenlandse onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de omstandigheden van vluchtelingen in Libië

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about reports of refugees being sold as slaves in Libya, EU support to the Libyan coast guard, detention conditions and voluntary return. The government answered that it is concerned, is pursuing an integrated EU approach with IOM and UNHCR, rejects that the EU returns refugees to Libya, and defends its training and monitoring of the Libyan coast guard.
The cabinet is affected by the recent harrowing images of de facto slave trade in Libya.
Het kabinet is getroffen door de recente schrijnende beelden van de facto slavenhandel in Libië.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de verslechterende omstandigheden van asielzoekers op de Griekse eilanden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about deteriorating conditions for asylum seekers in Greek island hotspots, including overcrowding, lack of basic provisions, slow asylum procedures, vulnerability screening, winter shelter and the EU-Turkey deal's success. The State Secretary answered that Greece bears primary responsibility for reception, that the Commission monitors the situation, that EU funding has been provided, and that no additional Dutch measures or accelerated family reunification steps are deemed necessary.
Because Greece has no central registration system, no reliable figures are available for the data requested in questions 4, 6 and 7.
2 Doordat er geen centraal registratiesysteem in Griekenland 3 is, zijn er geen betrouwbare cijfers beschikbaar met betrekking tot de in de vragen 4, 6 en 7 gevraagde gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Kuik over het bericht '95 procent van gemeenten heeft geen beleid voor aanpak mensenhandel'

MPs Segers and Kuik asked the State Secretary about reports that 95 percent of municipalities lack anti-trafficking policy, the responsibility of municipalities for victim care, implementation of the Lenferink commission's recommendations, and inconsistent thresholds for the reflection period across border-control agencies. The State Secretary replied that only 4.5 percent of municipalities have specific trafficking policy, promised joint work with stakeholders on victim care and a uniform reflection-period approach, and said a further plan would follow.
Following this report, I will agree further arrangements with the police, the Royal Netherlands Marechaussee and the Inspectorate SZW to reach a uniform way of offering the reflection period.

Naar aanleiding van dit rapport zal ik in overleg met de politie, de Koninklijke Marechaussee en de Inspectie SZW nadere afspraken maken om te komen tot een uniforme wijze van aanbieden van de bedenktijd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het niet herkennen van signalen van mensenhandel door artsen

An SGP MP asked the State Secretaries whether doctors fail to recognise human trafficking signals, whether trafficking should be added to the meldcode for domestic violence and child abuse, how doctors can be trained, and what role municipalities should play. The minister answered that the existing meldcode can support professionals on trafficking, medical bodies can extend it, and the Lenferink recommendations are being pushed at municipalities, with an integrated action plan promised.

In the talks I am having on the meldcode for domestic violence and child abuse, I will emphasise with the KNMG doctors' federation this possibility and the important role of medical professional groups in it.

In de gesprekken die ik voer over de meldcode huiselijk geweld en kindermishandeling zal ik met de artsenfederatie KNMG deze mogelijkheid en de belangrijke rol hierin van de medische beroepsgroepen benadrukken.

m: Amendement van de leden Heite en Ceder over de extra benodigde middelen voor kennisveiligheid te bekostigen uit defensiebudgetten
Moves 8.1 million euro for knowledge security costs from the education budget to the defence budget.
It seems more logical to finance these anticipated expenditures from article 9 of the Defence budget.
Het ligt eerder voor de hand deze voorziene uitgaven te financieren uit artikel 9 van de Defensiebegroting.
Motie van de leden Van der Wal en Heite over een certificeringsregeling voor bedrijven in de Nederlandse defensie- en veiligheidssector
Asks the government to develop a certification scheme for defence and security sector companies.
requests the government to develop a certification scheme for companies in the Dutch defence and security sector
verzoekt de regering een certificeringsregeling te ontwikkelen voor bedrijven in de Nederlandse defensie- en veiligheidssector
Motie van het lid Stultiens c.s. over zeer coulant en ruimhartig omgaan met bezwaren die buiten de nieuwe termijn van zestien weken worden ingediend
Motion asking the government to handle objections filed after the new sixteen-week deadline leniently and take parents' capacity into account.
requests the government not to act unnecessarily formalistically, to handle objections very leniently and generously
verzoekt de regering om niet onnodig formalistisch te werk te gaan, zeer coulant en ruimhartig om te gaan met bezwaren
Motie van het lid Heite c.s. over binnen de bestaande budgettaire kaders een team inrichten dat gemeenten ondersteunt bij de brede ondersteuning
